title: What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics? Lessons from 123 Rounds of Agentic Skill Discovery
summary: Can a robot improve itself the way coding agents now improve software? We built an agentic system to find out. It watches a robot fail, works out which capability is missing, writes new skills or finds and installs external models, tests every change in simulation, and repeats, with no human writing robot code. We ran it for 123 improvement rounds on household manipulation tasks. This report describes what we learned. The good news is that the agent can discover capabilities on its own: noticing that its targets were out of view, it asked for an active-viewing model, debugged it, and deployed a working search skill. The bad news is that its improvements did not add up. Changes kept passing their tests, yet the target task, putting condiments on the top shelf of a fridge, never succeeded. We found that the agent was rarely the bottleneck. Three things around it were. First, chained perception modules do not understand relations. Segmenters such as SAM 3 find shelves but not "the top shelf", so the agent filled the gap with ever more geometric rules that never converged, when what it needed was a different kind of model. Second, skill chains lock learning onto the first step. Long tasks mostly fail early, so evidence and fixes pile up there, and later skills are rarely reached, tested, or improved. Third, what the agent learns is decided by the harness. The agent optimized exactly what the evaluator measured, including where it was wrong, and weak tests and misleading memory turned activity into a standstill. We distill these lessons into concrete recommendations for building robot systems that improve themselves, each paired with an experiment that could prove it wrong.

AI.tldr: 我们构建了一个智能体系统，让机器人在无人工写码的情况下自我改进：观察失败、识别缺失能力、编写技能或安装外部模型、在仿真中测试并迭代，共进行123轮家庭操作任务的改进实验。
AI.motivation: 探索机器人能否像编程智能体改进软件那样改进自身，即能否在无人编写机器人代码的情况下自主发现并补齐能力。
AI.method: 构建一个智能体系统：监控机器人失败、推断缺失能力、编写新技能或寻找并安装外部模型、在仿真中测试每次改动，并循环迭代，全程无需人工编写机器人代码；在家庭操作任务上运行123轮改进。
AI.result: 好消息是智能体可自主发现能力，例如察觉目标不在视野内后请求主动观察模型、调试并部署搜索技能。坏消息是改进无法累积：改动持续通过各自测试，但目标任务（把调味品放到冰箱顶层）始终未成功。瓶颈很少在智能体本身，而在于三点环境因素。
AI.conclusion: 提出机器人自我改进系统的具体建议，并为每条建议配有可证伪的实验：感知模块需理解关系（如区分"顶层"）、技能链需避免学习锁定在首步、以及需要控制测试框架与记忆对智能体学习内容的决定作用。

title: Robot Manipulation with GPT-6-Astra: Body Knowledge, Experience Reuse, Emergent Skills, and Sim2Real Transfer
comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Code, data, prompts, and skills: https://github.com/hesd10/astra-robot-sim2real
summary: General-purpose multimodal agents can write robot-control programs, but repeated exploration and model-mediated action selection can make execution slow. We study how external body knowledge, successful experience, and executable skills improve an XLeRobot controlled by GPT-6-Astra in a simulated and a physical elevator-button task. In 30 fixed-start simulation trials, complete robot geometry and camera information reduce mean completion time by 57.4% relative to a baseline with only the common control interface and no prior experience; images with synchronized action and state records reduce it by 68.6% without additional body assets. In nine paired comparisons (18 trials) at starts displaced by 10-100 cm, experience recorded at the original start reduces mean time by 58-63% relative to no experience, demonstrating generalization to the tested new starting positions. During experience experiments, GPT-6-Astra spontaneously generates a short visual-feedback program. Researcher-refactored versions reduce mean local-task time by 29-31% in 27 simulation trials. Finally, 12 real-robot trials using operator-confirmed button contact demonstrate sim2real reuse: at a shared nominal start, simulation XML assets and simulation experience reduce mean time by 53.0% and 49.9%, respectively; real experience also transfers to two new starts. These results suggest a practical way to build general-purpose manipulation experiments around GPT-6-Astra: supply machine-readable body descriptions and synchronized demonstrations, and turn useful agent-generated feedback routines into reusable skills, while the agent adapts actions from current images. We release all task prompts, trial-level experimental data, and acquired skill implementations at https://github.com/hesd10/astra-robot-sim2real.

AI.tldr: 研究如何通过外部身体知识、成功经验与可执行技能，提升由GPT-6-Astra控制的XLeRobot在电梯按钮任务中的执行效率，并验证仿真到真机的迁移。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态智能体虽能编写机器人控制程序，但反复探索和模型介导的动作选择导致执行缓慢，需要研究如何利用外部知识与经验来加速执行。
AI.method: 在仿真和物理电梯按钮任务中，对比提供完整机器人几何与相机信息、同步动作与状态记录的图像等条件；在位移起点进行配对实验；将智能体自发生成的视觉反馈程序重构为可复用技能；并开展真机实验验证sim2real复用。
AI.result: 仿真中完整几何与相机信息使平均完成时间降低57.4%，同步图像记录降低68.6%；位移起点下经验使时间降低58-63%；重构技能使局部任务时间降低29-31%；真机中仿真XML资产与经验分别降低53.0%和49.9%，真机经验也可迁移到新起点。
AI.conclusion: 围绕GPT-6-Astra构建通用操作实验的实用方法是：提供机器可读身体描述与同步演示，将智能体生成的有用反馈例程转化为可复用技能，同时让智能体从当前图像自适应动作。

title: Reduced Cartesian Kinetostatics for Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots: Residual-Stabilized Full-Shape Propagation
summary: Many planning and control tasks for tendon-driven continuum robots (TDCRs) require the complete Cartesian backbone geometry. We present a reduced Cartesian framework for planar, axially compressible TDCRs that propagates equilibrium configurations along prescribed tendon-force and tendon-displacement trajectories. The backbone is represented by two global position fields. Following exact variation, a Taylor-Galerkin reduction condenses prescribed spatial properties and distributed loads into offline moment vectors, yielding analytic reduced residuals and Jacobians without online spatial quadrature or numerical differentiation. Analytical differentiation and residual correction yield first-order rate systems requiring one fixed-dimensional linear solve per rate evaluation after initial equilibrium alignment on a regular branch. Across four simulated cases covering variable tendon routing, nonuniform geometry, axial compression, and their combined effects, the propagated Cartesian shapes and distributed strains closely match pointwise geometrically variable-strain (GVS) equilibrium solutions. Residual correction suppresses propagation drift across the tested step sizes while adding only about 0.98% to the mean update time of uncorrected Euler. The proposed method requires 0.508 ms per update on average, approximately 11 times faster than pointwise GVS solves. Displacement-driven experiments yield a maximum normalized mean backbone position error of 1.02% and a maximum end-effector position error of 0.28%. These results support efficient and accurate Cartesian full-shape prediction along prescribed actuation paths.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于平面、轴向可压缩腱驱动连续体机器人（TDCR）的降阶笛卡尔框架，可沿预设的腱力与腱位移轨迹传播平衡构型，快速准确地获得完整骨干几何。
AI.motivation: TDCR的规划与控制任务需要完整的笛卡尔骨干几何，但逐点几何变应变（GVS）平衡求解计算量大，难以满足实时性需求。
AI.method: 采用两个全局位置场表示骨干，经精确变分与Taylor-Galerkin降阶，将空间属性与分布载荷离线凝聚为矩向量，得到解析的降阶残差与雅可比，无需在线空间积分或数值微分；结合解析微分与残差修正，在初始平衡对齐后每次速率评估只需一次固定维线性求解。
AI.result: 四个仿真案例（变腱路由、非均匀几何、轴向压缩及其组合）中，传播的笛卡尔形状与分布应变与逐点GVS解高度吻合；残差修正抑制传播漂移，仅增加约0.98%的平均更新时间；平均每次更新0.508 ms，约为逐点GVS求解的11倍加速；位移驱动实验中骨干位置最大归一化平均误差1.02%，末端位置最大误差0.28%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法支持沿预设驱动路径的高效、精确笛卡尔全形状预测，适用于TDCR的实时规划与控制。

title: Timed Rule-Based Supervision of an End-to-End Autonomous Parking Policy
summary: We study whether a manually specified runtime supervisor can correct recurring failures of an existing end-to-end parking policy in a fixed CARLA parking lot. The vision-based Transformer architecture is inherited from Yang et al.; our contribution is a timed, rule-based Parametric Safety Shield (PSS) applied to its control outputs. The PSS uses hand-calibrated speed, position, and duration thresholds to intervene in observed failure modes, including boundary exits, delayed braking, and stalled or oscillatory control. In the reported closed-loop evaluation, 16 held-out target slots and six initial poses are each evaluated in four rounds (384 attempts per configuration). Target success increases from 327/384 (85.16%) for the retrained policy to 375/384 (97.66%) with the PSS; mean position and orientation errors among successful attempts are 0.21m and 0.33 degrees. These results show an improvement within this simulator setup. The repeated attempts share one map, vehicle, and sensor configuration, and the PSS uses simulator world coordinates; thus the results do not establish generalization to other lots or real vehicles, or a formal safety guarantee.

AI.tldr: 在固定 CARLA 停车场中，为已有端到端泊车策略加装手工标定的定时规则型参数化安全盾（PSS），将目标成功率从 85.16% 提升至 97.66%。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端泊车策略在闭环运行中会出现反复失败（如越界、制动延迟、停滞或振荡），作者希望验证一个手动设定的运行时监督器能否在不重新训练策略的前提下纠正这些失败。
AI.method: 视觉 Transformer 架构沿用 Yang 等人的工作；本文贡献是对其控制输出施加定时、基于规则的参数化安全盾（PSS）。PSS 使用手工标定的速度、位置和时长阈值，针对已观测到的失败模式（边界越出、制动延迟、停滞或振荡控制）进行干预。闭环评估设定：16 个留出目标车位 × 6 个初始位姿，每种配置 4 轮，共 384 次尝试。
AI.result: 目标成功率由重训练策略的 327/384（85.16%）提升至加入 PSS 后的 375/384（97.66%）；成功尝试的平均位置误差 0.21 m，平均姿态误差 0.33 度。
AI.conclusion: 在该仿真器设定下性能确有提升，但所有尝试共享同一地图、车辆与传感器配置，且 PSS 依赖仿真世界坐标，因此结果不足以说明可泛化到其他停车场或真实车辆，也不构成形式化安全保证。

title: PalmLeaf-VQA: A Multi-Script Visual Question Answering Benchmark for Historical Palm-Leaf Manuscript Understanding Across Diverse Regions
summary: Historical manuscripts remain largely absent from modern vision-language benchmarks, leaving open how well multimodal large language models (MLLMs) handle culturally diverse, degraded, and non-Latin document images. We introduce \textbf{PalmLeaf-VQA}, a multi-script visual question answering benchmark for historical palm-leaf manuscript understanding across South and Southeast Asian traditions. PalmLeaf-VQA contains \textbf{923 curated manuscript images} and \textbf{7,384 question--answer pairs} from eight collection groups: Balinese, Grantha, Jathakam, Kambaramayanam, Kannada, Khmer, Sundanese, and Tamil. Unlike recognition-oriented resources, the benchmark targets manuscript-aware visual reasoning over preservation-relevant cues, including physical condition, line structure, material and coating, binding holes, margins, symbols, drawings, and localized visual artifacts. We evaluate recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs under open-answer and constrained-answer prompting and provide fine-grained analysis across collections, question categories, and task types. The strongest evaluated model reaches only \textbf{58.00\% exact-match accuracy} on the held-out test split, revealing substantial limitations in current MLLMs for rare-script, degraded-layout, and preservation-oriented document understanding. PalmLeaf-VQA provides a standardized benchmark for advancing culturally grounded and layout-aware multimodal document analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PalmLeaf-VQA，一个面向南亚与东南亚历史贝叶经手稿的多文字视觉问答基准，包含923张图像与7384个问答对，最强模型仅达58.00%准确率，揭示当前MLLM在稀有文字与退化版面理解上的不足。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉-语言基准中几乎不包含历史手稿，导致多模态大模型在文化多样、退化、非拉丁文字文档图像上的表现尚不明确，缺乏标准化评估资源。
AI.method: 构建PalmLeaf-VQA基准，涵盖八个收藏组（Balinese、Grantha、Jathakam、Kambaramayanam、Kannada、Khmer、Sundanese、Tamil），共923张精选手稿图像和7384个问答对；针对保存相关线索（物理状况、行结构、材质与涂层、装订孔、页边、符号、绘图、局部视觉伪影）设计面向手稿的视觉推理任务；在开放与受限回答提示下评估近期闭源与开源MLLM，并按收藏、问题类别与任务类型进行细粒度分析。
AI.result: 表现最好的模型在留出测试集上仅达到58.00%的精确匹配准确率，表明当前MLLM在稀有文字、退化版面及面向保存的文档理解方面存在明显局限。
AI.conclusion: PalmLeaf-VQA为推进具有文化根基且版面感知的多模态文档分析提供了标准化基准。

title: Path Planning with Motion Primitives in Dynamic Environments: SIPP on Lattices
comment: Accepted to International Conference on Interactive Collaborative Robotics (ICR 2026), Vladivostok, Russia
summary: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments is a critical challenge, particularly when spaces are shared with other mobile agents whose future trajectories are known. While traditional grid-based planners efficiently find collision-free paths, their reliance on stop-and-turn mechanics over $2^k$-connected grids produces piecewise-linear trajectories that are kinodynamically highly sub-optimal for differentially constrained robots. In this paper, we present an adaptation of Safe Interval Path Planning (SIPP) that operates on state lattices, utilizing precomputed, kinodynamically smooth motion primitives. To efficiently handle dynamic environments, we rasterize the spatiotemporal swept volumes of moving obstacles directly onto the grid, treating grid cells as atomic units of space, whose resolution is typically dictated by inherent localization noise. We perform a comprehensive comparative analysis between our lattice-based approach and $2^k$-connected grid planners across diverse topological environments. Our evaluation considers a broad spectrum of performance metrics, including planning time, path angularity, cumulative heading change (angle-over-length), and bending energy. The results demonstrate that while the expanded state space of lattice-based search increases computational overhead, it yields trajectories with significantly superior kinodynamic properties. Specifically, our method achieves a reachability comparable to highly connected grids while ensuring smooth, continuous, and physically executable paths ready for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文将安全区间路径规划(SIPP)扩展到状态栅格上，利用预计算的动力学平滑运动基元，并通过将移动障碍物的时空扫掠体栅格化来处理动态环境，实现了比2^k连通栅格规划器更优的动力学轨迹质量。
AI.motivation: 在与其他移动智能体共享的动态环境中进行自主导航是重要挑战，且这些障碍物的未来轨迹已知。传统基于栅格的规划器虽能高效找到无碰撞路径，但依赖2^k连通栅格上的停-转机制，产生分段线性轨迹，对差速约束机器人而言在运动动力学上高度次优。
AI.method: 提出安全区间路径规划(SIPP)在状态栅格上的适配方法，使用预计算的、运动动力学平滑的运动基元；为高效处理动态环境，将移动障碍物的时空扫掠体直接栅格化到栅格上，把栅格单元视为空间的原子单位，其分辨率通常由固有的定位噪声决定；在多种拓扑环境上，对基于栅格的方法与2^k连通栅格规划器进行全面对比分析。
AI.result: 评估涵盖规划时间、路径角性、累积航向变化(角度与长度之比)和弯曲能量等广泛性能指标。结果表明，栅格搜索扩展的状态空间增加了计算开销，但产生的轨迹具有显著更优的运动动力学特性；该方法达到了与高连通栅格相当的可达性，同时确保路径平滑、连续且物理可执行。
AI.conclusion: 基于状态栅格的SIPP方法以一定的计算开销换取了显著更优的运动动力学轨迹质量，能够生成可直接用于真实世界部署的平滑、连续、物理可执行路径。

title: Temporal-Attention Head Specialization During Video Diffusion Training
summary: Video diffusion transformers depend on temporal attention to coordinate information across frames, yet nearly everything known about this mechanism comes from analyzing trained models, so when and where temporal-attention structure forms during training remains poorly characterized. Population averages can also hide it, since a few specializing heads and a diffusing majority cancel in the mean. We therefore conduct a checkpoint-resolved census of every temporal-attention head across nine Open-Sora STDiT training runs spanning three model scales (306M to 1.03B parameters), scoring each head with an entropy-normalized measure of cross-frame attention concentration (CFAC) under a preregistered change-point and effect-size selection rule. The census reveals the sparse picture that averages obscure. Aggregate CFAC is flat or decreasing in every run, while a small minority of heads, roughly 4--13% in full-grid runs, develops pronounced concentration. Across seeds, the reproducible signal is positional but block-level. Selected heads repeatedly arise in the first temporal block, whereas individual head coordinates do not reproduce once block membership is accounted for. Among the analyzed 760M selected heads, attention maps converge to a small repertoire of local frame-routing motifs, self-frame diagonals and adjacent-frame bands, even when the responsible coordinates differ across runs. Correlation and ablation analyses do not establish a causal link to generated video quality, and we bound our claims accordingly. Beyond this STDiT family, the study contributes a transferable methodology. Checkpoint-resolved, per-head analysis under fixed selection rules can expose sparse temporal organization in other factorized video diffusion transformers and, with adapted routing metrics, in joint spatio-temporal architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文对九个 Open-Sora STDiT 训练过程进行逐检查点、逐注意力头的普查，发现时间注意力结构呈稀疏、位置性的块级组织。
AI.motivation: 以往对视频扩散 Transformer 中时间注意力的认识多来自已训练模型，训练过程中该结构何时、何处形成尚不清楚；且总体平均会掩盖少数专门化注意力头与多数弥散头相互抵消的现象。
AI.method: 对九个 Open-Sora STDiT 训练运行（三种规模，306M–1.03B 参数）中每个时间注意力头进行逐检查点普查，用熵归一化的跨帧注意力集中度（CFAC）打分，并采用预注册的变化点与效应量选择规则。
AI.result: 聚合 CFAC 在各运行中持平或下降，但少数头（全网格运行中约 4–13%）出现显著集中；跨随机种子可复现的信号是位置性的但属块级——被选中的头反复出现在第一个时间块，而单个头坐标在考虑块归属后不可复现。760M 规模被选头中，注意力图收敛于少量局部帧路由模式（自帧对角线与相邻帧带），即使坐标不同。相关性与消融分析未能确立与生成视频质量的因果联系。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示平均所掩盖的稀疏时间组织，并提出一种可迁移方法：在固定选择规则下进行逐检查点、逐头分析，可暴露其他分解式视频扩散 Transformer 的稀疏时间结构，并经路由度量调整后适用于联合时空架构。

title: Humanoid Badminton: Learning Dynamic Racket Skills from Limited Human Motion Data
summary: High-speed racket sports provide a demanding testbed for humanoid robots, requiring time-critical decisions, precise striking, and dynamic whole-body coordination. In badminton, fast-changing shuttle trajectories require timely contact decisions, while successful returns demand precise racket pose and velocity within a brief contact window and across a broad three-dimensional striking workspace. Human motion data provide valuable priors for such athletic skills, but usable badminton references are limited and imperfect. Direct tracking provides insufficient executable variation for diverse shuttle conditions, while purely task-driven optimization may produce unnatural motion. To address these challenges, we present a three-stage hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for dynamic humanoid badminton. First, task-randomized motion augmentation expands sparse annotated hitting events into executable target-conditioned stroke variations, forming a continuous latent skill space. Second, a high-level planner outputs continuous latent skill codes to compose these skills online according to the observed shuttle state. Third, a context-conditioned adversarial regularizer encourages more natural planner-level skill usage while preserving return performance. When deployed on a real humanoid robot, our system achieves sustained multi-skill rallies with human players, including forehand, backhand, and highly dynamic jump returns. This is the first real-world humanoid racket-sport system to demonstrate multi-skill human--robot rallies including highly dynamic jump returns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三阶段分层强化学习框架，实现真实人形机器人的动态羽毛球多技能对打（含正手、反手与跳跃回球）。
AI.motivation: 高速球拍运动（如羽毛球）对人形机器人提出严苛要求：需在极短接触窗口内做出及时的击球决策、精确控制球拍位姿与速度，并覆盖广阔的三维击球空间。人类运动数据可提供先验，但可用羽毛球参考数据稀缺且不完美——直接跟踪难以提供适应多样来球条件的可执行变化，而纯任务驱动优化易产生不自然动作。
AI.method: 三阶段分层强化学习框架：(1) 任务随机化运动增强，将稀疏标注的击球事件扩展为目标条件化的可执行击球变体，形成连续潜技能空间；(2) 高层规划器根据观测的球状态在线输出连续潜技能编码以组合技能；(3) 上下文条件对抗正则化器，在保持回球性能的同时促进更自然的规划器级技能使用。
AI.result: 在真实人形机器人上部署后，系统能与人类选手持续进行多技能对打，涵盖正手、反手及高动态跳跃回球，是首个实现多技能人机对打（含高动态跳跃回球）的真实世界人形球拍运动系统。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过分层强化学习结合人类运动先验与任务优化，成功将人形机器人的羽毛球能力从单一技能推进到多技能、高动态的真实人机对打，验证了运动增强+潜技能规划+对抗正则化路线的有效性。

title: One Evaluation, Any Operating Point: Hypernetwork-Amortized MeanFlow for 3D MRI Reconstruction
summary: Generative priors reconstruct accelerated 3D MRI well but pay heavily at deployment: tens of network evaluations per volume, and protocol-specific hyperparameter tuning. A third hidden cost is the scanner's fixed sampling pattern. We treat the whole operating point as an input. A 3D MeanFlow patch network (a one-step flow model) is fine-tuned end-to-end through a warm-started, five-iteration differentiable conjugate-gradient projection. A small hypernetwork maps the operating point (data-consistency weight, acceleration, and the Cartesian sampling pattern itself) to the network's per-channel modulation. Three findings follow. (i) Learning the acquisition is worth more than any other operating point: on clinical knee data, the learned mask gains up to +2.34 dB over the protocol's variable-density mask. This gain requires the solver: with a feed-forward reconstructor the same learned mask hurts at 4x (-1.7 dB), but with the data-consistency projection it adds +4.6 dB. (ii) One evaluation is highly effective: it beats a 20-step patch-diffusion prior by up to +3.1 dB on brain and +2.9 dB on knee. Three to five evaluations extend the front to +6 dB while using a quarter of the prior's network calls. (iii) Fully sampled targets are optional: trained self-supervised on a split of acquired samples, the reconstructor matches its supervised twin at 4x on real data. Finally, we report what failed and why: subject-adaptive acquisition from measured energy, combining self-supervision with learned acquisition, and amortising the data-consistency weight.

AI.tldr: 提出将整个加速MRI工作点（数据一致性权重、加速倍数、采样模式）作为输入，用3D MeanFlow单步流模型结合可微共轭梯度投影端到端微调，并配超网络调制，显著提升重建质量、减少网络调用并支持自监督。
AI.motivation: 生成式先验重建加速3D MRI效果好，但部署代价高：每个体数据需数十次网络评估、需按协议调超参，还有隐藏代价即扫描仪固定采样模式；作者希望把整个工作点一并作为输入来优化。
AI.method: 3D MeanFlow patch网络（单步流模型），通过热启动、五轮迭代的可微共轭梯度投影进行端到端微调；一个小超网络将工作点（数据一致性权重、加速倍数、笛卡尔采样模式本身）映射到网络逐通道调制。
AI.result: (i) 学习采样模式收益最大：临床膝关节数据上学习掩码比协议变密度掩码最高+2.34 dB；该收益依赖求解器，前馈重建下同一学习掩码在4x反而-1.7 dB，而在数据一致性投影下+4.6 dB。(ii) 单次评估非常高效：在脑部最高+3.1 dB、膝部+2.9 dB优于20步patch-diffusion先验；三到五次评估可扩展到+6 dB，且网络调用仅为先验的四分之一。(iii) 全采样目标可选：用采集样本的拆分自监督训练，真实数据4x下可匹配其监督版本。
AI.conclusion: 把工作点作为输入、结合单步流模型与可微数据一致性投影，可在更少网络评估下取得更优重建，并支持自监督；同时报告了失败方向：基于实测能量做被试自适应采集、自监督与学习采集结合、摊销数据一致性权重。

title: PHIRL: Aligning Learned Rewards with Task Progress for Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Human demonstrations provide dense policy-level information but sometimes lack local precision. Human feedback presents accurate local critiques, but offers sparse evaluations rather than direct policy guidance. We propose Progress-Heuristicized Inverse Reinforcement Learning (PHIRL), a data-efficient framework that learns robust reward functions by jointly leveraging demonstrations and feedback. Specifically, we use progress, a feedback modality that describes cumulative task completion. PHIRL iteratively infers a reward function from demonstrations via inverse reinforcement learning, calculates the learned rewards over the progress-annotated demonstrations, and aligns the rewards with progress annotations over four dimensions. We evaluate PHIRL on real and simulated robot tasks, with additional exploration using a fine-tuned vision-language model to provide progress feedback. Results demonstrate that PHIRL significantly outperforms the baselines, achieving substantially higher environmental return rewards and task success with only twenty percent of demonstrations annotated. Analysis of reward-hacking scenarios demonstrates that PHIRL learned reward functions are reliable against exploitation.

AI.tldr: 提出PHIRL框架，联合利用人类示范与进度反馈，通过逆强化学习迭代学习鲁棒奖励函数，在少量标注下显著优于基线并抵抗奖励劫持。
AI.motivation: 人类示范提供密集的策略级信息但缺乏局部精度；人类反馈提供准确的局部评价但过于稀疏，缺乏直接策略指导。单一信息源各有不足，需要一种数据高效的框架来结合二者优势以学习稳健的奖励函数。
AI.method: PHIRL（Progress-Heuristicized Inverse Reinforcement Learning）。使用"进度"这一描述累积任务完成度的反馈模态。迭代地：通过逆强化学习从示范中推断奖励函数，在带进度标注的示范上计算所学奖励，并在四个维度上使奖励与进度标注对齐。评测涵盖真实与仿真机器人任务，并额外探索使用微调视觉语言模型提供进度反馈。
AI.result: PHIRL显著优于基线，仅用20%的示范标注即实现更高的环境回报奖励和任务成功率。对奖励劫持场景的分析表明，PHIRL学到的奖励函数可靠、不易被利用。
AI.conclusion: 结合示范与进度反馈的PHIRL能在少量标注下高效学习鲁棒奖励函数，优于现有基线并具备抗奖励劫持能力，同时可由微调视觉语言模型提供进度反馈，具备实际应用潜力。

title: Enhancing Foundation Models for Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification via Targeted Oversampling
summary: Remote-sensing foundation models offer strong representations for SAR imagery, but their behavior under severe long-tail class imbalance is still not well characterized. We benchmark DOFA and SAR-JEPA on the imbalanced OpenSARShip dataset and compare them with ImageNet-pretrained baselines under a fixed, training-efficient protocol that keeps the backbone frozen. To mitigate imbalance without fine-tuning, we apply four oversampling methods in embedding space exclusively to minority classes and train a lightweight classifier head on the augmented embeddings. Across both foundation models, oversampling improves Macro-F1 and test accuracy relative to their respective baselines, with the largest Macro-F1 gains observed for DOFA using ADASYN (34.39 to 38.56) and for SAR-JEPA using SVM-SMOTE (25.89 to 32.30). We also report class-wise behavior, showing that aggregate improvements can coexist with persistent failures on specific rare classes. Code for embedding extraction and reproducible multi-seed evaluation is provided to support rapid experimentation on free-tier hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文在长尾不平衡的OpenSARShip数据集上评测DOFA与SAR-JEPA两个遥感基础模型，冻结主干并在嵌入空间对少数类做四种过采样后训练轻量分类头。过采样普遍提升Macro-F1与准确率，DOFA+ADASYN、SAR-JEPA+SVM-SMOTE增益最大，但部分稀有类仍持续失败。
AI.motivation: 遥感基础模型对SAR图像有强表征能力，但其在严重长尾类不平衡下的行为尚不清楚，需要系统的基准评测。
AI.method: 在OpenSARShip不平衡数据集上对比DOFA、SAR-JEPA与ImageNet预训练基线；采用冻结主干的训练高效协议，仅在嵌入空间对少数类应用四种过采样方法（含ADASYN、SVM-SMOTE），再训练轻量分类头，并进行多种子可复现评测。
AI.result: 两种基础模型上过采样均提升Macro-F1与测试准确率；DOFA用ADASYN从34.39升至38.56，SAR-JEPA用SVM-SMOTE从25.89升至32.30；类级分析显示整体提升与特定稀有类持续失败并存。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入空间过采样可在不微调的情况下有效缓解基础模型的长尾不平衡，但稀有类性能仍需针对性改进；作者提供代码以支持在免费算力上快速实验。

title: Efficient Bezier Velocity Optimization for Free-Floating Space Manipulators
summary: We present FAVOR (Free-floating Arm Velocity Optimization with Recursive Sensitivities), a planner for collision-free reaching, tracking, and prescribed-time pre-grasp interception on an unactuated spacecraft. It optimizes Bezier joint-velocity curves with linear velocity, acceleration, and continuity constraints. Decision dimension is independent of rollout resolution. Analytical recursive sensitivities provide task and clearance gradients through the coupled base-arm motion. Parallel evaluation, caching, and incremental collision discovery reduce computation. With a seven-DoF arm and five simulated spacecraft models, FAVOR achieves 99.8% point-to-point success with 1.779 s mean computation, versus 62.9% and 50.270 s for an IK-initialized position-spline baseline. Means include failures and timeouts. FAVOR completes 30 of 36 tracking cases, versus 15 for single-step QP, and all 36 interception instances, versus 22 for the spline baseline. A controlled ablation shows that finite differences increase mean planning time 4.7-fold.

AI.tldr: FAVOR 是一种面向无驱动航天器上自由漂浮机械臂的规划器，通过优化贝塞尔关节速度曲线并结合递归灵敏度分析，实现无碰撞到达、跟踪与指定时间抓取前拦截，成功率与计算效率显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 无驱动航天器上的机械臂运动存在基座与机械臂耦合动力学，且需满足速度、加速度与连续性约束，传统IK初始化位置样条方法成功率低、耗时长，难以完成跟踪与指定时间预抓取拦截任务。
AI.method: FAVOR 优化满足线速度、加速度和连续性约束的贝塞尔关节速度曲线；决策维度与 rollout 分辨率解耦；通过解析递归灵敏度计算任务与间隙梯度以处理基座-机械臂耦合运动；采用并行评估、缓存与增量式碰撞发现降低计算量。
AI.result: 在七自由度机械臂与五种仿真航天器模型上，点对点到达成功率达99.8%，平均计算1.779秒，对比IK初始化位置样条基线的62.9%与50.270秒；跟踪任务完成36例中的30例（单步QP为15例）；全部36例拦截任务完成（样条基线为22例）；消融显示有限差分使平均规划时间增加4.7倍。
AI.conclusion: FAVOR 通过速度级贝塞尔参数化与递归灵敏度，在自由漂浮航天器机械臂上实现了高成功率、低计算代价的无碰撞到达、跟踪与规定时间预抓取拦截，明显优于IK样条基线与单步QP方法。

title: Cross-Dataset Transfer and Unknown-Class Detection in Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification
summary: Ship classification from Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery is a critical computer vision task, yet the robustness of models under deployment shifts remains unclear. While models are often trained on one dataset and deployed on another, we lack a comprehensive understanding of their cross-dataset generalization. To address this, we evaluate six pretrained models on two SAR ship datasets in three settings: in-domain classification, cross-dataset transfer, and unknown-class detection. For unknown detection, we hold out all classes one at a time. In-domain, SARDet100K gives the best balanced accuracy on both datasets (73.4\% on FUSARShip and 53.2\% on OpenSARShip). In cross-dataset transfer, we observe strong failures: some models show moderate accuracy but near-chance balanced accuracy (for example, 64.5\% accuracy but 33.3\% balanced accuracy for OpenSARShip to FUSARShip). In unknown detection, performance depends on the held-out class and dataset, while MC-dropout variance is often close to random. These findings show that cross-dataset generalization in SAR remains limited and that task-specific uncertainty scores are often more informative than MC-dropout variance for held-out-class detection, although their relative ranking depends on the dataset and held-out class.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了六种预训练模型在两个SAR舰船数据集上的域内分类、跨数据集迁移与未知类检测表现，发现跨数据集泛化能力有限。
AI.motivation: SAR图像舰船分类是重要任务，但模型常在一个数据集训练、在另一个数据集部署，其跨数据集泛化鲁棒性尚缺乏系统理解。
AI.method: 在两个SAR舰船数据集上评估六个预训练模型，设置三种场景：域内分类、跨数据集迁移、未知类检测（每次留出一类作为未知类）。
AI.result: 域内分类中SARDet100K在FUSARShip上平衡准确率73.4%、OpenSARShip上53.2%，表现最佳；跨数据集迁移出现严重失效，如OpenSARShip到FUSARShip准确率64.5%但平衡准确率仅33.3%（接近随机）；未知检测性能依赖留出类别与数据集，MC-dropout方差常接近随机。
AI.conclusion: SAR中的跨数据集泛化仍然有限；对于留出类检测，任务特定的不确定性分数通常比MC-dropout方差更具信息量，但其相对优劣取决于数据集与留出类别。

title: Differentiable Dynamics for Autonomous Micro-Mobility Navigation
summary: Autonomous micro-mobility vehicles (MMVs) such as wheelchairs, scooters, and bicycles have the potential to improve mobility access and support safe low-speed transportation in pedestrian-shared spaces. Achieving MMV autonomy will require realistic, predictable MMV motion. However, many existing autonomous vehicle stacks rely on simplified kinematic models that fail to capture key MMV characteristics such as tire slip, friction, and wheel layouts, limiting realism and gradient-based optimization. In this paper, we explore differentiable formulations of dynamics models for autonomous micro-mobility systems. We first construct DiffKBM, a differentiable version of the kinematic bicycle model (KBM). Then, we introduce DiffGM3, a differentiable formulation of the General Micro-Mobility Model (GM3), a unified tire-based dynamics formulation for micro-mobility vehicles that supports a wide range of MMV configurations. DiffKBM and DiffGM3 enable end-to-end differentiable optimization through MMV dynamics, making them suitable for integration into differentiable autonomy stacks. We evaluate these dynamics models in both open-loop and closed-loop settings: (1) open-loop trajectory matching, where DiffKBM and DiffGM3 are integrated as a dynamics layer within DiffStack and optimized to reproduce real-world MMV trajectories, and (2) closed-loop autonomous navigation, where DiffKBM and DiffGM3 are paired with a differentiable MPC controller in CrowdNav pedestrian scenarios. In the open-loop setting, DiffGM3 outperforms DiffKBM in reproducing trajectories with improvements in ADE and NLL across bicycle, scooter, and motorcycle modes, and reductions in planning loss for bicycle and motorcycle trajectories. We also find that, in closed-loop settings, DiffGM3 improves on DiffKBM's CrowdNav performance by producing 55\% fewer collisions and a 75\% lower discomfort frequency for the bicycle mode.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可微动力学模型DiffKBM与DiffGM3，用于自动驾驶微出行车辆的优化与导航。
AI.motivation: 自主微出行车辆（如轮椅、滑板车、自行车）可在行人共享空间中提升出行可达性与低速交通安全，但实现自主化需要真实且可预测的运动模型。现有自动驾驶栈多依赖简化运动学模型，无法刻画轮胎滑移、摩擦和轮布局等关键特性，限制真实性与基于梯度的优化。
AI.method: 构建DiffKBM（运动学自行车模型KBM的可微版本），并提出DiffGM3（通用微出行模型GM3的可微形式，统一基于轮胎的动力学公式，支持多种MMV构型）。两者支持端到端可微优化，可集成到可微自主栈中。
AI.result: 开环轨迹匹配中，DiffGM3在自行车、滑板车和摩托车模式下相比DiffKBM在ADE与NLL上均有改善，并在自行车和摩托车轨迹上降低规划损失。闭环CrowdNav行人场景中，自行车模式下DiffGM3相比DiffKBM碰撞减少55%、不舒适频率降低75%。
AI.conclusion: 可微动力学建模能更真实地刻画微出行车辆特性，并显著提升开环轨迹重现与闭环自主导航表现。

title: ForensicZoom: Adaptive Visual Inspection with Multimodal LLMs for Industrial-Grade Face Forgery Detection
summary: Reliable face forgery detection is critical to the security of online identity verification systems, where missed attacks compromise security and excessive false positives disrupt legitimate users. Specialized forensic detectors achieve strong detection performance but provide limited interpretability, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer strong semantic understanding and interpretable reasoning yet remain substantially weaker for face forgery detection. We argue that a key limitation lies in how visual evidence is acquired: subtle forensic artifacts may be poorly represented at standard resolution, while uniformly processing all cases at higher resolution is computationally inefficient. We therefore introduce ForensicZoom, an industrial-grade MLLM framework for adaptive visual inspection. ForensicZoom first equips a general-purpose MLLM with forensic-aware visual representations and aligns the language model with these features. Its central mechanism, NEED_ZOOM, enables the model to autonomously request magnified views of suspicious regions when the initial evidence is insufficient, turning fixed-pass classification into adaptive multi-round forensic reasoning. The zoom behavior is learned through reward shaping that balances detection accuracy with unnecessary visual inspection, concentrating additional computation on difficult cases. A final attribution optimization stage improves natural-language forensic reports while preserving detection performance. On large-scale industrial identity verification data, ForensicZoom achieves over 97% TPR at 0.1% FPR, substantially outperforming both specialized detectors and existing MLLM-based methods while producing actionable forensic attributions. These results demonstrate that ForensicZoom can provide an effective path toward accurate, interpretable, and scalable MLLM-based face forgery detection.

AI.tldr: 提出ForensicZoom，一个工业级MLLM人脸伪造检测框架，通过自适应的"放大观察"机制，在保证可解释性的同时实现高检测性能。
AI.motivation: 在线身份验证系统需要可靠的人脸伪造检测：漏检会危害安全，误报会干扰正常用户。专用取证检测器性能强但可解释性有限；多模态大语言模型（MLLM）语义理解与推理可解释性强，但在人脸伪造检测上明显偏弱。作者认为关键瓶颈在于视觉证据的获取方式：细微伪造痕迹在标准分辨率下表征不足，而统一用高分辨率处理所有样本又计算低效。
AI.method: 提出ForensicZoom框架。首先为通用MLLM配备取证感知的视觉表征，并对齐语言模型与这些特征。核心机制NEED_ZOOM使模型在初始证据不足时自主请求对可疑区域进行放大查看，将固定单次分类转为自适应多轮取证推理。通过奖励塑形学习放大行为，在检测准确率与不必要的视觉检查之间取得平衡，把额外计算集中于困难样本。最后加入归因优化阶段，提升自然语言取证报告质量而不损害检测性能。
AI.result: 在大规模工业身份验证数据上，ForensicZoom在0.1% FPR下TPR超过97%，显著优于专用检测器和现有基于MLLM的方法，同时能生成可操作的取证归因。
AI.conclusion: ForensicZoom为准确、可解释且可扩展的基于MLLM的人脸伪造检测提供了一条有效路径。

title: Game-Theoretic Control with Constrained Potential Surgery
summary: Constrained general-sum dynamic games are a popular formulation for highly interactive multi-agent planning problems. In recent years, Generalized Nash Equilibrium (GNE) solvers have achieved real-time performance for small dynamic games. However, solution speed still remains a bottleneck, and controlling even a small number of agents (e.g., more than four) in a dynamic task remains elusive. In addition, Newton solvers that focus on the first-order conditions are vulnerable to non-Nash saddle points, limiting the usefulness of the provided solution. In this work, we propose a fast and versatile interior point solver for constrained dynamic games, along with a computationally efficient second-order correction that increases the probability of converging to a local GNE solution in constrained dynamic games. The performance of the proposed method is evaluated on numerical benchmarks and a physical experiment involving scaled race cars.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种求解约束一般和动态博弈的快速通用内点法，并设计计算高效的二阶修正以提升收敛到局部广义纳什均衡的概率。
AI.motivation: 约束一般和动态博弈广泛用于高交互多智能体规划，但现有广义纳什均衡求解器速度仍是瓶颈，难以实时控制四个以上智能体；此外仅关注一阶条件的牛顿类求解器易收敛到非纳什鞍点，解的质量受限。
AI.method: 提出面向约束动态博弈的快速、通用内点法求解器；并给出一种计算高效的二阶修正，用于提高在有约束动态博弈中收敛到局部广义纳什均衡解的概率。
AI.result: 在数值基准测试以及涉及缩比赛车的物理实验中评估了所提方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提内点法求解器结合二阶修正，可在约束动态博弈中实现快速且通用的求解，并提升收敛到局部广义纳什均衡的可能性，具备在真实多智能体任务中应用的前景。

title: Learning Steadily: Accumulating Relative Point Margin Scores for Face Image Quality Assessment
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Biometrics, Behavior, and Identity Science
summary: Face Image Quality Assessment determines the suitability of captured face images for automated face recognition (FR), a critical capability for reliable biometric systems. Existing state-of-the-art FR-integrated FIQA methods suffer from temporal instability: as the feature space evolves during training, single-epoch quality estimates fluctuate, creating a moving target that undermines reliable quality prediction. We introduce CARPM-FIQA, a stabilization strategy for FR-integrated FIQA that accumulates relative point margin measurements, the ratio between intra-class compactness and inter-class separation, across the entire training trajectory rather than relying on single-epoch estimates. This cumulative averaging approach provides theoretically grounded advantages: reduced variance in quality estimates, improved mean squared error, and enhanced ranking stability with convergence guarantees as training progresses. Through controlled experiments on the SynFIQA dataset with labeled quality groups, we demonstrate that cumulative averaging achieves superior discriminative ability, and ablation studies across different training configurations confirm consistent improvements. Evaluated against twelve FIQA methods on eight challenging benchmarks with four FR models at two FMR thresholds, CARPM-FIQA places 4th (CARPM-FIQA(L)) and 6th (CARPM-FIQA(S)) of 17 compared methods by pAUC-EDC and AUC-EDC averaged across FR models and, after per-benchmark normalization, across benchmarks, staying within a few percent of the best method's normalized average for every FR model, providing a principled solution to training instability while maintaining the performance benefits of FR integration. More broadly, our work demonstrates that temporal aggregation strategies can stabilize training objectives in deep learning systems where target values inherently fluctuate due to evolving feature representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CARPM-FIQA，一种通过跨训练轨迹累积"相对点间隔"测量来稳定人脸图像质量评估（FIQA）的策略，缓解了 FR 集成式 FIQA 方法因特征空间演化导致的质量估计时间不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有最先进的 FR 集成式 FIQA 方法存在时间不稳定性：随着训练过程中特征空间不断演化，单轮次的质量估计会波动，形成"移动目标"，从而削弱可靠的质量预测能力。
AI.method: CARPM-FIQA 累积整个训练轨迹上的"相对点间隔"（类内紧凑度与类间分离度之比）测量，而非依赖单轮次估计。该累积平均方法在理论上具有优势：降低质量估计方差、改善均方误差、增强排序稳定性，并随训练进展提供收敛保证。作者在带质量标签分组的 SynFIQA 数据集上进行受控实验与消融研究。
AI.result: 在 SynFIQA 数据集上，累积平均取得更优的判别能力，消融实验证实不同训练配置下的一致改进。在八个挑战性基准、四个 FR 模型、两个 FMR 阈值下与十二种 FIQA 方法对比，CARPM-FIQA 在 17 种方法中分别位列第 4（CARPM-FIQA(L)）和第 6（CARPM-FIQA(S)）（按 pAUC-EDC 与 AUC-EDC 跨 FR 模型平均、经逐基准归一化后跨基准平均），在每种 FR 模型下均处于最佳方法归一化平均值的几个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: CARPM-FIQA 为训练不稳定性提供了有原则的解决方案，同时保持了 FR 集成的性能优势。更广泛地，本工作表明时间聚合策略可以稳定深度学习系统中因特征表示演化而固有波动的训练目标。

title: GT-VLA: Target-Conditioned Trace Guidance for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance on robotic manipulation, but they often struggle to generalize to unseen tasks, configurations, and long-horizon settings. A key challenge is that VLAs overfit to training scenes and fail to follow novel language instructions. Off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs) often provide stronger generalization, but cannot directly control robot actions. To combine the common sense of VLMs with VLA control, we propose Guided Trace VLA (GT-VLA), a steerable framework that accepts guidance from an external generalist VLM through trace-conditioned action generation. GT-VLA uses a generalist model to identify semantic guidance for the current skill, converts this guidance into a 2D visual trace, and conditions its action policy on the resulting trace-rendered observation. This design separates semantic target acquisition, trace generation, and low-level action execution, allowing high-level guidance to propagate to robot actions. GT-VLA uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with skill-specific trace and action modules for robust execution. We evaluate GT-VLA on LIBERO and a physical robot platform, showing improved generalization over recent VLA baselines in both settings. The code and additional supplemental materials are available on our project website at https://ivaniz.github.io/gt-vla/.

AI.tldr: 提出GT-VLA框架，通过外部通用视觉语言模型生成2D视觉轨迹引导VLA动作生成，提升机器人在未见任务和长时序场景下的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在机器人操作上表现良好，但难以泛化到未见任务、配置和长时序场景，容易过拟合训练场景且无法遵循新语言指令；而现成VLM虽泛化性强却不能直接控制机器人动作。
AI.method: GT-VLA接受外部通用VLM的引导，通过轨迹条件动作生成实现可操控框架：由通用模型识别当前技能的语义引导，转换为2D视觉轨迹，并将轨迹渲染观测作为动作策略的条件。设计分离了语义目标获取、轨迹生成与低层动作执行，并采用混合专家（MoE）架构配合技能特定的轨迹与动作模块。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准和物理机器人平台上评估，相比近期VLA基线在两种设置下均展现出更好的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: GT-VLA成功将VLM的常识与VLA控制能力结合，通过轨迹条件生成实现高层引导向机器人动作的传播，提升了泛化能力，代码与补充材料已在项目网站公开。

title: Language-Augmented Video Action Anticipation: Design Fundamentals, Benchmarks, and Open Challenges
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 19 tables. Review article. Supplementary material, machine-readable data, and public artifacts are available at https://github.com/mahsa7290/language-augmented-action-anticipation
summary: Action anticipation predicts future human actions from partial video under incomplete context and temporal uncertainty. Recent systems introduce large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), or language-derived semantics at different stages, but reported gains are difficult to interpret when task formulation, visual pretraining, supervision, decoder design, and evaluation code change simultaneously. The central contribution of this review is an evidence-aware design map that crosses task regime with the point at which language-derived information intervenes. We characterise task regimes along six axes. These axes organise the literature into five broad task families: single-action, sequence, object-interaction, cross-view, and planning-oriented settings. C1-C3 locate interventions in context construction, goal/intention modelling, and future decoding, while C4 is treated as an adjacent, emerging grounding/executability extension. Unlike a generic processing pipeline, the map links each intervention to an appropriate counterfactual, failure diagnosis, and permissible evidence claim. Supporting contributions include a protocol-level audit of Ego4D-LTA and EPIC-KITCHENS-100, a multidimensional evidence profile, and the Backbone-Aware Comparison and Ablation Protocol (BCAP). The unresolved EK-100 record is treated as a reporting-comparability case study and is not used as a leaderboard. Evidence for LLM benefits, goal ambiguity, and horizon effects is therefore formulated as testable hypotheses requiring matched validation, not as causal conclusions. The accompanying package contains the coded evidence, source locators, protocol metadata, and versioned catalogue used in the review.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于动作预判(action anticipation)的综述,提出以"任务情境×语言信息介入点"交叉组织的证据感知设计图谱,并配套协议级审计、多维证据画像与BCAP对比消融协议。
AI.motivation: 近期动作预判系统引入LLM、VLM或语言派生语义并报告性能提升,但由于任务表述、视觉预训练、监督信号、解码器设计与评测代码常同时变化,这些增益难以解释,缺乏可比的因果证据。
AI.method: 构建证据感知设计图谱:沿六个轴刻画任务情境,划分为五类任务族(单动作、序列、物体交互、跨视角、规划导向);用C1-C3定位语言介入于上下文构建、目标/意图建模、未来解码,C4作为相邻的grounding/可执行性扩展;并为每种介入匹配反事实、失败诊断与可允许的证据主张。支持性工作包括Ego4D-LTA与EPIC-KITCHENS-100的协议级审计、多维证据画像,以及Backbone-Aware Comparison and Ablation Protocol (BCAP)。
AI.result: 最终交付物包含编码化证据、来源定位器、协议元数据与版本化目录;EK-100未决记录仅作为报告可比性案例研究,不作排行榜使用。
AI.conclusion: 关于LLM增益、目标歧义与预测时域效应的证据被重新表述为需匹配验证的可检验假设,而非因果结论。

title: End-to-end QP-based policies: A unified perspective on robust control and robot learning
summary: We present an end-to-end QP-based policy framework that enables systematic policy construction with minimal domain-specific design, while preserving the transparency and interpretability of model-based control. The proposed policy representation supports both domain-randomized model-based auto-tuning, where policy parameters are optimized over distributions of disturbances and model variations, and black-box policy construction, where the problem is formulated in terms of a (possibly) unknown model without requiring explicit notions of states, inputs, or the underlying system dynamics. We establish connections to existing policy representations and control paradigms, including robust control, multilayer perceptrons, and robot learning, and interpret our end-to-end QP policies as a common abstraction of these approaches. We validate the resulting framework in both simulation and hardware, demonstrating a broad range of applications spanning robustness, automatic policy tuning, and control under unknown system dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种端到端基于QP的策略框架，用最少的领域设计实现系统化策略构建，同时保持模型控制的透明性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 在机器人控制中，模型控制具有透明性和可解释性但依赖领域设计，而学习型策略虽灵活却缺乏可解释性。本文希望在两者之间搭建桥梁，实现系统化且可解释的策略构建。
AI.method: 提出一种基于二次规划（QP）的端到端策略表示。该表示支持两类构建方式：一是域随机化的基于模型自动调参，在扰动和模型变化的分布上优化策略参数；二是黑盒策略构建，仅以（可能未知的）模型描述问题，无需显式定义状态、输入或系统动力学。
AI.result: 建立了该框架与鲁棒控制、多层感知机、机器人学习等现有策略表示和控制范式的联系，并将其视为这些方法的统一抽象。在仿真和硬件上验证了框架，覆盖鲁棒性、自动策略调参和未知动力学下控制等应用。
AI.conclusion: 端到端QP策略可作为多种控制与学习方法的通用抽象，兼具模型控制的可解释性和学习方法的灵活性，适用于鲁棒控制、自动调参及未知动力学控制等场景。

title: Query-aligned video frame selection for long video understanding
summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) process multimodal inputs by converting text, images, and videos into token sequences that are subsequently processed by a backbone language model. While MLLMs have achieved excellent performance in understanding the content of individual images, video understanding remains significantly more difficult because videos contain large number of video frames. MLLMs typically process only a subset of these frames, usually ranging from 8 to 64. MLLMs usually sample frames uniformly, regardless of their relevance to the question being answered. To address this limitation, several training-free, model-agnostic methods for selecting question-relevant frames have recently been proposed.
  In this work, we introduce a frame-selection method designed specifically for multiple-choice questions. We extend the query text by appending semantic cues derived from the answer choices and employ a direct query-frame alignment scoring mechanism. To the best of our knowledge, our method is the first to directly utilize answer choices as inference-time cues for selecting frames relevant to answering a question. The method first constructs a compact candidate pool by subsampling video frames at a fixed rate. The frames are then scored according to their maximum cosine similarity across all question-answer pairs to identify the most relevant frames for a given query. This approach preserves a fixed token budget while improving the relevance of the visual evidence provided to the downstream MLLM.
  We evaluate the effectiveness of our frame-selection method on the MLVU, Video-MME, and LongVideoBench benchmarks using three MLLMs: LLaVA-Mini, Qwen2-VL, and LLaVA-Video. Experimental results demonstrate that answer-aware frame selection generally outperforms uniform sampling and existing training-free frame-selection methods under the same frame budget.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向多项选择题的答案感知无训练帧选择方法，通过将答案选项的语义提示融入查询并结合查询-帧对齐打分，在相同帧预算下提升视频理解性能。
AI.motivation: MLLM处理视频时受限于token预算，通常只均匀采样8-64帧，忽略帧与问题的相关性。已有的无训练、模型无关的帧选择方法未利用多项选择题中答案选项这一关键线索。
AI.method: 针对多项选择题设计帧选择方法：首先按固定速率对视频帧子采样构建紧凑候选池；然后将答案选项的语义线索附加到查询文本中，通过计算帧与所有"问题-答案对"的最大余弦相似度对帧打分，选出最相关帧。该方法在固定token预算下提升视觉证据相关性，且首次直接将答案选项作为推理时线索。
AI.result: 在MLVU、Video-MME和LongVideoBench三个基准上，使用LLaVA-Mini、Qwen2-VL和LLaVA-Video三种MLLM评估，结果表明答案感知帧选择在相同帧预算下总体优于均匀采样和现有无训练帧选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用答案选项作为推理时的语义线索可有效提升多项选择题场景下的帧选择质量，是一种简单、无训练、模型无关的即插即用方法。

title: HapticWorld: an Interactive World Simulator with Real-time Torque Feedback
summary: Contact-rich manipulation depends on force sensing that is hard to infer from visual signals alone, both for collecting demonstrations and for training policies. Force-annotated data, however, remains hard to obtain at scale: real-robot collection ties every demonstration to physical hardware, physics simulators report contact forces that deviate systematically from real measurements, and learned world simulators, though scalable and realistic, are vision-only, so operators feel nothing during data collection and the data carries no force/torque (F/T) labels. We present HapticWorld, an interactive world simulator that predicts joint torque together with observations and renders it back to the operator in real time, closing the haptic loop between a human and a learned world model. Across three contact-rich tasks, torque feedback raises data collection throughput by 1.6 times on average. Policies trained on HapticWorld-generated demonstrations succeed in 54/60 real-world trials, approaching the 56/60 upper bound of real-world data, and far exceeding the 19/60 success rate of the vision-only baseline. Moreover, the success rates measured inside HapticWorld closely match real-world evaluation, demonstrating that HapticWorld can serve as a stand-alone F/T-conditioned policy evaluation platform.

AI.tldr: HapticWorld 是一个可交互的世界模拟器，能同时预测关节力矩与观测，并实时反馈给操作者，闭合人与学习世界模型之间的触觉回路，实现大规模力/力矩标注数据收集与策略评测。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富操作依赖力感知，而力信息难以从视觉中推断。力标注数据难以规模化获取：真机采集依赖硬件、物理模拟器的接触力与真实测量存在系统性偏差、学习型世界模拟器虽可扩展且逼真但仅支持视觉，操作者在采集时无触觉反馈，数据也不含力/力矩标签。
AI.method: 提出 HapticWorld：一个交互式世界模拟器，在预测观测的同时预测关节力矩，并将其实时渲染回传给操作者，从而在人类与学习型世界模型之间闭合触觉回路，用于力/力矩条件下的数据采集与策略训练。
AI.result: 在三项接触丰富任务中，力矩反馈使数据采集吞吐量平均提升 1.6 倍。使用 HapticWorld 生成示范训练的策略在真实世界试验中成功 54/60，接近真实数据上界 56/60，并远高于纯视觉基线的 19/60。此外，HapticWorld 内部测得的成功率与真实世界评估高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: HapticWorld 可有效提升接触丰富任务的数据采集效率与策略性能，并能作为独立的力/力矩条件策略评测平台。

title: One-Step Is Optimal: Unconditional Rectified Flows are Noise2Noise Denoisers, and Multi-Step Integration Provably Hurts---A Benchmark and Task-Based Detectability Study on Low-Dose CT
summary: Iterative and generative denoisers are increasingly used under the assumption that multi-step refinement outperforms a single regression pass. We show the opposite for \emph{label-free} denoising. An \emph{unconditional} rectified flow trained on two noisy observations of the same signal, as in Noise2Noise, has a minimiser whose one-step readout is exactly the MMSE denoiser without requiring clean targets. In contrast, multi-step integration provably departs from the MMSE solution because the flow terminates at the noisy data distribution rather than the clean-signal distribution. This departure is exact in a tractable Gaussian model and is confirmed experimentally: one-step flow matches a direct regressor, whereas multi-step Euler integration progressively reduces fidelity. Counterintuitively, the degradation increases with training quality, as a better velocity field more faithfully transports samples toward the noisy terminal law. The key ingredient is therefore the decorrelated \emph{pairing}, not the flow machinery: a one-step regressor trained on matched noisy pairs gives our best label-free result ($+1.99$,dB). We evaluate these findings on \textbf{CTDenoiser}, a controlled low-dose CT benchmark spanning five architectures and supervised, similarity-based, blind-spot, and per-image methods. Among label-free approaches, only correlated-noise-aware Noise2Sim improves over the noisy baseline, while Noise2Void is flat-to-negative because CT noise violates its pixel-independence assumption. Finally, although supervised denoisers gain approximately $4$,dB PSNR, a channelized Hotelling observer shows reduced low-contrast lesion detectability, revealing clinically relevant degradation missed by PSNR and SSIM.

AI.tldr: 在无标签去噪任务中，多步迭代与生成式去噪反而劣于单步回归；单步读出即可达到MMSE去噪器，关键在于噪声配对而非流模型机制。
AI.motivation: 学界普遍假设多步迭代精修优于单步回归，且生成式/迭代去噪器被广泛采用。作者质疑这一假设，特别针对无标签（label-free）去噪场景，探究流模型多步积分是否真能提升去噪性能。
AI.method: 在Noise2Noise设定下，用同一信号的两个噪声观测训练无条件rectified flow，分析其一步读出与多步Euler积分的数学性质；在可解的高斯模型中进行理论验证，并在受控低剂量CT基准CTDenoiser上，跨五种架构、对比监督、相似度、盲点及逐图方法进行实验评估，同时用通道化Hotelling观察者评估病灶可检测性。
AI.result: 理论上：单步读出恰好为无需干净目标的MMSE去噪器；多步积分因终止于噪声分布而非干净信号分布而偏离MMSE，且训练越好偏离越大。实验中单步流与直接回归器相当，多步Euler积分逐步降低保真度，最佳无标签结果为基于配对训练的单步回归（+1.99,dB）。无标签方法中仅Noise2Sim优于噪声基线，Noise2Void持平或下降。监督去噪器PSNR提升约4,dB，但低对比度病灶可检测性下降。
AI.conclusion: 多步迭代/生成式去噪在无标签场景下并非更优，真正的关键是去相关的噪声配对而非流模型机制；PSNR/SSIM等指标可能掩盖临床相关的可检测性退化，需引入任务相关评估。

title: Inertia-Corrected Newton Method For Generalized Nash Equilibria in Dynamic Games with Optimality Verification
summary:
Newton methods efficiently find Generalized Nash Equilibria (GNE) in dynamic games by solving for the KKT necessary conditions. These methods are fast and can support multi-agent Model Predictive Control (MPC) for highly dynamic robots. However, a small KKT residual alone does not certify that the returned solution satisfies the second-order sufficient conditions for a local GNE.
  In this paper, we propose an efficient numerical method to verify the second-order sufficient conditions (SOSC) for a local GNE. We connect the inertia of the agent KKT matrix with the positive definiteness of the reduced Hessian of the cost function, projected onto the null space of the constraints. Furthermore, we introduce an inertia-corrected update step that improves convergence to local GNEs by destabilizing strict saddle points with weak cross-agent coupling.
  Our main contribution is a fast Newton solver for Constrained Dynamic Games that provides efficient optimality checking. Through numerical benchmarks, we demonstrate the proposed solver's runtime and convergence performance in practical multi-agent planning problems. We also validate the solver's real-time capabilities in physical experiments using a platform of miniature autonomous race cars.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种高效数值方法，用于验证动态博弈中局部广义纳什均衡（GNE）的二阶充分条件（SOSC），并给出惯性校正的牛顿求解器。
AI.motivation: 牛顿法通过求解KKT条件能快速找到动态博弈中的GNE，且支持多智能体MPC。但KKT残差小并不能保证解满足局部GNE的二阶充分条件，因此需要可靠的最优性验证手段。
AI.method: 将智能体KKT矩阵的惯性（inertia）与约束零空间上代价函数约化Hessian的正定性联系起来，从而实现SOSC验证；并引入惯性校正的更新步，通过 destabilizing 弱跨智能体耦合的严格鞍点来改善向局部GNE的收敛。
AI.result: 数值基准实验展示了所提求解器在多智能体规划问题中的运行时间与收敛性能；并通过微型自主赛车的物理实验验证了其实时能力。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种面向约束动态博弈的快速牛顿求解器，可高效进行最优性检验，兼具收敛性与实时性。

title: Unsupervised spiking feature learning for event-based pedestrian crossing detection: approaching supervised accuracy without labelled training data
summary: Event cameras are well suited to pedestrian crossing detection, and spiking neural networks (SNNs) can process their output natively, but current SNN detectors are trained with supervised backpropagation and therefore require costly frame-level crossing labels. We investigate crossing detection with no labels in feature learning and report the first unsupervised results on the recent DVS-PedX pedestrian-crossing benchmark. A single spiking layer trained with winner-take-all spike-timing-dependent plasticity learns a dictionary from unlabelled event-frame patches; frames are encoded by cosine similarity to the learned filters with spatial pooling and read out by a linear classifier, the only supervised component. On the 24,454-frame test split the method attains 90.3% accuracy and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.936, compared with 92.0% and 0.943 for a supervised spiking network trained end-to-end on the same frames; under adverse weather the AUROC is 0.913. The result is insensitive to the choice of plasticity rule but depends strongly on the readout protocol: with the classical neuron-assignment readout the same network attains only 0.70 AUROC. On the benchmark's real converted portion, a readout refit lifts performance from chance (0.53) to 0.67 AUROC, within the published supervised range. These findings indicate that the accuracy cost of removing labels from feature learning is small on this benchmark, and that reported weaknesses of unsupervised spiking networks may be attributable to the readout protocol rather than to the learning rule.

AI.tldr: 首个在DVS-PedX行人穿越基准上的无监督脉冲神经网络检测方法，仅特征学习无标签，测试集达90.3%准确率与0.936 AUROC，接近监督基线。
AI.motivation: 事件相机适合行人穿越检测，脉冲神经网络可原生处理其输出，但现有SNN检测器依赖监督反向传播，需要昂贵的帧级穿越标签，因此作者希望在特征学习阶段去除标签依赖。
AI.method: 用单一脉冲层，通过赢者通吃（WTA）的脉冲时序依赖可塑性（STDP）从无标签事件帧图像块中学习字典；帧编码采用与学习滤波器的余弦相似度并进行空间池化，最后由线性分类器读出（唯一的监督组件）。
AI.result: 在24,454帧测试集上取得90.3%准确率和0.936 AUROC（端到端监督SNN为92.0%和0.943）；恶劣天气下AUROC为0.913。结果对可塑性规则不敏感，但强烈依赖读出协议：经典神经元分配读出仅0.70 AUROC。在基准的真实转换部分，读出重拟合将性能从随机水平（0.53）提升至0.67 AUROC，处于已发表监督范围内。
AI.conclusion: 在该基准上，从特征学习中移除标签带来的精度损失很小；无监督脉冲网络被报告的弱点可能归因于读出协议而非学习规则本身。

title: Low Cost Eye Tracking for Vision Screening
summary: This engineering study assesses gaze-assisted data acquisition during visual screening with a Gaze Quest implementation via webcam and GC308 near infrared camera with an Orlosky eye tracking pipeline. Ten subjects performed under both acquisition conditions. Accuracy of Tumbling E orientation, reported application logMAR value,and response latency were determined from keyboard responses and hence are behavioral outputs as opposed toeye tracker screening results. Frame-to-frame change in theangle between successive normalized gaze vectors (28.2degrees) served as the GC308 eye tracker derived diagnostic with an effective sampling rate of roughly 8 FPS. No screen target calibration or gaze to screen translation was done on the GC308 eye tracker output data for the current analysis and hence, these data represent acquisition stability and not gaze accuracy in relation to the target. The webcam pipeline relied on 25-point screen calibration. Because the display resolution and pixel pitch could not be retained in the records of the study, the reported application logMAR values cannot be viewed as measures of visual acuity in any way.

AI.tldr: 该工程研究评估了在网络摄像头与GC308近红外摄像头（配合Orlosky眼动追踪流程）两种条件下，利用注视辅助进行视觉筛查数据采集的表现，10名被试参与。结果显示行为输出与眼动追踪输出需区分看待，因缺少屏幕目标校准与显示参数记录，数据仅反映采集稳定性而非注视精度或视力测量。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于探索注视辅助（gaze-assisted）方式在视觉筛查数据采集中的可行性，并比较网络摄像头与GC308近红外摄像头两种采集条件下的表现，以评估眼动追踪技术在视觉筛查场景中的应用潜力。
AI.method: 10名被试在两种采集条件下完成Gaze Quest视觉筛查任务。行为输出包括Tumbling E方向判断准确率、应用记录的logMAR值及键盘响应延迟。GC308眼动追踪的诊断指标为相邻归一化注视向量间夹角（28.2度）的逐帧变化，有效采样率约8 FPS，未做屏幕目标校准和注视-屏幕转换；网络摄像头流程则依赖25点屏幕校准。
AI.result: GC308眼动数据的有效采样率约为8 FPS，逐帧注视向量夹角变化为28.2度，但由于缺乏屏幕目标校准与注视-屏幕转换，该数据仅代表采集稳定性，而非相对于目标的注视精度。同时，由于显示分辨率和像素间距未在记录中保留，所报告的应用logMAR值不能视为视力测量结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究区分了行为输出与眼动追踪筛查结果，指出在缺乏屏幕目标校准和显示参数记录的情况下，GC308数据只能反映采集稳定性，logMAR值也无法作为视力指标。未来需完善校准流程并保留显示参数，才能使注视辅助视觉筛查具备有效的视力评估意义。

title: A Comparative Transfer-Learning Study of CNN Backbones for Partial Face Recognition on the SoF Dataset
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables, accepted at The 6th International Conference on Electrical, Computer, Communications and Mechatronics Engineering (ICECCME 2026)
summary: Face recognition is widely deployed in surveillance, access control, and forensic workflows, yet accuracy degrades sharply once the face is occluded by accessories, foreground objects, or the frame edge. Because most faces in the wild are partial, robust partial face recognition (PFR) remains open. This paper compares three pretrained convolutional backbones, ResNet-50, VGG-16, and FaceNet, fine-tuned for PFR by transfer learning under identical preprocessing, splitting, and optimization protocols on the Specs-on-Faces (SoF) dataset. All three arms use a common 160x160 input and a frozen backbone with a trainable head under a fixed epoch budget and no per-backbone hyperparameter search. The FaceNet configuration, denoted PFN (Partial FaceNet), substantially outperforms the other two, reaching 97.4% test accuracy with macro-averaged 87.04% precision, 84.61% recall, and 84.17% F1 over the 112 identity classes, the highest accuracy and recall reported on SoF.

AI.tldr: 该论文在Specs-on-Faces数据集上比较ResNet-50、VGG-16与FaceNet三种预训练骨干在统一协议下的部分人脸识别迁移学习表现，其中FaceNet微调版本（PFN）取得97.4%测试精度，为SoF上最高。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中人脸常被配饰、前景物体或画面边缘遮挡而呈部分状态，现有全脸识别精度急剧下降，鲁棒的部部分人脸识别（PFR）仍是未解难题，因此需要在统一条件下比较不同骨干网络的迁移学习效果。
AI.method: 在Specs-on-Faces（SoF）数据集上，对ResNet-50、VGG-16和FaceNet三种预训练卷积骨干进行迁移学习微调；三者采用相同预处理、数据划分与优化协议，统一160×160输入、冻结骨干并仅训练分类头，固定训练轮数且不做逐骨干超参搜索。
AI.result: FaceNet配置（记为PFN，Partial FaceNet）显著优于另外两者，在112个身份类别上达到97.4%测试精度，宏平均精确率87.04%、召回率84.61%、F1值84.17%，为SoF数据集上已报告的最高精度与召回率。
AI.conclusion: 在严格控制变量的迁移学习对比中，FaceNet骨干最适合部分人脸识别任务，PFN在SoF上树立了新的最优结果，表明骨干选择对PFR性能有决定性影响。

title: Grasp2Twist: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Jar Opening by Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper presents Grasp2Twist, a bimanual dexterous manipulation system that learns to grasp and twist open jar lids using reinforcement learning. Learning this task raises three challenges: learning a unified policy for a multi-stage task, sustaining lid twisting, and sim-to-real transfer. To address the first challenge, we introduce a continuous enclosure measure to guide grasp formation and a binary enclosure indicator to guide the grasp-to-twist transition for unified policy learning. We derive both from the geometric relationship between the object center and the convex hull formed by the hand's palm and fingertips. Kinematic constraints limit how far the hand can rotate the lid with fixed contacts, so sustained twisting requires finger contact reconfiguration. We use a three-stage curriculum to facilitate exploration of these contact changes and also improve robustness for sim-to-real transfer. With our approach, the learned policy demonstrates finger gaiting, reconfiguring hand-object contacts to sustain lid rotation. It transfers zero-shot to the physical system and achieves an 88% task success rate across six household containers, including peanut-butter, vitamin, and instant-coffee jars. Ablations further validate the roles of the geometric enclosure in grasp formation and the curriculum in contact-reconfiguration exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出Grasp2Twist双臂灵巧操作系统，用强化学习实现抓取并拧开罐盖，零样本迁移到真实系统，六种家用容器成功率88%。
AI.motivation: 学习"抓取并拧开罐盖"这一任务面临三大挑战：多阶段任务的统一策略学习、持续拧盖的维持、以及仿真到真实的迁移。运动学约束限制了固定接触下手指旋转瓶盖的角度，因此持续拧盖需要手指接触重构。
AI.method: 从物体中心与手掌及指尖构成凸包的几何关系中，导出连续包围度量和二元包围指示器，分别引导抓取形成与抓取到拧转的过渡，实现统一策略学习；使用三阶段课程学习促进接触变化的探索，并提升仿真到真实迁移的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 学到的策略展现出手指步态（finger gaiting），通过重配手-物接触维持瓶盖旋转；零样本迁移到物理系统，在六种家用容器（含花生酱、维生素、速溶咖啡罐）上达到88%任务成功率；消融实验验证了几何包围度在抓取形成中的作用以及课程学习在接触重构探索中的作用。
AI.conclusion: 几何包围度量与课程学习相结合，使统一强化学习策略能够完成多阶段双臂灵巧拧盖任务，并实现有效的仿真到真实迁移。

title: Toward AI-Assisted Poultry Coccidiosis Diagnosis: Evaluating Gemini and BiomedParse on Eimeria Microscopy Images
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, accepted at IEEE International Conference on Sustainability, Innovation and Technology (ICSIT 2026)
summary: Coccidiosis caused by Eimeria parasites is a major economic burden in poultry production, and effective control depends on accurate species-level diagnosis. This study evaluates whether a general-purpose multimodal large language model can support such diagnosis. Google Gemini was assessed on 4,225 mi- croscopy images covering the seven fowl-infecting Eimeria species under two prompting conditions, one without candidate labels and one with a predefined class list, and was further tested for pathology-report generation, while BiomedParse was examined for parasite segmentation. Without candidate labels, the model produced broad and taxonomically inconsistent outputs. With candidate labels, overall accuracy reached only 14.9%, with a strong bias toward E. tenella at 74% and no correct classifications for E. acervulina, E. mitis and E. praecox. Generated treatment reports were coherent but unverified, and segmentation was only partial. Current multimodal models are therefore not yet reliable for standalone Eimeria diagnosis without domain-specific fine- tuning and expert validation.

AI.tldr: 评估通用多模态大模型（Google Gemini）对七种感染家禽的艾美耳球虫进行物种级诊断的能力，结果显示其可靠性不足。
AI.motivation: 球虫病给家禽生产带来重大经济损失，有效防控依赖准确的物种级诊断，本文探讨通用多模态大模型能否支持此类诊断。
AI.method: 在4,225张显微镜图像（覆盖七种感染家禽的艾美耳球虫）上测试Google Gemini，设置两种提示条件（无候选标签、有预定义类别列表），并测试其病理报告生成能力；同时用BiomedParse评估寄生虫分割。
AI.result: 无候选标签时输出宽泛且分类学不一致；有候选标签时总体准确率仅14.9%，强烈偏向E. tenella（74%），对E. acervulina、E. mitis和E. praecox无任何正确分类；生成的治疗报告通顺但未经核实，分割仅为部分完成。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型尚不可靠，若无领域特定微调和专家验证，无法独立用于艾美耳球虫诊断。

title: Find Something You Can't Do: Agentic Real-World Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving VLA Models
summary: Vision--language--action (VLA) models provide strong priors for robotic manipulation but are typically deployed as frozen policies, unable to improve from their own failures. Real-world reinforcement learning (RL) offers a path to continued improvement, yet manual environment resets and task-success supervision hinder autonomous learning. We introduce \textbf{FIND}, an agentic real-world RL framework that closes the loop between scene understanding, weakness-aware practice, self-evaluation, and policy improvement in a persistent workspace. FIND reframes autonomous practice as a scene-conditioned, performance-aware task-selection problem: instead of restoring a predefined scene after each rollout, it uses the resulting scene to determine what to practice next. A vision--language agent identifies feasible tasks from a predefined library, prioritizes those with lower recent success rates, and evaluates outcomes using paired pre- and post-execution observations. We instantiate FIND with a frozen $π_{0.5}$ VLA and residual off-policy RL. Across eight real-world manipulation tasks, the independent human-assessed success rate improves from $55\%$ to $71.9\%$. A representative run completes 456 autonomous episodes within 6 hours of interaction, requiring 30 scene-recovery interventions and no human-provided reward labels during online learning. Ablations and systematic evaluations further examine key design choices, agent evaluation accuracy, and human intervention requirements. Our website is made publicly available at: FIND.github.io.

AI.tldr: FIND 是一个在真实世界持续工作空间中运行的自主强化学习框架，通过场景理解、弱点感知练习、自我评估与策略改进的闭环，让冻结的视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）从自身失败中持续提升，无需人工重置环境和任务成功监督。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型虽为机器人操作提供了强先验，但通常作为冻结策略部署，无法从自身失败中改进。真实世界强化学习虽能持续提升，但人工环境重置与任务成功监督阻碍了自主学习，因此需要一个能自主练习与自我评估的框架。
AI.method: FIND 将自主练习重构为"场景条件化、性能感知的任务选择"问题：每次 rollout 后不恢复预定义场景，而是利用当前场景决定下一步练习内容。一个视觉-语言智能体从预定义任务库中识别可行任务，优先选择近期成功率较低的任务，并通过执行前后的配对观测评估结果。框架以冻结的 π_0.5 VLA 与残差 off-policy RL 实例化。
AI.result: 在八个真实世界操作任务上，独立人工评估的成功率从 55% 提升至 71.9%。一次代表性运行在 6 小时交互内完成 456 个自主回合，仅需 30 次场景恢复干预，在线学习期间无需人工提供奖励标签。消融与系统评估进一步考察了关键设计选择、智能体评估准确性与人工干预需求。
AI.conclusion: FIND 实现了真实世界中端到端的自主强化学习闭环，显著提升 VLA 策略性能并大幅减少人工干预，为 VLA 模型的持续自主改进提供了可行路径。

title: Devanagari Handwritten Character Recognition Using TrOCR: A Transformer-Based Model with Real-Time Web Deployment
comment: Presented and accepted at the 16th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT), 2025
summary: Devnagari is a one of the ancient language of the Indian subcontinent consisting of 36 vowels, 14 consonants and 10 numerals. The accurate recognition of handwritten Devnagari characters is challenging due to high complexity of Devnagari scripts. This paper presents a method to fine tune the pre trained TrOCR model to accurately recognize Devanagari handwritten characters. The Methodology consists of a preprocessing mechanism where input images are standardized into RGB format, tokenized in batches and integrated with Hugging Face Dataset. The pre-trained microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten model is fine-tuned over a dataset of nearly 5000 character images that are uniformly partitioned in the ratio 8:1:1 for training, evaluation and testing. Further optimization is done is the training process through mixed precision training, gradient checkpointing, and early stopping mechanism. The model achieves a character error rate (CER) of 3.95% and a character-level accuracy of 96.05%, outperforming the previous CNN based models. A scalable web application is developed using Vite.js, Golang, and FastAPI which practically deploys the OCR model and serves character recognition task with a latency less than 5 seconds per request. This study demonstrates the use of TrOCR model to build a scalable handwritten Devnagari character recognition system and also a foundation to future research on Devnagari Script Recognition using Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文微调预训练TrOCR模型识别手写天城文字符，字符错误率3.95%、准确率96.05%，并部署为可扩展Web应用。
AI.motivation: 天城文包含36个元音、14个辅音和10个数字，字形结构复杂，手写字符准确识别难度大，而现有基于CNN的方法识别效果有限，需要更高精度且可扩展的识别方案。
AI.method: 方法包含预处理（输入图像统一为RGB格式、分批分词并集成Hugging Face Dataset）；在约5000张字符图像上微调预训练模型microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten，数据按8:1:1划分训练、评估与测试；训练中采用混合精度训练、梯度检查点和早停机制优化；并使用Vite.js、Golang和FastAPI开发可扩展Web应用部署模型。
AI.result: 模型取得3.95%的字符错误率（CER）和96.05%的字符级准确率，优于此前基于CNN的模型；Web应用单次请求延迟低于5秒。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明TrOCR模型可有效构建可扩展的手写天城文字符识别系统，并为未来基于Transformer的天城文识别研究奠定基础。

title: Fiber-Normalized Manipulability and Determinant Proxies: Intrinsic Redundancy Optimization Across and Within Task Fibers
summary:
This work establishes that determinant-based manipulability is an exact objective for fixed-task redundancy optimization, despite its dependence on task coordinates and the choice of task-space metric used for volume measurement. On every regular task fiber, the determinant proxy, its representation in any task chart, and every metric-completed manipulability differ only by positive constants. They consequently induce the same complete ordering, constrained extrema, gradient directions, critical points, and local optimality classifications.
  For comparisons and trajectory optimization across task fibers, this work introduces fiber-normalized manipulability: the capability attained at an internal state divided by the best capability available on the same fiber. The resulting dimensionless scalar is invariant under coordinate changes on the internal-state and task manifolds and independent of the task-space metric. Its associated loss provides an intrinsic objective for physically admissible cross-fiber trajectories, including problems with prescribed or free task evolution and temporal coupling. Planar-manipulator and redundant aerodynamic-allocation examples demonstrate fixed-fiber equivalence, task-dependent cross-fiber differences, and invariant fiber-normalized trajectory optimization.

AI.tldr: 该工作证明基于行列式的可操作度是固定任务冗余优化的精确目标，并提出纤维归一化可操作度用于跨任务纤维的轨迹优化。
AI.motivation: 行列式可操作度依赖任务坐标与任务空间度量，这使其作为优化目标的内在性受到质疑；同时跨任务纤维比较与轨迹优化缺乏不变量。
AI.method: 在每个正则任务纤维上比较行列式代理、其在任意任务图中的表示以及各度量补全可操作度；引入纤维归一化可操作度，即内部状态能力除以同一纤维上最优能力，并构造相应损失。
AI.result: 证明固定纤维上各量仅相差正常数，诱导相同的完全序、约束极值、梯度方向、临界点与局部最优分类；纤维归一化标量在内部状态与任务流形坐标变换下不变且与任务空间度量无关；平面机械臂与冗余气动分配示例验证了固定纤维等价性、跨纤维差异及不变轨迹优化。
AI.conclusion: 行列式可操作度在固定任务纤维上是精确且内在等价的目标；纤维归一化可操作度为含指定或自由任务演化及时间耦合的跨纤维轨迹提供内在目标函数。

title: Towards Transparent Diagnostics: Investigating Architectural Trade-offs and Explainability in Malaria Detection
summary: More than 80 countries have reported malaria cases with 610 thousand deaths and are projected to increase. Identifying malaria early and accurately helps save lives. The effective way to diagnose malaria is through microscopic methods that are labor intensive and require experts with special equipment. Deep learning (DL) has shown promising results in medical diagnosis. Here, we explored various DL models: ResNet18, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet-B2, VGG19 and also proposed a model for detecting malaria presence using blood smears taken from the NIH Malaria dataset. Our experiment shows that MobileNetV2 achieved 96.35% accuracy with the smallest model size (8.49 MB) and fastest inference (1.35 ms). The proposed model achieved 97.67% accuracy, 0.9756 AUC with longest inference time (13.17 ms). The larger architecture outputs a larger model size with moderate accuracy. Upon further pruning, the proposed model gained a slight improvement in accuracy and inference time. The GRAD-CAM, SHAP and LIME shade explainable AI (XAI) insights of the model.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用NIH疟疾数据集，比较了ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19及自建深度学习模型在疟疾血涂片检测中的表现，并引入剪枝与可解释AI分析。
AI.motivation: 疟疾在全球80多个国家流行，死亡率高且预计上升，早期准确诊断可挽救生命。传统显微镜诊断依赖专家与专用设备、耗费人力，因此需要更高效的自动诊断方法。
AI.method: 基于NIH疟疾血涂片数据集，评估ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19以及作者提出的模型；对提出模型进行剪枝优化；并使用GRAD-CAM、SHAP和LIME进行可解释性分析。
AI.result: MobileNetV2取得96.35%准确率，模型最小（8.49 MB）、推理最快（1.35 ms）；提出模型准确率97.67%、AUC 0.9756，但推理时间最长（13.17 ms）。更大的网络结构模型尺寸更大且准确率一般。剪枝后提出模型在准确率和推理时间上有小幅改善。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习可用于疟疾血涂片检测，MobileNetV2在效率与性能间平衡良好，自建模型准确率更高但推理较慢；剪枝可带来轻微提升，XAI方法增强了模型的可解释性。

title: Active 3D weaves for load-bearing and damage-resilient locomotion
summary: The craft of weaving, where different materials are interlaced, has tremendous potential for creating active and functional systems for use in soft robots, prosthetics, wearables, exoskeletons, and more. These textile-like systems are flexible and safe for human-machine interaction; however, this inherent flexibility limits their ability to carry loads, which is essential for many robotic functions. In this work, we introduce a general framework for integrating active materials into three-dimensional (3D) woven shells to create robotic structures that combine high axial stiffness for load bearing, low bending stiffness for efficient actuation, and system-level resilience for damage tolerance. These woven robots can be modularly assembled from 'woven corners', a fundamental unit of 3D woven structures. We use eigenvalue calculations to identify load bearing and actuation mechanisms of the 3D woven structures, and use that information to make five different robots capable of locomotion. We demonstrate that these 3D woven robots can locomote carrying loads 70 times their self-weight, and can maintain repeatable performance even after being subjected to extreme compression. This work is a pathway toward the design, manufacturing, and simulation of future 3D woven robotic systems where load bearing, high stiffness, active functional deformation, locomotion, and system-level resilience are all needed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将活性材料集成到三维编织壳体的通用框架，用特征值计算识别承载与驱动机制，造出五款可运动编织机器人，能负重70倍自重并在极端压缩后保持性能。
AI.motivation: 编织工艺在软体机器人、假肢、可穿戴与外骨骼等领域潜力巨大，其系统柔顺且人机交互安全；但固有的柔顺性限制了承载能力，而承载是许多机器人功能的必要条件，因此需要在保持柔顺驱动的同时实现高承载与损伤容限。
AI.method: 将活性材料集成到三维（3D）编织壳体中，构建兼具高轴向刚度、低弯曲刚度与系统级韧性的机器人结构；以"编织角（woven corners）"作为3D编织结构的基本单元进行模块化组装；利用特征值计算识别3D编织结构的承载与驱动机制，并据此设计五款具备运动能力的机器人。
AI.result: 所设计的3D编织机器人可携带约70倍自重的载荷进行运动，并且在经受极端压缩后仍能保持可重复的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来3D编织机器人系统的设计、制造与仿真提供了路径，可同时满足承载、高刚度、主动功能变形、运动与系统级韧性等需求。

title: Adapting Vision-Language Models for Human-Readable XAI in Industrial Object Detection
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) solutions are essential for building trust in AI technologies and their integration in real manufacturing lines. However, most existing methods are tailored to technical experts, limiting their accessibility to diverse user groups such as blue-collar workers in manufacturing lines who use AI for quality control. In this work, we introduce an XAI interface for object detection in industrial manufacturing based on a fine-tuned vision-language model, designed to generate intuitive explanations for non-expert users. We benchmark existing vision-language models and demonstrate that out-of-the-box models often fall short in delivering clear, context-relevant explanations for non-expert users. To address this, we fine-tune a vision-language model and integrate it into our interface, enabling contextualized, accessible explanations for non-expert users. We demonstrate improvements in explanation clarity, instruction adherence, image groundedness, and contextual awareness over GPT 4o-mini on proprietary and public robotics dataset. This approach advances the accessibility and usability of AI explanations, making them more intuitive and applicable in manufacturing domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向工业制造、基于微调视觉语言模型的可解释AI(XAI)界面，为质检等场景的非专家（如蓝领工人）生成直观解释，并在专有及公开机器人数据集上验证其优于GPT-4o-mini。
AI.motivation: 现有XAI方法多面向技术专家，难以被制造产线上从事质量控制的蓝领等多元用户群体理解和接受。为提升AI信任度与在真实产线的落地，需要为非专家用户提供直观、易用的可解释性方案。
AI.method: 针对工业制造中的目标检测任务，构建基于微调视觉语言模型的XAI界面。先对现有视觉语言模型进行基准评测，发现开箱即用模型难以给出清晰、贴合语境的解释；随后对视觉语言模型进行微调，并将其集成到界面中，生成语境化、易理解、面向非专家的解释。
AI.result: 在专有数据集和公开机器人数据集上，该微调方案在解释清晰度、指令遵循度、图像接地性（image groundedness）和语境感知方面均优于GPT-4o-mini。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提升了AI解释的可及性与可用性，使解释更加直观并适用于制造领域，有助于非专家用户理解和使用AI，推动XAI在真实产线中的集成。

title: Residual Denoising Enables Sample-Efficient Multi-Agent Coordination on Demand
summary: Pretrained robot policies offer strong manipulation skills but are typically limited to single-agent settings, where a robot acts in isolation. In this work, we study how to adapt pretrained single-agent diffusion policies to multi-agent settings using minimal collaborative data, co-optimizing for two key objectives: high coordination performance and single-agent skill retention. To this end, we introduce ALTER, an adaptation method for coordination on demand: the adapted policy coordinates with other robots when deployed in a team while remaining capable of acting independently when operating alone. Execution is decentralized: each robot acts only on its own visual observations, without explicit inter-agent communication. Our method trains a coordination head that predicts a residual denoiser to transform single-agent behavior into coordinated multi-agent behavior when necessary while also preserving single-agent capabilities. To preserve single-agent capabilities, we augment a small number of collaborative demonstrations with self-distilled data generated by the base policy during training of the residual denoiser. In simulation,ALTER achieves higher coordination success over our baselines while retaining much higher source-skill retention. In our hardware experiments, we find similar trends where ALTER better co-optimizes for coordination success and single-agent skill retention than the baselines

AI.tldr: 提出ALTER方法，将预训练单智能体扩散策略适配到多智能体协作场景，在少量协作数据下协同优化协调性能与单智能体技能保持。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人策略操作能力强，但局限于单智能体孤立作业；如何用最少协作数据同时兼顾多智能体协调与单智能体技能保持尚待研究。
AI.method: 训练一个协调头，预测残差去噪器，在需要时将单智能体行为转换为协调的多智能体行为；执行完全去中心化，各机器人仅依赖自身视觉观测、无显式通信；为保持单智能体能力，在训练残差去噪器时用基础策略自蒸馏生成数据，扩充少量协作示范。
AI.result: 仿真中ALTER的协调成功率高于基线，且源技能保持率显著更高；硬件实验呈相似趋势，在协调成功与单智能体技能保持的协同优化上优于基线。
AI.conclusion: ALTER可在极少协作数据下按需协调，使机器人团队协作时协调、单独作业时保持原有技能，实现去中心化执行。

title: Architecture-aware Robustness Evaluation of Explainable Deep Learning for Breast Cancer Diagnosis
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) has become essential in medical image analysis to ensure transparency of deep learning (DL)-based diagnostic systems. However, selecting appropriate XAI techniques for breast cancer recognition remains largely ad hoc, with limited systematic evaluation across different DL architectures. This study presents a systematic architecture-aware evaluation protocol to assess the effectiveness of nine widely used XAI techniques across four categories of DL models: very deep, lightweight, transformer-based and hybrid neural networks. The evaluation is conducted on a breast ultrasound dataset comprising 780 images using clinically aligned spatial metrics, including Pointing Game, Intersection over Union and Mean Coverage, to quantify agreement between generated explanations and expert-annotated lesion regions. Results indicate that explanation quality is primarily influenced by the interaction between model architecture and XAI method, rather than any single technique consistently outperforming others. Hybrid architectures produce more spatially coherent explanations, while lightweight and transformer-based models exhibit greater variability across methods. The findings show that no single technique generalises across architectures and evaluation criteria, emphasising the need for joint selection of DL models and XAI techniques. Explainability depends on both model design and explanation strategy and should not be considered independently. This work provides a structured evaluation protocol and practical guidance for selecting XAI techniques in breast cancer diagnosis, supporting more transparent clinical decision-support systems. \textcolor{blue}{Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Nishan-Charlie/Explainable-AI}

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种架构感知的可解释AI（XAI）系统评估协议，在乳腺超声数据集上评估九种XAI技术跨四类深度学习模型的解释效果，发现解释质量主要取决于模型架构与XAI方法的交互作用，而非某一技术普遍最优。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分析中XAI对保证深度学习诊断系统的透明性至关重要，但针对乳腺癌识别的XAI技术选择多为经验性做法，缺乏跨不同深度学习架构的系统评估。
AI.method: 提出架构感知的系统评估协议，在含780张图像的乳腺超声数据集上，将九种常用XAI技术应用于四类深度学习模型（超深、轻量、基于Transformer及混合神经网络），并采用临床对齐的空间指标（Pointing Game、IoU、Mean Coverage）量化解释与专家标注病灶区域的一致性。
AI.result: 解释质量主要受模型架构与XAI方法交互作用影响，而非单一技术持续占优；混合架构产生空间一致性更高的解释，轻量与Transformer模型在不同方法间波动更大；没有任何单一技术能跨架构和评估标准普遍适用。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性同时取决于模型设计与解释策略，二者不应独立考虑，需联合选择深度学习模型与XAI技术；该工作提供了结构化评估协议及乳腺癌诊断中XAI技术选择的实践指导，支持更透明的临床决策支持系统。

title: GAUGE: Planner-Conditioned Active Calibration of Opaque Quadruped Velocity Interfaces
summary: In this paper, we present a Goal-Aware Uncertainty-Guided Exploration (GAUGE) framework for planner-conditioned active calibration of opaque quadruped velocity interfaces. Commercial quadrupeds commonly expose planar-velocity commands, but the underlying locomotion controller remains inaccessible and can produce systematic discrepancies between commanded and realized motion. A navigation planner typically uses a structured subset of the command envelope. GAUGE maintains a Bayesian command-to-motion model and selects authorized trials according to their expected reduction of posterior epistemic uncertainty under the planner-induced command distribution. The resulting posterior supports validation-based stopping, bounded inverse compensation, and task-relevant recalibration after detected interface shifts. In three controlled response families, GAUGE reaches the joint criterion for task-facing accuracy and uncertainty with fewer trials than passive, D-optimal, and task-agnostic alternatives. Across six held-out Isaac Sim navigation maps, it meets the declared noninferiority margins against dense calibration. Code is available at https://github.com/EurekaZang/CalibAgent.
