AI.tldr: 本文提出GAUGE框架，用于在规划器条件下对不透明四足速度接口进行主动标定。该方法基于贝叶斯命令-运动模型，依据规划器诱导分布下的后验认知不确定性缩减来选择试验。在三个响应族中比被动、D-最优及任务无关方法用更少试验达到精度与不确定性联合标准，并在六个Isaac Sim导航地图上满足对密集标定的非劣效边界。
AI.motivation: 商用四足机器人仅暴露平面速度指令接口，底层运动控制器不可访问，导致指令运动与实际运动存在系统性偏差。导航规划器通常只使用指令包络中的结构化子集，因此需要面向任务、面向规划器的标定方法，而非任务无关的通用标定。
AI.method: GAUGE维护贝叶斯命令-运动模型，根据规划器诱导的命令分布下后验认知不确定性的期望缩减来选择"被授权"的试验。所得后验支持基于验证的停止准则、有界逆补偿，以及在检测到接口漂移后进行任务相关的重新标定。
AI.result: 在三个受控响应族中，GAUGE以比被动方法、D-最优方法和任务无关替代方案更少的试验次数达到面向任务的精度与不确定性联合准则。在六个留出的Isaac Sim导航地图上，其性能满足相对密集标定所声明的非劣效边界。
AI.conclusion: GAUGE实现了规划器条件下的主动标定，可在有限试验预算下高效校准不透明四足速度接口，并支持漂移后的重新标定，代码已开源。

title: Disentangle and Drop: Robust Universal Removal of Image Watermarks via Reconstructive Grayscale Residual Decomposition
summary: Invisible image watermarks are commonly evaluated against benign postprocessing operations such as compression, resizing, blur, and color changes. These tests leave out a different threat: a learned remover that preserves semantic image content while discarding residual evidence that carries the payload. We propose Disentangle and Drop (DnD), an attack that is agnostic to the watermark method and treats watermark removal as a representation routing problem. DnD decomposes a watermarked image into a semantic grayscale carrier and an auxiliary residual branch, and then suppresses the residual branch to reduce watermark evidence. The model is trained with latent spectral perturbations and low-strength diffusion exposure so that the drop operation remains stable under adaptive reconstruction. Experiments on seven representative watermark families show that one shared operating setting gives competitive removal with high visual fidelity. Operating scans and ablations separate usable attacks from image-damaging settings: stronger noise or diffusion can raise removal scores by damaging the image, while the practical regime comes from dropping the residual latent. These results argue for evaluating watermark robustness against learned removal at the representation level, not only against conventional image edits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Disentangle and Drop (DnD) 攻击，将水印去除视为表征路由问题，对水印方法不可知，通过学习式移除器在保留语义内容的同时丢弃水印证据。
AI.motivation: 现有图像水印评估主要针对压缩、缩放、模糊、颜色变化等良性后处理，忽略了更具威胁的场景：学习式移除器可在保留语义内容的前提下消除水印载荷证据。因此需要从表征层面评估水印鲁棒性。
AI.method: DnD 将含水印图像分解为语义灰度载体与辅助残差分支，随后抑制残差分支以减少水印证据。模型训练中引入隐空间谱扰动与低强度扩散曝光，使丢弃操作在自适应重建下保持稳定。
AI.result: 在七类代表性水印家族上，单一共享设置即可实现有竞争力的去除效果与高视觉保真度。操作扫描与消融实验区分了可用攻击与损伤图像的设置：更强噪声或扩散虽可提高去除分数，但以破坏图像为代价，实际操作区间来自丢弃残差隐变量。
AI.conclusion: 水印鲁棒性评估不应仅针对常规图像编辑，还应纳入表征层面的学习式移除攻击。

title: RecastVLA: From Past Interaction to Future Control with Adaptive Policy States
summary: Sequential manipulation requires a robot to track what has already happened, even when the current scene no longer reveals it. Policies with explicit history representations make past interactions available as context for current decisions. We ask how action generation itself can form a persistent state for subsequent control. Building on action-side test-time training, RecastVLA maintains an adaptive policy state within a flow-matching vision-language-action policy. The state is represented by shared fast weights and remains fixed throughout action generation. Depth-specific interfaces read the same state, while features across depths and flow evaluations jointly define one update for the next policy call. Subsequent action losses train the initialization, interfaces, and update rule by differentiating through earlier state transitions. At deployment, updates use the policy's own action-generation features without expert action labels. Across LIBERO, RoboTwin, RoboDojo, and twelve real-robot tasks, RecastVLA improves mean success over a matched policy trained without test-time training, including 10.68 percentage points on RoboTwin Clean-to-Clean. In controlled RoboTwin comparisons, retaining state improves success, and the shared design exceeds independently trained layer-local TTT by 2.58 points.

AI.tldr: RecastVLA 提出一种在流匹配视觉-语言-动作策略中维持自适应策略状态的方法，用共享快速权重表示历史，实现在测试时无需专家标签的持续控制更新。
AI.motivation: 顺序操作中，当前场景往往无法体现此前发生过的交互，因此机器人需要显式地追踪历史。已有工作通过显式历史表示将过去交互作为上下文，但作者想探究动作生成本身能否形成可供后续控制使用的持久状态。
AI.method: 基于动作侧测试时训练，RecastVLA 在流匹配 VLA 策略内维护自适应策略状态：状态由共享快速权重表示，并在整个动作生成过程中保持固定；不同深度的接口读取同一状态，跨深度与流评估的特征共同定义一次更新，供下一次策略调用使用。后续动作损失通过回溯早期状态转移来训练初始化、接口和更新规则。部署时更新只使用策略自身的动作生成特征，不需要专家动作标签。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin、RoboDojo 以及十二个真实机器人任务上，RecastVLA 相比未使用测试时训练的匹配策略取得更高的平均成功率，其中在 RoboTwin Clean-to-Clean 上提升 10.68 个百分点。在 RoboTwin 的受控对比中，保留状态可提升成功率，且共享设计比独立训练的分层局部 TTT 高出 2.58 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 动作生成过程本身可以形成持久策略状态，用于后续控制；共享快速权重的测试时训练设计优于分层独立方案，并在多平台与真实任务中验证了有效性。

title: RemTraceNet: Few-Shot Forensic Detection of Invisible Watermark Attacks
summary: Removing an invisible watermark and concealing the forensic evidence are distinct objectives: successfully disrupting the embedded watermark does not imply that the removal process is forensically undetectable. When verification fails, removal traces can provide complementary evidence for provenance and ownership verification, whereas their absence leaves the cause of the failure ambiguous. Existing methods are typically evaluated by watermark suppression and perceptual quality, while forensic stealth is rarely considered. We therefore study watermark-attack-specific few-shot forensics: for each known pipeline, a specialist can separate its outputs from paired clean and unattacked watermarked controls. Separate Attack-vs-Clean and Attack-vs-Watermarked evaluations prevent watermark-presence shortcuts. Image-aligned and prompt-matched controls are used for post-hoc and generator-integrated schemes, respectively. In this work, we introduce RemTraceNet, which fuses constrained residuals, local relations, FFT/Haar statistics, and block-DCT evidence at native resolution. Across 23 removal pipelines and 10 watermark configurations, we evaluate native 256 x 256 and 512 x 512 inputs. With 100 attacked training images per pipeline, the three-seed TPR@1%FPR, macro-averaged over attacks and watermark configurations, ranges from 82.75% to 88.17% across resolutions and control types. Under the condition of same labels and protocol, RemTraceNet outperforms retrained SRNet, ZhuNet, and SiaStegNet baselines by 10.80--15.68 percentage points. Extensive experimental results show that erasing a watermark and erasing evidence of its removal are distinct challenges, and that removal traces remain learnable under limited supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RemTraceNet，用于水印攻击特定的少样本取证，区分攻击痕迹与干净/带水印控制样本，在23种移除流程和10种水印配置下显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 移除不可见水印与掩盖取证证据是不同目标：成功破坏水印并不意味着移除过程在取证上不可检测。验证失败时，移除痕迹可为溯源和所有权验证提供补充证据，而其缺失则使失败原因模糊。现有方法通常只评估水印抑制和感知质量，很少考虑取证隐蔽性。
AI.method: 研究水印攻击特定的少样本取证：对每个已知流程，专家模型将攻击输出与配对的干净、未攻击带水印控制样本分离。采用Attack-vs-Clean和Attack-vs-Watermarked分离评估以避免水印存在捷径；分别对事后方案使用图像对齐控制，对生成器集成方案使用提示匹配控制。提出RemTraceNet，在原生分辨率下融合约束残差、局部关系、FFT/Haar统计和块DCT证据。
AI.result: 在23种移除流程和10种水印配置下，评估原生256×256和512×512输入。每个流程使用100张攻击训练图像时，三种子TPR@1%FPR在攻击和水印配置上宏平均为82.75%至88.17%。在相同标签和协议下，RemTraceNet比重新训练的SRNet、ZhuNet和SiaStegNet基线高出10.80至15.68个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明确实存在两个不同挑战：擦除水印与擦除其移除证据；并且在有限监督下，移除痕迹仍然可学习。

title: AquaBEV-Nav: Learned BEV Occupancy for Underwater Navigation and Exploration
summary: Safe underwater exploration requires a robot to understand where surrounding structures are located and which regions are available for motion. Existing vision-based underwater exploration systems commonly obtain this information indirectly by estimating monocular depth, unprojecting the geometry into 3D space, and accumulating it into a 2D bird's-eye-view occupancy map. This reliance on intermediate depth estimation is particularly problematic underwater, where scattering and wavelength-dependent attenuation degrade visual cues and limit the reliability of monocular depth estimates. We introduce AquaBEV-Nav, an underwater exploration framework that bypasses explicit monocular depth estimation through direct bird's-eye-view occupancy prediction. Built upon the CORAL hierarchical exploration framework, AquaBEV-Nav replaces its depth-based perception front end with AquaBEV. Given a single RGB frame, AquaBEV maps visual features into a learned polar representation, performs causal reasoning along the range dimension, and reconstructs local Cartesian occupancy without relying on intermediate depth prediction. The resulting occupancy map is accumulated into CORAL's persistent spatial memory, providing spatial context for VLM-based high-level planning and collision constraints for dynamics-aware local trajectory generation. Across ten simulated reef environments and six occupancy backbones evaluated under a single protocol, AquaBEV-Nav reaches 37.48 structure IoU and 53.2 target IoU, 88.95% closed-loop coverage with zero collisions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AquaBEV-Nav，一个通过直接预测鸟瞰图占据栅格来绕过显式单目深度估计的水下探索框架，提升了水下探索的安全性和覆盖效率。
AI.motivation: 水下环境中的散射和波长相关衰减会严重降低视觉线索，使单目深度估计不可靠；而现有基于视觉的水下探索系统普遍依赖单目深度估计，再将几何反投影到3D空间并累积为鸟瞰图占据地图，这种间接方式在水下尤其容易失效，因此需要绕过显式深度估计。
AI.method: 基于 CORAL 分层探索框架，用 AquaBEV 替换其基于深度的感知前端。给定单张RGB帧，AquaBEV 将视觉特征映射到学习到的极坐标表示，沿距离维度进行因果推理，并重建局部笛卡尔占据栅格，不依赖中间深度预测。所得占据地图累积到 CORAL 的持久空间记忆中，为基于VLM的高层规划提供空间上下文，并为动力学感知的局部轨迹生成提供碰撞约束。
AI.result: 在十个模拟礁石环境和六种占据栅格骨干网络下，采用统一协议评估，AquaBEV-Nav 达到 37.48 结构 IoU、53.2 目标 IoU、88.95% 闭环覆盖率，且零碰撞。
AI.conclusion: AquaBEV-Nav 表明直接鸟瞰图占据预测可有效替代水下探索中的单目深度估计前端，在保持零碰撞安全性的同时实现较高覆盖率，为水下自主探索提供了更可靠的感知方案。

title: Video Captioning in Low-Light Conditions through Efficient Uncertainty-Aware Caption Correction
summary: Low-light conditions can significantly degrade the ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to accurately describe human actions in videos. In this work, I propose an efficient uncertainty-aware representation correction framework for improving captions generated by VideoChat2 under real-world low-light conditions. Instead of fine-tuning the underlying VLM, the proposed framework introduces a lightweight sparse Gaussian process-based error estimation module between the projection layer and the language model to correct the intermediate representation. The correction module learns to estimate the residual between the original projected representation and a verified target representation, which is then adaptively scaled using a newly formulated uncertainty-aware coefficient and added to the original representation. To further improve residual estimation, I introduce a partitioned combined-kernel design. The correction model is trained separately using only 44 samples from the ARID dataset and requires only a small additional computational overhead during inference. The effectiveness of the proposed correction is evaluated through quantitative residual prediction and qualitative analysis of the generated captions. Although VideoChat2 is used in my experiments, the proposed framework is designed to be applicable to other compatible VLM architectures. \textbf{Code Availability: The implementation accompanying this work is publicly available at}:\href{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}

AI.tldr: 提出一种不确定性感知的表示校正框架，用轻量稀疏高斯过程在投影层与语言模型之间估计残差，少量样本即可提升VideoChat2在低光视频下的动作描述能力。
AI.motivation: 低光条件会显著削弱视觉语言模型准确描述视频中人类动作的能力，而微调底层VLM成本较高，因此需要一种高效、无需微调主模型的校正方案。
AI.method: 在投影层与语言模型之间插入基于稀疏高斯过程的轻量误差估计模块，学习原始投影表示与已验证目标表示之间的残差，并用新提出的不确定性感知系数自适应缩放后加回原表示；同时引入分区组合核设计以改进残差估计。
AI.result: 校正模型仅用ARID数据集的44个样本训练，推理时仅带来少量额外计算开销；通过残差预测的定量评估和生成描述的定性分析验证了校正效果。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在低光场景下有效改善VideoChat2生成的视频描述，且设计上可推广到其他兼容的VLM架构。

title: FutureRay: Control-Aligned Future Range for Agile Quadruped Navigation
summary: Moving obstacles can block a previously clear route while a quadruped robot executes a motion command. We investigate whether predicting changing clearance improves navigation when motion selection accounts for the robot footprint and the time needed to react and brake. We present FutureRay, which predicts ranges across viewing directions and future times, together with encounter risk, from depth-derived range history and observable robot motion. Training emphasizes near-term clearance and penalizes errors that overstate available space. A local planner queries the same forecast for candidate headings and combines it with current observations to check clearance around the robot footprint. Model-based reaction--braking limits guide speed selection, and the resulting velocity commands are passed to a fixed locomotion policy. In paired evaluations on 60 static and dynamic simulation scenes, FutureRay achieves 93.3% completion, compared with 75.0% for current-range persistence and 80.0% for Cartesian Kalman rollout, with perception, planning, and locomotion held fixed. FutureRay also records fewer collisions than both baselines. Qualitative trials on a physical quadruped show avoidance initiated while an obstacle is approaching the route, followed by renewed goal progress. These results show that joint range and encounter-risk prediction can improve obstacle avoidance without retraining the locomotion policy.

AI.tldr: 提出 FutureRay，预测未来时刻各方向的可通行距离与遭遇风险，并结合机器人足迹与反应-制动时间做速度选择，在保持运动策略不变的情况下提升四足机器人动态避障能力。
AI.motivation: 移动障碍物可能在四足机器人执行运动指令时堵住原本通畅的路径，因此需要预测变化的间隙距离，并在运动选择中考虑机器人足迹以及反应与制动所需时间。
AI.method: FutureRay 基于深度得到的距离历史与可观测的机器人运动，预测不同视角方向、不同未来时刻的距离范围及遭遇风险；训练时强调近期间隙并对高估可用空间的误差进行惩罚。局部规划器对候选朝向查询同一预测，与当前观测结合以检查机器人足迹周围间隙；基于模型的反应-制动限制指导速度选择，速度指令传给固定的运动策略。
AI.result: 在 60 个静态与动态仿真场景的配对评估中，FutureRay 完成率 93.3%，优于当前距离持续假设的 75.0% 与笛卡尔卡尔曼推演的 80.0%，且碰撞次数更少。物理四足机器人定性试验显示，在障碍物逼近路径时即开始避让，随后恢复目标推进。
AI.conclusion: 联合预测距离范围与遭遇风险可在不重新训练运动策略的前提下改善避障表现。

title: RPA: Residual Patch-Token Adapter for Image Retrieval from EEG and MEG
summary: Most existing MEG and EEG (M/EEG) visual decoding methods align brain signals with a single global embedding extracted from a pretrained visual encoder, leaving open whether intermediate patch representations, which preserve richer and more granular rich visual information, can improve representation learning. To address this question, we introduce the Residual Patch Adapter (RPA), a lightweight, modular adapter that leverages all patch tokens from an intermediate layer of a ViT visual encoder for alignment. Through extensive ablation analyses, we first show that pooling or masking patch tokens degrades the learned representation, demonstrating that retaining the full set of patch tokens is important for EEG alignment, while the CLS token provides little unique information. We then use a series of six quantitative feature analyses to show that both higher-level semantics and lower-level visual features, including color and texture, are essential for this EEG-to-image alignment. Under current protocols, our system achieves Top-1 accuracies of 95.4\% within-subject and 35.5\% cross-subject on THINGS-EEG2, and 65.2\% and 6.7\%, respectively, on THINGS-MEG, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across both datasets. Evaluations with alternative brain encoders, including pretrained EEG foundation models, demonstrate that the approach extends beyond the projection-based EEG encoder. Furthermore, we provide a plug-and-play interface that allows RPA to be replaced by convolution, attention, or ConvNeXt alternatives. Together, these findings provide significant insight into M/EEG-to-image representation learning by establishing design principles for leveraging the latent space of visual encoders, and open new directions for brain--image alignment and non-invasive brain--computer interface (BCI).

AI.tldr: 提出 Residual Patch Adapter (RPA)，利用 ViT 中间层全部 patch token 对齐 M/EEG 与图像表示，在 THINGS-EEG2 与 THINGS-MEG 上取得 SOTA，并总结出利用视觉编码器潜在空间的设计原则。
AI.motivation: 现有 M/EEG 视觉解码方法多将脑信号对齐到从预训练视觉编码器提取的单一全局嵌入，未探究保留更丰富、更细粒度视觉信息的中间层 patch 表示能否提升表示学习。
AI.method: 引入轻量、模块化的 Residual Patch Adapter (RPA)，利用 ViT 视觉编码器中间层的全部 patch token 进行对齐；通过大量消融分析（池化/掩码 patch token）验证保留完整 patch token 的重要性，并用六项定量特征分析检验高层语义与低层视觉特征（颜色、纹理）的作用；同时提供可插拔接口，支持卷积、注意力或 ConvNeXt 替代方案，并在包括预训练 EEG 基础模型在内的多种脑编码器上评估。
AI.result: 在当前协议下，THINGS-EEG2 上被试内 Top-1 为 95.4%、跨被试为 35.5%；THINGS-MEG 上分别为 65.2% 和 6.7%，在两个数据集上均达到 SOTA。消融显示池化或掩码 patch token 会降低表示质量，CLS token 提供的信息很少；高层语义与低层视觉特征（颜色、纹理）对 EEG-图像对齐均不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为 M/EEG-图像表示学习提供了重要洞见，确立了利用视觉编码器潜在空间的设计原则，并推动了脑-图像对齐及非侵入式脑机接口的新方向。

title: RoboFFT: Finetuning generative robot policy via online reinforcement learning with forward process
summary: Generative models, such as diffusion and flow-based models, have shown strong promise for robot policy learning by capturing complex and multimodal action distributions from demonstrations. However, policies trained solely with imitation learning often suffer from imperfect demonstrations and distributional shifts, while further improvement typically requires additional expert data. Reinforcement learning offers a natural solution through environment interaction, but effectively finetuning generative robot policies remains challenging due to the intractability of likelihood estimation. In this work, we propose RoboFFT, a forward-process reinforcement learning framework for finetuning generative robot policies, which applies forward noising to sampled actions and uses the weighted score / flow matching loss to construct a surrogate policy ratio for PPO-style updates. We evaluate RoboFFT with popular generative robot policies on representative simulation benchmarks, including long-horizon planning and sparse reward settings. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate that RoboFFT consistently improves performance while achieving better stability and training efficiency. We further integrate RoboFFT into a real world RL framework and demonstrate its effectiveness in real world tasks. Project website: https://student-of-holmes.github.io/RoboFFT/.

AI.tldr: 提出RoboFFT，一种基于前向过程的强化学习框架，用前向加噪与加权得分/流匹配损失构造代理策略比率，实现生成式机器人策略的PPO式微调，提升性能、稳定性与训练效率，并在真实任务中验证。
AI.motivation: 生成式模型（扩散、流模型）在机器人策略学习中能捕捉复杂多模态动作分布，但仅靠模仿学习常受不完美演示和分布偏移困扰，进一步提升需额外专家数据。强化学习可通过环境交互改进，但生成式策略的似然估计不可解，导致微调困难。
AI.method: RoboFFT采用前向过程强化学习框架：对采样动作施加前向加噪，利用加权得分/流匹配损失构造代理策略比率，进而用于PPO式策略更新，从而绕开似然估计的不可解问题。
AI.result: 在代表性仿真基准（含长时程规划与稀疏奖励设置）上，采用多种主流生成式机器人策略评估，RoboFFT持续提升性能，并获得更好的稳定性和训练效率；并集成到真实世界RL框架中，验证了真实任务有效性。
AI.conclusion: RoboFFT为生成式机器人策略提供了一种可行且高效的强化学习微调途径，兼顾性能提升、稳定性与训练效率，并具备真实世界应用潜力。

title: Modernising the Compressed-Domain Video Captioner: A Controlled Study of SigLIP2 and GPT-2 Substitutions
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code, configurations and the exact commit for every run: https://github.com/nepalashim/compressed-video-captioning-ablation-cocap-siglip2-gpt2
summary:
Compressed-domain video captioning avoids full video decoding by operating directly on I-frames, motion vectors and residuals, trading a small amount of accuracy for a large gain in inference speed. CoCap established this pipeline using a CLIP vision encoder and a shallow BERT-style multimodal decoder. Both components predate substantially stronger alternatives. We ask a narrow, controlled question: how much of CoCap's accuracy is limited by these two components, and which of the two is the binding constraint?
  We replace the CLIP I-frame encoder with SigLIP2 and the BERT-style decoder with GPT-2, and evaluate three configurations (the original pairing, the encoder substitution alone, and both substitutions together) under identical data, sampling budget and optimisation schedule. All comparisons are made against our own reproduction of CoCap rather than its published numbers, because we train on a 4,999-clip subset of VATEX at a reduced sampling budget; absolute values are therefore not comparable with the original work.
  Our reproduction tracks the published result closely: CIDEr and METEOR run slightly above it (54.9 against 52.7; 23.4 against 23.2), BLEU-4 and ROUGE-L slightly below (29.7 against 31.4; 48.9 against 49.4). We attribute the differences to our evaluation subset rather than to any improvement in either direction. We find the two substitutions pull in opposite directions: SigLIP2 alone improves every metric (+4.5 CIDEr), while adding GPT-2 on top erodes that gain, because a pretrained decoder overfits 4,999 clips within two epochs. We additionally report inference latency for each configuration, since speed is the property that motivates compressed-domain captioning in the first place, and an accuracy gain purchased at a latency cost should be reported as such.

AI.tldr: 在相同数据与训练预算下替换CoCap的I帧编码器(CLIP→SigLIP2)与多模态解码器(BERT→GPT-2)，发现SigLIP2单独替换可提升全部指标(+4.5 CIDEr)，而叠加GPT-2会因在小数据集上过拟合而侵蚀该增益，并同时报告各配置的推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 压缩域视频描述生成（如CoCap）通过直接在I帧、运动矢量和残差上操作避免完整视频解码，以少量精度换取大幅推理速度提升。但CoCap使用的CLIP视觉编码器和浅层BERT式多模态解码器均已落后于后续更强的替代方案。作者提出一个窄化且受控的问题：CoCap的精度有多少受限于这两个组件，以及其中哪个是瓶颈约束。
AI.method: 用SigLIP2替换CLIP I帧编码器，用GPT-2替换BERT式解码器，在相同数据、采样预算和优化计划下评估三种配置：原始配对、仅替换编码器、两者同时替换。所有比较均针对作者自己对CoCap的复现结果而非其已发表数字，因为训练在VATEX的4,999个片段子集上且采样预算降低，故绝对值不可与原工作直接比较。此外报告每种配置的推理延迟。
AI.result: 复现结果与发表结果接近：CIDEr和METEOR略高(54.9 vs 52.7；23.4 vs 23.2)，BLEU-4和ROUGE-L略低(29.7 vs 31.4；48.9 vs 49.4)，差异归因于评估子集。两种替换方向相反：SigLIP2单独提升每个指标(+4.5 CIDEr)，而叠加GPT-2侵蚀该增益，因为预训练解码器在4,999个片段上两轮内即过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 编码器是当前更紧的瓶颈：升级视觉编码器能带来一致且可测的精度提升，而解码器替换不仅未带来收益反而因小数据过拟合而回退。由于速度是压缩域描述生成的核心动机，精度增益若以延迟为代价应如实报告，故作者给出各配置的推理延迟。

title: Federated Subspace Guided Vision-Language-Action Policy Distillation for Non-IID Multi-Robot Manipulation
summary: Federated learning offers a natural way for multiple robots to jointly improve manipulation policies without requiring centralized access to training demonstrations. However, non-IID task and environment distributions can induce representation drift and mutually incompatible robot-policy updates, making naive parameter aggregation destructive. We present FedDRMan, a federated subspace-guided distillation framework for heterogeneous robot manipulation. At each communication round, the server model provides a frozen teacher for local behavior cloning, while low-rank multimodal subspace and action-distribution distillation preserve globally useful representation geometry and policy behavior. To address heterogeneous aggregation, FedDRMan groups clients by update compatibility and maintains a persistent model for each cluster. The server then spectrally rebalances each compatible aggregate to mitigate attenuation of weaker task-relevant robot-policy update directions. Extensive experiments on LIBERO across diverse non-IID settings, heterogeneity levels, client participation variation, together with ablations and aggregation analyses, show that FedDRMan substantially improves knowledge transfer and consistently outperforms strong federated baselines achieving a peak mean success rate of 80.7%, 11.6 percentage points above the strongest evaluated federated baseline.

AI.tldr: FedDRMan：面向异构机器人操作的联邦子空间引导蒸馏框架
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可让多机器人协同改进操作策略且无需集中训练数据，但任务与环境的非IID分布会导致表征漂移和机器人策略更新互不兼容，使朴素参数聚合产生破坏性效果。
AI.method: 每轮通信中，服务器模型作为冻结教师用于本地行为克隆，同时通过低秩多模态子空间蒸馏与动作分布蒸馏保留全局有用的表征几何与策略行为；针对异构聚合，按更新兼容性对客户端分组，并为每个簇维护持久模型；服务器再对每个兼容聚合结果进行谱重平衡，以缓解较弱任务相关策略更新方向的衰减。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上针对多种非IID设置、异构程度和客户端参与变化的大量实验，以及消融与聚合分析表明，FedDRMan显著改善知识迁移，持续优于强联邦基线，峰值平均成功率达80.7%，比最强联邦基线高出11.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FedDRMan通过子空间引导蒸馏、兼容性分组与谱重平衡，有效应对非IID异构下的表征漂移与聚合冲突，提升异构机器人操作策略的联邦协同学习效果。

title: Integrated Deep Learning Framework Designed on Hybrid Optimization Strategies for Automated Health Detection and Analysis in Silkworms
summary: A Hybrid Residual Attention Network is proposed for accurately classifying silkworm images into six different classes, including healthy and diseased states. It uses residual blocks for deep feature extraction and attention to focus on disease related features. A novel Integrated Adaptive Momentum Optimizer was introduced to enhance convergence and improve training efficiency. The dataset of silkworm images underwent preprocessing techniques such as normalization, resizing, and noise reduction, along with augmentation strategies to improve data quality and diversity. It is optimized using IAMO, achieved an accuracy of 98.67%.The integration of spatial and channel wise attention mechanisms, coupled with IAMO, significantly enhanced the model ability to recognize subtle differences between classes. Results indicate that HRAN can be used to detect disease at an early stage in sericulture, and future work will enhance scalability and efficiency in different environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合残差注意力网络（HRAN），结合残差块、空间与通道注意力机制及新型集成自适应动量优化器（IAMO），用于蚕图像六分类（健康与患病状态），取得98.67%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 蚕养殖（sericulture）中疾病早期检测对生产至关重要，而健康与患病蚕之间差异细微，传统方法难以准确区分，亟需高精度的自动分类模型。
AI.method: 构建混合残差注意力网络（HRAN）：使用残差块进行深层特征提取，融合空间与通道注意力机制以聚焦疾病相关特征；提出新型集成自适应动量优化器（IAMO）提升收敛速度与训练效率；对蚕图像进行归一化、缩放、去噪等预处理，并采用数据增强提升数据质量与多样性。
AI.result: 在蚕图像六分类任务上，采用IAMO优化的HRAN模型达到98.67%的准确率；空间与通道注意力的结合显著增强了模型识别类别间细微差异的能力。
AI.conclusion: HRAN可用于蚕养殖中的疾病早期检测；未来工作将提升其在不同环境下的可扩展性与效率。

title: DS-VLA: A Dendritic-inspired Vision-Language-Action Model for Robust Action Control
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance in language-conditioned manipulation, yet success under nominal evaluation does not necessarily translate into robust closed-loop behavior when executed actions are transiently corrupted. We introduce DS-VLA, a dendritic-inspired action architecture that incorporates dendritic spiking dynamics into VLA control to address this limitation. Specifically, to enable modularized feature processing and temporal information integration, DS-VLA equips action neurons with multiple sparsely connected dendritic branches, each featuring heterogeneous, learned decay factors. Furthermore, to suppress unreliable state updates while preserving task-relevant historical information, we introduce a neuron-wise inhibitory gate that adaptively regulates the admission of new multimodal evidence into dendritic states prior to somatic dynamics. We evaluate DS-VLA on all four LIBERO suites under both nominal rollouts and a unified closed-loop action-perturbation protocol. DS-VLA achieves a 91.6\% average nominal success rate and an 87.35\% average perturbed success rate, retaining 95.4\% of its nominal performance. Under the same reported perturbation setting, OpenVLA-OFT, FAST, $π_0$, and GR00T achieve 39.45\%, 23.90\%, 28.55\%, and 30.75\%, respectively. A controlled ablation isolates the contribution of neuron-wise shared inhibition, while analyses of neural dynamics and post-perturbation trajectories associate robust performance with selective evidence suppression and effective behavioral recovery. Together, these results demonstrate that integrating brain-inspired computational mechanisms offers a promising architectural prior for robust embodied intelligence beyond merely scaling vision-language backbones or generative action decoders.

AI.tldr: DS-VLA利用树突脉冲动力学构建动作神经元结构，在LIBERO四套件上取得91.6%常规成功率和87.35%扰动后成功率，显著优于多个基线。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在常规评测中表现良好，但当执行动作受到瞬时扰动时，闭环鲁棒性明显不足，需要超越单纯扩展视觉-语言主干或生成式动作解码器的架构先验。
AI.method: 提出DS-VLA：为动作神经元配置多条稀疏连接的树突分支，分支具有异质的学习衰减因子，以实现模块化特征处理与时间信息整合；引入神经元级抑制门，在胞体动力学前自适应调控新多模态证据进入树突状态，抑制不可靠状态更新并保留任务相关历史信息。
AI.result: 在LIBERO全部四套件、常规与统一闭环动作扰动协议下，DS-VLA平均常规成功率91.6%，扰动后87.35%，保留95.4%性能；相同扰动设置下OpenVLA-OFT、FAST、π0、GR00T分别为39.45%、23.90%、28.55%、30.75%。消融隔离了神经元级共享抑制的贡献，动力学和扰动后轨迹分析表明鲁棒性关联于选择性证据抑制与行为恢复。
AI.conclusion: 将类脑计算机制融入VLA控制是提升具身智能鲁棒性的有效架构先验，其价值超越单纯扩展视觉-语言主干或生成式动作解码器。

title: CLC-YOLO: A Compact Channel-Gated Prototype Network for Real-Time Leakage-Aware Breast Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation
summary: Reliable breast ultrasound lesion segmentation requires accurate boundaries and evaluation that prevents patients or duplicate images from crossing data splits. We propose Channel Local Contrast (CLC), a compact refinement of the YOLO26 segmentation prototype head. CLC adds a fixed local high-pass residual controlled by 64 zero-initialized, bounded channel gates. Baseline and CLC were compared in five matched folds on each of four breast ultrasound datasets. BUS-BRA used patient-disjoint outer tests with separate inner validation. BUS-UCLM and BrEaST used patient-grouped validation folds; BUSI used duplicate-component groups because patient identifiers are unavailable. Group-macro Dice increased by 1.68, 3.11, 1.12, and 2.45 percentage points on BUS-BRA, BUS-UCLM, BUSI, and BrEaST, respectively. Only the BUS-BRA paired 95% confidence interval excluded zero. CLC adds 64 parameters and 0.0049 giga floating-point operations (GFLOPs). At 640 pixels, single-T4, batch-one, 16-bit floating-point (FP16) TensorRT graph times were 2.1478 ms for CLC and 2.0512 ms for baseline, excluding preprocessing and postprocessing. CLC increased group-macro Dice across all four datasets with a measured T4 forward-pass overhead of 0.0966 ms. Code: https://github.com/mfazrinizar/CLC-YOLO

AI.tldr: 提出通道局部对比（CLC）模块，对YOLO26分割原型头做轻量改进，在四个乳腺超声数据集上均提升组宏Dice，仅增加64个参数和0.0049 GFLOPs，T4单张前向耗时仅增0.0966 ms。
AI.motivation: 乳腺超声病灶分割既需要准确边界，也需要防止患者或重复图像跨越数据划分造成评估泄漏。现有分割原型头在边界刻画上仍有提升空间，且评估方案需更严格。
AI.method: 提出CLC，作为YOLO26分割原型头的紧凑细化：加入固定的局部高通残差，由64个零初始化、有界的通道门控调节。在四个数据集上各做五折匹配对比：BUS-BRA用患者不交叉的外部测试加独立内部验证；BUS-UCLM与BrEaST用患者分组的验证折；BUSI因缺少患者标识，改用重复成分分组。
AI.result: 组宏Dice分别提升1.68、3.11、1.12、2.45个百分点（BUS-BRA、BUS-UCLM、BUSI、BrEaST）。仅BUS-BRA的配对95%置信区间不包含零。CLC增加64个参数与0.0049 GFLOPs。640像素、单T4、batch-one、FP16 TensorRT图时间：CLC为2.1478 ms，基线为2.0512 ms（不含前处理与后处理）。
AI.conclusion: CLC在四个数据集上一致提升组宏Dice，T4前向额外开销实测仅0.0966 ms，说明该改进以极低参数量与计算代价换来性能提升；但统计显著性仅在BUS-BRA上得到支持，其余数据集的提升需更稳健验证。代码已开源。

title: Affordance-Conditioned Decision Making: Bridging the Semantic-Spatial Gap in Zero-Shot Cross-Floor Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-language navigation increasingly relies on general-purpose semantic planners, yet translating correct high-level intent into reliable physical execution remains difficult in spatially constrained transitions. Reaching a staircase, doorway, or narrow passage does not ensure traversal; the agent must identify an executable affordance pose and recover from accumulated action errors. We propose PACE (Preference-refined Affordance-Conditioned Execution), a supervised local execution module that augments frozen zero-shot semantic planners for reliable cross-floor navigation. PACE grounds transition-related semantics into a long-horizon, agent-centric traversable affordance pose and conditions short-horizon action generation on this spatial target, thereby aligning semantic goals with physical execution. We further post-train PACE through failure-aware preference refinement using rollout-derived pairs that contrast normal or recovery behaviors with deviation-amplifying behaviors, thereby improving closed-loop correction. We integrate PACE into six open-source zero-shot VLN navigators and demonstrate consistent improvements on the cross-floor subsets of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, increasing the average success rate from 16.35% to 27.65% and from 4.76% to 12.06%, respectively. Real-world experiments further demonstrate PACE's applicability in unseen environments, highlighting the potential of traversable affordances to bridge semantic intent and reliable embodied behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出PACE模块，通过可通行可供性位姿与偏好精炼，提升零样本VLN规划器的跨楼层导航物理执行可靠性。
AI.motivation: 通用语义规划器虽能生成正确的高层意图，但在空间受限的过渡场景（楼梯、门道、狭窄通道）中难以转化为可靠执行；到达过渡区域不等于能成功穿越，智能体需识别可执行的可供性位姿并纠正累积动作误差。
AI.method: PACE为监督式局部执行模块，加载于冻结的零样本语义规划器之上：将过渡语义落地为长时程、以智能体为中心的可通行可供性位姿，并以此空间目标为条件生成短时程动作；再通过基于失败感知的偏好精炼进行后训练，利用rollout产生的对比数据（正常/恢复行为 vs. 放大偏差行为）提升闭环纠错能力。
AI.result: 集成到六个开源零样本VLN导航器后，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE跨楼层子集上均取得一致提升：平均成功率分别从16.35%升至27.65%、从4.76%升至12.06%。真实环境实验表明其在未见环境中同样适用。
AI.conclusion: 可通行可供性能够有效衔接语义意图与可靠的具身行为，PACE作为通用增强模块可显著提升跨楼层导航的执行成功率并具备真实场景泛化潜力。

title: MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding: Replication-Aware Automatic Stopping for Subword Tokenization
comment: 15 pages, 3 tables, 1 algorithm. Source code available online
summary:
Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) constructs subword vocabularies through greedy pair merging, but conventional BPE requires the number of merges or target vocabulary size to be specified externally. Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (SG-BPE) replaces frequency-only selection with a statistical criterion based on how strongly an observed pair exceeds its expected co-occurrence under an independence model.
  This paper introduces MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (MDL-SG), a three-stage procedure separating discovery, replication, and utility. Candidate pairs are ranked by Significance-Gain on a discovery partition, tested for replication on a separate partition using an exact one-sided hypergeometric test with per-iteration Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and then evaluated on a utility partition using a Minimum Description Length (MDL) criterion. Merging stops automatically when no replicated candidate yields positive held-out MDL gain.
  On WikiText-103, MDL-SG stops at 209, 433, and 847 merges for 120K, 250K, and 500K-character tokenizer-training samples, respectively. At 500K characters, it selects a stored vocabulary of 1,017 tokens without prescribing the vocabulary size in advance. In a compute-matched TinyGPT experiment with identical 2,024,448-parameter models and 500 optimizer updates per language model, MDL-SG achieves validation/test BPC of 3.2612/3.2436, compared with test BPC of 3.2894 for SG-BPE and 3.3493 for frequency BPE. Frequency BPE achieves stronger raw compression, while MDL-SG achieves lower BPC, showing that compression-oriented merge selection and language-model utility need not coincide.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MDL-SG，一种三阶段子词分词构建方法，通过发现、复制与效用评估自动决定合并次数，无需预先指定词表大小。
AI.motivation: 传统BPE需要外部指定合并次数或目标词表大小，且仅凭频率选择合并对，未必符合语言模型的实际效用需求。
AI.method: MDL-SG分离发现、复制和效用三个分区：在发现集上用Significance-Gain排序候选对；在复制集上用单侧超几何检验并配合逐迭代Benjamini-Hochberg校正；在效用集上用最小描述长度（MDL）准则评估，当无复制候选带来正留出MDL增益时自动停止合并。
AI.result: 在WikiText-103上，MDL-SG对120K、250K、500K字符训练样本分别停止于209、433、847次合并；500K字符时得到1,017个词的词表而无需预设大小。在算力匹配的TinyGPT实验中（2,024,448参数、500次优化更新），验证/测试BPC为3.2612/3.2436，优于SG-BPE的3.2894和频率BPE的3.3493。
AI.conclusion: 频率BPE压缩率更强，但MDL-SG获得更低BPC，说明面向压缩的合并选择与语言模型效用并不一致；MDL-SG能自动确定合并规模并提升语言模型表现。

title: MemTransfer: Benchmarking Memory Beyond Matched Experience in Embodied Decision-Making
summary: Memory lets an embodied agent reuse past experience, yet retaining useful information does not ensure that the agent can apply it when conditions change. We present MemTransfer, a benchmark comparing six memory representations, a working-memory baseline and five representations of past experience, under a shared frozen vision-language-model policy. It comprises 100 navigation cases across ten task types in a simulated warehouse, with expert demonstrations supplying the history. Three comparisons vary the starting pose, route availability, and amount and task relevance of history. With one demonstration per task, Full-context and Episodic memory reach 95.3% and 100.0% success at the original demonstration start, but lose 48-49 percentage points at a new test start. Summary changes little between these two test starts, yet with four demonstrations per task it retains a smaller fraction of its unchanged-route success after blocking (39.3%) than Working memory (44.8%) or the two trajectory memories (56-58%). At the new test start, increasing from one to four relevant demonstrations raises Episodic success by 14.3 percentage points, while the other evaluated representations gain no more than 1.3 percentage points. Replacing half of the relevant histories with other-task experience lowers success for both trajectory memories. These results show that robustness to one kind of mismatch does not imply robustness to another, motivating evaluation of both stored information and its use at decision time.

AI.tldr: MemTransfer 是一个具身导航记忆基准，在共享冻结视觉语言模型策略下比较六种记忆表示，发现记忆对某一类条件变化的鲁棒性不能迁移到另一类变化。
AI.motivation: 记忆让具身智能体复用过去经验，但"保留有用信息"不等于"条件变化时能用上它"，现有评估缺乏对多种记忆表示在多种失配条件下的系统比较。
AI.method: 构建模拟仓库环境，含十类任务共100个导航案例，由专家示范提供历史。在共享冻结视觉语言模型策略下比较六种记忆表示：一个工作记忆基线和五种过去经验表示。设置三组对比：改变起始位姿、改变路线可用性、改变历史数量及其任务相关性。
AI.result: 每任务一个示范时，Full-context 与 Episodic 在原始示范起点成功率分别为95.3%和100.0%，但在新测试起点下降48–49个百分点。Summary 在两个测试起点间变化很小，但当每任务四个示范并封锁路线后，其保持成功率（39.3%）低于 Working memory（44.8%）和两种轨迹记忆（56–58%）。新测试起点下，相关示范由1个增至4个使 Episodic 成功率提升14.3个百分点，而其他表示提升不超过1.3个百分点。用其他任务经验替换一半相关历史会降低两种轨迹记忆的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 对某一类失配的鲁棒性并不意味着对另一类失配也鲁棒，因此评估记忆时需同时考察所存信息及其在决策时刻的实际使用。

title: Can't Find Waldo: Evaluating VLMs' Sensitivity to Image Resolution and Detail Level
summary: Visual Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse tasks, yet they struggle with high-resolution inputs where critical information resides in small regions or detailed, cluttered scenes. While several approaches address this limitation, a systematic understanding of why models fail at high resolutions is lacking. We introduce a controlled evaluation framework that disentangles resolution-related performance degradation from task difficulty through semantics-preserving transformations. We propose two simple metrics: Area Under the Scaling Curve (AUSC), which quantifies scaling robustness independent of baseline accuracy, and Prediction Variance Score (PVS), which measures resolution-induced prediction instability. Through comprehensive experiments across 5 model families and 5 benchmarks, we identify three primary failure modes: (1) information loss from downsampling at vision token limits, (2) tokenization artifacts from patch boundary shifts and positional encoding fragility under non-standard aspect ratios, and (3) attention dilution as token counts increase. Our analysis reveals that even state-of-the-art models suffer from performance drops when processing high-resolution images, with degradation patterns varying systematically by architectural family. We provide actionable insights for model architecture design and data augmentation strategies to mitigate these limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个可控评估框架，通过语义保持变换解耦分辨率相关的性能下降与任务难度，并给出AUSC和PVS两个指标，跨5个模型家族和5个基准识别出三大高分辨率失效模式。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在需关注小区域或杂乱细节的高分辨率输入上表现不佳，但学界缺乏对高分辨率失败原因的系统性理解。现有方法多为针对性修补，未厘清性能下降究竟源自分辨率本身还是任务难度。作者希望建立一个可控框架，将分辨率相关的退化与任务难度分离，并量化不同架构的缩放鲁棒性与预测稳定性。
AI.method: 提出可控评估框架，使用语义保持变换（semantics-preserving transformations）将分辨率相关的性能退化与任务难度解耦。设计两个简单指标：AUSC（Scaling Curve下面积），在独立于基线准确率的情况下量化缩放鲁棒性；PVS（Prediction Variance Score），衡量由分辨率引起的预测不稳定性。实验覆盖5个模型家族与5个基准进行综合评估。
AI.result: 识别出三类主要失效模式：(1) 视觉token上限下采样导致的信息损失；(2) 非标准宽高比下patch边界移动与位置编码脆弱性带来的tokenization伪影；(3) token数量增加导致的注意力稀释。实验表明即便SOTA模型在处理高分辨率图像时也出现性能下降，且退化模式按架构家族呈现系统性差异。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率下VLM的性能下降可归因于上述三类可解释失效模式，且与架构强相关。作者据此提出面向模型架构设计与数据增强策略的可操作建议，以缓解这些局限。

title: WSM-Aware HRI: An IoT-Enhanced Framework for Early Detection and Norm-Guided Repair of Failures with LLM Guidance
summary: Human-robot interaction (HRI) failures remain a major barrier to deploying robots in real-world environments. Prior work often treats failures as isolated technical faults or focuses on post-hoc recovery behaviors. In practice, many breakdowns arise because humans and robots operate under inconsistent assumptions about the current world state. We propose WSM-Aware HRI, an IoT-enhanced modular framework that unifies diverse HRI breakdowns as World-State Mismatches (WSMs) between a human's instruction-implied assumptions and a robot's grounded world model built from multimodal perception and digital augmentation. A Large Language Model (LLM) is used to make implicit assumptions explicit, map them to a small set of mismatch types, and specify the evidence needed for verification against the robot's world state. WSM-Aware HRI shifts failure handling from execution-time recovery to proactive mismatch detection during intention formation, enabling interventions guided by safety, norm compliance, and multi-user coordination with transparent explanations. We evaluate mismatch identification in ten everyday cases spanning both visual and latent-state mismatches. The system can accurately produce the expected output results, and ablations show that reliable identification depends on appropriate grounding representations and verification-oriented refinement. These results indicate that treating interaction breakdowns as explicit world-state mismatches enables earlier detection of impending failures and offers a principled mechanism for integrating external evidence and social constraints into human-robot interaction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出WSM-Aware HRI框架，将人机交互失败统一建模为"世界状态不匹配"（WSM），利用LLM显式化隐含假设并在意图形成阶段主动检测不匹配，从而实现更早的失败预防。
AI.motivation: 人机交互失败是机器人落地的主要障碍，而现有研究多将失败视为孤立的技术故障或仅关注事后恢复行为。实际上，许多故障源于人与机器人对当前世界状态的假设不一致。
AI.method: 提出WSM-Aware HRI，一个IoT增强的模块化框架。将各类人机交互故障统一为人类指令隐含假设与机器人基于多模态感知和数字增强构建的世界模型之间的"世界状态不匹配"。使用大语言模型（LLM）显式化隐含假设，映射到少量不匹配类型，并指定验证所需证据，从而在意图形成阶段进行主动不匹配检测。
AI.result: 在十个涵盖视觉与潜在状态不匹配的日常案例上评估不匹配识别，系统能准确产生预期输出；消融实验表明可靠识别依赖适当的grounding表示与面向验证的refinement。
AI.conclusion: 将交互故障视为显式的世界状态不匹配，能够更早检测潜在失败，并为将外部证据与社会约束整合进人机交互提供了一种有原则的机制。

title: Cross-Dataset Generalization of Bangladeshi Rice Leaf Disease Classifiers: Benchmark, Diagnosis, and Mitigation
summary: Cross-dataset transfer in rice leaf disease classification remains a significant challenge, with models trained on one image collection performing substantially worse when deployed on another. We conduct a systematic benchmark across three Bangladeshi rice leaf disease datasets (5,419 images, 6 transfer pairs, 3 CNN backbones, 3 random seeds) to characterize and diagnose this failure. Strong augmentation recovers a mean cross-dataset macro-F1 improvement of +0.070 (Wilcoxon p < 0.001, 15 of 18 transfer pairs positive). Removing non-leaf image content via segmentation shows directional benefit (mean +0.066, p = 0.062, n = 36 paired observations) that is consistent across two independent segmentation methods but does not reach conventional significance. A self-supervised ViT control (DINOv2 linear probe) exhibits equivalent cross-dataset collapse to CNNs, ruling out architecture inductive bias as the primary driver and pointing to acquisition-condition shift. Adaptive batch normalization uniformly harms transfer performance, with harm magnitude correlating with source-target label-prior divergence and model depth (Spearman rho = 0.621, p = 0.009). Grad-CAM attribution analysis on 12 sampled predictions does not distinguish correct from incorrect cross-domain predictions (p = 0.462), indicating that common attribution proxies are insufficient for diagnosing shift at practical sample sizes. We document all frozen results, prespecified analysis criteria, and reproducibility artifacts in a public repository with SHA-256 integrity verification. This work establishes a rigorous empirical baseline for understanding cross-dataset generalization in agricultural computer vision and identifies both effective (augmentation) and ineffective (AdaBN) adaptation strategies.

AI.tldr: 该论文对水稻叶片病害跨数据集迁移进行系统基准评测，发现强增强有效（+0.070 macro-F1），而自适应批归一化（AdaBN）反而有害，并指出常见归因代理不足以诊断域偏移。
AI.motivation: 水稻叶片病害分类模型在一个图像集上训练后，部署到另一数据集时性能显著下降，跨数据集迁移失败问题突出，但缺乏系统性诊断与实证基线。
AI.method: 在3个孟加拉水稻叶片病害数据集（5,419张图像）上构建6组迁移对，采用3种CNN骨干、3个随机种子；评估强数据增强、分割去除非叶片内容、自监督ViT对照（DINOv2线性探针）、自适应批归一化（AdaBN）以及Grad-CAM归因分析，并公开冻结结果与SHA-256校验工件。
AI.result: 强增强取得平均macro-F1提升+0.070（Wilcoxon p<0.001，18组中15组为正）；分割去除非叶片内容呈正向趋势（+0.066，p=0.062）但未达显著；DINOv2表现与CNN相同的跨域性能崩塌，排除架构归纳偏置为主因；AdaBN一致损害迁移，其损害幅度与源-目标标签先验差异及模型深度相关（Spearman rho=0.621，p=0.009）；Grad-CAM在12个样本上无法区分正确与错误的跨域预测（p=0.462）。
AI.conclusion: 跨数据集失败主要由采集条件偏移驱动，而非架构归纳偏置；强增强是有效适应策略，AdaBN无效甚至有害；常见归因代理在实用样本量下不足以诊断域偏移。该工作为农业计算机视觉跨数据集泛化建立了严格实证基线。

title: Human Motion Prediction for Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: This paper compares three human motion prediction methods - GMM-based clustering, TransFusion, and Graph-Mixer - evaluating their effectiveness in human-robot collaboration. These predictions are valuable for improving robot motion planning by anticipating human movements and enhancing safety and efficiency in dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文将基于GMM聚类、TransFusion和Graph-Mixer三种人体运动预测方法进行对比，评估其在人机协作场景中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 人体运动预测有助于机器人提前预判人类动作，从而改进运动规划，并在动态环境中提升安全性与效率，因此需要比较不同预测方法在人机协作中的表现。
AI.method: 采用对比研究的方式，对GMM聚类、TransFusion和Graph-Mixer三种人体运动预测方法进行评估。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据或量化结果，仅说明对三种方法在人机协作中的有效性进行了评价。
AI.conclusion: 人体运动预测对人机协作具有重要价值，但摘要未明确给出三种方法的优劣结论。

title: Statistical Testing for Multiple Instance Learning via Selective Inference with Applications to Computational Pathology
summary: Multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely used in computational pathology because it enables weakly supervised analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) without requiring patch-level annotations. In attention-based MIL, instances with high attention scores are often interpreted as diagnostically important regions and used as visual explanations. However, attention scores alone cannot determine whether selected high-attention instances are significantly different from normal instances, limiting the reliability of attention-based explanations. In this paper, we formulate the evaluation of high-attention instances as a statistical hypothesis testing problem. Specifically, we assess whether a selected high-attention instance significantly deviates from a representative normal reference instance selected based on feature similarity. A major challenge is that both the target instance and the reference instance are selected through data-dependent procedures, rendering standard hypothesis testing invalid. To address this issue, we introduce a selective inference (SI) framework that explicitly accounts for the selection events induced by attention-based instance selection and adaptive reference selection, thereby enabling the computation of valid selective $p$-values conditional on these events. Experiments demonstrate Type-I error control on synthetic and MNIST-based data and practical applicability to pathological WSIs, with higher statistical power than the conventional over-conditioning approach.

AI.tldr: 本文将高注意力实例的评估建模为统计假设检验问题，并引入选择性推断框架来计算有效的选择性p值。
AI.motivation: 在基于注意力的多实例学习（MIL）中，高注意力实例常被当作诊断重要区域并用作视觉解释，但仅凭注意力分数无法判断所选高注意力实例是否显著偏离正常实例，从而限制了注意力解释的可靠性。
AI.method: 将高注意力实例的评估形式化为假设检验：检验被选实例是否显著偏离基于特征相似度选出的代表性正常参考实例；由于目标实例与参考实例均通过数据依赖过程选出，标准检验失效，因此提出选择性推断（SI）框架，显式建模注意力实例选择与自适应参考选择带来的选择事件，从而在给定这些事件的条件下计算有效的选择性p值。
AI.result: 在合成数据与基于MNIST的数据上实现了Type-I错误控制，并在病理WSI上验证了实际适用性，且统计功效高于传统的过度条件化方法。
AI.conclusion: 选择性推断可为注意力MIL中的高注意力实例提供具有有效性保证的统计评估，提升注意力解释的可靠性，并优于过度条件化方法。

title: Proactive Motion Planning for Human-Robot Cooperation
summary: This abstract addresses the incorporation of human motion prediction into proactive and dynamic human-aware motion planning, with the goal of enabling safe collaboration between humans and robots. A deep learning, graph-based model is used to forecast human motion and is integrated into a planning framework. This framework employs a static roadmap along with a time-variant A* algorithm to modify the trajectory of a UR5e manipulator. This method greatly improves human-robot interaction and enables proactive collision avoidance by combining precise motion forecasts with adaptive trajectory planning.

AI.tldr: 该论文将基于图深度学习的人体运动预测融入主动式动态人因感知运动规划框架，借助静态路径图与时间变化A*算法调整UR5e机械臂轨迹，实现人机安全协作与主动避碰。
AI.motivation: 目标是实现人与机器人的安全协作，需要机器人在动态环境中主动预测人的运动并据此提前调整自身行为，而非被动响应。
AI.method: 采用基于图的深度学习模型预测人体运动，并将其集成到规划框架中；该框架使用静态路径图结合时间变化的A*算法，对UR5e机械臂的轨迹进行修正。
AI.result: 将精确的运动预测与自适应轨迹规划相结合，显著提升了人机交互效果，并实现了主动式碰撞避免。
AI.conclusion: 人体运动预测与动态规划的融合是提升人机协作安全性与主动避碰能力的有效途径。

title: Agentic Video Understanding: A Survey
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become capable of processing increasingly diverse modalities and longer temporal contexts, an emerging line of work is moving beyond fixed video-language inference toward agentic systems that actively decide what information to inspect, retain, verify, and act upon. This survey reviews video understanding agents: systems that use video as the primary information source and solve understanding tasks through adaptive state construction and action selection. We first formalize an agent loop for video understanding, then address a central question: why do agents matter for video understanding? To answer this, we organize the literature through a challenge-to-design taxonomy, linking context bottlenecks to hierarchical evidence memory, evidence sparsity to active evidence acquisition, temporal causality to state and process tracking, and multimodal ambiguity to role-specialized coordination. We further review state space paradigms, learning paradigms, supervision signals, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols. Finally, we identify open directions toward agentic-native temporal modeling and video-native agents. Project page: https://github.com/DXY0711/Awesome-Agentic-Video-Understanding

AI.tldr: 本文综述了"视频理解智能体"这一新兴方向：系统以视频为主要信息源，通过自适应状态构建与动作选择完成理解任务，并提出了从挑战到设计的分类体系，最后展望了智能体原生时序建模等开放方向。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型能够处理日益多样的模态与更长的时间上下文，研究正从固定的视频-语言推理范式，转向能主动决定检视、保留、验证哪些信息并据此行动的智能体系统，因此需要对该方向进行系统梳理与形式化。
AI.method: 本文首先形式化视频理解的智能体循环，并以"挑战到设计"的分类法组织文献：将上下文瓶颈对应到层次化证据记忆，将证据稀疏对应到主动证据获取，将时序因果对应到状态与过程追踪，将多模态歧义对应到角色专门化协作；此外还综述了状态空间范式、学习范式、监督信号、基准与评测协议。
AI.result: 论文提供了视频理解智能体的统一形式化框架与挑战-设计对应关系，并系统整理了该领域的状态空间与学习范式、监督信号以及基准和评测协议。
AI.conclusion: 本文指出了通向智能体原生时序建模与视频原生智能体等开放研究方向，并提供了项目页面以汇总相关资源。

title: RE-0: Verified Recursive Improvement of Embodied Code-as-Policy Agents through Local On-Policy Distillation
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Corresponding author: Hongzhou Wang (wanghongzhou@jlu.edu.cn)
summary: Code-as-Policy agents accomplish long-horizon embodied tasks by generating and executing code, yet continually improving them with teachers that are stronger but not globally reliable remains a key challenge. Existing distillation methods typically treat the teacher's complete behavior as the supervision target and thus misassign training credit on states where the teacher fails. We propose RE-0, a recursively verified policy improvement framework: rather than assuming that the teacher globally outperforms the student, RE-0 requests local corrections from the teacher on the student's own failure histories and checks in the environment whether each correction is genuinely beneficial; verified corrections yield immediate improvement. Building on this, we propose RE-OPD, which turns verified interventions into supervision for on-policy distillation. Only counterfactually verified teacher interventions provide distribution-level supervision, weighted by their measured local benefit, and the improvement they induce is projected back into the standalone student, so both where supervision is applied and how much credit the teacher receives co-evolve with the student policy. We further prove that the student's per-round gain is lower-bounded by its verified intervention gain up to verification and projection error terms. Experiments across multiple Code-as-Policy embodied tasks show that RE-0 improves both teacher-assisted execution and the standalone student, and generalizes to novel robots and scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RE-0与RE-OPD框架，通过递归验证教师局部修正，实现更可靠的Code-as-Policy智能体策略改进与在策略蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有蒸馏方法将教师完整行为作为监督目标，在教师失败的状态上错误分配训练信用。教师虽更强但并非全局可靠，如何持续改进Code-as-Policy智能体仍是关键挑战。
AI.method: RE-0不假设教师全局优于学生，而是在学生自身失败历史请求教师局部修正，并在环境中验证每个修正是否真正有益。RE-OPD进一步将验证过的干预转化为在策略蒸馏的监督信号，仅由反事实验证的教师干预提供分布级监督，按其测得的局部收益加权，并将改进投影回独立学生，使监督位置与教师信用随学生策略共同演化。
AI.result: 理论上证明了学生的每轮收益下界为经验证的干预收益（至多相差验证与投影误差项）。在多个Code-as-Policy具身任务上，RE-0同时提升了教师辅助执行与独立学生表现，并能泛化到新机器人与新场景。
AI.conclusion: 通过递归验证教师干预并按局部收益加权蒸馏，可有效避免错误信用分配，实现学生策略与监督信号的协同演化，提升独立部署性能与泛化能力。

title: OmniFysics-Captioner Technical Report: Grounding Omni-Modal Understanding in the Physical World for Better Captioning
summary: Building omni-modal models with physical intelligence requires fine-grained supervision that captures physical evidence such as contact, support, deformation, and state transitions. However, existing omni-modal captioners primarily model general audiovisual semantics and often overlook transient or spatially localized physical evidence. We present a unified framework for physics-aware audiovisual captioning spanning data construction, training, and evaluation. Firstly, we build a data construction pipeline that identifies physics-rich clips and leverages OmniFysics-Agent to coordinate audio, visual, and physical-perception tools for collecting spatiotemporally aligned and traceable cross-modal evidence; within the Agent, a physical perception model (PPM) fine-tuned on approximately 2M image-level samples serves as a dedicated tool for extracting object-interaction and state-change cues. Secondly, we build the Daily-Physics 50K dataset and introduce the evidence-driven OmniPhysCap (OPC) benchmark to evaluate the recovery of physical and cross-modal evidence from generated captions. Finally, we train OmniFysics-Captioner from the resulting data. Our Captioner matches Gemini 3.1 Pro on audiovisual captioning, achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple video-captioning benchmarks, and substantially outperforms other open-source models. Ablations show that PPM evidence improves physical coverage and produces finer-grained, more reliable cross-modal descriptions.

AI.tldr: 提出物理感知的音视频字幕统一框架，涵盖数据构建、训练与评估，模型在多个基准上达到最优。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态字幕模型主要建模通用视听语义，忽视瞬态或空间局部的物理证据（如接触、支撑、形变、状态转换），而构建具身物理智能的全模态模型需要这类细粒度监督。
AI.method: 构建识别物理丰富片段的数据构建流程，利用 OmniFysics-Agent 协调音频、视觉和物理感知工具，收集时空对齐且可追溯的跨模态证据；其中物理感知模型（PPM）基于约 200 万图像级样本微调，作为提取物体交互和状态变化线索的专用工具。构建 Daily-Physics 50K 数据集与证据驱动的 OmniPhysCap（OPC）基准，并训练 OmniFysics-Captioner。
AI.result: Captioner 在音视频字幕上与 Gemini 3.1 Pro 相当，在多个视频字幕基准上达到当前最优，并显著优于其他开源模型。消融实验表明 PPM 证据提升了物理覆盖度，产生了更细粒度、更可靠的跨模态描述。
AI.conclusion: 面向物理感知的音视频字幕统一框架有效，结合专用物理感知模型与证据驱动数据可提升跨模态物理证据的恢复与描述质量。

title: DRAM: Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory for Robot Manipulation Policies
summary: Robotic manipulation is inherently history-dependent, yet most pretrained robotic policies condition on only the current observation or a short temporal window. Equipping such policies with long-term memory remains challenging: existing approaches either feed the backbone multi-frame observation windows, which substantially increase inference cost, or rely on pre-defined semantic features, which limit task generality and may also require the retraining of the backbone to adapt to the memory. We introduce DRAM (Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory), a plug-and-play memory module that can be attached to a wide range of pretrained robotic policies, endowing them with long-horizon memory without architectural modification or backbone retraining, requiring only task-specific post-training of the memory module and action expert. DRAM maintains a fixed-size associative memory using gated delta-rule linear attention, with a modified update that incorporates all tokens within each frame in parallel. An architecture-agnostic readout integrates historical context into action prediction across different policy architectures. Experiments show that DRAM consistently improves frozen pretrained policies over short-context baselines and alternative compact memory designs, validating its effectiveness as a fixed-size, post-hoc memory module trained with the backbone frozen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRAM，一种即插即用的记忆模块，可为预训练机器人策略赋予长时程记忆，无需修改架构或重训练骨架。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作本质上是依赖历史的，但现有预训练策略通常只以当前观测或短时间窗口为条件。为策略添加长期记忆存在困难：要么输入多帧观测窗口导致推理成本大增，要么依赖预定义的语义特征，限制了任务通用性且可能需要重训练骨架。因此需要一种兼容性强、成本低的长时记忆方案。
AI.method: DRAM（Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory）采用门控delta-rule线性注意力维护固定大小的关联记忆，并修改更新方式以并行纳入每帧内所有token。同时设计了一种架构无关的读出机制，将历史上下文融入不同策略架构的动作预测中，仅需对记忆模块和动作专家进行任务特定的后训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，DRAM在冻结的预训练策略上持续优于短上下文基线以及其他紧凑记忆设计，验证了其作为固定大小、后置式记忆模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DRAM是一种有效的即插即用记忆模块，可在不修改架构、不重训练骨架的情况下为多种预训练机器人策略赋予长时程记忆能力。

title: Fysiverse-3D-SimReady Technical Report: Agentic Physical Simulation for Pragmatic 3D World Reconstruction
summary: Agentic recognition requires visual perception to move beyond static scene understanding and produce structured scene representations that support the perception--reasoning--action loop. Existing single-image 3D generation methods, however, mainly produce visually plausible object assets rather than simulation-ready scene states. When independently generated meshes are composed in a shared space, they may fail to align with the input camera, violate gravity, interpenetrate nearby objects, or become unstable under physics simulation. We present Fysiverse-3D-SimReady, a grounded refinement framework for reconstructing simulation-ready multi-object scenes from a single RGB image with instance and ground prompts. The method places generated object meshes into a shared gravity-aligned scene, refines their camera-space poses through differentiable rendering, and corrects scene-level supports and contacts for stable physical execution. The scene is then used by an agentic simulation workflow, which converts a scene-specific task goal into an executable physics rollout rendered from the original camera view. Experiments show that Fysiverse-3D-SimReady improves input-view alignment, contact plausibility, and physical stability over existing single-image reconstruction and scene generation baselines, while enabling goal-conditioned physical interactions from a single image.

AI.tldr: 提出Fysiverse-3D-SimReady框架，从单张RGB图像重建可直接用于物理仿真的多物体场景，提升对齐、接触合理性与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有单图3D生成方法主要产出视觉上可信的物体资产，而非仿真就绪的场景状态；独立生成的网格组合后常出现与输入相机不对齐、违反重力、物体穿插或仿真不稳定等问题，无法支撑感知-推理-行动闭环。
AI.method: 在给定实例与地面提示下，将生成物体网格放入统一的、重力对齐的共享场景；通过可微渲染优化相机空间位姿；随后修正场景级的支撑与接触关系以保证物理执行的稳定性。场景进一步接入智能体仿真工作流，将任务目标转化为可执行的物理仿真展开，并从原始相机视角渲染。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在输入视角对齐、接触合理性与物理稳定性上优于现有单图重建与场景生成基线，并实现从单张图像出发的目标条件物理交互。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将单图场景重建从"视觉可信"推进到"仿真就绪"，为面向智能体任务的感知-推理-行动闭环提供了可行路径。

title: GlowTact: Simple and Compact Vision-Based Tactile Sensing with High Sensitivity and Spatial Resolution
summary: Vision-based tactile sensors (VBTS) provide rich contact information for robotic manipulation, but existing designs can be hard to simplify and adapt to the size and constraints of humanoid fingertips. We introduce \textbf{GlowTact}, a pressure-responsive vision-based tactile sensing mechanism that directly visualizes contact pressure. \textbf{GlowTact} requires only single-color, non-directional illumination, and the raw tactile image directly represents the pressure distribution without explicit geometry reconstruction. This simple sensing principle enables compact, customizable tactile sensors while preserving high sensitivity and rich spatial detail. We demonstrate gram-scale contact detection, accurate normal-force estimation, and reconstruction of fine contact geometry, including M1 screw threads. These results establish \textbf{GlowTact} as a practical new sensing technology for compact humanoid fingertips, combining a durable nitrile membrane and simple optical design with sensitive and information-rich tactile perception.

AI.tldr: GlowTact是一种压力响应式视觉触觉传感机制，直接可视化接触压力，仅需单色非定向照明，适合紧凑型人形指尖应用。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉触觉传感器（VBTS）设计复杂，难以简化和适配人形指尖的尺寸与约束条件，需要一种更紧凑、可定制的触觉传感方案。
AI.method: 提出GlowTact压力响应式视觉触觉传感机制，直接可视化接触压力；仅使用单色、非定向照明，原始触觉图像直接表征压力分布，无需显式几何重建；采用耐用的丁腈膜与简单光学设计。
AI.result: 实现了克级接触检测、精确的法向力估计，以及精细接触几何的重建（包括M1螺纹）。
AI.conclusion: GlowTact结合耐用丁腈膜与简单光学设计，具备灵敏且信息丰富的触觉感知能力，是一种适用于紧凑型人形指尖的实用新型传感技术。

title: PanOVOcc: Panoramic Embodied Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Mapping with Long-term Spatial Voxel Memory
comment: The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at https://github.com/bakereet/PanOVOcc
summary: Persistent semantic occupancy mapping is essential for embodied scene understanding. However, perspective-based systems provide limited spatial coverage, while existing panoramic methods primarily predict local volumes from single observations. We introduce PanOVOcc, a training-free framework for persistent open-vocabulary semantic occupancy mapping from panoramic sequences. PanOVOcc unifies panoramic SLAM, open-vocabulary perception, and long-term spatial voxel memory within an online architecture, continuously integrating geometric and semantic evidence into a global, language-queryable map. To facilitate systematic evaluation of this setting, we establish Pan-Replica and Pan-Holo360D, two benchmarks pairing continuous panoramic RGB-D sequences with scene-level semantic occupancy ground truth across synthetic and real-world scenes. Compared with the strongest evaluated baseline for each metric, PanOVOcc improves occupancy IoU and semantic mIoU by absolute +20.03 and +7.06 on Pan-Replica, and by +43.26 and +20.16 on Pan-Holo360D, respectively. The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at https://github.com/bakereet/PanOVOcc.

AI.tldr: PanOVOcc：免训练的全景序列持续开放词汇语义占据建图框架
AI.motivation: 沉浸式场景理解需要持续的语义占据建图，但透视法空间覆盖有限，现有全景方法多只从单次观测预测局部体素，缺乏长期全局建图能力。
AI.method: 提出PanOVOcc，将全景SLAM、开放词汇感知与长期空间体素记忆统一到在线架构中，无需训练，持续融合几何与语义证据，构建可语言查询的全局地图；并建立Pan-Replica与Pan-Holo360D两个基准。
AI.result: 在Pan-Replica上占据IoU与语义mIoU分别提升+20.03和+7.06；在Pan-Holo360D上分别提升+43.26和+20.16（绝对值，对比最强基线）。
AI.conclusion: PanOVOcc实现了免训练的持续开放词汇全景语义占据建图，并提供了系统性评测基准，代码与基准将开源。

title: Assisting for Open-Ended Tasks: Goal-Oriented Shared Autonomy as a Particle Filter
summary: A common approach for shared autonomy blends human inputs with autonomous assistance based on the human's likely goal. However, most existing approaches assume that a static set of possible goals is known a priori, which limits the use of such methods in unstructured assistive settings. We instead investigate how to enable shared autonomy with open-ended and dynamically changing goals. We formulate goal-oriented shared autonomy as a particle filter in which particles represent candidate human goals. Unlike conventional approaches with a fixed goal set, our transition model dynamically proposes new candidate goals as the interaction evolves, and human actions update the belief over these goals in real time. We instantiate this framework with foundation models (e.g., vision grounding and large language models) that propose context-relevant semantic goals, generate goal-conditioned assistance from low-level skill primitives, and refine those skills from human corrections. We assess our approach through a user study where 12 participants perform a variety of tabletop manipulation tasks with our method and state-of-the-art shared autonomy baselines. The results show that our particle filter-based approach reduces the amount of time users spend teleoperating the system and improves user satisfaction. User study videos: https://youtu.be/Ii26XuRqm9c

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于粒子滤波的开放式目标共享自主框架，利用基础模型动态提出并更新候选人类目标，实现动态变化目标下的辅助，用户研究显示可减少遥操作时间并提升满意度。
AI.motivation: 现有共享自主方法大多假设一组预先已知的静态候选目标，这限制了其在非结构化辅助场景中的适用性。作者希望实现目标开放且动态变化的共享自主。
AI.method: 将目标导向的共享自主建模为粒子滤波，粒子表示候选人类目标；与固定目标集不同，其转移模型随交互演进动态提出新候选目标，人类动作实时更新对目标的信念。用基础模型（视觉定位与大语言模型）实例化该框架：提出上下文相关的语义目标、由底层技能原语生成目标条件下的辅助、并从人类纠正中细化技能。
AI.result: 通过12名参与者在多种桌面操作任务上的用户研究，与最先进共享自主基线对比，结果显示该方法减少了用户遥操作时间并提升了用户满意度。
AI.conclusion: 基于粒子滤波的共享自主方法能够有效应对开放式、动态变化的目标，结合基础模型可在非结构化辅助场景中减少用户操作负担并提高满意度。

title: PanoFuse: Panorama-Enhanced Vision-Language-Action Learning with Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing
comment: Code and data will be released publicly at https://xux-hnu.github.io/PanoFuse
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have shown promising performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, most existing VLA systems rely on conventional perspective cameras with limited fields of view, often missing global scene context and leading to unreliable manipulation under visual occlusions, distractors, and unseen environments. In this work, we propose PanoFuse, a panorama-enhanced VLA framework that complements local manipulation observations with global panoramic perception. PanoFuse introduces a dedicated panoramic branch that leverages a pretrained panoramic foundation model to extract complementary semantic and geometric representations from omnidirectional observations. Rather than directly mixing these heterogeneous features, we introduce Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing (DSGR), which maintains semantic and geometric representations as separate context streams and selectively routes both to downstream state and action representations through structured block-wise attention. This design provides the action expert with global spatial context while preserving task-relevant semantic information from the pretrained VLA backbone. We further develop a synchronized data collection pipeline and construct a new real-world manipulation dataset containing panoramic RGB observations, wrist-view images, language instructions, robot states, and actions. Across seven evaluation settings, PanoFuse achieves an average success rate of 52.9%, outperforming the evaluated baselines and achieving consistent gains under novel-object, unseen-background, and distractor-rich settings. Code and data will be released publicly at https://xux-hnu.github.io/PanoFuse.

AI.tldr: PanoFuse：利用全景感知增强视觉-语言-动作策略，通过解耦语义-几何路由融合全局上下文，提升遮挡与陌生环境下的操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略多依赖视野有限的常规透视相机，缺少全局场景上下文，在视觉遮挡、干扰物和未见环境下操作不可靠。
AI.method: 提出全景增强VLA框架PanoFuse：引入全景分支，借助预训练全景基础模型从全向观测中提取互补的语义与几何表征；设计解耦语义-几何路由（DSGR），将语义与几何表征作为独立上下文流，通过结构化分块注意力选择性路由至下游状态与动作表征；同时构建同步数据采集pipeline与包含全景RGB、腕部视图、语言指令、机器人状态与动作的真实操作数据集。
AI.result: 在七种评测设置下平均成功率52.9%，优于所评估的基线，并在新物体、未见背景与干扰物丰富的场景中取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: PanoFuse通过全景全局感知与解耦路由设计有效增强了VLA策略的鲁棒性，代码与数据将公开。

title: Think Fast, Plan Selectively: Adaptive Deliberation for Efficient Data-Driven MPC
summary: Data-driven model predictive control (MPC) combines learned world models with online trajectory optimization, achieving strong performance in continuous control. However, the per-step cost of sampling and evaluating hundreds of candidate trajectories restricts deployment to control frequencies well below what real-time robotics demands. Motivated by the dual-process theory of human cognition, which distinguishes between fast, intuitive processing (System 1) and slower, deliberative reasoning (System 2), we ask whether every decision requires the same degree of computational deliberation. We propose Fast-TD-MPC, a lightweight framework that adaptively routes between fast policy execution and test-time planning, reserving costly deliberation for states where it is most needed. Fast-TD-MPC delivers competitive task performance across 103 continuous control tasks while achieving up to ~4x faster inference. Under external disturbances, Fast-TD-MPC selectively falls back to planning, maintaining robustness comparable to the original planner.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fast-TD-MPC，受人类双过程认知理论启发，在快速策略执行与测试时规划之间自适应路由，兼顾性能与效率。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动 MPC 每步需采样并评估数百条候选轨迹，推理开销大，导致控制频率远低于实时机器人的需求。作者类比人类认知的双过程理论（System 1 快速直觉、System 2 缓慢审慎），质疑是否每个决策都需要同等程度的计算 deliberation。
AI.method: Fast-TD-MPC 是一个轻量级框架，能够自适应地在快速策略执行（System 1）与测试时规划（System 2）之间进行路由，仅在真正需要 deliberation 的状态下才付出高昂的规划代价，从而实现自适应决策分配。
AI.result: 在 103 个连续控制任务上取得有竞争力的任务表现，同时推理速度最高提升约 4 倍；在外部扰动下，Fast-TD-MPC 会选择性回退到规划，保持与原始规划器相当的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 并非所有决策都需要同等程度的计算 deliberation；通过自适应路由快速执行与规划，可在保持性能与鲁棒性的同时显著提升推理效率，为实时机器人控制提供可行方案。

title: LatentReRig: An SDF-Based VAE with Dual Decoders for Latent-Space Deformation Conditioning
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, extracted from final dissertation
summary: Transferring deformation between characters with different geometry and topology is challenging because conventional rigs encode behaviour through character-specific structures and correspondences. We present LatentReRig, an experimental framework that investigates whether pose-associated changes can instead be represented as reusable directions in a learned geometric latent space. An SDF-based variational autoencoder is coupled with two decoders: one reconstructs the implicit field, while the other predicts target vertex positions from source geometry and latent deformation conditioning. The source geometry may be neutral or already deformed. Experiments on a controlled humanoid dataset show that several poses induce coherent latent directions across identities, particularly for broad articulated motions. These signals can guide deformation of unseen characters, but explicit predictions remain less accurate for localized changes and corrective contributions. Diagnostic comparisons with repeated SDF sampling show that inter-identity distances exceed same-geometry resampling variability on average, while pose signals exhibit different margins above this baseline. The results support the presence of reusable pose-related structure and identify stable local conditioning and accurate mesh decoding as complementary requirements for improving transfer.

AI.tldr: LatentReRig是一个实验性框架，探索能否将姿态相关的形变表示为学习到的几何潜空间中的可复用方向，从而实现不同几何与拓扑角色间的形变迁移。
AI.motivation: 传统绑定（rig）通过角色特定的结构和对应关系来编码行为，导致在不同几何与拓扑的角色之间迁移形变非常困难。作者希望验证姿态相关的形变能否以"可复用方向"的形式存在于学习到的几何潜空间中。
AI.method: 提出LatentReRig框架：基于SDF的变分自编码器（VAE），并耦合两个解码器——一个重建隐式场，另一个从源几何与潜形变条件预测目标顶点位置。源几何可以是中性姿态或已形变的姿态。在受控的人形数据集上进行实验。
AI.result: 若干姿态在不同身份间诱导出连贯的潜方向，尤其是宽幅关节运动；这些信号可引导未见角色的形变，但对局部变化和矫正性贡献的显式预测精度较低。与重复SDF采样的诊断对比表明，身份间距离平均超过同几何重采样变异性，而姿态信号的裕度表现不同。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持可复用姿态相关结构的存在，并指出稳定的局部条件化与精确的网格解码是改进形变迁移的两个互补要求。

title: RECAST: Recasting Vision-Language Semantics into an Actionable Cost Map for Robot Navigation
summary: Safe and robust robot navigation across diverse environments requires a high-level understanding of complex scenes and the ability to carry it into stable motion. Recent works tackle this with learning-based models trained at scale and with approaches built on vision-language models (VLMs). However, learning-based models break down outside their training distribution, while VLM-based approaches bring that understanding but rarely ground it in the scene or align the action with it. To address these limitations, we present RECAST, a robot navigation framework that combines the reasoning of a VLM with the spatial grounding of vision foundation models to build an Actionable Cost map. Given the robot's front view and the user's instruction, we first decompose the scene with the VLM, judging which surfaces are traversable, which objects pose a risk, which heading to prefer, and which gaps are passable. Vision foundation models then ground these surfaces and objects in the image, and all four judgments are spatially recast into one compact cost map. This map both conditions the trajectory decoders and scores their proposals to select the one to execute. As the VLM's answers trail the live scene, both steps draw on cost maps from two points in time: the pivot frame the VLM judged, which carries all four judgments, and the current frame, whose terrain and collision costs are rebuilt from the current image. RECAST improves success over the strongest prior method by 13.3 points in simulation and 31.4 points on a real quadruped, and reduces the collision rate relative to it by 9.6 and 14.3 points, reaching the lowest collision rate among all methods. The project page is available at https://recast-nav.github.io/

AI.tldr: RECAST 是一种机器人导航框架，将 VLM 的语义推理与视觉基础模型的空间定位相结合，构建可操作代价地图（Actionable Cost Map），用于条件化并评分轨迹解码器，从而在仿真和真实四足机器人上显著提升成功率并降低碰撞率。
AI.motivation: 复杂环境下的安全鲁棒导航需要高层场景理解并转化为稳定运动。现有方法存在两类局限：基于学习的模型在训练分布之外会失效；基于 VLM 的方法虽有理解能力，但缺乏场景落地（grounding），也未将动作与之对齐。
AI.method: RECAST 结合 VLM 推理与视觉基础模型的空间定位，构建 Actionable Cost map。给定机器人前视图与用户指令，VLM 先分解场景，判断：哪些表面可行走、哪些物体有风险、应偏好哪个朝向、哪些间隙可通行；视觉基础模型将这些表面与物体在图像中定位，四类判断被空间重铸（recast）为一张紧凑代价地图。该地图既条件化轨迹解码器，又为候选轨迹评分以选择执行者。由于 VLM 回答滞后于实时场景，两个步骤都利用两个时刻的代价地图：VLM 判断的枢纽帧（含全部四类判断）与当前帧（从当前图像重建地形与碰撞代价）。
AI.result: 相比最强先前方法，RECAST 在仿真中成功率提升 13.3 个百分点，在真实四足机器人上提升 31.4 个百分点；碰撞率分别降低 9.6 与 14.3 个百分点，达到所有方法中最低的碰撞率。
AI.conclusion: 将 VLM 的语义推理与视觉基础模型的空间定位融合为统一的可操作代价地图，可有效弥补学习模型泛化不足与 VLM 落地欠缺的问题，实现更安全鲁棒的机器人导航，并在仿真与真实平台上验证了其优越性。

title: Where Does the Watermark Hide? Push-Pull Disentanglement for Invisible Watermark Removal
summary: Fixed image distortions do not cover an attacker that learns from paired clean and watermarked images. We study this paired-training threat with single-image inference: deployment uses neither the clean reference nor the watermark key, payload, or decoder. An encoder maps each image to a structural latent $g$ and an auxiliary residual latent $u$. Push supervision reconstructs the watermarked image from $D(g_w,u_w)$. Pull supervision trains the zero-auxiliary output $D(A_g(g_w;k),0)$ toward the paired clean image. At $k=1.10,u=0$, the four-method sweep gives an average BER of $0.3958$, PSNR of $31.07$ dB, and SSIM of $0.9554$. Restoring $u$ from $0$ to $0.15$ moves average BER from $0.3893$ to $0.3357$, while PSNR falls from $30.99$ to $28.23$ dB. The intervention supports decoder dependence on the auxiliary input in the evaluated setting. The accompanying theory is a conditional, post-hoc account of this behavior rather than an experimentally verified information-relocation result.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一种配对训练威胁：攻击者从成对干净图像与带水印图像中学习，而部署时仅用单图推理，不依赖干净参考、水印密钥、载荷或解码器。方法通过结构潜变量与辅助残差潜变量的分离设计，用Push/Pull监督进行训练，实验显示该方法对水印的破坏效果与图像质量之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 固定图像失真无法覆盖"从配对干净/带水印图像中学习"的攻击者。作者希望研究这种配对训练威胁下的单图推理场景，即在部署阶段攻击者不掌握干净参考图像，也不知道水印密钥、载荷或解码器，从而检验水印方案在这种更现实、更强大的攻击下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 将图像映射为结构潜变量g和辅助残差潜变量u。Push监督：从D(g_w,u_w)重建带水印图像；Pull监督：将零辅助输出D(A_g(g_w;k),0)拉向配对的干净图像。在k=1.10、u=0条件下对四种方法进行扫描，并考察将u从0恢复到0.15的影响。
AI.result: 在k=1.10、u=0时，四种方法平均BER为0.3958，PSNR为31.07 dB，SSIM为0.9554。将u从0恢复到0.15使平均BER从0.3893降至0.3357，但PSNR从30.99 dB降至28.23 dB，表明BER改善伴随图像质量下降。
AI.conclusion: 该干预结果支持在所评估的设定中解码器依赖辅助输入。作者强调，论文附带的仅是条件性、事后性的理论解释，而非经实验验证的信息迁移结论，因此相关理论主张应谨慎看待。

title: World SLAM Model: Joint World Modeling for SLAM and Navigation
summary: We introduce World SLAM Model (WSM), a unified framework that brings the SLAM paradigm directly into downstream navigation. Rather than treating SLAM merely as an upstream module that provides poses, maps or tokens, WSM adopts its core mechanisms, including incremental state updates with persistent memory and backend refinement of accumulated errors, to maintain a consistent world state during interaction. Given the current observation and a navigation goal, WSM predicts future visual states and jointly estimates their camera motion and dense geometry, grounding visual prediction in an evolving spatial world state. This spatial state is continuously updated as new observations arrive and provides the basis for action generation and closed-loop navigation. WSM is trained end-to-end with a joint navigation--SLAM objective, enabling downstream navigation to benefit directly from SLAM-style state maintenance and refinement while preserving accurate geometric estimation. Experiments demonstrate improved navigation performance together with strong SLAM accuracy, highlighting the potential of SLAM as an intrinsic mechanism for long-horizon world modeling and embodied interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出World SLAM Model (WSM)，将SLAM范式直接引入下游导航任务，通过增量状态更新、持久记忆与后端优化维护一致的世界状态，联合预测未来视觉状态及其相机运动与稠密几何，实现闭环导航。
AI.motivation: 传统方法仅将SLAM视为提供位姿、地图或token的上游模块，未能充分发挥SLAM在长期世界建模与具身交互中的潜力。作者希望将SLAM的核心机制（增量状态更新、持久记忆、后端误差优化）内化为导航的内在机制。
AI.method: WSM以当前观测和导航目标为输入，预测未来视觉状态并联合估计相机运动与稠密几何，将视觉预测锚定在不断演化的空间世界状态上；该空间状态随新观测持续更新，为动作生成与闭环导航提供依据。模型以导航-SLAM联合目标进行端到端训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，WSM在提升导航性能的同时保持了较强的SLAM精度，验证了SLAM作为长期世界建模与具身交互内在机制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: WSM展示了将SLAM范式内化为导航机制的前景，为长期世界建模和具身交互提供了一条新路径。

title: Frequency-Domain AI-Generated Image Detection: Exploring Decoder and Channel Attention for Feature Refinement
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Optics, Machine Learning and Emerging Technology (OMLET)
summary: With the rapid progress of AI, the number of AI-generated images has increased significantly in recent years. However, the increasing variety of image generation models makes detection more difficult. In this work, we use Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) representation with EfficientNet-B0 for AI-generated image detection. EfficientNet-B0 provides a lightweight architecture that can be useful for resource-limited applications. Most frequency-domain detectors use a standard encoder to extract features from the FFT spectrum and directly pass them to a classifier. We explored a different approach by investigating ECA, U-Net, and Attention U-Net as alternatives to this direct encoder-to-classifier approach. ECA applies channel attention, while U-Net and Attention U-Net use decoder-based architectures to recover and refine spatial information in the extracted frequency features. We used a balanced subset of the MS COCOAI dataset that includes AI-generated images from five different models. Three runs were carried out for each experiment, and the average values were recorded. Experimental results indicate that EfficientNet-B0 obtained an accuracy of 84.64%, which is 4.50 percentage points higher than the ResNet-50 baseline reported in the dataset paper. EfficientNet-B0 with U-Net provided a small improvement, achieving an accuracy of 84.85%, while ECA did not increase the overall performance. EfficientNet-B0 with Attention U-Net achieved the best overall performance, with an accuracy of 85.51% and an ROC-AUC of 92.99%. This represents an improvement of 0.87 percentage points in accuracy compared to the EfficientNet-B0 baseline and 5.37 percentage points over the ResNet-50 baseline reported in the dataset paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用FFT频谱结合EfficientNet-B0进行AI生成图像检测，并对比ECA、U-Net、Attention U-Net等替代结构，发现EfficientNet-B0+Attention U-Net效果最佳，准确率85.51%、ROC-AUC 92.99%。
AI.motivation: 随着AI生成图像数量激增且生成模型种类繁多，检测难度不断加大；同时现有频域检测器多采用标准编码器直接接分类器，且需兼顾资源受限场景下的轻量化需求。
AI.method: 采用Fast Fourier Transform（FFT）表示结合轻量级EfficientNet-B0；在编码器到分类器的直接方案之外，探索ECA（通道注意力）、U-Net与Attention U-Net（基于解码器恢复与细化频域特征的空间信息）三种替代结构；使用MS COCOAI数据集的均衡子集（含五种模型生成的图像），每组实验运行三次取平均值。
AI.result: EfficientNet-B0准确率84.64%，比数据集论文中ResNet-50基线高4.50个百分点；EfficientNet-B0+U-Net为84.85%，略有提升；ECA未提升整体性能；EfficientNet-B0+Attention U-Net表现最佳，准确率85.51%、ROC-AUC 92.99%，较EfficientNet-B0提升0.87个百分点，较ResNet-50基线提升5.37个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 在频域AI生成图像检测中，轻量级EfficientNet-B0已明显优于ResNet-50基线，而引入Attention U-Net解码结构可进一步带来最优性能，提示解码器式特征细化比单纯通道注意力更有效。

title: PF-RL: Progress Field Reinforcement Learning via Goal-Conditioned Value Geometry for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning~(RFT) has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving Vision-Language-Action~(VLA) policies, yet sparse task-level outcomes provide limited credit for intermediate transitions, especially in long-horizon manipulation. A natural approach is to model intermediate task progress and use it as dense feedback for policy improvement. Despite their architectural differences, existing progress-aware methods commonly formulate task progress as an explicit scalar prediction, providing limited structure for modeling how intermediate observations relate to the task goal, which may hinder effective transition-level credit assignment. We introduce Progress Field Reinforcement Learning (PF-RL), which learns a structured goal-conditioned progress representation over pretrained VLA features and converts it into dense credit for policy optimization. A lightweight shared Progress Field head maps current and goal representations into a compact progress space, where geometric distance induces goal-conditioned value, while complementary temporal and goal-structure objectives shape the learned geometry. Transition-level value changes naturally yield dense progress advantages, enabling fine-grained credit assignment for both offline policy improvement and online reinforcement fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin2.0, and real-world bimanual manipulation tasks show that PF-RL consistently improves policy performance over strong supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement fine-tuning, and progress-aware baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出Progress Field Reinforcement Learning (PF-RL)，通过学习结构化的目标条件进度表示，将稀疏任务回报转化为稠密信贷信号，在多个基准上提升VLA策略性能。
AI.motivation: 强化微调（RFT）在改进VLA策略时，稀疏的任务级回报难以为中间过渡提供有效信贷，尤其在长时域操作任务中。现有进度感知方法多将进度建模为显式标量预测，缺乏刻画中间观测与任务目标关系的结构化信息，限制了过渡级的信贷分配。
AI.method: PF-RL在预训练VLA特征上学习结构化、目标条件的进度表示，并转化为稠密信贷用于策略优化。使用轻量共享Progress Field头将当前与目标表示映射到紧凑进度空间，以几何距离诱导目标条件价值，并用互补的时序目标与目标结构目标塑造学习的几何结构。过渡级价值变化自然产生稠密进度优势，支持离线策略改进与在线强化微调。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0及真实世界双臂操作任务上的大量实验表明，PF-RL相比强监督微调、强化微调及进度感知基线方法，均能持续提升策略性能。
AI.conclusion: 将进度建模为结构化目标条件表示而非显式标量，可为长时域操作提供有效的稠密信贷分配，是一种提升VLA策略的通用且有效的强化微调框架。

title: SWT: Self-Supervised Video Object Segmentation via Sliding, Wavelet and Transportation
