summary: Video Object Segmentation (VOS) aims to accurately segment target objects from consecutive video frames and track the changes of the objects in each frame of the video. Conventional VOS methods typically demand substantial quantities of pixel-level labeled video sequences for fully supervised learning, which limits the performance of the model in sparse video scenes, while existing VOS methods have limited adaptability to global changes in objects. Based on this observation, in this paper, we propose self-supervised VOS with Sliding window, Wavelet transform and optimal Transport (SWT), a self-supervised VOS framework entirely trained on static dataset using contrastive learning. Firstly, a rolling sample buffer reuses overlapping groups of independently sampled images across successive updates. Secondly, to address the long-distance modeling difficulty caused by simple convolutional structures, we introduce wavelet transform to expand the receptive field of convolutional kernels, thus improving the model's representational capability. Finally, we incorporate optimal transport to assist the model in finding the globally optimal match between the target across two frames, improving the model's ability to handle nonrigid deformations of objects. SWT only requires training on the COCO dataset once and achieves excellent results on five VOS datasets as well as an additional body part propagation dataset. The code will be released soon at [https://github.com/machine928/SWT.git](https://github.com/machine928/SWT.git).

AI.tldr: 提出自监督视频目标分割框架SWT，结合滑动窗口采样、小波变换和最优传输，仅在静态COCO数据集上训练一次即可在五个VOS数据集及一个身体部位传播数据集上取得优异结果。
AI.motivation: 传统VOS方法需要大量像素级标注的视频序列进行全监督学习，在稀疏视频场景下性能受限；且现有方法对目标的全局变化适应能力有限。
AI.method: 1) 采用滚动采样缓冲区，在连续更新中复用重叠的独立采样图像组；2) 引入小波变换扩展卷积核感受野，缓解简单卷积结构的长距离建模困难，提升表征能力；3) 引入最优传输帮助模型在两帧间找到目标的全局最优匹配，提升处理非刚性形变的能力；整体为基于对比学习、完全在静态数据集上训练的自监督框架。
AI.result: SWT仅需在COCO数据集上训练一次，即在五个VOS数据集以及一个额外的身体部位传播数据集上取得优异结果。
AI.conclusion: 该自监督框架通过滑动窗口、小波变换与最优传输的组合，在无需视频标注的情况下实现了强泛化的视频目标分割性能，代码将开源。

title: SEES: A Self-Evolving Embodied System via Failure-Guided VLA Policy Adaptation
summary: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies demonstrate promising generalization across diverse short-horizon tasks. However, they remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks, partly because the large-scale training data is biased toward single-stage manipulation tasks that are cheaper to demonstrate. A single weak atomic skill can cause failures across multiple multi-stage tasks. To address such failures, existing methods often require experts to identify the bottleneck and provide additional demonstrations, making the improvement costly and potentially impractical after deployment. To this end, we present a Self-Evolving Embodied System (SEES) that learns from failures and improves the VLA policy without additional expert demonstrations. SEES decomposes long-horizon tasks into atomic tasks and routes them to corresponding family policies. Each family consists of related atomic skills that share one VLA adapter. During execution, the system automatically monitors atomic-task outcomes to identify the most frequently failing atomic skills as the current bottlenecks. To overcome these bottlenecks, SEES constructs tailored RL tasks in simulation by restoring previously encountered states and generating task-specific success criteria with an LLM. Online RL updates the shared family adapters to promote positive transfer among related atomic skills and cumulative improvement across evolution rounds. Extensive experiments show that SEES can be integrated with different VLA backbones to progressively improve their long-horizon performance. We also observe continued improvement on unseen tasks, providing evidence of transfer beyond the evolution settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自进化具身系统SEES，无需额外专家示范，通过从失败中学习并利用仿真RL持续改进VLA策略的长程任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略在短程任务上泛化良好，但在长程任务上不可靠，原因是训练数据偏向单阶段操作任务，单一薄弱原子技能会导致多阶段任务失败。现有改进方法需专家定位瓶颈并提供额外示范，成本高且部署后不实用。
AI.method: SEES将长程任务分解为原子任务并路由到对应家族策略，每个家族共享一个VLA适配器。执行时自动监控原子任务结果，识别最常失败的原子技能作为当前瓶颈；通过LLM在仿真中构建定制RL任务，恢复曾遇到的状态并生成任务特定成功标准，用在线RL更新共享家族适配器以实现正迁移和跨轮次累积改进。
AI.result: 大量实验表明SEES可集成到不同VLA骨干网络，逐步提升其长程性能，并在未见任务上持续改进，证明超出进化设置之外的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: SEES提供了一种无需额外专家示范、可自我进化提升VLA策略长程任务表现的有效方案，并具备向未见任务迁移的潜力。

title: High-Capacity Robust Medical Image Exfiltration via Neural Network Weight Replacement
summary: Collaborative medical AI platforms allow researchers to train models on sensitive imaging data while restricting data export. However, trained models can serve as covert carriers of patient information: medical images may be encoded within model parameters and reconstructed outside the secure environment. Existing defenses rely on lightweight sanitization (e.g., fine-tuning, pruning, quantization) and limited statistical auditing, creating a realistic insider exfiltration risk. We introduce a high-capacity neural steganography attack that encodes medical images as continuous latent representations embedded into model initialization. A StyleGAN2-based adversarial autoencoder learns compact latent codes regularized to match standard weight initialization statistics, keeping embedded parameters statistically consistent with clean models. Noise injection during training improves robustness to export-time mitigation. The carrier model remains functional on its intended task and hidden images can be reconstructed directly from its weights after export. This continuous encoding enables robust and scalable exfiltration, allowing up to 99 brain MRI volumes to be embedded within a 30MB model, and remains recoverable under mitigations that disrupt prior bit-level schemes. While reconstructions are approximate rather than pixel-exact, embedded content remains anatomically recognizable and recoverable at scale, exposing a privacy risk distinct from prior bit-level approaches. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR, BraTS, and LiTS demonstrate effectiveness across modalities, tasks, and architectures, highlighting the need for structural defenses beyond parameter-level sanitization. Code is available at https://github.com/ElieThellier/high-capacity-robust-medical-image-exfiltration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种高容量神经隐式隐写攻击，可将医学图像编码为连续潜在表示嵌入模型初始化参数中，导出后可从权重重建图像，构成现有防御难以阻断的隐私泄露风险。
AI.motivation: 协作式医学AI平台虽限制数据导出，但训练好的模型可能成为患者信息的隐蔽载体。现有防御仅依赖轻量级净化（微调、剪枝、量化）和有限统计审计，存在现实的内部人员数据窃取风险，且已有位级隐写方案易被扰乱。
AI.method: 提出基于StyleGAN2的对抗自编码器，将医学图像编码为紧凑连续的潜在码，并对其正则化以匹配标准权重初始化统计分布，使嵌入参数与干净模型在统计上一致；训练中注入噪声以增强对导出时缓解手段的鲁棒性。载体模型仍可正常执行原任务。
AI.result: 在30MB模型内可嵌入多达99个脑MRI体积；在MIMIC-CXR、BraTS、LiTS上跨模态、任务和架构均有效。虽重建为近似而非像素级精确，但解剖结构可识别，且在此前能破坏位级方案的各种缓解措施下仍可恢复。
AI.conclusion: 连续编码式隐写实现稳健、可扩展的医学图像窃取，暴露了区别于位级方法的隐私风险，说明仅靠参数级净化不足，需要结构性防御。

title: MORPH: Self-Organising Multi-Robot Task Allocation via Neuroplasticity-Inspired Adaptive Topology
comment: Full version of the paper published in The 23rd European Conference on Multi-Agent Systems (EUMAS), 2026.The implementation and experiment scripts are available at https://github.com/Cyber-physical-Systems-Lab/morph_v2
summary: Multi-robot task allocation (MRTA) in dynamic environments faces a fundamental tension: effective coordination requires learned structure, but that structure must adapt when conditions change. Existing methods resolve this by assuming prior task knowledge, a utility function, a cost matrix, or a trained policy making them brittle when deployed without such knowledge or when task distributions shift. We present MORPH(Multi-agent Online Rewiring through Plasticity-guided Hierarchy), a training-free MRTA framework where global allocation quality emerges from 4 local plasticity rules (synaptic, homeostatic, structural, and metaplasticity) applied to a directed pairwise preference matrix updated from runtime co-occurrence and task-completion feedback. MORPH requires no task model, no bid computation, and no offline training; response decisions use learned AGV-to-Picker preferences rather than a fixed proximity rule. Within the Gerkey-Mataric MRTA taxonomy, MORPH is the first method in the single-task, single-robot, instantaneous-assignment class to learn directed pairwise allocation preferences online. Evaluated on the TA-RWARE warehouse benchmark (8-24 agents, 4 maps, 800 steps per episode, 5 seeds), MORPH achieves 110% of all-to-all throughput at N=24 while using only 21% of possible coordination links as an efficiency advantage that grows monotonically with fleet size. Under spatial task distribution shift, MORPH degrades 3x less than proximity-based methods while its learned preferences remain uncorrelated with Manhattan distance. Systematic ablation confirms all four plasticity rules contribute measurably. Two allocation properties emerge without programming: cross-type preference dominance and progressive preference sparsification, mirroring the developmental refinement of biological neural circuits. Learned preferences are driven by task co-occurrence history, not spatial proximity.

AI.tldr: MORPH 是一个免训练的多机器人任务分配框架，将全局分配质量从 4 条局部可塑性规则中涌现出来，在动态环境和任务分布漂移下优于基于邻近度的方法。
AI.motivation: 动态环境中的多机器人任务分配（MRTA）存在根本矛盾：有效协调需要学习到的结构，但条件变化时该结构又必须适应。现有方法依赖先验任务知识、效用函数、成本矩阵或已训练策略，缺乏这些知识或任务分布发生偏移时会变得脆弱。
AI.method: 提出 MORPH（Multi-agent Online Rewiring through Plasticity-guided Hierarchy），一个免训练的 MRTA 框架。对从运行时共现与任务完成反馈更新的有向成对偏好矩阵，施加 4 条局部可塑性规则（突触、稳态、结构、元可塑性），无需任务模型、无需投标计算、无需离线训练，响应决策使用学习到的 AGV-to-Picker 偏好。在 Gerkey-Mataric 分类中属于单任务、单机器人、瞬时分配类，是首个在线学习有向成对分配偏好的方法。
AI.result: 在 TA-RWARE 仓库基准（8-24 智能体、4 张地图、每回合 800 步、5 个种子）上，MORPH 在 N=24 时达到全互联吞吐量的 110%，且仅使用 21% 的可能协调链路，效率优势随规模单调增长。空间任务分布偏移下，其性能退化比基于邻近度的方法少 3 倍，学习到的偏好与曼哈顿距离不相关。系统性消融证实 4 条可塑性规则均有可测贡献。无需编程即涌现出跨类型偏好主导与渐进式偏好稀疏化两种分配特性。
AI.conclusion: MORPH 证明全局分配质量可由局部可塑性规则涌现，无需任何任务模型或训练。学习到的偏好由任务共现历史驱动而非空间邻近度，两种自发涌现的特性与生物神经回路的发展性精炼相呼应。

title: GERIS: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Filtering Instance-Dependent Label Noise in License Plate Data Augmentation
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures. To appear in AUT Journal of Mathematics and Computing (AUT J Math Comput)
summary: In this paper, we propose GERIS, a game-theoretic framework for instance selection in the data augmentation phase of license plate recognition systems. During augmentation, synthetic license plate images are generated and transformed using stochastic noise to simulate real-world conditions. However, certain noise configurations lead to highly distorted, unreadable images that degrade model performance by introducing instance-dependent label noise. GERIS formulates a non-cooperative game in which each noise vector competes for inclusion in the training set based on its similarity to labeled data and its contribution to model reliability. By identifying and pruning low-quality instances, GERIS improves the overall quality of the augmented dataset. Unlike traditional black-box learning methods, GERIS offers a transparent, theoretically grounded mechanism for data filtering. Experimental results demonstrate that GERIS outperforms existing instance selection methods in terms of classification accuracy and robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GERIS，一个用于车牌识别数据增强阶段实例选择的博弈论框架，通过非合作博弈筛选高质量增强样本，提升模型准确率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 数据增强中使用随机噪声生成的合成车牌图像，部分噪声配置会导致图像严重扭曲、不可读，引入与实例相关的标签噪声，从而损害模型性能。因此需要一种机制来识别并剔除低质量增强实例。
AI.method: GERIS 将每个噪声向量视为非合作博弈中的参与者，依据其与标注数据的相似度以及对模型可靠性的贡献来竞争进入训练集，通过识别和剪枝低质量实例来提升增强数据集质量。与黑盒学习方法不同，该机制透明且具有理论支撑。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，GERIS 在分类准确率和鲁棒性方面均优于现有的实例选择方法。
AI.conclusion: GERIS 为数据增强中的实例筛选提供了一种可解释、有理论依据的博弈论解决方案，有效提升车牌识别系统的性能。

title: An Empirical Study on What Matters for Viewpoint-Generalizable Policies in Visual Imitation Learning
summary: Visual imitation learning is a promising approach to training robot manipulation policies capable of completing a wide variety of tasks. However, policies today remain brittle to viewpoint perturbations, making deployment in diverse environments a challenge. We present a controlled empirical study of which design choices allow visuomotor policies to generalize across viewpoints. We find that viewpoint generalization improves when dense visual tokens are retained and the action head participates in geometric reasoning. On a suite of simulated tasks that span a wide range of camera poses, we show that these design choices yield a policy that remains performant across viewpoints. As a practical consequence, a policy trained with these design choices also transfers zero-shot from simulation to the real world under random camera configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实证研究，探究哪些设计选择能让视觉运动策略在不同视角下泛化。结果表明，保留密集视觉token并让动作头参与几何推理可提升视角泛化能力，且该策略能从仿真零样本迁移到真实世界。
AI.motivation: 视觉模仿学习在训练机器人操作策略方面很有前景，但现有策略对视角扰动十分脆弱，难以部署到多样化环境中。因此需要研究哪些设计选择能够帮助视觉运动策略实现跨视角泛化。
AI.method: 作者开展了一项受控实证研究，系统比较不同设计选择对视角泛化的影响；同时设计了一套覆盖多种相机位姿的仿真任务套件，用于评估策略在广泛视角范围内的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现：当保留密集视觉token、并让动作头参与几何推理时，视角泛化能力得到提升。在仿真任务中，采用这些设计的策略在广泛视角范围内保持良好性能；此外，该策略在随机相机配置下还能从仿真零样本迁移到真实世界。
AI.conclusion: 保留密集视觉token与让动作头参与几何推理是提升视觉运动策略视角泛化能力的关键设计选择，并有助于实现仿真到真实世界的零样本迁移。

title: When Retrieval Hurts: Measuring and Explaining Retrieval-Induced Hallucination in Chest X-ray Report Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation is an attractive way to improve chest X-ray reporting, because reports from similar prior studies supply clinical context a general vision-language model lacks. We show the same mechanism is a reliable source of clinical error. Over 100 MIMIC-CXR studies with a frozen LLaVA-1.5 generator and BioMedCLIP retrieval, CheXbert clinical F1 doubles under relevant retrieval (0.201 to 0.402) and collapses to 0.043 under clinically mismatched retrieval, a fifth of the image-only score; the retrieval-induced hallucination rate, counting only unsupported findings traceable to retrieved evidence, rises from 0.00 to 0.76 and 0.98. To show this is not an artefact of evidence-set coverage, we introduce a coincidental-overlap control that scores image-only generations against evidence they never saw, placing the chance base rate at 0.18, four to five times below the observed rates. The generator does not merely acquire findings, it transcribes text: 95% of reports produced under relevant retrieval contain an eight-word span occurring verbatim in the retrieved evidence but absent from the reference, against 0% without retrieval. We then explain the mechanism: a normal chest X-ray retrieves at least one abnormal precedent in 24 of 28 cases, because medical image-embedding similarity is dominated by anatomy and acquisition rather than by the presence of disease. This has a direct design consequence. Retrieval similarity does not predict harm (RIH rates 0.80/0.80/0.60/0.84 across similarity quartiles), so relevance gates conditioned on embedding similarity cannot work; gating on predicted pathology agreement removes 61% of unsupported evidence at no cost to useful coverage. We argue that retrieval-augmented clinical systems must be evaluated under retrieval failure, not only under retrieval success.

AI.tldr: 检索增强生成在胸部X光报告中被证明既是提升手段也是临床错误的可靠来源：相关检索下F1翻倍，但错配检索下崩溃至0.043，且模型会逐字转抄检索证据中的文本。
AI.motivation: 胸部X光报告可通过检索相似既往研究获得临床上下文，弥补通用视觉语言模型的不足；但作者想揭示同一机制也可能成为可靠的临床错误来源，并主张临床系统必须在检索失败而非仅成功的情形下接受评估。
AI.method: 在100余例MIMIC-CXR研究上，使用冻结的LLaVA-1.5生成器和BioMedCLIP检索，比较相关检索、临床错配检索与纯图像生成的CheXbert临床F1；定义并统计检索诱导幻觉率（RIH）；引入"巧合重叠"对照以估计随机基线；通过逐字八词跨度分析验证文本转抄；并分析嵌入相似度与病理一致性对危害的预测能力。
AI.result: 相关检索下F1从0.201升至0.402，错配检索下崩溃至0.043（仅为纯图像分数的五分之一）；RIH从0.00升至0.76和0.98，而巧合重叠对照的随机基线为0.18（低四至五倍）。相关检索下95%报告含检索证据中逐字出现但参考中缺失的八词跨度，无检索时为0%。28例正常胸片中24例至少检索到一个异常先例；相似度四分位间RIH为0.80/0.80/0.60/0.84，相似度不预测危害；基于预测病理一致性门控可移除61%无支持证据且不损失有用覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 检索相似度受解剖与采集而非疾病存在主导，导致正常胸片也常检索到异常先例；基于嵌入相似度的相关性门控无法奏效，应改用预测病理一致性门控。检索增强临床系统必须在检索失败情形下进行评估，而不仅在成功情形下。

title: CLAP: Closed-Loop Alignment with Pressure for Precise Suction Manipulation
summary: Stacking and palletising demand precise placement: error left in one layer is inherited by the next, and a flat pad offers no feature to funnel a wrong pose into the right one. Top-down suction suits such dense arrangements, and suction has already been brought into vision-language-action (VLA) policies. What that work does not report, however, is a policy conditioned on a measured vacuum signal, or one that uses it to abandon an action already under way. Vision does not settle the question here, because at the moment it matters the cup and the face it holds occlude each other. We present CLAP, which makes the attachment state observable through a pressure module tapped into the vacuum line. The decoded reading replaces the suction command in the policy's proprioception, is fused with the visual features, and terminates the open-loop execution window so that the policy re-infers from a fresh observation. For data, we record goal-state disassembly on the physical robot and reverse the joint-state sequence offline, without a simulation replay. Targeted phase demonstrations, 8.3% of the training frames, cover the suction transitions and the configurations an interrupted grasp leaves behind. On a real Unitree Z1, one multi-task checkpoint reaches 96.67% average success in both colour settings, 16.67 and 10.00 points above the strongest baseline, its monochromatic four-block successes averaging 15.92 mm of error. Four ablation settings fall 5.00 to 13.33 points short. We will release code and trained weights.

AI.tldr: CLAP通过压力模块使抽吸状态可观测，将真空信号融入VLA策略的感知并中断开环执行，实现高精度堆叠与码垛。
AI.motivation: 堆叠与码垛要求精确放置，单层误差会被逐层继承，而平面吸盘缺乏可引导错误姿态的特征。视觉在吸盘与工件相互遮挡的关键时刻无法判断贴合状态，因此需要可观测的抽吸信号。
AI.method: 在真空管路中接入压力模块，解码读数替代策略本体感知中的吸盘指令，与视觉特征融合，并在抓取状态异常时终止开环执行窗口以重新推理；数据通过在真机上录制目标状态拆解并离线反转关节序列获得，另采集8.3%的针对性阶段演示覆盖抽吸切换与被中断抓取后的构型。
AI.result: 在真实Unitree Z1上，单多任务检查点在两种颜色设置下平均成功率达96.67%，较最强基线高16.67与10.00个百分点，单色四块任务平均误差15.92 mm；四项消融设置分别低5.00至13.33个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将实测真空信号作为策略的可观测条件并用于中断进行中的动作，可显著提升密集堆叠码垛的成功率与精度，代码与权重将公开。

title: Measuring the evolution of camera distance across a century of film
summary: The rise of computer vision and artificial intelligence has made possible new forms of large-scale computational measurement. We apply these techniques to a deep collection of 5,205 digitized films viewed in theaters between 1922-2025 (covering popular, prestigious, and independent movies) to trace the development of one of the most fundamental ways through which film communicates: by manipulating the space between the camera and its subject. This work finds abrupt changes with the rise of new technologies in sound and television, and allows us to shed an empirical light on gender disparity (women, despite having substantially less screentime than men, are disproportionately the subject of closer shots), and illustrate how animated films both inherit and break free from the norms of live-action filmmaking.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用计算机视觉与AI技术，对1922-2025年间5205部数字化影片进行大规模计算测量，追踪电影如何通过操控摄影机与拍摄对象之间的空间来传递信息，揭示了技术变革与性别差异对镜头运用的影响。
AI.motivation: 计算机视觉和人工智能的兴起使大规模计算测量成为可能。作者希望借助这些技术，从一个深度的电影集合中，定量追踪电影最基本的沟通方式之一——操控镜头与拍摄对象之间的空间，并实证检验技术变迁、性别差异及动画与真人电影规范的关系。
AI.method: 作者应用计算机视觉与AI技术，对1922-2025年间在影院放映的5205部数字化电影（涵盖流行、权威和独立影片）进行大规模计算分析，量化测量摄影机与拍摄对象之间的距离（即镜头景别）随时间的变化。
AI.result: 研究发现，随着声音技术和电视的兴起，镜头空间运用出现突变式变化。同时，实证揭示了性别差异：女性尽管在银幕上的时间明显少于男性，却不成比例地成为更近距离镜头的拍摄对象。此外，研究还展示了动画电影如何既继承又突破真人电影的拍摄规范。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明计算方法可有效揭示电影视觉语言的长期演变，为理解技术、性别与媒介形式对镜头空间运用的影响提供了实证基础。

title: Copper-Policy: Focus on the Representation for Robust Robot Manipulation
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) acquire behavioral priors by modeling future scene evolution, but predicting detailed futures in pixel or latent space incurs substantial cost. Recent evidence that co-training gains persist without test-time generation raises a question: what must a WAM learn to improve control? We introduce Copper-Policy, which learns a compact World representation with the policy rather than relying on a predefined target space. Through temporal joint-embedding prediction, it predicts future observation embeddings conditioned on task intention without reconstructing pixels. This prediction and action decoding shape the representation jointly, while the policy retains access to current-frame spatial detail for execution. Representation analyses show that the learned features better separate task-driven change from perturbations and provide complementary information for control. Compact prediction targets reduce training tokens per sample, enabling a 2B-parameter model trained in 9.67 hours on 8$\times$ RTX 5090 GPUs and 6$\times$ faster than Fast-WAM on matched A100 GPUs. Copper-Policy outperforms every compared method without embodied pretraining on RoboTwin and several embodied-pretrained VLAs on LIBERO-Plus (80.85%). On three challenging real-robot tasks, it performs comparably to $π_{0.5}$ and attains a higher average score. Together, these results show that Copper-Policy combines strong control performance with efficient training.

AI.tldr: 提出 Copper-Policy，通过与策略联合学习紧凑的世界表示（预测未来观测嵌入而非重建像素），在保持强控制性能的同时大幅提升训练效率。
AI.motivation: World Action Models 通过建模未来场景演化获取行为先验，但在像素或潜空间预测详细未来代价高昂。近期证据显示，即使测试时不生成未来，协同训练带来的收益依然存在，这引出一个问题：WAM 究竟需要学到什么才能改善控制。作者希望摆脱预定义目标空间，让表示与策略共同塑造，以降低训练成本并提升控制效果。
AI.method: Copper-Policy 与策略联合学习紧凑的世界表示，而非依赖预定义目标空间。它通过时间联合嵌入预测，在任务意图条件下预测未来观测嵌入，不重建像素。该预测与动作解码共同塑造表示，同时策略保留对当前帧空间细节的访问以用于执行。
AI.result: 表示分析显示，所学特征能更好地区分任务驱动变化与扰动，并为控制提供互补信息。紧凑预测目标减少了每个样本的训练 token 数，使 2B 参数模型在 8× RTX 5090 GPU 上 9.67 小时完成训练，在同等 A100 GPU 上比 Fast-WAM 快 6 倍。Copper-Policy 在 RoboTwin 上超越所有对比方法（无需具身预训练），在 LIBERO-Plus 上超过多个具身预训练 VLA（80.85%）。在三个挑战性真实机器人任务上，其表现与 π_0.5 相当，并取得更高的平均分。
AI.conclusion: Copper-Policy 表明，通过学习紧凑的、与策略联合塑造的世界表示，可以在无需重建像素的前提下实现强控制性能与高效训练的统一。

title: LukeNet: A lightweight CNN integrated with an XAI model for Smart acute lymphoblastic leukemia detection and management
summary: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) patients require early, accurate detection to enable timely treatment and effective patient management. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is well-suited for creating an end-to-end enabling environment for ALL detection and classification. However, most CNN-based ALL detection systems are theoretical and unsuitable for deployment on edge devices due to high computational demands. The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT)-enabled devices offer an opportunity to monitor ALL patients in real time. Wearables that track temperature, heart rate, oxygen saturation, and activity can deliver critical data to support timely clinical intervention and improve patient outcomes. In smart IoMT environments, a lightweight CNN is essential because connected devices often operate under limited computational power, memory, and latency constraints. To address this need, this study proposes LukeNet, a lightweight CNN integrated with explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) for an IoMT-based SMART Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Detection and Management System. Trained on three (3) ALL datasets and five-fold cross-validation, LukeNet achieved an impressive 99% model accuracy as well as 99% unseen test accuracy, which is higher than six state-of-the-art (SOTA) CNNs, such as DenseNet121, MobileNet, ResNet50, InceptionV3, Xception, and VGG16, as well as transfer learning models. Furthermore, LukeNet was compared with two ensemble models. In addition, explainable AI methods are integrated to highlight relevant regions in microscopic images. The novelty of this study lies in the architecture of LukeNet, which balances model depth and computational efficiency by using depthwise separable convolutions, mitigates the risk of gradient loss in deeper layers, and provides strong global and local feature extraction capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级CNN模型LukeNet，集成可解释AI，用于IoMT环境下急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）的实时检测与管理，准确率达99%，优于六种SOTA模型及集成模型。
AI.motivation: ALL需早期准确检测以支持及时治疗，但多数基于CNN的检测系统计算需求高，难以在边缘设备部署。IoMT可穿戴设备可实时监测患者数据，因此需要适应有限算力、内存与延迟约束的轻量级CNN。
AI.method: 构建LukeNet轻量级CNN，采用深度可分离卷积平衡模型深度与计算效率，缓解深层梯度消失问题，兼具全局与局部特征提取能力；在三个ALL数据集上进行五折交叉验证；集成可解释AI（XAI）方法高亮显微图像中的相关区域。
AI.result: 模型准确率达99%，未见测试集准确率99%，优于DenseNet121、MobileNet、ResNet50、InceptionV3、Xception、VGG16六种SOTA CNN及迁移学习模型，并与两种集成模型进行了对比。
AI.conclusion: LukeNet适合IoMT边缘设备部署，可实现ALL的实时检测与管理，并通过XAI提升可解释性，在准确率与计算效率间取得良好平衡。

title: CollisionGAT: Controller-Agnostic One-Step Collision Screening for Multi-Agent Motion
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 1 table, 2 algorithms. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE MIT Undergraduate Research Technology Conference (URTC)
summary: Before a team of robots moves, each proposed step must be checked for collisions with other robots and with obstacles. We present CollisionGAT, a graph-attention network that reads the current and proposed states of moving agents together with locally relevant stationary obstacles and returns one collision-risk score per moving agent. Any controller can use these scores to accept, repair, replan, or postpone a proposed step. We mount CollisionGAT on a continuous path-following controller and on GATeD, an obstacle-blind D* Lite planner that uses typed vetoes to update its planning graphs. Exact geometric checks supply the training labels and independently audit every executed step.

AI.tldr: 提出CollisionGAT，一种图注意力网络，用于多机器人运动前的碰撞风险评分，并可与控制器及规划器结合使用。
AI.motivation: 机器人团队运动前，每个提出的动作步骤都必须先检查与其他机器人及障碍物的碰撞，传统精确几何检查可能计算开销大，因此需要高效的风险评估方法。
AI.method: CollisionGAT读取移动智能体的当前状态与提议状态，以及局部相关静止障碍物，输出每个移动智能体的碰撞风险分数；将其安装在连续路径跟随控制器和GATeD（一种障碍盲D* Lite规划器，使用类型化veto更新规划图）上。
AI.result: 精确几何检查提供训练标签，并独立审计每一个执行步骤；控制器可利用风险分数接受、修复、重规划或推迟提议步骤。
AI.conclusion: CollisionGAT可作为通用碰撞风险评分模块，支持控制器与规划器在运动前高效处理碰撞检查。

title: Seeing the Heat: Synthesizing High-Resolution Wood Thermal Responses from Optical Imagery
summary: The thermal behavior of wood is a critical factor in advanced material assembly. However, pixel-level thermal analysis remains fundamentally constrained by the low resolution and noise inherent to infrared thermography. To address this, we introduce an end-to-end computational framework that synthesizes high-resolution thermal responses directly from wood RGB images. We first establish a core physical linkage: because spatial color variation in natural wood is driven by cellular anatomy, optical intensity serves as a reliable geometric proxy for the localized solid volume fraction. By leveraging this theoretical insight, we develop an automated finite-element-method data engine that maps pixel-level optical intensity to a 3D thermodynamic voxel grid, generating high-fidelity synthetic thermal responses. We find that 1) when the thermal conductivity along the thickness direction is uniform or linear, wood RGB images and their corresponding thermal responses exhibit extreme morphological similarities, and the lateral thermal diffusion acts as a low-pass filter that smooths out high-frequency details; 2) when the thermal conductivity along the thickness direction is random, such morphological similarities are destroyed, and wood's 3D structure dominantly governs its thermal response. We further utilize these synthetic thermal responses to supervise a neural surrogate model built upon the DINOv3 foundation model. Our results demonstrate that the neural surrogate model successfully internalizes the governing thermodynamic laws, thereby bypassing computationally expensive simulations and enabling high-resolution thermal inference. This methodology effectively bridges the semantic and thermodynamic domains, unlocking systematic, pixel-level analysis of fine-grained wood thermal responses. Project: https://zekifayes.github.io/seeheat

AI.tldr: 提出端到端计算框架，用木材RGB图像合成高分辨率热响应。基于"颜色变化源于细胞解剖结构、光强可作局部固相体积分数几何代理"的物理联系，构建自动有限元数据引擎，将像素光强映射为3D热力学体素网格。发现导热率均匀/线性时RGB与热响应形态高度相似（横向热扩散起低通滤波作用）；随机时该相似性被破坏、3D结构主导。以合成热响应监督基于DINOv3的神经代理模型，使其内化热力学规律，绕过昂贵仿真实现高分辨率热推断。
AI.motivation: 红外热成像分辨率低、噪声大，导致木材的像素级热分析受到根本性限制。需要一种能从低成本RGB图像直接获取高分辨率热响应的方法。
AI.method: 1) 建立物理联系：木材空间颜色变化由细胞解剖结构驱动，故光学强度可作局部固相体积分数的可靠几何代理；2) 开发自动化有限元数据引擎，将像素级光强映射到3D热力学体素网格，生成高保真合成热响应；3) 用合成热响应监督基于DINOv3基础模型的神经代理模型。
AI.result: 当厚度方向导热率为均匀或线性时，木材RGB图像与其热响应形态高度相似，横向热扩散作为低通滤波器平滑高频细节；当导热率随机时，形态相似性被破坏，木材3D结构主导热响应。神经代理模型成功内化热力学规律，绕过昂贵仿真并实现高分辨率热推断。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效桥接语义域与热力学域，打通了细粒度木材热响应的系统性像素级分析，为先进材料组装中的热行为研究提供新途径。

title: Towards Kinematic Actionable Infeasibility Detection in Motion Planning
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Motion planning in robotics requires not only computing collision-free paths but also certifying infeasibility when no such path exists. Complete methods are limited to low-dimensional spaces, while sampling-based planners scale efficiently but cannot provide finite-time infeasibility certificates, leaving this problem largely unresolved in high-dimensional spaces. In this letter, we present a geometry-driven framework for certifying infeasibility through an explicit resolution-dependent analysis of configuration space topology. Leveraging signed distance field representations, the proposed method traces separating manifolds induced by obstacle boundaries directly in configuration space, enabling both detection of infeasibility and identification of the specific geometric cause. To address computational challenges, we develop a parallel frontier-expansion algorithm that exploits GPU acceleration for efficient simplicial reconstruction in high-dimensional spaces. We validate the approach on 4-DOF and 5-DOF robot scenarios, certifying infeasibility within seconds for 4-DOF cases and under four minutes for 5-DOF cases. We further discuss avenues for improving scalability to higher-dimensional spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于几何的框架，通过显式分析配置空间拓扑来认证高维空间中的运动规划不可行性，利用符号距离场追踪分离流形，并借助GPU并行前沿扩展算法实现高效重建。
AI.motivation: 运动规划不仅需要计算无碰撞路径，还需在无路径存在时认证不可行性。现有完整方法局限于低维空间，而采样规划器虽可扩展却无法提供有限时间的不可行性证书，使得高维空间中的这一问题基本未解决。
AI.method: 基于符号距离场表示，在配置空间中直接追踪由障碍边界诱导的分离流形，实现不可行性检测并识别具体几何原因；同时开发并行前沿扩展算法，利用GPU加速进行高维空间中的高效单纯形重建。
AI.result: 在4自由度与5自由度机器人场景中进行验证，4自由度案例可在数秒内完成不可行性认证，5自由度案例在四分钟内完成。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效认证高维空间中的运动规划不可行性，并进一步讨论了向更高维空间提升可扩展性的途径。

title: Beyond Volume Overlap: Surface Matching for Topology-Aware Coronary Artery Segmentation
comment: 12 Pages, 2 figures, Statistical Atlases and Computational Modeling of the Heart (STACOM) workshop of MICCAI 2026
summary: Accurate coronary artery segmentation on coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) is essential for diagnosing coronary artery disease. Deep networks are conventionally trained and evaluated with the Dice coefficient, but volume-overlap metrics are poorly suited to thin, tubular anatomy: since most voxels belong to a few thickproximal segments, a missing distal branch barely affects Dice despite severely disrupting the connectivity required for clinical use. We introduce a surface metric that matches predicted and reference surface points via bipartite assignment under a localized, vessel-radius tolerance, reporting precision, recall, and F1 with decoupled false positives (spurious branches) and false negatives (missed branches) a distinction the symmetric Dice cannot make. With it we show that a strong Dice-trained baseline omits far more vessel surface than it hallucinates, an asymmetry its high Dice hides. Building on this, we propose a differentiable surface loss that simultaneously suppresses spurious mass and recovers absent structure, validated by fine-tuning three backbones (nnU-Net, SwinUNETR, NexToU) on two public benchmarks (Image-CAS, ASOCA). Against a matched-epoch control, it significantly improves surface F1 by recovering missed distal vessels at comparable Dice. Our findings argue for measuring and optimizing the vessel surface, not the volume it overlaps. Code

AI.tldr: 提出面向冠状动脉表面的分割评价指标与可微表面损失，揭示Dice对细管状结构的缺陷。
AI.motivation: CCTA冠脉分割临床依赖连通性，但常规Dice为体积重叠指标：大多数体素属于少数粗近端段，缺失远端分支对Dice影响甚微，却严重破坏临床所需的连通性。Dice的对称性也无法区分假阳性（虚假分支）与假阴性（漏检分支）。
AI.method: (1) 提出表面度量：在局部血管半径容差下，用二分图分配匹配预测与参考表面点，报告精确率、召回率与F1，并解耦假阳性与假阴性。(2) 基于该度量提出可微表面损失，同时抑制虚假质量并恢复缺失结构；在nnU-Net、SwinUNETR、NexToU三个骨干上，于Image-CAS与ASOCA两个公开基准微调，并与同epoch对照比较。
AI.result: 用该表面度量显示：强Dice训练基线漏掉的血管表面远多于其虚构的，这种不对称被高Dice掩盖。相比同epoch对照，所提损失在Dice相当的情况下，通过恢复漏检远端血管显著提升表面F1。
AI.conclusion: 应度量并优化血管表面而非其所重叠的体积，为细管状解剖结构的分割评估与训练提供了更贴合临床需求的方案。

title: Scanning While Imagining: A Scene-Graph World Model for Robotic Ultrasound Navigation
summary: Ultrasound (US) acquisition depends on the operator's ability to interpret anatomy and anticipate how the view will change with probe motion. Many robotic US navigation methods select actions without explicitly predicting these anatomical changes. We propose SonoGraph-WM, an action- and goal-conditioned world model for anticipatory probe navigation. The model represents anatomy as scene graphs (SGs), capturing visible structures, their geometry, and spatial relationships without synthesizing US images. Given a history of SGs and probe poses, a unified Transformer jointly predicts future SGs and poses. A receding-horizon planner recursively imagines candidate trajectories, selects the shortest predicted path reaching a goal graph, and follows it over a short execution horizon before replanning from new observations. To reduce reliance on tracked and anatomically annotated US sequences, we generate aligned SG--pose training data from computed tomography (CT) label maps along surface-constrained probe trajectories. On four held-out CT cases, spatial relation F1 remains above 93% over 20 prediction steps, and closed-loop navigation achieves 77.50% and 75.00% success for the gallbladder and pancreas, respectively, using annotation-derived SGs. In robot--phantom navigation experiments with label-map-derived SGs, the planner reached the target view in 73.7% of trials. These findings support CT-supervised anatomical world modeling for probe planning and highlight the importance of frequent observation updates for reliable navigation. Project Page: https://noseefood.github.io/us-sonograph-wm/

AI.tldr: 提出SonoGraph-WM，一种以动作为条件、目标导向的世界模型，用场景图表征解剖结构，联合预测未来场景图与探头位姿，实现前瞻性超声探头导航。
AI.motivation: 超声采集依赖操作者解读解剖并预判探头运动带来的视野变化，但现有机器人超声导航方法在选择动作时并未显式预测解剖变化，缺乏前瞻性。
AI.method: 以场景图表示解剖，包含可见结构、几何与空间关系，不合成超声图像；输入历史场景图与探头位姿，用统一Transformer联合预测未来场景图与位姿；采用滚动时域规划器递归想象候选轨迹，选择到达目标图的最短预测路径并在短执行时域后重规划；为减少对标注超声序列的依赖，从CT标签图沿表面约束轨迹生成对齐的场景图-位姿训练数据。
AI.result: 在四个留出CT病例上，20个预测步内空间关系F1保持93%以上；使用标注导出的场景图，胆囊和胰腺闭环导航成功率分别为77.50%和75.00%；在机器人-体模实验中，使用标签图导出的场景图，73.7%的试验到达目标视野。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持CT监督的解剖世界建模用于探头规划，并凸显频繁观测更新对可靠导航的重要性。

title: PEEL-DDPM: Physics-Enabled Evidential Learning for the Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model
summary:
Normal-inverse-gamma (NIG) regression is not identifiable from its marginal Student-t likelihood: three combinations of four NIG parameters are determined, leaving one degree of freedom. We introduce PEEL-DDPM, a physics-enabled evidential learning framework for denoising diffusion probabilistic models. A measurement-conditioned DDPM is first trained with epsilon-MSE and then frozen. Its complete reverse trajectory produces a reconstruction, whose residual from the known training object is modeled by a final-image evidential network. The network learns only the identifiable Student-t coordinates, while repeated scanner-noise realizations and repeated diffusion trajectories provide a nested Monte Carlo estimate of final-image aleatoric variance, separated into scanner-induced and sampler-induced components. This measured variance resolves the remaining NIG ambiguity and yields a decomposition of predictive uncertainty into measurement, diffusion, and epistemic terms.
  The method uses sequential training without a cross-loss weighting coefficient. In a feasibility study on eight held-out objects, empirical central-interval coverages were 49.3%, 80.3%, 90.1%, and 95.6% for nominal 50%, 80%, 90%, and 95% intervals. The mean squared residual was 0.967 times the mean predicted variance, and a single-image aleatoric head achieved pooled Spearman correlation 0.785 against an independent nested reference. Across five dose levels, scanner-induced variance showed a log-log dose slope of -1.15, whereas sampler-induced variance remained nearly dose independent with slope -0.01. These results support PEEL-DDPM as a practical route to identifiable and physically interpretable uncertainty quantification in diffusion-based image reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 提出PEEL-DDPM框架,通过物理启发的证据学习解决NIG回归不可识别问题,实现扩散模型重建中的可识别且可物理解释的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: Normal-inverse-gamma (NIG)回归从其边际Student-t似然中不可识别:四个NIG参数中只有三种组合被确定,留下一个自由度无法确定。因此需要引入额外信息来消解这一模糊性,并实现扩散图像重建中可识别、可物理解释的不确定性量化。
AI.method: 提出PEEL-DDPM物理启发的证据学习框架:(1)先用epsilon-MSE训练一个以测量为条件的DDPM并冻结;(2)其完整逆向轨迹生成重建,重建与已知训练对象的残差由最终图像证据网络建模;(3)网络仅学习可识别的Student-t坐标,同时通过重复扫描噪声实现与重复扩散轨迹提供嵌套蒙特卡洛估计最终图像的偶然方差,并分离为扫描仪引起和采样器引起两部分;(4)测得的方差消解NIG剩余模糊性,将预测不确定性分解为测量、扩散和认知三项。方法采用顺序训练,无需交叉损失权重系数。
AI.result: 在八个留出对象的可行性研究中,经验中心区间覆盖率分别为49.3%、80.3%、90.1%、95.6%,对应标称50%、80%、90%、95%区间;均方残差为平均预测方差的0.967倍;单图像偶然方差头的合并Spearman相关系数为0.785(对比独立嵌套参考)。在五个剂量水平上,扫描仪引起方差的log-log剂量斜率为-1.15,而采样器引起方差近乎与剂量无关,斜率为-0.01。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持PEEL-DDPM作为扩散图像重建中实现可识别且具物理解释的不确定性量化的实用途径。

title: FINE: Future-Informed Navigation Encoding for Data-Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Adapting vision-language navigation (VLN) policies to new environments is expensive because every additional route and instruction requires an embodied demonstration. Yet standard observation-to-action training uses only a small fraction of the information already contained in each trajectory. In particular, future observations reveal the instruction-relevant landmarks that the agent will encounter, including what they look like and how they are arranged in 3D. We introduce FINE, a Future-Informed Navigation Encoding framework that extracts this latent supervision from existing demonstrations. FINE equips a VLN backbone with two complementary auxiliary representations. First, explicit landmark tokens follow the ordered landmarks specified by the instruction and are trained to predict future landmark regions in both semantic 2D patch-feature space and viewpoint-dependent 3D geometric feature space. Second, an implicit future token learns to distinguish the landmark state that is actually reached from plausible same-scene counterfactual futures generated by a video world model. On R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen, FINE improves InternVLA-N1 by 2.6 and 4.5 success-rate points, respectively, at full training data. More importantly, as demonstrations become limited, the benefit grows: at a 70% demonstration budget, FINE improves success rate by 6.8 points, recovering roughly one-third of the performance lost by reducing the training demonstrations. Project page is available at https://finevln.github.io/.

AI.tldr: FINE框架从已有示范轨迹的未来观测中挖掘潜在监督信号，通过显式地标token和隐式未来token两种辅助表示增强视觉语言导航策略，在示范数据有限时提升尤为显著。
AI.motivation: 将视觉语言导航（VLN）策略适配到新环境成本高昂，因为每条新增路线和指令都需要具身示范。而标准的观测到动作训练仅利用了每条轨迹中已有信息的一小部分，未来观测中蕴含的指令相关地标信息（外观及3D布局）未被充分利用。
AI.method: 提出FINE（Future-Informed Navigation Encoding）框架，从现有示范中提取潜在监督。为VLN骨干网络配备两种互补的辅助表示：(1) 显式地标token，按指令指定的有序地标排列，在语义2D patch特征空间和视角相关的3D几何特征空间中预测未来地标区域；(2) 隐式未来token，学习区分实际到达的地标状态与由视频世界模型生成的合理同场景反事实未来。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE和RxR-CE val-unseen上，全量训练数据下FINE使InternVLA-N1的成功率分别提升2.6和4.5个百分点。在示范数据受限时收益更大：70%示范预算下成功率提升6.8个百分点，约恢复因减少训练示范而损失性能的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: FINE通过从现有示范的未来观测中挖掘潜在监督，有效提升了VLN策略性能，且在示范数据有限时优势更为突出，为降低VLN适配成本提供了有效途径。

title: VisionPsy-Nano: Improving Accuracy, Efficiency, and Reliability in On-Device Vision-Language Models
summary: Sub-billion-parameter Vision-Language Models are increasingly viable for on-device deployment, yet compact model size alone does not guarantee usability. On a phone, such a model can still require more than two minutes to produce its first token. On-device usability depends on three axes: accuracy, efficiency, and behavioral reliability; standard benchmarks miss the third, with answers too short to expose doom loops and prompts too benign to probe adversarial safety. We introduce a diagnosis-driven post-training recipe in which a teacher VLM stress-tests the student, uncovers failure modes beyond human priors, and converts them into targeted supervision and preference alignment, supplementing generic data scaling with failure-driven optimization. Coupled with two visual-token policies, the recipe yields two accuracy-efficiency variants with improved behavioral reliability. \textbf{\NanoFull} attains a 62.3 normalized average over 17 benchmarks, the highest among openly released $\sim$0.5B models, +7.4 over its base at identical architecture and token budget, with doom-loop rates at or below the strongest baseline's. \textbf{\FlashFull} retains 61.4 while cutting warm time-to-first-token on a Pixel 9 from 138\,s to 6.1\,s (23$\times$). By jointly addressing all three axes, we move compact VLMs toward practical on-device usability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种诊断驱动的后训练方法，使亚十亿参数视觉语言模型在手机端同时提升精度、效率与行为可靠性，\NanoFull 取得 17 项基准 62.3 归一化均分，\FlashFull 在 Pixel 9 上将首 token 时间从 138 秒降至 6.1 秒。
AI.motivation: 紧凑型 VLM 虽可端侧部署，但模型小不等于可用：手机上首个 token 可能需超过两分钟。端侧可用性取决于精度、效率和行为可靠性三轴，而标准基准缺少第三轴——答案过短无法暴露 doom loop，提示过于温和无法检验对抗安全性。
AI.method: 诊断驱动的后训练配方：由教师 VLM 对学生进行压力测试，发现超出人类先验的失败模式，并将其转化为定向监督与偏好对齐，以失败驱动优化补充通用数据扩展；同时结合两种视觉 token 策略。
AI.result: \NanoFull 在 17 项基准上归一化平均 62.3，为公开约 0.5B 模型中最高，在同架构同 token 预算下比基座提升 7.4，doom loop 率不高于最强基线。\FlashFull 保持 61.4，同时将 Pixel 9 上热启动首 token 时间从 138 秒缩短至 6.1 秒，提速 23 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时优化精度、效率与行为可靠性三轴，该方法推动紧凑型 VLM 走向实用化端侧部署。

title: RoboFoundry: System-as-Policy Evolution for Self-Learning Embodied Agents
summary: A foundation model should not act in isolation as an embodied agent. Yet, existing methods often optimize individual components of the agent stack, such as memory, context, skills, or action interfaces, rather than treating the supporting system itself as a unified policy. Moreover, interaction alone does not yield self-improvement unless execution experience is converted into persistent, validated system changes. We therefore propose RoboFoundry, the first embodied agentic framework that formulates this process as Self-Evolving System-as-Policy. RoboFoundry diagnoses capability gaps in decision-making and memory management, converts execution traces into validated task-specific system updates, and promotes recurring improvements to the general system. Evolution operates over two complementary surfaces: a context system that manages active internal context and persistent file-system memory, and a hierarchical skill system that organizes atomic skills, reusable compositions, and failure-conditioned recovery. A shared semantic interface separates embodiment-invariant decisions from embodiment-specific execution, allowing evolved system capabilities to transfer across heterogeneous robots. On EmbodiedBench, RoboFoundry achieves state-of-the-art performance, notably improving GPT-5.5 by 27.8%. It also brings Qwen3.7-Plus to near parity with GPT-5.5 (70.3% vs. 72.7%), showing consistent gains from system-as-policy evolution across foundation models. For long-horizon memory, RoboFoundry outperforms all baselines on RoboMemArena by at least 39.0%, even against methods assisted by external foundation models. On LIBERO-PRO, it further outperforms Cap-Agent0 by 243.8%-679.7% across all perturbation types. In real-world deployments, RoboFoundry demonstrates zero-shot transfer and online evolution across robots and tasks, highlighting its potential for fully autonomous embodied agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoboFoundry，首个将具身智能体支撑系统本身建模为统一策略的“自演化系统即策略”框架，通过将执行经验转化为持久、经校验的系统级更新，实现决策与记忆管理的自我改进，并可跨异构机器人迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常只优化智能体栈中的单个组件（如记忆、上下文、技能或动作接口），而非把支撑系统整体视为统一策略；同时，仅有交互并不能带来自我改进，除非能把执行经验转化为持久且经过验证的系统变更。
AI.method: RoboFoundry 将过程形式化为“自演化系统即策略”，诊断决策与记忆管理中的能力缺口，把执行轨迹转化为经校验的任务级系统更新，并将反复出现的改进提升为通用系统能力。演化在两个层面进行：管理活跃内部上下文与持久文件系统记忆的上下文系统，以及组织原子技能、可复用组合与失败条件恢复的分层技能系统。共享语义接口将具身无关决策与具身特定执行分离，使演化后的系统能力可跨异构机器人迁移。
AI.result: 在 EmbodiedBench 上取得最优性能，使 GPT-5.5 提升 27.8%，并使 Qwen3.7-Plus 接近 GPT-5.5（70.3% vs. 72.7%）。在长时程记忆的 RoboMemArena 上，较所有基线至少高出 39.0%，即使对比有外部基础模型辅助的方法亦然。在 LIBERO-PRO 上，在所有扰动类型中较 Cap-Agent0 高出 243.8%–679.7%。在真实部署中展示了跨机器人与任务的零样本迁移与在线演化。
AI.conclusion: RoboFoundry 表明将支撑系统作为统一策略进行自演化能够跨基础模型带来一致增益，并在决策、记忆与真实部署中展现出完全自主具身智能体的潜力。

title: The Earth in One Gaze: Training-Free Active Focus for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) must balance local detail against scene context when interpreting ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing (RS) imagery within a limited visual-input budget. Existing selection-based methods either prune tokens and select patches through relevance scoring, or crop actively through repeated inspection. Neither strategy directly redistributes pixels within a continuous full-scene view: the first retains selected tokens or patches, and the second re-encodes a crop detached from its surroundings. Our pilot study finds that a frozen MLLM already produces useful question-guided spatial requests, yet crop-based inspection of the selected regions does not consistently improve its answers. We therefore formulate UHR understanding as a question of where to spend a fixed pixel budget. Based on this, we introduce GazeEarth, a simple-yet-effective training-free framework that couples question-guided region selection with full-scene foveated observation. The MLLM selects evidence cells from an indexed overview; a deterministic, topology-preserving warp resamples the original image onto a fixed-size canvas, enlarging their shared neighborhood while compressing the periphery; the same frozen model answers from this focused view, using at most two MLLM calls and no external selector or iterative search. Across three UHR remote sensing benchmarks and four frozen backbones, GazeEarth improves benchmark-averaged accuracy by 4.6 to 9.4 percentage points over direct answering and 3.4 to 4.3 over overview answering, outperforming task-trained methods. Our analyses show that existing MLLMs can guide where to look in UHR images on their own, and that what they can infer from the selected evidence depends on how that evidence is presented.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GazeEarth，一个无需训练的多模态大模型框架，将超高分辨率遥感图像理解重新表述为"如何在固定像素预算下分配像素"的问题，通过问题引导的区域选择与全场景中央凹式观察相结合，在多个遥感基准上取得显著精度提升。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在有限视觉输入预算下处理超高分辨率遥感图像时，需在局部细节与全局场景上下文之间取得平衡。现有的基于选择的方法要么通过相关性打分剪枝token和选择patch，要么通过反复检查主动裁剪，但都无法在连续全场景视图中直接重新分配像素：前者仅保留选定token或patch，后者重新编码的裁剪区域脱离周围环境。作者发现冻结的MLLM已能产生有用的问题引导空间请求，但基于裁剪的区域检查并不能稳定提升其回答质量。
AI.method: GazeEarth是一个简单有效、无需训练的框架，将UHR理解形式化为"在哪里花费固定像素预算"的问题。其核心包括：由MLLM从索引化的概览图中选择证据单元（evidence cells）；随后采用确定性、保持拓扑结构的warp变换，将原始图像重采样到固定尺寸画布上，放大所选证据的共享邻域并压缩外围区域；最后由同一个冻结模型从这一聚焦视图作答。整个过程最多使用两次MLLM调用，无需外部选择器或迭代搜索。
AI.result: 在三个UHR遥感基准和四个冻结骨干网络上，GazeEarth相较直接回答平均准确率提升4.6至9.4个百分点，相较概览回答提升3.4至4.3个百分点，并优于任务训练方法。
AI.conclusion: 分析表明，现有MLLM能够自行引导在UHR图像中的观察位置，而其从所选证据中能推断出什么，取决于证据的呈现方式。这凸显了证据呈现方式（而非仅证据选择）对UHR遥感理解性能的关键作用。

title: Communication-Aware Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Decentralized Multi-Human Multi-Robot Task Allocation
summary: Multi-human multi-robot (MH-MR) teams combine robotic autonomy with human expertise, but effective task allocation requires coordinating scarce, dynamically available human support with distributed robot execution. Limited robot-robot and human-robot communication further complicates this coupling by delaying information exchange and supervisory intervention. We introduce CommHG, a communication-aware heterogeneous graph learning framework for decentralized MH-MR task allocation. CommHG represents coupled human-robot-task interactions through local graphs conditioned on information availability and age. Learned communication actions enable robots to decide when and which operator to query, and when to share information with peers. Allocation and communication are jointly optimized through cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, allowing the team to acquire useful information while managing limited communication and supervisory resources. We also introduce a benchmark integrating heterogeneous humans and robots, dynamic tasks and operational states, and constrained robot-robot and bidirectional human-robot links. Experiments across heterogeneous teams with up to 16 robots, 6 humans, and 112 tasks show that CommHG improves timely weighted mission completion as coordination scale increases, outperforming the strongest baseline in the Large scenario.

AI.tldr: CommHG：通信感知异构图学习框架，用于去中心化多人类多机器人任务分配，联合优化任务分配与通信决策。
AI.motivation: 多人类多机器人团队需将有限且动态可用的人类支持与分布式机器人执行相协调；受限的机器-机器、人-机通信会延迟信息交换与监督干预，加剧任务分配耦合难度。
AI.method: 提出CommHG，以受信息可用性与信息时效（age）约束的局部图表示人-机器人-任务耦合交互；通过学习通信动作让机器人决定何时向哪位操作员查询、何时与同伴共享信息；采用协作式多智能体强化学习联合优化分配与通信；并构建包含异构人类与机器人、动态任务与运行状态、受限通信链路的基准。
AI.result: 在最多16机器人、6人类、112任务的异构团队实验中，随着协调规模增大，CommHG提升了及时加权任务完成度，在Large场景中优于最强基线。
AI.conclusion: CommHG验证了将通信决策与任务分配联合学习的有效性，可提升大规模异构MH-MR团队在受限通信下的协调性能。

title: Fusion Under Component Failure: Negative Results and Failure Modes in Ensemble AI-Generated Image Detection
summary:
We built an ordinary stacking ensemble for AI-generated image detection -- three open detectors producing five scores, fused by a gradient-boosted meta-learner that treats a detector's failure as missing data -- deployed it, and then evaluated it against three controls it should have faced first. This paper reports what the controls found, including where they overturned our own earlier conclusions.
  Fusion is worth its cost only when refitted on the target domain. The shipped meta-learner, fitted on a separate corpus, does not beat its best single member on 2000 StyleGAN faces (AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961; McNemar p = 1.000). But a stacker refitted in-domain beats that member plus a post-hoc calibrator (Delta-AUC = +0.0025, [+0.0014, +0.0038]; p = 3.4e-4). An earlier draft claimed the calibrated single detector won outright; that comparison mixed regimes and we correct it here.
  One corpus is not an evaluation. On 80 screenshots every model's AUC interval contains 0.5. We can say nothing stronger: the difference between the ensemble's drop and its best member's is [-0.185, +0.115].
  Abstention is real, correlated, and mishandled. With four of five detectors silent and the survivor reporting "real", the system returns P(AI) = 0.9985, because an all-NaN input scores 0.9995 in a learner never fitted with missingness. The three AIDE checkpoints fail together, sharing one preprocessing path. A quorum rule requiring two distinct architectures prevents both failures with no retraining.
  We also find Corpus A carries a class-conditional JPEG bias severe enough to separate the classes from the header alone, which limits every in-domain number we report. Code, harness, hash-identified artifacts and all corrections are released.

AI.tldr: 该论文对一个AI生成图像检测的堆叠集成系统进行了三类对照检验，发现融合仅在目标域重拟合时有效、单语料评估不可靠、弃权机制被误处理，并指出Corpus A存在类别相关的JPEG偏置。
AI.motivation: 作者已构建并部署了一个AI生成图像检测的堆叠集成系统，但意识到它未经应有的对照检验。论文动机是报告这些对照实验的结果，包括推翻了作者自己早期结论的发现。
AI.method: 构建由三个开放检测器（产生五个分数）和一个梯度提升元学习器（将检测器失败视为缺失数据）组成的堆叠集成；随后进行三项对照检验：(1)域内重拟合的堆叠器与最佳单成员及事后校准器对比，(2)80张截图上的AUC区间评估，(3)弃权与缺失数据处理及法定人数规则测试，并分析Corpus A的JPEG偏置。
AI.result: 在2000张StyleGAN人脸上市售元学习器未能超越最佳单成员（AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961，McNemar p=1.000）；域内重拟合的堆叠器则胜过最佳成员加事后校准器（Delta-AUC=+0.0025，[+0.0014,+0.0038]，p=3.4e-4）。80张截图上所有模型AUC区间含0.5，集成与最佳成员下降差为[-0.185,+0.115]。五检测器中四个静默且幸存者报"real"时，系统因全NaN输入返回P(AI)=0.9985；三个AIDE检查点因共享预处理路径同时失败。要求两种不同架构的法定人数规则可在不重训练下防止两类失败。Corpus A存在足以仅凭文件头区分类别的类别相关JPEG偏置。
AI.conclusion: 融合仅在被目标域重拟合时才值得成本；单一语料不足以作为评估；弃权是真实、相关且被误处理的；Corpus A的JPEG偏置限制了所有域内报告数字。代码、测试框架、哈希标识的构件及全部修正已公开。论文还修正了早期草稿中将不同情形混为一谈的比较结论。

title: Learning Geometry-Aware Virtual Fixtures From Sparse Demonstrations
summary: In many teleoperation applications, collecting a large number of demonstrations as required for traditional probabilistic learning from demonstration (LfD) approaches may not be feasible. To still give operators the ability to intuitively create trajectories as Virtual Fixtures (VFs), we propose to leverage a motion prior in the learning process. Particularly, by using Linear Quadratic Tracking (LQT), users are able to define guiding trajectories from the demonstration of just a few via points. To account for orientation guidance, we further reformulate classical LQT on Riemannian manifolds, introducing an additional geometric prior. Through a probabilistic interpretation of the LQT solution, we derive a covariance estimate at each trajectory point which we use to modulate the stiffness of the resulting fixture, resulting in strong guidance around the via points and softer guidance when far away. The covariance information is also used to define a validity region of the fixture, allowing the operator to leave its influence area and conduct unmodeled tasks. We evaluate the proposed Riemannian LQT formulation in a set of toy examples and the full framework on a cutting task requiring high precision in a minimally invasive surgery setting on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于运动先验的虚拟夹具生成方法，通过黎曼流形上的线性二次跟踪（LQT）从少量示教点生成轨迹，并利用概率协方差调节刚度与有效区域，在dVRK手术切割任务中验证了其高精度引导能力。
AI.motivation: 传统基于概率的示教学习（LfD）通常需要大量示教数据，但在许多遥操作应用中难以收集如此多的演示。作者希望仍能让操作者以直观方式创建作为虚拟夹具（VF）的轨迹，因此引入运动先验以减少所需示教量并保持操作的直观性。
AI.method: 方法上，采用线性二次跟踪（LQT）使用户仅通过少量via点即可定义引导轨迹；为处理姿态引导，将经典LQT重新构造到黎曼流形上，引入额外几何先验；对LQT解进行概率解释，在轨迹每一点推导协方差估计，用于调节虚拟夹具刚度（via点附近强引导、远离时柔和），并用协方差定义夹具有效区域，使操作者可离开影响区域执行未建模任务。
AI.result: 作者在一组玩具示例中评估了所提出的黎曼LQT公式，并在达芬奇研究套件（dVRK）上进行了需要高精度微创手术切割任务的完整框架实验，验证了方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入运动与几何先验，该方法能够在少量示教下生成直观且可概率调节刚度的虚拟夹具，并支持操作者自由离开夹具区域，在微创手术等高精度遥操作任务中具有良好的应用前景。

title: Dimension-Specific Imbalance and an Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy for Multi-Task Affective State Recognition in Classroom Video
summary: Recognition of student affective states from classroom video is constrained by a class imbalance problem whose true nature is, we argue, under-analyzed. We show that on DAiSEE -- the de facto benchmark for this task -- class imbalance is fundamentally a dimension-specific phenomenon: raw imbalance ratios reach as high as approximately 79:1 (Frustration), and the structure of imbalance -- not only its magnitude -- varies across dimensions, so uniform algorithmic treatments (aggressive class reweighting, focal loss, uniform binary simplification) fail in dimension-dependent ways. We propose the Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy (AHLS), which assigns four-level classification to dimensions with manageable imbalance and binary classification to severely long-tailed dimensions, coupled with a null-class placeholder mechanism that stabilizes multi-task optimization by compressing the maximum effective inverse-frequency weight ratio from as high as ~79$\times$ to at most ~8.5$\times$ across the four dimensions. Validated on a lightweight FERShuffleNetV2 + LTCN architecture (0.39 M parameters, 0.07 G FLOPs), the strategy attains the highest mean Macro-F1 of 47.70% across all four affective dimensions among 11 compared methods, including five state-of-the-art deep models (up to 167$\times$ larger) and five traditional machine-learning baselines. A cross-model behavioral analysis on DAiSEE indicates that, in this setting, classification strategy may influence minority-state recognition more strongly than further backbone scaling alone. We also report evidence of an annotation-density limitation of DAiSEE on minority affective states, which suggests that benchmark design may bound future progress as much as algorithmic refinement. Index Terms Affective computing, classroom video analysis, class imbalance, multi-task learning, lightweight deep learning, DAiSEE, engagement recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文指出DAiSEE基准上的类别不平衡本质上是"维度特异性"现象，提出自适应混合标签策略（AHLS），在轻量模型上取得最优平均Macro-F1。
AI.motivation: 课堂视频中学生情感状态识别受类别不平衡制约，而现有分析低估了其真实性质：不平衡不仅是幅度问题，其结构与幅度均随维度变化，导致统一的算法处理（如激进重加权、focal loss、统一二值简化）以维度依赖的方式失效。
AI.method: 提出自适应混合标签策略（AHLS）：对不平衡可控的维度采用四级分类，对严重长尾维度采用二值分类；并引入零类占位符机制，将最大有效逆频权重比从约79×压缩至至多约8.5×，从而稳定多任务优化。基于轻量架构FERShuffleNetV2 + LTCN（0.39M参数，0.07G FLOPs）验证。
AI.result: 在四个情感维度上取得最高平均Macro-F1 47.70%，优于11种对比方法（含5个SOTA深度模型，最大达其167×规模，以及5个传统机器学习基线）。跨模型行为分析表明，在此设定下分类策略对少数类识别的影响可能强于单纯扩大骨干网络。此外发现DAiSEE在少数情感状态上存在标注密度局限。
AI.conclusion: 类别不平衡应按维度差异化处理；分类策略设计可能比模型规模扩展更关键；同时基准数据集的标注密度可能同样限制未来进展，提示基准设计对性能上限的约束。

title: TriDrive: Joint Driver, Vehicle, and Road Modeling for Forecasting and Driver Monitoring
comment: 32 pages (10-page main text plus appendices), 4 figures, 25 tables. Under review. Code, checkpoints, and demo video: https://huggingface.co/HenryYHW/TriDrive
summary: Predicting how drivers, vehicles, and road scenes interact and evolve together is central to driver monitoring. Prior work models in-cabin activity or traffic-conditioned driver motion in isolation, motivating joint driver, vehicle, and road modeling with real-time on-vehicle evaluation. We introduce TriDrive, to our knowledge the first unified framework that jointly forecasts driver kinematics, vehicle dynamics, and road demands through an automation-conditioned transition model. Modality-specific encoders (an anchored kinematic representation of the driver, causal CAN-bus dynamics, and frozen V-JEPA 2 road latents with structured road margins) are connected by directed residual connections through which driver and road context refine vehicle forecasts. We evaluate TriDrive on three downstream tasks. On the public AIDE benchmark, its kinematic encoder recipe sets a new full-set state of the art (SOTA) among published baselines (48.05 versus 71.47 All-MPJPE). On 197.2 hours of naturalistic BATON subset, directed connections and road margins raise assistance-engaged PR-AUC by 0.084 for steering onset and 0.286 for time-to-collision drops. For real-time use, we distill the road encoders and run TriDrive on a comma four with an external 8 GB GPU, where a lightweight current-state warning probe updates at 5 Hz with 177 ms p95 latency while the joint model forecasts concurrently. The probe is above an openpilot-based baseline on human-labeled manual-driving warnings (AUROC 0.725 versus 0.563), and in a paired on-road study 14 drivers rate its warnings as more appropriate (+1.79) and timely (+2.67) than those of openpilot's driver-monitoring system.

AI.tldr: 提出TriDrive统一框架，联合预测驾驶员运动学、车辆动力学与道路需求，并在车载实时场景中验证其有效性与实用性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将车内活动或交通条件下的驾驶员运动分开建模，缺少对驾驶员、车辆与道路三者交互演化的联合建模，且需要支持车载实时评估。
AI.method: 构建自动化条件驱动的转移模型，使用模态专属编码器：驾驶员锚定运动学表示、因果CAN总线动力学、冻结V-JEPA 2道路潜变量及结构化道路边界，并通过有向残差连接让驾驶员与道路上下文细化车辆预测；同时蒸馏道路编码器以支持实时部署。
AI.result: 在AIDE基准上运动学编码方案达到全数据集SOTA（All-MPJPE 48.05 vs 71.47）；在BATON 197.2小时子集上，有向连接与道路边界使转向起始PR-AUC提升0.084、碰撞时间下降提升0.286；在comma four加外置8GB GPU上，轻量预警探针以5Hz更新、p95延迟177ms，AUROC 0.725优于openpilot基线0.563；14名驾驶员实车配对研究中，警告适当性(+1.79)与及时性(+2.67)评分更高。
AI.conclusion: TriDrive是首个联合预测驾驶员、车辆与道路的统一框架，既在离线基准上取得领先，也展示了车载实时预警的可行性与用户认可度。

title: EgoTSR++: Egocentric Spatiotemporal Reasoning for Task Progress Understanding
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in static visual understanding, yet remain unreliable when judging how an egocentric task is progressing. Given a task instruction and two visual observations, a model should determine which state is closer to the goal by analyzing task-relevant object configurations and spatial relations, rather than relying on timestamps or presentation order. This distinction is critical in manipulation, where retries, corrective actions, and temporary regressions make progress inherently non-monotonic. We introduce EgoTSR, a unified framework for diagnosing and improving order-robust task-progress understanding. First, SpatialLogic-Bench evaluates each physical state pair in both original and order-swapped presentations across short- and long-horizon settings, exposing whether a model follows task-state evidence or chronological shortcuts. Second, our data construction pipeline converts successful, approximately monotonic manipulation and first-person trajectories into bidirectional supervision; LongTag further preserves intermediate subtask structure for long-horizon comparison, while failure-aware data extend learning to regressions and recoveries. Third, a progressive CoT-to-Tag curriculum first supervises evidence-grounded interpretation of task-relevant state changes and then consolidates the comparison rule through scalable label-only training. Experiments reveal substantial input-order bias in representative VLMs. EgoTSR achieves 92.4% long-horizon accuracy with a 0.1-point forward-inverse Gap. Failure-aware supervision further improves accuracy on non-monotonic trajectories by 11.8 points and Recovery Accuracy by 11.2 points, while maintaining broad visual and spatial capabilities. These results establish goal-conditioned state comparison as an explicit formulation of egocentric spatiotemporal reasoning for task-progress understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EgoTSR 框架，用于诊断并改进视觉语言模型在第一人称任务进度理解中的顺序鲁棒性问题，通过基准测试、数据构建与课程学习显著提升长时程与非单调轨迹下的准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在静态视觉理解上进展迅速，但在判断第一人称任务进度时不可靠。模型往往依赖时间戳或呈现顺序等时间捷径，而非基于任务相关物体配置与空间关系进行判断。在操作任务中，重试、纠正动作和暂时退步使进度天然非单调，因此基于目标状态的比较能力尤为关键。
AI.method: 提出统一框架 EgoTSR，包含三部分：(1) SpatialLogic-Bench，对每个物理状态对在原始与顺序交换两种呈现下、覆盖短时程与长时程设置进行评估，检验模型是否依据任务状态证据而非时间捷径；(2) 数据构建流程，将成功且近似单调的操作与第一人称轨迹转为双向监督，LongTag 保留中间子任务结构以支持长时程比较，失败感知数据扩展到退步与恢复情形；(3) 渐进式 CoT-to-Tag 课程，先监督基于证据的任务相关状态变化解读，再通过可扩展的仅标签训练巩固比较规则。
AI.result: 实验揭示代表性 VLM 存在明显的输入顺序偏差。EgoTSR 取得 92.4% 的长时程准确率，前向-逆向差距仅 0.1 点；失败感知监督使非单调轨迹准确率提升 11.8 点，恢复准确率提升 11.2 点，同时保持广泛的视觉与空间能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将目标条件下的状态比较作为第一人称时空推理的显式形式，可有效支撑任务进度理解。

title: CAPEX: Efficiently Distilling Foundation Model Behavior into Deployable Robot Policies through Experience-Adaptive Reasoning
summary: Robot learning has largely relied on human-teleoperated demonstrations to acquire effective learnable behaviors. However, human-operated data collection processes can be unintuitive, difficult to scale, and inherently asynchronous. We explore an alternative: distilling physical behavior from general-purpose multimodal foundation models into deployable robot policies by using the foundation model itself as an autonomous demonstrator. While sufficiently capable models can generate successful zero-shot manipulation trajectories, repeatedly invoking them during physical execution is slow and expensive, limiting their utility as scalable data generators. As a solution, we introduce CAPEX, an experience-conditioned demonstration collection framework that uses execution experience from previous attempts to adapt how frequently the foundation model must observe, reason, and replan. We evaluate across RoboCasa tasks and on physical Franka and bimanual YAM-arm platforms, measuring task success, model calls, token usage, collection time, and cost. We further train Diffusion Policy and ACT on matched sets of human-teleoperated and foundation-model-generated demonstrations to evaluate the downstream learning value of autonomously collected data. We find that CAPEX increases the number of successful demonstrations by 4.3x while reducing the cost per successful demonstration by 80%. Policies trained on CAPEX-generated data approach the performance of those trained on matched human demonstrations; with longer training, this gap largely closes for policies trained from scratch. These results suggest that foundation models can serve as scalable sources of reusable robot experience. Project page: https://capex-paper.github.io/

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAPEX框架，用通用多模态基础模型作为自主演示者，通过执行经验自适应调节重规划频率，高效采集机器人演示数据，成本降低80%且下游策略性能接近人工演示。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习长期依赖人工遥操作演示，该过程不直观、难以规模化且本质异步。虽然基础模型能生成成功的零样本操作轨迹，但在物理执行中反复调用它们速度慢、成本高，限制了其作为可扩展数据生成器的实用性。
AI.method: 提出CAPEX——一种经验条件化的演示采集框架，利用先前尝试的执行经验来自适应地调整基础模型进行观察、推理和重规划的频率。在RoboCasa任务以及物理Franka和双臂YAM平台进行评估，并训练Diffusion Policy与ACT对比人工遥操作与基础模型生成数据的学习价值。
AI.result: CAPEX将成功演示数量提升4.3倍，同时将每条成功演示的成本降低80%。在CAPEX生成数据上训练的策略性能接近匹配的人工演示策略；随着训练时间延长，从零训练的策略差距基本消失。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型可作为可复用机器人经验的可扩展来源。

title: Calibration-Free Surface Normals Estimation in Vision-Based Tactile Sensing using Universal Photometric Stereo
summary: Vision-based tactile sensors are a popular solution for capturing rich contact surface geometry. However, to obtain high-detail contact surface normals and depth, it is necessary to calibrate the sensor by physically pressing a probe with known geometry against the sensor elastomer and mapping tactile images onto the ground truth probe's shape. This approach does not scale across different tactile sensors, and the calibration effort can be complex depending on the sensor shape and optical system. Instead, we propose a calibration-free procedure for the estimation of contact surface normals using Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks. In a series of real-world experiments, we evaluate our approach on 3 sensors with different optical systems, demonstrating that universal methods are a suitable approach for estimating surface normals at the contact patch from tactile images, thereby alleviating the need for tactile sensor calibration. Controlled experiments with a metal ball show that universal methods match the calibrated method, with a mean angular error of $6.56^{\Large\circ}$. We show that the proposed framework recovers high-frequency surface details of objects with natural textures, achieving an overall mean angular error of $10.66^{\Large\circ}$. Universal method robustly recovers the contact surface normals captured with dome-shaped Digit 360, achieving a low angular discrepancy of $10.18^{\Large\circ}$ relative to the calibrated baseline. This experiment demonstrates that with sufficient illumination settings surface normals could be estimated using a model trained solely on synthetic data. By providing a unified representation of contact surfaces across different vision-based tactile sensor designs, Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks lay the foundation for transferable tactile perception across sensors.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需标定的通用光度立体（Universal Photometric Stereo）方法，可直接从视触觉图像估计接触表面法向，免除传统探针标定流程，并在多种传感器上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 视触觉传感器要获得高精度接触表面法向与深度，通常需用已知几何探针按压弹性体并建立图像到真值形状的映射，标定繁琐且难以在不同传感器间迁移。作者希望找到一种可跨传感器通用的免标定方案。
AI.method: 采用通用光度立体神经网络，仅依赖合成数据训练，直接从触觉图像估计接触区域表面法向，无需针对具体传感器做物理标定。
AI.result: 在3种不同光学系统的传感器上开展真实实验：金属球对照实验中与标定方法相当，平均角度误差6.56°；对具有自然纹理的物体可恢复高频表面细节，整体平均角度误差10.66°；在圆顶形Digit 360上与标定基线差异为10.18°。
AI.conclusion: 通用光度立体方法无需标定即可稳健估计接触表面法向，在足够照明条件下可仅用合成数据训练模型，为跨不同视触觉传感器设计的可迁移触觉感知提供了统一表示基础。

title: Is Online Interaction Necessary for Recovery? A Minimalist Approach to Robust Planning via Perturbation
summary: Behavior cloning (BC) is vulnerable to covariate shift during closed-loop execution, where small prediction or execution errors can drive the robot toward states poorly covered by the demonstration data. We focus on action-sequence planning, where a policy predicts a finite-horizon sequence of actions as a reference trajectory for robot execution. Existing approaches to covariate shift often rely on collecting additional corrective demonstrations, requiring further environment interaction and access to an expert or reference policy. We propose Perturbation-Augmented Recovery Supervision (PARS), a simple training approach for improving recovery using only existing demonstrations. PARS perturbs the robot's proprioceptive state and anchors only the later portion of the predicted trajectory to the original demonstration, leaving the earlier portion free to generate corrective motion and recover toward the demonstrated behavior within the planning horizon. Unlike conventional input-noise augmentation, which preserves the original supervision target over the entire prediction horizon, PARS explicitly provides trajectory-level supervision for recovery from perturbed states. PARS requires neither additional environment interaction nor expert queries and can be instantiated across different action-sequence policy classes with only minor modifications to their BC objectives. Experiments on 51 RLBench manipulation tasks with flow-based, transformer-based, and diffusion-based policies demonstrate that PARS improves robustness to covariate shift during closed-loop execution.

AI.tldr: 提出PARS训练方法，仅用现有演示数据，通过扰动本体状态并只锚定预测轨迹后段，为动作序列策略提供轨迹级恢复监督，提升闭环执行中的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆在闭环执行中易受协变量偏移影响，微小预测或执行误差会使机器人进入演示数据覆盖不足的状态。现有方法多依赖额外收集纠正演示，需要更多环境交互以及专家或参考策略。
AI.method: PARS扰动机器人的本体感知状态，仅将预测轨迹的后段锚定到原始演示，前段保持自由以生成纠正动作，从而在规划时域内恢复至演示行为。不同于传统输入噪声增强（在整个预测时域保留原始监督目标），PARS显式提供针对扰动状态的轨迹级恢复监督。该方法无需额外环境交互或专家查询，仅需对行为克隆目标做小幅修改即可适配不同动作序列策略。
AI.result: 在RLBench的51个操作任务上，针对基于流、基于Transformer和基于扩散的策略，PARS均提升了闭环执行中对协变量偏移的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: PARS是一种简单有效的训练策略，仅利用已有演示即可为动作序列策略提供恢复监督，具备跨策略类别的通用性，能增强闭环执行鲁棒性。

title: Gauge-Equivariant Attention for Rotation-Stable $360^\circ$ Scene Understanding
comment: 23 pages. Accepted to ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026)
summary: Panoramic $360^\circ$ scene understanding increasingly relies on icosphere transformers, but a state-of-the-art spherical model loses more than half of its segmentation accuracy when the camera rotates by $90^\circ$, and controlled ablations identify gauge dependence in its relative-position bias as a major contributor. We propose gauge-equivariant relative position encoding (GE-RPE): a parameter-free Reynolds average of the bias over a finite cyclic subgroup $C_n\!\subset\!\mathrm{SO}(2)$ of gauge rotations. Plugged into a SphereUFormer backbone the change is invisible at deployment---zero added parameters and $1.5$--$4.4\%$ forward latency---and the matched three-seed GE-RPE model records a $1.3\%$ drop; the published SphereUFormer checkpoint records $53\%$ under the same stress protocol but a different training recipe. Once the gauge defect is removed and a teacher-token permutation $π_R$ aligns the SSL views to the rotated student frame, iBOT$+$MAE pretraining stops being a liability and becomes a clean low-label lever: the full framework EquiSSL (GE-RPE $+$ $π_R$ $+$ iBOT$+$MAE) tightens the drop to $0.8\%$ at $68.30\%$ val mIoU and lifts $1\%$-label fine-tuning by $+2.39$ mIoU on the $N{=}373$ test split (and by $+4.10$ on the smaller $N{=}40$ val split); the same fix carries over to monocular depth and to zero-shot Structured3D segmentation. The construction is provably $C_n$-invariant and $\mathcal{O}(n^{-2})$-close to the continuous $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ average, making the resulting model a usable $360^\circ$ visual-computing primitive across panoramic relighting, immersive video, and cross-dataset transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaywalk18/equissl-release.

AI.tldr: 论文提出无参数的规范等变相对位置编码GE-RPE（在有限循环子群C_n上做Reynolds平均），消除球面Transformer的规范依赖，结合教师token置换π_R与iBOT+MAE预训练形成EquiSSL框架，显著提升360°全景分割的旋转鲁棒性与低标注性能。
AI.motivation: 全景360°场景理解日益依赖icosphere transformer，但先进球面模型在相机旋转90°时损失超过一半的分割精度；受控消融实验表明，其相对位置偏置的规范依赖（gauge dependence）是主要原因。作者希望消除该规范缺陷，使模型在旋转下保持等变性，并改善自监督预训练与低标注迁移表现。
AI.method: 提出规范等变相对位置编码（GE-RPE）：对规范旋转的有限循环子群C_n⊂SO(2)上的偏置做无参数Reynolds平均，可证明具有C_n不变性且以O(n^{-2})逼近连续SO(2)平均。将其插入SphereUFormer骨干，并引入教师token置换π_R，将SSL视图对齐到旋转后的学生帧，从而组合出EquiSSL框架（GE-RPE + π_R + iBOT+MAE预训练）。
AI.result: GE-RPE部署零新增参数，前向延迟仅增加1.5–4.4%；三种子匹配模型精度下降仅1.3%，而已发布SphereUFormer检查点在同压力协议下下降53%。EquiSSL将下降收窄至0.8%，val mIoU达68.30%；在N=373测试集上1%标注微调提升+2.39 mIoU（N=40验证集提升+4.10）。该修复同样适用于单目深度估计与零样本Structured3D分割。
AI.conclusion: 通过消除规范缺陷并对齐SSL视图，iBOT+MAE预训练从负担转变为干净的低标注提升杠杆；该构建使模型成为可用于全景重光照、沉浸式视频与跨数据集迁移的360°视觉计算原语。代码已开源。

title: SwingRL: Adaptive Observation Reinforcement Learning with World-Model Prediction for Cable-Suspended Hoisting Control
summary: Cable-suspended hoisting is widely used to move heavy or bulky payloads that cannot be handled conveniently by rigid pick-and-place systems, for example in crane-assisted construction. Robotic hoisting using flexible cables is challenging because payload motion is underactuated, external disturbances vary, and delayed or lost visual observations can make the perceived payload state stale at control execution. These effects are particularly critical during precise insertion of a suspended payload's sockets onto rebar pins, which is a very common task in construction environments. We present SwingRL, a residual reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that combines an age-aware world model, a classical anti-swing prior, and a recurrent residual policy to address two coupled problems: stale feedback and uncertain dynamics. The world model propagates the newest received payload observation to the current control step using the executed commands, providing a time-aligned state estimate under delayed and lossy sensing. The prior supplies nominal tracking and swing damping. The residual policy learns bounded corrections to the prior rather than the complete control law, compensating for system-parameter variation, external disturbances, and remaining state-estimation errors. We evaluate SwingRL against classical and learning-based baselines across a cumulative difficulty ladder covering system-parameter variation, wind disturbance, degraded sensing, and strong gusts. Under the most difficult setting, SwingRL achieves 69.5% strict and 77.3% broad success, exceeding all baselines by at least 60 percentage points, respectively. World-model ablations support the role of time-aligned state estimation in maintaining insertion success as observation loss increases. Finally, without real-robot fine-tuning, SwingRL achieves 90% success on the physical rig.

AI.tldr: 提出 SwingRL 残差强化学习框架，结合年龄感知世界模型、经典抗摆先验与循环残差策略，解决缆索吊装插入中的反馈陈旧与动力学不确定问题，仿真最难关卡成功率 69.5%，实物验证 90%。
AI.motivation: 缆索吊装广泛应用于起重机辅助施工中搬运刚性系统难以处理的重型或笨重载荷。其难点在于：载荷运动欠驱动、外部扰动多变、视觉观测延迟或丢失导致控制执行时感知到的载荷状态已过时。这些问题在将悬吊载荷的套筒精确插装到钢筋销钉上时尤为关键，而该任务在施工环境中极为常见。
AI.method: SwingRL 是一种残差强化学习框架，包含三个组件：(1) 年龄感知世界模型，利用已执行指令将最新接收到的载荷观测传播到当前控制步，在延迟和有损感知下提供时间对齐的状态估计；(2) 经典抗摆先验，提供标称跟踪与摆动阻尼；(3) 循环残差策略，学习对先验的有界修正而非完整控制律，以补偿系统参数变化、外部扰动及残余状态估计误差。
AI.result: 在涵盖系统参数变化、风扰、感知退化和强阵风的累积难度阶梯上，与经典及学习型基线对比：最困难设置下实现 69.5% 严格成功率和 77.3% 宽泛成功率，分别超出所有基线至少 60 个百分点。世界模型消融实验支持时间对齐状态估计在观测丢失增加时维持插入成功率的作用。无需真实机器人微调，在物理实验平台上达到 90% 成功率。
AI.conclusion: SwingRL 通过世界模型的时间对齐估计、抗摆先验与残差策略的协同，有效应对感知延迟/丢失与动力学不确定性，在仿真难例与实物平台均显著优于基线，且具备从仿真到现实的零微调迁移能力。

title: 3dgs-sc: a controlled static screen-content benchmark for 3d gaussian splatting
summary: Does high image fidelity imply readable screen content in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)? We introduce 3DGS-SC, a controlled static screen-content dataset and benchmark for examining this mismatch. Ten procedural scenes provide fixed multi-view splits, exact cameras, screen masks, text boxes, and transcripts. The protocol separates whole-image fidelity, screen-region fidelity, OCR readability, and edge preservation. In the reported five-method comparison, LightGaussian exceeds Mip-Splatting in screen PSNR by only 0.08 dB, yet trails it in OCR accuracy by 12.7 percentage points. Across all ten method pairs, screen-PSNR and OCR orderings disagree in seven cases. These aggregate results expose a method-selection failure of fidelity-only evaluation. Complementing prior text-aware 3DGS research, 3DGS-SC targets controlled monitor interfaces and exact annotations; scene-wise robustness and acquisition effects remain open validation questions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出3DGS-SC，一个用于研究3D高斯泼溅中图像保真度与屏幕内容可读性不匹配问题的受控静态屏幕内容数据集与基准，揭示仅以保真度评估方法会导致方法选择失误。
AI.motivation: 高图像保真度是否意味着3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）中屏幕内容可读？现有评估多依赖保真度指标，可能无法反映屏幕文本等内容的实际可读性，存在评估盲区。
AI.method: 构建3DGS-SC受控静态屏幕内容数据集与基准：包含10个程序化场景，提供固定多视角划分、精确相机参数、屏幕掩码、文本框与文字转录。评估协议将整体图像保真度、屏幕区域保真度、OCR可读性与边缘保持分开考察，并进行五种方法的对比。
AI.result: 在五方法对比中，LightGaussian在屏幕PSNR上仅比Mip-Splatting高0.08 dB，但OCR准确率低12.7个百分点；在全部十组方法配对中，屏幕PSNR与OCR排序有七组不一致。
AI.conclusion: 聚合结果暴露了仅用保真度评估的“方法选择失败”问题。3DGS-SC补充了既有文本感知3DGS研究，面向受控显示器界面与精确标注；但场景级鲁棒性与采集效应仍有待验证。

title: REALM: A Coarse-to-Fine Generative Framework for Embodied Reactive Listening
summary:
Generating responsive listener facial motion is an important task for embodied conversational AI. Two modeling challenges are central: accounting for the timing of speaker cues while maintaining continuity with the listener's ongoing motion, and capturing locally variable facial events alongside the overall motion trajectory. Listener responses may follow preceding cues with a temporal lag, while brief expressions and blinks introduce variation that is difficult to predict deterministically. These challenges motivate a framework that combines history-aware temporal alignment with stochastic expression refinement. We propose REALM (Reactive Embodied Audio-driven Listening Model), a coarse-to-fine framework for audio-driven reactive listening. A Reactive Gated Speaker-Listener Fusion module combines listener motion history with speaker audio through a delay-centered attention prior and adaptive gating. A coarse decoder predicts a base motion trajectory, which is augmented by audio-conditioned stochastic residuals in the expression subspace while retaining the coarse pose parameters. Evaluations on ViCo and L2L show improvements over the evaluated baselines across multiple motion-quality metrics. Additional analyses examine delay sensitivity, gate behavior, and blink dynamics. Finally, deployment on an Ameca humanoid robot and a perceptual user study demonstrate the applicability of the generated behavior to physical embodiment.
  Code: https://github.com/lipzh5/REALM Demo: https://youtu.be/Tf5mpd5S8VQ

AI.tldr: 提出 REALM 粗到细框架，结合历史感知时间对齐与随机表情细化，实现音频驱动的响应式听者面部动作生成。
AI.motivation: 生成响应式听者面部动作对具身对话 AI 很重要。两个核心建模挑战：需在保持听者动作连续性的同时考虑说话者线索的时间性；需在整体运动轨迹之外捕捉局部可变的面部事件。听者反应可能滞后于先前线索，短暂表情与眨眼带来难以确定性预测的变化。
AI.method: REALM（Reactive Embodied Audio-driven Listening Model）为粗到细框架。Reactive Gated Speaker-Listener Fusion 模块通过以延迟为中心的注意力先验与自适应门控，将听者动作历史与说话者音频融合。粗解码器预测基础运动轨迹，再在表情子空间中用音频条件的随机残差增强，同时保留粗姿态参数。
AI.result: 在 ViCo 与 L2L 数据集上，多个运动质量指标相较所评估基线均有提升。额外分析考察延迟敏感性、门控行为与眨眼动态。在 Ameca 人形机器人上部署并进行感知用户研究，验证生成行为可用于物理具身。
AI.conclusion: REALM 通过历史感知时间对齐与随机表情细化的结合，有效生成响应式听者面部动作，并在数据集评测、机器人部署与用户研究中得到验证。

title: HGPTrans: Hierarchical Graph-Pooling Transolver for Automotive Aerodynamic Drag Coefficient Prediction
summary: Accurate and rapid prediction of the aerodynamic drag coefficient ($C_D$) is essential for vehicle design, particularly during early-stage styling iterations where a large number of candidate geometries must be evaluated. Although computational fluid dynamics (CFD) provides reliable aerodynamic estimates, its high computational cost, typically requiring hours to days for a single configuration, limits its use in large-scale design exploration. This paper proposes HGPTrans, a hierarchical graph-pooling network with Transolver-based attention, to directly predict $C_D$ from vehicle surface meshes. Motivated by the fact that vehicle aerodynamics depends on both local geometric features and long-range interactions among spatially distant surface regions, HGPTrans integrates three complementary components. Graph isomorphism convolutions encode discriminative local geometry, physics-aware slice attention captures global interactions with linear computational complexity, and information-redundancy-aware hierarchical pooling progressively removes redundant nodes while preserving informative geometric structures. The model is trained and evaluated on the large-scale DrivAerNet and DrivAerNet++ datasets, where it achieves the lowest mean absolute error and mean squared error among the evaluated baselines. Its generalization capability is further assessed through transfer learning on a real-vehicle dataset containing both sedans and SUVs, achieving relative $L_1$ errors of 1.56% (sedans) and 2.12% (SUVs) with an inference time of approximately $0.293$ s per vehicle. This corresponds to an acceleration of several orders of magnitude relative to high-fidelity CFD while keeping the predicted drag coefficients within a few percent of the CFD reference. Ablation studies confirm each component's contribution and reveal the effects of depth and pooling ratio.

AI.tldr: 提出HGPTrans，一种分层图池化结合Transolver注意力的网络，从车辆表面网格直接预测空气阻力系数，在DrivAerNet数据集上取得最低误差，并具良好泛化性。
AI.motivation: 车辆造型早期迭代需评估大量几何候选，而高保真CFD计算成本极高（单次需数小时至数天），难以支撑大规模设计探索，因此需要快速准确的C_D预测方法。
AI.method: HGPTrans整合三个组件：图同构卷积编码局部几何特征；物理感知切片注意力以线性复杂度捕获全局长程交互；信息冗余感知的分层池化逐步去除冗余节点并保留有效几何结构。在DrivAerNet与DrivAerNet++上训练评估，并通过真实车辆数据集（轿车与SUV）进行迁移学习验证。
AI.result: 在所评估基线中取得最低MAE与MSE；迁移学习下相对L1误差为轿车1.56%、SUV 2.12%，单车辆推理时间约0.293秒，相比高保真CFD加速数个数量级且预测值误差仅百分之几。消融实验验证各组件贡献并揭示深度与池化比例的影响。
AI.conclusion: HGPTrans能高效准确预测车辆空气阻力系数，兼顾局部与全局特征，具备强泛化能力与极高推理效率，可支撑大规模车辆设计探索。

title: Humanoids for Robot-Assisted Surgery: Bimanual Base Placement and Tool-Mount Optimization via Capability Maps
summary: Rapid advances in humanoid robotics have motivated growing interest in the application of humanoids for healthcare and clinical tasks.
