However, it remains unclear how close contemporary humanoids are to meeting the kinematic demands of robot-assisted laparoscopic surgery. In this work, we address the question of optimal robot positioning through a quantitative analysis of workspace and robot setup configurations. We present a capability-map-based robot setup framework that optimizes humanoid base placement and tool mounting orientation to maximize bimanual humanoid reachability while accounting for tool-tip kinematics and remote-center-of-motion (RCM) constraints. We evaluate three humanoid platforms spanning different body dimensions and kinematic redundancy on workspace reachability for three representative general surgery procedures: cholecystectomy, inguinal hernia repair, and sleeve gastrectomy. The proposed joint optimization of base placement and tool mounting consistently outperforms base-only optimization and heuristic baselines. For cholecystectomy and inguinal hernia repair, which are characterized by relatively small and minimally overlapping workspaces, humanoid reachability approached 90%. For the larger, overlapping multi-port arm workspace of sleeve gastrectomy, humanoids yield substantially lower coverage. These results quantify the near-term promise of humanoids for selected laparoscopic procedures and clarify key limitations that must be addressed for broader deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文通过能力地图框架优化人形机器人基座位置与器械安装方向，量化评估三款人形机器人对三类腹腔镜手术的工作空间可达性。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人用于医疗与临床任务的兴趣日益增长，但当代人形机器人能否满足机器人辅助腹腔镜手术的运动学需求尚不明确，尤其是最优机器人定位问题缺乏定量分析。
AI.method: 提出基于能力地图的机器人配置框架，联合优化人形机器人基座放置与器械安装朝向，在考虑器械末端运动学及远程运动中心（RCM）约束下最大化双臂可达性；对三款体型与运动冗余度不同的人形平台，在胆囊切除、腹股沟疝修补和袖状胃切除三类代表性手术上进行评估，并与仅优化基座及启发式基线对比。
AI.result: 联合优化基座与器械安装的方案持续优于仅基座优化和启发式基线；在胆囊切除和腹股沟疝修补（工作空间较小且重叠少）中可达性接近90%，而袖状胃切除的多孔重叠大工作空间中覆盖率显著较低。
AI.conclusion: 结果量化了人形机器人在特定腹腔镜手术中的近期应用前景，并明确了其更广泛部署需解决的关键限制。

title: UNMATCH: Selective Unbalanced Token-Patch Matching for Forensic Image-Claim Verification
summary: Contextual image misuse pairs an image with a misleading claim. We study image-claim correspondence in fact-checked pairs containing out-of-context reuse, visual manipulation, or both. Existing pair-based detectors often compress the two modalities into a global compatibility score or learn a highly flexible interaction module, which can obscure a decisive local mismatch. We introduce directional multiscale coverage, a compact representation that summarizes local image-claim affinity in both directions and at three spatial scales. At each scale, each direction is summarized by its mean, lower quartile, and two thresholded support ratios; the signed difference between directional means completes a nine-dimensional scale descriptor. Concatenating the three scales yields a compact local representation for a lightweight global-local classifier. Under leakage-aware three-fold, three-seed evaluation on the Snopes subset of the Fauxtography benchmark, UNMATCH achieves 69.82 Macro-F1 and 71.05 balanced accuracy, exceeding the MCOT adaptation by 2.60 and 2.16 points. A matched-reassigned intervention shows that breaking the observed pairing lowers coverage and increases both discrepancy and false-pair probability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"方向性多尺度覆盖"紧凑表示，用于图像-声明事实核查中局部不匹配的检测，在Fauxtography的Snopes子集上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图像-声明配对检测器往往将两种模态压缩为全局兼容性分数，或学习高度灵活的交互相模块，这可能掩盖决定性的局部不匹配（如断章取义或图像篡改）。
AI.method: 提出方向性多尺度覆盖表示：在三个空间尺度上、沿两个方向总结图像-声明的局部亲和性。每个尺度每个方向用均值、下四分位数和两个阈值化支持率概括，方向均值的有符号差补全为九维尺度描述子；拼接三个尺度得到紧凑局部表示，并输入轻量级全局-局部分类器（UNMATCH）。
AI.result: 在Fauxtography基准的Snopes子集上，采用防泄漏的三折三随机种子评估，UNMATCH达到69.82 Macro-F1和71.05平衡准确率，分别超过MCOT适配版2.60和2.16个点。匹配-重分配干预显示，打破原有配对会降低覆盖率并提高差异度和假配对概率。
AI.conclusion: 方向性多尺度覆盖能有效刻画图像-声明的局部对应关系，在事实核查配对检测中优于现有方法，且能敏感反映配对信息的破坏。

title: Evolving Dexterous Robots from Scratch
summary: Little is known about how to manually design agents capable of dexterous manipulation. Some design principles have been inferred from close examination of how animals manipulate objects, but these structures and behaviors have so far resisted biomimicry and may not be optimal for artificial machines. Here we evolve freeform robots to pick up, hold, rotate, and use diverse objects. Unlike other approaches to optimizing robot hands, we do not presuppose the presence, articulation, or geometry of any part of the body. Although familiar prehensile forms such as tails, beaks, paws and claws may emerge spontaneously under certain conditions--and while such conditions could be of interest to evolutionary biologists--de novo manipulator design can also reveal whole new solutions, overlooked or unknown structures which may be better suited for the task at hand. We use contrastive learning to create a highly searchable genetic embedding of design space, an autoregressive developmental model to decode designs, evolutionary strategies to find good designs, and reinforcement learning to train each evolved design. Winning designs were automatically converted into a manufacturable blueprint, printed, assembled and tested in the real world in a zero-shot manner. The results represent the state-of-the-art in evolutionary robotics in terms of performance, diversity and complexity.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过进化自由形态机器人实现抓取、握持、旋转和使用多样物体的灵巧操作，无需预设身体结构或几何形状，最终将优胜设计自动转为可制造蓝图并在真实世界中零样本测试。
AI.motivation: 目前对如何手动设计灵巧操作智能体知之甚少。尽管从动物操作物体的行为中推断出一些设计原则，但这些结构与行为难以被仿生复制，且未必适用于人工机器。因此作者希望摆脱预设结构，探索全新的操作器设计方案。
AI.method: 研究方法包括：使用对比学习构建高度可搜索的设计空间遗传嵌入；使用自回归发育模型解码设计；使用进化策略寻找优质设计；使用强化学习训练每个进化出的设计。研究不预设身体的任何部分、关节或几何结构，允许自由形态进化。
AI.result: 进化出的优胜设计被自动转换为可制造蓝图，打印、组装并在真实世界中进行零样本测试。结果在性能、多样性和复杂性方面代表了进化机器人学的最先进水平。同时，尾巴、喙、爪等熟悉的抓握形式可能在特定条件下自发涌现，也可能出现全新的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明无需预设结构即可进化出灵巧操作器，并能够发现优于仿生设计的新结构；通过结合对比学习、自回归模型、进化策略与强化学习，实现了从设计到真实制造与零样本部署的完整流程。

title: Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer
summary: Modern text-to-image models produce high-fidelity images but still struggle with compositional prompts that require instance identity, attribute ownership, counting, spatial ordering, and role-sensitive relations. We introduce Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer (PSP-DiT), a diffusion-transformer architecture that treats a panoptic scene program as a first-class latent variable rather than an external control signal or post-hoc parse. PSP-DiT jointly denoises image latents and scene-program latents through coupled transformer streams, while panoptic grounding and cycle-consistency objectives tie object instances, attributes, relations, and counts to visual support in the generated image. Under matched training and inference settings, PSP-DiT improves over a strong flat-text baseline across GenEval 2, SANEval-Simple, PSG-Score, and DetailMaster, with the largest gains on counting, attribute binding, role-sensitive relations, and long structured prompts. The method preserves image quality, adds modest inference overhead, and remains robust to imperfect scene programs.

AI.tldr: 提出PSP-DiT，将全景场景程序作为一等潜变量与图像潜变量联合去噪，提升组合式文本到图像生成的实例身份、属性归属、计数、空间顺序和角色敏感关系能力。
AI.motivation: 现代文本到图像模型虽能生成高保真图像，但在组合式提示（涉及实例身份、属性归属、计数、空间排序和角色敏感关系）上仍表现不佳。
AI.method: PSP-DiT是一种扩散-Transformer架构，将全景场景程序视为一等潜变量而非外部控制信号或事后解析。它通过耦合的Transformer流联合去噪图像潜变量和场景程序潜变量，并使用全景接地与循环一致性目标，将对象实例、属性、关系和计数与生成图像中的视觉支撑绑定。
AI.result: 在匹配的训练与推理设置下，PSP-DiT在GenEval 2、SANEval-Simple、PSG-Score和DetailMaster上均优于强flat-text基线，在计数、属性绑定、角色敏感关系和长结构化提示上提升最大。方法保持图像质量，推理开销增加适中，且对不完美的场景程序具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 将全景场景程序建模为一等潜变量并与图像联合去噪，可有效增强组合式图像生成的精确性与鲁棒性，同时保持图像质量并仅带来适度推理开销。

title: VPTwin: Real-Sim-Real Video Prediction for Robotic Manipulation Planning
summary: While action-conditioned video prediction provides an intuitive world model for robotics, purely data-driven predictors often suffer from compounding errors and physically implausible hallucinations in long-horizon rollouts, severely undermining downstream action planning. We propose VPTwin, a Real-Sim-Real video prediction framework that anchors real-world future prediction using real-synchronized simulation twins. For a target manipulation task, a VLM reconstructs an executable digital twin from a real demonstration episode. To accommodate the ill-posed estimation of unobserved physical properties, Isaac Sim simulates multiple forward dynamic rollouts across randomized physical configurations under candidate action trajectories. Using these rollouts as in-context references, VPTwin harmonizes both domains, using simulation dynamics to enforce physical plausibility while capturing unmodeled contact interactions from real video. Furthermore, we establish a predictive planning loop using VPTwin to visually verify VLM-proposed actions and guide reliable real-world execution. Evaluations show substantial reductions in physical hallucinations during video prediction and marked improvements in manipulation planning performance.

AI.tldr: 提出VPTwin，一种Real-Sim-Real视频预测框架，利用与真实同步的仿真孪生来锚定真实世界的未来预测，减少物理幻觉并提升操作规划性能。
AI.motivation: 纯数据驱动的动作条件视频预测存在误差累积和物理上不合理的幻觉问题，在长时程推演中严重影响下游动作规划，因此需要引入仿真动力学来提升物理合理性。
AI.method: 针对目标操作任务，用VLM从真实演示片段重建可执行的数字孪生；由于未观测物理属性难以估计，在Isaac Sim中对候选动作轨迹进行多组随机物理配置的前向动力学推演；将这些推演作为上下文参考，融合仿真动力学与真实视频，兼顾物理合理性并捕捉未建模的接触交互；并建立基于VPTwin的预测规划闭环以验证VLM提议动作。
AI.result: 评估显示视频预测中的物理幻觉显著减少，操作规划性能明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过Real-Sim-Real框架将仿真孪生与真实视频结合，可有效缓解物理幻觉并提升操作规划可靠性，为机器人世界模型提供了可行路径。

title: SelfCue: Making a 3D CT Report Generator Say What It Already Knows
summary: Progress in 3D CT report generation is usually sought in increasingly sophisticated architectures and larger pools of training data. We find instead that a 3D CT report generator already holds what its report leaves out, and loses it when the hidden state becomes tokens. Over the 18 CT-RATE abnormalities, this hidden-to-report surfacing gap is reflected by a drop in macro AUROC from 0.848 in the hidden states to 0.739 in the generated report. We propose SelfCue based on contrastive decoding. It promotes what the hidden state already supports and suppresses what it does not. It raises clinical efficacy F1 to 0.481 and the LLM-judged GREEN score to 0.510. Distilling that behaviour into the weights gives SelfCue-KD, a student that keeps most of the gain, needs nothing extra at inference, and drops into any pipeline already serving the baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/renjie-liang/SelfCue-CT.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现3D CT报告生成器在隐状态中已包含报告中遗漏的信息，提出自提示方法SelfCue以缩小"隐状态到报告"的落地差距，并提升报告质量。
AI.motivation: 当前3D CT报告生成的进展多依赖更复杂的架构与更大训练数据；作者转而发现生成器隐状态本已具备报告所遗漏的信息，但在隐状态转为token时丢失了这一能力。
AI.method: 基于对比解码提出SelfCue，促进隐状态已支持的内容并抑制其不支持的内容；进一步将其行为蒸馏进权重，得到SelfCue-KD学生模型。
AI.result: 在18种CT-RATE异常上，宏观AUROC从隐状态的0.848降到生成报告的0.739；SelfCue将临床效能F1提升至0.481，LLM评判GREEN分数提升至0.510；SelfCue-KD保留大部分增益。
AI.conclusion: SelfCue有效缓解隐状态到报告的落地差距，蒸馏版无需额外推理开销，可无缝嵌入现有基线管线。

title: Multi-Modal Non-Prehensile Estimation of Physical Parameters via Press-and-Pull Tipping
summary: Recovering physical properties of unknown objects through non-prehensile interaction is challenging because no single manipulation primitive reveals all relevant parameters. Planar pushing couples mass and friction, while conventional tipping cannot recover friction and may fail entirely when low-friction or curved-base objects slide or rotate instead of tipping. We introduce a multi-modal estimation framework that combines a sliding interaction with a press-and-pull tipping primitive to recover object mass, center of mass height, and surface friction. The press-and-pull interaction increases the object-table sliding threshold and stabilizes the pivot, enabling controlled tipping without any prior geometric object model. Wrist force/torque sensing, RGB-D perception, and robot proprioception are fused to estimate the physical parameters from the two complementary interaction modes. Experiments on an ABB IRB120 across four objects with varied geometry, mass, center of mass, and friction achieve low relative error, while successfully operating on curved-base objects that fail under conventional forward tipping. The results demonstrate that complementary non-prehensile interactions can recover a compact set of physical parameters without grasping, a prior object model, or learned interaction dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态非抓取交互框架，结合滑动与"按压-牵引"翻转动作，估计物体质量、质心高度和表面摩擦，无需抓取或先验模型。
AI.motivation: 单一非抓取操作难以揭示物体的全部物理参数：平面推动使质量与摩擦耦合，而传统翻转无法恢复摩擦，且对低摩擦或曲面底座物体会因滑动或旋转而完全失效。
AI.method: 融合滑动交互与"按压-牵引"（press-and-pull）翻转原语的多模态估计框架；该原语提高物体-桌面滑动阈值并稳定支点，实现无先验几何模型的可控翻转。融合腕部力/力矩传感、RGB-D 感知与机器人本体感知，从两种互补交互模式中估计物理参数。
AI.result: 在 ABB IRB120 上对四个几何、质量、质心与摩擦各异的物体进行实验，相对误差较低，并成功处理在传统前向翻转下失败的曲面底座物体。
AI.conclusion: 互补的非抓取交互可在不抓取、无先验物体模型、无学习交互动力学的情况下，恢复一组精简的物理参数。

title: Rate-Adaptive One-Step Diffusion Compression for AIGC Images
summary: We describe our entry to the LoViF 2026 AIGC Image Compression Challenge, a benchmark for ultra-low-bitrate coding of AI-generated images under a strict global rate budget of 0.025 bits per pixel (BPP). Generated imagery poses a distinct challenge for compression: it frequently contains rendered typography, synthetic edges, repeated motifs, UI-like layout, and stylized micro-texture that conventional distortion-oriented codecs erase at this rate, while unconstrained generative decoders can restore plausible-looking detail that no longer matches the source geometry or symbols. We treat this as a rate-perception allocation problem. Our system fine-tunes four rate-specialized checkpoints of the AEIC one-step diffusion codec, generates per-image candidates from all four, including one latent refined through encoder-side test-time optimization (TTO) with periodic entropy-conditioning refresh, entropy-codes every candidate with practical rANS coding, and selects exactly one bitstream per image with an exact multiple-choice knapsack solved over true coded file sizes. A fixed, zero-additional-bit residual restoration network is applied at decode time. Every submitted bitstream is independently decodable by the shipped decoder, which uses no source image or external side information. We report the full pipeline, an ablation history spanning 77 logged experiments, and a set of negative results, including why PSNR could not be pushed to parity with rate-distortion-oriented competitors under this architecture, useful to future participants. This is a challenge report: our entry scored 31.527739 (PSNR 27.02 dB, MS-SSIM 0.9176, LPIPS 0.0778, DISTS 0.0390 at 0.02495 BPP), the second-best DISTS on the leaderboard, ranking 5th on the final test-phase leaderboard announced August 4, 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文是LoViF 2026 AIGC图像压缩挑战赛的技术报告，提出基于AEIC一步扩散编解码器的极低码率（0.025 BPP）图像压缩方案，通过多码率专用检查点、测试时优化、rANS熵编码与背包选择策略，实现每图单码流传输，最终以DISTS 0.0390排名第五。
AI.motivation: AI生成图像在极低码率下压缩面临独特挑战：其包含渲染文字、合成边缘、重复母题、类UI布局与风格化微纹理，传统面向失真的编解码器在此码率会将其抹除；而无约束的生成式解码器虽能恢复看似合理的细节，却会偏离源几何与符号。因此作者将问题重新定义为码率—感知分配问题。
AI.method: 微调AEIC一步扩散编解码器的四个码率专用检查点；由四者生成每图候选，其中一版潜在表示经编码器端测试时优化（TTO）并周期性刷新熵条件；对所有候选使用实用rANS熵编码；以真实编码文件大小求解精确多选背包问题，每图仅选一条码流；解码时应用固定的、不额外消耗比特的残差恢复网络。所有码流均可由所发布解码器独立解码，不使用源图或外部边信息。
AI.result: 参赛方案得分31.527739（在0.02495 BPP下PSNR 27.02 dB、MS-SSIM 0.9176、LPIPS 0.0778、DISTS 0.0390），取得排行榜第二好的DISTS，并在2026年8月4日公布的最终测试阶段排行榜中位列第五。报告还给出完整流程、涵盖77次记录实验的消融历史及一系列负面结果。
AI.conclusion: 该架构下PSNR难以追平面向率失真的竞争者，此负面结果对未来参赛者具有参考价值。整体证明多码率候选生成、精确背包选择与零额外比特残差恢复的组合，可在极低码率AIGC压缩中于感知指标上取得有竞争力表现。

title: Beyond State-as-Action: Exploiting Command-State Discrepancy for Robot Imitation Learning
summary: Constructing action targets from measured robot motion is an established approach in imitation learning. Under interaction constraints, however, command-state discrepancy may reflect control demands that motion alone does not capture. We investigate when this information matters and how to exploit it. Across three real-robot tasks, task and phase analyses reveal larger supervision gaps under constrained interaction, while selective command retention provides evidence of locally useful command information. Building on these findings, we propose Command-State Discrepancy Weighting (CSDW), which accounts for robot response times and combines subsequent progress, persistent unmet demand, and demand changes into continuous weights for command supervision. The method requires no task-phase annotations or changes to policy architecture or inference. CSDW improves over uniform command supervision on constrained tasks, while methods perform similarly in the less constrained task.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究交互约束下命令-状态差异所蕴含的控制需求信息，提出命令-状态差异加权（CSDW）方法，将响应时间、后续进展、持续未满足需求及需求变化转化为连续权重，用于命令监督，无需任务阶段标注且不改变策略架构与推理。
AI.motivation: 在模仿学习中，通常以实测机器人运动构建动作目标。但在交互约束下，命令与状态之间的差异可能反映运动本身无法捕捉的控制需求。论文旨在探究这种信息何时重要，以及如何加以利用。
AI.method: 通过三个真实机器人任务，进行任务与阶段分析，发现受约束交互下监督差距更大，且选择性保留命令可提供局部有用命令信息的证据。在此基础上提出 CSDW：考虑机器人响应时间，将后续进展、持续未满足需求与需求变化综合为连续权重，用于命令监督。
AI.result: 在受约束任务上，CSDW 优于均匀命令监督；在约束较少的任务上，各方法表现相近。
AI.conclusion: 命令-状态差异在交互约束下具有可利用的监督价值，CSDW 能在不增加标注、不改变策略架构与推理的前提下有效提升受约束任务表现。

title: A Surgical Foundation Model Reveals Task-Dependent Label Efficiency
summary:
Developing label-efficient models is a central challenge in surgical AI due to the high cost and scarcity of expert annotation. While self-supervised foundation models adapt well to new tasks with minimal data, how label efficiency varies across different surgical tasks remains largely unexplored.
  Here, we introduce SURGE, a surgical foundation model trained on SurgSpectrum-30M+, the largest pretraining dataset comprising over 30 million frames, with checkpoints released to enable further research. We systematically evaluate label efficiency across 5 task categories and 15 benchmarks. These range from temporal and spatial scene understanding to fine-grained reasoning tied to instrument-anatomy interactions and safety-critical maneuvers.
  SURGE outperforms prior state-of-the-art on all benchmarks, even surpassing task-specific models on complex reasoning tasks. Crucially, we reveal a task-dependent scaling behavior: while scene understanding tasks saturate with minimal supervision, fine-grained reasoning tasks continue improving with substantially larger annotation budgets, providing a blueprint for allocating expert effort in complex domains.
  Code: https://github.com/CAMMA-public/SURGE

AI.tldr: 提出手术基础模型SURGE，基于3000万帧数据集SurgSpectrum-30M+训练，系统评估15个基准上5类任务的标签效率，揭示任务相关的扩展规律。
AI.motivation: 外科AI中专家标注成本高且稀缺，开发标签高效模型是核心挑战。自监督基础模型虽能以极少数据适应新任务，但标签效率在不同手术任务间的差异尚未被探索。
AI.method: 构建SurgSpectrum-30M+（最大预训练数据集，超3000万帧），训练手术基础模型SURGE并开源检查点；在5类任务、15个基准上系统评测标签效率，任务涵盖时序与空间场景理解、器械-解剖交互的细粒度推理及安全关键操作。
AI.result: SURGE在所有基准上超越此前最优方法，在复杂推理任务上甚至超过任务专用模型。发现任务相关的扩展行为：场景理解任务在极少监督下即饱和，而细粒度推理任务随标注预算显著增加仍持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 标签效率具有任务依赖性，为复杂领域中专家的标注投入分配提供了蓝图，并为手术AI的标签高效建模奠定基础。

title: TimelyDAgger: Timing-Aware Expert Querying for VLA Policy Improvement
summary: DAgger improves robot policies by aggregating expert supervision from states visited during policy execution. Robot-gated DAgger automates expert queries, allowing the robot to decide when to request expert takeover. While existing gates emphasize detecting the need for assistance, takeover timing also shapes the content of these demonstrations and their value for policy learning. We propose TimelyDAgger, combining Bridge-PCA monitoring of internal vision-language-action (VLA) features with Feedback-guided Threshold Adaptation based on expert behavior to improve takeover timing. We introduce an evaluation framework linking failure detection, takeover timing, and policy improvement, including Target-Aligned Supervision Ratio (TASR) for assessing supervision quality without retraining. Experiments show that takeover timing affects policy learning, with TimelyDAgger achieving competitive failure detection and higher post-training success in most evaluated settings under matched expert-action budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TimelyDAgger，通过Bridge-PCA监控VLA内部特征并结合基于专家行为的反馈引导阈值自适应，改进机器人门控DAgger的接管时机，并引入评估框架（含TASR）衡量监督质量。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人门控DAgger主要关注检测何时需要帮助，但接管时机同样影响示范内容及其对策略学习的价值，这一点尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 提出TimelyDAgger：(1) 用Bridge-PCA监控视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型的内部特征；(2) 基于专家行为的反馈引导阈值自适应(Feedback-guided Threshold Adaptation)来优化接管时机。
AI.result: 实验表明接管时机确实影响策略学习；在匹配专家动作预算下，TimelyDAgger在多数评估设置中实现了有竞争力的失败检测能力和更高的训练后成功率。
AI.conclusion: 接管时机是门控DAgger中的关键因素，TimelyDAgger通过结合内部特征监控与阈值自适应有效改进监督质量，且所提评估框架（含TASR）可在无需重训练的情况下评估监督质量。

title: SynDORBench: Evaluating LVLM Perceptual Robustness Under Physically Constrained Visibility Conditions
summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, yet their perceptual reliability under physically constrained imaging conditions remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations predominantly assume ideal visual inputs and therefore fail to characterize how camera distance, illumination, viewpoint, and pixel density fundamentally affect semantic recoverability. We introduce SynDORBench, the first physically grounded benchmark for evaluating LVLM perceptual robustness under DORI-calibrated conditions aligned with human visual capability standards. SynDORBench comprises over 54k question--answer pairs generated through a controllable synthetic pipeline that systematically varies viewing distance, lighting, camera geometry, and action pose according to physically interpretable pixel-density regimes. To support scalable low-visibility supervision, we further propose a discernibility annotation framework that propagates human perceptual labels using mask-conditioned statistical features and ensemble learning. We evaluate 16 open-source LVLMs, a commercial LVLM baseline, and YOLO11x across human-presence classification and action recognition tasks under progressively degraded visibility conditions. Our results reveal that perceptual failure in LVLMs is strongly governed by pixel density and physical imaging constraints rather than model scale alone. Surprisingly, several compact open-source LVLMs outperform larger commercial baselines and substantially exceed YOLO11x robustness under long-range and low-light conditions. SynDORBench establishes a new benchmark paradigm for physically grounded multimodal evaluation, enabling systematic analysis of LVLM reliability under real-world perceptual constraints and direct comparison against human visibility thresholds.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SynDORBench，首个基于物理约束（DORI校准）的LVLM感知鲁棒性基准，包含5.4万余问答对，揭示LVLM感知失败主要由像素密度和物理成像约束主导而非模型规模。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM评估多假设理想视觉输入，无法刻画相机距离、光照、视角和像素密度如何影响语义可恢复性，导致对LVLM在真实物理成像约束下感知可靠性的理解不足。
AI.method: 构建可控合成流水线，按物理可解释的像素密度分区系统变化视距、光照、相机几何与动作姿态，生成54k+问答对；并提出可辨识性标注框架，利用掩码条件统计特征与集成学习传播人类感知标签，以支持可扩展的低可见度监督。
AI.result: 在逐步退化的可见度条件下评估16个开源LVLM、1个商业LVLM基线及YOLO11x，覆盖人体存在分类与动作识别任务；发现感知失败强烈受像素密度和物理成像约束支配，若干紧凑开源LVLM优于更大商业基线，并在远距离和低光条件下显著超过YOLO11x的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SynDORBench确立了物理落地的多模态评估新范式，支持在真实感知约束下系统分析LVLM可靠性，并与人类可见度阈值直接比较。

title: Beyond Tasks: A Vision for Reproducing an Animal-like Behavioral Substrate Using Modern Robot Learning Techniques
summary: Recent advances in robot learning have produced increasingly capable embodied agents. Yet comparatively less attention has been given to a more basic form of competence that animals exhibit continuously: the ability to remain situated, responsive, and behaviorally coherent as physical, environmental, and social demands change over time. We propose the ethological behavioral substrate as a conceptual lens for studying this form of competence in artificial agents. Rather than treating these behaviors that animals exhibit as a set of isolated skills, we argue that their continual coordination under competing demands constitutes an important and underexplored target for modern robot learning. We further propose robotic animal companions as a useful research setting for studying sustained interaction and adaptation in human-centered environments. Such systems provide an opportunity to investigate how social behavior, memory, and continual learning develop over long periods of interaction. This perspective motivates further investigation of how such persistent behavioral competence may complement higher-level capabilities in embodied agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"行为学行为基底"概念，主张将动物持续协调的涌现行为作为机器人学习的新研究目标，并建议以机器人动物伴侣作为研究场景。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习虽已造出能力不断增强的具身智能体，但较少关注一种更基础的能力——当物理、环境和社会需求随时间变化时，智能体仍能保持"在场"、响应性与行为连贯性。这种持续的行为胜任力是动物持续展现的，却是当前研究中的空白。
AI.method: 这是一篇立场/观点类论文：提出"行为学行为基底"（ethological behavioral substrate）作为分析人工智能体此类能力的概念透镜；将动物行为视为需在竞争性需求下持续协调的整体，而非孤立技能集合；并建议以机器动物伴侣为研究场景，考察社会行为、记忆与持续学习在长期人机互动中的发展。
AI.result: 本文属于概念性探讨，未提供实验数据或量化结果，主要贡献是提出研究议题、概念框架与研究场景建议。
AI.conclusion: 持续的行为胜任力可作为具身智能体高层能力的补充，值得进一步研究；机器动物伴侣为研究长期互动与适应提供了有价值的平台。

title: CueKFS: Agentic Cue-Driven Keyframe Selection for Long Video Understanding
summary: Keyframe selection (KFS) has long produced compact video summaries for browsing and retrieval, and representative frames for thumbnails. More recently, when conditioned on a question, KFS provides an alternative to uniform sampling for long-video question answering by selecting frames that are more relevant to the question. Most methods rank frames by similarity to the question. Yet a relevant frame may score poorly when the question combines subjects or moments that no single frame shows, or requires implicit information absent from its wording. Other methods try to break down the question into subqueries, but suffer from inaccurate decomposition due to their static initial context. Therefore, we propose CueKFS, a training-free method that reformulates question--frame matching as comparing frames against a set of dynamically generated visual cues. From an initial set of salient frames, we decompose the question into cues. Each cue concurrently probes the video to navigate to its own evidence. A reasoning VLM then agentically revises the cue set against its evidence to re-explore the video. CueKFS then allocates the budget across the surviving cues. Across three benchmarks, CueKFS establishes state-of-the-art results in all 27 evaluated settings with available prior results, achieving budget-averaged gains of up to +4.54% over the previous baseline and a median of only two VLM calls. We further provide a detailed behavioral analysis of CueKFS, showing that agentic cue refinement drives active re-exploration of the video, yielding relative similarity gains of up to 92% over the initial context.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的 CueKFS 方法，将问题-帧匹配重构为帧与动态生成视觉线索的比较，在长视频问答的关键帧选择任务上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答中，关键帧选择（KFS）可作为均匀采样的替代方案。但多数方法按与问题的相似度排序帧，当问题涉及单帧无法涵盖的主体/时刻或隐含信息时，相关帧得分可能偏低；而将问题分解为子查询的方法又因静态初始上下文导致分解不准。
AI.method: CueKFS 为免训练方法：从一组初始显著帧出发，将问题分解为若干视觉线索（cues）；每个线索独立探测视频以导航到自身证据；再由推理 VLM 以智能体方式依据证据修订线索集并重新探索视频；最后在存活的线索间分配预算。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，CueKFS 在所有 27 个有既往结果的评测设置中均达到 SOTA，预算平均提升最高达 +4.54%，中位 VLM 调用次数仅为 2 次；行为分析显示智能体式线索细化驱动主动再探索，相对初始上下文的相似度增益最高达 92%。
AI.conclusion: CueKFS 通过动态线索生成与智能体式修订，有效解决了传统相似度排序与静态分解的局限，以极低的 VLM 调用成本实现长视频问答关键帧选择的领先性能。

title: Dynamic Manipulation with World-Action Models via Counterfactual Planning
comment: 48 pages, including appendices. Project page: https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/
summary:
World-Action models (WAMs) trained on static demonstrations often fail to manipulate moving targets even when they possess the required manipulation skills. We attribute this failure to target-response collapse: as execution advances, the policy becomes increasingly biased toward the learned continuation of its ongoing behavior and less responsive to target relocation.
  To bridge the gap between what the model has learned and what it can generate from the current context, we formulate dynamic manipulation as counterfactual planning by decoupling the context used for plan generation from the physical state used for execution. Our framework, Dynamic Predictive Planning (DPP), first uses the WAM's predictive rollout to estimate when an interaction is expected to occur, and combines this timing estimate with observed target motion to predict the target's future interaction position. DPP then constructs a counterfactual observation that places this predicted target position in a familiar robot context, allowing the model to invoke an existing manipulation skill rather than generate a recovery behavior from an unfamiliar robot-target configuration. The resulting plan is connected to the robot's actual state during execution.
  DPP enables real-time dynamic manipulation on a single consumer GPU without additional training on dynamic data. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse target motions, with simulation performance surpassing all evaluated baselines, including methods additionally trained on dynamic data.
  Project page: https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出动态预测规划（DPP）框架，通过反事实规划解决World-Action模型在动态目标操作中的"目标响应崩溃"问题，无需额外动态数据训练即可在单张消费级GPU上实现实时动态操作。
AI.motivation: 基于静态演示训练的World-Action模型（WAMs）即使具备所需操作技能，也难以操作运动中的目标。作者将这一失败归因于"目标响应崩溃"：随着执行推进，策略越来越偏向于延续已学到的正在进行的行为，对目标位置变化的响应性降低。这一现象导致模型学到的能力无法在当前上下文中发挥出来。
AI.method: 作者将动态操作形式化为反事实规划，将用于计划生成的上下文与用于执行的物理状态解耦。DPP框架首先利用WAM的预测推演估计交互发生的时机，结合观测到的目标运动预测目标未来的交互位置；然后构造一个反事实观测，将预测的目标位置置于熟悉的机器人上下文中，使模型调用已有的操作技能，而非从陌生的机器人-目标构型生成恢复行为；最后在执行时将生成的计划连接到机器人实际状态。
AI.result: DPP无需在动态数据上额外训练，即可在单张消费级GPU上实现实时动态操作。仿真和真实机器人实验表明，DPP在多种目标运动下均取得一致的性能提升，仿真性能超越了所有评估基线，包括额外使用动态数据训练的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦计划生成上下文与执行物理状态的反事实规划，DPP有效缓解了目标响应崩溃问题，使基于静态演示训练的WAM能够胜任动态目标操作，且具备低成本、免额外训练、实时部署的优势。

title: Auditing Quality Filters for Long-Tail Human Data Curation
summary: Robots on construction sites must detect workers who are kneeling or bending, which we call low poses. These workers can be lost from training datasets during automatic labeling. We study a pipeline that detects people, estimates their body joints using NLF, and groups similar poses. Low poses account for only about 2 percent of the retained examples. This low share may partly reflect the pipeline's quality filter, which rejects examples with low detection confidence or uncertain joint estimates. We examine this filtering using four alternative pose clues: bounding-box shape, vertical body span, pose grouping aligned to the scene's vertical direction, and image appearance. All four suggest that low poses are rejected by the filter more often. Separately, controlled simulated scenes show that a person detector fine-tuned on a public construction dataset misses more workers in these poses even when we correct their bounding box height is matched to that of standing workers. These findings suggest that low poses are scarce and hard to find, and we cannot rely on bounding boxes or poses for long-tail human data curation.

AI.tldr: 机器人施工场景中"低姿态"（跪姿/弯腰）工人数据稀缺，自动标注流程的过滤环节会更多地拒绝这类姿态，且针对公开数据集的微调检测器也更容易漏检。
AI.motivation: 工地机器人需要检测跪姿、弯腰的工人（低姿态），但这类工人在自动标注过程中可能从训练数据集中被筛掉，而理解数据集长尾分布对于人形数据治理至关重要。
AI.method: 研究一条流水线：先检测人物，再用NLF估计人体关节，并将相似姿态分组。采用四种替代姿态线索检验过滤环节：包围框形状、竖直身体跨度、对齐场景竖直方向的姿态分组、图像外观；并结合受控模拟场景，将人物检测器微调到公开施工数据集上进行验证。
AI.result: 低姿态仅占保留样本的约2%；四种线索均显示低姿态更常被过滤器拒绝；在包围框高度与站立工人匹配的情况下，微调检测器在模拟场景中仍更多地漏检低姿态工人。
AI.conclusion: 低姿态既稀缺又难以发现，不能依赖包围框或姿态信息来进行长尾人体数据的筛选取用。

title: Multi-Terrain Mastery: A Comprehensive Controller for Bipedal Locomotion
summary: Advancing bipedal robots to navigate diverse terrains remains a significant challenge in robotics. Traditional locomotion controllers excel on specific surfaces but struggle across varied environments, limiting their practical applications. Given the unpredictable nature of real-world environments, a single controller capable of handling multiple terrains is ideal, eliminating the need for multiple specialized controllers. We propose a multi-terrain controller to enhance the versatility and robustness of bipedal locomotion. Building on previous work with a stance ankle motor for stability on inclined and rough surfaces, this paper extends capabilities to steep wet uneven grassy slopes, and compliant terrains such as sand, gravel, rocks, and constrained terrains like staircases. To address the unique demands of these terrains, we introduce a new impact map that is essential for maintaining performance and robustness against unseen terrains. We also discuss in detail the control structure for real-time deployment on the robot. We validate our controller on the 20 degree-of-freedom Cassie bipedal robot.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多地形控制器，扩展双足机器人（Cassie）在湿滑草丛陡坡、沙石等柔性地形及楼梯等受限地形上的运动能力，引入新的冲击映射以增强鲁棒性，并在20自由度机器人上验证。
AI.motivation: 探索让双足机器人在多样化地形上行走仍是机器人领域的重大挑战。传统运动控制器在特定表面表现优异，但难以适应多变环境，限制了实际应用。由于真实环境具有不可预测性，理想的方案是用单一控制器应对多种地形，无需多个专用控制器。
AI.method: 在先前利用站立踝关节电机在倾斜与粗糙表面保持稳定的工作基础上，提出多地形控制器。针对新地形需求，引入新的冲击映射（impact map）以维持性能和对未见过地形的鲁棒性，并详细讨论用于机器人实时部署的控制结构。
AI.result: 控制器在20自由度Cassie双足机器人上进行了验证，能力扩展至陡峭湿滑不平的草坡、沙地、砾石、岩石等柔性地形，以及楼梯等受限地形。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的单一多地形控制器提升了双足运动的通用性与鲁棒性，减少了对多个专用控制器的依赖，具有实际应用潜力。

title: Enhancing Visual Reasoning in Chest X-Ray Report Generation Using Reinforcement Learning
summary: Medical report generation has made significant progress with the rise of modern vision-language models and the growing availability of large-scale medical datasets. However, hallucinations remain a major challenge, largely due to the limitations of supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which prioritizes lexical similarity to reference reports rather than clinical correctness. While reinforcement learning has shown strong performance in domains with verifiable rewards such as mathematics and code generation, its application to open-ended medical tasks remains limited. Existing work focuses on evaluating final answers, overlooking the model's reasoning, despite evidence that flawed reasoning can degrade overall performance. In this study, we propose a framework that verifies the model's reasoning process by integrating anatomical regions, bounding boxes, and region-level textual descriptions. We design spatial and factual reward mechanisms to ensure that the model's reasoning is both visually grounded and factually accurate. Starting from Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as our base model, we adapt it to the medical domain using supervised fine-tuning, introduce reasoning capability through a cold-start SFT stage, and refine it with reinforcement learning. We find that RL provides performance gains beyond those achievable through SFT alone, and that jointly verifying both reasoning steps and final outputs yields larger improvements than verifying either in isolation. We further identify multiple modes of reward hacking in the RL stage. Finally, the model's structured think traces enhance interpretability, making its outputs easier to audit for clinical use.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通过整合解剖区域、边界框和区域级文本描述来验证模型推理过程的框架，设计空间与事实奖励机制，使医学报告生成模型的推理既视觉有据又事实准确。
AI.motivation: 医学报告生成中幻觉问题突出，根源在于监督微调（SFT）侧重与参考报告的词汇相似度而非临床正确性；强化学习在数学、代码等可验证奖励领域表现优异，但在开放式医学任务中应用有限，且现有工作只看最终答案、忽视推理过程，而有证据表明错误推理会损害整体表现。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 为基础模型，先通过监督微调适配医学领域，再用冷启动 SFT 阶段引入推理能力，最后用强化学习精修。框架整合解剖区域、边界框与区域级文本描述来验证推理过程，并设计空间奖励与事实奖励机制，确保推理在视觉上有据、在事实上准确。
AI.result: RL 带来的性能提升超过仅用 SFT 所能达到的水平；同时验证推理步骤与最终输出比单独验证任一者带来更大改进；研究还识别出 RL 阶段中多种奖励黑客（reward hacking）模式；模型的结构化思维链增强了可解释性，使输出更易于为临床使用而审计。
AI.conclusion: 在医学报告生成中，将空间与事实奖励相结合的强化学习，并联合验证推理步骤与最终输出，可有效缓解幻觉、提升临床正确性与可解释性，为开放式医学任务中的 RL 应用提供了可行路径。

title: DeltaWAM: Change-Centric Visual Foresight via Delta Tokens for an Efficient World-Action Model
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) offer visual foresight for robotic manipulation, but pixel-space models repeatedly reconstruct entire future scenes, incurring high computational cost and spatio-temporal redundancy. In physical manipulation, consecutive frames often share most of their visual context; the changes between them are what an action policy needs to anticipate. We introduce DeltaWAM, a change-centric WAM that makes a compact delta token the unit of future prediction. Each token is a single vector encoding changes between consecutive dense DINO feature maps. DeltaWAM builds on DeltaWorld, a latent world model pretrained on large-scale videos, to autoregressively predict one delta token per future frame. A flow-matching action expert then conditions on the predicted transitions and current DINO features, which serve as spatial anchors, to generate action chunks. Trained for 256 GPU hours on two H100 GPUs, DeltaWAM has 0.725B parameters and achieves 92.8% average success on LIBERO. It also shows robust generalization under procedural perturbations on LIBERO-Pro. Inference takes 142.1 ms per action chunk with 3.86 GB peak memory.

AI.tldr: DeltaWAM 是一种以"变化量"为中心的 World-Action Model，用单个 delta token 编码相邻 DINO 特征图之间的变化作为未来预测单元，在 LIBERO 上达到 92.8% 平均成功率，且推理高效。
AI.motivation: 现有像素空间的 World-Action Model 需要反复重建整个未来场景，计算成本高且存在严重的时空冗余。而在物理操作任务中，相邻帧的视觉上下文大部分相同，真正需要动作策略预测的是帧间的"变化"，因此作者希望用更紧凑的方式表示未来预测。
AI.method: 提出 DeltaWAM，一种以变化为中心的 WAM，将紧凑的 delta token 作为未来预测的基本单元——每个 token 是一个编码相邻稠密 DINO 特征图之间变化的单一向量。模型基于 DeltaWorld（在大规模视频上预训练的潜在世界模型）自回归地预测未来每帧的一个 delta token。随后，一个 flow-matching 动作专家以预测到的状态转移和当前 DINO 特征（作为空间锚点）为条件，生成动作块。
AI.result: 在两张 H100 GPU 上训练 256 GPU 小时，模型参数为 0.725B，在 LIBERO 上取得 92.8% 的平均成功率；在 LIBERO-Pro 的程序化扰动下也展现出稳健的泛化能力。推理时每个动作块耗时 142.1 ms，峰值内存 3.86 GB。
AI.conclusion: 以 delta token 为预测单元的变化中心设计能够在保持甚至提升任务成功率的同时，显著降低计算与内存开销，为机器操作中的高效视觉前瞻提供了一种可行范式。

title: PredRA: Fast Medical Image Translation by Deterministic Component Extraction and Controlled Stochastic Refinement
comment: Preprint. 14 pages, 7 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/jianhai-zhang/RredRA
summary: Strongly paired medical image translation contains a substantial component that can be predicted directly from the source. The current reality is that pure deterministic prediction can smooth away fine detail, while generative models can recover detail but may also introduce unnecessary or potentially harmful variation. We propose PredRA, a fast framework that uses the deterministic prediction as a stable reference and further extracts additional deterministic components from the residual during generative refinement, thereby improving fidelity while maintaining perceptual quality. The goal is simple: we view the entire residual-based generative process as an optimization problem and derive a practical solution that recovers useful residual detail through controlled refinement while keeping the prediction close to the paired target. Mechanism studies further show that useful residual information follows structured patterns, but its usefulness is difficult to estimate reliably at the voxel level. We therefore globally control how much of the residual refinement is added to the deterministic prediction, thereby reducing the accumulation of unnecessary uncertainty. PredRA therefore combines deterministic component extraction with controlled stochastic refinement for fast, fidelity-preserving, and perceptually strong medical image translation. We validate the approach across multiple real-world datasets, showing that controlled refinement improves fidelity to the paired target compared with full residual refinement while retaining much of the perceptual benefit of generative modeling. PredRA achieves competitive or superior performance to substantially larger state-of-the-art models with 1.4-11.9x fewer total parameters and 3.1-26.2x fewer trainable parameters, while its 32-step flow sampler requires 31.25x fewer sampling steps than the matched 1000-step DDPM.

AI.tldr: 提出PredRA框架，将确定性预测作为稳定参考，从残余中提取额外确定性成分并进行全局控制的生成式精修，实现快速、保真且感知质量强的医学图像翻译。
AI.motivation: 强配对医学图像翻译中，大量内容可由源图像直接预测。纯确定性预测会平滑掉细节，而生成模型虽能恢复细节却可能引入多余的、甚至有害的变化。目标是兼顾保真度与感知质量。
AI.method: 将基于残余的整个生成过程视为优化问题并推导出实用解：以确定性预测为稳定参考，在生成式精修中从残余提取额外的确定性成分；由于有用残余信息呈结构化模式但难以在体素级可靠估计，故在全局层面控制加入确定性预测的残余精修量，以减少不必要的不确定性累积。方法结合确定性成分提取与受控随机精修。
AI.result: 在多个真实数据集上验证，受控精修相比完全残余精修提高了对配对目标的保真度，同时保留生成式建模的大部分感知收益。PredRA以总参数少1.4-11.9倍、可训练参数少3.1-26.2倍，取得与更大规模先进模型相当或更优的性能；32步流采样器所需采样步数比匹配的1000步DDPM少31.25倍。
AI.conclusion: PredRA通过结合确定性成分提取与受控随机精修，实现了快速、保真且感知质量强的医学图像翻译，并以更少参数和采样步数达到竞争力或更优的性能。

title: TAO-DA: Towards Autonomous Operation--A Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified framework for grounding high-level semantic information into low-level robot actions, enabling scalable robotic manipulation across diverse tasks. However, existing VLA models lack explicit mechanisms to disentangle the states and intents of the two arms, leading to unintended cross-arm interference that degrades task execution success. To address this issue, we propose a symmetric Dual-Arm Expert (DAE) architecture built upon a shared Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone with decoupled, arm-specific expert towers. Expert selection is carried out through a two-stage dual-arm intent routing scheme, in which experts are routed either by explicit language instructions in the first stage or by implicit visual semantics in the second stage. Moreover, we introduce a lightweight task progress prediction module that leverages cross-attention between the pre-chunk temporal features and semantic representations of proprioceptive and visual observations to accurately estimate frame-wise task completion progress. This module facilitates task progress synchronization to support coordinated scheduling for collaborative multi-robot tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our model in dual-arm intent routing and the disentanglement of cross-arm interference, and further provide preliminary evidence of emergent skill generalization from single- to dual-arm tasks (as well as the reverse), together with cross-arm motion-domain skill transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出对称双臂专家（DAE）架构，基于共享VLM主干与解耦臂专属专家塔，通过两阶段意图路由和任务进度预测模块，缓解双臂交叉干扰并提升协作任务执行。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型缺乏显式机制区分双臂的状态与意图，导致非预期的跨臂干扰，降低任务执行成功率。
AI.method: 构建共享VLM主干加解耦的臂专属专家塔的对称双臂专家架构；采用两阶段双臂意图路由（第一阶段由显式语言指令路由，第二阶段由隐式视觉语义路由）；引入轻量任务进度预测模块，通过交叉注意力融合chunk前时序特征与本体感受和视觉观测的语义表示，估计逐帧任务完成进度，用于协作多机器人任务的进度同步与调度。
AI.result: 实验表明模型在双臂意图路由与跨臂干扰解耦方面有效，并初步显示从单臂到双臂（及反向）的技能泛化能力以及跨臂运动域技能迁移。
AI.conclusion: 该架构通过专家解耦与意图路由有效应对双臂干扰问题，并为技能泛化与跨臂迁移提供初步证据。

title: Facial classification Using Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning
summary: Hybrid quantum methods have received limited study for resource-constrained facial biometrics. We present a hybrid quantum-classical facial recognition pipeline designed to run on standard computing hardware. Images undergo gamma correction, contrast enhancement, and principal component analysis before their features are encoded into an eight-qubit variational quantum classifier. Classical image matching then performs recognition. In experiments with 50,000 images, comprising 25,000 faces from CelebA and 25,000 non-face images from CIFAR-10, the method outperformed the reported CPU-trained FaceNet baseline in accuracy and training efficiency. The pipeline was also evaluated on GPU and quantum hardware. In an attendance monitoring deployment at Mahindra University in collaboration with Lloyds Technology Centre, CPU inference took 0.2 to 0.5 seconds per person, and the system remained robust to the use of spectacles. These findings support the feasibility of deploying hybrid quantum methods for facial recognition on existing CPU hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可在标准硬件上运行的人脸识别混合量子-经典流水线，并结合经典图像匹配完成识别。
AI.motivation: 混合量子方法在资源受限的人脸生物识别场景中研究有限，需要验证其在现有硬件上的可行性。
AI.method: 图像经伽马校正、对比度增强和主成分分析后，特征编码进八量子比特变分量子分类器，再由经典图像匹配完成识别；并在CPU、GPU和量子硬件及实际考勤部署中评估。
AI.result: 在5万张图像（CelebA与CIFAR-10各2.5万）实验中，准确率与训练效率优于报道的CPU训练FaceNet基线；CPU推理每人0.2至0.5秒，对佩戴眼镜保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明在现有CPU硬件上部署混合量子人脸识别方法具有可行性。

title: Learning with Object-centric Representations of Tactile Interactive Perception for Robot Manipulation
summary: Implicit object properties that are difficult to directly infer from vision, such as material, container contents, or softness, can be revealed through tactile sensing and exploratory interactions. However, because tactile signals are transient and sparse, extracting informative tactile events and effectively incorporating them into robotic manipulation remains a challenge. In this work, we present an object-centric context-aware manipulation framework that learns task-agnostic object representations through tactile exploration. A token learner autonomously selects representative tactile segments from long-horizon exploration, while contrastive alignment with descriptive text embeddings enables a latent space that captures multiple physical object properties. These learned representations are then used as semantic context to guide object-centric manipulation policies and adapt strategies based on object properties. Experiments show that the learned representations achieve 93% and 84% property estimation accuracy on seen and unseen objects. Evaluated on three tasks involving visually ambiguous objects, i.e. multi-object rearrangement, pouring, and box opening, the proposed framework improves both target selection and property-dependent manipulation adaptation, raising task success, aggregated over all evaluation trials, from 41% to 92% on seen objects and from 19% to 67% on unseen objects over baseline policies without object-context conditioning. Videos and additional results are available at https://xinyiyxyx.github.io/tactile-object-centric/.

AI.tldr: 提出以物体为中心、具备情境感知的操作框架，通过触觉探索学习任务无关的物体表征，并用作语义情境指导操作策略。
AI.motivation: 材料、容器内容物、软硬度等隐式物体属性难以从视觉直接推断，需借助触觉感知与探索性交互获取；但触觉信号瞬时且稀疏，如何提取有效触觉事件并融入机器人操作仍是难题。
AI.method: 框架包含token learner，从长时程探索中自主选取具代表性的触觉片段；通过对比学习与描述性文本嵌入对齐，构建能捕捉多种物理属性的潜在空间；将学到的表征作为语义情境，指导以物体为中心的操作策略，并据物体属性自适应调整策略。
AI.result: 学到的表征在已知与未知物体上的属性估计准确率分别达93%和84%。在多物体重排、倒液、开箱三个涉及视觉歧义物体的任务上，相比无物体情境条件的基线策略，任务成功率在已知物体上从41%提升至92%，未知物体上从19%提升至67%。
AI.conclusion: 触觉探索学得的物体中心表征可作为有效语义情境，显著提升视觉歧义场景下目标选择与依赖属性的操作适应能力。

title: CaptchaArena: A Large-Scale, Fine-Grained Dataset for Training Computer-Use Agents on Interactive CAPTCHAs
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/X0X0X00/CaptchaArena
summary: Interactive CAPTCHAs remain challenging for computer-use agents, while existing datasets face trade-offs among type coverage, interaction fidelity, and trajectory supervision. To address these gaps, we present CaptchaArena, the first large-scale, fine-grained training dataset for interactive CAPTCHA solving. It contains 50K puzzles across 20 CAPTCHA types and 5 interaction modes, with every solution verified through execution. CaptchaArena provides 50K screenshot-action trajectories, including 46K with step-by-step reasoning annotations. It also includes fine-grained pixel-mask annotations for irregular targets. Using CaptchaArena, we train CaptchaAgent, a single 9B policy for all 20 CAPTCHA types, with supervised fine-tuning followed by reinforcement learning. The environment verifier directly provides the RL reward. Supervised fine-tuning reaches 70.5 Pass@1, and reinforcement learning further improves it to 71.7, while also improving performance on two external benchmarks. These results demonstrate the value of large-scale, fine-grained computer-use supervision for training interactive CAPTCHA agents. We release CaptchaArena and CaptchaAgent at https://github.com/X0X0X00/CaptchaArena.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CaptchaArena——首个大规模、细粒度的交互式CAPTCHA求解训练数据集，含20种类型、50K样本及分步推理与像素掩码标注；据此训练单一9B模型CaptchaAgent，SFT达70.5 Pass@1，经RL提升至71.7，并在两个外部基准上有增益。
AI.motivation: 交互式CAPTCHA对computer-use agent仍是难题，而现有数据集难以在类型覆盖、交互真实性和轨迹监督之间取得平衡。为此需要构建兼具规模、多样性与细粒度监督的数据资源，以支撑此类智能体的训练。
AI.method: 构建CaptchaArena数据集：50K谜题，覆盖20种CAPTCHA类型和5种交互模式，每个解答均经执行验证；提供50K截图-动作轨迹（其中46K带分步推理），以及针对不规则目标的细粒度像素掩码。基于该数据训练统一9B策略CaptchaAgent，先做监督微调，再用环境验证器直接提供奖励进行强化学习，同一模型覆盖全部20种类型。
AI.result: 监督微调达到70.5 Pass@1，强化学习进一步提升至71.7，同时在两个外部基准上也有性能改善。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，大规模、细粒度的computer-use监督对训练交互式CAPTCHA智能体具有重要价值，验证了数据规模与标注精细度在提升策略性能上的作用。

title: SurgFlow: 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow for Surgical Robot Manipulation
summary: Paired video-action demonstrations enable autonomous surgical behavior, but such data is scarce: robots perform roughly 1% of surgeries, while video-only data is abundant. Learning 3D object flow offers an embodiment-agnostic way to utilize video data, but flow alone specifies how an object should move, not where and when the tool should engage it, a distinction that is critical in surgery. We introduce SurgFlow, a framework that learns 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow from stereo surgical video without action labels. For each object point, it predicts a future 3D trajectory and contact scores. We extract targets via 3D tracking and tool-object proximity, train a flow matching generator to predict them, and use predicted contact to trigger grasp and release while optimizing end effector motion from flow. On the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK), SurgFlow succeeds in 37 of 39 stage evaluations across tissue retraction, bimanual reveal, needle pickup, and handover, outperforming baselines trained on equal data with or without action labels. Zero-shot transfer to a humanoid-based laparoscopic robot achieves 85% and 70% average success under similar and novel camera viewpoints, respectively.

AI.tldr: SurgFlow从立体手术视频中无动作标签地学习3D物体中心接触流，预测物体点的未来3D轨迹与接触分数，据此触发抓取/释放并优化末端执行器运动，在dVRK上39个阶段评估中成功37个，并实现零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 成对的视频-动作演示数据对外科自主行为至关重要，但极为稀缺：机器人仅完成约1%的手术，而纯视频数据却很丰富。仅靠3D物体流虽能以与具身无关的方式利用视频数据，但流只指定物体应如何运动，不指定工具应在何处、何时接触物体，这一区分在外科手术中尤为关键。
AI.method: 提出SurgFlow框架，从立体手术视频中无动作标签学习3D物体中心接触流。对每个物体点预测未来3D轨迹和接触分数；通过3D跟踪与工具-物体邻近度提取目标；训练流匹配生成器进行预测；利用预测的接触触发抓取与释放，并根据流优化末端执行器运动。
AI.result: 在da Vinci研究套件（dVRK）上，SurgFlow在组织牵拉、双手显露、拾针和传递等任务的39个阶段评估中成功37个，优于使用同等数据（有或无动作标签）训练的基线。零样本迁移至人形腹腔镜机器人，在相似和新颖相机视角下平均成功率分别为85%和70%。
AI.conclusion: 通过从视频中学习物体中心的3D接触流，可在缺乏动作标签的情况下实现自主外科行为，并具备跨具身、跨视角的泛化能力。

title: Double-Edged Sword of Mediated Visibility: How Visual Framing Undermines Congresswomen's Perceived Competence
comment: 36 pages, 3 figures, plus 25-page online appendix (included). Under review
summary: Women's presence in Congress has stalled below 30%. That institutional underrepresentation is mirrored by their limited visibility on televised news, where visual presentation can shape perceived competence and authority. Yet research tells us more about whether congresswomen appear than how they are visually framed. Facial recognition analysis of 695,464 image-text segments from CNN and Fox News (2011-2021) reveals that congresswomen appear disproportionately in split-screen rather than solo shots. Two pre-registered experiments with 6,220 participants show that, in static frames, split-screen framing reduces congresswomen's perceived political competence, but not congressmen's. In dynamic videos, the competence penalty disappears; instead, outraged language reduces a congresswoman's perceived warmth roughly three times as much as a congressman's. Suggestive evidence (p = .057) indicates that women viewers report greater external political efficacy after watching a congresswoman appear alone. We conclude that visual framing shapes both congresswomen's mediated visibility and their perceived capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文通过面部识别分析CNN与Fox News的69万余条图像-文本片段（2011-2021），发现女国会议员更多出现在分屏镜头中；两项预注册实验（N=6,220）表明分屏框架会降低女议员被感知的政治能力（仅对女性），而在动态视频中该惩罚消失，但愤怒语言对女性温暖度的损害约为男性的三倍。
AI.motivation: 女性在国会的比例长期停滞在30%以下，这种制度性代表性不足也反映在电视新闻的可见度上。既有研究多关注女议员"是否出现"，而较少探讨她们"如何被视觉框定"，而视觉呈现可能塑造受众对能力与权威的感知。
AI.method: 采用面部识别技术分析CNN和Fox News 2011至2021年间695,464条图像-文本片段；并开展两项预注册实验，共6,220名被试，考察静态画面中的分屏与单独镜头框架，以及动态视频中愤怒语言的影响。
AI.result: 女国会议员在分屏镜头中出现的比例过高。静态画面下，分屏框架降低女议员被感知的政治能力，但对男议员无此影响；在动态视频中该能力惩罚消失，取而代之的是愤怒语言对女议员温暖度的负面效应约为男议员的三倍。此外有提示性证据（p=.057）显示，女性观众在观看女议员单独出镜后报告更高的外部政治效能感。
AI.conclusion: 视觉框架既塑造了女国会议员在媒介中的可见性，也影响其被感知的能力，说明新闻视觉呈现方式对性别化的政治评价具有实质作用。

title: ActionGround: Training-Free Runtime Refinement of Frozen VLA Policies
summary:
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions directly to robot actions, but they do not explicitly represent the phase structure of manipulation tasks or the rigid-body dynamics governing execution. We present ActionGround, a neuro-symbolic, training-free runtime layer that wraps a frozen VLA policy without retraining, fine-tuning, or weight access, adding less than 1 ms of overhead per control step. A symbolic phase-aware finite-state machine identifies the manipulation phase (approach, grasp, transport, or place) and applies a phase-specific rule-based correction. In parallel, an always-on, inertia-weighted Euler-Lagrange term incorporates the robot's equations of motion into each control step, while its dynamics residual is logged as a consistency diagnostic rather than used as a gate.
  We evaluate ActionGround across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, Force-VLA, and Generalist-VLA on ten LIBERO-Spatial pick-and-place tasks using a 7-DoF Franka Panda. With fixed parameters across tasks and backbones, ActionGround improves success rate by up to 6 percentage points and stability by up to 19.3 percentage points, while improving trajectory efficiency by up to 15%. In a separate Robosuite noise sweep, ActionGround provides approximately a 10x improvement in trajectory-jerk robustness under injected action noise. In a matched-seed Robosuite simulation companion to a real Agilex Piper trial, simulated baseline success increases from 35% to 95%. The physical-hardware experiment is presented as a qualitative deployment demonstration; quantitative per-trial success on the real arm is left for future work. Our evaluation is limited to rigid-object pick-and-place manipulation.

AI.tldr: ActionGround 是一个无需训练、即插即用的神经符号运行时层，为冻结的 VLA 策略附加相态感知有限状态机与惯性加权欧拉-拉格朗日修正，在多个 VLA 骨干与 LIBERO-Spatial 任务上提升成功率、稳定性与轨迹效率，并在噪声鲁棒性与仿真对照中表现显著，硬件实验仅为定性展示。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型直接将视觉观测与语言指令映射为机器人动作，但未显式建模操作任务的相态结构（接近、抓取、搬运、放置）以及支配执行的刚体动力学，导致执行稳定性和轨迹质量受限。作者希望在不重训练、不微调、不访问权重的前提下弥补这一缺口。
AI.method: 提出 ActionGround，一个神经符号、免训练的运行时封装层，每控制步开销低于 1 ms。方法包含两条并行机制：(1) 符号化相态感知有限状态机，识别操作相态并施加相态特定的规则化修正；(2) 始终启用的惯性加权欧拉-拉格朗日项，将机器人运动方程引入控制步，其动力学残差仅作为一致性诊断记录，而非门控条件。
AI.result: 在 OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、Force-VLA、Generalist-VLA 四种骨干及 7-DoF Franka Panda 上的十个 LIBERO-Spatial 抓放任务中，固定参数下成功率最多提升 6 个百分点，稳定性最多提升 19.3 个百分点，轨迹效率最多提升 15%。Robosuite 噪声扫描中，注入动作噪声下轨迹抖动鲁棒性提升约 10 倍。与真实 Agilex Piper 试验配对的同种子 Robosuite 仿真中，基线成功率由 35% 提升至 95%。
AI.conclusion: ActionGround 以极低开销、免训练的方式为冻结 VLA 策略补充相态与动力学先验，在仿真中一致提升成功率、稳定性、效率与噪声鲁棒性。但评估仅限于刚体抓放操作，真实硬件实验仅为定性部署演示，未给出逐试验的定量成功率，留待未来工作。

title: Does Vision-Language Pretraining Granularity Matter? A Controlled Evaluation of Vision-Language Objectives Across Chest X-Ray Interpretation Tasks
summary: Vision-language pretraining objectives differ in the spatial granularity of their supervision, yet the implications of this distribution for chest X-ray interpretation remain underexplored. We present a controlled study that isolates the pretraining objective: holding the encoder and pretraining data fixed, we train nine objectives spanning global and local contrastive learning, captioning, and their combinations, and evaluate across five chest X-ray tasks of increasing spatial granularity. We find that (i) pretraining granularity aligns with task granularity at the extremes, with local objectives leading on abnormality detection and global objectives on classification; (ii) local objectives are surprisingly competitive on global-level generation and question answering tasks; (iii) the merits of captioning and contrastive learning reverse across granularity levels; and (iv) among combinations, mixing captioning and contrastive supervision is strongest on classification and in distribution generation, while pairing two captioning objectives generalizes best on zero-shot report generation. These results show that no single objective is universally optimal, and that the interaction of objective type, granularity, and task governs downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制实验隔离视觉-语言预训练目标，发现预训练的空间粒度与下游胸部X光任务粒度在极端情况下对齐，且不存在普适最优目标。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言预训练目标在监督的空间粒度上存在差异，但这种分布对胸部X光影像解读的影响尚不明确，因此需要一个控制变量研究来隔离预训练目标本身的作用。
AI.method: 固定编码器和预训练数据，训练九种目标（涵盖全局与局部对比学习、描述生成及其组合），并在五个空间粒度递增的胸部X光任务上进行评估。
AI.result: (i) 预训练粒度在极端情况下与任务粒度对齐：局部目标在异常检测上领先，全局目标在分类上占优；(ii) 局部目标在全局级生成和问答任务上出乎意料地有竞争力；(iii) 描述生成与对比学习的优势随粒度层级发生反转；(iv) 组合中，混合描述与对比监督在分类和分布内生成上最强，而两个描述目标搭配在零样本报告生成上泛化最佳。
AI.conclusion: 没有单一目标在所有任务上普遍最优，目标类型、粒度与任务之间的交互共同决定下游性能。

title: PORTER: Edge-Cloud Residency for Persistent 3D Scene Graph Memory
summary: Recent task-driven and just-in-time 3D Scene Graph (3DSG) methods reduce per-task representations by constructing or activating only task-relevant information. Yet sparse per-task working sets do not bound onboard memory usage over a robot's lifetime: as tasks change, payloads accumulated for earlier tasks may become irrelevant to the current task but can be useful again in future tasks. Over repeated task switches and expanding environments, retaining such reusable payloads causes local memory to grow, whereas discarding them entirely can lead to costly repeated construction of the same payloads later. We introduce PORTER, which decouples persistence from residency: lightweight anchors remain in the limited memory of the edge robot while heavy object payloads migrate between the edge and the cloud. Relevance alone is insufficient for deciding residency because multiple relevant payloads may provide redundant information. We therefore decompose each task into functional requirements and introduce Irreplaceable Support Erasure (ISE), which measures the loss in requirement coverage caused by offloading. ISE discounts replaceable support and penalizes losses more strongly when the remaining coverage of a requirement is weak. PORTER constructs a budget-aware local working set by repeatedly offloading the payload with the smallest marginal ISE per byte. Experiments on JITOMA-Bench evaluate PORTER across four 3DSG builders. Under progressive compression, pooled relative mR@3 remains at 100% through 91% payload-byte offloading.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PORTER，通过将3D场景图的持久性与驻留性解耦，用轻量锚点驻留机器人端、重量级对象载荷在边缘与云端间迁移，并设计"不可替代支撑擦除"（ISE）指标实现预算感知的卸载决策，在91%字节卸载率下保持检索性能不降。
AI.motivation: 现有任务驱动和即时（just-in-time）3D场景图方法仅构建或激活任务相关信息，但其稀疏的按任务工作集无法限制机器人全生命周期的内存占用：随着任务切换，早期任务的载荷对当前任务无关，却可能在未来任务中再次有用。全部保留会导致本地内存持续增长，全部丢弃则会造成未来重复构建的高昂代价。因此需要一种在有限边缘内存下决定哪些载荷应驻留、哪些可卸载的机制。
AI.method: PORTER将持久性与驻留性解耦：轻量锚点常驻边缘机器人内存，重量级对象载荷在边缘与云端之间迁移。由于单纯的相关性不足以决定驻留（多个相关载荷可能提供冗余信息），方法将每个任务分解为功能需求，并提出不可替代支撑擦除（ISE）指标，衡量卸载某载荷导致的需求覆盖损失；ISE会折减可替代的支撑，并在某需求剩余覆盖较弱时对损失施加更强惩罚。基于此，PORTER通过反复卸载"每字节边际ISE最小"的载荷来构建预算感知的本地工作集。
AI.result: 在JITOMA-Bench上对四种3DSG构建器进行评估。在渐进式压缩设置下，当载荷字节卸载率达到91%时，池化相对mR@3仍保持100%。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，基于ISE的预算感知卸载能够在极高卸载率下维持任务检索性能，验证了将持久性与驻留性解耦、并利用需求覆盖与可替代性来指导载荷驻留决策的有效性。

title: Type-Balanced Federated Learning for Visual Analog Meter Reading
summary: Analog dial meters are widely deployed in industrial applications and utility sites, where environments and meter types vary and inspection data may be sensitive. Currently, automatic meter readers must be individually developed and deployed for each environment and meter type in practice. Deep learning could handle this variability but requires diverse labeled data that are costly to collect and update. In practice, meter images are distributed across independent sites, each with limited labels, while raw images often cannot be pooled because of ownership, governance, or privacy constraints. To address these challenges, we present a federated framework for visual analog meter reading that enables multiple sites to collaboratively train a reading model without sharing their raw images. Our framework consists of a four-stage pipeline: (1) dial localization, (2) thin-structure segmentation trained federatively across clients, (3) polar unwrapping, and (4) tick-counting decoding for final reading. To enable systematic evaluation of this setting, we release MeterFL, a 1,382-image mask-annotated dataset organized into deployment-motivated pseudo-clients derived from visual attributes via deterministic rules, with dHash near-duplicate control between the segmentation train and test splits. We evaluate both segmentation quality and end-to-end reading accuracy. MeterFL is publicly available at https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL.

AI.tldr: 提出联邦框架实现多站点协作训练模拟表读数模型，无需共享原始图像，并发布MeterFL数据集。
AI.motivation: 模拟表部署环境与类型多样、检查数据敏感，现有自动读表需逐场景定制开发；深度学习虽可应对多样性但依赖昂贵标注，且图像受隐私与治理限制难以集中。
AI.method: 四阶段流水线：表盘定位、跨客户端联邦训练的细结构分割、极坐标展开、刻度计数解码。并发布MeterFL数据集（1382张带掩码标注图像，按视觉属性以确定性规则组织为模拟客户端，训练与测试分割间用dHash近重复控制）。
AI.result: 评估了分割质量和端到端读数精度；MeterFL已公开：https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL。
AI.conclusion: 该联邦框架与配套数据集为隐私受限、多站点的模拟表读数提供了可系统评估的解决方案。

title: Q-WAM: 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models with Action-Subspace Protection
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate video and robot actions through iterative diffusion and perform strongly in robotic manipulation. However, their prohibitive compute and memory costs pose substantial deployment challenges. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce these costs, but existing PTQ methods such as smoothing and rotation are insufficient to maintain the precision of action generation. To overcome this limitation, we propose Q-WAM, a new 4-bit weight-activation quantization for WAMs that preserves the actions the model generates. Specifically, we introduce the \textit{Action Observability Gramian (AOG)}, which measures how much rounding errors in each weighted combination of a layer's input channels change the final action through all denoising steps. We also develop Action-Subspace Protection (ASP), which keeps the few most action-sensitive channel combinations in a tiny 16-bit low-rank branch and quantizes the complementary weights and activations to 4 bits, both as dense matrix multiplications that run efficiently on GPUs. Finally, to preserve action quality with minimal overhead, we identify the experts that matter most for the generated action by aggregating the AOG-derived action mass across the layers of each expert and apply ASP only to those experts. We evaluate Q-WAM on three WAMs, both in simulation and in real-world deployment. On the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, it reaches 89.6--93.0\% average success rate, within 1.1 percentage points of the 16-bit models, while reducing the memory of the quantized blocks by 3.1--3.4$\times$. Our method outperforms the strongest baseline, SVDQuant, by 2.5--8.7 percentage points. On a Unitree G1 humanoid and a bimanual UR3 robot, it improves success over SVDQuant by 12.8-17.6 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Q-WAM，一种面向 World Action Models 的 4-bit 权重-激活后训练量化方法，通过 Action Observability Gramian 和 Action-Subspace Protection 在显著降低显存的同时保持动作生成精度。
AI.motivation: World Action Models 通过迭代扩散联合生成视频与机器人动作，在操作任务上表现优异，但其计算与显存开销巨大，部署困难。现有 PTQ 方法（如平滑、旋转）难以维持动作生成精度，因此需要针对动作生成特性的新型量化方法。
AI.method: 提出 Action Observability Gramian (AOG)，衡量输入通道加权组合的舍入误差经全部去噪步骤后对最终动作的影响；提出 Action-Subspace Protection (ASP)，将少数最动作敏感的通道组合保留在 16-bit 低秩分支，其余权重与激活量化为 4-bit，均以稠密矩阵乘法实现；并通过聚合各专家层的 AOG 动作质量，仅对动作最关键的专家应用 ASP 以降低开销。
AI.result: 在三个 WAM 上仿真与真实部署评估：RoboTwin 2.0 上平均成功率 89.6–93.0%，距 16-bit 模型仅差 1.1 个百分点，量化块显存降低 3.1–3.4×；优于最强基线 SVDQuant 2.5–8.7 个百分点。在 Unitree G1 人形与双臂 UR3 上，成功率较 SVDQuant 提升 12.8–17.6 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Q-WAM 通过动作可观测性和子空间保护实现了高效高精度的 4-bit 量化，证明针对动作生成误差传播的量化设计可有效降低 WAM 部署成本并保持动作质量。

title: TriO: Tri-Modal Unsupervised Occupancy World Model for Anything Perception
summary: We present TriO, a multi-modal unsupervised world model that predicts 4D occupancy, obstacle segmentation, flow and LiDAR. In contrast to prior work, TriO utilizes three distinct sensor modalities (camera, LiDAR, and RADAR) as both inputs and sources of self-supervision, eliminating the need for additional human annotations. Thanks to its novel supervision, the model is able to segment any occupancy from the drivable surface, overcoming the limitations of existing open-set methods in handling long-tail objects. TriO achieves state-of-the-art results in multiple 3D and 4D tasks, including occupancy, flow, and LiDAR prediction, as well as zero-shot road obstacle segmentation across multiple datasets such as Argoverse 2, and Spotting the Unexpected.

AI.tldr: TriO 是一种多模态无监督世界模型，可预测 4D 占据、障碍物分割、光流和 LiDAR，利用相机、LiDAR、RADAR 三种模态同时作为输入与自监督来源，无需人工标注，并在多项 3D/4D 任务上达到最优。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多依赖人工标注，且开放集方法在长尾物体处理上存在局限，难以从可行驶表面中有效分割各类占据区域。
AI.method: TriO 将相机、LiDAR 和 RADAR 三种传感器模态同时用作输入和自监督来源，提出新颖的监督方式，从而无需额外人工标注即可实现占据分割。
AI.result: 在多个 3D 与 4D 任务上取得最优结果，包括占据预测、光流预测、LiDAR 预测，以及在 Argoverse 2、Spotting the Unexpected 等数据集上的零样本道路障碍物分割。
AI.conclusion: TriO 通过多模态自监督消除了人工标注需求，并克服了现有开放集方法在长尾物体上的不足，展现出多任务、跨数据集的强泛化能力。

title: AquaWAM: A Dynamics-aware World Action Model for Underwater Embodied Agents
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) are becoming increasingly important and useful for embodied intelligence, as they enable robots to anticipate the consequences of candidate actions before interacting with the physical environment. However, underwater robots are usually subject to passive dynamics, such as inertia, buoyancy, hydrodynamic drag, and persistent drift, which can continue to affect the vehicle even after an action is completed. Existing WAMs, which primarily predict action-conditioned visual observations, are not explicitly designed to capture such passive motion dynamics. In this paper, we present AquaWAM, the first World Action Model designed for underwater embodied agents. Instead of predicting future images, AquaWAM models both action-conditioned and passive physical dynamics, including the thruster dead band, the inertial glide that outlasts each command, and ambient currents. Specifically, it senses through the DVL, IMU, pressure sensor and joint encoders, while cameras supply only semantics for understanding goals and target pose. By modeling compact navigation states rather than high-dimensional visual observations, AquaWAM substantially reduces the model size and computational cost compared with conventional WAMs. Experimentally, AquaWAM achieves a 72.6% task success rate across 20 underwater tasks on the USIM benchmark, outperforming existing methods while making action decisions 2.7x faster than U0 on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Our model also remains effective when some onboard sensor measurements are unavailable. For example, without DVL velocity measurements, our method still achieves a 61.6% success rate, compared with 39.4% for U0.

AI.tldr: 提出首个面向水下具身智能体的世界动作模型 AquaWAM，建模动作驱动与被动物理动力学，降低模型规模与计算成本，在 USIM 基准 20 个任务上达到 72.6% 成功率。
AI.motivation: 水下机器人常受惯性、浮力、水阻和持续漂移等被动动力学影响，即使动作结束后仍会继续运动；现有世界动作模型主要预测动作条件下的视觉观测，未显式建模这类被动运动动力学，因此不适用于水下场景。
AI.method: AquaWAM 不预测未来图像，而是建模动作驱动与被动物理动力学，包括推进器死区、超出指令持续时间的惯性滑行以及环境水流；通过 DVL、IMU、压力传感器和关节编码器进行感知，相机仅提供理解目标与目标位姿的语义；通过建模紧凑的导航状态而非高维视觉观测来降低模型规模与计算成本。
AI.result: 在 USIM 基准的 20 个水下任务上取得 72.6% 的任务成功率，优于现有方法；在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上动作决策速度比 U0 快 2.7 倍；在部分传感器测量缺失时仍有效，例如缺少 DVL 速度测量时成功率仍达 61.6%，而 U0 仅为 39.4%。
AI.conclusion: AquaWAM 作为首个面向水下具身智能体的世界动作模型，通过显式建模被动动力学和采用紧凑导航状态，在性能、效率与传感器缺失鲁棒性上均优于现有方法。

title: Depth Any Seen: Which Surfaces and How Far?
comment: 54 pages, 31 figures, including appendix. Video demo: https://youtu.be/D8TIzhjq-2Y
summary: When several surfaces are visible along a ray, recovering visible 3D structure from one image requires jointly estimating their presence and metric depth. Depth Any Seen represents these surfaces as image-conditioned multi-Bernoulli depth sets, whose components each contribute one depth or remain absent. Its auxiliary-free Exact Multi-Bernoulli objective (ExactMB) learns depth and presence by marginalizing one-to-one assignments to complete, distinct targets. Our analysis shows that matching expected count can leave component-surface assignment unresolved. We extend real and synthetic layered-depth benchmarks to evaluate depth accuracy, recovered support, and overprediction. Compared to depth stacking, ExactMB reduces overprediction by a relative 88.2% on LD-Real and 80.5% on MD-3K while retaining most ordinal accuracy, with comparable conditional metric-depth error on LD-Syn. Further ablation studies show that ordered assignment improves depth-accurate recall and precision over marginalization, whereas the count-regularized configuration achieves higher deeper-rank precision than ordered assignment at lower recall. Our code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Depth Any Seen，将可见表面建模为图像条件下的多伯努利深度集合，并分析 Exact Multi-Bernoulli（ExactMB）目标在组件–表面分配上的不足。
AI.motivation: 当一条射线穿过多个可见表面时，从单张图像恢复可见 3D 结构需要同时估计表面的存在性与度量深度，而现有方法在组件与表面的一对一对应关系上存在未解决问题。
AI.method: 将多表面表示为图像条件下的多伯努利深度集合，每个组件贡献一个深度或保持缺失；使用无辅助的 Exact Multi-Bernoulli 目标（ExactMB），通过对完整且互异目标的一对一分配进行边缘化来学习深度与存在性；并扩展真实与合成分层深度基准。
AI.result: 相比 depth stacking，ExactMB 在 LD-Real 上相对减少过预测 88.2%，在 MD-3K 上减少 80.5%，同时保留大部分序数精度，在 LD-Syn 上具有可比的条件下度量深度误差；消融显示有序分配相比边缘化提升深度准确的召回与精度，而计数正则配置在更低召回下获得更高的更深秩精度。
AI.conclusion: 匹配期望计数可能无法解决组件–表面分配问题；扩展基准可评估深度精度、恢复支撑与过预测，ExactMB 在显著降低过预测的同时保持较强精度，代码将公开。

title: CompliantWBC: Whole-Body Compliance for Heavy Humanoids via Force Latent Estimation and Residual Impedance Targets
summary: Whole-body compliant control is essential for deploying heavy humanoids under high payload in human-centric environments. Most prior force-aware learning-based pipelines focus on end-effector resistance, per-link upper-body springs, or end-effector stiffness modulation, leaving arbitrary-site perturbations on heavy platforms with lower-body engagement largely unaddressed. We close this gap with CompliantWBC comprising: (1) A base policy trained with RL to maximize compliance-fidelity reward, guided by a multi-site whole-body impedance reference controller, extending classical Cartesian impedance to any controlled link; (2) A bounded residual policy that edits the per-link impedance equilibrium over a frozen base, correcting the coarse but structured wrench estimate supplied by a force encoder co-trained behind a gradient barrier; (3) A Phong-weighted force-origin sampler with an axis-decoupled pelvis anchor induces lower-body-inclusive compliance curriculum training via two interpretable parameters. We evaluate CompliantWBC in simulation against both compliant and stiff baselines, achieving best compliant fidelity of 2.58cm deviation from analytical solutions, and demonstrate it on a real heavy humanoid across static/dynamic force reaction, board wiping, squat under payload, and cooperative payload transport. Project website: https://dotandung.github.io/compliantwbc/

AI.tldr: 提出CompliantWBC全身柔顺控制框架，让重型人形机器人在任意部位受扰动时保持高保真柔顺，并在真机上验证多种任务。
AI.motivation: 重型人形机器人在载重、人机共存环境下需要全身柔顺控制，但已有基于力感知的学习方法多只关注末端阻力、上肢逐连杆弹簧或末端刚度调制，未解决重型平台上任意部位扰动且需下肢参与的问题。
AI.method: CompliantWBC包含三部分：(1) 用RL训练基础策略，以多部位全身阻抗参考控制器引导，最大化柔顺保真奖励，将经典笛卡尔阻抗扩展到任意受控连杆；(2) 有界残差策略在冻结基座上编辑各连杆阻抗平衡点，修正由梯度屏障后共同训练的力编码器提供的粗但结构化的力旋量估计；(3) Phong加权力源采样器与轴解耦骨盆锚点，用两个可解释参数实现含下肢的柔顺课程训练。
AI.result: 仿真中与柔顺和刚性基线对比，取得最佳柔顺保真度，距解析解偏差2.58cm；并在真实重型人形上完成静态/动态受力反应、擦板、载重深蹲和协作搬运载重等任务。
AI.conclusion: CompliantWBC通过RL基础策略、有界残差修正和力源课程采样，实现了任意部位扰动下的全身柔顺控制，兼顾仿真精度与真机多任务泛化能力。

title: ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding
summary: We introduce ScreenHaystack, a dynamic needle-in-a-haystack benchmark for evaluating spatial reliability in GUI grounding. Instead of testing each target at a fixed position, ScreenHaystack systematically relocates controlled target icons across high-resolution GUI backgrounds and measures whether models can localize them consistently. Using this benchmark, we find that leading GUI grounding models, including Qwen3-VL, UI-TARS, GTA, and UI-Venus, exhibit blind zones: spatial regions where grounding accuracy drops sharply despite fixed target appearance and instruction. These blind zones transfer to unseen ScreenSpot-Pro examples: targets inside blind zones are consistently harder to ground, with Qwen3-VL-8B dropping by 16.1 percentage points, and controlled relocation shows that moving targets into blind zones decreases accuracy while moving them out improves accuracy. We further show through controlled synthetic experiments that uneven spatial coverage in training data can induce such blind zones. Therefore, we propose a simple strategy, blind-zone-oriented augmentation, which adds supervision in blind zones and improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy over both original and randomly augmented Click-100k fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ScreenHaystack 基准，系统性移动目标图标以评估 GUI grounding 模型的空间可靠性，发现主流模型存在"盲区"，并证明可通过盲区导向的数据增强缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI grounding 评测多在固定位置测试目标，无法反映模型在不同空间位置上的可靠性差异，可能掩盖模型在特定区域定位能力严重下降的问题。
AI.method: 构建 ScreenHaystack 动态 needle-in-a-haystack 基准：在高分辨率 GUI 背景中系统性地重新放置受控目标图标，测量模型定位的一致性与准确性；并通过受控合成实验分析盲区成因，进而提出盲区导向增强策略。
AI.result: Qwen3-VL、UI-TARS、GTA、UI-Venus 等模型均表现出盲区；盲区可迁移至 ScreenSpot-Pro，Qwen3-VL-8B 在盲区内目标上准确率下降 16.1 个百分点；受控移动目标进入盲区降低准确率，移出则提升；训练数据空间覆盖不均会导致盲区。
AI.conclusion: GUI grounding 模型存在位置相关的盲区，且由训练数据空间分布不均引起；盲区导向的数据增强相比原始及随机增强的 Click-100k 微调可提升 ScreenSpot-Pro 准确率。

title: SocialHumanoid: Towards Expressive Humanoid Behavior via One-Step Co-Speech Motion Generation
summary: Humanoid robots are increasingly expected to serve as embodied social agents that communicate naturally with humans through face-to-face interaction. During such communication, humanoid robots require body behaviors that are synchronized with speech, affectively expressive, and suitable for real-time execution. However, existing co-speech methods are primarily developed for digital humans and lack joint support for affective control and low-latency continuous generation on physical embodiments. To bridge this gap, we present SocialHumanoid, a system for expressive humanoid behavior via one-step co-speech motion generation. Given response speech and a specified affective condition, SocialHumanoid generates each full-body motion window in a single forward pass and connects successive windows through motion-history conditioning. The generated human motion is further converted online into embodiment-compatible robot references and tracked by a whole-body controller for physical execution. To provide explicit supervision for affective body expression, we further introduce AffectMoCap, a 4-hour dataset captured from two professional actors, containing synchronized speech, body motion, fine-grained hand motion, and emotion annotations. On BEAT2, SocialHumanoid achieves the best FGD among the compared generation methods, competitive speech-motion synchrony, and approximately $6\times$ faster inference than GestureLSM under the same protocol. Perceptual evaluations further show that training with AffectMoCap improves affect recognition from generated body motion, while real-robot experiments demonstrate continuous affect-conditioned behavior and stable long-horizon execution. Our project page is https://rex0191.github.io/SocialHumanoid/.

AI.tldr: 提出 SocialHumanoid 系统，实现一句话情感可控、单步生成的类人机器人共语身体行为，并支持实时物理执行。
AI.motivation: 类人机器人需具备与语音同步、富有情感表达且能实时执行的身体行为，但现有共语动作方法多面向数字人，缺乏情感控制与低延迟连续生成在物理实体上的联合支持。
AI.method: 给定回复语音与指定情感条件，单次前向生成每个全身动作窗口，并通过动作历史条件连接相邻窗口；生成的人体动作在线转换为机器人可用的参考，由全身控制器跟踪执行。同时构建 AffectMoCap，一个 4 小时、两名专业演员、含同步语音、身体动作、精细手部动作与情感标注的数据集。
AI.result: 在 BEAT2 上取得对比方法中最优 FGD、有竞争力的语音-动作同步性，推理速度约为 GestureLSM 的 6 倍；感知评估显示 AffectMoCap 训练提升生成动作的情感识别；真实机器人实验展示连续情感条件行为与稳定长时执行。
AI.conclusion: SocialHumanoid 通过单步共语动作生成与情感数据监督，实现了类人机器人表达性、实时且长时稳定的情感化身体行为。

title: ControlGS: Conditioning Neural Gaussians for Downstream-Processing-Aware XR Rendering
comment: Accepted to Siggraph Asia'26, 36 pages, poject page: https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/
summary: Extended Reality (XR) users do not directly perceive the output of a rendering engine. Instead, rendered images pass through a post-processing pipeline and the physical display-optics path before reaching the eye. Critically, the exact downstream processing can vary significantly at run time, influenced by, for instance, camera pose and display power budget. Traditional 3DGS methods either implicitly assume that this downstream pipeline preserves image quality or cannot adapt to downstream processing changes. To bridge this gap, we present ControlGS, an XR Gaussian rendering pipeline that optimizes end-to-end visual quality. ControlGS models and integrates the entire downstream processing, between the rendering output and the human eye, into the optimization objective. To adapt to downstream processing at run time, ControlGS dynamically generates Gaussian primitives conditioned upon the downstream processing parameters. Experiments show that ControlGS consistently improves end-to-end post-optics XR quality across different neural Gaussian backbones and datasets, with minimal overhead. Code is available at https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/.

AI.tldr: ControlGS 提出一种面向 XR 的 3D 高斯渲染管线，将渲染输出到人眼之间的完整下游处理链纳入优化目标，并根据下游处理参数动态生成高斯原语，从而在运行时实现端到端视觉质量优化。
AI.motivation: XR 用户看到的并非渲染引擎的直接输出，图像还需经过后处理管线和物理显示—光学路径才能到达眼睛。而这一下游处理在运行时会发生显著变化（如受相机位姿、显示功耗预算影响）。传统 3DGS 方法要么默认下游管线不损害画质，要么无法适应下游处理的变化，因此存在端到端质量优化的缺口。
AI.method: ControlGS 将渲染输出与人眼之间的整个下游处理过程建模并集成到优化目标中；为了在运行时适应下游处理，它以下游处理参数为条件，动态生成高斯原语。
AI.result: 在不同神经高斯骨干网络和数据集上，ControlGS 均能持续提升端到端的光学后 XR 质量，且额外开销极小。
AI.conclusion: ControlGS 通过端到端建模下游处理并动态条件化高斯生成，有效弥合了 3DGS 与 XR 实际显示链路之间的差距，在保持低开销的同时提升了 XR 视觉质量。代码已开源。

title: Traceable Human-to-Humanoid Sign Language Benchmarking
summary: Sign data collection is costly, and teleoperation scales poorly, motivating reuse of large video corpora. Humanoid signing requires converting video-derived human motion into robot trajectories while preserving linguistic motion cues. Errors from fitting, human-motion repair, retargeting, robot geometry repair, and control are hard to separate from the final trajectory alone. We introduce HumanoidCSL-20K, a dataset and benchmark of 20,648 sentence-level Chinese Sign Language sequences, each with four aligned versions: the source, the repaired human motion, the direct robot reference, and the geometry-repaired robot reference. Observation-supported local human-motion repair, full-robot geometry repair, and cross-representation provenance make each transformation traceable. Paired evaluations measure human-motion continuity and content preservation, robot-reference feasibility, and physical execution. A sign-specific kinematic-reference protocol scores handshape, location, palm orientation, and inter-hand relation over the full planned motion. Full-corpus results show fewer abnormal arm / hand steps and less inter-hand and hand-body penetration after repair. Control experiments separate reference learnability from curriculum effects, while component scores expose remaining execution errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HumanoidCSL-20K 数据集与基准，包含 20,648 条句级中文手语序列，每条含源视频、修复后人体运动、直接机器人参考和几何修复后机器人参考四个对齐版本，用于溯源式评估人形机器人手语生成。
AI.motivation: 手语数据采集成本高、遥操作难以规模化，因此需要复用大规模视频语料；但将视频中的人体运动转化为机器人轨迹时，拟合、人体运动修复、重定向、机器人几何修复与控制等多环节误差难以从最终轨迹中区分，缺乏可溯源的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建 HumanoidCSL-20K 数据集与基准，每条序列提供四种对齐版本（源视频、修复人体运动、直接机器人参考、几何修复机器人参考），通过观测支持的局部人体运动修复、全机器人几何修复和跨表示溯源使每个变换可追踪；提出手语专用运动学参考协议，对全程规划运动中的手型、位置、手掌朝向和双手关系打分；并进行配对评估与控制实验。
AI.result: 全语料结果显示，经修复后异常手臂/手部步态更少，双手间及手-身体穿透减少；控制实验将参考可学习性与课程效应分离，各分量得分揭示了残余的执行误差。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集与基准为视频驱动的人形机器人手语生成提供了可溯源、可分解的评估框架，能够定位各处理环节的误差来源并量化执行质量。

title: Amnesia by Design, Memory By Necessity: Persistent State for Document Intelligence
summary: Modern Document AI reads contracts, extracts fields, reasons over tables, and grounds answers to page regions, then forgets everything. Processing an amendment the next day begins from scratch: no schema retained, no contradiction detected, no experience carried forward. This is a structural choice, not a scale failure: current systems are stateless functions. We call this the statelessness bottleneck. This bottleneck lies beyond parameter scaling, context extension, and retrieval augmentation: storage provides persistence and retrieval provides access, but neither consolidates observations into knowledge that improves future processing. This survey formalizes persistent evidence-grounded document state as a unifying framework, specifying the operations and invariants required to convert multimodal evidence into durable, provenance-linked state. We introduce a statefulness audit showing that ten representative benchmarks, coded against eight statefulness criteria, leave cross-session state evolution untested, and derive a longitudinal benchmark harness with five counterfactual metrics: Experience Gain, Cost Efficiency, Memory Harm, Forgetting Fidelity, Coverage Retention, to characterize the benefit, cost, risk, and governability of persistent document state. Document AI lacks mechanisms coupling persistent state to document-native structure, provenance, and temporal validity. The next era of Document AI will be defined by what systems retain across documents, sessions, and time.
