AI.tldr: 本文指出当前文档AI系统本质上是无状态函数，存在"无状态瓶颈"，并提出以持久化、可溯源的多模态文档状态为统一框架，配合状态性审计和纵向评测指标来推动文档AI进入跨文档、跨会话、跨时间的持久状态时代。
AI.motivation: 现代文档AI能读取合同、抽取字段、推理表格并定位答案，但处理完即遗忘。第二天处理修订版本时需从零开始，既不保留schema，也不检测矛盾，更不积累经验。这种无状态性是结构性设计选择，而非模型规模问题，且无法通过参数扩展、上下文扩展或检索增强来根治——存储只提供持久性、检索只提供访问，都无法把观察结果整合为可提升未来处理能力的知识。
AI.method: 论文以综述形式将"持久化、基于证据的文档状态"形式化为统一框架，明确规定将多模态证据转化为持久、溯源关联状态所需的操作与不变量；并提出状态性审计方法，用八项状态性标准来评估现有基准，同时推导出纵向基准测试框架。
AI.result: 状态性审计显示，十个代表性基准在八项状态性标准下均未测试跨会话的状态演化；据此提出的纵向基准框架包含五个反事实指标：经验增益、成本效率、记忆危害、遗忘保真度、覆盖保留，用以刻画持久文档状态的收益、成本、风险与可治理性。
AI.conclusion: 文档AI目前缺乏将持久状态与文档原生结构、溯源信息及时间有效性相耦合的机制。文档AI的下一个时代将由系统在跨文档、跨会话和跨时间维度上"保留什么"来定义。

title: Recursive Harness Distillation across Agents for Robot Manipulation
summary: A central goal in robotics is to enable manipulation across changing tasks and environments. Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad manipulation capabilities but can struggle when execution requires diagnosing failures and adapting behavior. Strong agents can discover effective interventions through interaction with these policies. We propose Recursive Harness Distillation to accumulate this experience as reusable guidance across agents. A strong agent distills its experience into a playbook for a light agent, then recursively refines the playbook using the light agent's execution feedback. The resulting playbook enables agents to reuse accumulated intervention knowledge in new task instances without updating model parameters. In real-world manipulation, the harness improves success from 37.3% to 64.0%. On SimplerEnv Bridge, the light agent with the playbook achieves 66.7% success, compared with 41.7% for the GR00T-only baseline, and outperforms the strong agent without a playbook. The same playbook also benefits the strong agent, which reaches 79.2% success. These results demonstrate the feasibility of harness distillation for robotics: intervention experience can be accumulated, refined through execution, and reused across agents to improve manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出"递归式执行框架蒸馏"（Recursive Harness Distillation），将强智能体的干预经验蒸馏为可复用的"操作手册"（playbook），并通过轻量智能体的执行反馈递归精炼，从而在无需更新模型参数的情况下提升视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的操作能力。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作需在变化的任务与环境中泛化。VLA模型虽具备广泛操作能力，但在需要诊断失败并调整行为的执行场景中表现欠佳。强智能体可通过与策略交互发现有效干预，但这类经验难以积累与复用。因此作者希望将干预经验沉淀为可跨智能体复用的引导知识。
AI.method: 提出递归式执行框架蒸馏（Recursive Harness Distillation）：强智能体将自身经验蒸馏为供轻量智能体使用的"操作手册"（playbook），再利用轻量智能体的执行反馈对该手册进行递归精炼。最终手册使智能体在新任务实例中复用积累的干预知识，且不更新模型参数。
AI.result: 真实世界操作任务成功率从37.3%提升至64.0%。在SimplerEnv Bridge上，配备手册的轻量智能体达到66.7%成功率，而仅用GR00T的基线为41.7%，并优于无手册的强智能体；同一手册也使强智能体受益，成功率达79.2%。
AI.conclusion: 证明了"执行框架蒸馏"在机器人领域的可行性：干预经验可被积累、通过执行过程精炼，并跨智能体复用以提升操作性能。

title: ReFM: Semantic-Aware Refinement Flow Model for Motion Retargeting
summary: Motion retargeting transfers motion across characters with different skeletal structures while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility. Despite recent progress, two fundamental questions remain: (i) how can reliable source-motion semantics be learned without high-quality paired retargeting data, and (ii) how should retargeting be formulated when no reliable paired motion can serve as a definitive regression objective? Existing methods commonly preserve semantics by constraining predictions toward copied motions. However, such initializations entangle useful articulation cues with artifacts caused by mismatched skeletal proportions and body geometry. Moreover, directly regressing a final motion in one forward pass is restrictive because retargeting is inherently underdetermined, and the desired solution must balance semantic fidelity with target-specific physical and temporal constraints rather than match a unique paired target. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ReFM, a source-mesh-agnostic, energy-guided model that reformulates motion retargeting as progressive refinement. First, an SO(3) canonicalizer removes redundant global-orientation variations. Second, a cross-character semantic encoder, pretrained through contrastive learning, provides a character-invariant representation for both optimization guidance and semantic evaluation. ReFM then progressively refines an initialized target motion through a learned flow guided by semantic consistency, physical plausibility, temporal coherence, and minimal motion modification. The framework is compatible with different initialization strategies, including both direct motion copying and Autodesk HumanIK, an industry-standard full-body inverse-kinematics retargeting system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReFM，一种与源网格无关、能量引导的运动重定向模型，将运动重定向重构为渐进式精修过程，通过学习流并结合语义一致、物理合理、时间连贯与最小修改等约束逐步优化目标运动。
AI.motivation: 现有运动重定向方法通过将预测约束到复制运动来保持语义，但这会将有用的关节线索与因骨骼比例和身体几何不匹配产生的伪影纠缠在一起。此外，直接一次前向回归最终运动具有限制性，因为重定向本质上是欠定的，理想解需在语义保真与目标特定的物理和时间约束间取得平衡，而非匹配唯一的配对目标。因此论文关注两个问题：(i) 如何在缺乏高质量配对重定向数据时学习可靠的源运动语义；(ii) 当没有可靠配对运动作为明确回归目标时，应如何表述重定向问题。
AI.method: ReFM 包含三部分：1) 使用 SO(3) 规范化器去除冗余的全局朝向变化；2) 通过对比学习预训练的跨角色语义编码器，为优化引导和语义评估提供角色不变表示；3) 通过学习的流对初始化目标运动进行渐进式精修，引导信号包括语义一致性、物理合理性、时间连贯性和最小运动修改。该框架兼容多种初始化策略，包括直接运动复制和工业标准全身逆运动学重定向系统 Autodesk HumanIK。
AI.result: 摘要总结了该方法的设计与框架特性，提到其与直接运动复制和 Autodesk HumanIK 等初始化策略兼容。
AI.conclusion: ReFM 将运动重定向重新表述为渐进式精修问题，通过能量引导和角色不变语义表示，避免了对高质量配对重定向数据的依赖，并克服了单次回归的局限性，为跨角色运动重定向提供了一种与源网格无关的新范式。

title: Large Language Models for Model-Based Robot Design
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can contribute useful engineering knowledge to robot design, but directly generated designs may rely on implicit assumptions and provide no guarantees of feasibility or optimality. These assumptions are critical because different reasonable modeling choices can materially change which designs are predicted to be feasible or optimal. We therefore present a framework that uses LLMs to construct explicit engineering models containing physical relationships, compatibility constraints, and objectives, allowing these modeling choices to be inspected and revised before formal optimization. The model can then be updated with additional engineering, manufacturer, or system-specific information before formal multi-objective optimization provides feasibility and Pareto-optimality guarantees with respect to the finalized model and specified design space. We evaluate the framework on quadcopter and line-following robot component-selection problems. Across 30 direct LLM design trials, none could be verified as feasible under the corresponding finalized model. Comparisons with an independently developed expert model and successive stages of model refinement further showed that changes in modeling assumptions substantially altered the predicted feasible and Pareto-optimal design sets. Together, these results show that using LLMs to construct explicit engineering models makes the underlying design choices available for inspection and revision before those assumptions determine the optimized designs. Explicit modeling therefore provides an interface for combining LLM-generated engineering knowledge, system-specific information, and formal design optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个框架：用LLM构建显式工程模型（物理关系、兼容性约束、目标），在正式多目标优化前可检查修正建模假设，从而获得可行性与帕累托最优性保证。
AI.motivation: 直接用LLM生成机器人设计方案会依赖隐含假设，且无法保证可行性或最优性；不同合理的建模选择会实质性地改变预测的可行或最优设计。
AI.method: 用LLM构建包含物理关系、兼容性约束与目标的显式工程模型，允许在形式化优化前检查并修改建模选择；模型可加入工程、制造商或系统特定信息，再进行多目标优化，得到相对最终模型与给定设计空间的可行性与Pareto最优性保证。
AI.result: 在四旋翼和循迹机器人部件选择问题上评估。30次直接LLM设计试验均无法在对应最终模型下被验证为可行；与独立开发的专家模型及各阶段模型细化的比较显示，建模假设的变化显著改变了预测的可行与Pareto最优设计集合。
AI.conclusion: 用LLM构建显式工程模型，使底层设计选择在决定优化设计之前可被检查与修改；显式建模为结合LLM工程知识、系统特定信息与形式化设计优化提供了接口。

title: Gaussian Image Steganography via Parameter-Domain Keyed Embeddings
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables; 2-page supplementary material in ancillary files. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
summary: 2D Gaussian-based image representation is becoming increasingly popular, and our work proposes a new approach to steganography by embedding information within Gaussian parameters rather than image pixels. We first fit the parameters of this representation to the target image and employ a secret key to select a subset of these parameters for fine-tuning, allowing us to embed an 8-bit message while maintaining high visual fidelity in the reconstructed image. Thirty fitting experiments on three synthetic images show that the correct key can recover the message without error, while decoding with incorrect keys yields a Bit Error Rate (BER) of $0.543$, close to random guessing. Compared with random selection using the key, selecting the least-disturbing edits recovers the message more reliably (one-sided $p=0.031$), and the average PSNR cost is only $0.091$ dB in visual quality. The embedding method transfers to 112 natural images at $256\times256$ using 4,096 Gaussians. The correct-key BER is $0.000$, and decoding under a wrong key stays close to random guessing at $0.520$. Our method embeds the payload through three Gaussian parameter types: log-anisotropy, opacity, and color luminance. In a separate nine-fit reduced setting, color luminance is removed, so the payload uses two instead of three parameter types, a $33.3\%$ reduction; all 256 Gaussians remain in the fitted representation. The correct key still recovers the message without error. However, wrong-key BER rises from $0.514$ to $0.571$, moving farther from random guessing ($0.5$).

AI.tldr: 提出在2D高斯表示的高斯参数中嵌入信息而非像素的隐写方法，通过密钥选取子集微调嵌入8位消息，在合成与自然图像上均可无误恢复，错误密钥接近随机猜测。
AI.motivation: 2D高斯图像表示日益流行，但现有隐写多在像素层面进行。本文希望利用高斯参数作为新的信息载体，在保持重建图像高视觉保真度的同时实现消息嵌入。
AI.method: 先对目标图像拟合高斯表示参数，用密钥选择部分参数进行微调以嵌入8位消息；通过三类高斯参数（对数各向异性、不透明度、颜色亮度）承载信息。选择扰动最小的编辑，并与随机选择进行对比；另在九次拟合的缩减设置中移除颜色亮度，仅用两类参数。
AI.result: 三张合成图像30次拟合中，正确密钥可零错误恢复，错误密钥BER为0.543（接近随机）；最小扰动选择比随机选择恢复更可靠（单侧p=0.031），平均PSNR代价仅0.091 dB。迁移到112张256×256自然图像（4096个高斯），正确密钥BER=0.000，错误密钥BER=0.520。缩减设置下正确密钥仍无误恢复，但错误密钥BER从0.514升至0.571，更远离随机猜测。
AI.conclusion: 在高斯参数中嵌入信息是一种可行且高保真的隐写方案，密钥可可靠区分正确与错误解码；减少承载参数类型会削弱错误密钥下的随机性表现，说明参数类型选择对安全性有影响。

title: VIDEAS: Distilling Explicit Action Semantics from Demonstration Videos for World Models via Prior-Guided Simulation
summary: World models learn internal representations of environment dynamics to predict future states, enabling agents to optimize action plans without physical interactions. However, developing world models that genuinely internalize underlying causal physical laws to explicitly reason about action preconditions and subsequent state transitions remains an open challenge. In this paper, we propose VIDEAS, a data distillation framework that transforms continuous physical dynamics from operational videos into explicit action semantics for foundation models. Specifically, it deconstructs visual demonstrations into discrete action trajectories and utilizes advanced vision-language models (VLMs) to extract structured knowledge encapsulating action preconditions and effects. To ensure physical consistency, we introduce a prior-guided trajectory simulation mechanism grounded within a text-based environment to rigorously validate the extracted knowledge. Notably, we incorporate negative trajectories to enrich knowledge completeness and enhance data diversity to mitigate cognitive bias. Furthermore, we present VIDEAS-WM, an 8B/9B-parameter suite of language-based world models trained on 34K high-quality samples derived from AgiBot-World dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VIDEAS-WM establishes state-of-the-art performance in high-level embodied action semantic reasoning, exhibiting profound physical understanding and robust generalization across unseen scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VIDEAS数据蒸馏框架，将操作视频中的连续物理动态转化为基础模型可用的显式动作语义，并基于此训练出VIDEAS-WM世界模型套件，在高层次具身动作语义推理上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型虽能预测未来状态，但难以真正内化底层因果物理规律，无法显式推理动作前提条件与后续状态转移。
AI.method: VIDEAS将视觉演示分解为离散动作轨迹，利用视觉语言模型提取包含动作前提与效果的结构化知识；引入基于文本环境的先验引导轨迹模拟机制验证物理一致性；加入负轨迹以提升知识完整性与数据多样性、缓解认知偏差。基于AgiBot-World数据集生成34K高质量样本，训练出8B/9B参数的VIDEAS-WM语言世界模型套件。
AI.result: 大量实验表明VIDEAS-WM在高层次具身动作语义推理上达到当前最优性能，展现出深刻的物理理解能力及对未见场景的良好泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式动作语义蒸馏与物理一致性验证，可有效构建具备因果物理理解与强泛化能力的语言世界模型。

title: CausalDriveBench: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving produce natural-language reasoning alongside predicted trajectories, but whether this reasoning reflects the causal structure of the scene remains untested. We introduce CausalDriveBench, an evaluation framework grounded in Pearl's Causal Hierarchy (PCH) that tests causal reasoning in driving-specific VLAs through structured visual question answering (QA) and alternative-trajectory prediction. To this end, we construct causal scene graphs over nuScenes that distinguish causally active, dormant, and distractor entities, separating perceptual salience from causal relevance. The benchmark spans all four rungs of PCH (association, intervention, and counterfactual along with causal discovery) for QA generation. For the higher rungs, we additionally provide reference trajectories under specified scene modifications, enabling action-level verification that complements reasoning-level evaluation. In total, the benchmark contains 7,285 verified causal QA pairs and 1,000 counterfactual trajectories derived from nuScenes. We evaluate 10 driving-specific VLAs and 3 general-purpose VLMs, and report three findings. First, the best model reaches only 70.6% QA accuracy, and 4 of 13 models score below random chance. Second, comparing each driving VLA to the general-purpose VLM that shares its language backbone, the cost of driving fine-tuning ranges from 2 to 34 percentage points on causal QA, with post-training design explaining the spread. Third, causal QA and trajectory accuracy are statistically uncorrelated across models: under counterfactual prompts, predicted trajectories either over-react or collapse onto the observed-scene baseline. Taken together, these results show that neither fluent rationales nor accurate observed-scene trajectories constitute evidence of causal understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CausalDriveBench，基于 Pearl 因果层级构建驾驶场景因果评测基准，包含 7285 对因果问答与 1000 条反事实轨迹，评测 13 个模型后发现现有 VLA 的因果理解能力严重不足。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶 VLA 模型虽能输出自然语言推理与预测轨迹，但其推理是否真正反映场景的因果结构尚缺乏检验，需要专门的因果评测框架来区分感知显著性与因果相关性。
AI.method: 在 nuScenes 上构建因果场景图，区分因果活跃、休眠与干扰实体；基于 Pearl 因果层级（关联、干预、反事实及因果发现）生成结构化视觉问答，并为高层级提供场景修改下的参考轨迹，实现推理级与动作级双重验证，共含 7285 个问答对与 1000 条反事实轨迹。
AI.result: 评测 10 个驾驶专用 VLA 与 3 个通用 VLM：最佳模型因果问答准确率仅 70.6%，13 个模型中有 4 个低于随机水平；与共享语言主干的通用 VLM 相比，驾驶微调的因果问答代价为 2–34 个百分点，差异由后训练设计决定；因果问答与轨迹准确率在模型间统计不相关，反事实提示下轨迹要么过度反应要么坍缩到观测场景基线。
AI.conclusion: 流畅的推理文本与准确的观测场景轨迹都不构成因果理解的证据，现有驾驶 VLA 的因果推理与动作预测存在系统性脱节。

title: AMBIT: Anticipatory Multimodal Body Recruitment for Bimanual Tracking on a Humanoid
summary: A humanoid with 5-DoF arms cannot track generic bimanual end-effector trajectories with its arms alone; pelvis and waist motion must be recruited, but which motion, and when, is not uniquely determined. On a Unitree R1 in fixed double support, the set of dynamically valid recruitment strategies (pelvis pose and waist trajectories) for a task is a diverse continuous manifold, and a deterministic regressor trained on it mode-averages into strategies valid only 35% of the time, against 52% for a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) and 82% for the best of 16 CVAE samples. We introduce AMBIT: the CVAE proposes strategies from a preview of the commanded trajectory, a non-learned selector filters, ranks and verifies them, and a receding-horizon loop commits to one with hysteresis. The committed strategy is the reference of the same whole-body differential-IK QP a reactive tracker runs, which keeps authority over residual error. On 160 held-out episodes that admit a valid strategy, in full MuJoCo dynamics under a torque controller, AMBIT reaches 85% success at a 3 cm/15 deg tolerance against 74% for the tracker (disjoint confidence intervals) and recruits the body before the arms saturate in 48% of episodes against 35%. Because diversity is preserved, constraints unknown at training time are enforced by selection alone: under five zero-shot shifts AMBIT beats the warm-started tracker on every shift and matches a test-time re-optimisation baseline 17x more expensive. On a Unitree G1, with hyperparameters unchanged, the protocol reproduces the structure of the valid set and widens the gap over the tracker to 0.85 against 0.53. Five selected strategies execute on the externally supported physical R1, distinct in pelvis excursion and tracking the planned end-effector motion to a median of 11 mm by encoder forward kinematics, which establishes kinematic realisability, not balance.

AI.tldr: 提出AMBIT框架：用CVAE生成多样化的全身协同策略，配合非学习选择器与滚动时域决策，解决5自由度臂人形机器人双臂轨迹跟踪中的冗余问题。
AI.motivation: 5-DoF双臂人形机器人无法仅靠手臂跟踪一般双臂末端轨迹，必须调动骨盆与腰部运动，但具体何种运动、何时运动并不唯一。现有确定性回归器在多样连续策略流形上会发生模式平均，导致策略有效率仅35%。
AI.method: AMBIT由CVAE基于指令轨迹预览生成候选策略，非学习的选择器进行过滤、排序与验证，滚动时域循环带滞回地提交一个策略；该策略作为全身微分IK二次规划（QP）的参考，反应式跟踪器保留残差误差控制权。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo全动力学力矩控制下，160个有效测试片段中，AMBIT在3 cm/15度容差下成功率达85%，高于跟踪器74%；48%片段中在手臂饱和前调动躯干，高于35%。五种零样本偏移下均优于跟踪器，并匹配17倍昂贵的测试时重优化基线。Unitree G1上差距扩大至0.85对0.53。物理R1上五种策略中位跟踪误差11 mm。
AI.conclusion: 保留策略多样性使选择器可单独执行训练时未知约束，AMBIT在仿真与硬件上均超越反应式跟踪器，验证了运动学可实现性（非平衡性）。

title: PruneForget: Joint Unlearning and Pruning of Vision Models
summary: Machine unlearning and model pruning are increasingly coupled in the real world. Models must support unlearning requests, e.g., for safety concerns, while also meeting requirements in latency and memory budget. Until recently, existing works have studied each aspect as an independent problem, e.g., running unlearning and pruning sequentially. In this work, we show that unlearning and pruning are naturally aligned and should be solved jointly to be made aware of each other. Intuitively, parameters that encode information of the unlearned samples are natural pruning targets, as unlearning and pruning both call for the "deletion" of such parameters. We propose PruneForget, a method that uses the unlearn set as a guide for pruning, so that unlearning and pruning mutually benefit each other. Extensive experiments on image classifiers and generative models show that PruneForget removes the influence of the unlearned samples while producing a more compact model with reduced inference cost. It achieves a negligible performance gap relative to an oracle that retrains from scratch for unlearning and then prunes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PruneForget，将机器遗忘与模型剪枝联合求解，用遗忘集引导剪枝，使二者相互受益。
AI.motivation: 现实中模型既需支持遗忘请求（如安全考量），又需满足延迟与内存预算。既有工作将遗忘与剪枝各自独立处理（如顺序执行），未意识到二者内在一致——都需要"删除"编码遗忘样本信息的参数。
AI.method: 提出PruneForget：将遗忘集用作剪枝的引导信号，把编码被遗忘样本信息的参数作为天然剪枝目标，从而在统一框架下让遗忘与剪枝相互促进。
AI.result: 在图像分类器与生成模型上的大量实验表明，PruneForget既消除了被遗忘样本的影响，又生成更紧凑、推理成本更低的模型，性能与"从头重训后剪枝"的oracle方案差距可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘与剪枝天然对齐，应联合求解并相互感知；PruneForget验证了该思路的有效性，能以极低性能损失同时实现遗忘与模型压缩。

title: AI-Driven Collaborative Assembly Line Inspection: System Integration and Deployment Challenges
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 22nd International Conference on Mobile Web and Intelligent Information Systems (MobiWIS 2026)
summary: Manual visual inspection on assembly lines is a persistent manufacturing bottleneck: operator fatigue over extended shifts lowers defect-detection rates. This paper presents the design, integration, and field deployment of an AI-assisted collaborative inspection cell at the Silverline kitchen-appliance factory, developed within the AI-PRISM project. The cell couples a Universal Robots UR 10e cobot carrying a machine-vision defect-detection pipeline with a Comau Racer-5 cobot for functional tests, coordinated through ROS 2 Humble on an Ubuntu 22.04 LTS server. Multi-modal data (Basler camera imagery, TIA microphone acoustics, and SPS electrical-safety measurements) are logged locally and visualised in real time with Grafana. We report the practical deployment challenges (close-proximity safety, AI robustness under glare and reflections, ROS 2 namespace collisions across two cobots, and operating-system and dependency issues) together with the engineering solutions adopted, and structure the integration through a four-level Human-Robot Interaction analysis. The deployed cell cuts per-unit quality-check time from 82 s to 61 s (about 25%), raises final-control resource efficiency from 0.75 to 0.88, reduces operator visual-inspection viewing time by 82%, and significantly lowers operator mental demand (p = 0.005, NASA-TLX).

AI.tldr: 本文设计并实地部署了一个AI辅助协作检测单元（UR 10e机械臂+机器视觉检测、Comau Racer-5功能测试，ROS 2 Humble协调），单件质检时间由82 s降至61 s（约25%），最终检测资源效率由0.75升至0.88，操作员视觉检测时间减少82%，心理负荷显著下降（p=0.005, NASA-TLX）。
AI.motivation: 装配线上的手工目视检测是长期存在的制造瓶颈：操作员在长时间轮班中产生疲劳，导致缺陷检出率下降。因此需要引入AI辅助的协作检测方案以缓解疲劳、提升检测效率与质量。
AI.method: 在AI-PRISM项目框架下，于Silverline厨房家电工厂构建协作检测单元：由UR 10e协作机器人搭载机器视觉缺陷检测流水线，Comau Racer-5协作机器人执行功能测试，通过Ubuntu 22.04 LTS服务器上的ROS 2 Humble进行协调；多模态数据（Basler相机图像、TIA麦克风声学、SPS电气安全测量）本地记录并用Grafana实时可视化；采用四级人机交互分析框架组织系统集成，并记录实际部署挑战（近距离安全、眩光反射下AI鲁棒性、双机器人ROS 2命名空间冲突、操作系统与依赖问题）及相应工程解决方案。
AI.result: 部署后的检测单元将单件质检时间从82 s缩短至61 s（约25%）；最终控制资源效率从0.75提升至0.88；操作员目视检测时间减少82%；操作员心理负荷显著降低（p = 0.005，NASA-TLX）。
AI.conclusion: 该AI辅助协作检测单元在真实工厂环境中成功部署，在提升检测效率与资源利用率的同时显著降低了操作员的视觉检测负担与心理负荷，验证了多机器人协作与多模态数据融合方案在工业质检场景中的可行性与实用性。

title: PQR3D: Progressive Query Refinement over Reference-Conditioned Temporal Windows for Multi-View 3D Object Detection
summary: Temporal context is essential for camera-only multi-view 3D object detection. Existing streaming detectors maintain and propagate query states from one frame to the next, requiring sequence-aware training and chronological inference. We propose PQR3D, which performs progressive query refinement within referenceconditioned temporal windows. This design enables random frame sampling and independent inference without persistent query memory. Within each window, PQR3D progressively transfers motion-aligned high-confidence queries from earlier timestamps toward the target frame. We further introduce masked selfattention to regulate interactions among regular, propagated, and denoising queries while keeping denoising supervision isolated from detection queries. In addition, a stage-decoupled anchor embedding injects position before self-attention and size, orientation, and velocity afterward, reducing interference from temporally inconsistent attributes. With a ViT-L backbone, PQR3D sets a new state of the art on the nuScenes test set, achieving 71.6 NDS and 64.9 mAP. Source code is available at https://github.com/huiyegit/PQR3D

AI.tldr: PQR3D 提出一种在参考条件时间窗口内进行渐进式查询精炼的纯视觉多视角3D检测框架，摆脱了对持久查询记忆和按时序推理的依赖。
AI.motivation: 时序上下文对纯视觉多视角3D检测至关重要，但现有流式检测器需要跨帧维护并传播查询状态，导致必须进行序列感知训练和严格按时间顺序推理，限制了训练与推理的灵活性。
AI.method: 在参考条件时间窗口内做渐进式查询精炼，允许随机帧采样与独立推理；将早期高置信度查询经运动对齐后逐步传递至目标帧；引入掩码自注意力规范常规查询、传播查询与去噪查询间的交互，并将去噪监督与检测查询隔离；提出阶段解耦锚点嵌入，在自注意力前注入位置信息，之后注入尺寸、朝向和速度，减少时间不一致属性的干扰。
AI.result: 采用 ViT-L 骨干网络，在 nuScenes 测试集上取得 71.6 NDS 和 64.9 mAP，刷新了当前最优结果。
AI.conclusion: PQR3D 通过窗口内渐进查询精炼与解耦嵌入设计，在不依赖持久查询记忆的前提下有效利用时序上下文。代码已开源。

title: A Disk-Shaped Magnetoelastic Torque Sensor for Robotic Joints Using Permanent Magnetization
summary: Direct torque sensing is a growing need in the robotics community to enable precise control and interactions where torque estimation from motor current is not sufficient. This paper presents a novel disk-shaped magnetoelastic torque sensor with a compact axial envelope of about 1 cm, suitable for integration in robotic joints. A four-magnetometer architecture is used to measure the field modulated by the stress affecting a narrow magnetized region while rejecting the effects of parasitic cross forces. A custom-designed magnetic shield enhances the torque sensitivity while reducing the external stray fields by a factor 7x. The device measures the torque with an accuracy of 1.34 %FS relative to the 50 Nm full scale (FS). The paper details the development of the sensor through the mechanical design, the magnetization procedure, and the experimental validation. The results demonstrate the potential of the proposed sensor for robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种适用于机器人关节的紧凑圆盘状磁弹性扭矩传感器（轴向厚度约1 cm），采用四磁力计架构抑制寄生交叉力影响，并借助定制磁屏蔽将外部杂散场降低7倍。器件在50 Nm满量程下测量精度为1.34 %FS，验证了其在机器人应用中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 机器人领域对直接扭矩传感的需求日益增长：仅靠电机电流估算扭矩无法满足精确控制与交互的要求。现有方案在集成度、抗干扰能力等方面存在不足，因此需要一种紧凑、可集成于机器人关节且抗寄生力干扰的扭矩传感器。
AI.method: 提出一种新型圆盘状磁弹性扭矩传感器，轴向尺寸紧凑（约1 cm）。采用四磁力计架构测量被应力调制的磁场，同时抑制寄生交叉力影响；设计定制磁屏蔽以提升扭矩灵敏度并降低外部杂散场（降低7倍）。论文详述了机械设计、磁化过程与实验验证。
AI.result: 定制磁屏蔽使外部杂散场降低7倍并提升扭矩灵敏度；器件在50 Nm满量程下实现1.34 %FS的扭矩测量精度。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，所提出的磁弹性扭矩传感器具有紧凑、抗干扰、精度较高的特点，展现了其在机器人关节等应用中的集成潜力。

title: OneFixer: High-Quality and Consistent One-Step Autoregressive 3DGS Refinement for Driving Scenes
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion is a promising render-time fixer for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) in autonomous-driving simulation, but deployment demands high visual quality and temporal consistency at low latency. This is especially hard for one-step causal generation, where each imperfect prediction immediately becomes context for subsequent frames. Existing approaches stabilize rollouts through staged training with multiple modules and rollout-aware regularization, yet one-step quality still falls short of what deployment requires. We introduce OneFixer, a one-step autoregressive video-diffusion fixer trained in a single task-specific adaptation stage. Our key idea is a deployment-matched shared rollout: the model's own one-step predictions serve as the causal context for flow matching, exposing training to deployment-time errors, while the same rollout receives direct pixel-space perceptual supervision to preserve fine detail. Because the predictions optimized for current-frame quality are exactly those reused as future context, fidelity and autoregressive robustness are learned jointly, without bidirectional-to-causal conversion or teacher-student distillation. OneFixer further exploits cues that driving simulation readily provides, lane geometry and dynamic-agent states, to improve geometric fidelity. On Waymo and proprietary driving scenes with 900-frame rollouts, OneFixer achieves the lowest FVD, LPIPS, and DISTS among all baselines at one step, with temporal consistency matching or exceeding multi-stage DMD pipelines. Under identical backbone and conditioning, it matches a multi-stage DMD-with-Self-Forcing pipeline in under half the GPU-hours and keeps improving beyond its plateau. In closed-loop simulation with a driving policy, OneFixer reduces the collision rate by a third relative to raw 3DGS rendering. Project page: https://onefixer-web.vercel.app/

AI.tldr: OneFixer 是一种单阶段训练的一步自回归视频扩散修复器，通过"部署匹配的共享 rollout"让模型自身预测同时充当下一帧上下文与像素级监督目标，在自动驾驶 3DGS 仿真中实现低延迟、高质量、强时序一致性的渲染。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散是自动驾驶仿真中 3DGS 的渲染期修复方案，但部署要求高画质、强时序一致性且低延迟，这对一步因果生成尤其困难——每帧不完美预测会立即成为后续帧的上下文。现有方法依赖多模块分阶段训练和 rollout 感知正则化来稳定展开，但一步生成的质量仍达不到部署要求。
AI.method: 提出 OneFixer，在单一任务特定适配阶段完成训练。核心是"部署匹配的共享 rollout"：模型自身的一步预测作为 flow matching 的因果上下文，使训练暴露于部署时的误差；同一 rollout 直接接受像素空间的感知监督以保留细节。由于用于优化当前帧质量的预测正是被复用为未来上下文的预测，保真度与自回归鲁棒性得以联合学习，无需双向到因果的转换或师生蒸馏。此外利用驾驶仿真易得的车道几何和动态智能体状态线索提升几何保真度。
AI.result: 在 Waymo 与私有驾驶场景、900 帧展开下，OneFixer 在一步设置中取得最低的 FVD、LPIPS 和 DISTS，时序一致性匹配或超过多阶段 DMD 管线。在相同骨干与条件下，性能达到多阶段 DMD-with-Self-Forcing 管线的水平而 GPU 时间不到其一半，并在其平台期之后仍持续提升。在带驾驶策略的闭环仿真中，相比原始 3DGS 渲染将碰撞率降低三分之一。
AI.conclusion: OneFixer 证明单阶段训练的一步自回归视频扩散修复器可在低延迟下同时满足高保真与强时序一致性，为自动驾驶 3DGS 仿真提供了高效可部署的渲染期修复方案。

title: Steer2Grasp: Inference-Time Embodiment-Aware Steering for Diverse Physically Feasible Grasp Diffusion
summary: Current grasp diffusion models provide rich priors for generation, yet their object-centric approach can violate the kinematic and collision constraints imposed by the embodiment and the environment. Existing embodiment-aware methods primarily perform local corrections around generated grasps through gradient guidance or optimization, making it difficult to recover from fundamentally infeasible modes. We present Steer2Grasp, a training-free, embodiment-agnostic framework for inference-time grasp steering that adapts a frozen Cartesian grasp diffusion model using deployment-specific rewards. Through Feynman-Kac (FK) inspired particle reweighting and resampling, the method reallocates population mass from infeasible to high-reward grasp modes, enabling population-level mode transitions without modifying the pretrained diffusion model or requiring differentiable constraints. The framework enables a unified treatment for single and dual arm grasping through reachability and collision aware rewards, followed by gradient free gripper level local refinement. Across diverse objects, robot embodiments, and constrained environments, our method substantially improves feasible grasp generation while maintaining proximity to the underlying grasp prior.

AI.tldr: 提出 Steer2Grasp，一种免训练、与具体机器人本体无关的推理时抓取引导框架，通过 Feynman-Kac 启发的粒子重加权与重采样，将冻结的笛卡尔抓取扩散模型的生成质量从不可行模式迁移到高奖励模式，统一处理单臂与双臂抓取。
AI.motivation: 现有抓取扩散模型虽然生成先验丰富，但其以物体为中心的方式容易违反机器人本体与环境带来的运动学和碰撞约束。现有考虑本体的方法多通过梯度引导或优化在生成抓取附近做局部修正，难以从根本不可行的模式中恢复。
AI.method: Steer2Grasp 是免训练、本体无关的推理时引导框架。它利用部署特定的奖励，对冻结的笛卡尔抓取扩散模型进行引导：采用 Feynman-Kac 启发的粒子重加权与重采样，将种群质量从不可行抓取模式重新分配到高奖励模式，实现种群级模式转移，而无需修改预训练扩散模型或依赖可微约束。通过可达性和碰撞感知奖励统一处理单臂与双臂抓取，随后进行无梯度的夹爪级局部细化。
AI.result: 在多种物体、机器人本体和受限环境下，该方法显著提升了可行抓取的生成能力，同时保持与底层抓取先验的接近性。
AI.conclusion: Steer2Grasp 通过推理时粒子重加权与重采样实现种群级模式转移，为冻结扩散模型注入本体与环境约束提供了一种免训练、本体无关且统一支持单双臂抓取的方案。

title: Federated 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction at Wireless Edge
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for publication
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) has emerged as a promising technique for large-scale scene reconstruction due to its high rendering efficiency and fidelity. However, the training of large-scale 3D-GS models at wireless edge faces various technical challenges including the limited communication, computation, and graphics processing unit (GPU) memory resources at edge devices, the structural inconsistency issue across local models hindering their effective aggregation, as well as privacy leakage risks associated with raw visual content and camera parameters. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel resource-efficient federated learning framework for efficiently training 3D-GS models of large scenes under severe resource constraints. First, we propose an on-device model lightweighting mechanism that adaptively selects and prunes Gaussian points to balance the rendering quality and training efficiency. In this mechanism, we quantitatively evaluate the importance of different Gaussian points at each device to facilitate the pruning, and use a novel importance-to-latency ratio criterion to determine the number of pruned Gaussian points under GPU memory and computation/communication latency constraints. Furthermore, we develop a 3D-GS model recovery mechanism that restores structural consistency across local 3D-GS models without accessing private camera parameters, enabling their effective aggregation towards a global model. Finally, extensive experiments show that our approach significantly accelerates convergence, maintains high rendering quality, and reduces training latency compared to state-of-the-art federated 3D-GS baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向无线边缘的资源高效联邦学习框架，用于在资源受限条件下训练大规模3D高斯溅射（3D-GS）模型，通过模型轻量化与结构一致性恢复机制提升训练效率与渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 大规模3D-GS模型在无线边缘训练面临多重挑战：边缘设备的通信、计算和GPU显存资源有限；本地模型之间存在结构不一致问题，阻碍有效聚合；同时原始视觉内容和相机参数存在隐私泄露风险。因此需要一种资源高效且保护隐私的联邦训练方案。
AI.method: 首先，提出端侧模型轻量化机制，自适应地选择和剪枝高斯点以平衡渲染质量与训练效率：定量评估每个设备上不同高斯点的重要性以支持剪枝，并采用新的"重要性-时延比"准则在GPU显存及计算/通信时延约束下确定剪枝数量。其次，提出3D-GS模型恢复机制，在不访问私有相机参数的前提下恢复各本地3D-GS模型间的结构一致性，从而实现向全局模型的有效聚合。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，与最先进的联邦3D-GS基线方法相比，所提方法显著加速了收敛，保持了高渲染质量，并降低了训练时延。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在严重资源约束下高效训练大规模场景的3D-GS模型，兼顾训练效率、渲染质量与隐私保护。

title: FoLD: Force-Informed Learning for Dexterous Articulated Object Manipulation
summary: Transferring human demonstrations to dexterous robots remains challenging because differences in hand morphology and contact dynamics often cause retargeted motions to fail at producing the intended object behavior. We present \textbf{FoLD}, a framework for learning dexterous manipulation of articulated objects through explicit force guidance. FoLD compute compensatory force fields from human demonstrations together with the robot's current interaction state, yielding a force prior that promotes the demonstrated object motion. This force prior informs a residual policy that adapts retargeted hand motions to the contact requirements of the task. We evaluate FoLD on a public benchmark for articulated object manipulation, where it consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across tasks and embodiments. We further validate FoLD on real dexterous robot platforms, demonstrating successful transfer of human manipulation skills to robot execution. Here is the link of our project page: https://gghgghgghgg.github.io/FoLD-project-page/.

AI.tldr: FoLD：通过显式力引导学习灵巧手操作铰接物体，从人类演示计算补偿力场作为力先验，驱动残差策略适配重定向手部动作，在公开基准与真机平台均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 将人类演示迁移到灵巧机器人仍然困难，因为手部形态与接触动力学差异常导致重定向后的动作无法产生预期的物体行为，即运动学重定向忽略了接触力需求。
AI.method: 提出FoLD框架：结合人类演示与机器人当前交互状态计算补偿力场，得到促进演示物体运动的力先验；该力先验引导一个残差策略，使重定向的手部动作适配任务的接触要求。
AI.result: 在公开的铰接物体操作基准上，FoLD在各任务与各本体形态上持续优于当前最优基线；并在真实灵巧机器人平台上验证成功，实现了人类操作技能向机器人执行的有效迁移。
AI.conclusion: 显式力引导可有效弥合形态与接触动力学差异，是提升人类演示到灵巧操作迁移成功率的有前景途径。

title: Binaural Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation
summary: Audio-visual segmentation (AVS) aims to segment sounding objects at the pixel level by integrating auditory and visual cues. However, existing methods are predominantly developed under the monaural setting and primarily rely on cross-modal semantic correspondence, which limits their ability to distinguish visually similar instances of the same semantic class. In contrast, humans naturally exploit binaural hearing, where interaural differences and direction-dependent acoustic filtering introduced by the head and pinnae provide physically grounded spatial cues for accurate sound source localization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce binaural audio-visual instance segmentation (BiAVIS), a new task that leverages synchronized binaural audio and video frames to segment sounding instances. To advance research on this task, we establish two benchmarks by manually annotating an existing binaural audio-visual dataset and collecting a new real-world dataset, BiAVIS-Bench, in more challenging and diverse scenarios. We further propose a BiAVIS model, which leverages an audio-only sound source localization network to learn spatial and semantic priors for sounding instances from binaural audio. A query-level audio-visual fusion strategy is subsequently introduced to inject these informative priors into the instance segmentation decoder. Extensive experiments conducted on the two proposed benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of the BiAVIS model over previous monaural AVS methods, especially in resolving instance-level intra-class ambiguity. On the more challenging BiAVIS-Bench, the proposed BiAVIS model outperforms the best-performing monaural baselines by 17.22\% in mAP and 7.71\% in FSLA, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双耳视听实例分割（BiAVIS）新任务，利用双耳音频的空间线索分割发声实例，并构建两个基准与一个新模型，在挑战性基准上显著超越单耳基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视听分割（AVS）方法多在单耳设置下开发，主要依赖跨模态语义对应，难以区分同一语义类别中视觉相似的实例。而人类借助双耳听觉中的耳间差异及头部与耳廓引起的方向相关声学滤波，可获得物理空间线索，实现精确声源定位。受此启发，作者希望引入双耳空间信息来提升实例级分割能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出新任务 BiAVIS，利用同步的双耳音频与视频帧分割发声实例；2) 构建两个基准：对已有双耳视听数据集进行人工标注，并采集更具挑战性和多样性的真实世界数据集 BiAVIS-Bench；3) 提出 BiAVIS 模型，使用纯音频声源定位网络从双耳音频中学习发声实例的空间与语义先验，并通过查询级视听融合策略将这些先验注入实例分割解码器。
AI.result: 在两个基准上的大量实验表明，BiAVIS 模型优于此前的单耳 AVS 方法，尤其在解决实例级类内歧义方面表现突出。在更具挑战性的 BiAVIS-Bench 上，BiAVIS 模型相比最佳单耳基线分别提升 mAP 17.22% 和 FSLA 7.71%。
AI.conclusion: 双耳空间线索为视听实例分割提供了有效且物理基础明确的信息来源，BiAVIS 任务、基准与模型为该方向研究奠定了基础，并显著提升了实例级发声物体分割性能。

title: SLIP-VLA: Single-Step Latent Imagination for Policy Learning in Vision-Language-Action Models
comment: Project page and demonstration videos: https://haoxuanxu1024.github.io/SLIP_VLA/
summary: Vision-Language-Action models are increasingly effective for robotic manipulation, yet most predict actions directly from current observations without explicitly modeling future scene evolution. Recent methods introduce future prediction to improve action generation, but dense future modeling often requires expensive iterative denoising, while one-step alternatives can underperform their multi-step counterparts. To reconcile efficient future modeling with strong action performance, we present SLIP-VLA, a policy learning framework that equips VLA models with a Single-Step Latent Imagination for future-aware action prediction. SLIP-VLA obtains temporally dense future latent representations with a single denoising update, and we improve the perceptual sufficiency of these representations by aligning intermediate latents with future geometric and semantic features. We further improve their control sufficiency through action-conditioned latent world modeling and inverse dynamics modeling, explicitly coupling latent transitions with robot actions. SLIP-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks, while its single-step latent imagination takes only 12 ms.

AI.tldr: SLIP-VLA通过单步潜在想象为VLA模型引入未来感知的动作预测，在高效建模未来的同时实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型多直接从当前观测预测动作，缺乏对未来场景演化的显式建模；引入未来预测的方法中，稠密未来建模需昂贵的迭代去噪，而单步方案性能又弱于多步版本，因此需在高效未来建模与强动作性能间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出SLIP-VLA框架，用单次去噪更新获得时间稠密的未来潜在表示；通过对齐中间潜在表示与未来几何和语义特征提升感知充分性；再通过动作条件潜在世界建模与逆动力学建模，显式耦合潜在状态转移与机器人动作，提升控制充分性。
AI.result: 在多种仿真基准和真实世界操作任务上取得SOTA性能，单步潜在想象仅耗时12毫秒。
AI.conclusion: SLIP-VLA证明单步潜在想象可在保持高效率的同时实现强动作生成，兼顾未来感知与实时性。

title: KeyRec: Bounded Visual Memory for Streaming and Long-Video Understanding
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used to understand long videos and continuous streams. However, dense visual tokens accumulate with video duration, making long-context inference prohibitively expensive. Existing training-free visual-token selection methods reduce this cost by retaining informative tokens, but may lose coherent event evidence and fail to distinguish detailed recent observations from long-range history. We propose \textbf{KeyRec}, a training-free framework for constructing bounded visual memory. During query-agnostic writing, KeyRec preserves fine-grained recent observations in a visual cache and organizes historical evidence into a structured event bank. Candidate events are proposed according to their novelty relative to previously stored events and maintained through an online add--merge--evict update. When a question arrives, a text-only router adaptively allocates a fixed readout budget between recent and event memory, without reprocessing historical frames. KeyRec operates on model-facing visual embeddings and supports both modular encoder--projector VLMs and the encoder- and projector-free NEO-ov architecture. Across four streaming and long-video benchmarks and three VLM backbones, KeyRec achieves the best compressed performance in 13 of 15 settings using only 10\% of the dense decoder-facing visual-token budget. It outperforms the strongest compressed baseline by 2.21--18.37 points on real-time questions, achieves the best compressed result in five of six long-video settings, and performs best in every NEO-ov 2B setting.

AI.tldr: KeyRec：一种免训练的有界视觉记忆框架，通过视觉缓存保存近期细节、事件库组织历史证据，并用文本路由器在固定读取预算下自适应分配，实现高效长视频理解。
AI.motivation: 长视频与连续流的密集视觉token随视频时长累积，导致长上下文推理成本极高。现有免训练的视觉token选择方法虽能降低开销，但可能丢失连贯事件证据，且难以区分近期细粒度观测与长程历史。
AI.method: KeyRec采用查询无关的写入过程：在视觉缓存中保留细粒度近期观测，并将历史证据组织为结构化事件库；候选事件依据其相对已存储事件的新颖性提出，并通过在线add-merge-evict更新维护。问题到来时，一个纯文本路由器在近期记忆与事件记忆之间自适应分配固定读取预算，无需重新处理历史帧。方法作用于面向模型的视觉嵌入，支持模块化encoder-projector VLMs及无encoder-projector的NEO-ov架构。
AI.result: 在四个流式与长视频基准、三个VLM骨干上，KeyRec在15个设置中的13个取得最佳压缩性能，仅使用10%的密集解码器面向视觉token预算。在实时问题上比最强压缩基线高2.21–18.37分，在六个长视频设置中的五个取得最佳压缩结果，并在所有NEO-ov 2B设置中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: KeyRec作为一种免训练的有界视觉记忆框架，能在极低视觉token预算下有效兼顾近期细节与长程历史事件，在多种流式与长视频任务及VLM架构上展现出优于现有压缩基线的性能。

title: Beyond One-Step Accuracy: State-Affine Latent Transition for Reliable Visual Planning
summary: Joint-embedding world models enable visual planning by learning action-conditioned dynamics in latent space. Yet they are commonly trained for one-step prediction on encoded states, while planning recursively applies the learned transition to its own predictions. One-step accuracy therefore does not capture how prediction errors propagate under recursive rollout. We decompose multi-step rollout error into the errors introduced at individual steps and their propagation through subsequent transitions. We show that state-affine dynamics are precisely the differentiable transitions with state-independent Jacobians, eliminating the nonlinear propagation residual and making the error propagation operators depend only on the action sequence. Guided by this result, we introduce SALT (State-Affine Latent Transition), an action-conditioned state-affine dynamics model in which the action modulates both the state transformation and the additive update. We train SALT through recursive multi-step rollout supervision, feeding each predicted latent state back into the transition so that training matches how the model is used during planning. Across four visual planning environments, SALT exhibits $1.48$--$2.19\times$ higher one-step prediction error than the matched LeWM baseline, yet improves closed-loop success in every environment by $10.0$ percentage points on average. On OGBench-Cube, the fraction of episodes that fail with a sharp rise in model-predicted cost after execution decreases from $23.3%$ to $2.0%$.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了潜空间世界模型中多步递归预测的误差传播机制，提出状态仿射动力学（state-affine dynamics）可消除非线性传播残差，并据此设计SALT模型，通过递归多步监督训练，在闭环规划中取得更优表现。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入世界模型通常在编码状态上做单步预测训练，但规划时会递归地将学习到的转移应用到自身预测上，因此单步精度无法反映递归展开下误差如何传播，导致训练目标与实际使用方式不匹配。
AI.method: 作者将多步展开误差分解为各步引入的误差及其在后续转移中的传播，证明状态仿射动力学正是具有状态无关雅可比的可微转移，从而消除非线性传播残差、使误差传播算子仅依赖动作序列。基于此提出SALT（State-Affine Latent Transition），一种动作调制的状态仿射动力学模型，动作同时调制状态变换与加性更新，并采用递归多步展开监督训练，将每个预测潜状态反馈回转移中。
AI.result: 在四个视觉规划环境中，SALT的单步预测误差比匹配的LeWM基线高1.48–2.19倍，但闭环成功率平均提升10.0个百分点，且每个环境均有改善。在OGBench-Cube上，执行后模型预测代价骤升的失败回合比例从23.3%降至2.0%。
AI.conclusion: 单步预测精度并非递归规划性能的良好指标；通过状态仿射动力学消除非线性误差传播并结合递归多步监督，可使训练与规划使用方式一致，从而在闭环规划中显著提升成功率与鲁棒性。

title: Scalable In-Domain Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Dense Representation Transfer in High-Resolution Plant Imaging
summary: High-resolution plant imaging enables detailed characterization of plant morphology, but dense scientific analysis remains limited by costly pixel-level annotations, large image pixel dimensions, and substantial variation in imaging conditions. This work proposes a scalable in-domain self-supervised pretrained foundation model for high-resolution, high-pixel-dimension multi-species plant imagery. A masked autoencoder with a ViT backbone is pretrained on more than 10 million multi-view plant image tiles using distributed training. Following scalable pretraining, the learned foundation-model representations are comprehensively benchmarked across fine-grained dense prediction and coarse global feature recognition, with particular emphasis on limited supervision and realistic downstream imaging conditions. This work focuses on the domain gap of existing foundation models in dense feature representation and transfer. Through extensive experiments involving limited annotations, cross-view variation, and resolution degradation, the in-domain FM achieves a Mean Dice of 0.8686 and a Pooled Dice of 0.8959, outperforming an MAE counterpart pretrained on large-scale natural-image data by 0.0694 and 0.0613, respectively. The results further indicate that increasing pretraining scale produces consistent improvements in dense feature transfer. Overall, these findings suggest that scaling in-domain self-supervised pretraining can reduce the domain gap and improve transferable dense representations for high-pixel-dimension scientific imaging.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出面向高分辨率多物种植物图像的域内自监督预训练基础模型，采用MAE+ViT在超1000万多视角图像块上分布式预训练，在密集预测与全局识别任务上优于自然图像预训练的MAE。
AI.motivation: 植物高分辨率成像虽能精细刻画形态，但密集的科学分析受限于像素级标注成本高、图像像素维度大以及成像条件差异显著；同时现有基础模型在密集特征表示上存在域间差距与迁移困难。
AI.method: 构建可扩展的域内自监督预训练基础模型：以ViT为主干的掩码自编码器（MAE），在多视角植物图像块（超过1000万）上通过分布式训练进行预训练；随后在细粒度密集预测与粗粒度全局特征识别任务上系统评测，重点关注有限监督与真实下游成像条件，并考察跨视角变化与分辨率退化。
AI.result: 该方法取得Mean Dice 0.8686、Pooled Dice 0.8959，分别比在大规模自然图像上预训练的MAE高出0.0694和0.0613；增大预训练规模可持续提升密集特征迁移性能。
AI.conclusion: 扩大域内自监督预训练规模能够缩小域间差距，并为高像素维度的科学成像提供更具可迁移性的密集表示，为植物表型等密集分析任务提供可扩展的基础模型范式。

title: InfraVLA: Extending Vision-Language-Action Navigation with Infrastructure Cameras
summary: Many indoor environments in which robots operate, such as warehouses, offices, and hospitals, already have cameras installed. They observe parts of the building that the robot cannot see from where it stands, yet navigation policies, including recent vision-language-action (VLA) models, do not use them. We propose InfraVLA, an end-to-end method that adapts a pretrained navigation VLA to such static infrastructure views: a closed-circuit television (CCTV) encoder turns each external view into tokens of the input sequence. Because the views matter only at rare decision points, fine-tuning alone did not make the policy use them in our experiments; we therefore train in two stages, on demonstrations with upsampled counterfactual data and then on recovery data. We evaluate on two simulated warehouse tasks, finding an object named in the instruction and rerouting around blocked aisles, where the deciding information is often visible only to the infrastructure cameras. Tested in distribution, InfraVLA reached a success rate of 100% on both, against 34.0% and 73.6% for a baseline without CCTV input. On out-of-distribution test sets it reached 88.2% and 88.9%. On a real quadruped fine-tuned with under 10 minutes of demonstrations, the policy reached 83.3% against 29.2% for the on-board-only baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出InfraVLA，将预训练导航VLA模型适配到静态基础设施相机（CCTV）视角，通过两阶段训练让策略在关键决策点利用外部视角信息，在仿真与真实四足机器人任务上大幅超越仅用机载视觉的基线。
AI.motivation: 仓库、办公室、医院等室内环境通常已安装摄像头，它们能看到机器人自身视角无法观测到的建筑区域信息，但现有导航策略（包括近期VLA模型）并未利用这些信息，导致在需要全局或外部视角的决策点上信息不足。
AI.method: InfraVLA是端到端方法：引入CCTV编码器，将每个外部视角转换为输入序列的token，从而把预训练导航VLA适配到静态基础设施视角。由于外部视角仅在少数罕见决策点起作用，单独微调无法让策略学会使用它们，因此采用两阶段训练——先在经过上采样的反事实数据演示上训练，再在恢复数据上训练。
AI.result: 在两个仿真仓库任务（寻找指令指定物体、绕行被阻塞通道）上测试：分布内成功率均达100%，而不用CCTV的基线分别为34.0%和73.6%；分布外测试集上分别达88.2%和88.9%。在真实四足机器人上，用不到10分钟演示微调后成功率为83.3%，仅用机载视觉的基线为29.2%。
AI.conclusion: 利用环境中已有的静态基础设施相机可显著提升导航VLA策略的性能，两阶段训练（反事实上采样+恢复数据）是让策略有效利用外部视角的关键，且该方法可低成本迁移到真实机器人。

title: Contamination, Prior, or Evidence? Decomposing and Training Evidence Use in Whole-Slide Vision-Language Models
summary: Pathology vision-language models (VLMs) are conventionally evaluated by accuracy, but accuracy alone does not measure evidence use: it may conflate dataset contamination, prior knowledge, and image evidence. In a motivating study of lymph-node metastasis prediction, we found that most public pathology VLMs showed minimal differences when changing from feeding the models with whole-slide images, an annotated lesion, or no image at all. To better understand the specific features leveraged by these models, this paper presents two contributions aimed at disentangling these factors. First, we present CleanSlide, a TCGA-based VQA benchmark designed to eliminate image- and question-side contamination. It contains 149K audited multiple-choice questions over 9,985 slides, with patient- and tissue-source-disjoint splits. Every question is audited for option shortcuts, stem leakage, cross-split duplication, and blind solvability. Second, we propose Pair-DPO, a preference loss over counterfactual slide pairs from the same question and source. By controlling for shared confounding factors, Pair-DPO cancels out the question-attributable signal and leaves image evidence as the source of preference. Specifically, each pair consists of two real slides with opposite, verified findings, introducing neither editing artifacts nor unverified labels for diffuse or graded features such as invasion, necrosis, and tumor grade. Experiments show that our method gains 15.29% from image evidence on the CleanSlide, compared with 2.81% for the best published model. On the external CPTAC and BCNB cohorts, our method achieves accuracies of 57.6% and 59.0%, outperforming all other evaluated models by 9.7% and 3.4%, respectively. We will release the benchmark and code.

AI.tldr: 针对病理视觉语言模型仅用准确率评估无法分辨证据来源的问题，本文提出无污染的 TCGA 基准 CleanSlide 与反事实偏好损失 Pair-DPO，显著提升模型对图像证据的利用。
AI.motivation: 传统病理 VLM 只用准确率评估，准确率可能混入数据污染、先验知识和图像证据，无法衡量模型是否真正使用了图像证据。作者在淋巴结转移预测的动机研究中发现，多数公开病理 VLM 在全切片图像、标注病灶图像和无图像三种输入下表现差异极小，说明模型可能并未依赖图像证据。
AI.method: 两项贡献：1) CleanSlide，基于 TCGA 的 VQA 基准，消除图像侧和问题侧污染，包含 149K 经审核的多选题、覆盖 9,985 张切片，患者与组织来源均不交叉，每题审核选项捷径、题干泄露、跨划分重复和盲解可行性。2) Pair-DPO，对来自同一问题和同一来源的反事实切片对施加偏好损失，通过控制共享混杂因素抵消问题相关信号，使图像证据成为偏好来源。每对由两张真实切片构成，具有相反且经核实的发现，避免编辑痕迹，也避免对浸润、坏死、肿瘤分级等弥漫性或分级特征使用未验证标签。
AI.result: 在 CleanSlide 上，本方法从图像证据中获得 15.29% 提升，而最佳公开模型仅为 2.81%。在外部 CPTAC 和 BCNB 队列上分别达到 57.6% 和 59.0% 的准确率，较所有其他评估模型分别高出 9.7% 和 3.4%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了病理 VLM 评估中准确率掩盖证据来源的问题，并通过无污染基准和反事实偏好训练，使模型真正依赖图像证据，且在外部队列上取得更优表现；基准与代码将公开。

title: Demonstration-Free Success-Probability Reward Learning for Generalist Robot Policies
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables generalist robot policies to improve through trial-and-error interaction, yet its effectiveness is fundamentally constrained by sparse task rewards. Existing general-purpose reward models typically alleviate this issue by learning task progress from expert demonstrations, but introduce a distribution mismatch with the mixed-quality rollouts encountered during policy optimization, making their estimates unreliable on suboptimal and failed behaviors from which the policy must learn. In this work, we introduce a demonstration-free reward learning paradigm where dense reward feedback can be learned directly from sparse task outcomes and policy experience. We theoretically show that terminal task outcomes implicitly define dense success-probability feedback at intermediate timesteps, which can be recursively learned through bootstrapping. Based on this insight, we introduce eVTA$_0$, which learns success probabilities from mixed-quality policy rollouts through temporal-difference-style bootstrapping, without expert demonstrations or intermediate annotations. We further introduce RL with Evolving Rewards (RLER), a closed-loop framework that adapts eVTA$_0$ using newly collected rollouts as the policy evolves. Experiments show that eVTA$_0$ provides more informative rewards than state-of-the-art reward models and achieves the best average policy performance across all LIBERO task suites under the same RL training budget, improving success rates by 5.4%-13.8% over the initial policy. In real-world manipulation, RLER further improves overall success rates by 20%-26%, with 35%-36% gains under out-of-distribution conditions. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of demonstration-free reward learning and adapting rewards as the policy evolves. Project webpage: https://duowuyms.github.io/evta0.

AI.tldr: 提出无需专家演示的奖励学习范式 eVTA₀，从稀疏任务结果与策略经验中学习稠密奖励，并设计闭环框架 RLER 随策略演化自适应调整奖励，在仿真与真实操作任务上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 强化学习受稀疏任务奖励限制，效果受限。现有通用奖励模型依赖专家演示学习任务进度，但与策略优化中混合质量的 rollout 存在分布不匹配，导致对次优和失败行为的估计不可靠，而这些正是策略需要学习的关键样本。
AI.method: 1）从理论上证明终端任务结果隐式定义了中间时间步的稠密成功概率反馈，可通过自举递归学习；2）提出 eVTA₀，利用时序差分式自举，从混合质量的策略 rollout 中学习成功概率，无需专家演示或中间标注；3）提出 RL with Evolving Rewards（RLER）闭环框架，随策略演化用新采集的 rollout 自适应更新 eVTA₀。
AI.result: eVTA₀ 提供的奖励比最先进奖励模型更具信息量；在相同 RL 训练预算下，于所有 LIBERO 任务套件取得最佳平均策略性能，成功率较初始策略提升 5.4%–13.8%。真实世界操作中，RLER 将整体成功率提升 20%–26%，分布外条件下提升 35%–36%。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了无需演示的奖励学习以及随策略演化自适应调整奖励的有效性，为克服稀疏奖励与分布不匹配问题提供了可行路径。

title: Presence Is Not Faithfulness: Figurative Vehicle Intrusion in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (TTI) models increasingly generate high-quality images from natural-language prompts, yet figurative language exposes a failure: a vehicle that should guide the depiction of a tenor may instead be rendered as a visible object. We call this failure Figurative Vehicle Intrusion: the intruding content is textually licensed, but it is assigned the wrong visual role, showing that visual presence is not always faithfulness and that presence-oriented evaluation can miss such errors. To study it systematically, we introduce Vehicle Intrusion and Semantic Tenor Assessment (VISTA), a multilingual benchmark of figurative prompts organized by Figurative Form and Mapping Mechanism. We further propose V-Score, a diagnostic question-answering metric that evaluates role-aware figurative faithfulness in generated images. Evaluations on recent high-performing TTI models show that vehicle intrusion persists across languages and figurative categories. As a lightweight mitigation, we introduce VISTA-Guard, which partially reduces vehicle intrusion and suggests a practical path toward more figuratively faithful TTI generation. All resources will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别出文生图模型中的"喻体入侵"失败现象，提出VISTA多语言基准与V-Score诊断指标，并给出VISTA-Guard缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 文生图模型能从自然语言提示生成高质量图像，但在处理比喻性语言时会失败：本应引导本体描绘的喻体却被渲染为可见物体。这种"喻体入侵"的干扰内容在文本上有依据，但被赋予了错误的视觉角色，说明视觉存在并不等于忠实性，且面向存在性的评估会漏检此类错误，因此需要系统研究。
AI.method: 提出VISTA（喻体入侵与语义本体评估）多语言基准，按比喻形式与映射机制组织比喻提示；提出V-Score诊断性问答指标，评估生成图像中角色感知的比喻忠实性；并提出轻量级缓解方法VISTA-Guard。
AI.result: 对近期高性能文生图模型的评估显示，喻体入侵在不同语言和比喻类别中持续存在。VISTA-Guard能部分减少喻体入侵。
AI.conclusion: 喻体入侵是文生图模型在比喻语言理解上的系统性缺陷，VISTA基准与V-Score指标可有效诊断该问题，VISTA-Guard为更符合比喻忠实性的文生图生成提供了可行路径，所有资源将公开。

title: Observability-Informed Optimal Sensor Placement for Soft Robots
comment: Published in IEEE Robosoft 2026. 8 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables
summary: This paper presents the application and experimental evaluation of a systematic method for optimal sensor placement in soft robots. Existing methods either lack generalizability across different soft robot morphologies or do not account for system dynamics. The applied method uses convex optimization to find the optimal sensor configuration that maximizes an observability Gramian-based metric. The framework is experimentally evaluated using position and strain measurements on a soft continuum arm. Kalman filter state estimates using optimal sensor placements yield lower reconstruction error than a baseline across all sinusoidal input trials, with improvements on the order of millimeters. This case study shows that linear control theory tools can guide optimal sensor placement in soft robots, suggesting an interpretable approach to sensor placement that may extend to other morphologies.

AI.tldr: 本文应用并实验验证了一种软体机器人最优传感器布置的系统方法，该方法利用凸优化最大化基于可观测性格拉姆矩阵的指标，并在软体连续臂上通过位置和应变测量进行验证，最优布置下的卡尔曼滤波状态估计误差低于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有软体机器人传感器布置方法要么缺乏跨不同形态的通用性，要么未考虑系统动力学，因此需要一种系统化且通用的最优传感器布置方法。
AI.method: 采用凸优化方法寻找最优传感器配置，以最大化基于可观测性格拉姆矩阵的指标；并在软体连续臂上使用位置和应变测量进行实验评估。
AI.result: 在所有正弦输入试验中，使用最优传感器布置的卡尔曼滤波状态估计重建误差均低于基线，改进量达到毫米级。
AI.conclusion: 该案例研究表明，线性控制理论工具可以指导软体机器人中的最优传感器布置，提供了一种可解释的传感器布置方法，并有望推广到其他形态。

title: Evaluating Single and Multi-Omics Based Explainable Artificial Intelligence (MOXAI) for Molecular Subclass Classification of Adult-Type Diffuse Gliomas
summary: DNA methylation (DNAM) profiling has emerged as a powerful diagnostic tool for classifying brain and solid tumors. However, existing computational models typically analyze methylation and copy number variation (CNV) data separately, failing to capture the complementary information their integration could provide. Moreover, current classification models lack mechanisms for within-class risk assessment analogous to traditional tumor grading, and no established explainability method can attribute classification decisions to specific genomic loci. In this paper, we present MOXAI (Multi-Omics Based Explainable AI), a deep learning framework that integrates DNA methylation and copy number data from methylation arrays to classify molecular subtypes of adult-type diffuse gliomas, alongside single-modality variants for comparison. Using a cohort from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), we trained ResNet50, DINOv2, and Graph Attention Network (GAT) models on methylation data alone, copy number data alone, and combined multimodal data. We further developed explainable AI (XAI) methods based on class activation maps (CAMs) and gradient-weighted CAM (Grad-CAM) to identify the specific CpG sites, genes, and chromosomal regions most relevant to each classification decision. The multimodal model achieved up to 92.98% cross-validation accuracy, outperforming models trained on CNV data alone. DINOv2 showed the strongest generalization, reaching 94.25% accuracy (confidence >0.9) on independent validation sets. XAI results aligned with established molecular features of adult-type diffuse glioma subtypes, confirming the biological interpretability of the framework.

AI.tldr: 提出MOXAI框架，融合DNA甲基化与拷贝数数据分类成人型弥漫性胶质瘤分子亚型，并结合CAM/Grad-CAM实现可解释性，多模态模型交叉验证准确率达92.98%，DINOv2独立验证达94.25%。
AI.motivation: 现有计算模型通常分别分析甲基化与拷贝数变异数据，无法捕捉二者整合带来的互补信息；同时缺乏类似传统肿瘤分级的类内风险评估机制，也没有成熟的可解释性方法能将分类决策归因到具体基因组位点。
AI.method: 构建MOXAI（多组学可解释AI）深度学习框架，整合甲基化阵列的DNA甲基化与拷贝数数据，并设置单模态对照。基于TCGA队列，训练ResNet50、DINOv2与图注意力网络（GAT），分别在甲基化、拷贝数及多模态数据上建模；同时开发基于类激活图（CAM）与梯度加权CAM（Grad-CAM）的可解释性方法，定位对分类决策最相关的CpG位点、基因和染色体区域。
AI.result: 多模态模型交叉验证准确率最高达92.98%，优于仅用CNV数据的模型；DINOv2泛化能力最强，在独立验证集上（置信度>0.9）达到94.25%准确率。可解释性结果与已知的成人型弥漫性胶质瘤亚型分子特征相符，验证了框架的生物学可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 多组学整合可提升胶质瘤分子亚型分类性能，且CAM/Grad-CAM类方法能提供具有生物学意义的基因组位点归因，表明MOXAI兼具高精度与可解释性。

title: MomWorld: Momentum-Aware Latent World Model for Long-Horizon Autonomous Driving
summary: Long-horizon planning enables autonomous vehicles to anticipate scene evolution and potential risks, supporting safe and stable decisions in complex interactions. However, existing methods struggle to propagate motion trends from observed history into the future. Long rollouts based on a single latent state may further attenuate useful dynamics, retain stale motion patterns, and disrupt reliable near-term plans. We introduce MomWorld, a momentum-aware latent world model for long-horizon planning. MomWorld extracts scene motion trends from historical-to-current observations and propagates latent momentum into future horizons, jointly predicting future configuration and momentum states. A learnable momentum persistence mechanism preserves stable trends, scene-conditioned momentum updates adapt future dynamics, and a scene-adaptive reset gate suppresses stale momentum under abrupt changes. We further propose MoFlow, a momentum-conditioned flow-matching module that refines a base trajectory to align with the predicted future scene evolution in only a few integration steps, with a horizon-aware residual fusion that preserves near-term planning stability while permitting stronger long-range corrections. Extensive experiments on NAVSIM, nuScenes and Bench2Drive demonstrate that MomWorld improves long-horizon planning consistency and reduces the average collision rate by 12.2% relative to MomAD over a 6-second planning horizon.

AI.tldr: 提出动量感知的潜在世界模型MomWorld，通过传播潜在动量提升自动驾驶长时域规划的一致性与安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法难以将观测历史中的运动趋势传播到未来；基于单一潜在状态的长时域推演会衰减有效动态、保留过时运动模式，并破坏近期的可靠规划。因此需要一种能保持并调节运动趋势的长时域规划方法。
AI.method: MomWorld从历史到当前观测中提取场景运动趋势，并将潜在动量传播到未来时域，联合预测未来构型与动量状态。其包含可学习的动量保持机制以稳定趋势、场景条件化的动量更新以适应未来动态、场景自适应重置门以在突变时抑制过时动量。另提出MoFlow动量条件流匹配模块，仅几步积分即可将基础轨迹细化以对齐预测的未来场景演化，并采用时域感知残差融合，兼顾近期规划稳定性与更远距离的修正能力。
AI.result: 在NAVISIM、nuScenes和Bench2Drive上的大量实验表明，MomWorld提升了长时域规划一致性，在6秒规划时域内相比MomAD平均碰撞率降低12.2%。
AI.conclusion: 动量感知的潜在世界模型与动量条件流匹配相结合，可有效改善长时域规划的稳定性与安全性，并显著降低碰撞率。

title: Devol-ONE: One Autoregressive Mixture of Transformers to Unify Vision-Language-Action and Latent World Modeling
summary: Vision Language Action (VLA) models condition actions directly on current visual and language context, without an explicit account of how the scene evolves under candidate actions. World Action Models (WAM) attempt to address this limitation by predicting future states, but existing designs keep prediction and policy learning architecturally separate, connecting them only through the predicted output, whether through pixel space video generation or a latent forecasting module trained independently of the policy. We present Devol-ONE, a Mixture of Transformers architecture that unifies vision language understanding, latent world dynamics prediction, and action generation within a single autoregressive framework. Instead of encoding vision language tokens once and feeding them to the action expert, Devol-ONE runs autoregressive prediction jointly across a vision language stream and a V-JEPA pretrained dynamics stream, attending to the vision language key-value cache at every layer to forecast future latent states under language guidance. The action expert is in turn shaped continuously by semantic reasoning and predicted physical dynamics rather than by a fixed representation computed in advance. Extensive experiments are conducted on LIBERO, LIBERO-PLUS, RoboTwin2.0 along with real-world evaluation on Flexiv single-arm and dual-arm setups. Ablation studies show the effectiveness of dynamic stream prediction and layer-wise unified attention to validate our model architectural coherency.

AI.tldr: 提出Devol-ONE，一种混合Transformer架构，在单一自回归框架内统一视觉语言理解、潜在世界动态预测与动作生成，解决现有VLA与世界动作模型预测与策略学习架构分离的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型直接以当前视觉与语言上下文为条件生成动作，缺少对场景在候选动作下如何演变的显式刻画；世界动作模型虽试图预测未来状态，但其预测与策略学习在架构上相互独立，仅通过预测输出（像素空间视频生成或独立于策略训练的潜在预测模块）连接，导致动作专家只能依赖预先计算的固定表示，无法被语义推理与预测的物理动态持续塑造。
AI.method: Devol-ONE采用混合Transformer（Mixture of Transformers）架构，在单一自回归框架中联合运行：视觉语言流与基于V-JEPA预训练的动力学流进行自回归预测，并在每一层通过注意力访问视觉语言键值缓存，在语言引导下预测未来潜在状态；动作专家由此被语义推理与预测的物理动态持续塑造，而非依赖固定的预计算表示。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-PLUS、RoboTwin2.0基准以及Flexiv单臂与双臂真实世界设置上进行了大量实验；消融研究验证了动态流预测与逐层统一注意力的有效性，佐证了模型架构的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视觉语言理解、潜在世界动态预测与动作生成统一在单一自回归Transformer框架中，并以逐层注意力实现跨流交互，Devol-ONE使动作生成持续受语义与物理动态引导，实验与消融结果验证了该架构设计的有效性与内在一致性。

title: AnyStep-WAM: Budget-Aligned Distillation and Adaptive Inference for World Action Models
summary: World-action models (WAMs) couple predictive visual modeling with action generation, typically relying on iterative denoising with a fixed denoising steps. However, manipulation tasks contain actions chunks with varying sensitivity to generation errors: critical actions require precision, while less sensitive actions allow faster generation with fewer denoising steps. Here we introduce AnyStep World Action Model, a general framework for tunable-budget prediction and scene-dependent computation allocation. Our budget-aligned teacher-trajectory distillation trains interval-conditioned flow maps using explicit frozen-teacher transitions and shared low-rank adapters, supporting action generation from one-step prediction to multi-step refinement. Building on this capability, a lightweight risk-benefit scheduler predicts teacher-curvature-based difficulty and budget-specific student-teacher fidelity from a single one-step preview, selecting the smallest budget predicted to satisfy risk-adaptive fidelity requirements. We evaluate our framework on three widely used WAMs Motus, FastWAM, and LingBotVA using RoboTwin 2.0. Our method reduces average denoising steps by 60.2%, 49.8%, and 85.28%, respectively, while maintaining baseline task success rates. In particular, our AnyStep training substantially improves model performance under a one-step denoising budget, increasing task success rates by 7.07%, 12.08%, and 8.94% on Motus, FastWAM, and LingBotVA, respectively. Experiments on six real-world manipulation tasks further validate its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出 AnyStep WAM 框架，实现可调预算预测与场景相关的计算分配，在保持成功率的同时大幅减少去噪步数。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型通常依赖固定去噪步数的迭代去噪，但操作任务中各动作片段对生成误差的敏感度不同：关键动作需要精度，次要动作可用更少步数快速生成，因此固定预算造成计算浪费。
AI.method: 采用预算对齐的教师轨迹蒸馏，利用显式冻结教师转移与共享低秩适配器训练区间条件下的流映射，支持从单步预测到多步精修；并基于此设计轻量风险-收益调度器，从单次单步预览中预测基于教师曲率的难度与特定预算下的师生保真度，选取满足风险自适应保真度要求的最小预算。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 上的三种主流 WAM（Motus、FastWAM、LingBotVA）中，平均去噪步数分别减少 60.2%、49.8%、85.28%，同时保持基线任务成功率；单步预算下成功率分别提升 7.07%、12.08%、8.94%；六个真实操作任务实验进一步验证有效性。
AI.conclusion: AnyStep WAM 通过预算对齐蒸馏与风险自适应调度，实现了可变去噪预算下的高效动作生成，在显著降低计算量的同时提升或保持任务表现，并具备真实场景适用性。

title: Kernel-Based Steering of CLIP with Vision-Language Model Preferences
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) can judge visual similarity, but their judgments are not directly available as compact image embeddings for efficient comparison. We study how to transfer these preferences into CLIP while retaining its image--text capabilities. We introduce ASK, a kernel-based steering method that learns from elicited pairwise judgments without accessing teacher embeddings or collecting new human similarity annotations. ASK constructs positive semidefinite target kernels within small image groups and combines visual kernel matching with an image--text distributional anchor. Low-rank adapters jointly update the visual and text encoders while regularizing predictions toward frozen CLIP. After adaptation, retrieval uses CLIP image embeddings and cosine similarity, with no VLM calls. Experiments across five image domains, four CLIP backbones, and six judges evaluate teacher agreement, retrieval, and recognition retention. For ViT-B/16, mean retrieval mAP on classes excluded from adaptation increases from 53.8 to 75.0, compared with 71.7 for DINOv2 targets with KL anchoring. Mean zero-shot accuracy with jointly adapted encoders increases from 61.8\% to 62.4\%, averaged over 12 benchmarks and the five adaptation domains. Prompting provides an additional capability: selecting which visual distinctions the student learns. Human-annotated evaluations across four datasets support this criterion-specific control.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ASK，一种基于核的引导方法，可将大型视觉语言模型（VLM）的成对相似性判断迁移到CLIP中，同时保留其图像-文本能力。适配后检索仅用CLIP嵌入与余弦相似度，无需调用VLM。
AI.motivation: 大型VLM能判断视觉相似性，但其判断无法直接作为紧凑图像嵌入用于高效比较。因此作者希望将这些偏好迁移到CLIP中，同时保持其原有的图像-文本能力。
AI.method: ASK在小型图像组内构造半正定目标核，结合视觉核匹配与图像-文本分布锚定；使用低秩适配器联合更新视觉与文本编码器，并将预测正则化向冻结CLIP靠拢。方法无需访问教师嵌入或收集新的人类相似性标注。
AI.result: 在五个图像领域、四种CLIP骨干和六个评判者上评估教师一致性、检索与识别保持。ViT-B/16上，未参与适配类别的平均检索mAP由53.8提升至75.0，优于DINOv2目标+KL锚定的71.7；联合适配编码器的平均零样本准确率由61.8%升至62.4%（12个基准、5个适配域平均）。提示还提供了选择学生所学视觉区分的能力，四个人类标注数据集支持这种准则特异性控制。
AI.conclusion: ASK能有效将VLM相似性偏好迁移至CLIP嵌入，在提升检索性能的同时基本保持零样本识别能力，并可通过提示控制学习到的视觉区分。

title: Principal Steering Subspaces for Online Adaptation of Frozen Generative Robot Policies
summary: Generative robot policies provide expressive behavior priors, but updating a large diffusion or flow-matching model through online interaction is costly. Latent-space reinforcement learning avoids updating the pretrained generator by controlling its initial sampling noise, yet high-dimensional noise can have strongly anisotropic effects on decoded actions. We introduce Principal Steering Subspaces (PSS), a forward-query interface that constructs a fixed low-dimensional control basis from finite-difference decoder responses. Soft Actor-Critic controls the leading response directions, while the orthogonal complement is independently resampled from the Gaussian prior at each query. On three RoboMimic tasks with diffusion and flow-matching policies, response spectra reveal substantial concentration. Across five matched task-generator pairs, the training curves indicate that PSS generally converges faster and exhibits more stable late-training behavior than full-latent control, while achieving stronger final performance overall. Controlled Diffusion-Square ablations further show that leading-response directions outperform random and least-responsive subspaces of equal dimension. We further integrate PSS with a frozen, closed-source 3B-parameter vision-language-action (VLA) policy in a humanoid learning system with synchronous transition collection, reset-time optimization, and latency-aware asynchronous deployment. In an exploratory screwdriver-placement evaluation, success is observed in 2/10 trials for the frozen VLA policy and 6/10 after SAC+PSS adaptation. These results support decoder-response geometry as a practical basis for online adaptation of frozen generative robot policies.

AI.tldr: 提出主引导子空间(PSS)，用解码器响应的低维控制基替代高维潜噪声控制，实现冻结生成式机器人策略的高效在线自适应。
AI.motivation: 生成式机器人策略（扩散/流匹配模型）提供丰富行为先验，但通过在线交互更新大模型代价高昂；潜空间强化学习虽避免更新预训练生成器，仅控制初始采样噪声，却面临高维噪声对解码动作影响强各向异性的问题。
AI.method: PSS是一种前向查询接口，通过有限差分解码器响应构造固定低维控制基；用SAC控制主导响应方向，而正交补方向在每个查询时独立从高斯先验重采样。方法在RoboMimic三个任务上以扩散与流匹配策略验证，并做响应谱分析与Diffusion-Square消融；进一步与冻结的闭源3B参数VLA策略集成，构建含同步转移采集、重置时优化和延迟感知异步部署的人形学习系统。
AI.result: 响应谱显示显著集中；五组匹配任务-生成器对中，PSS比全潜控制收敛更快、后期更稳定，最终性能整体更强。消融表明主导响应方向优于同维度随机与最不敏感子空间。探索性螺丝刀放置任务中，冻结VLA成功2/10，SAC+PSS自适应后为6/10。
AI.conclusion: 解码器响应几何可作为冻结生成式机器人策略在线自适应的实用基础。

title: Geometry-Preserving Blind Watermarking for Raw 3D Point Clouds
summary:
Raw 3D point clouds are a core geometric representation. Establishing their ownership is challenging because point sets are irregular, unstructured, and frequently altered by resampling and geometric preprocessing. We present a blind watermarking framework that operates directly on xyz coordinates and supports both object-level shapes and scene-scale scans. At verification time, the embedded message is recovered from the observed point cloud alone, without access to the original point cloud, color, normals, or mesh connectivity. The method jointly learns watermark embedding and extraction through a feed-forward octree-based architecture, enabling efficient multi-scale geometric reasoning on large point sets. During training, a stochastic transformation layer exposes the decoder to common geometric perturbations, while progressive pose alignment improves robustness to pose changes.
  Experiments on object-level and scene-level benchmarks demonstrate reliable message recovery under common geometric processing while maintaining low geometric distortion. Qualitative comparisons further show that the learned perturbations are less visually conspicuous and less spatially structured than those of handcrafted alternatives.

AI.tldr: 提出一种直接作用于xyz坐标的盲水印框架，基于八叉树前馈架构联合学习嵌入与提取，支持物体级与场景级点云，在常见几何处理下稳健恢复信息且失真低。
AI.motivation: 3D点云是核心几何表示，但其所有权确立困难：点集不规则、无结构，且常被重采样和几何预处理改变。现有方法多依赖原始点云、颜色、法线或网格连接信息，限制了实用性。
AI.method: 直接对xyz坐标操作，验证时仅凭观测点云即可恢复信息，无需原始点云、颜色、法线或网格连接。采用前馈八叉树架构联合学习水印嵌入与提取，实现大规模点集的高效多尺度几何推理。训练中引入随机变换层使解码器暴露于常见几何扰动，并用渐进式姿态对齐提升对姿态变化的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在物体级与场景级基准上，常见几何处理下实现可靠的信息恢复，同时保持较低的几何失真。定性比较显示，所学扰动比手工设计的替代方案在视觉上更不显眼、空间结构更弱。
AI.conclusion: 该盲水印框架可同时适用于物体级形状与场景级扫描，兼顾鲁棒性与低失真，且扰动的视觉隐蔽性优于手工方法，为点云所有权保护提供了实用方案。

title: CodeActionBench: Evaluating Agentic Code-as-Policy for Embodied Manipulation
comment: 28 pages including references and appendices, 10 figures. Project website: https://codeactionbench.org
summary: How well can general-purpose multimodal models turn visual understanding and reasoning into embodied manipulation via executable code? We introduce CodeActionBench, a benchmark of 25 manipulation tasks that evaluates this capability through agentic Code-as-Policy. Without task-specific fine-tuning, demonstrations, external specialist perception or grasp modules, privileged scene state, or predefined task policies, agents should select visual evidence, form task-relevant 3D estimates, construct manipulation targets, and iteratively execute and revise their policies. A shared robot API provides RGB observations, calibrated geometric operations, robot feedback, and bounded motion, leaving task-dependent decisions to the evaluated agent. Fixed task instances, resource budgets, and a hidden physical-outcome verifier support controlled comparisons across models and harness configurations. Extensive evaluations across nine configurations and 675 attempts achieve success rates ranging from 2.7% to 73.3%. The strongest configuration, GPT-6 Astra with Codex CLI, solves 22 of 25 tasks at least once in three attempts, demonstrating the best performance while still leaving substantial room for improvement. Trajectory analyses reveal difficulties in spatial alignment, object retention, and completion judgment, including task failures despite successfully completed motions. CodeActionBench provides a controlled testbed for measuring how general-purpose models translate their capabilities into manipulation behavior and for examining typical failure scenarios in that process.

AI.tldr: 提出 CodeActionBench 基准，用 25 个操作任务评测通用多模态模型能否通过可执行代码（Code-as-Policy）将视觉理解与推理转化为具身操作行为。
AI.motivation:
现有研究尚不清楚通用多模态模型能否把视觉理解与推理能力转化为具身操作。需要可控的评测平台，在不依赖任务特定微调、演示、外部专家感知/抓取模块、特权场景状态和预设策略的条件下，衡量模型将自身能力转化为操作行为的程度。

"
AI.method: 构建 CodeActionBench：25 个操作任务，采用智能体式 Code-as-Policy 范式。智能体需自主选择视觉证据、形成任务相关 3D 估计、构建操作目标，并迭代执行与修正策略。共享机器人 API 提供 RGB 观测、标定几何操作、机器人反馈和受限运动，任务相关决策留给智能体。评测使用固定任务实例、资源预算和隐藏的物理结果验证器，以保证跨模型与不同 harness 配置的可比性。共评测 9 种配置、675 次尝试。
AI.result: 9 种配置、675 次尝试的成功率介于 2.7% 至 73.3%。最强配置 GPT-6 Astra 配合 Codex CLI 在三次尝试内至少一次解决 25 个任务中的 22 个，表现最佳但仍留有较大提升空间。轨迹分析揭示空间对齐、物体保持与完成判断方面的困难，包括运动已成功完成却判定任务失败的案例。
AI.conclusion: CodeActionBench 为衡量通用模型如何将自身能力转化为操作行为、并考察该过程中的典型失败场景，提供了可控的测试平台。

title: Skeletons in Flow: Graph Structured Flow Matching for Human Motion Prediction
summary: Human motion prediction requires diverse future trajectories that remain consistent with observed motion and the articulated physical structure of the body. Skeletal constraints restrict individual poses, while coordinated motion depends on spatial interactions (between connected joints) and temporal interactions (between time instants). To facilitate human motion prediction in light of these constraints and interactions, we introduce Graph Structured Flow Matching (GSFM), which transports the complete future skeletal trajectory through a single conditional velocity field. The trajectory produces a spatiotemporal skeleton graph, and spatial and temporal attention couple its evolution according to skeletal relations and physical time offsets. Bone directions lie on unit spheres relative to a root joint, and tangent evolution preserves input bone lengths throughout generation. We train a learned velocity field through conditional flow matching along geodesic paths connecting random trajectories centered on the last-observed pose to recorded future trajectories. Experiments on the Archive of Motion capture As Surface Shapes (AMASS) dataset evaluate prediction accuracy, diversity calibration, and motion statistics. We demonstrate the contributions of spatial and temporal message passing in the developed architecture through an ablation study. GSFM models trained on AMASS also perform competitively on the Human3.6M skeleton without parameter updates or retraining, demonstrating applicability to an unseen skeletal structure.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出图结构化流匹配（GSFM），通过单一条件速度场传输完整未来骨骼轨迹，实现多样化且符合骨骼与物理约束的人体运动预测。
AI.motivation: 人体运动预测需要生成多样化且与观测动作一致的未来轨迹，同时受骨骼结构约束。个体姿态受骨骼限制，而协调运动依赖空间（相连关节间）与时间（不同时刻间）的交互。现有方法难以同时满足这些约束与交互需求。
AI.method: 提出图结构化流匹配（GSFM）：将完整未来骨骼轨迹通过单一条件速度场进行传输，轨迹形成时空骨骼图，空间与时间注意力依据骨骼关系和物理时间偏移耦合其演化。骨骼方向位于以根关节为单位的球面上，切线演化在生成过程中保持输入骨骼长度。通过条件流匹配沿测地路径训练学习到的速度场，路径连接以最后观测姿态为中心的随机轨迹与记录的未来轨迹。
AI.result: 在AMASS数据集上评估了预测精度、多样性校准和运动统计，并通过消融实验验证了空间与时间消息传递的贡献。在AMASS上训练的GSFM在Human3.6M骨骼上无需参数更新或重训练即具有竞争力，显示对未见骨骼结构的适用性。
AI.conclusion: GSFM通过时空图结构与流匹配有效处理人体运动预测中的骨骼约束与交互，在准确性、多样性和泛化到未见骨骼结构方面表现良好。

title: Achieve What You Imagined: Learning to Align Actions with Visual Plans
summary: World-action models can jointly predict future visual observations and robot actions. However, discrepancies may exist between their visual predictions and the consequences implied by generated actions. We observe that WAMs can often generate visually plausible task-completion outcomes before producing action sequences that reliably achieve them. Consequently, we treat the WAM-generated visual prediction as a goal-conditioned visual proposal rather than a directly executable plan. We use a frozen action-conditioned world model to predict action-conditioned consequences and construct feedback based on consistency between the two future predictions and alignment with the terminal goal. Leveraging this feedback, we employ Flow Policy Optimization (FPO) to optimize the action head of the WAM. This framework avoids online robot interaction and additional training of task-specific reward models. Across four real-world UR5 manipulation tasks, our method increases the mean success rate from 43.4% to 75.1%, compared with 61.4% for $π_{0.5}$. These results show that cross-model prediction discrepancy can provide useful feedback for improving robot policies under the evaluated manipulation tasks. Website: https://imagine-to-achieve.github.io/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用世界-动作模型（WAM）的视觉预测作为目标视觉提议，通过冻结的动作条件世界模型构建一致性反馈，并用Flow Policy Optimization优化动作头，在四个真实UR5任务上将平均成功率从43.4%提升至75.1%。
AI.motivation: WAM可联合预测未来视觉观测与机器人动作，但其视觉预测与生成动作所隐含的结果之间存在不一致：模型往往先产生视觉上合理的目标完成结果，却随后生成无法可靠实现该结果的动作序列。这一矛盾促使作者将视觉预测重新定位为目标提议而非可直接执行的计划，并寻求无需在线交互和任务专属奖励模型的优化方式。
AI.method: 将WAM生成的视觉预测视为目标条件的视觉提议；使用冻结的动作条件世界模型预测动作条件下的结果；基于两次未来预测之间的一致性以及与终端目标的对齐程度构造反馈信号；利用该反馈通过Flow Policy Optimization (FPO)优化WAM的动作头，无需在线机器人交互，也无需额外训练任务专属奖励模型。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界UR5操作任务上，方法将平均成功率从43.4%提升至75.1%，且优于π_{0.5}的61.4%。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的操作任务中，跨模型预测差异能够为改进机器人策略提供有效反馈，验证了将WAM视觉预测作为目标提议并结合一致性反馈优化动作头的可行性。

title: Two-Stage Multi-View Gait Recognition with a Re-Embedding Network
summary: Gait recognition always remains challenging due to severe overfitting and the rigid view constraints common in single-stage approaches. We propose a two-stage framework, termed Translate-First-Then-Reason (TFTR), to address these issues. In the first stage, a shallow Siamese convolutional network with triplet loss maps Gait Energy Images (GEIs) into a 128-dimensional view-specific embedding space. In the second stage, these per-view embeddings are treated as tokens and processed by a 12-layer Transformer encoder, which re-projects them into a new space with improved cosine separability. This design enables flexible fusion of an arbitrary number of views at inference, overcoming the fixed-input limitations of prior methods. Trained on the OU-MVLP dataset (6,000 subjects) and evaluated on unseen CASIA-B across normal, bag-carrying, and coat-wearing conditions, our pipeline achieves 96.91\% single-view and 99.49\% three-view accuracy on OU-MVLP, and attains 100\% accuracy on CASIA-B with three views.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段步态识别框架 TFTR：先用 Siamese 网络将 GEI 映射到视角特定嵌入，再用 Transformer 进行重投影与多视角融合。
AI.motivation: 单阶段步态识别方法存在严重过拟合和视角约束僵化的问题，且已有方法对输入视角数量固定，难以灵活融合多视角信息。
AI.method: 第一阶段用带 triplet loss 的浅层 Siamese 卷积网络将 Gait Energy Images 映射到 128 维视角特定嵌入空间；第二阶段将这些逐视角嵌入视为 token，输入 12 层 Transformer 编码器，重新投影到具有更好余弦可分性的新空间，实现任意数量视角的灵活融合。
AI.result: 在 OU-MVLP（6000 人）上训练，并在未见过的 CASIA-B 上跨正常、背包、穿大衣条件评估：OU-MVLP 单视角 96.91%、三视角 99.49%；CASIA-B 三视角达到 100% 准确率。
AI.conclusion: TFTR 通过“先变换、后推理”的两阶段设计，缓解了过拟合与视角限制，支持任意视角数量融合，并在跨数据集与多条件下取得优异性能。

title: DeltaSeek: Toward Active Perception in Evolving Construction Environments
summary: Construction environments evolve continuously, causing large geometric changes that degrade static mapping and registration performance. This necessitates active perception, where robots deliberately select sensing configurations to resolve the environment's current state. We present DeltaSeek, an initial framework toward active perception in evolving built environments. While our broader objective is a system that reasons about where, how, and when to observe, this paper addresses a critical prerequisite: how a robot's sensing embodiment constrains the observations it can acquire. We formalize an embodiment's permissible observation set and evaluate with a Husky A300 equipped with a UR5e on an IFC-derived benchmark under chassis-mounted and wrist-mounted RGB-D configurations, scoring observations by geometric visibility and effort by drivable distance. In a room-scale scene with eight controlled changes spanning four observability conditions, exhaustive evaluation over 240 permissible base poses and five arm postures shows that two changes admit no chassis viewpoint whatsoever, while the wrist camera resolves both. For changes observed by both embodiments, the median base travel is $6.0$~m for the wrist camera and $15.2$~m for the chassis camera. These results distinguish sensing limitations from acquisition costs, clarifying whether an observation is impossible or simply requires more travel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeltaSeek框架，研究动态建筑环境中主动感知的前置问题：机器人感知构型如何约束其可获得的观测。
