AI.motivation: 建筑环境持续演变，产生大幅几何变化，导致静态建图与配准性能下降，因此需要主动感知。作者更宏大的目标是让系统推理"在哪、如何、何时"观测，而本文聚焦一个关键前提：机器人感知本体如何限制其可获取的观测集合。基于IFC基准，使用Husky A300搭载UR5e，对比底盘安装与腕部安装的RGB-D构型，以几何可见性评分观测、以可行驶距离衡量代价。在包含八处受控变化、四种可观测性条件的房间尺度场景中，对240个可行基座位姿与五种臂姿态进行穷举评估，发现两处变化不存在任何底盘视角，而腕部相机可解决这两处；对两者均可观测的变化，腕部相机的基座移动中位数为6.0 m，底盘相机为15.2 m。结果表明该方法能区分感知限制与获取代价，澄清某观测是"不可能"还是"仅需更多移动"。
AI.method: 形式化感知本体的许可观测集合；在IFC派生基准上，用Husky A300 + UR5e在底盘安装与腕部安装两种RGB-D配置下，对240个可行基座位姿与5种臂姿态做穷举评估，以几何可见性评分观测、以可行驶距离衡量代价。
AI.result: 在含8处受控变化、4种可观测性条件的房间尺度场景中：2处变化无任何底盘视角但腕部相机可解决；两者均可观测的变化中，腕部与底盘相机的基座移动中位数分别为6.0 m与15.2 m。
AI.conclusion: 结果将感知能力限制与观测获取代价区分开，有助于判断某观测是根本不可能，还是仅仅需要更多移动代价。

title: RoboSTAR: Next-Scale Autoregressive Sign Language Translation for Humanoid Robots
summary: Sign-language interpretation in public communication relies on qualified professional interpreters and can be difficult to scale, motivating robotic signing as a complementary accessibility interface. We present RoBoSTAR, a text-conditioned sign language production (SLP) framework for generating human-centric sign motion that can be retargeted for robotic execution, with speech supported optionally through an external ASR front end. Conventional autoregressive approaches flatten motion into a single full-resolution token sequence, forcing long-range and local dependencies to be modeled at a uniform temporal granularity. RoBoSTAR instead combines part-wise Finite Scalar Quantization with next-scale autoregression, generating motion over progressively finer temporal resolutions while predicting synchronized body and hand tokens in parallel within each step. This coarse-to-fine formulation provides compact long-range context before progressively refining motion details, while self-conditioning and context corruption improve robustness to cross-scale prediction errors. The generated motion is subsequently retargeted for physical humanoid execution. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness of RoBoSTAR.

AI.tldr: 提出RoBoSTAR，一种文本驱动的手语动作生成框架，采用部件级有限标量量化与下一尺度自回归，实现由粗到细的动作生成并支持机器人执行重定向。
AI.motivation: 公共传播中的手语翻译依赖专业译员，难以规模化扩展，因此需要机器人手语作为辅助的无障碍交互接口，但传统自回归方法将动作压平为单一全分辨率序列，无法兼顾长程与局部依赖的建模。
AI.method: 结合部件级有限标量量化（Finite Scalar Quantization）与下一尺度自回归（next-scale autoregression），在逐步细化时间分辨率的过程中并行预测同步的身体与手部token；通过自条件（self-conditioning）与上下文破坏（context corruption）提升对跨尺度预测误差的鲁棒性；生成的动作用于物理人形机器人的重定向执行；语音可作为可选输入经由外部ASR前端支持。
AI.result: 开展了大量定性与定量评估，验证了RoBoSTAR的有效性。
AI.conclusion: RoBoSTAR通过由粗到细的多尺度生成范式，先建立紧凑的长程上下文再细化动作细节，为可扩展的机器人手语生成提供了一条有效路径。

title: Robot-GST: geometry-aware spatial-temporal robot policy representation and evaluation
summary: Robotic manipulation policies are advancing rapidly with increasing reliance on vision-language models for end-to-end decision making. However, reliable deployment remains challenging because many policies lack explicit mechanisms for predicting task outcomes and evaluating whether generated actions will achieve desired final states, causing execution errors to accumulate during long-horizon manipulation. We present Robot-GST, a geometry-aware spatio-temporal behaviour representation and evaluation framework that constructs a Gaussian-SAM robotic environment for real-to-sim policy verification and improves the reliability of real-world manipulation deployment. Our approach constructs a high-fidelity robotic environment from RGB-D observations using 3D Gaussian Splatting and SAM3D, enabling ``simulation and evaluation before acting''. It integrates visual observations and language instructions with spatio-temporal reasoning for long-horizon task planning using large vision-language models. To bridge high-level planning and real-world execution, we introduce Gaussian-aware final-state estimation through geometric sampling and state-based trajectory planning. Before execution, candidate action sequences are simulated and evaluated in the Gaussian-SAM environment to filter infeasible behaviours. We validate our approach on representative manipulation tasks involving rigid, soft, and deformable objects, including cube placing, toy packing, and duck rearrangement, demonstrating that geometry-aware spatio-temporal reasoning and state-aware execution improve manipulation reliability across different object categories. Our results suggest that combining geometry-aware reconstruction with high-quality rendering and simulation provides a scalable approach for evaluating robotic manipulation behaviours. Website: https://robot-gst.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出Robot-GST，一种几何感知的时空行为表示与评估框架，通过构建Gaussian-SAM机器人环境实现real-to-sim策略验证，提升真实世界操作部署可靠性。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作策略日益依赖视觉语言模型进行端到端决策，但许多策略缺乏预测任务结果和评估生成动作能否达成期望最终状态的显式机制，导致长时程操作中执行误差不断累积，可靠部署仍然困难。
AI.method: 利用3D高斯泼溅与SAM3D从RGB-D观测构建高保真机器人环境，实现"先仿真评估再执行"；将视觉观测与语言指令结合，借助大型视觉语言模型进行时空推理的长时程任务规划；引入基于几何采样的高斯感知最终状态估计与基于状态的轨迹规划；执行前在Gaussian-SAM环境中仿真并评估候选动作序列以过滤不可行行为。
AI.result: 在涉及刚性、软体和可变形物体的代表性操作任务（包括方块放置、玩具打包和鸭子重排）上进行了验证，证明几何感知的时空推理与状态感知执行可提升不同物体类别下的操作可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 将几何感知重建与高质量渲染和仿真相结合，为评估机器人操作行为提供了一种可扩展的途径。

title: FSS-UBrain: Multi-region Few-Shot Brain Tumor MRI Segmentation
comment: This work has been submitted to the Elsevier for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Accurate delineation of whole tumor (WT), tumor core (TC), and enhancing tumor (ET) from multimodal magnetic resonance imaging remains challenging under limited annotation, cross-cohort variation, and severe target sparsity. We propose FSS-UBrain, a region-wise one-shot segmentation framework that uses a labeled positive support slice to condition binary query segmentation separately for WT, TC, and ET. Support-derived foreground and background descriptors guide query-feature adaptation, bottleneck interaction, decoder-side reconstruction, and boundary refinement. Episodic training additionally incorporates hard-negative and fully negative queries with empty-query regularization to suppress spurious foreground activation when the selected region is absent. Although inference operates on two-dimensional support--query slice pairs, checkpoint selection, threshold calibration, and final evaluation are performed after volumetric reconstruction. FSS-UBrain is evaluated on a held-out BraTS 2020 split and under target-supported cross-cohort protocols on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa. Cases used as target support are excluded from the query cohorts, and no target-domain fine-tuning or test-time parameter updates are performed. On BraTS 2020, FSS-UBrain achieves volumetric Dice scores of 89.82%, 82.14%, and 77.42% for WT, TC, and ET, respectively, with corresponding 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) values of 11.12, 9.01, and 4.46 mm. It also achieves the highest mean Dice and lowest finite-pair mean HD95 point estimates on BraTS 2023 and BraTS-Africa among the compared few-shot methods. These findings support target-conditioned few-shot segmentation while highlighting sensitivity to support selection and cohort-specific variation.

AI.tldr: 提出FSS-UBrain，一种区域级单样本少样本分割框架，用一张有标注的正支持切片分别条件化WT、TC、ET的二值查询分割。
AI.motivation: 多模态MRI中全肿瘤、肿瘤核心和增强肿瘤的精确勾画在标注有限、跨队列变异和目标稀疏条件下仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 支持片衍生的前景与背景描述子引导查询特征适配、瓶颈交互、解码器侧重建和边界细化；情景训练引入难负查询、全负查询及空查询正则以抑制误激活；推理基于二维支持-查询切片对，但检查点选择、阈值校准和评估在体数据重建后进行，不进行目标域微调或测试时参数更新。
AI.result: 在BraTS 2020上，WT、TC、ET的体积Dice分别为89.82%、82.14%、77.42%，HD95分别为11.12、9.01、4.46 mm；在BraTS 2023和BraTS-Africa上取得对比少样本方法中最高的平均Dice和最低的有限配对平均HD95点估计。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持目标条件化的少样本分割，但同时对支持切片选择和队列特异性变异敏感。

title: DexTaG: Tactile-as-Guidance in Reinforcement Learning for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Glove-based motion capture is emerging as a scalable approach to collecting dexterous-hand demonstration data. However, due to the kinematic gap between the human and robot hand, the recorded human motions cannot be executed directly on the robot, especially for contact-rich tool-use tasks involving in-hand reorientation. Prior work bridges this gap in simulation through reinforcement learning (RL) or trajectory optimization, but the human contact pattern is hard to preserve under such formulations, often producing unnatural manipulation and unstable functional grasps. These methods also train a separate policy or solve a separate optimization for each reference trajectory, which is inefficient. To solve these problems, we propose DexTaG, a tactile-guided RL framework for dexterous manipulation. During training, tactile signals captured by the glove guide policy search toward the measured human contact pattern, reducing reliance on precise reference geometry for contact supervision. To improve efficiency, we train a single generalizable retargeter jointly on all training trajectories of the same object. The retargeter is further distilled into a tactile-free student controller conditioned on the target object trajectory for real-world deployment. On marker-pen and hammer manipulation tasks, DexTaG learns natural, contact-rich behaviors that baselines with distance-based contact heuristics fail to learn, generalizes to held-out trajectories of the same object and task, and outperforms single-trajectory baselines on OakInk2.

AI.tldr: 提出 DexTaG，一种触觉引导的强化学习框架，用于将手套捕捉的人类手部动作重定向到机器人手，实现接触丰富的工具操作。
AI.motivation: 基于手套的动作捕捉是采集灵巧手演示数据的可扩展方法，但人手与机器人手之间存在运动学差距，采集的人类动作无法直接在机器人上执行，尤其在涉及手内重定向的接触丰富工具使用任务中。已有工作通过强化学习或轨迹优化在仿真中弥合差距，但难以保留人类接触模式，常导致不自然的操作和不稳定的功能性抓取；同时这些方法需为每条参考轨迹单独训练策略或求解优化，效率低下。
AI.method: DexTaG 利用手套采集的触觉信号引导策略搜索，使其趋向测量到的人类接触模式，从而减少对精确参考几何进行接触监督的依赖。为提升效率，在同一物体的所有训练轨迹上联合训练一个可泛化的重定向器。该重定向器进一步蒸馏为以目标物体轨迹为条件的无触觉学生控制器，用于真实世界部署。
AI.result: 在标记笔和锤子操作任务上，DexTaG 学到了自然且接触丰富的行为，这些行为是基于距离的接触启发式基线无法学到的；方法能泛化到同一物体和任务的未见过轨迹，并在 OakInk2 上优于单轨迹基线。
AI.conclusion: 以触觉信号引导重定向并结合可泛化重定向器与无触觉学生控制器蒸馏，可在减少监督依赖的同时高效学习接触丰富的灵巧操作，并支持真实世界部署与跨轨迹泛化。

title: HeroFrame-Bench: Reference-Anchored Evaluation via Rubric--Ranking Co-Evolution for Movie Hero Frame Selection
summary: Hero frames are in-film stills used as source imagery for theatrical posters, streaming cover art, film database listings, and other promotional placements. As the first visual entry point, they shape audiences' initial impressions of the movie and their subsequent willingness to watch it. Selecting these frames, a task we term hero frame selection, requires balancing content relevance with aesthetic appeal. A related task is keyframe selection, yet its benchmarks prioritize relevance over aesthetics, using either finite annotations that exclude valid alternatives or VideoQA that entangles selection quality with downstream model capability. We therefore introduce HeroFrame-Bench, built through a scalable VLM-as-a-Judge framework. We construct multimodal contexts from diverse metadata to ground a VLM judge that scores selected frames using our Reference-anchored Percentile. The percentile is obtained by inserting each frame into reusable, pre-ranked reference chains, enabling direct, extensible, and reliable evaluation. To reduce ambiguity and improve consistency in these subjective judgements, we further propose Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution, which generates movie-specific rubrics to condition the VLM judge and refines rubrics jointly with the resulting rankings. Within this process, we introduce several verifiable signals, most notably the Inverted Rubric Attack, to select robust rubrics. Finally, HeroFrame-Bench is instantiated over 204 movies with 2,031 reference chains and 1,970 learned rubrics. We build an annotation interface for human-alignment studies which show that our construction design improves VLM agreement with human from 77.56% to 83.78%. Evaluation on multiple methods show that hero frame selection remains challenging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出英雄帧选择任务及HeroFrame-Bench基准，通过VLM-as-a-Judge框架、参考锚定百分位与评分标准-排序协同进化方法，实现可扩展且可靠的英雄帧评估。
AI.motivation: 英雄帧是电影海报、流媒体封面等宣传素材的源图像，作为观众的第一视觉入口，影响其对电影的印象与观看意愿。该任务需在内容相关性与美学吸引力之间取得平衡。而相关任务关键帧选择的基准偏重相关性而忽视美学，且要么使用排除了合理替代项的有限标注，要么使用将选择质量与下游模型能力纠缠在一起的VideoQA，因此需要新的评估基准。
AI.method: 提出HeroFrame-Bench，基于可扩展的VLM-as-a-Judge框架构建。利用多样元数据构建多模态上下文以支撑VLM评判器，采用Reference-anchored Percentile打分：将每帧插入可复用的预排序参考链中获得百分位，实现直接、可扩展、可靠的评估。为降低主观判断的歧义并提升一致性，提出Rubric-Ranking Co-Evolution，生成电影专属评分标准以条件化VLM评判器，并与排序结果联合优化评分标准。过程中引入若干可验证信号，尤以Inverted Rubric Attack最为突出，用于筛选鲁棒的评分标准。
AI.result: HeroFrame-Bench实例化覆盖204部电影、2,031条参考链与1,970个学习到的评分标准。构建标注界面进行人类对齐研究，结果显示该构建设计将VLM与人类的一致性从77.56%提升至83.78%。对多种方法的评估表明英雄帧选择仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出并实例化了英雄帧选择任务与HeroFrame-Bench基准，验证了参考锚定百分位与评分标准-排序协同进化在提升VLM与人类一致性方面的有效性，并指出现有方法在该任务上仍有较大提升空间。

title: Residual Learning-Based Control of Vehicle Platoons with $\ell_2$ Stability Guarantees via Recurrent Equilibrium Networks
comment: Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: This paper proposes a residual learning-based control framework for heterogeneous vehicle platoons subject to parametric uncertainty and external disturbances. A nominal controller designed via Linear Matrix Inequalities (LMIs), along with disturbance-observer compensation, is enhanced by a Recurrent Equilibrium Network (REN) trained offline using stored trajectories and nominal-model prediction errors. The REN is constrained to satisfy a prescribed $\ell_2$-gain bound, enabling sufficient small-gain conditions for local closed-loop stability and disturbance string stability. Experiments demonstrate reduced spacing and velocity errors relative to the nominal controller.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于残差学习的异构车辆队列控制框架，用REN补偿LMI标称控制器，在参数不确定与外部扰动下实现局部稳定性与扰动弦稳定性，实验显示间距与速度误差降低。
AI.motivation: 异构车辆队列面临参数不确定性与外部扰动，传统基于LMI的标称控制器与扰动观测器补偿难以充分应对模型失配与残余误差，需要一种能利用数据进一步降低跟踪误差、同时保持可证明稳定性的学习型控制方法。
AI.method: 以LMI设计的标称控制器加扰动观测器补偿作为基础控制器；用离线存储的轨迹与标称模型预测误差训练循环平衡网络（REN）作为残差控制器；对REN施加预设的ℓ2增益约束，从而导出小增益条件，保证局部闭环稳定性与扰动弦稳定性。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比纯标称控制器，所提残差学习框架降低了车辆队列的间距误差与速度误差。
AI.conclusion: 通过在标称控制器上叠加具有ℓ2增益约束的REN残差学习模块，可在保持可证明稳定性（局部闭环稳定与扰动弦稳定）的同时提升异构车辆队列的控制精度，验证了残差学习与稳定性约束结合的有效性。

title: One Perception, All Maneuvers: Directional Traffic Signal Understanding for Maneuver-Level Signal Intent Prediction
summary:
Traffic lights are a key regulatory signal for autonomous driving at urban intersections, yet existing traffic signal perception is still predominantly formulated as instance-level detection or color recognition. Such formulations identify where traffic lights are and what colors they display, but leave a critical semantic gap before downstream planning: which ego maneuver is controlled by each visible signal and what dynamic permission the signal expresses for that maneuver.
  In this paper, we formulate Directional Traffic Signal Understanding, a decision-oriented task that predicts structured signal states for straight, left-turn, right-turn, and U-turn maneuvers from a front-view image. Each state contains the associated signal color and signal-implied passability. Based on OpenLane-V2, we provide a direction-level benchmark with maneuver-level supervision and metrics for color recognition, passability, full-frame consistency, and safety-critical errors. A direction-aware baseline combines global context, localized traffic-light evidence, and maneuver-specific representations. Experiments show that direction-level modeling improves passability prediction over image-level classifiers and detection-oriented pipelines, particularly at complex multi-signal intersections. The resulting representation provides a direct and interpretable traffic-signal interface for downstream planning together with topology, route, and surrounding-agent information.

AI.tldr: 本文将交通信号感知重构为面向决策的"方向级交通信号理解"任务，预测直行、左转、右转和掉头各机动对应的信号颜色与通行许可，并基于OpenLane-V2构建方向级基准与评估指标。
AI.motivation: 现有交通信号感知多以实例级检测或颜色识别为主，只能回答信号灯"在哪里、显示什么颜色"，却无法说明每个可见信号控制的是哪个自车机动、以及该信号对这一机动表达何种动态通行许可，导致下游规划前存在关键的语义鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出方向级交通信号理解任务，从车头视角图像出发，为直行、左转、右转、掉头四类机动预测结构化信号状态（信号颜色+信号隐含的可通行性）。基于OpenLane-V2构建带机动级监督的方向级基准，并设计颜色识别、可通行性、全帧一致性和安全关键错误四类指标。同时提出方向感知基线，融合全局上下文、局部交通灯证据与机动特定表示。
AI.result: 实验表明，方向级建模在可通行性预测上优于图像级分类器和检测导向的流水线，在复杂多信号交叉口场景下优势尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 该表示方法为下游规划提供了直接、可解释的交通信号接口，可与拓扑、路径及周围智能体信息协同使用。

title: ArticulateArena: A Metric for Articulated Kinematics
summary: Modern methods reconstruct or generate simulation-ready articulated objects, predicting not only their geometry but also how their parts are connected and allowed to move. Evaluating the geometry is straightforward, but evaluating the predicted articulation is not, because articulation specifies a motion rather than a shape, and there is no agreed distance between two motions. More specifically, existing protocols score joint type, axis direction, origin, and motion limits separately, although these parameters jointly describe a single physical motion, and the same motion can be written as different parameter values. As a result, a joint can score maximally wrong against an equivalent encoding of itself, and several component errors are ill-conditioned or undefined exactly where predictions become accurate. We propose ArticulateArena, a representation-invariant counterpart of Chamfer distance for articulation that compares the motions one-DOF joints induce rather than the parameters that encode them. It represents each joint by the unordered pair of its Lie-algebra endpoint twists, and we prove that the resulting quotient distance is a metric. It unifies fixed, revolute, prismatic, and helical joints, brings continuous joints into the same score through a compactification, and reads as the RMS motion of the moving part in meters when weighted by its mass distribution. A motion-aware tree edit distance lifts the metric to full kinematic trees, pricing structural errors such as spurious or missing joints in the same motion units as joint errors, and for a fixed inner product it remains a metric on trees up to relabeling. Alongside the metric we release ArticulateArena-20K, a new suite of 19,977 articulated objects with verified kinematics, and we re-evaluate published reconstruction methods on it under the new metric. Project page: https://heyumeng.com/ArticulateArena-web/

AI.tldr: 提出ArticulateArena，一种表示不变的关节铰接距离度量（类似Chamfer距离的对应物），比较单自由度关节所诱导的运动而非其参数编码，并证明其商距离为度量。结合运动感知的树编辑距离可度量完整运动学树，并发布ArticulateArena-20K数据集（19,977个物体）用于重新评估现有重建方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法重建或生成可仿真的铰接物体时，既预测几何也预测关节连接与运动方式。几何评估简单，但铰接评估困难，因为铰接描述的是运动而非形状，且不存在公认的"两个运动之间的距离"。现有协议分别对关节类型、轴方向、原点、运动限制打分，而这些参数共同描述单一物理运动，且同一运动可有不同参数表示；导致等价编码可能得到完全错误的分数，且部分分量误差在预测变准处反而病态或未定义。
AI.method: 以运动而非参数编码来比较单自由度关节所诱导的运动。每个关节用其李代数端点twist的无序对表示，证明所得商距离构成度量。统一处理固定、旋转、棱柱和螺旋关节，通过紧致化把连续关节纳入同一评分，按质量分布加权后以移动部件的RMS运动（米）呈现。再用运动感知的树编辑距离将该度量提升到完整运动学树，用同一运动单位衡量结构性错误（如多余或缺失关节），对固定内积在树的重标号意义下仍为度量。
AI.result: 在运动度量本身及数据结构上：实现了关节类型无关、参数表示不变的运动比较；给出度量性质证明（商距离与树编辑距离）；统一各类关节并支持连续关节；加权后可解释为米制RMS运动。同时发布ArticulateArena-20K，包含19,977个具有经验证运动学的铰接物体；并在此新度量下重新评估已发表的重建方法。
AI.conclusion: ArticulateArena为铰接评估提供了表示不变的几何Chamfer距离对应物，关节层面比较运动、树层面衡量结构与关节误差，并提供新基准与重新评估结果，弥补了现有参数化评估的等价编码不一致与病态问题。

title: FoundDSR: A Generalizable Foundation Model with Guided 2D Gaussian Splatting for Depth Super-Resolution
summary: We introduce FoundDSR, a generalizable foundation model for robust depth reconstruction across unseen data distributions using RGB-D pairs. FoundDSR begins with a guided 2D Gaussian Splatting strategy to model depth representations with Gaussian primitives. This strategy employs high-resolution RGB as prompts to optimize the Gaussian parameters, thereby encouraging each Gaussian primitive to anisotropically deform along high-frequency structural directions. The resulting Gaussian-upsampled representations are then mapped to high-resolution depth through an effective depth reconstruction branch. Furthermore, to mitigate training instability and bias toward dominant sources caused by distribution gaps in large-scale heterogeneous data, we introduce heterogeneous federated learning that allocates each data source to an independent client for local optimization and global aggregation. This design effectively endows FoundDSR with stable scalability to diverse and large-scale training data. Extensive zero-shot evaluations on synthetic, real-world, arbitrary-scale, and noisy conditions demonstrate that FoundDSR consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches, confirming its strong robustness and generalization to unknown scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出通用基础模型 FoundDSR，结合引导式 2D 高斯溅射与异构联邦学习，实现跨未见分布的鲁棒深度重建。
AI.motivation: 现有深度重建方法在面对未见数据分布时泛化能力不足，且大规模异构数据存在分布差异，易导致训练不稳定与对主导数据源的偏置，难以稳定扩展。
AI.method: 1) 引导式 2D 高斯溅射：以高分辨率 RGB 作为提示优化高斯参数，促使高斯基元沿高频结构方向各向异性变形，得到高斯上采样表示；2) 通过深度重建分支将其映射为高分辨率深度；3) 引入异构联邦学习，将每个数据源分配到独立客户端进行本地优化并全局聚合。
AI.result: 在合成、真实、任意尺度及噪声条件下的广泛零样本评测中，FoundDSR 持续超越现有最先进方法，验证了其对未知场景的强鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FoundDSR 通过高斯溅射表示与异构联邦学习的结合，既能提升深度重建精度，又能稳定扩展至多样大规模训练数据，是一种可泛化的鲁棒深度重建基础模型。

title: EpiTransfer: Sparse, Training-Free Long-Range Depth Estimation from Temporal Monocular Aerial Frames
summary: Reliable 3D spatial understanding is essential for autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and scene reconstruction. While state-of-the-art learned depth estimation techniques achieve high accuracy in-distribution, they often generalize poorly to novel viewpoints and altitudes. This paper presents a geometrically derived, training-free depth estimation method using epipolar transfer with only two monocular images and camera pose estimates. By leveraging camera motion to synthesize a virtual stereo pair with a freely chosen baseline, our approach transforms temporal correspondence into a stereo triangulation task while mitigating geometric degeneracies inherent to direct two-view triangulation. Validated across outdoor drone flights (to a maximum range of approximately 90\,m) and indoor OptiTrack environments against LiDAR ground truth, the method achieves an indoor AbsRel of 0.092 and $δ< 1.25$ of 0.940, comparable to direct triangulation (AbsRel 0.073) while retaining valid depth over a larger fraction of challenging scenes, and substantially outperforms off-the-shelf learning-based baselines such as ZoeDepth (AbsRel 0.225) and Depth Anything V2 (AbsRel 0.570), which are not trained or fine-tuned for this domain, with no training data required.

AI.tldr: 提出一种几何推导、免训练的深度估计方法，仅用两幅单目图像和相机位姿，通过极线转移动生成虚拟立体像对进行三角测量，在无人机与室内场景中对LiDAR真值验证，效果优于现成学习基线。
AI.motivation: 可靠的三维空间理解对自主导航、避障与场景重建至关重要。现有学习式深度估计在分布内精度高，但在新视角和新高度下泛化能力差，且通常需要训练数据。
AI.method: 一种几何推导、免训练的深度估计方法：仅使用两幅单目图像与相机位姿估计，利用相机运动合成具有可自由选择基线的虚拟立体像对，把时间对应转化为立体三角测量问题，从而缓解直接双视图三角测量固有的几何退化。
AI.result: 在室外无人机飞行（最远约90米）与室内OptiTrack环境中对LiDAR真值验证：室内AbsRel为0.092、δ<1.25为0.940，与直接三角测量（AbsRel 0.073）相当，但在更多困难场景中保持有效深度；显著优于ZoeDepth（AbsRel 0.225）和Depth Anything V2（AbsRel 0.570）等现成学习基线，且无需训练数据。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以几何方式实现免训练深度估计，在跨视角、跨高度场景中泛化更好，无需训练数据即可优于未针对该领域训练或微调的学习式基线，适用于无人机与室内等场景。

title: Progressive-View On-Policy Distillation for Regional-to-Global Transfer in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Regional-to-global distillation uses crop-conditioned guidance to improve full-image understanding. The challenge is to effectively transfer the teacher's crop-based advantage to the student's full-image inference. We propose progressive-view on-policy distillation (PVD), which shifts the student's view distribution from the crop toward the full image through an intermediate aspect-preserving padded crop. The padded crop preserves regional content while matching the full image's visual-token grid. Across stages, the view mixture assigns increasing probability to the full image. A lightweight regional-advantage weighting reallocates token-level supervision using the crop-conditioned teacher-student log-probability gap. Evaluated under each sampled input, it applies mild reweighting when the gap is small and emphasizes higher-gap tokens when the gap widens. A Jensen-Shannon metric decomposition interprets this schedule as a shift from matched-input imitation toward the deployment objective. Across benchmarks spanning perception, visual mathematics and general multimodal question answering, PVD-full reaches an average accuracy of 77.51 over three seeds, improving on the reward-free distillation baseline by 2.01 points and on its reward-matched variant by 1.00 point. In the reward-free setting, PVD-distill still gains 1.16 points.

AI.tldr: 本文提出渐进视图在策略蒸馏（PVD），通过中间态填充裁剪逐步将学生视图分布从裁剪图像迁移到全图，并结合区域优势加权，显著提升全图理解性能。
AI.motivation: 区域到全局蒸馏利用裁剪条件指导提升全图理解，但难点在于如何有效将教师基于裁剪的优势迁移到学生的全图推理中，避免视图分布不匹配。
AI.method: 提出渐进视图在策略蒸馏（PVD）：通过保持长宽比的填充裁剪作为中间视图，使区域内容保留且视觉token网格与全图对齐；各阶段视图混合逐步提高全图概率。采用轻量区域优势加权，根据裁剪条件下教师-学生对数概率差重新分配token级监督：差距小时温和加权，差距大时强调高差距token。并用Jensen-Shannon度量分解解释该调度是从匹配输入模仿向部署目标的转变。
AI.result: 在感知、视觉数学和通用多模态问答等基准上，PVD-full三次种子平均准确率达77.51，比无奖励蒸馏基线提升2.01分，比其奖励匹配变体提升1.00分；在无奖励设定下，PVD-distill仍提升1.16分。
AI.conclusion: PVD通过渐进视图调度与区域优势加权，有效弥合裁剪与全图之间的视图差距，在多种多模态任务上取得一致且显著的性能提升。

title: ReSync: Re-Aligning the Two Clocks of Asynchronous World-Action Models
summary: Jointly generating future video and actions has become a standard recipe for world-action models, and the strongest systems denoise the two streams on separate schedules: actions are decoded in few steps so control stays fast, while the video stream runs longer to keep the predicted future sharp. The design is deliberate, but it leaves the two streams on different clocks, and an action can become executable while the future that should justify it is still largely unresolved. We formalize this as a two-clock view of asynchronous inference and introduce the commitment-evidence gap, a quantity read directly from a model's own sampling schedule rather than measured by search. The gap is predictive: as it widens, candidate utility becomes harder to identify and extra candidate sampling buys less, while advancing the world stream buys more, and the two cross. Spending more world computation is therefore not simply better. The useful interval is closed at both ends, and both ends can be read off the schedule before any rollout. ReSync places the computation inside it: hold the action state, advance only the world within the supported window, then resume native denoising. No parameters change and no candidates are compared. On a frozen paired RoboCasa panel this improves success by 4.48 points, while an equal-compute control that waits without advancing the world does not move, and the same rule transfers to a second benchmark and a second backbone without retuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"双时钟"视角刻画世界-动作模型的异步推理，定义可从采样调度直接读取的"承诺-证据鸿沟"，并据此设计ReSync方法：在有用区间内冻结动作、只推进世界流，再恢复原生去噪，无需改参或候选比较，在RoboCasa上成功率提升4.48点且可跨基准、跨骨干迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型对动作与视频采用独立调度去噪：动作少步解码以保持控制快速，视频多步以保持预测清晰。这使两流处于不同时钟，动作可能已可执行而其应有的未来依据仍远未确定。作者希望形式化这一异步推理问题，并找到无需搜索即可判断"何时该多算世界、何时该多采候选"的判据。
AI.method: 将异步推理形式化为双时钟视角，提出"承诺-证据鸿沟"这一可直接从模型采样调度读取的指标（而非通过搜索测量）。发现该指标具有预测性：鸿沟变宽时候选效用更难识别、多采候选收益递减，而推进世界流收益递增，二者存在交叉。由此提出ReSync：在有用区间内保持动作状态、仅推进世界流至支撑窗口，再恢复原生去噪。方法不改变任何参数，也不比较候选。
AI.result: 在冻结的配对RoboCasa测试面板上，ReSync使成功率提升4.48个百分点；等计算量但不推进世界流的对照实验无提升；同一规则无需重新调参即可迁移到第二个基准和第二个骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: 更多的世界计算并非简单地越好，其有用区间两端封闭且可在任何推演前从调度读出。ReSync在有用区间内分配计算，以零额外参数、零候选比较实现稳定提升，并具备跨基准与跨骨干的泛化性。

title: SGA-Flow-GRPO: Spatial Gradient-Guided Credit Assignment for Flow-GRPO
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has proven effective in aligning flow-based generative models with human preferences. Recently, Flow-GRPO has emerged as an efficient critic-free paradigm by calculating advantages over sampled candidate trajectories. However, standard Flow-GRPO applies a uniform scalar advantage across both temporal denoising steps and spatial latent dimensions, without explicitly accounting for the spatial structure of generated images, which may lead to sub-optimal policy updates. To address this, we propose a novel gradient-guided spatial credit assignment framework tailored for Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). We first reformulate the transition-level log-likelihood in Flow-GRPO into a token-wise representation natively aligned with DiT patch architectures, constructing spatially fine-grained importance sampling ratios. To allocate localized credit without rigid, boundary-sensitive segmentation heuristics, we introduce a continuous spatial credit map derived from reward gradients. Crucially, we employ an outlier-robust normalization scheme based on Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) coupled with temperature scaling, effectively eliminating gradient noise while highlighting functional prompt-aligned regions. Extensive evaluations on GenEval show that our approach delivers SOTA alignment quality, achieving a convergence rate comparable to top-tier methods like DiffusionNFT while substantially improving upon Flow-GRPO-based methods in alignment performance.

AI.tldr: 提出梯度引导的空间信用分配框架，将Flow-GRPO的统一标量优势改为DiT token级的空间细粒度信用分配，在GenEval上达到SOTA对齐质量。
AI.motivation: 标准Flow-GRPO在整个去噪时间步和空间潜维上施加统一标量优势，未显式考虑生成图像的空间结构，可能导致次优的策略更新。
AI.method: 将Flow-GRPO的transition级对数似然重构为与DiT patch架构原生对齐的token级表示，构建空间细粒度的重要性采样比；用奖励梯度导出连续空间信用图，避免依赖僵硬且对边界敏感的分割启发式；再以基于中位数绝对偏差(MAD)的离群点鲁棒归一化配合温度缩放，消除梯度噪声并突出与提示对齐的功能区域。
AI.result: 在GenEval上的大量评估显示，该方法实现了SOTA的对齐质量，收敛速度与DiffusionNFT等顶级方法相当，并在对齐性能上显著优于基于Flow-GRPO的方法。
AI.conclusion: 面向DiT的梯度引导空间信用分配有效提升了Flow-GRPO类方法的对齐性能与收敛效率，实现SOTA对齐质量。

title: Integrity Detection and Characterization of Malicious Injections in RAVEN II
summary:
The increasing adoption of robotic systems in surgery, together with the expanding range of procedures they can support and the growing level of autonomy they provide, has substantially increased the complexity of surgical robots. As these systems integrate more sensors, controllers, communication interfaces, and model-driven control components, their attack surface continues to expand. A compromise of the integrity of a surgical robot can therefore cause unintended robot behavior and potentially threaten patient safety.
  In this paper, we characterize the detection boundary of malicious injections on RAVEN II using a public dataset that pairs the platform's telemetry with external high-resolution encoder ground truth. We identify three injection points spanning the command and observation paths and evaluate three injection patterns with increasing temporal dispersion. To capture different detection behaviors, we perform detection at two timescales: the window scale and the session scale. Rather than reporting detection rates at an arbitrarily chosen threshold, we quantify, for each injection point and injection pattern, the smallest end-effector deviation that can be resolved while maintaining an alarm rate acceptable for surgical operation. Our results show that detectability is strongly influenced by how the injected deviation is distributed over time. An abrupt step can be detected at deviations well below the 1 mm clinical tolerance, whereas the same overall deviation spread across a window or a session can remain hidden from single-window statistics. The open source code can be found at http://github.com/RAVENIIROS/RAVENIIIntegrity.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了手术机器人RAVEN II对恶意注入攻击的检测边界，发现检测能力受注入偏差的时间分布方式强烈影响。
AI.motivation: 手术机器人集成越来越多传感器、控制器与模型驱动组件，攻击面不断扩大，其完整性若被破坏可能导致意外行为并威胁患者安全，因此需要明确系统对恶意注入的可检测边界。
AI.method: 基于RAVEN II公开数据集（平台遥测数据配以外部高分辨率编码器真值），在命令与观测路径上确定三个注入点，评估三种时间弥散度递增的注入模式，并在窗口尺度和会话尺度两个时间尺度上进行检测，量化在各注入点与模式下可分辨的最小末端执行器偏差（在满足手术可接受报警率前提下）。
AI.result: 可检测性与注入偏差随时间分布的方式密切相关：突变的阶跃式偏差可在远低于1 mm临床容差的水平被检出，而相同总偏差若分散到整个窗口或会话中，则可能无法被单窗口统计方法发现。
AI.conclusion: 手术机器人恶意注入的检测边界并非仅取决于偏差大小，而与时间弥散特性相关；需综合考虑多时间尺度检测策略。开源代码见 http://github.com/RAVENIIROS/RAVENIIIntegrity。

title: OpenMASC: An Open-Source Pipeline for Cross-Trajectory Metal-Aware Sampling and Correction in Accelerated MRI
summary: Metal implants corrupt MRI measurements throughout $k$-space, yet existing accelerated MRI methods assume clean data and most metal artifact reduction approaches assume fully sampled acquisitions. No public dataset provides paired $k$-space and images with and without metal for the same anatomy, and no framework jointly addresses artifact-aware acquisition and reconstruction across sampling trajectories. We present OpenMASC, an open-source pipeline covering the full workflow from data generation to deployment. A physics-based data generation module converts public CT volumes into paired clean and metal-corrupted MRI data in both Cartesian and radial formats. MA-VarNet, an unrolled reconstruction network with a per-cascade DC Rectifier, corrects artifacts that data-consistency steps reintroduce from corrupted measurements. A reinforcement learning agent actively selects $k$-space readouts and co-trains with the reconstruction network through a decoupled three-stage procedure. The framework is trajectory-agnostic except for the data-consistency operator, supporting both Cartesian and radial acquisition without architectural changes. Experiments on two datasets at $4\times$ and $8\times$ acceleration demonstrate consistent improvements over conventional and learned baselines on both trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenMASC开源流程，涵盖从物理数据生成到重建部署的全链路，针对金属植入物污染的MRI数据，实现轨迹无关的伪影感知采样与重建。
AI.motivation: 金属植入物会污染整个k空间的MRI测量，但现有加速MRI方法假设数据干净，多数金属伪影抑制方法又假设全采样。缺乏配对（含/不含金属）的k空间与图像公开数据集，也没有同时处理伪影感知采集与跨采样轨迹重建的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 基于物理的数据生成模块，将公开CT体数据转换为笛卡尔与径向两种格式下配对的干净与金属污染MRI数据；2) MA-VarNet：带逐级DC Rectifier的展开重建网络，用于纠正数据一致性步骤从污染测量中重新引入的伪影；3) 强化学习智能体主动选择k空间读出，通过解耦的三阶段流程与重建网络协同训练；4) 除数据一致性算子外框架与轨迹无关，无需改变架构即支持笛卡尔与径向采集。
AI.result: 在两个数据集、4倍与8倍加速下，在两种采样轨迹上均一致优于传统与学习类基线方法。
AI.conclusion: OpenMASC提供首个覆盖数据生成到部署的开源流程，通过伪影感知采集与重建联合框架，在多种加速倍数与轨迹下有效提升金属伪影MRI的重建质量。

title: FINGR: Learning Dexterous Hand Control for Real-World Rubik's Cube Solving
summary: Manipulating a Rubik's Cube with a single dexterous hand is a challenging test of sustained, contact-rich control: the hand must execute successive layer turns while keeping the cube secure. Each turn requires some fingers to support the cube while others push a moving layer, release contact, and reset for the next move. To learn this coordination, we introduce FINGR (Future-supervised Interaction Network with Geometric Representations), a policy that combines finger-relative geometry with future interaction prediction. A shared point encoder expresses the cube relative to each fingertip and aggregates its points without depending on cubie indexing. Learned future tokens share the observation encoder and receive supervision for contact-force changes, layer-turn progress, and finger joint displacement at multiple time scales. The resulting representation conditions a flow policy that directly generates finger actions. On a real dexterous hand, our policy achieves 99.0% success over 300 turn attempts, compared with 79.7% for the base flow policy. Integrated with grasping and table-assisted regrasping, the policy solves all ten scrambled $2\times2\times2$ cubes in a mean complete-system time of approximately 137 seconds. The project website is available at https://www.lyt0112.com/projects/FINGR

AI.tldr: 本文提出FINGR策略，通过手指相对几何表示与未来交互预测监督，实现单只灵巧手操作魔方并完成全部打乱二阶魔方的求解。
AI.motivation: 单只灵巧手操作魔方是持续、接触丰富的控制难题：每次转动需要部分手指支撑魔方、其余手指推动运动层、释放接触并为下一步重置，学习这种协调极具挑战。
AI.method: FINGR将手指相对几何与未来交互预测相结合：共享点编码器以每个指尖为参照表达魔方并聚合点云，不依赖小块索引；未来token共享观察编码器，并在多时间尺度上接受接触力变化、转层进度和手指关节位移的监督；所得表示用于条件化流策略，直接生成手指动作。
AI.result: 在真实灵巧手上，300次转动尝试成功率达99.0%，优于基础流策略的79.7%；结合抓取与桌面辅助重抓取，系统平均约137秒内解出全部十个打乱的2×2×2魔方。
AI.conclusion: 手指相对几何表示与多尺度未来交互监督能显著提升灵巧手接触丰富操作的鲁棒性与成功率，并支持完整魔方求解系统。

title: EyeVQA: Benchmarking Ophthalmic Vision-Language Models from Recognition to Spatial Grounding
comment: Accepted to MICCAI 2027 CREATE Workshop. 19 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Project page: [https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA](https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA)
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for medical image understanding, yet their capabilities in ophthalmic imaging remain insufficiently characterized. Existing ophthalmic datasets are typically designed for individual diseases or specialized tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate whether VLMs can move beyond disease recognition toward comparative reasoning and fine-grained spatial grounding. We introduce EyeVQA, a unified visual question answering benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of ophthalmic VLMs. EyeVQA is constructed from 21 available ophthalmic datasets and contains 20,000 question-answer pairs spanning six disease groups and seven question types: Single-Choice, Multi-Select, Variable-Select, True-False, Ranking, Point Location, and Bounding Box. Gold answers are deterministically derived from source-provided diagnoses, severity grades, clinical findings, segmentation masks, bounding boxes, and anatomical landmarks, enabling reproducible evaluation without relying on model-generated annotations. Notably, 44.5% of the questions require reasoning across multiple images, extending evaluation beyond conventional single-image medical VQA. We benchmark fourteen representative general-purpose, scientific, and medically specialized VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The best-performing model only achieves an overall score of 62.8, while substantial gaps remain in spatial grounding and cross-task generalization. These results highlight the limitations of current VLMs in comprehensive ophthalmic visual understanding and establish EyeVQA as a diagnostic benchmark for developing more reliable and spatially grounded ophthalmic multimodal models. The project page is available at https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA.

AI.tldr: 提出EyeVQA眼科视觉问答基准，含2万问答对，评测14个VLM，最佳仅62.8分，暴露空间定位与泛化短板。
AI.motivation: 现有眼科数据集多针对单一疾病或特定任务，难以系统评估VLM能否从疾病识别走向跨图比较推理与细粒度空间定位。
AI.method: 整合21个眼科数据集构建EyeVQA，含2万问答对，覆盖6类疾病组与7种题型（单选、多选、变选、判断、排序、点定位、边框）；答案由源数据诊断、分级、临床发现、分割掩码等确定性推导；44.5%题目需跨多图推理；在统一零样本协议下评测14个通用、科学与医学专用VLM。
AI.result: 最佳模型总体得分仅62.8，空间定位与跨任务泛化存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM在综合眼科视觉理解上仍有局限，EyeVQA可作为诊断性基准，推动更可靠、空间定位更准的眼科多模态模型发展。

title: Test-Time Spatial Reasoning for Robot Manipulation Using Generative Real-to-Sim
summary: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to general robot intelligence, as it enables robots to complete long-horizon tasks involving multi-object interaction. We introduce Simify, a training-free, test-time framework that performs explicit spatial reasoning via massively parallel physics simulation. From a single RGB-D image of a scene, Simify reconstructs simulation-ready assets leveraging 3D generative models and vision-language models. Then given a task specified by a reward function (e.g., build the tallest tower), Simify launches thousands of parallel rollouts in simulation and performs an evolutionary search to optimize object arrangements, typically converging within seconds. We conduct quantitative experiments on real-robot hardware to demonstrate the ability of our framework to execute complex object rearrangement tasks end-to-end with previously unseen objects. Results show that our framework outperforms prior work on foundation models for spatial reasoning by effectively exploiting large-scale parallel simulation during inference, and also highlight the importance of complete and accurate geometry for successful sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出 Simify，一种免训练、测试时的空间推理框架，通过大规模并行物理仿真显式完成空间推理，实现真实机器人对未见物体的复杂重排任务。
AI.motivation: 空间推理是通用机器人智能的基础，能让机器人完成涉及多物体交互的长时序任务；然而现有基础模型在空间推理上仍存在不足，需要更有效的推理方式。
AI.method: 从单张场景 RGB-D 图像出发，利用 3D 生成模型与视觉语言模型重建可仿真资产；在给定由奖励函数指定的任务后，在仿真中并行启动数千次 rollout，并采用进化搜索优化物体摆放，通常在数秒内收敛；整体为免训练、测试时框架。
AI.result: 在真实机器人硬件上进行定量实验，端到端执行对未见物体的复杂物体重排任务，性能优于此前空间推理基础模型的工作，并揭示了完整且准确几何对 sim-to-real 迁移成功的重要性。
AI.conclusion: Simify 表明在推理阶段利用大规模并行仿真可有效提升空间推理与真实机器人操作能力，同时强调精确几何重建是实现仿真到现实迁移的关键。

title: Fewer Tokens, More Self-Teaching: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Extreme Visual Token Reduction
summary: Visual token reduction is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but performance deteriorates rapidly under extremely low token budgets. Existing work has explored both visual-token selection and training-based adaptation to reduced visual inputs. We take a step further by asking how a heavily compressed MLLM should learn from the states induced by its own generations. This setting naturally calls for on-policy self-distillation: a heavily compressed model is supervised on the states induced by its own generations, while its full-token counterpart serves as an information-rich teacher. Based on this insight, we propose LT-OPD, a training framework for extreme visual-token reduction. The student rolls out responses with only a small fraction of visual tokens, and a frozen full-token copy of the same MLLM provides distributional supervision along these student-generated trajectories. To stabilize on-policy learning when visual evidence is severely limited, we further introduce a budget-level curriculum that progressively decreases the token budget during training. Across nine benchmarks on Qwen3.5-4B, LT-OPD raises average retained performance under 5% visual-token retention from 68.6% to 82.3%, outperforming training-free, training-based, and reinforcement-learning baselines at the same budget. The gains transfer consistently to Qwen3.5-9B, GLM-4.6V-9B, and LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B. LT-OPD also reduces KV-cache usage by 85.2% and prefill FLOPs by 85.4% without additional inference overhead, demonstrating that on-policy learning can substantially recover capabilities lost to extreme visual-token reduction.

AI.tldr: 提出LT-OPD训练框架，通过在线策略自蒸馏与预算课程学习，在仅保留5%视觉token时平均保留性能从68.6%提升至82.3%。
AI.motivation: 视觉token削减能加速多模态大模型，但在极低token预算下性能急剧下降。现有工作主要探索视觉token选择与基于训练的适配，尚未解决“重度压缩模型如何从自身生成状态中学习”的问题。本文希望借助完整token版本作为信息丰富的教师，通过在线策略自蒸馏来恢复被极端压缩损失的能力。
AI.method: 提出LT-OPD训练框架：学生模型仅用少量视觉token生成响应，冻结的同源全token模型在这些学生生成轨迹上提供分布监督；同时引入预算级课程，在训练过程中逐步降低token预算，以在视觉证据严重受限时稳定在线策略学习。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-4B的九个基准上，5%视觉token保留率下平均保留性能从68.6%升至82.3%，超过同预算的无训练、基于训练及强化学习基线；增益可迁移至Qwen3.5-9B、GLM-4.6V-9B和LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B；KV缓存使用降低85.2%，prefill FLOPs降低85.4%，且无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 在线策略学习能够显著恢复因极端视觉token削减而损失的能力，LT-OPD在极低token预算下兼具性能与效率优势，并具备跨模型迁移性。

title: TacGooseBumps (TacGB): Retrofitting Normal-Only Tactile Sensors with Shear Encoding for Learning Contact-Rich Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Wenjie Li and Binyu Yang contributed equally
summary: Contact-rich policies often fail because distinct physical states look alike yet require different actions. Cameras may not reveal whether a connector is aligned or fully seated, while many normal-only tactile sensors can miss the tangential interactions perpendicular to the grasping direction that distinguish these states. We ask whether a learning policy needs calibrated shear measurements, or only a repeatable observation that separates shear-dependent contact states. We introduce TacGooseBumps (TacGB), a passive domed film that mechanically encodes tangential loading as pattern changes in an existing sensor's pressure map. Tangential loading tilts each dome and redistributes pressure across its footprint; an end-to-end policy consumes the resulting maps without added electronics, force reconstruction, or taxel-level dome alignment. Across four imitation-learning tasks and two data-collection pipelines, TacGB improves goal attainment, efficiency, and contact quality: insertion success increases by up to 36 percentage points, and successful insertions are completed faster, while fragile-object placement becomes gentler and drawing becomes more continuous and straight. Signal, stage-wise, failure-mode, and trajectory analyses link these gains to contact regimes in which task-relevant tangential interactions are poorly resolved by vision and normal pressure alone. Together, these results show that shear need not be measured metrically to benefit robot learning; it can instead be mechanically encoded without changing the underlying tactile sensor or the policy's pressure-map input format.

AI.tldr: 提出被动圆顶薄膜 TacGB，将切向载荷机械编码为既有触觉传感器压力图上的图案变化，无需额外电子器件或力重建，即可提升模仿学习在接触丰富任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富型策略常因不同物理状态外观相似却需不同动作而失败。相机难以分辨连接器是否对齐或完全就位，而仅提供法向信号的触觉传感器会遗漏与抓取方向垂直的切向交互，正是这类交互区分了上述状态。作者追问：学习策略究竟需要标定过的剪切测量，还是只需要一种可重复、能区分剪切相关接触状态的观测。
AI.method: 设计 TacGooseBumps（TacGB）——一种被动圆顶薄膜，切向载荷使每个圆顶倾斜并在其接触足迹上重新分布压力，从而把切向加载机械地编码为现有传感器压力图的图案变化。端到端策略直接消费这些压力图，不使用额外电子元件、不做力重建、也不需要逐触觉单元与圆顶的对齐标定。在四个模仿学习任务和两种数据采集流程中进行评估。
AI.result: 在四个模仿学习任务和两条数据采集流程中，TacGB 提升了目标达成率、效率和接触质量：插入成功率最高提升 36 个百分点，成功插入完成得更快；易碎物体放置更轻柔，绘制轨迹更连续、更直。信号、阶段、失败模式和轨迹分析表明，这些增益来自视觉与法向压力难以分辨任务相关切向交互的接触区域。
AI.conclusion: 剪切信息不必被度量式测量也能有益于机器人学习；它可以被机械编码，且不改变底层触觉传感器或策略的压力图输入格式。

title: StegGNN: Learning Graphical Representation for Image Steganography
summary: Image steganography refers to embedding secret messages within cover images while maintaining imperceptibility. Recent advances in deep learning - primarily driven by Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and architectures such as inverse neural networks, autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks - have led to notable progress. However, these frameworks are primarily built on CNN architectures, which treat images as regular grids and are limited by their receptive field size and a bias toward spatial locality. In parallel, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have recently demonstrated strong adaptability in several computer vision tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance with architectures such as Vision GNN (ViG). This work moves in that direction and introduces StegGNN - a novel autoencoder-based, cover-agnostic image steganography framework based on GNNs. By modeling images as graph structures, our approach leverages the representational flexibility of GNNs over the grid-based rigidity of conventional CNNs. We conduct extensive experiments on standard benchmark datasets to evaluate visual quality and imperceptibility. Our results show that our GNN-based method performs comparably to existing CNN benchmarks. These findings suggest that GNNs provide a promising alternative representation for steganographic embedding and open the field of deep learning-based steganography to further exploration of GNN-based architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出StegGNN，一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的自编码器式、与载体无关的图像隐写框架，将图像建模为图结构以突破CNN的网格化局限，实验表明其视觉质量与不可感知性与现有CNN基准相当。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习图像隐写方法主要依赖CNN、逆神经网络、自编码器和GAN等架构，但CNN将图像视为规则网格，受感受野大小限制并偏向空间局部性。与此同时，GNN在计算机视觉任务（如ViG）中展现出强适应性和先进性能，因此作者希望将GNN引入隐写领域，探索更灵活的图像表示。
AI.method: 提出StegGNN：一个基于GNN的、与载体无关的图像隐写框架，采用自编码器结构。核心思想是把图像建模为图结构，利用GNN对非规则关系建模的表征灵活性，替代传统CNN的网格刚性。在标准基准数据集上进行大量实验，评估视觉质量和不可感知性。
AI.result: 在标准基准数据集上的实验显示，所提出的基于GNN的方法在视觉质量与不可感知性方面与现有CNN基准表现相当（comparable）。
AI.conclusion: GNN为隐写嵌入提供了一种有前景的替代表示方式，为基于深度学习的隐写开辟了进一步探索GNN架构的方向。

title: ZeroBot: Learning from Scratch in Minutes with Generative Real2Sim
summary: We present ZeroBot, a real2sim framework for learning a robot manipulation task from scratch in minutes under challenging conditions: zero human demonstrations, zero policy pre-training, and zero known object models. Given only a single view of an object and a goal pose for that object, ZeroBot uses image-to-3D generative models to obtain a complete object mesh, which is used in simulation for large-scale parallel reinforcement learning. To accelerate training, we introduce an action space which leverages the generated geometry and learned value function to sample states involving robot-object contact. When evaluated on real-world tasks including grasping, pushing, articulated object interaction, and multi-stage manipulation, ZeroBot achieves an 87% success rate with an average training time of 119 seconds. These results show the value of using image-to-3D models in a real2sim framework for rapid, autonomous robot learning.

AI.tldr: ZeroBot：zero人类演示、zero策略预训练、zero已知物体模型的real2sim框架，用图像到3D生成模型构建物体网格并在仿真中并行强化学习，平均119秒训练即可达87%真机成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人操作学习通常依赖人类演示、策略预训练或已知物体模型，成本高、泛化差。论文希望在无演示、无预训练、无物体模型的严苛条件下，仅凭单视角图像和目标位姿，实现快速自主的机器人操作学习。
AI.method: 提出real2sim框架ZeroBot：由单视角图像加目标位姿，通过image-to-3D生成模型重建完整物体网格；在仿真中进行大规模并行强化学习；并设计一种利用生成几何与学习到的价值函数来采样包含机器人与物体接触状态的动作空间，以加速训练。
AI.result: 在真机任务（抓取、推动、铰接物体交互和多阶段操作）上，ZeroBot取得87%成功率，平均训练时间119秒。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将image-to-3D模型用于real2sim框架，能够支撑快速、自主的机器人学习，为在无演示、无预训练、无物体模型条件下解决操作任务提供了可行路径。

title: An End-to-End Latent-Rollout Approach for Pushing Few-Step ImageNet-$256$ Generation to FID $1.11$ without Fréchet Losses
summary: Iterative generation poses a joint optimization problem across steps, as intermediate predictions shape subsequent computations and ultimately determine the final output distribution. Few-step generators distilled from pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models make such optimization computationally practical end to end. We build on this opportunity with a distill-then-refine approach that uses teacher imitation to establish a strong initialization for a few-step rollout in latent space, then shifts to end-to-end refinement of the complete latent rollout against real data. We introduce FiST (Flow-in-Stage Transformer), an architecture that composes learned latent-state transitions in a few stages using a shared Transformer, with optional cross-stage hidden communication. Distillation applies teacher-forced regression to selected states along teacher trajectories; refinement replaces this supervision with adversarial and auxiliary classification objectives on the final latent output. A trainable discriminator module operates on semantically rich features extracted from clean real and generated latents by a frozen SiT backbone pretrained with REPA. All training takes place in latent space, without image decoding. During refinement, FiST consumes its own intermediate predictions, and endpoint gradients pass through every generation stage. For class-conditional generation on ImageNet at $256\times256$, our approach achieves FID 1.11 (IS 282) with three stages and FID 1.15 (IS 280) with two. These results demonstrate competitive few-step generation through learned distribution-level supervision, without explicit Fréchet-distance minimization. Ablations characterize how distillation, pretrained checkpoint choices, refinement supervision, and cross-stage hidden communication affect generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出FiST架构与"蒸馏-再精炼"方法，通过共享Transformer在潜空间组合少步生成，实现竞争性的少步生成质量（3步FID 1.11）。
AI.motivation: 少步迭代生成本质上是跨步骤的联合优化问题：中间预测会影响后续计算并决定最终输出分布。从预训练扩散/流匹配模型蒸馏出的少步生成器使这种端到端优化在计算上变得可行，本文希望利用这一机会提升少步生成质量。
AI.method: 采用"先蒸馏后精炼"策略：先用教师模仿为潜空间少步展开建立强初始化，再针对真实数据对完整潜空间展开做端到端精炼。架构FiST（Flow-in-Stage Transformer）用共享Transformer在少数几个阶段中组合学习到的潜状态转移，并可选跨阶段隐藏通信。蒸馏阶段对教师轨迹上的选定状态做教师强制回归；精炼阶段用对抗目标与辅助分类目标替代该监督，作用于最终潜输出。可训练判别器基于冻结的、经REPA预训练的SiT骨干提取的语义特征，处理干净真实与生成潜变量。全部训练在潜空间进行，无需图像解码。精炼时FiST消费自身中间预测，端点梯度穿过每个生成阶段。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256类条件生成上，三阶段达到FID 1.11（IS 282），两阶段达到FID 1.15（IS 280），展现了具有竞争力的少步生成效果，且未显式最小化Fréchet距离。消融实验分析了蒸馏、预训练检查点选择、精炼监督以及跨阶段隐藏通信对生成质量的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习到的分布级监督（而非显式Fréchet距离最小化），可在潜空间中实现高质量少步生成，验证了蒸馏-再精炼与FiST架构的有效性。

title: Estimate, Don't Imitate: Reusing Differentiable State-Based Policies for Visuomotor Control
summary: Simulation-trained manipulation policies can exploit privileged state information to learn effective contact-rich behaviours, but deployment requires acting from partial observations such as noisy camera images. A common solution is teacher-student distillation, in which a visuomotor policy is trained to reproduce the actions of the privileged expert. This requires the student to jointly infer the task-relevant state and relearn the expert's action mapping that is already available. An alternative is to reuse the state-based expert and learn only a perceptual interface that reconstructs its missing state inputs. However, minimising the state estimate error alone does not necessarily minimise the downstream control error induced by these estimates. To bridge this gap, we train a visual state estimator using both direct state supervision and an action-consistency loss backpropagated through the frozen, differentiable expert. A scheduled objective first establishes a physically meaningful state estimate and progressively emphasises errors that affect the expert's actions. Across five goal-conditioned manipulation tasks, retaining the expert consistently outperforms direct pixel-to-action imitation from the same expert demonstration corpus. We further demonstrate sim-to-real transfer on a physical Panda robot, achieving 76% success without retraining the underlying expert.

AI.tldr: 提出一种视觉状态估计器训练方法，利用直接状态监督与通过冻结可微专家反向传播的动作一致性损失，分阶段优化，从而在保留专家策略的前提下实现从部分观测的鲁棒操作，并成功完成仿真到真实机器人的迁移。
AI.motivation: 仿真训练的操作策略通常依赖特权状态信息，但实际部署只能获取如含噪相机图像等部分观测。现有教师-学生蒸馏方法要求学生同时推断任务相关状态并重新学习专家已有的动作映射，效率与效果受限。
AI.method: 复用基于状态的专家策略，仅学习重建其缺失状态输入的感知接口。视觉状态估计器同时使用直接状态监督和经过冻结、可微专家反向传播的动作一致性损失。采用分阶段目标：先建立具有物理意义的状态估计，再逐步强调影响专家动作的估计误差。
AI.result: 在五个目标条件操作任务中，保留专家的方法始终优于直接像素到动作的模仿学习。在真实Panda机器人上完成仿真到现实迁移，无需重新训练底层专家即达到76%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过动作一致性损失引导的视觉状态估计器能够在保持专家策略的同时有效桥接感知与控制误差，实现高性能的部分观测操作与成功的仿真到现实迁移。

title: RefCompose: Multi-Reference Image Generation via LoRA-Conditioned Diffusion
comment: Accepted in ECCV 2026 Workshop on AI for Visual Arts
summary: Filmmakers and visual artists routinely need to compose multiple references, actors, locations, props, cultural elements, into a single coherent shot, but existing tools either fail to scale past a handful of references or destroy fine grained subject identity in the process, since per reference tokenization scales memory linearly with reference count $N$ and generated content often departs from the given references rather than reproducing them. We propose \textbf{RefCompose}, a pixel space compositional conditioning framework that decouples \emph{where} things go from \emph{what} they look like, via a single fixed resolution reference canvas that keeps conditioning size constant regardless of reference count. Spatial layout is induced at inference time from a frozen diffusion transformer and extracted via Grounding DINO, requiring no LLM or dedicated layout model, while dual stream LoRA adapters inject a layout derived depth map and the encoded canvas through separate low rank streams, disentangling geometric scaffolding from localized appearance. On the Dense Layout protocol, RefCompose consistently outperforms layout based and state of the art multi reference baselines on color, texture, shape, spatial accuracy, and identity/content preservation at higher reference counts, all with constant inference memory, making it a practical building block for multi subject cinematic composition at production scale.

AI.tldr: 提出 RefCompose，一种像素空间组合式条件框架，通过固定分辨率参考画布将条件规模与参考数量解耦，无需 LLM 或专用布局模型即可在推理时获得空间布局，并用双流 LoRA 分离几何骨架与外观信息，实现高参考数量下的多主体构图且内存恒定。
AI.motivation: 影视与视觉艺术创作常需将多个参考对象、演员、场景、道具、文化元素组合进同一画面，但现有工具存在两大痛点：一是逐参考 token 化使内存随参考数量 N 线性增长，难以扩展到多参考场景；二是生成内容往往偏离给定参考，破坏细粒度主体身份。因此需要一种可扩展且能保持主体一致性的组合式条件方法。
AI.method: RefCompose 在像素空间进行组合式条件建模，将"物体放在哪里"与"物体长什么样"解耦。核心是单一固定分辨率的参考画布，使条件规模不随参考数量变化。空间布局在推理时由冻结的扩散 Transformer 诱导生成，并经 Grounding DINO 提取，无需 LLM 或专用布局模型。随后使用双流 LoRA 适配器，将布局导出的深度图与编码后的画布分别通过两个低秩流注入，从而分离几何脚手架与局部外观。
AI.result: 在 Dense Layout 协议下，RefCompose 在颜色、纹理、形状、空间准确度以及身份/内容保持等指标上，均稳定优于基于布局的方法与当前最先进的多参考基线，且在更高参考数量下仍保持优势，同时推理内存恒定。
AI.conclusion: RefCompose 以恒定推理内存实现多主体电影级构图，可作为生产规模多主体组合的实用基础模块，解决了参考数量扩展性与细粒度身份保持之间的矛盾。

title: Quantile Head for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with action heads for robot control. Common action heads have distinct limitations: point regression provides only a point estimate of the action distribution, while standard flow-matching samplers require costly iterative sampling. To address these limitations, we unify regression and flow matching under a shared objective and extend it to derive a quantile objective. This quantile objective guides the design of our Quantile Head, which predicts a median and positive gaps to form ordered marginal action quantiles in one forward pass. These quantiles support multiple sampling strategies without retraining and are jointly supervised to train the default median policy. Our local analysis of this joint supervision shows that, with calibrated nearby quantiles, fixed gaps, and matched correction speed, direct median updates have lower variance than under median-only supervision. Experiments show that this jointly supervised median policy achieves the highest average success rates among the compared methods on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and two real-robot tasks, together with the shortest mean episode time among matched LIBERO baselines; code is available at https://github.com/xwangrs/Quantile-Head-for-VLA.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Quantile Head，将回归与流匹配统一到同一目标并推导出分位数目标，通过一次前向传播预测中位数与正向间隔形成有序动作分位数，支持多种采样策略，在多个基准与真实机器人任务上取得最高成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型的动作头存在局限：点回归只给出动作分布的点估计，标准流匹配采样器需要昂贵的迭代采样。作者希望兼顾两者的优点，解决单一动作头表达能力与采样效率的矛盾。
AI.method: 作者将回归和流匹配统一到共享目标下，并扩展推导出分位数目标，据此设计Quantile Head：一次前向传播预测中位数和正向间隔，构成有序的边缘动作分位数。这些分位数无需重训练即支持多种采样策略，并被联合监督以训练默认的中位数策略。
AI.result: 对联合监督的局部分析表明，在校准邻近分位数、固定间隔和匹配校正速度下，直接中位数更新比仅用中位数监督方差更低。实验显示该联合监督的中位数策略在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro及两个真实机器人任务上取得最高平均成功率，并在匹配的LIBERO基线中具有最短平均回合时间。
AI.conclusion: 分位数动作头通过统一回归与流匹配目标，实现了高效且高性能的动作生成，验证了联合监督的有效性，代码已开源。

title: Endo-TSR: Temporal Spectral Modeling of Appearance and Motion for Endoscopic Reconstruction
summary: Endoscopic scene reconstruction requires modeling tissue motion and temporal appearance while recovering fine surface detail. Deformable Gaussian models provide explicit trajectories, but their fixed colour coefficients lack a dedicated temporal representation for photometric changes. We propose Endo-TSR, which augments deformable Gaussian splatting with bounded Fourier colour residuals and independent translation residuals on shared temporal frequencies. The colour residuals capture local appearance changes, while a Matérn spectral prior regularises motion corrections. Multi-scale Laplacian supervision guides tissue-detail recovery during joint image fitting. Extensive experiments on the EndoNeRF and StereoMIS datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art rendering quality, with the highest PSNR across all evaluated sequences. Ablation studies show that temporal appearance yields the largest PSNR gain among the tested component additions, while appearance and detail supervision jointly improve rendering with fixed Gaussian counts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Endo-TSR，在可变形高斯泼溅框架上引入有界傅里叶颜色残差与独立平移残差，并配合 Matérn 谱先验和多尺度拉普拉斯监督，实现内窥镜场景的高质量重建。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜场景重建需要同时建模组织运动、外观随时间变化以及精细表面细节。现有可变形高斯模型虽能给出显式轨迹，但颜色系数固定，缺乏专门的时间表示来刻画光度变化。
AI.method: 在可变形高斯泼溅基础上增加有界傅里叶颜色残差，用于捕捉局部外观变化；同时在共享时间频率上加入独立平移残差以校正运动；使用 Matérn 谱先验正则化运动修正；并在联合图像拟合中采用多尺度拉普拉斯监督引导组织细节恢复。
AI.result: 在 EndoNeRF 和 StereoMIS 数据集上取得最优渲染质量，在所有评测序列中 PSNR 最高。消融实验显示，时间外观建模带来的 PSNR 提升最大；外观与细节监督在固定高斯数量下共同改善渲染效果。
AI.conclusion: 分离时间外观表示与运动建模、并结合谱先验与多尺度细节监督，能有效提升内窥镜动态场景的重建质量。

title: AD-E2E-JEPA: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture For End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving requires \textit{world models} that can understand the physical world, reason and plan, and operate safely. In this paper, we first systematically evaluate existing action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models, including LeWM, DINO-WM, and JEPA-WM for end-to-end autonomous driving (E2EAD). To isolate world-model quality from policy learning, we employ a goal-conditioned zero-shot planning setting that evaluates these models using ground-truth future observations as goals, without training any driving policy. We find that existing JEPA-based world models are either accurate for driving but computationally expensive, or computationally efficient but insufficient for planning. To address this trade-off, we propose \textbf{AD-E2E-JEPA}, which introduces a SIGReg-regularized learnable projector applied to projected patch embeddings. The projector reduces the number of planning patches by $16\times$ and the embedding dimension by $4\times$, achieving a $100\times$ inference speedup while retaining planning performance, with a 0.8-second runtime for an 8-frame rollout over 256 candidate trajectories. \textit{Without} training any driving policy, the world model itself reaches the goals located 20 meters away on average within the displacement of respectively 4.0/2.8 meters, using world-model rollouts over trajectory vocabularies of respectively 256/8,192 candidates. On the NAVSIMv2 benchmark, it achieves 67.3/72.9 EPDMS with multiplicative safety metrics and 84.1/86.5 EPDMS$^{\dagger}$ without them in goal-conditioned zero-shot planning. Experiments further show that the self-supervised pretrained projector improves downstream imitation learning performance from 80.2 to 85.4 EPDMS. The source code is available at https://github.com/HaoranZhuExplorer/AD-E2E-JEPA

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AD-E2E-JEPA，通过引入 SIGReg 正则化的可学习投影器，将规划 patch 数量减少 16 倍、嵌入维度减少 4 倍，实现 100 倍推理加速，同时保持规划性能，并提升下游模仿学习表现。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需要能理解物理世界、推理规划并安全运行的"世界模型"。作者系统评估了现有动作条件联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型（LeWM、DINO-WM、JEPA-WM）在端到端自动驾驶中的表现，发现存在精度高但计算昂贵、或计算高效但规划能力不足的两难权衡，因此希望解决这一权衡问题。
AI.method: 采用目标条件零样本规划设置，以真实未来观测作为目标，不训练任何驾驶策略，从而将世界模型质量与策略学习分离。提出 AD-E2E-JEPA，引入 SIGReg 正则化的可学习投影器作用于投影后的 patch 嵌入，以减少规划 patch 数量和嵌入维度。
AI.result: 规划 patch 减少 16 倍、嵌入维度减少 4 倍，实现 100 倍推理加速，8 帧 rollout 在 256 条候选轨迹下运行时间为 0.8 秒。不训练驾驶策略时，世界模型平均可在 4.0/2.8 米位移内到达 20 米外的目标（分别使用 256/8,192 条候选轨迹）。NAVSIMv2 基准上达到 67.3/72.9 EPDMS（含乘性安全指标）与 84.1/86.5 EPDMS†（不含），自监督预训练投影器将下游模仿学习从 80.2 提升至 85.4 EPDMS。
AI.conclusion: AD-E2E-JEPA 有效解决了 JEPA 世界模型在精度与效率间的权衡问题，在保持规划性能的同时大幅提升推理速度，并能改善下游模仿学习性能，为端到端自动驾驶世界模型提供了高效方案。

title: Toward On-Chip Training of Spiking Neural Networks for Dense Event-Based Vision
summary: Event cameras provide low-latency, asynchronous visual sensing for resource-constrained robotics. Spiking neural networks (SNNs) process event streams naturally, but training deep SNNs with backpropagation through time (BPTT) requires substantial memory and remains difficult on neuromorphic hardware. Local learning avoids this by restricting error propagation to local blocks, but existing methods mainly target classification rather than dense prediction. We introduce DELL (Dense Event-driven Local Learning), a block wise scheme for dense event-based vision that replaces global gradient propagation with local dense supervision. Learnable, spatially structured local heads supervise each block at its appropriate resolution while preserving temporal dynamics within blocks. We evaluate DELL on optical-flow regression and semantic segmentation with a fully spiking U-shaped architecture. On DSEC optical flow, DELL reduces peak training memory by 39.6% relative to end-to-end BPTT while improving accuracy, reaching 1.670 px endpoint error on the official test benchmark versus 1.941 px for the same backbone trained end-to-end. Block detachment behaves more like a regularizer than a constraint. DECOLLE, the existing local-learning baseline, relies on fixed random local read-outs poorly suited to dense regression, resulting in a 3.9x higher endpoint error; learnable local heads recover this loss and outperform end-to-end training across all optical-flow metrics. On segmentation, they recover most of the performance gap, although DELL remains a few mIoU points behind end-to-end training. With 2.3M parameters, 24x fewer than the strongest SNN baseline, the backbone remains competitive with the SNN state of the art on DSEC. These results extend local learning to dense event-based prediction while substantially reducing training memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DELL（Dense Event-driven Local Learning），一种面向密集事件视觉的块级局部学习方案，用可学习的局部密集监督替代全局梯度传播，在光流回归与语义分割任务上降低训练内存并提升或保持性能。
AI.motivation: 事件相机为资源受限机器人提供低延迟异步视觉感知，SNN可自然处理事件流，但用BPTT训练深层SNN内存开销大且在神经形态硬件上困难；现有局部学习多针对分类任务，缺乏面向密集预测的方法。
AI.method: 提出DELL块级方案：将误差传播限制在局部块内，取代全局梯度传播；采用可学习、空间结构化的局部头在各块适当分辨率上进行密集监督，同时保留块内时间动态；在完全脉冲的U形架构上评估，任务为光流回归与语义分割。
AI.result: DSEC光流上，相比端到端BPTT峰值训练内存降低39.6%，精度反而提升，官方测试集EPE为1.670 px（端到端同骨干为1.941 px）；块分离更像正则化而非约束。相比DECOLLE的固定随机局部读出（EPE高3.9倍），可学习局部头恢复损失并在所有光流指标上超越端到端训练。分割任务上缩小了大部分差距，但仍落后端到端几个mIoU点。模型2.3M参数，比最强SNN基线少24倍，在DSEC上仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: DELL将局部学习扩展到密集事件视觉预测，在大幅降低训练内存的同时保持或提升性能，为资源受限场景下的SNN密集预测提供了可行方案。

title: Beyond Retrieval Relevance: Scene-Grounded Risk Entailment for Vision-Language Driving
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) gives vision--language driving systems access to external safety knowledge, yet a retrieved risk rule may be relevant without applying to the current scene. A vision--language model (VLM) receiving such knowledge must ground objects, bind entities across time, and verify relations before deciding how to act, leaving the support for risk conclusions implicit. We address this relevance--applicability gap with a Driving-Risk Knowledge Graph (DRKG) and Semantic Web Rule Language (SWRL) reasoning stage before VLM decision-making. Structured perception instantiates scene facts, from which SWRL rules derive events and directed risk relations when their antecedents are jointly satisfied. Recognized events, bound risk relations, and semantic descriptions of activated rules form compact evidence that conditions the VLM and diffusion planner. In matched comparisons on nuReasoning, our method improved the nuReasoning planning score (NPS) by 1.30 points and the non-at-fault collision score (NC) by 2.76 points over the relevance retrieval-based baseline. These gains indicate that scene-applicable risk evidence improves safety-weighted planning relative to semantically retrieved risk knowledge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出驾驶风险知识图谱（DRKG）与SWRL推理阶段，在VLM决策前对检索到的安全知识进行适用性验证，从而提升安全加权规划性能。
AI.motivation: RAG为视觉-语言驾驶系统提供外部安全知识，但检索到的风险规则可能相关却不适用于当前场景。VLM接收此类知识时需自行完成对象定位、跨时间实体绑定与关系验证，导致风险结论的支持依据是隐式的，存在"相关性—适用性"鸿沟。
AI.method: 构建驾驶风险知识图谱（DRKG），并在VLM决策前引入SWRL规则推理阶段。结构化感知实例化场景事实，当规则前件同时满足时，SWRL规则推导事件与有向风险关系；将识别出的事件、绑定的风险关系及激活规则的语义描述组成紧凑证据，用于条件化VLM与扩散规划器。
AI.result: 在nuReasoning数据集上的匹配对比中，相比基于相关性检索的基线，方法将nuReasoning规划分数（NPS）提升1.30分，非过失碰撞分数（NC）提升2.76分。
AI.conclusion: 场景适用的风险证据相较语义检索的风险知识能更有效地改进安全加权规划，表明显式适用性推理对驾驶安全决策具有价值。

title: RefAdapt-DiT: Adaptive Joint Attention for Reference-Conditioned Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become the standard backbone for high-quality generative modeling, yet deploying them in conditional generation tasks remains computationally prohibitive because bidirectional joint attention repeatedly processes large reference streams. While existing optimization schemes mitigate generic temporal redundancy, they typically rely on coarse-grained static reuse and overlook the distinct dynamics of references and targets. Specifically, we observe that reference representations often evolve slowly along the generation trajectory, while the target often assigns little attention mass to them; reference drift and this target-to-reference exposure jointly shape how strongly stale reference states affect the target. To exploit these patterns, we introduce \RefAdapt, a training-free framework for adaptive control of joint attention between references and targets. Instead of rigid static strategies, \RefAdapt combines consecutive target-Q change with previously observed target-to-reference attention mass to control reference computation adaptively at block granularity. Under ultra-few-step settings, \RefAdapt enables speedups of up to $2.097\times$ on 4-step MiniMax H3 and $3.54\times$ on 8-step Qwen Image Edit, while maintaining comparable visual quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练的 RefAdapt 框架，通过自适应控制参考与目标之间的联合注意力计算，在几乎不损失视觉质量的前提下大幅加速条件生成中的 DiT 推理。
AI.motivation: 扩散 Transformer（DiT）已成为高质量生成建模的主流骨干，但在条件生成任务中，双向联合注意力需要反复处理庞大的参考流，导致计算成本过高。现有优化方法多依赖粗粒度、静态的冗余复用策略，忽略了参考与目标在生成过程中截然不同的动态特性。作者观察到：参考表示沿生成轨迹通常演化缓慢，而目标对其分配的注意力质量往往较小；参考漂移与目标对参考的暴露程度共同决定了过期参考状态对目标的影响强度。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架 RefAdapt，用于自适应控制参考与目标之间的联合注意力。它摒弃僵化的静态策略，在块粒度上将连续的 target-Q 变化量与先前观测到的目标对参考的注意力质量相结合，从而自适应地控制参考计算。
AI.result: 在超少步设置下，RefAdapt 在 4 步 MiniMax H3 上实现最高 2.097 倍加速，在 8 步 Qwen Image Edit 上实现最高 3.54 倍加速，同时保持相当的视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过挖掘参考与目标之间的差异化动态特性并进行块粒度的自适应注意力控制，RefAdapt 在无需训练的情况下有效降低了条件生成的推理开销，为 DiT 部署提供了高效且实用的加速方案。

title: Reliability-Aware Sparse Route Memory for Round-Trip Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) is typically evaluated as a one-way task, although deployed robots may need to return after reaching a goal. We study continuous round-trip VLN and diagnose failures in directional observability, deviation recovery, and termination stability. We propose a reliability-aware sparse route memory that records the executed Outbound trajectory as ordered geometric anchors and queries them in reverse through a structured hint, action-level arbitration, and terminal verification. On 50 reverse-paired episodes using NaVILA and a simulated Unitree Go2, language-only Return succeeds in 22.0% of episodes, while our online system reaches 55.1%. With exact route information, the same interfaces achieve 86.0%, showing that effective Return requires both accurate information and consistent action on that information. The remaining online gap arises mainly from geometric evidence that is too unreliable to authorise intervention. These results distinguish information quality, behavioural consistency, and online reliability as separate limits in long-horizon navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究连续往返式VLN，提出可靠性感知的稀疏路径记忆方法，将去程轨迹记录为有序几何锚点并在返程中反向查询，在仿真Unitree Go2上把返程成功率从22.0%提升到55.1%。
AI.motivation: 传统VLN通常被当作单向任务评估，但实际部署的机器人到达目标后往往需要返回起点。作者因此研究连续往返VLN，并诊断出三类失败原因：方向可观测性、偏差恢复与终止稳定性。
AI.method: 提出可靠性感知的稀疏路径记忆：把已执行的去程轨迹记录为有序几何锚点，并通过结构化提示、动作级仲裁与终止验证在返程中反向查询这些锚点，以增强信息可靠性与行为一致性。
AI.result: 在NaVILA与仿真Unitree Go2的50个反向配对回合中，纯语言返程成功率为22.0%，在线系统达到55.1%；若提供精确路径信息，相同接口可达86.0%。
AI.conclusion: 有效返程同时需要准确的信息与对该信息一致的动作执行。剩余的在线差距主要来自几何证据可靠性不足而无法授权干预，说明信息质量、行为一致性与在线可靠性是长时程导航中三个相互独立的限制因素。

title: CityToolVQA: Tool-Augmented Visual Question Answering for 3D Spatial Cognition in Urban Low-Altitude Environments
summary: CityToolVQA addresses the weak performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on quantitative tasks in urban low-altitude visual question answering. We divide the seven tasks into qualitative and quantitative groups: qualitative questions are answered directly by the VLM, whereas quantitative questions are handled by an external visual-geometric toolchain that performs object grounding, segmentation, depth back-projection, and spatial computation. The toolchain can be attached to different VLMs in a zero-shot manner; a Depth-Assisted Prompt Inference (DAPI) fallback is triggered when the main-chain detection is invalid or unreliable, and CityToolVQA-SFT adapts the 8B backbone to tool-conditioned inputs. On the 73,324-question Open3D-VQA-v2 test set, CityToolVQA-SFT (Qwen3-VL-8B) reaches 67.6% overall accuracy, and attaching the toolchain to ten open-source VLMs improves quantitative-task accuracy by 12.7-36.9 percentage points. These results indicate that externalizing explicit 3D geometric computation effectively complements the limited ability of RGB-only VLMs to estimate metric distances and object sizes.

AI.tldr: CityToolVQA提出用外部视觉-几何工具链处理城市低空视觉问答中的定量任务，定性任务仍由VLM直接回答，可在零样本下挂载到多种VLM，并在Open3D-VQA-v2测试集上取得67.6%总体准确率。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在城市低空视觉问答的定量任务上表现较弱，尤其是仅依赖RGB输入时难以估计度量距离和物体尺寸，因此需要引入显式的3D几何计算来弥补这一能力缺口。
AI.method: 将七类任务分为定性与定量两组：定性问题由VLM直接回答，定量问题交由外部视觉-几何工具链处理，包括目标定位、分割、深度反投影和空间计算；工具链可零样本挂载到不同VLM；当主链检测无效或不可靠时触发深度辅助提示推理（DAPI）回退；并通过CityToolVQA-SFT使8B骨干模型适应工具条件输入。
AI.result: 在73,324问题的Open3D-VQA-v2测试集上，CityToolVQA-SFT（Qwen3-VL-8B）达到67.6%的总体准确率；将工具链挂载到十个开源VLM上，定量任务准确率提升12.7至36.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将显式3D几何计算外部化，能有效补充仅依赖RGB的VLM在估计度量距离和物体尺寸方面的有限能力。

title: RAVEL: Asynchronous Rolling Inference for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models are highly effective for generalist robot manipulation, yet their reliance on computationally expensive VLM encoding and multi-step iterative action generation imposes a significant latency bottleneck. The resulting inference latency makes it difficult for robots to respond quickly, especially in dynamic environments. We address this limitation with RAVEL (Rolling Asynchronous VLA Enabling Low-Latency Control), an asynchronous inference framework that addresses the computational bottlenecks of both the VLM backbone and the action expert. To reduce the delay from multi-step action denoising, RAVEL allows near-term actions to be executed after a single denoising step by carrying partially denoised future actions forward in a rolling buffer. To avoid blocking on slow VLM encoding, RAVEL decouples VLM encoding from rolling action generation, allowing the action expert to operate continuously using the latest available VLM context, while a lightweight Fast Observation Pathway (FOP) directly conditions the action expert on current observations. Across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, RAVEL consistently achieves substantially lower response latency while maintaining the task capability of the underlying VLA, enabling high-frequency and responsive closed-loop control.

AI.tldr: RAVEL是一个异步推理框架，通过滚动缓冲与VLM编码解耦，显著降低flow-based VLA模型的控制延迟。
AI.motivation: flow-based VLA模型虽在通用机器人操作上高效，但依赖计算昂贵的VLM编码和多步迭代动作生成，造成严重的延迟瓶颈，使机器人在动态环境中难以快速响应。
AI.method: RAVEL针对VLM主干和动作专家的计算瓶颈进行异步处理：对多步去噪，允许单步去噪后即在滚动缓冲中传递部分去噪的未来动作；对VLM编码，将其与滚动动作生成解耦，使动作专家可持续利用最新VLM上下文运行，同时通过轻量级快速观测通路（FOP）直接以当前观测条件化动作专家。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实世界操作任务中，RAVEL在保持底层VLA任务能力的同时，持续实现显著更低的响应延迟，支持高频、响应式的闭环控制。
AI.conclusion: RAVEL有效缓解flow-based VLA的延迟瓶颈，在不损失任务性能的前提下实现低延迟、高频闭环控制。

title: De-biasing Skeleton-based Action Recognition with Convex Hull Adaptive Shift
comment: Accepted for publication in International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV). Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Necolizer/CHASE
summary: Skeleton sequences can represent both individual actions and multi-entity interactions, encompassing human bodies, hands, objects, and robots. Existing approaches to recognize skeleton-based actions and interactions usually adopt a late fusion strategy, which expects individuals are independent and identically distributed to train a robust weight-shared entity encoder. However, observed entity bias in various skeletal data violates this assumption, leading to suboptimal optimization of backbone models that might produce wrong recognition results. This bias arises from the world coordinate system's initial configuration, where the choice of origin often creates bias in representation. To this end, we propose a Convex Hull Adaptive Shift based normalization method to reduce Entity bias (CHASE), improving performance across a variety of skeleton-based action and interaction recognition tasks. To adaptively apply plausible shifts to the input skeletons, we formulate a plug-and-play parameterized network that ensures the relocated world origin lies within the skeleton convex hull, which avoids non-convergence by limiting the search space. To further minimize entity bias, we incorporate an auxiliary objective that leverages pair-wise distribution distances to guide network optimization. To support both single- and multi-entity actions, we propose a sub-entity strategy that offers a consistent formulation for both scenarios. Moreover, CHASE demonstrates compatibility with various intra-skeleton modalities, such as bones and velocities, highlighting its adaptability. Essentially, our method works as a normalization approach to reduce entity bias, enabling subsequent classifiers to achieve improved recognition performance across diverse settings. Extensive experiments on 7 datasets verify our approach by seamlessly integrating with various backbones and significantly boosting their performance.

AI.tldr: 提出CHASE归一化方法，通过凸包自适应平移消除骨架动作识别中的实体偏差，在7个数据集上显著提升多种骨干网络性能。
AI.motivation: 现有骨架动作与交互识别多采用晚期融合策略，假设各实体独立同分布以训练权重共享的实体编码器，但实际骨骼数据中存在实体偏差违背该假设，导致骨干模型优化次优、识别结果错误。该偏差源于世界坐标系初始配置中原点选择带来的表示偏差。
AI.method: 提出基于凸包自适应平移的归一化方法CHASE：设计即插即用的参数化网络，自适应地对输入骨架施加合理平移，并约束迁移后的世界原点落在骨架凸包内，以限制搜索空间、避免不收敛；引入利用成对分布距离的辅助目标函数引导网络优化；提出子实体策略，统一单实体与多实体动作的表述；方法兼容骨骼、速度等多种骨架内模态。
AI.result: 在7个数据集上的大量实验表明，CHASE可无缝集成到多种骨干网络中并显著提升其性能，跨多种动作与交互识别任务均有改善，且对骨骼、速度等不同模态具备适应性。
AI.conclusion: CHASE作为一种归一化方法，有效减少实体偏差，使后续分类器在多种设定下取得更优识别性能，具有良好的通用性与可插拔性。

title: FailPatch: Failure Residual Patching for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically adapted using successful demonstrations, which provide direct action supervision but rarely cover failure-prone states. Deployment failures expose these states, yet lack the corrective actions needed for conventional supervised learning. We propose FailPatch, a failure-driven residual patching framework that decouples action supervision from execution-reliability supervision. Successful demonstrations ground how the policy should act, while deployment trajectories indicate when its behavior becomes unreliable. We further observe that action hidden representations exhibit clear linear separability between reliable and failure-associated states while directly conditioning action generation. Building on these insights, FailPatch introduces a Null-gated Residual Expert Bank into the action hidden space of a frozen VLA policy. A unified Preserve--Redirect--Trust objective retains the original policy in reliable states, selects residual experts in failure-associated states and redirects representations from failure regions toward success-associated regions under bounded intervention. With only 0.52% trainable parameters, FailPatch improves success rates by 11.0 percentage points on four long-horizon RoboTwin tasks under clean evaluation, 9.5 percentage points under clean-to-random generalization, and 16.7 percentage points over the baseline across three real-world tasks. Project and code: https://github.com/yupeng-2003/FailPatch.

AI.tldr: FailPatch：一种失败驱动的残差修补框架，将动作监督与执行可靠性监督解耦，在冻结VLA策略的动作隐空间中引入Null门控残差专家库，仅需0.52%可训练参数即显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略通常依赖成功演示进行适配，虽提供直接动作监督，却几乎无法覆盖易失败状态；而部署失败虽暴露这些状态，却缺乏纠正动作，难以用于传统监督学习。
AI.method: 提出FailPatch框架：成功演示提供"应如何动作"的监督，部署轨迹指示"行为何时不可靠"；利用动作隐表示在可靠与失败状态间具有线性可分性的特点，在冻结VLA策略的动作隐空间中加入Null门控残差专家库，并采用Preserve–Redirect–Trust统一目标，在可靠状态保留原策略、在失败相关状态选择残差专家，并在有界干预下将表示从失败区域重定向到成功相关区域。
AI.result: 仅0.52%可训练参数，在四个长时程RoboTwin任务上干净评估成功率提升11.0个百分点，干净到随机泛化提升9.5个百分点；在三个真实世界任务上较基线提升16.7个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FailPatch通过将执行可靠性监督与动作监督解耦，以极低参数代价有效修补冻结VLA策略的失败状态，在仿真与真实任务中均取得一致性提升。

title: QuacamFM: Quaternion-Constrained Flow Matching for Camera Pose Estimation
summary: Camera pose estimation from multi-view images remains a challenge in computer vision. Traditional methods often address this problem using Structure-from-Motion (SfM) with bundle adjustment. However, camera poses estimated from sparse views are inherently ambiguous due to insufficient geometric constraints. Recent work leverages probabilistic models, such as diffusion models, to generate multiple camera pose hypotheses and therefore capture this uncertainty better. Most of these methods represent camera rotations using unit quaternions, but treat them as unconstrained 4D vectors during the generative processes, thereby ignoring the unit-norm constraint of quaternions. Unconstrained quaternions create non-smooth and suboptimal generation trajectories. To this end, we propose *QuacamFM*, a quaternion-constrained flow matching framework for camera pose estimation that preserves unit quaternion representations throughout the entire flow trajectory. We design the optimal transport of the quaternion flows using smooth spherical linear interpolation. Experiments on CO3Dv2 demonstrate our method's advantage in camera pose accuracy over diffusion-based methods and classical SfM approaches. We further show that our quaternion-constrained formulation outperforms the naive application of standard flow matching to 4D quaternion vectors on sparse-view camera pose estimation. Finally, it is observed that QuacamFM generalizes well across datasets and in-the-wild examples.

AI.tldr: 提出QuacamFM，一种四元数约束的流匹配框架，用于相机位姿估计，在整个流轨迹中保持单位四元数表示，并在CO3Dv2上取得优于扩散模型和经典SfM的精度。
AI.motivation: 多视角稀疏视图下相机位姿估计存在固有的几何约束不足导致的不确定性。近期概率模型（如扩散模型）能生成多个位姿假设以捕捉不确定性，但多数方法用单位四元数表示旋转却在生成过程中当作无约束4D向量，忽略了单位范数约束，导致生成轨迹不光滑且次优。
AI.method: 提出QuacamFM，一种四元数约束的流匹配框架，在整个流轨迹上保持单位四元数表示，并利用光滑的球面线性插值（slerp）设计四元数流的最优传输。
AI.result: 在CO3Dv2上的实验表明，该方法在相机位姿精度上优于基于扩散的方法和经典SfM方法；四元数约束形式优于将标准流匹配简单应用于4D四元数向量；且QuacamFM在不同数据集和in-the-wild样本上泛化良好。
AI.conclusion: 通过在整个流轨迹中保持单位四元数约束并使用球面线性插值设计最优传输，能有效提升稀疏视图相机位姿估计的精度与泛化能力。

title: Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Modeling from Human Demonstrations for Dexterous Manipulation
