summary: Dexterous manipulation requires tactile feedback.However, robot tactile demonstrations are difficult to scale,because dexterous-hand teleoperation provides limited tactile feedback to the operator. In contrast, human demonstrations offer a substantially more scalable source of diverse tactile interactions. Motivated by a simple premise: hands can change, but the underlying physics of interaction does not. We leverage human tactile data to improve dexterous manipulation policies. Specifically, we first build a tactile motion-capture system that synchronously records images, tactile signals, and hand motions. Using this system, we construct the UVTA dataset spanning five contact-rich tasks, with 1,000 human demonstrations covering diverse interaction patterns and 150 robot demonstrations per task. To transfer the underlying physics of human interaction to robot control, we propose a Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Model that maps both embodiments into aligned tactile and action representations and jointly predicts future action and tactile trajectories. The joint objective enables human demonstrations to supervise contact-aware representation learning, while only robot actions are executed during deployment. In real-robot evaluations across five tasks, our method achieves an average success rate of 70%, outperforming the strongest visual-tactile baseline, which achieves 29%, and an architecture ablation, which achieves 42%. Performance improves consistently with additional human demonstrations and exhibits no saturation at 1,000 demonstrations per task, validating the effectiveness of scalable human tactile data for dexterous manipulation. Project page is available at https://uni-vta.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 该论文利用人类触觉数据来提升灵巧操作策略，通过构建同步采集图像、触觉信号与手部运动的系统，建立UVTA数据集，并提出统一视觉-触觉-动作模型（Uni-VTA），在真实机器人五类任务中平均成功率达70%，远超基线29%与架构消融42%。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作需要触觉反馈，但机器人触觉演示难以规模化，因为灵巧手遥操作给操作者的触觉反馈有限。相比之下，人类演示是可扩展且多样化的触觉交互来源。作者基于一个朴素前提：手可以不同，但交互背后的物理规律不变，因此希望用人类触觉数据改进灵巧操作策略。
AI.method: 首先构建触觉运动捕捉系统，同步记录图像、触觉信号与手部运动，并据此建立UVTA数据集，涵盖五类接触密集任务、1000个人类演示（覆盖多样交互模式）以及每任务150个机器人演示。随后提出统一视觉-触觉-动作模型（Uni-VTA），将人类与机器两种本体映射到对齐的触觉与动作表征，并联合预测未来动作与触觉轨迹。联合目标使人类演示可监督接触感知表征学习，而部署时仅执行机器人动作。
AI.result: 真实机器人五任务评测中，方法平均成功率为70%，优于最强的视觉-触觉基线（29%）和架构消融（42%）。性能随人类演示数量增加持续提升，在每任务1000个演示时仍未见饱和，验证了可扩展人类触觉数据对灵巧操作的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 人类触觉数据可作为可扩展的监督来源，通过跨本体的对齐表征与联合动作-触觉预测，有效提升灵巧操作的接触感知能力；性能未饱和表明继续扩大人类演示规模仍有潜力。项目主页：https://uni-vta.github.io/。

title: Seeing Parts, Reasoning about Worlds: Visual Inference under Partial Observation
summary: World modeling under partial observation requires reasoning about the complete worlds that remain compatible with limited visual evidence. Occluded objects and unseen regions can leave several world states possible; additional views can exclude alternatives and strengthen the conclusions supported by the observations. We introduce WorldScope to study this process through possible-world semantics, evidence-grounded data, and learned visual representations. WorldScope-1.2M provides 1.2 million English question-answer pairs spanning eight world properties, ten task interfaces, and three observation protocols. Its answers encode confirmed facts, supported bounds, and unresolved possibilities. Complementary supervision comprises 4,800 certified counterworld groups with equivalent base observations and different hidden object configurations and query answers. These groups provide physical witnesses of ambiguity and training-only labels for world compatibility and view-induced exclusions. We propose WorldFlow, which composes cross-view entity evidence and support-surface coverage into an image-subset evidence lattice. Counterworld compatibility and transition objectives train subset representations to reflect how new observations constrain possible worlds. A shared answer generator uses these representations to predict the strongest supported conclusion. WorldScope-Bench evaluates claim judgments and evidence-dependent conclusions as views are selected, combined, removed, or ordered. On its 5,000-question test set, WorldFlow reaches 64.34% exact accuracy, improving over the same backbone trained on QA alone by 24.88 percentage points. It retains 50.43% accuracy on the 3,000 questions from structure-disjoint scenes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出WorldScope研究部分观测下的世界建模，构建120万问答对数据集WorldScope-1.2M及反世界监督，并提出WorldFlow方法，在WorldScope-Bench上达到64.34%准确率。
AI.motivation: 部分观测下的世界建模需要推理与有限视觉证据相容的完整世界。遮挡物体和未见区域会导致多个可能世界状态，额外视角可排除替代方案并强化结论，但现有工作缺乏对这一过程的系统研究。
AI.method: 提出WorldScope：基于可能世界语义、证据驱动数据和学习的视觉表示。数据集WorldScope-1.2M含120万英文问答对，覆盖八种世界属性、十种任务界面和三种观测协议，答案编码已确认事实、支持边界和未决可能性；含4800个经认证的反世界组作为歧义物理见证。模型WorldFlow将跨视角实体证据与支持面覆盖组合为图像子集证据格，通过反世界相容性和转换目标训练子集表示，共享答案生成器预测最强支持结论。
AI.result: WorldScope-Bench评估随视角选择、组合、移除或排序变化的声明判断与证据依赖结论。在5000题测试集上，WorldFlow达到64.34%精确准确率，比仅用QA训练的相同主干提升24.88个百分点；在3000道结构不相交场景问题上保持50.43%准确率。
AI.conclusion: WorldScope为部分观测下可能世界推理提供了数据集、基准和方法框架，WorldFlow通过证据格表示与反世界监督显著优于纯QA训练，并具备一定的结构泛化能力。

title: WB-WAM: Heterogeneous Body-Hand Pre-training for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation demands coordinated body and hand behavior, while conventional robot pre-training data provide limited coverage of such whole-body motion. We present WB-WAM, a World Action Model that incorporates explicit whole-body action supervision into generative video pre-training. A shared physical action space integrates body, root, and dexterous hand annotations from heterogeneous sources, enabling joint video and action learning from 1880.2 hours of partially annotated video and motion data. The resulting priors are refined through PICO mid-training and adapted to robot tasks with auxiliary forward kinematics supervision. We construct WB-Datasets to support these stages with retargeted egocentric human demonstrations and robot trajectories, allowing task-aligned human motion to supplement limited robot data. Evaluations in simulation demonstrate strong whole-body task performance with 81.9% in HumanoidArena, while real-world experiments further validate WB-WAM with 84.0% mean success across five tasks. Moreover, task-aligned PICO mid-training improves downstream task performance while reducing the need for real-robot demonstrations. These results support heterogeneous whole-body pre-training and human motion transfer as a practical route to data-efficient humanoid loco-manipulation.

AI.tldr: WB-WAM 是一种世界动作模型，将显式全身动作监督引入生成式视频预训练，实现数据高效的人形移动操作。
AI.motivation: 人形移动操作需要身体与手部协调动作，但传统机器人预训练数据对这类全身运动覆盖有限。因此作者希望利用异构的全身动作数据来弥补这一空白，实现数据高效的全身操作学习。
AI.method: 提出 WB-WAM（World Action Model），在生成式视频预训练中引入显式全身动作监督。构建共享物理动作空间，整合来自异构数据源的躯体、根节点和灵巧手标注，从 1880.2 小时的局部标注视频与运动数据中进行视频与动作联合学习。先验经过 PICO 中期训练精炼，并借助辅助前向运动学监督适配到机器人任务。同时构建 WB-Datasets，包含重定向的自我中心人类演示与机器人轨迹。
AI.result: 仿真评估中 HumanoidArena 达到 81.9% 的全身任务表现；真实世界实验在五个任务上取得 84.0% 的平均成功率。此外，任务对齐的 PICO 中期训练提升了下游任务性能，同时减少了对真实机器人演示的需求。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将异构全身预训练与人类运动迁移作为实现数据高效人形移动操作的可行途径。

title: REMEDY: How Far Is Video Generation from Medical Education World Models?
summary: Recent video generation models produce realistic videos and show potential as a foundation for world models. These advances create opportunities for generating medical teaching demonstrations, which requires both convincing visual quality and precise procedural actions. However, whether current generators can meet these requirements has not been measured. To address this problem, we introduce Readiness Evaluation of Medical Education Demonstration sYnthesis (REMEDY), to our knowledge, the first benchmark for AI-generated medical teaching demonstrations. REMEDY provides 900 first frames from real demonstration videos, covering 12 tasks across four scenarios: operating room, imaging, clinic and bedside, and resuscitation. Five contemporary open-source video generation models produce 4,500 videos from these frames. We combine task-specific clinical checklists with video and motion quality metrics. Evaluation covers four dimensions: clinical action following, clinical profiles, video quality, and motion quality. Our results show that realistic appearance and temporal consistency do not ensure correct clinical actions. Even the most advanced MiniMax-H3 achieves only 28.25% on strict clinical success rate, and fine-grained clinical actions remain challenging. These findings establish a foundation and roadmap for developing future medical education world models.

AI.tldr: 提出首个AI生成医学教学演示视频基准REMEDY，涵盖12项任务、4类场景、900个首帧与4500个生成视频，从临床动作遵循、临床特征、视频质量与运动质量四个维度评估，最高模型严格临床成功率仅28.25%。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型的进步为生成医学教学演示提供了机会，但这类应用既要求逼真的视觉质量，也要求精确的操作步骤，目前尚缺乏对现有生成器能否满足这些要求的度量手段。
AI.method: 构建REMEDY基准：收录来自真实演示视频的900个首帧，覆盖手术室、影像、门诊与床旁、复苏四类场景共12项任务；用5个当代开源视频生成模型基于这些首帧生成4500个视频；结合任务专属临床检查表与视频、运动质量指标，从四个维度进行评估。
AI.result: 评估显示，逼真的外观与时间一致性并不能保证临床动作正确；即使最先进的MiniMax-H3模型严格临床成功率也仅为28.25%，细粒度临床动作仍然困难。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了现有视频生成模型在医学教学演示生成上的不足，为未来医学教育世界模型的开发提供了基础与路线图。

title: RLE-Bench: A Qualifying Exam for Coding Agents as Robot Learning Engineers
summary: Coding agents are beginning to move beyond purely digital tasks to tackle physical-world challenges, particularly in robotics. Existing robotics benchmarks, however, primarily focus on the performance of individual artifacts, such as policies or controllers, offering limited coverage of coding agents' broader engineering capabilities. Real-world robotics extends beyond control: agents must build, integrate, diagnose, and improve heterogeneous artifacts under resource constraints and reason from multimodal feedback. To evaluate these broader capabilities, we introduce RLE-Bench, a benchmark of robot-learning tasks spanning four representative robotics development workflows: interactive control, policy learning, perception and estimation, and mechanical design. We use diverse task-specific metrics to evaluate the artifacts submitted by the coding agents, from the success rate the agents achieved to the policy agents trained, the harness agent built, and the mechanical structures the agent designed. We aggregate these metrics into an overall RLE Index and report workflow-specific capability profiles, enabling systematic comparison of coding agents' capabilities across multiple capability dimensions. Beyond performance ranks, we also conduct in-depth case studies examining agent behavior on representative tasks, highlighting both current capabilities and limitations, and pointing to the opportunities robotics tasks have to offer for future agent training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RLE-Bench，一个面向机器人学习的编码智能体基准，覆盖交互控制、策略学习、感知估计与机械设计四类开发工作流，用任务特定指标评估智能体产物并汇总为 RLE Index。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人基准主要评估单个产物（如策略或控制器）的性能，未能覆盖编码智能体在真实机器人开发中所需的构建、集成、诊断与改进异构产物、在资源约束下推理多模态反馈等更广泛的工程能力。
AI.method: 构建 RLE-Bench 基准，包含四类代表性机器人开发工作流：交互控制、策略学习、感知与估计、机械设计；针对智能体提交的产物采用多样化任务特定指标进行评估，涉及智能体的任务成功率、训练出的策略智能体、构建的测试框架以及设计的机械结构，并将这些指标汇总为整体 RLE Index，同时输出各工作流的能力画像。
AI.result: 通过多样指标得到跨能力维度的系统性比较结果，并给出性能排名之外的深入案例分析，揭示智能体在代表性任务上的当前能力与局限。
AI.conclusion: RLE-Bench 为跨能力维度系统比较编码智能体提供了工具，案例研究指明了机器人任务对智能体未来训练的潜在价值与改进机会。

title: Can Motion-Language Models Ground Structure? STRIDE for Evaluating the Evaluators
summary: Motion-language models are typically scored by motion-language evaluators, but how well these evaluators ground language structure remains unclear. Here, we introduce the Structure grounding via Temporal-order, Reflection, and Identity Diagnostic Evaluation (STRIDE) benchmark to systematically evaluate the ability of evaluators to track temporal order, mirror reflection, and action identity. STRIDE comprises $5{,}869$ triples, each consisting of a motion, its original caption, and a perturbed caption, spanning both short and long descriptions. We likelihood-balance caption pairs to reduce text-only bias and estimate each evaluator's caption preference under unrelated motions to measure the discrimination gain from matched motions relative to this baseline. Our experiments reveal weak structural grounding and severe deficits in mirror sensitivity among the audited evaluators, which commonly used evaluation protocols fail to expose. To understand why these limitations go undetected in standard tests, we examine the evaluators more closely. We find that text-only priors alone can solve naive perturbation tests on existing datasets, while common retrieval and distributional metrics barely respond to structural corruption introduced by mirroring ground-truth motions. These findings suggest a natural intervention: structural hard negatives. Our experiments show that a simple modification to contrastive learning substantially improves performance on temporal order and mirror reflection. The benchmark and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出STRIDE基准，系统评估动作-语言评估器对时间顺序、镜像反射和动作身份的语义结构对齐能力，发现现有评估器结构对齐薄弱、镜像敏感性严重不足，并提出“结构硬负样本”改进方案。
AI.motivation: 动作-语言模型通常依赖动作-语言评估器打分，但这些评估器在多大程度上真正理解语言结构（如时间顺序、镜像关系、动作身份）尚不明确，且常用评估协议可能掩盖其缺陷。
AI.method: 构建STRIDE基准，包含5,869个三元组（动作、原始描述、扰动描述），覆盖长短描述；对描述对进行似然平衡以降低纯文本偏置，并通过无关联动作下的偏好估计来衡量匹配动作带来的判别增益。进一步分析标准测试为何未暴露问题，并提出结构硬负样本的对比学习干预。
AI.result: 实验显示被审计评估器结构对齐能力弱，镜像敏感性缺陷严重，而常见评估协议无法揭示；纯文本先验即可在现有数据集的朴素扰动测试中取得好成绩，常见检索与分布指标对镜像造成的结构破坏几乎无响应。引入结构硬负样本后，时间顺序与镜像反射性能显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 现有动作-语言评估器缺乏对语言结构的有效对齐，标准评测存在盲区；结构硬负样本是一种有效的改进方向，基准与代码将公开。

title: mmHRI: Towards Privacy-Preserving Human-Robot Interaction with Millimeter-Wave Radar
summary: Assistive robots increasingly operate in many human-centered environments and perform various human-robot interaction (HRI) tasks, such as object delivery. However, most existing HRI systems rely on RGB cameras that continuously observe humans to respond to non-verbal commands, such as hand gestures. This raises privacy concerns in privacy- critical environments, such as hospital wards or restaurants, where direct camera observation of humans is restricted. To develop privacy-preserving HRI, we leverage millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar, which can sense human motion through privacy barriers without identifiable imagery. We propose mmHRI, the first multi-modal robot manipulation framework that achieves mmWave radar-guided privacy-preserving HRI. mmHRI introduces two key designs to mitigate the sparsity and temporal inconsistency of radar data in cluttered robot manipulation environments. First, we propose a dual-stream architecture that jointly learns from unfiltered raw radar tensors and radar point clouds to estimate both human actions and 3D poses. To mitigate signal inconsistency, mmHRI further incorporates a memory-based state-space model (MSSM) that retains historical radar features to reduce abrupt changes in pose/action. These estimated human states are then converted into structured textual robot instructions, which control a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for closed-loop robot manipulation and human-aware reactions. Our evaluation covers human action recognition and closed-loop delivery and retrieval. In the privacy-preserving curtain setting, mmHRI achieves 85.09% action-recognition accuracy, outperforming existing radar-based alternatives. Robot trials further demonstrate successful delivery and retrieval under visual occlusion, with stable task performance across unseen subjects, clutter configurations, and environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 mmHRI，首个利用毫米波雷达实现隐私保护人机交互的多模态机器人操作框架，通过双流架构与记忆状态空间模型缓解雷达稀疏与时序不一致，实现遮挡下的动作识别与闭环递送/取回。
AI.motivation: 现有HRI系统主要依赖RGB相机持续观测人类以响应手势等非语言指令，在医院病房、餐厅等隐私敏感环境中受到限制，因此需要一种无需可识别图像、可穿透隐私屏障感知人体动作的隐私保护HRI方案。
AI.method: 基于毫米波雷达感知人体运动。提出双流架构，从原始未滤波雷达张量和雷达点云联合学习，估计人体动作与3D姿态；引入基于记忆的状态空间模型（MSSM）保留历史雷达特征以减少姿态/动作的突变；将估计的人体状态转换为结构化文本机器人指令，驱动视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略实现闭环操作与人类感知反应。
AI.result: 在隐私保护帘幕场景下，mmHRI动作识别准确率达85.09%，优于现有基于雷达的方案；机器人试验在视觉遮挡下成功完成递送与取回，并在未见被试、杂乱配置与环境中保持稳定性能。
AI.conclusion: mmHRI验证了毫米波雷达引导的隐私保护HRI在多模态机器人操作中的可行性，能在视觉受限条件下实现稳定的人体动作理解与闭环机器人交互。

title: Back-Tracking from Clarity: Self-Learning to See Text from Afar
summary: We propose a self-supervised framework designed to enhance the capability of scene text detectors in identifying and recognizing text in scenarios where instances are shown at significant distances, typically small, blurred, and frequently missed by conventional models. Our approach leverages the high-fidelity performance of existing text spotting models on large, clear text as a foundational supervisor. By temporally back-tracking these high-confidence detections through video sequences, we automatically synthesize pseudo-labels for preceding frames where the distant text is still visually degraded or undersized. These pseudo-labels enable training a student model specialized for early text detection, without requiring any manual annotation. The success of this approach depends on accurate pseudo-label generation, for which we develop a dedicated scene text tracker capable of maintaining consistent text identities across challenging video sequences. In addition, we propose SceneText50, a diverse multilingual outdoor dataset to facilitate training and evaluation. Experiments show that our framework significantly improves early detection accuracy and robustness across varied scenes and languages. Code and data are at \href{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督框架，通过视频时序回溯生成伪标签，提升场景文本检测器对远距离、模糊小文本的早期检测能力，并发布SceneText50多语言数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有场景文本检测模型在远距离、小尺寸、模糊文本场景下性能不足，常漏检；而这类早期文本又缺乏人工标注，难以训练专门模型。
AI.method: 利用现有文本检测模型在清晰大文本上的高置信度检测结果作为监督源，在视频序列中时序回溯，为远距离文本仍模糊或过小的前序帧自动合成伪标签；训练面向早期文本检测的学生模型；并设计了专用场景文本跟踪器以保证伪标签生成中文本身份的一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架在多种场景和语言下显著提升了早期检测的准确率和鲁棒性；同时提出了SceneText50多语言户外数据集用于训练与评估。
AI.conclusion: 自监督时序回溯伪标签方法可在无需人工标注的情况下有效增强场景文本检测器对远距离退化文本的检测能力，代码与数据已开源。

title: Proprioceptive Force Estimation for Quadruped Locomotion and Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Payload forces must be accommodated during locomotion, while leash forces can specify desired motion. We investigate whether a shared three-dimensional force estimate in newtons, inferred from proprioceptive history under sustained loading, can support both tasks. An estimator and locomotion policy are jointly trained with supervised force and velocity outputs and learned latent context. The estimated force conditions locomotion and additionally generates planar-velocity and yaw-rate commands for leash guidance through an analytical map. In sustained-force simulation sweeps, temporal means of componentwise force root mean square error range from 1.44 to 2.83\,N. Compared with a domain-randomized baseline, the framework reduces velocity-tracking and base-orientation error scores by 21.6\% and 46.5\%, respectively, and increases mean survival from 68.29\% to 94.60\% in separate sustained-force tests. Unitree Go1 experiments demonstrate stationary vertical and horizontal force estimation, locomotion with an 8.5\,kg payload whose weight exceeds the 70\,N training force limit, and leash guidance using the same force-estimation interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种共享三维力估计框架，通过监督力/速度输出与学习潜在上下文联合训练估计器和运动策略，实现负载承载与牵引引导两种任务。
AI.motivation: 运动过程中需承受负载力，而牵引力可用于指定期望运动。作者探究是否可以用一个共享的三维力估计（以牛顿为单位，从本体感觉历史在持续负载下推断）同时支持这两种任务。
AI.method: 估计器与运动策略联合训练，包含监督力与速度输出及学习到的潜在上下文。估计力用于调节运动，并通过解析映射生成平面速度与偏航率命令以实现牵引引导。
AI.result: 持续力仿真扫掠中，各分量力均方根误差时间均值范围为1.44至2.83 N。相比域随机化基线，速度跟踪与基座朝向误差分数分别降低21.6%和46.5%，平均存活率从68.29%提升至94.60%。Unitree Go1实验展示了静止垂直与水平力估计、承载8.5 kg（超过70 N训练力上限）负载的运动，以及使用同一力估计接口的牵引引导。
AI.conclusion: 单一共享三维力估计接口可同时支持负载承载运动与牵引引导，并在仿真与真机中验证有效。

title: JEPA Learns What the Mask Leaves Unrecoverable
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures are unusually sensitive to how the input is masked: block masks work, scattered masks do not, and the explanations are empirical. We give a measurement account. A mask is a linear measurement, and in a compactly supported wavelet basis every atom whose support lies inside the hidden region falls in the measurement's null space and leaves no trace in the data. The JEPA loss asks only that the encoded context suffice for the target, so a target that a low-level prior can recover admits a shortcut, one the moving-average target encoder can make self-consistent. What removes the shortcut is the coarse-scale content the mask leaves unrecoverable, provided enough context stays within reach of each target. We score that content before training and test the account's distinctive predictions in 151 pre-training runs. On ImageNet-100, strip masks match blocks in area and contiguity yet are recoverable, and they land at 40.3% linear top-1, beside random masks at 40.8%, against 64.3% for blocks; within one geometry family, the placements that leave the least unrecoverable content lose 6.5 points to those that leave the most, over five seed pairs; pixel targets span 7 points where latent targets span 25; and against a frozen target the gap between random and block masks, 19 points on the same kind of GPU, closes to 1.5, so the geometry acts through the target the encoder produces for itself. On UCF101 the masking ratio decides which condition, content or reach, binds; removing whole frames, unrecoverable in space but recoverable from neighbouring frames, is worst at both ratios; and on V-JEPA's own masks, batching them intact instead of truncated changes little (36.0% against 35.1%), whereas making 100 target tokens inside the blocks visible lifts them to 48.7% and hiding 100 context tokens outside the blocks does not (33.7%).

AI.tldr: 本文用测量理论解释JEPA对掩码几何的敏感性：掩码是线性测量，小波基下支撑落在隐藏区的原子落入零空间，低层先验可恢复的目标产生捷径；不可恢复的粗尺度内容决定表征质量。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）对掩码方式异常敏感——块状掩码有效、散点掩码无效，但此前解释多为经验性、缺乏理论刻画。作者希望给出一个可度量、可预测的原理性解释。
AI.method: 将掩码视为线性测量，在紧支撑小波基下分析其零空间：支撑完全落入隐藏区的原子不留下任何数据痕迹。据此指出JEPA损失只要求编码上下文足以预测目标，故低层先验可恢复的目标存在捷径，且移动平均目标编码器可使其自洽。真正消除捷径的是掩码留下的不可恢复的粗尺度内容（需保证每个目标周围有足够上下文）。作者在训练前对该内容打分，并在151次预训练中检验该理论的独特预测。
AI.result: ImageNet-100上：条带掩码与块掩码在面积和连续性上相当，但可恢复，线性top-1仅40.3%，接近随机掩码40.8%，远低于块掩码64.3%；同一几何族内，不可恢复内容最少的排布比最多的低6.5分（五对种子）；像素目标跨度7分而潜在目标跨度25分；冻结目标下随机与块掩码差距从19分降到1.5分。UCF101上掩码比例决定内容或可达性哪个约束起作用；整帧移除在两个比例下都最差。在V-JEPA自有掩码上，整体批处理与截断差异很小（36.0% vs 35.1%），但让块内100个目标token可见提升到48.7%，而隐藏块外100个上下文token无影响（33.7%）。
AI.conclusion: 掩码几何通过编码器为自己生成的目标起作用；表征质量由掩码留下的不可恢复粗尺度内容决定，并受上下文可达性调节。该测量分析在151次预训练中成功预测了JEPA的多种经验现象。

title: GAE: General Action Expert for Real-Time Humanoid Teleoperation
summary: Humanoid avatars extend human physical presence beyond the body, enabling people to participate in social, service, and labor activities through remotely operated robots. This requires teleoperation systems capable of realizing diverse and dynamic whole-body behaviors while maintaining responsive human-robot synchronization. We present General Action Expert(GAE), a unified learning framework for general-purpose, low-latency humanoid whole-body teleoperation. To cover diverse human behaviors, GAE builds a large-scale human motion dataset from heterogeneous sources, including videos, animations, and motion capture, followed by standardization and augmentation. GAE then addresses the noise and embodiment mismatch in human motions with a two-stage training paradigm: a privileged generator policy first tracks human motion references in simulation and rolls out feasible humanoid trajectories; a deployable executor policy then learns to track these generated trajectories under curriculum domain randomization. For responsive human-robot synchronization, GAE introduces a latency-conditioned anticipation mechanism that adaptively compensates for end-to-end delay during real-time teleoperation. Simulation and real-world experiments on Unitree G1 and Westlake O1 robots demonstrate that GAE enables humanoids to smoothly mirror diverse, agile, and expressive human behaviors. Project website: https://wangyf0928.github.io/gae-wlrobotics/

AI.tldr: 提出GAE统一学习框架，实现通用、低延迟的人形机器人全身遥操作，使机器人能平滑模仿多样敏捷的人类行为。
AI.motivation: 人形化身需通过远程操控机器人扩展人类物理存在，要求遥操作具备多样动态全身行为与响应式人机同步能力。
AI.method: 构建异构来源（视频、动画、动捕）大规模人体运动数据集并标准化增强；采用两阶段训练：特权生成器策略在仿真中跟踪人体运动并生成可行轨迹，可部署执行器策略在课程域随机化下跟踪生成轨迹；引入延迟条件预判机制自适应补偿端到端延迟。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1与Westlake O1机器人上的仿真与真实实验表明，GAE使人形机器人能平滑模仿多样、敏捷且富有表现力的人类行为。
AI.conclusion: GAE作为统一框架，有效解决了噪声与本体差异问题并补偿延迟，实现了通用低延迟的人形全身遥操作。

title: GeoCR: Learning a Generalist Cloud Removal Prior from Heterogeneous Observations
summary: Cloud removal methods are typically specialized to individual datasets and input configurations, limiting reuse across sensors, spectral bands, and observation settings. We introduce GeoCR, a generalist model that unifies RGB-only-based CR and multispectral-based CR from single- or multi-temporal cloudy observations, with optional SAR guidance, within a single network. To accommodate different spectral and sensing domains, compact input and output stems extend a pretrained RGB autoencoder while keeping its encoder and decoder trunks frozen. This shared latent interface enables a single flow transformer to jointly model clean RGB and non-RGB latents, conditioned on separate cloudy-observation streams and optional SAR tokens. Through joint pretraining on the training splits of ten datasets comprising 883,331 cloud-free target images, GeoCR learns a shared cloud removal prior across these heterogeneous configurations. The same pretrained checkpoint supports direct inference without dataset-specific fine-tuning and efficient adaptation through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We evaluate GeoCR against general image restoration and cloud removal methods on test splits of the contributing datasets under full-band and RGB-only settings. GeoCR achieves the best FID and DISTS on full-band SEN12MS-CR and Sen2_MTC_New and RGB-only CUHK-CR2, outperforming existing models and demonstrating the effectiveness of a reusable generative model across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 提出通用云去除模型GeoCR，统一RGB与多光谱、单/多时相、可选SAR引导等多种配置，在十个数据集上联合预训练，无需微调即可直接推理并支持LoRA适配。
AI.motivation: 现有云去除方法通常针对特定数据集与输入配置专门设计，难以跨传感器、光谱波段和观测设置复用，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 在预训练RGB自编码器上添加紧凑的输入输出stem，冻结编码器与解码器主干；共享潜在接口使单一flow transformer联合建模干净RGB与非RGB潜变量，条件为各自的云观测流和可选SAR token；在十个数据集（883,331张无云目标图像）的训练集上联合预训练，学得共享的去云先验，支持直接推理与LoRA高效适配。
AI.result: 在全波段SEN12MS-CR和Sen2_MTC_New以及仅RGB的CUHK-CR2上取得最佳FID和DISTS，优于现有通用图像复原与云去除方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明该可复用生成模型在多样化设置下有效，验证了统一云去除模型的可行性与通用性。

title: WAM-OPD: Sharpening World Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
summary: Pretrained world action models (WAMs) provide generalist capabilities across diverse robotic manipulation tasks, yet improving target-task performance to an expert level without degrading pretrained skills remains challenging. We explore on-policy distillation (OPD) for WAMs and introduce WAM-OPD. WAM-OPD inherits the advantage of OPD methods that transfer task-specific teacher knowledge under the student's own induced distribution, rather than directly fitting the student to a narrow task-specific data distribution. However, in closed-loop manipulation, the observation histories change as the student policy evolves, requiring fresh environment rollouts to remain on-policy. Applying OPD to WAMs entails repeated data collection, which is costly even in simulation and often impractical on real robots. To avoid repeated environment rollouts during distillation, we introduce prefix-weighted trajectory replay (PWTR). PWTR uses a fixed trajectory pool composed primarily of initial-student rollouts, supplemented with task-specific teacher rollouts to broaden trajectory coverage. For each trajectory replayed from this pool, PWTR conditions the current policy on successive stored histories to generate fresh denoising paths, along which the task-specific teacher provides supervision. Although these denoising paths are refreshed as the policy evolves, the replayed environment trajectories remain fixed. PWTR therefore reweights per-decision distillation losses using proxy importance weights derived from path scores accumulated over the trajectory prefix preceding each decision to mitigate the resulting shift in the history distribution. Simulated and real-world experiments demonstrate task adaptation without additional environment interaction during distillation. In both settings, WAM-OPD improves target-task performance while retaining near-initial performance on tasks excluded from adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WAM-OPD，将 on-policy distillation 用于预训练 world action models，并用 prefix-weighted trajectory replay 避免蒸馏时反复环境交互，实现目标任务适配且不损失预训练能力。
AI.motivation: 预训练 world action models 具备通用机器人操作能力，但在提升目标任务至专家水平时，容易损害预训练技能。已有 on-policy distillation 需要在学生自身分布下迁移教师知识，而闭环操作中观测历史随策略演化而改变，需要不断环境 rollout，代价高甚至不可行。
AI.method: 提出 WAM-OPD，将 on-policy distillation 引入 world action models。为免去蒸馏中反复环境交互，提出 prefix-weighted trajectory replay（PWTR）：使用固定轨迹池，主要由初始学生 rollout 组成并辅以任务特定教师 rollout。对每条回放轨迹，令当前策略以存储的连续历史为条件，生成新的去噪路径，由任务特定教师提供监督。轨迹固定、去噪路径随策略更新，故用基于决策前缀路径分数累积的代理重要性权重，对每个决策的蒸馏损失重新加权，以缓解历史分布偏移。
AI.result: 仿真与真实实验表明，蒸馏过程中无需额外环境交互即可完成任务适配；WAM-OPD 提升目标任务性能，同时在未纳入适配的任务上保持接近初始模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: WAM-OPD 为 world action models 提供了一种无需额外环境交互的 on-policy 蒸馏式任务适配方案，在提升目标任务表现的同时较好保留预训练通用能力。

title: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Writer Adaptation for Real-World Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition
comment: Accepted at the 32nd IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP 2026)
summary: Handwritten mathematical expression recognition (HMER) refers to the task of recognizing and converting handwritten mathematics into a parsable markup language, usually LaTeX. No current state-of-the-art-competitive system adjusts to the way a specific person writes, and the domain gap between training images (usually digital or perfectly binarized) and images physically taken with a camera used in inference has received fairly little attention for this specific problem. We characterize this domain gap through fragmentation and stroke-width analyses of the images as well as introduce a writer-adaptive fine-tuning pipeline to MFH-CoMER in an attempt to address it. We further introduce sample author-specific datasets, consisting of five handwriting category subsets from two authors, and evaluate using a McNemar's test and permutation tests adapted to limited data. Results suggest an increase in expression recognition rate and a decrease in CER for digital handwriting but more varied results for physical handwriting, with the model struggling for handwriting articles that the base model can already evaluate well. Nonetheless, adapted models were found to have improved results for four out of five subsets. Statistical testing results suggest a consistency in improvement for two of the tested author-specific subsets. Our results point towards the potential feasibility of writer adaptation for the HMER task.

AI.tldr: 本文针对手写数学表达式识别（HMER）中的书写者适应问题，分析了训练图像与相机拍摄图像间的域差距，并提出对MFH-CoMER进行书写者自适应微调的流程，构建了两位作者的五个手写子集数据集，采用McNemar检验和置换检验进行评估，结果显示对数字手写有改善潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有HMER最优系统无法适应特定个人的书写方式，且训练图像（数字或完美二值化）与推理时用相机拍摄图像之间存在域差距，该问题此前关注不足。作者希望通过书写者自适应来缓解这一差距。
AI.method: 通过碎片化和笔画宽度分析刻画域差距；提出针对MFH-CoMER的书写者自适应微调流程；构建包含两位作者、五个手写类别子集的样本数据集；并使用适配小样本的McNemar检验和置换检验进行评估。
AI.result: 数字手写的表达式识别率提高、CER下降；物理手写结果不一，模型对基模型已能良好评估的手写文章表现吃力；但自适应模型在五个子集中的四个上取得改进；统计检验显示两个作者特定子集具有一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明书写者适应在HMER任务上具有潜在可行性，尽管对物理手写的效果尚不稳定。

title: UMR: Universal Manipulation Representation
comment: Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: General-purpose embodied manipulation hinges on a unified action representation that generalizes across embodiments and scales readily. Yet existing policies rely on embodiment-specific action spaces, making cross-embodiment demonstrations difficult to leverage at scale and limiting transfer to new embodiments and spatial variations. To this end, we introduce Universal Manipulation Representation (UMR), a unified action representation that enables zero-shot skill transfer from human demonstrations to heterogeneous robots. UMR decomposes manipulation into two functionally distinct yet geometrically linked components: embodiment-agnostic World Flow, which describes task-relevant object motion in the world frame, and Ego Trajectory, which represents end-effector motion relative to the current pose. We instantiate UMR as World--Ego Point VLA (WEPVLA), a compact 0.5B-parameter policy that learns in the unified geometric action space through a dual-stream Point Action Adapter and a unified Point Action Expert, with an $SE(3)$ conjugation coupling the two components. To improve data efficiency, we complement UMR with a Data-Efficient Strategy (DES) that diversifies object configurations through stage-aware point-cloud editing while preserving demonstrated contact geometry. In simulation, WEPVLA achieves average success rates of 97.5\% on LIBERO and 85.7\% on the 10-task RLBench benchmark. In real-world experiments, a single policy trained on human demonstrations augmented by DES transfers zero-shot to diverse deployment conditions. With about 10 minutes of collected human demonstrations per task and no robot demonstrations, it achieves 91.7\% average success across six evaluation settings, compared with 60.8\% for HumanEgo. Code and additional materials are available at https://umr-wepvla.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通用操作表示UMR及策略WEPVLA，实现人类演示到异构机器人的零样本技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有策略依赖特定本体的动作空间，导致跨本体演示难以规模化利用，并限制向新本体与空间变化的迁移。
AI.method: UMR将操作分解为本体无关的World Flow（世界坐标系下物体运动）与Ego Trajectory（相对当前位姿的末端运动），二者由SE(3)共轭耦合；实例化为0.5B参数的WEPVLA策略，含双流Point Action Adapter与统一Point Action Expert；并配套数据高效策略DES，通过阶段感知点云编辑丰富物体构型。
AI.result: 仿真中LIBERO平均成功率97.5%，RLBench 10任务85.7%；真实实验中每任务约10分钟人类演示、无机器人演示，单策略零样本迁移到六种评估设置，平均成功率91.7%，优于HumanEgo的60.8%。
AI.conclusion: 统一几何动作表示可有效利用人类演示并实现跨本体零样本迁移，验证了UMR与WEPVLA的通用性与数据高效性。

title: UnStep: Training-Free Acceleration of Causal Video Diffusion with Fewer Steps Than Distillation
summary: Distilling bidirectional multi-step video diffusion transformers into few-step causal models has become a common approach for streaming video generation. While these few-step students are significantly faster than the teachers they are distilled from, they remain slow for real-time generation. In this work we present UnStep, a training-free wrapper that accelerates few-step causal video models at inference by running them with fewer diffusion transformer (DiT) steps than during distillation and limiting the temporal window retained in the attention KV cache. We propose two inference-only mechanisms to recover quality lost by step reduction and attention windowing: renoising the generated latent frames to a near-clean level and reusing the existing clean-cache pass to refine them, and applying truncated SVD to the DiT attention value and output projections. We also accelerate inference with a quality-preserving runtime stack for the DiT and VAE decoder, including more efficient attention calls and KV indexing, fused Triton RoPE with cached coefficients, and VAE decoding with optimized memory layout, precision, and convolution kernels. By reducing computation and optimizing the runtime stack, UnStep sets a new throughput regime for causal video diffusion, by running substantially faster than current methods, reaching 50 FPS on a single H100 without quality loss, and 77 FPS on GB200, all without retraining.

AI.tldr: UnStep：一种无需训练、用于加速少步因果视频扩散模型的推理包装器，通过减少DiT步数、限制注意力KV缓存时间窗口，并配合两种仅推理机制与优化运行时，在单张H100上达50 FPS且无质量损失。
AI.motivation: 少步因果视频扩散学生模型虽比教师快，但对实时生成仍偏慢，论文旨在不重新训练的前提下进一步显著提升推理速度。
AI.method: 以比蒸馏时更少的DiT步数运行模型，并限制注意力KV缓存的时间窗口；提出两种仅推理机制：对生成潜帧加噪至接近干净水平并复用干净缓存通路进行精修，以及对DiT注意力的value与输出投影做截断SVD；同时采用质量保持的运行时栈优化（更高效注意力调用与KV索引、融合Triton RoPE并缓存系数、优化内存布局/精度/卷积核的VAE解码）。
AI.result: 在单张H100上达到50 FPS、在GB200上达到77 FPS，且无质量损失，全部无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: UnStep通过减少计算并优化运行时栈，为因果视频扩散树立了新的吞吐量水平，实现实时高质量流式视频生成。

title: RoboICL: Embodied In-Context Learning with GPT-6 Astra
summary: General-purpose vision-language models offer a promising way to zero-shot robot control: \gptastra{} excels at open-ended and language- or image-conditioned manipulation but remains substantially weaker on high-precision and long-horizon tasks. We introduce \emph{RoboICL}, an in-context robot-control framework that narrows these gaps without robot-specific parameter updates or a learned VLA. RoboICL separates \emph{demonstration context}, which provides recorded examples when available, from \emph{interaction memory}, which accumulates the model's own actions and observed outcomes. Both use a shared observation--action--receipt--observation grammar. To preserve experience across task stages, RoboICL combines sampled demonstration blocks with bounded anchored memory. Fixed anchors keep earlier rollout interactions available for in-context learning, while the latest interaction supports immediate error correction. Across 30 RoboDojo tasks, using zero shot for Open and one demonstration elsewhere, RoboICL improves on official zero-shot \gptastra{} by 20--27 progress-score points in every category. It leads the leaderboard baselines on Memory and Open, achieves comparable performance to the strongest Precision baseline, and remains competitive on Long-Horizon. Its 30-task Overall score is 50.64, versus 33.68 for the strongest baseline. On a separate ten-task subset, RoboICL scores 60.60, within 2.00 points of the $π_{0.5}$ + \gptastra{} hybrid approach. On three real-robot tasks, mean progress rises from 14.45 at zero shot to 63.33 at one shot and 78.89 at three shots. On two development tasks, optional Jev-gated action reuse reduces \gptastra{} calls by 33--48\%. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}.

AI.tldr: RoboICL 是一个上下文机器人控制框架，通过分离演示上下文与交互记忆，在无需机器人专用参数更新或学习型 VLA 的情况下，显著提升通用视觉语言模型在精密与长时程任务上的零样本控制能力。
AI.motivation: 通用视觉语言模型（如 GPT-Astra）在开放式、语言或图像条件操控上表现优异，但在高精度和长时程任务上仍明显偏弱，需要一种无需额外训练即可弥补这些差距的方法。
AI.method: RoboICL 将提供记录示例的“演示上下文”与累积模型自身动作及观测结果的“交互记忆”分离，二者共享“观测—动作—回执—观测”语法。为跨任务阶段保留经验，它结合采样的演示块与有界锚定记忆：固定锚点保持早期 rollout 交互可用于上下文学习，最新交互则支持即时纠错。此外可选 Jev 门控动作复用以减少模型调用。
AI.result: 在 30 个 RoboDojo 任务上（Open 用零样本，其余用一个演示），RoboICL 相较官方零样本 GPT-Astra 在每个类别提升 20–27 分进度分；在 Memory 与 Open 上领先排行榜基线，与最强 Precision 基线相当，长时程保持竞争力。30 任务总分 50.64，最强基线为 33.68。十任务子集得 60.60，距 π0.5+GPT-Astra 混合方法仅 2.00 分。三个真实机器人任务上，平均进度从零样本 14.45 升至一次示教 63.33、三次示教 78.89。两个开发任务上，可选 Jev 门控动作复用使 GPT-Astra 调用减少 33–48%。
AI.conclusion: RoboICL 无需机器人专用参数更新或学习型 VLA，即可在仿真与真实机器人任务上大幅提升通用视觉语言模型的零样本控制表现，并在多个类别上达到或接近更强基线水平，同时可通过动作复用降低模型调用成本。

title: SetOPD: From Few Visual Exemplars to Multimodal Candidate Sets for Remote-Sensing Open-Prompt Detection
summary: Open-prompt detectors allow users to specify targets with text, visual exemplars, or both. We argue that existing designs underuse the visual modality in two ways. First, multiple exemplars are commonly compressed into a single class-level embedding. This textualizes visual prompting: the resulting vector plays the role of another class name, is often aligned to or injected into the text pathway, and may be suboptimal when only a few heterogeneous exemplars are available. Second, existing methods interact primarily in prompt or representation space, before modality-specific detection states are formed. We address both issues from a set perspective: \setopd preserves modality-specific decoding states from a shared prompt-conditioned initialization and performs explicit multimodal collaboration at the candidate-state level. For the first issue, we introduce \br prompting, which reads every boxed exemplar in its full scene context and decomposes the pooled support evidence into a Base anchor and a learned Residual correction; the resulting prompt has fixed capacity regardless of the number of examples and drives its own visual detection pathway. For the second, we recast text--visual collaboration from representation-level fusion into a candidate-set modeling problem. Paired-Query Arbitration (\pqa) then performs explicit cross-modal state arbitration only after modality-specific candidate states have been formed. The two readers share query initialization so their candidates are paired by index; a learned gate arbitrates within each pair, followed by a permutation-equivariant module that reasons over the fused set.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 setopd 框架，从集合视角解决开放提示检测器对视觉模态利用不足的问题，包括 BR prompting 与 PQA 仲裁机制。
AI.motivation: 现有开放提示检测器在两方面低估了视觉模态：一是多个视觉示例被压缩成单一的类级嵌入，使视觉提示"文本化"，在示例少且异质时表现不佳；二是多模态交互主要发生在提示或表示空间，而非模态特有检测状态形成之后。
AI.method: 提出 setopd：保留由共享提示条件初始化得到的两条模态特有解码路径，在候选状态层面进行显式多模态协作。具体包括 BR prompting（在完整场景上下文中读取每个框选示例，将汇聚的支持证据分解为 Base 锚点与学习的 Residual 修正，提示容量固定且独立于示例数量，并驱动自身的视觉检测通路）与 Paired-Query Arbitration（将文本—视觉协作重构为候选集建模问题，两个读取器共享查询初始化使候选按索引配对，学习门控在每对内仲裁，再由置换等变模块对融合集合进行推理）。
AI.result: 该方法通过 BR prompting 实现固定容量的视觉提示路径，并通过 PQA 在模态特有候选状态形成后进行显式跨模态状态仲裁与集合推理，从而更充分利用视觉模态信息。
AI.conclusion: setopd 从集合视角重构开放提示检测，将视觉示例证据分解为锚点与残差修正，并把多模态协作从表示级融合转为候选集级建模，为开放提示检测提供新范式。

title: SAGE: Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing for LLM Task Planners
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 1 table, 3 algorithms. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). Code and benchmark: https://github.com/mtbui2010/sage_release
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are now the default cognitive core of embodied household agents, yet the plans they emit are rarely checked against a grounded model of the environment before execution, and the task-success they report is often measured on benchmarks so saturated that no method can be separated from another. We present SAGE (Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing), a single-LLM planner built from two lightweight mechanisms: a domain-agnostic symbolic gate (~250 lines of Python, zero tokens, $O(|π|)$) that blocks precondition-violating actions with typed reasons as a runtime safety monitor, and a local edit that regenerates only the failed sub-goal's suffix, keeping completed and untouched work intact; a hybrid seed+live memory store supports cold-start coverage. We evaluate under a leak-free protocol (leave-one-out retrieval) over five open-weight models and a 75-task AI2-THOR benchmark. On the standard benchmark goal-completeness saturates (52% of instances trivially solved) and SAGE ties strong hierarchical baselines. On a harder, method-agnostic multi-goal composition, SAGE's completeness lead re-emerges large (+0.06 to +0.23 across four models). Under injected mid-execution failures, SAGE recovers as reliably as whole-plan replanners at 2.4-3.3x fewer LLM calls. As a verify-before-execute gate, the symbolic monitor blocks unsafe actions before actuation and raises simulator-reported step-success for every planner tested (up to +0.11), a signal the verifier never sees (non-circular). Because the gate calls no model (0.008 ms/plan), it is a safety layer that runs essentially free on the edge: SAGE planning reproduces its quality on a Jetson AGX Orin, where small-model verification helps most. We release the benchmark, the leak-free protocol, the recovery and safety-gate harnesses, and a verifier-portability study (auto-induced on ALFWorld, 0.89 held-out).

AI.tldr: SAGE是一种单LLM具身规划器，通过零token的符号门控与局部编辑机制，在饱和基准上与强基线持平，但在更难的多目标任务与故障恢复中显著领先，且作为近零开销的运行时安全层。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM具身智能体的规划在执行前缺乏基于环境模型的校验，且任务成功率指标已饱和，无法区分方法优劣。
AI.method: 提出SAGE，含两个轻量机制：(1)领域无关符号门控(约250行Python、零token、O(|π|))，以带类型理由阻止违反前置条件的动作；(2)局部编辑，仅重生成失败子目标的后续片段；辅以种子+实时混合记忆库支持冷启动。
AI.result: 在无泄漏协议下评测5个开放权重模型与75任务AI2-THOR基准：标准基准上目标完整性饱和(52%实例被平凡解决)，SAGE与强分层基线持平；在更难的跨方法多目标组合中完整性领先+0.06至+0.23；注入执行中故障时，以2.4-3.3倍更少的LLM调用达到与整体重规划相当的恢复率；符号监控可提升每个规划器的模拟器步成功率(最高+0.11)。
AI.conclusion: 符号门控作为执行前验证层可近零成本运行于边缘设备(Jetson AGX Orin上质量可复现)，并开源基准、无泄漏协议、恢复与安全门控工具及验证器可移植性研究(ALFWorld自诱导，留出集0.89)。

title: DepthBench: Measuring How Residual Connections Enable More Computational Depth
summary: Depth is a natural way to increase the computational capacity in Transformers, yet the contribution of deeper layers can diminish as depth grows larger. Recent approaches enhance normalization (\text{e.g.}, LayerNorm Scaling) or residual connections (\text{e.g.}, mHC, AttnRes) to enable better information flow and depth utilization. However, it remains unclear whether they truly translate increased architectural depth into effective computational depth, and whether their reported gains stem from better access to information across depth, or unaccounted-for confounding factors. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{DepthBench}, a controlled benchmark for studying computational depth across various architectures. We systematically vary the width--depth aspect ratio ($d_{\text{model}}/n_{\text{layer}}$) from shallow--wide to deep--narrow shapes, while keeping the model size and pre-training recipe fixed. Across 10 representative architectures, we find that the benefit of allocating more capacity to depth is strongly architecture-dependent. Standard Pre-LN and most of its norm- and scaling-based variants provide little benefit and can even degrade performance as models become deeper and narrower, whereas HC and Full AttnRes improve consistently even at extreme deep shapes. These gains extend beyond pre-training loss and consistently translate into improved domain-specific performance and effective computation. Controlled layer-level analyses further show that the gains of HC and Full AttnRes are associated with more effective utilization of additional layers, revealing distinct mechanisms of computational depth across architectures. Overall, our results identify residual connection design as a key determinant of whether depth can serve as a meaningful scaling axis by enabling additional architectural depth to translate into effective computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DepthBench 基准，系统研究不同架构下"计算深度"的有效性，发现残差连接设计是决定深度能否成为有效扩展轴的关键因素。
AI.motivation: Transformer 中深度是提升计算能力的自然途径，但随深度增加，深层贡献会递减。近期方法通过改进归一化（如 LayerNorm Scaling）或残差连接（如 mHC、AttnRes）来改善信息流动与深度利用，但尚不清楚这些方法是否真正将架构深度转化为有效的计算深度，其收益是源于更好的跨深度信息获取，还是未被解释的混杂因素。
AI.method: 作者提出 DepthBench——一个受控基准，用于跨多种架构研究计算深度。在保持模型规模和预训练配方固定的前提下，系统地将宽度-深度纵横比（d_model/n_layer）从浅宽型变化到深窄型，并测试 10 种代表性架构。此外进行受控的层级分析。
AI.result: 将更多容量分配给深度的收益强烈依赖架构。标准 Pre-LN 及多数基于归一化和缩放的变体几乎无收益，甚至在模型变深变窄时性能下降；而 HC 和 Full AttnRes 即使在极端深窄形状下也持续改善。这些收益不仅在预训练损失上体现，也一致转化为领域特定性能和有效计算的提升。层级分析显示 HC 和 Full AttnRes 的收益与更有效地利用额外层相关，揭示了不同架构间计算深度的不同机制。
AI.conclusion: 残差连接设计决定了深度能否作为有意义的扩展轴——它使额外的架构深度转化为有效计算。这为未来深度扩展策略提供了关键设计指导。

title: Bayesian Active Learning for Intent Disambiguation in Interactive Robot Planning
comment: Accepted by CoRL 2026, also presented at IROS 2026 Human-Robot Dialogue workshop
summary: Interactive robot planning requires robots to infer and execute human intentions from natural language instructions that are often ambiguous, incomplete, or underspecified. Although large language models (LLMs) provide a powerful interface for clarification, relying on the generative model to drive an multi-turn conversation can introduce systematic failures. We propose a Bayesian framework that treats clarification as an active learning problem over grounded Signal Temporal Logic (STL) task specifications. Our method uses LLMs to initialize candidate formal specifications and translate informative contrasts into natural-language clarification questions, while Bayesian optimization maintains uncertainty estimation over user intent and selects queries that maximize information gain. After convergence, the inferred STL specification is passed to a formal planner to synthesize a verifiable robot trajectory. Across four simulated and real-world task domains, our approach generally achieves higher task satisfaction and requires fewer clarification rounds than LLM baselines, while helping smaller models close the performance gap against larger reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 提出贝叶斯主动学习框架，用LLM初始化STL任务规范并生成澄清问题，结合贝叶斯优化选择信息量最大的查询，从而在少量对话轮次内推断用户意图并生成可验证的机器人轨迹。
AI.motivation: 自然语言指令常存在歧义、不完整或欠规范，机器人需推断并执行人类意图。直接用生成式LLM驱动多轮澄清对话会引入系统性失败，因此需要更稳健的澄清机制。
AI.method: 将澄清建模为面向具身STL任务规范的主动学习问题：用LLM初始化候选形式化规范，并将有信息量的对比转化为自然语言澄清问题；用贝叶斯优化维护对用户意图的不确定性估计，并选择最大化信息增益的查询；收敛后将推断的STL规范交给形式化规划器合成可验证轨迹。
AI.result: 在四个仿真与真实世界任务域中，相比LLM基线通常获得更高的任务满足度，且所需澄清轮次更少；同时帮助小模型缩小与大型推理模型之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM的生成能力与贝叶斯主动学习、形式化规划相结合，可在减少对话轮次的同时提升任务满足度，并增强小模型的规划表现，为可验证的交互式机器人规划提供了有效路径。

title: RIPE-MambaSpike: Resolution-Independent Spiking-State-Space Interfaces for Parameter-Efficient Event-Based Vision
summary: Spiking-Mamba hybrids reach strong accuracy on event-based vision, but existing designs often require tens of millions of parameters. Much of that cost comes from how the spiking front-end is connected to the state-space backbone rather than from the hybrid architecture itself. In a representative model, a single resolution-dependent projection accounts for 33.55M of 36.25M parameters. To that end, we introduce RIPE-MambaSpike (Resolution-Independent, Parameter-Efficient), which replaces that projection with a hierarchical multi-resolution bridge of fixed channel width. Its deployed footprint is 0.870M parameters, constant at fixed time steps and widths across a 43x range of input areas. Reparameterized spiking stages, temporal decoupled modulation, and a dynamic convex-hull-bounded dual-stream membrane-potential attention preserve accuracy under this compact design. Result-wise, RIPE-MambaSpike is pareto-optimal on CIFAR10-DVS, N-Caltech101, and DailyDVS-200. Notably, on the 200-class DailyDVS-200, a scaled 8.04M configuration achieves 45.7% top-1 accuracy, the best reported spiking result on that benchmark, and outperforms prior spiking methods with 3.0-15.1x fewer parameters than dense ANNs. Overall, our findings demonstrate that competitive event-based recognition does not require resolution-dependent parameter growth. Code is available at https://github.com/MuhiminOsim/RIPE-MambaSpike.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RIPE-MambaSpike，用固定通道宽度的分层多分辨率桥接替换分辨率依赖投影，使脉冲-Mamba混合模型参数量从36.25M降至0.870M，且在多个事件视觉基准上达到帕累托最优。
AI.motivation: 现有脉冲-Mamba混合模型在事件视觉上精度高，但参数量常达数千万。经分析，成本主要来自脉冲前端与状态空间骨干之间的分辨率依赖投影连接，而非混合架构本身（某代表模型中单个投影占36.25M中的33.55M）。因此需要消除分辨率依赖的参数增长。
AI.method: 提出RIPE-MambaSpike（分辨率无关、参数高效），用固定通道宽度的分层多分辨率桥接替代原投影；配合重参数化脉冲阶段、时间解耦调制，以及动态凸包约束的双流膜电位注意力，在紧凑设计下保持精度。部署占用0.870M参数，在43倍输入面积范围内，固定时间步与宽度下参数恒定。
AI.result: 在CIFAR10-DVS、N-Caltech101和DailyDVS-200上均为帕累托最优。在200类DailyDVS-200上，8.04M规模的配置取得45.7% top-1精度，为该基准最佳脉冲结果，且比稠密ANN少3.0-15.1倍参数。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性的事件识别并不需要分辨率依赖的参数增长。代码开源于https://github.com/MuhiminOsim/RIPE-MambaSpike。

title: NavHarness: Towards Lifelong Embodied Navigation
summary: Frontier models can now perform well on individual embodied navigation tasks through multi-round multimodal reasoning with simple tools. Across successive tasks, however, an agent must also rely on an evolving map and earlier search records, both of which may be incomplete or conflict with new observations. We present NavHarness, a training-free embodied harness towards lifelong navigation that makes memory processing part of the navigation loop. During navigation, its multi-round agentic session draws on maps, task records, and house knowledge, checking them against observations and recording corrections to guide its actions. NavHarness preserves this experience across fresh conversations for new tasks or recovery attempts, while outcome verification and run-end summaries support its later reuse. On GOAT-Bench, NavHarness improves s-SR over context-only independent sessions by 18.6 points with Astra and 22.6 with Opus 5. Using SLAM-estimated poses, NavHarness with GPT-6 Astra achieves state-of-the-art task success of 83.7 s-SR with 36.9 e-SR on GOAT-Bench and 85.9 s-SR on IR2R-CE. To understand these gains, we examine how experience is carried between sessions and find that structured recovery handovers outperform length-matched summaries. In extended deployments across houses, consolidation improves navigation beyond retaining maps and task records, with case studies showing how agents use earlier experience to interpret new goals, investigate unresolved questions, and resume failed searches. We suggest that progress towards lifelong navigation depends on how successive reasoning sessions build on prior experience, alongside improvements in single-task capability.

AI.tldr: NavHarness 是一个无需训练的具身导航框架，将记忆处理嵌入导航循环，通过跨会话保留地图、任务记录与房屋知识来提升终身导航性能。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型在单个体化导航任务上表现良好，但在连续任务中，智能体需依赖不断演化的地图与历史搜索记录，而这些信息可能不完整或与新观测冲突。论文认为通往终身导航的进展不仅取决于单任务能力，还取决于连续推理会话如何建立在先前经验之上。
AI.method: 提出 NavHarness，一种免训练的具身导航框架，把记忆处理作为导航循环的一部分。其多轮智能体会话综合地图、任务记录与房屋知识，与观测进行核对并记录修正以指导行动；经验可在新任务或恢复尝试的新对话中保留，并通过结果验证与运行结束总结支持后续复用。
AI.result: 在 GOAT-Bench 上，相比仅依赖上下文的独立会话，NavHarness 使 s-SR 提升 18.6 点（Astra）和 22.6 点（Opus 5）。使用 SLAM 估计位姿时，NavHarness 配合 GPT-6 Astra 在 GOAT-Bench 达到 83.7 s-SR、36.9 e-SR 的当前最优任务成功率，在 IR2R-CE 上达到 85.9 s-SR。
AI.conclusion: 经验跨会话的传递方式很关键，结构化恢复交接优于等长摘要；在跨房屋的长期部署中，经验整合优于仅保留地图与任务记录。案例显示智能体能利用先前经验解读新目标、追查未决问题并恢复失败的搜索，表明终身导航的进展依赖于连续推理会话对先前经验的积累。

title: In-Flight KV Cache with Clean Anchors for Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion generates a long video by splitting the video into temporal chunks and generating chunk-by-chunk, each through a short sequence of denoising stages. To memorize chunks that are already generated, previous methods reconstruct a clean or less-noisy key--value (KV) cache by additional forwards to build the cache without advancing an output latent. However, every denoising forward itself already computes the in-flight KV of the current chunk. We introduce FlashForward, which directly reuses this cache to avoid the heavy cache-update-only model forwards. After the current chunk completes one denoising stage, its stage-specific cache is already available for the next chunk. Assigning one GPU to each stage therefore lets different chunks occupy different stages concurrently. This early availability has a quality cost: the resulting stage-matched history is noisy, causing appearance and motion drift among chunks. To complement it, FlashForward produces sparse auxiliary clean anchor latents before the corresponding region is generated so the generation trajectories can be stabilized by this two-sided conditioning. The two memories operate at different temporal scales: sparse clean anchor KV supplies coarse, long-range two-sided structural guidance, while dense stage-matched history preserves fine, recent evolution. With up to four GPUs, FlashForward runs $1.16$--$1.69\times$ faster than HiAR and $1.42$--$2.92\times$ faster than Self-Forcing for 16 FPS videos of 20 seconds or longer across 1.3B and 14B backbone scales at 480p and 720p. On VBench, for the 1.3B model at 480p, it achieves higher scores and remains stable at longer durations, demonstrating that FlashForward generates high-quality and temporally consistent videos across durations of 20s, 35s and 65s at a much faster generation speed.

AI.tldr: FlashForward 直接复用去噪过程中的在途 KV 缓存，省去仅更新缓存的额外前向，并辅以稀疏干净锚点 KV 进行双侧条件约束，实现更快、时长更长且时序一致的自回归视频生成。
AI.motivation: 少步自回归视频扩散逐块生成视频，需要记忆已生成块。已有方法为构建 KV 缓存而进行额外的、不推进输出潜变量的模型前向，开销大；而实际上每次去噪前向本身就已计算当前块的在途 KV，存在明显冗余。
AI.method: 提出 FlashForward：直接复用每个去噪阶段计算出的在途 KV 缓存，避免仅为更新缓存的前向；当前块完成某一去噪阶段后，其阶段专属缓存即可供下一块使用，从而可将不同阶段分配到不同 GPU，实现不同块并发占用不同阶段。为弥补早期可用缓存带来的噪声（导致外观与运动漂移），在对应区域生成前产生稀疏的辅助干净锚点潜变量，形成双侧条件；两种记忆作用于不同时间尺度：稀疏干净锚点 KV 提供粗粒度的长程双侧结构引导，密集的阶段匹配历史保留细致的近期演化信息。
AI.result: 在最多 4 张 GPU 上，对 16 FPS、时长达 20 秒及以上的视频，FlashForward 相比 HiAR 快 1.16–1.69 倍，相比 Self-Forcing 快 1.42–2.92 倍，覆盖 1.3B 与 14B 骨干规模及 480p、720p 分辨率。在 VBench 上，1.3B 模型 480p 设置下取得更高分数，并在更长时长下保持稳定，在 20s、35s、65s 时长上均生成高质量且时序一致的视频。
AI.conclusion: 通过复用去噪过程中的在途 KV 缓存并引入稀疏干净锚点的双侧条件，FlashForward 在显著提升生成速度的同时，保证了长时长视频的生成质量与时序一致性。

title: TLC-DiT: Task-Aligned Local Visual Conditioning for Robust Multitask Robot Manipulation
summary: Language-conditioned robot policies have made clear progress in multitask manipulation, but task-relevant local visual evidence usually stays hidden inside a visual backbone or attention layers. This leaves the policy difficult to inspect and fragile under visual change, two symptoms of a missing explicit, task-aligned local visual channel. We present TLC-DiT, a plug-in extension of the Multitask Diffusion Transformer (DiT) policy that adds explicit task-guided local visual feature maps without changing the diffusion objective or the action-generation process. For each camera view, frozen DINOv2 patch features are modulated by the CLIP task embedding through FiLM and refined by a lightweight CoordConv CNN adapter into smooth spatial maps, which are concatenated with the original global image, language, joint-state, and timestep conditions. On LIBERO, TLC-DiT reaches a 93.5% average success rate, compared with 86.5% for Multitask DiT and 79.25% for SmolVLA. On LIBERO-plus, the total success rate improves from 54.07% to 57.24%, with larger gains under camera, background, and sensor-noise changes. In real-world bimanual tasks, TLC-DiT raises Teabag Putting completion from 44% to 89% while maintaining comparable Match Box Opening performance. Feature-map visualizations confirm that the model attends to task-relevant regions across views and perturbations, providing a direct way to inspect the visual evidence.

AI.tldr: TLC-DiT 在多任务扩散 Transformer 策略中显式加入任务引导的局部视觉特征图，不改变扩散目标与动作生成过程，提升了鲁棒性与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有的语言条件机器人策略虽在多任务操作上取得进展，但任务相关的局部视觉证据通常隐藏在视觉骨干或注意力层内部，导致策略难以检查，且在视觉变化下表现脆弱。这反映出缺少一个显式的、任务对齐的局部视觉通道。
AI.method: 提出 TLC-DiT，作为多任务扩散 Transformer（DiT）策略的插件式扩展。对每个相机视角，用 CLIP 任务嵌入通过 FiLM 调制冻结的 DINOv2 patch 特征，再经轻量 CoordConv CNN 适配器细化为平滑空间图，与原始全局图像、语言、关节状态和时间步条件拼接。
AI.result: LIBERO 上平均成功率 93.5%，优于 Multitask DiT 的 86.5% 和 SmolVLA 的 79.25%。LIBERO-plus 总成功率从 54.07% 提升到 57.24%，在相机、背景和传感器噪声变化下增益更大。真实双臂任务中，Teabag Putting 完成率从 44% 提升至 89%，Match Box Opening 性能相当。特征图可视化显示模型能关注任务相关区域。
AI.conclusion: TLC-DiT 通过显式任务引导的局部视觉通道，在保持扩散目标与动作生成不变的前提下，同时提升了策略性能、视觉变化鲁棒性与可解释性，并提供直接检查视觉证据的途径。

title: Harnessing Coupled Stream Completion For Human-Object Ineraction Modeling
summary: Text-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires body motion, object trajectories & rotations, and hand articulation to remain coordinated. These components differ in scale and dynamics, but must agree on contact, relative pose, and timing. A shared representation may limit the distinct structure of each stream, while independent generation prevents each stream from responding to changes in the others. Latent supervision alone also does not directly constrain contact after decoding. We propose TRACE, a continuous latent framework that keeps stream states separate and couples their updates. TRACE encodes body, object, and hand motion into separate latents and predicts each stream velocity from the complete current interaction state. Geometric losses on decoded motion further constrain contact and object-relative motion over time. The same model supports completion of any single absent stream from the other two. Frozen flow features also serve as input to a language model for HOI understanding. Experiments on InterAct, OMOMO, and BEHAVE show that joint completion training improves generation and that frozen flow features improve understanding over raw-motion encoding. On InterAct, TRACE achieves the highest contact precision, recall, and F1 among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: TRACE：一种连续潜空间框架，将身体、物体、手部运动编码为独立潜变量并耦合更新，配合几何损失约束接触，兼具生成、补全与理解能力。
AI.motivation: 文本驱动的HOI生成需协调身体运动、物体轨迹旋转与手部关节，三者尺度与动态不同却须在接触、相对位姿和时序上一致。共享表示会抹平各流的独特结构，独立生成又无法相互响应；仅靠潜空间监督不能直接约束解码后的接触。
AI.method: TRACE将身体、物体、手部运动编码为分离潜变量，由完整当前交互状态预测各流速度，实现分离状态与耦合更新；在解码运动上施加几何损失约束接触与物体相对运动；同一模型可基于另两流补全任一缺失流；冻结的flow特征输入语言模型用于HOI理解。
AI.result: 在InterAct、OMOMO、BEHAVE上实验表明，联合补全训练提升生成质量，冻结flow特征相比原始运动编码提升理解性能；在InterAct上TRACE取得最高接触精度、召回与F1。
AI.conclusion: 分离潜变量加耦合更新，配合解码层几何约束，是协调多模态HOI生成的有效路径，并能统一支持补全与理解任务。

title: When World Models Lie: Adaptive Safety Analysis Under Wrong Imaginations
summary: World models offer a powerful substrate for safety reasoning in high-dimensional robotic systems, but they are also fallible: their predictions can be biased, miscalibrated, or confidently wrong. This creates a central challenge for latent-space safety filters, which often learn Hamilton-Jacobi safety value functions on the dynamics of a world model. If the world model is incorrect, the resulting value function can inherit its errors and produce overconfident safety estimates. Existing latent safety filters often rely on auxiliary signals such as ensemble disagreement or value-target consistency residuals for adaptation, but these signals can remain small even when the world model's predictions deviate from observations. We propose an adaptive latent safety filter that calibrates safety reasoning using directly observed world-model error. Our method uses Adaptive Conformal Inference to construct online uncertainty sets from discrepancies between predicted and observation-inferred latent states, then evaluates safety pessimistically by minimizing the learned value function over these sets. This allows the filter to remain minimally conservative when the world model is accurate, while becoming more cautious when observations reveal model mismatch. We provide a finite-time coverage guarantee for the adaptive uncertainty radius. Through simulation and hardware experiments, we show that our method significantly reduces failures relative to state-of-the-art latent safety filters while preserving task completion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自适应潜空间安全滤波器，利用世界模型预测与观测推断潜状态之间的误差，通过自适应保形推断构建在线不确定集，并在此集合上悲观地最小化安全价值函数，从而在世界模型不准时提升安全性。
AI.motivation: 世界模型为高维机器人系统的安全推理提供了强大基础，但其预测可能存在偏差、校准不良或自信错误。潜空间安全滤波器通常在学到的动态上学习Hamilton-Jacobi安全价值函数，若世界模型有误，价值函数会继承误差并给出过度自信的安全估计。现有依赖集成分歧或价值目标一致性残差等辅助信号的方法，即使模型预测偏离观测，这些信号也可能保持很小，难以触发适应。
AI.method: 提出自适应潜空间安全滤波器，直接利用观测到的世界模型误差进行安全推理校准。方法采用自适应保形推断（Adaptive Conformal Inference），基于预测潜状态与观测推断潜状态之间的差异构建在线不确定集；随后在该不确定集上对学得的安全价值函数进行悲观最小化评估。并给出自适应不确定半径的有限时间覆盖保证。
AI.result: 在仿真与硬件实验中，该方法相比最先进的潜空间安全滤波器显著减少了失败情况，同时保持了任务完成能力；当世界模型准确时保持最小保守性，当观测揭示模型不匹配时则更加谨慎。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接利用观测到的世界模型误差并借助自适应保形推断构建在线不确定集，可实现动态、可校准的潜空间安全滤波，在保障任务完成的同时显著降低不安全失败。

title: Feature Space Guidance for Breast Cancer Classification in DCE-MRI
summary: Dynamic contrast enhanced breast MRI (DCE-MRI) is a powerful clinical tool for breast cancer detection, providing high resolution anatomical detail together with rich temporal contrast information. However, high dimensional 4D inputs, small lesions, and heterogeneous acquisition protocols across clinical sites hinder robust automated classification of healthy, benign, and malignant cases. To address these challenges, we propose a framework that dynamically analyzes latent representations to adapt to protocol-specific characteristics. Spatial variability is mitigated by reducing confounding background uptake and compensating for misalignment caused by deformable soft tissue. Additionally, relationships in the latent space across phases are leveraged to select the most informative temporal features, improving robustness to protocol-specific temporal variability. Finally, task specific discriminative features are promoted through large scale supervised lesion segmentation pretraining, which substantially enhances downstream finetuning. Evaluated under leave-one-center-out validation on the ODELIA dataset and the held-out AMBL cohort, the proposed framework substantially outperforms finetuned radiology foundation models and prior methods, improving mean AUROC by nearly 8 points and balanced accuracy by 4 points over the strongest baseline. Additionally, our method achieved first place in the MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025, further demonstrating its effectiveness for robust breast cancer classification. We publicly release our codebase under https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/CURIAtor.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CURIAtor框架，通过动态分析潜在表征来应对DCE-MRI乳腺分类中的高维4D输入、小病灶和跨站点协议异质性问题，显著提升分类性能并在MICCAI ODELIA挑战赛获第一。
AI.motivation: DCE-MRI是乳腺癌检测的有力工具，但高维4D输入、小病灶以及不同临床站点间异质的采集协议，阻碍了对健康、良性和恶性病例的稳健自动化分类。
AI.method: 提出一种动态分析潜在表征以适应协议特征的框架：通过减少混杂的背景摄取并补偿可变形软组织引起的错位来缓解空间变异；利用跨期相潜在空间关系选择最具信息量的时间特征以增强对协议时间变异的稳健性；并通过大规模监督病灶分割预训练促进任务特定的判别性特征，显著提升下游微调效果。
AI.result: 在ODELIA数据集和留出的AMBL队列上进行留一中心验证，平均AUROC比最强基线提升近8个点，平衡准确率提升4个点，优于微调的放射学基础模型和先前方法；在MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025中获得第一名。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效实现了稳健的乳腺癌分类，并在多中心评估和挑战赛中验证了其优越性，代码已公开。

title: Predictive Semantic Safety: From Visual Physical Reasoning to Safety-Critical Control
comment: The first two authors contributed equally to this work. Project page: https://www.taekyung.me/pss
summary: Physical interactions can create future hazards that are not apparent from the robot's current geometric surroundings. We present a framework termed Predictive Semantic Safety (PSS), which connects visual physical reasoning to backup-based safety filtering. A vision-language model (VLM) predicts physical events and their timing or directly predicts object displacements. An explicit motion model converts event hypotheses into object trajectories. Split conformal prediction calibrates position errors jointly across specified objects, observation times, and future times; geometric shape bounds convert the resulting position regions into predicted object occupancy. PSS evaluates a prescribed backup maneuver against this occupancy and derives input-affine constraints for minimally modifying the nominal input while preserving backup feasibility under the robot dynamics and input limits. MuJoCo experiments with a Unitree Go1 consider falling fixtures, impact-driven support loss, and contact propagation. PSS achieves a safe episode rate of 99.3%, compared with 43.3% for a Backup Control Barrier Function baseline that only uses current obstacle geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Predictive Semantic Safety（PSS）框架，将视觉物理推理与基于备份的安全过滤相结合，通过VLM预测未来物理事件并转化为占用区域，生成约束以保证机器人备份机动可行性。MuJoCo实验（Unitree Go1）显示安全回合率达99.3%，显著优于基线43.3%。
AI.motivation: 物理交互可能造成从机器人当前几何环境中无法察觉的未来危险（如支架坠落、支撑丧失、接触传播），仅依赖当前障碍物几何的传统安全方法难以应对这类潜在风险。
AI.method: PSS利用视觉语言模型预测物理事件及其时序或直接预测物体位移；显式运动模型将事件假设转为物体轨迹；采用拆分共形预测跨指定物体、观测时间与未来时间联合校准位置误差；几何形状边界将位置区域转为预测占用；随后评估预设备份机动对该占用的可行性，推导输入仿射约束以最小化修改名义输入，同时保持机器人在动力学与输入限制下的备份可行性。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo中使用Unitree Go1进行实验，涵盖坠落装置、冲击导致支撑丧失与接触传播场景。PSS实现99.3%的安全回合率，而仅使用当前障碍几何的Backup Control Barrier Function基线仅为43.3%。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉物理推理与备份式安全过滤相连接，能够有效预测并规避由物理交互引发的未来危险，显著提升机器人在复杂动态环境中的安全性。

title: CFCH: Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical Learning for Anterior Segment Disease Analysis
summary: Accurate classification of anterior segment diseases is crucial for ophthalmic screening and diagnosis. However, slit-lamp image analysis remains challenging due to substantial variability in imaging conditions and the intrinsic anatomical-disease hierarchy of ocular pathologies. Existing methods typically formulate this task as a flat multi-class classification problem, ignoring the structured dependency between anatomical regions (e.g., cornea, conjunctiva, and lens) and disease manifestations.To address these limitations, we propose CFCH, a Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical learning framework that explicitly models anatomical context and disease semantics through a dual-branch architecture. To enable effective cross-granularity collaboration, CFCH introduces semantic and cross-granularity attention consistency constraints, encouraging aligned yet complementary feature learning across branches. In addition, we construct AS-9K, a large-scale anterior segment dataset with 8975 images covering 12 common disease categories. To the best of our knowledge, AS-9K is the largest publicly available dataset for anterior segment image classification. Extensive experiments on two anterior segment datasets demonstrate that CFCH outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Qualitative visualizations further show more focused and lesion-relevant activation responses, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Code will be available at https://github.com/ybupengwang/CFCH.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CFCH粗-细协同层级学习框架，通过双分支架构显式建模解剖上下文与疾病语义，并构建了目前最大的眼前节图像分类数据集AS-9K（8975张图像、12类疾病），在多个数据集上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 眼前节疾病的准确分类对眼科筛查与诊断至关重要，但裂隙灯图像分析面临成像条件多变以及眼病固有的“解剖-疾病层级”结构带来的挑战。现有方法通常将其建模为扁平的多元分类问题，忽略了解剖区域（如角膜、结膜、晶状体）与疾病表现之间的结构化依赖关系。
AI.method: 提出CFCH（Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical）框架，采用双分支架构建模解剖上下文与疾病语义；为实现跨粒度协同，引入语义一致性与跨粒度注意力一致性约束，促使两个分支学习到对齐且互补的特征。同时构建AS-9K数据集，包含8975张图像、覆盖12种常见疾病类别。
AI.result: 在两个眼前节数据集上的大量实验表明，CFCH优于当前最先进方法；定性可视化显示其激活响应更聚焦、更贴近病灶区域，验证了框架的有效性。AS-9K是据作者所知最大的公开可用眼前节图像分类数据集。
AI.conclusion: CFCH通过显式建模解剖-疾病层级并强化跨粒度协同，有效提升了眼前节疾病分类性能，同时发布了大规模数据集AS-9K以推动该领域研究。

title: FutureDuet: Decoupling Observation Access from Future Supervision in World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot action generation with future visual supervision. Existing WAMs commonly fuse main and wrist observations into one visual stream and train both with the same future-video objective, despite their different visual dynamics. A stable main camera reveals scene-level task evolution, whereas wrist cameras move with the end effector, mixing local interaction changes with viewpoint shifts and self-occlusion. These contrasting predictive demands suggest that the two views may benefit from different future objectives. We introduce FutureDuet, which retains both views for control, while allowing each visual stream to receive a different future objective. For the main view, future RGB models task evolution, while interaction masks and robot skeletons focus supervision on task objects and robot motion. For the wrist stream, future latent prediction models short-horizon interaction changes without requiring pixel-level reconstruction. ActionDiT jointly reads the resulting Task State and Interaction State, combining scene-level progress with close-range interaction evidence. All auxiliary prediction modules are training-only, adding no inference overhead. FutureDuet achieves 94.2% clean and 94.1% randomized success on RoboTwin50 and 99.2% average success on LIBERO. The improvements are most pronounced on six RoboTwin50 tasks that require precise interaction, averaging gains of 9.2% and 12.8% over Fast-WAM in clean and randomized settings. Controlled studies further show complementary gains from separating the wrist pathway and designing future supervision separately for the two views.

AI.tldr: FutureDuet 提出为机器人主视角与腕部视角设计不同的未来预测目标：主视角用 RGB、交互掩码与机器人骨架建模任务演进，腕部视角用隐空间预测建模短时交互变化，并联合输入 ActionDiT，实现无推理开销的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有 World Action Models 将主视角与腕部视角融合为单一视觉流，并用相同的未来视频目标训练。但两者视觉动态差异显著：主相机稳定，反映场景级任务演进；腕部相机随末端执行器运动，混合了局部交互变化、视角偏移与自遮挡。这提示两路视角应使用不同的未来预测目标。
AI.method: FutureDuet 保留两路视角用于控制，但为每路视觉流设置不同未来目标。主视角：未来 RGB 建模任务演进，交互掩码与机器人骨架将监督聚焦于任务物体与机器人运动。腕部视角：未来隐空间预测建模短时交互变化，不要求像素级重建。ActionDiT 联合读取生成的 Task State 与 Interaction State，融合场景级进度与近距离交互证据。所有辅助预测模块仅用于训练，不增加推理开销。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin50 上取得 94.2% 干净、94.1% 随机化成功率，在 LIBERO 上平均成功率 99.2%。在六个需精确交互的 RoboTwin50 任务上提升最明显，相比 Fast-WAM 在干净与随机化设置下平均提升 9.2% 与 12.8%。对照实验进一步显示，分离腕部通路与为两视角单独设计未来监督均带来互补增益。
AI.conclusion: 为不同视角设计差异化未来监督目标可显著提升机器人动作生成性能，尤其在精确交互任务上；且该设计无额外推理成本。

title: Attribution Gaps in Zero-Training LLM+OVOD Pipelines: A Fine-Grained Analysis of the CAAP--SNAP Discrepancy
summary: LAOD and similar zero-training LLM+open-vocabulary-detector (OVOD) pipelines score two things separately: class-agnostic localization accuracy (CAAP) and semantic naming accuracy (SNAP). The two consistently diverge, and nobody has asked why. This paper asks why, on the full 5,000-image COCO-Val split (27,273 detections) rather than the small subset the original work evaluated on. Object visual complexity turns out not to be the driver -- small and occluded objects are, if anything, localized better than large ones. Vocabulary novelty is: once the LLM's wording falls outside the detector's native category set, localization accuracy falls from 80.9% to 31.6%. That drop is not spread evenly across unfamiliar phrasing, though. Almost all of it comes from cases where the novel wording actually names a different object than the one COCO annotated (true synonyms still score 89.3%; semantically unrelated "noise" labels score 12.0%). A closer look at a further failure subset tells a similar story: 78-88% of what looks like complete localization failure is really the model correctly finding a real object that COCO's non-exhaustive 80-category scheme simply never labeled, not hallucination. Swap the detector backbone (YOLO-World for Grounding DINO) or the LLM (Gemma-3 for Qwen2.5-VL) and both the effect and its rough size hold up, so this looks like a general property of the pipeline family rather than a quirk of one model pairing. The upshot is that a large share of the apparent CAAP--SNAP gap traces back to closed-category annotation limits rather than a real grounding failure, which matters for how we detect hallucination, analyze failure modes, and design evaluation for grounded multimodal systems meant to work in the open world.

AI.tldr: 本文探究零训练LLM+开放词汇检测器（OVOD）流水线中类无关定位精度（CAAP）与语义命名精度（SNAP）为何持续背离，在完整COCO-Val验证集上发现：该差距主要源于词汇新颖性（尤其是命名了不同于标注对象的措辞），而非物体视觉复杂度或定位失败，且大量"失败"实为COCO封闭类别标注不全所致。
AI.motivation: 已有LAOD等零训练LLM+OVOD流水线分别评估CAAP与SNAP，二者结果持续背离，但此前无人追问原因；且原工作仅在小规模子集上评估，缺乏对全量数据的系统分析。
AI.method: 在完整5,000张COCO-Val子集（27,273个检测框）上进行评估，而非原工作的小规模子集；对比物体视觉复杂度、词汇新颖性与定位精度的关系，并按同义词、语义无关"噪声"标签等类别细分分析；进一步检查失败子集以区分真实定位失败与COCO未标注的真实物体；通过更换检测器骨干（YOLO-World vs Grounding DINO）与LLM（Gemma-3 vs Qwen2.5-VL）验证结论的普适性。
AI.result: 物体视觉复杂度并非主因，小且被遮挡的物体定位反而优于大物体；词汇新颖性是关键：当LLM用词超出检测器原生类别集时，定位精度从80.9%降至31.6%；几乎全部降幅来自"新措辞实际命名了与COCO标注不同的对象"的情况（真同义词仍达89.3%，语义无关噪声标签仅12.0%）；进一步失败子集中78-88%的"完全定位失败"实为模型正确找到COCO 80类未标注的真实物体，而非幻觉；更换检测器或LLM后效应及其大致规模依然成立。
AI.conclusion: CAAP--SNAP差距的很大一部分可归因于封闭类别标注的局限，而非真实的grounding失败；这对开放世界多模态系统的幻觉检测、失败模式分析与评估设计具有重要启示，表明该现象是此类流水线家族的普遍特性。

title: RoboIRGBench: Benchmarking Implicit Referential Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks typically assume that task-relevant information is explicitly specified in the instruction. In practice, however, humans frequently refer to objects, quantities, and relations implicitly, requiring robots to recover the intended target from linguistic and perceptual context. We study this capability as Implicit Referential Grounding (IRG) and introduce RoboIRG-Bench, a manipulation benchmark designed to systematically evaluate it. Built upon RoboMME, RoboIRG-Bench contains 40 variants derived from 11 tasks and covers four challenges, including direct, reasoning-mediated, spatial, and contextual referential grounding. As IRG often requires retaining and retrieving previously established context, we evaluate representative VLAs spanning different memory mechanisms. Our evaluation reveals a noticeable referential robustness gap. Models that perform well under explicit instructions can degrade sharply when the same task-relevant information must be recovered from context. Reasoning-mediated and spatial references are particularly challenging, while models using external VLMs show greater robustness but still exhibit significant failures. Moreover, replacing the external VLM with a stronger model does not eliminate these gaps. We further validate these findings on a Franka Research 3 robot arm, where the gap persists under real-world manipulation and manifests as both incorrect referent grounding and downstream execution failures. These results establish IRG as a distinct and underexplored capability for reliable robotic instruction following and highlight the need for VLAs that can robustly integrate language, perception, reasoning, and action.

AI.tldr: 本文提出隐式指称落地（IRG）能力研究，并构建 RoboIRG-Bench 基准，系统评估 VLA 模型在隐式指令下的机器人操作表现，揭示显著的指称鲁棒性差距。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 基准通常假设任务相关信息在指令中被明确指定，但现实中人类常用隐式方式指代物体、数量和关系，机器人需从语言与感知上下文中恢复真实目标。这一能力此前缺乏系统评估，因此作者将其定义为 IRG 并展开研究。
AI.method: 基于 RoboMME 构建 RoboIRG-Bench，包含由 11 个任务衍生的 40 个变体，覆盖直接、推理中介、空间和上下文四类指称落地挑战；并评估了采用不同记忆机制的代表性 VLA 模型，同时在 Franka Research 3 机械臂上进行真实世界验证。
AI.result: 评估显示出明显的指称鲁棒性差距：显式指令下表现良好的模型在需从上下文恢复信息时性能急剧下降；推理中介和空间指称尤其困难；使用外部 VLM 的模型鲁棒性更强但仍存在显著失败，替换为更强 VLM 也无法消除差距；真实机器人实验中差距依然存在，表现为指称错误与下游执行失败。
AI.conclusion: IRG 是可靠机器人指令跟随中一个独特且尚未充分探索的能力，亟需能够稳健整合语言、感知、推理与动作的 VLA 模型。

title: OmniSmartHome: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark for Smart-Home Agents
summary: Smart-home assistants are expected to handle diverse, realistic requests that arise in daily life. In such interactions, users often rely on the surrounding multimodal context-pointing at objects or referring to what they see or hear, leaving their requests underspecified in language alone. Existing smart-home benchmarks, however, express user requests solely through language, leaving context-dependent real-world requests underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniSmartHome, a multimodal smart-home benchmark where each spoken request is paired with the surrounding visual and spatial-audio context, providing complementary cues to disambiguate underspecified requests. OmniSmartHome comprises 1,360 synthetic and 272 real-world episodes. We evaluate 16 omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) and reveal that, while they perform strongly when speech alone sufficiently conveys the user's intent, performance drops substantially when resolving it requires reasoning over multimodal contextual cues. As a simple agent baseline, we provide PROME (PROcedural Memory for multimodal Evidence gathering), which equips agents with specialized audio-visual perception tools and procedural memory for orchestrating their use. PROME generally improves performance across six Omni-LLMs. Demos and examples are available at https://omni-smart-home.github.io

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OmniSmartHome，一个多模态智能家居基准，将语音请求与视觉和空间音频上下文配对，以解决语音本身表达不充分的真实请求问题，并揭示当前 Omni-LLM 在多模态上下文推理上的性能下降。
AI.motivation: 现有智能家居基准仅用语言表达用户请求，而真实交互中用户常指向物体或提及所见所闻，导致请求在语言层面不完整。为探索依赖上下文的多模态真实请求，作者构建了多模态基准以弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 提出 OmniSmartHome 基准，每个语音请求配以周围视觉和空间音频上下文，提供互补线索以消歧不充分请求，包含 1360 个合成与 272 个真实场景。评估 16 个 Omni-LLM，并提供智能体基线 PROME（多模态证据收集的程序性记忆），为智能体配备专门的音视频感知工具和程序性记忆来编排工具使用。
AI.result: 评估显示，当语音本身足以传达意图时 Omni-LLM 表现良好，但当需要基于多模态上下文线索进行推理时性能大幅下降。PROME 在六个 Omni-LLM 上总体提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: 当前 Omni-LLM 在多模态上下文消歧的真实智能家居请求上仍有明显不足，PROME 作为简单智能体基线展示了工具与程序性记忆编排的潜力，为未来研究提供方向。

title: Contact-Aware Impedance Controller for Robot-Assisted Ultrasound Imaging
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA2027)
summary: Safe robot-assisted ultrasound imaging requires a reliable controller able to detect and localize probe--tissue interaction. In this paper, we present a B-mode ultrasound image-based contact perception method and a contact-aware impedance controller for robotic ultrasound imaging. The proposed method detects acoustic contact independently of force measurements, enabling contact-conditioned force/torque taring to reduce residual wrench bias. During contact, the method continuously estimates the effective contact location along the curved probe surface and uses it to update the controller interaction frame, enabling visual servoing of the physical probe--tissue contact point during imaging. Experiments on an agar phantom demonstrated a contact-localization RMSE of $\mathbf{1.46 \pm 0.14}$~mm over probe roll angles from $\mathbf{-15^\circ}$ to $\mathbf{15^\circ}$. During static rolling, the proposed controller maintained task-space tracking accuracy comparable to a conventional fixed-frame impedance controller while reducing the maximum compressive interaction force from $\mathbf{31.56}$~N to $\mathbf{20.09}$~N, corresponding to a $\mathbf{36.3\%}$ reduction. These results demonstrate the potential of ultrasound images as direct contact feedback for safe and accurate robot-assisted ultrasound imaging.

AI.tldr: 提出基于B超图像接触感知方法与接触感知阻抗控制器，无需力测量即可检测接触并估计接触位置，提升机器人超声成像的安全性与准确性。
AI.motivation: 安全的机器人辅助超声成像需要可靠控制器来检测并定位探头与组织的交互，而传统方法依赖力测量，存在残余力偏置等问题。
AI.method: 基于B超图像的接触感知方法，独立于力测量检测声学接触，实现接触条件下的力/力矩清零以减小残余力偏置；接触期间持续估计弯曲探头表面的有效接触位置，并据此更新控制器交互坐标系，实现物理接触点的视觉伺服。
AI.result: 在琼脂体模上，探头滚转角-15°至15°范围内接触定位RMSE为1.46±0.14 mm；静态滚动时控制器保持与固定坐标系阻抗控制器相当的任务空间跟踪精度，同时将最大压缩交互力从31.56 N降至20.09 N，降低36.3%。
AI.conclusion: 超声图像可作为直接接触反馈，用于安全且精确的机器人辅助超声成像。

title: Retrieved but Not Delivered: Multimodal Memory Delivery for Long-Term Agents
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures, 21 tables. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/DeliverMem/
summary: Work on memory for multimodal agents optimizes what is written, updated and retrieved. Between retrieval and the answer, however, is a stage that multimodal memory evaluations do not isolate: what of the retrieved memory reaches the model, and in what form.
