We call it delivery, and a controlled decomposition on MemLens locates the remaining room there. With the retrieved evidence set exactly fixed, delivering the original pixels instead of withholding them raises accuracy by 13.87 points on an 8B backbone, whereas making retrieval perfect on those same messages improves it by 2.31. Delivery is the larger term on all three MemLens backbones and grows with backbone strength; retrieval grows too, without closing the gap. We propose DeliverMem, an instantiation of delivery as three decisions: keep the original modality, give each item a readable identity, and state when it was seen, with a retrieval-side adapter for the one property delivery cannot supply. Each is measured against a delivery-matched control that alters only its own variable. DeliverMem leads the strongest published memory agent on MemLens at all four context lengths, and beats DMV-Bench's own strongest method at every setting on both backbones. On MemLens it does this on a tenth to a seventieth of the input. Each decision helps only where the question lacks what it supplies, and is null elsewhere. A single fixed configuration nonetheless leads both benchmarks, without training any component or modifying the stored records. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/DeliverMem/

AI.tldr: 论文指出多模态记忆评估忽视"交付"阶段，提出DeliverMem，通过三项决策显著提升准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有工作聚焦于记忆的写入、更新与检索优化，但检索与回答之间的"交付"阶段（检索到的内容以何种形式到达模型）未被评估隔离。作者称该阶段存在最大的性能提升空间。
AI.method: 在MemLens上进行受控分解：固定检索证据集，比较交付原始像素与保留像素的效果。提出DeliverMem，将交付形式化为三项决策：保留原始模态、为每项赋予可读身份、标注被看到的时间，并配一个检索端适配器；每项决策均与只改变自身变量的对照比较。
AI.result: 在8B骨干上，交付原始像素相比保留像素提升13.87点，而将检索做到完美仅提升2.31点；交付项在三个骨干上均更大且随骨干增强而增长。DeliverMem在MemLens四个上下文长度上均超过最强已发表记忆智能体，并在两个骨干上于DMV-Bench所有设置击败最强方法；在MemLens上仅用十分之一到七十分之一的输入。每项决策仅在问题缺少其所提供信息时有效，否则无效。
AI.conclusion: 交付是比检索更大的性能瓶颈。单一固定配置、无需训练任何组件、不修改存储记录即可在两个基准上领先，表明交付是值得关注的关键环节。

title: From Language to Task Maps: Compiling Semantic Relations While Preserving Task-Relevant Freedom
summary: Natural-language manipulation instructions specify qualitative relations, whereas continuous controllers require state-evaluable task quantities, differentials, and completion conditions. Because a qualitative relation generally leaves part of the relative configuration unspecified, expanding it into a complete pose can introduce unintended constraints. We present a typed semantic-to-geometric interface in which language specifies entities, relations, and phases, while each relation indexes a registered specification of its task-relevant distinctions and preserved freedoms. A robot-side compiler grounds these specifications, constructs relation-specific task maps and consistent differentials using conformal geometric algebra, and composes the resulting policies through RMPflow. To evaluate the division of responsibility between the language model and the compiler, we compared a Semantic Topology interface with one that additionally requires relation-specific geometric specifications over 60 instructions. Both produced correct shared semantic content in 41/60 cases, but critical errors under their respective interface requirements occurred in 19/60 and 58/60 cases. Across 64 grounded evaluations spanning eight geometric relation forms, the task maps preserved registered null directions and responded to relation-relevant perturbations; analytic directional derivatives agreed with finite differences, and Jacobian ranks matched the registered dimensions. In three closed-loop ablations using a simulated Franka Emika Panda in MuJoCo, fixing a relation-preserved coordinate increased median terminal progress error by 20.24--71.00~mm while the retained relation errors remained within their evaluation bounds. These results support compiling relation-visible geometry and preserved freedom together into composable continuous objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种类型化的语义到几何接口，将自然语言操作指令中的定性关系编译为连续控制器可用的任务量、微分与完成条件，通过CGA构建关系专用任务映射并用RMPflow组合策略。
AI.motivation: 自然语言指令指定的是定性关系，而连续控制器需要可求值的任务量、微分和完成条件。将定性关系直接展开为完整位姿可能引入非预期约束，因此需要一种明确划分语言与几何编译职责的接口。
AI.method: 提出类型化语义到几何接口：语言指定实体、关系与阶段，每个关系索引一个已注册的规格，记录其任务相关区分与保留自由度。机器人端编译器利用共形几何代数（CGA）对这些规格进行grounding，构建关系专用的任务映射与一致的微分，并通过RMPflow组合所得策略。与仅需语义拓扑的接口进行对比，并开展64次grounding评估与三项闭环消融实验。
AI.result: 在60条指令中，两种接口均产生正确的共享语义内容为41/60，但在各自接口要求下的关键错误分别为19/60与58/60。64次grounding评估覆盖八种几何关系形式，任务映射保留了已注册的零方向并响应关系相关扰动；解析方向导数与有限差分一致，雅可比秩与注册维度匹配。在MuJoCo中模拟Franka Emika Panda的三项闭环消融中，固定一个关系保留坐标使终端进度误差中位数增加20.24–71.00 mm，而保留的关系误差仍在评估界限内。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将关系可见几何与保留自由度一起编译为可组合的连续目标，是可行且有效的方向。

title: SPACE: Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction for Streaming Video Memory
summary: Fixed-capacity streaming video memory requires repeated eviction decisions whose effects accumulate over time. Yet existing policies are evaluated primarily in terms of retained information or downstream accuracy, leaving how repeated updates alter the futures supported by memory largely unexamined. We define a memory's predictive state as the future representations supported by its retained history and formulate eviction as counterfactual control over transitions in this space. We introduce SPACE (Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction), which uses a frozen multi-horizon JEPA to predict the future representations induced by alternative eviction actions. Counterfactual utility identifies future-useful alternatives, while slow predictive-basin geometry determines when to correct avoidable drift and when to adapt to sustained predictive change, without online parameter updates. We further introduce MABS-Bench, which evaluates future-task sufficiency, within-regime predictive stability, transition responsiveness, and perturbation recovery under matched causal streams and memory budgets. Across multiple video datasets, SPACE yields consistent improvements in dataset-native task performance while reducing predictive-state drift.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出以"预测状态"视角重新审视流式视频记忆的逐出决策，并给出无需在线更新的方法 SPACE 及配套基准 MABS-Bench。
AI.motivation: 固定容量的流式视频记忆需要反复做逐出决策，其影响会随时间累积。但现有策略多只用"保留信息量"或"下游准确率"来评价，忽略了反复更新究竟如何改变记忆所支撑的未来（即预测状态），这一维度缺乏考察。
AI.method: 作者将记忆的预测状态定义为"由被保留历史所支撑的未来表征"，把逐出建模为对该状态空间转移的反事实控制。提出 SPACE（Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction）：用一个冻结的多时程 JEPA 预测不同逐出动作会诱导出的未来表征；用反事实效用识别对未来有用的备选方案；用"慢预测吸引盆"几何决定何时纠正可避免的漂移、何时适应持续性的预测变化，全程不做在线参数更新。同时提出 MABS-Bench，在匹配的因果流与记忆预算下评估未来任务充分性、同机制内预测稳定性、转变响应性与扰动恢复。
AI.result: 在多个视频数据集上，SPACE 在数据集原生任务性能上取得一致性提升，同时降低了预测状态漂移。
AI.conclusion: 以预测状态及其转移为评价与控制对象，可在不更新参数的前提下改善流式视频记忆的逐出决策，兼顾任务性能与预测稳定性。

title: From World Models to World Action Models: Rethinking Next-State Prediction
summary: Predicting the next state is a core paradigm of World Models for modeling physical dynamics, emphasizing prediction fidelity. As World Models evolve into World-Action Models (WAMs), existing methods still fix the next state before training as RGB, a single latent feature, or a static combination of predefined targets, thereby constraining action learning to the inductive biases preserved by a particular representation. To address this limitation, we propose CF-WAM, a dynamic next-state prediction framework that samples visual, semantic, geometric, and interaction projections of the same future, standardizes them into a common video form, and supervises a unified WAM across these projections. The action-relevant constraints exposed by these projections accumulate across training steps, forcing WAM to capture the underlying state-transition structure that supports multiple projections of the same action-conditioned future. This dynamic mechanism also provides a natural cross-embodiment dynamics reference frame for Human and Robot learning. By jointly learning across different next-state parameterizations, heterogeneous Human and Robot experience can bypass appearance differences and directly contribute to shared state-transition learning, improving cross-embodiment generalization. Experiments show that CF-WAM improves both training efficiency and final control performance, while translating Human experience effectively into policy gains. CF-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa-GR1 with an average success rate of 82.50%, while reaching 82.65% on LIBERO-Plus and up to 84.00% in real-world evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出CF-WAM，一种动态下一状态预测框架，将视觉、语义、几何、交互等多种未来投影标准化为统一视频形式，联合监督世界-动作模型，提升控制性能与跨本体泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型在训练前将下一状态固定为RGB、单一隐特征或预定义目标的静态组合，使动作学习受限于特定表示的归纳偏置，难以捕捉支撑多种未来投影的底层状态转移结构，也限制了人类与机器人经验的跨本体迁移。
AI.method: CF-WAM动态采样同一未来的视觉、语义、几何与交互投影，将其标准化为通用视频形式，并在这些投影上监督统一的世界-动作模型；动作相关约束在训练步间累积，迫使模型捕捉同一动作条件下未来的状态转移结构，并为人类与机器人学习提供自然的跨本体动力学参考系。
AI.result: 实验表明CF-WAM同时提升训练效率与最终控制性能，并能有效将人类经验转化为策略增益；在RoboCasa-GR1上平均成功率82.50%，LIBERO-Plus达82.65%，真实世界评估最高达84.00%。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨不同下一状态参数化的联合学习，异构的人类与机器人经验可绕过外观差异，直接贡献于共享的状态转移学习，从而提升跨本体泛化能力并取得当前最优性能。

title: GAUGE: Group-Wise View-Inconsistency Rectification for Feed-Forward 4D Tracking
comment: 9 pages of main text plus appendices. Code: https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/GAUGE
summary: Feed-forward models regress dense 3D point trajectories directly from monocular video, yet the residual after global alignment is substantial and lacks a structural explanation. Measured on dynamic query points across models and datasets, the error concentrates along the view direction, while the scale correction each motion group requires differs. The predicted displacement direction nevertheless supports reliable grouping, with a median angle far below the 90° random baseline. The systematic part of the residual is therefore a family of radial degrees of freedom per motion group, along directions 2D observations cannot constrain. We call it group-wise view inconsistency. We present GAUGE (Group-wise Adaptive Unsupervised Gauge Estimation), a training-free and model-agnostic post-hoc module. It recovers motion groups from direction consistency and spatial connectivity, then estimates a per-frame radial scale and group-level translation from 1% to 5% metric anchors, four degrees of freedom per group and frame. On dynamic query points of eight trackers, including D4RT, 4RC and SM4RT, our correction lowers endpoint error by 15.1% to 62.6% over the uncorrected predictions, while spending the same anchors on gradient fine-tuning improves the same models by only -1.1% to 15.2%. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/GAUGE.

AI.tldr: 前馈式单目视频3D点轨迹预测在全局对齐后仍存在系统性残差，其结构为每个运动组的径向自由度，作者提出免训练、模型无关的后处理模块GAUGE来估计并修正该误差。
AI.motivation: 前馈模型直接从单目视频回归稠密3D点轨迹，但全局对齐后的残差很大且缺乏结构性解释，因此需要揭示其来源并提出修正方法。
AI.method: 先在动态查询点上分析残差分布：误差集中于视线方向，各运动组所需尺度修正不同，但预测位移方向的分组可靠性高（中位角远低于90°随机基线）。据此定义"组间视角不一致性"，并提出GAUGE：从方向一致性与空间连通性恢复运动组，再用1%–5%的度量锚点逐帧估计各组径向尺度和组级平移（每组每帧四个自由度）。
AI.result: 在D4RT、4RC、SM4RT等八个跟踪器的动态查询点上，该修正使端点误差相比未修正预测降低15.1%–62.6%；而在相同锚点预算下用梯度微调仅改善-1.1%–15.2%。
AI.conclusion: 系统性残差可归结为沿视线方向的组级径向自由度，GAUGE以极少量锚点显著优于微调，验证了该结构化解释的有效性，代码已公开。

title: ARS: Agentic Reward System for Robot Learning
summary: Progress reward modeling is the problem of estimating how a robot's behavior changes task progress over time. Reliable estimation requires distinguishing meaningful state changes from failed attempts and task-irrelevant actions. We introduce the Agentic Reward System (ARS), an inference framework for progress reward modeling with general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs), without additional reward-model training. Given an offline trajectory and a task instruction, ARS uses adaptive visual inspection for both event proposal and verification. A subagent proposes a task-relevant event timeline, which a primary agent verifies and revises before estimating per-frame progress. ARS can incorporate optional terminal outcome labels and visual references to inform its judgments. It can also audit progress estimates from external reward models. We evaluate ARS with a 27B VLM on a controlled semantic-mismatch benchmark and downstream policy learning in simulation and on a real robot. The benchmark reveals that several evaluated reward baselines assign spurious progress to wrong-object manipulation even in simple pick-and-place scenes. ARS better suppresses these errors and outperforms these baselines in simulation policy learning. We further demonstrate that ARS supports long-horizon policy learning from mixed-quality offline experience on real-robot multi-screw fastening in a full-scale laboratory replica of an industrial washing-machine assembly line. These results suggest that structured inference and verification can improve the usefulness of general-purpose VLMs for robot reward modeling. Code is at https://github.com/midea-ai/ars

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Agentic Reward System (ARS)，一种无需额外奖励模型训练、基于通用 VLM 的进度奖励建模推理框架，通过子智能体提出事件时间线、主智能体验证修订并估计逐帧进度，在语义错配基准、仿真策略学习及真实机器人长程装配任务中优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人进度奖励建模需要区分有意义的状态变化与失败尝试、任务无关动作。现有奖励基线在简单抓取放置场景中仍会对错误物体操作赋予虚假进度，可靠性不足；而训练专用奖励模型成本高。
AI.method: ARS 以通用 VLM 为推理核心，无需训练奖励模型。给定离线轨迹与任务指令，采用自适应视觉检查进行事件提议与验证：子智能体提出任务相关事件时间线，主智能体验证并修订后估计逐帧进度。可选地融合终端结果标签与视觉参考，并可审计外部奖励模型的进度估计。
AI.result: 使用 27B VLM 在受控语义错配基准上评测：多个奖励基线在简单 pick-and-place 场景中对错误物体操作给出虚假进度，ARS 更好地抑制此类错误，并在仿真策略学习中表现更优。在真实机器人多螺钉紧固任务（工业洗衣机装配线全尺寸实验室复刻）中，ARS 支持混合质量离线经验的长程策略学习。
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理与验证可提升通用 VLM 在机器人奖励建模中的实用价值，为无需训练奖励模型的进度估计提供可行路径。

title: Levy-Driven Correspondence Estimation for Registration
summary: Finding reliable point correspondences is difficult when point clouds have low overlap or undergo non-rigid deformation. Iterative refinement can correct uncertain matches, but costly network evaluations limit the number of updates. We present LevyMatch, a Lévy-driven method that uses random jumps to refine a soft matching matrix. At each step, a network uses the current matching state and geometric information to predict a target matching matrix. A Brownian reference bridge gives an explicit formula for the update toward this target. A Gamma random clock sets the time step for each update. The updated matches provide new geometric feedback for the next target prediction. We further propose a fixed front-loaded Gamma policy that assigns more expected clock time to early updates and less to later ones, without retraining or extra network evaluations. Reordering the same sampled Gamma increments shows that placing larger increments early gives higher accuracy than placing them late. On 4DMatch and 4DLoMatch, our method improves both non-rigid feature matching recall (NFMR) and inlier ratio (IR) over the compared methods. The front-loaded policy achieves 93.09% NFMR and 92.11% IR on 4DMatch, and 82.79% NFMR and 79.07% IR on 4DLoMatch.

AI.tldr: LevyMatch：一种基于Lévy驱动的软匹配矩阵迭代精炼方法，通过随机跳跃与前置Gamma时钟策略提升低重叠/非刚性点云匹配精度。
AI.motivation: 当点云重叠度低或发生非刚性形变时，找到可靠的点对应关系十分困难；迭代精炼虽能修正不确定匹配，但昂贵的网络评估限制了更新次数，需要一种在有限评估下更高效的精炼机制。
AI.method: 提出LevyMatch，利用随机跳跃精炼软匹配矩阵。每步由网络结合当前匹配状态与几何信息预测目标匹配矩阵；用Brownian参考桥给出朝目标的显式更新公式，用Gamma随机时钟设定每步时间步长；更新后的匹配为下一步预测提供新的几何反馈。另提出固定的前置Gamma策略，将更多期望时钟时间分配给早期更新、较少分配给后期更新，且无需重训练或额外网络评估。
AI.result: 重排同一组采样得到的Gamma增量表明，将较大增量放在早期比放在后期精度更高。在4DMatch和4DLoMatch上，NFMR与IR均优于对比方法；前置策略在4DMatch上达到93.09% NFMR和92.11% IR，在4DLoMatch上达到82.79% NFMR和79.07% IR。
AI.conclusion: Lévy驱动的随机跳跃精炼结合前置Gamma时钟策略，可在不增加网络评估成本的前提下有效提升非刚性点云匹配的召回率与内点率。

title: Trajectory-Safe Orienteering for Human-Robot Shared Environments
summary: Orienteering problem (OP) has wide real-world applications and also great potential in human-robot collaboration. However, existing approaches struggle to simultaneously ensure safe and feasible trajectories while achieving high-quality task execution in shared workspaces. To this end, this work studies the OP with time windows and variable profits (OPTWVP). A two-stage DEcoupled discrete-Continuous Optimization with Service-time-guided Trajectory (DeCoST) approach is proposed to effectively solve OPTWVP in shared spaces. Meanwhile, the safety-aware time windows of nodes and the discretized workspace are introduced to ensure collision-free trajectories between the end effector and the human. Preliminary results validate the effectiveness of DeCoST in generating collision-free trajectory plans while preserving the quality of orienteering tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带时间窗和可变收益的定向问题（OPTWVP），提出两阶段解耦离散-连续优化方法DeCoST，结合服务时间引导的轨迹规划，在共享空间中生成无碰撞轨迹并保证任务质量。
AI.motivation: 定向问题在现实世界与人机协作中应用广泛，但现有方法难以在共享工作空间中同时保证轨迹安全可行与高质量任务执行，因此需要新方法解决OPTWVP。
AI.method: 提出两阶段解耦离散-连续优化方法DeCoST（DEcoupled discrete-Continuous Optimization with Service-time-guided Trajectory）。引入安全感知的节点时间窗和离散化工作空间，以确保末端执行器与人类之间的无碰撞轨迹。
AI.result: 初步结果验证了DeCoST在生成无碰撞轨迹规划的同时能够保持定向任务的质量。
AI.conclusion: DeCoST能有效求解共享空间中的OPTWVP，兼顾安全无碰撞轨迹与定向任务执行质量。

title: DraftAttention2: Fast Video Diffusion with Low-Resolution-Guided Mixed-Precision Attention
summary: Video generation has broad applications in content creation and entertainment. Diffusion transformers have advanced the quality of generated videos, but attention over spatiotemporal tokens becomes increasingly expensive as video resolution and duration increase. We present DraftAttention2, a training-free framework that uses the low-resolution draft attention map to jointly select attention blocks and assign their numerical precision. Specifically, spatial 2D average- and max-pooled queries and keys capture complementary regional statistics to estimate block importance, and a shared ranking assigns higher precision to important blocks, lower precision to less important retained blocks, and skips the rest under configurable budgets. Our analysis separates sparsification error from attention-weighted quantization error, establishing when recovering skipped interactions with low-bit computation tightens the output-error bound. This analysis motivates retaining more interactions at low precision while reserving higher precision for blocks with larger attention mass. To translate these fine-grained assignments into practical speedups, we further develop fused operand preparation and a single attention kernel with precision-specific phases, sharing data movement, softmax statistics, and output accumulation across precisions. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a superior quality-efficiency trade-off over existing efficient video generation methods. Notably, its advantage is particularly pronounced for few-step video diffusion, where jointly combining sparsity with 4- and 8-bit mixed-precision computation substantially improves generation quality while retaining significant acceleration. Code is available at https://github.com/anemoi-project/anemoi

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的DraftAttention2框架，利用低分辨率草稿注意力图联合进行注意力块选择与数值精度分配，实现视频生成的高质量高效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer提升了视频生成质量，但随着视频分辨率和时长增加，时空token上的注意力计算代价急剧上升，需要一种既能加速又保持质量的方案。
AI.method: 使用低分辨率草稿注意力图，通过空间2D平均池化和最大池化的query/key捕获互补区域统计来估计块重要性；以共享排序为重要块分配高精度、次要保留块分配低精度、其余块跳过；并开发融合操作数准备与单一注意力核（含精度特定阶段）以将细粒度分配转化为实际加速。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在质量-效率权衡上优于现有高效视频生成方法，优势在少步视频扩散中尤为明显，联合稀疏与4位/8位混合精度计算显著提升生成质量并保持明显加速。
AI.conclusion: DraftAttention2通过联合稀疏化与混合精度量化，为视频扩散模型提供了一种免训练的高效注意力方案，分析还明确了稀疏化误差与注意力加权量化误差的关系及误差界收紧条件。

title: Model-Informed Safe Reinforcement Learning for Bipedal Locomotion via Step-to-Step Prediction
summary: Humanoid robots promise versatile mobility in cluttered, human-centric environments, but real deployment demands principled safety. Classical model-based gait generators yield interpretable motions but often lack the robustness and adaptability of modern reinforcement learning (RL) based approaches. We propose a model-informed reinforcement learning framework anchored to the analytical Angular Momentum Linear Inverted Pendulum (ALIP) template. We provide a step-to-step safety certificate for ALIP stepping via a discrete exponential control barrier function (DECBF) and use it as (i) a training-time shaping signal and (ii) a runtime action filter that minimally adjusts swing-foot placement to satisfy template-level constraints. Full-order safety is evaluated empirically on the Digit humanoid in MuJoCo with a whole-body controller stack. Compared to an unconstrained baseline, our approach reduces safety-violation events in the reported external-disturbance trial, while larger lateral-velocity transients reveal a safety-tracking tradeoff.

AI.tldr: 提出一种以ALIP模板为锚的模型信息强化学习框架，通过离散指数控制屏障函数（DECBF）为类人机器人步态提供逐步安全证书，并将其同时用作训练塑形信号与运行时动作滤波器。
AI.motivation: 类人机器人需要在杂乱的以人为中心的环境中实现灵活移动，但实际部署对安全性有严格要求。传统基于模型的步态生成器可解释性强但鲁棒性与适应性不足；现代强化学习方法鲁棒灵活但缺乏原则性的安全保障。因此需要一个兼顾两者优势的框架。
AI.method: 以解析的角动量线性倒立摆（ALIP）模板为锚，构建模型信息强化学习框架。通过离散指数控制屏障函数（DECBF）为ALIP迈步提供逐步安全证书，并将其用作：（i）训练阶段的塑形信号；（ii）运行时动作滤波器，以最小幅度调整摆动脚落点以满足模板层约束。全阶安全性在MuJoCo中的Digit人形机器人上借助全身控制器栈进行实证评估。
AI.result: 在报告的外部扰动试验中，与未加约束的基线相比，该方法减少了安全违规事件的发生；但在较大的横向速度瞬变情形下，暴露出安全与跟踪性能之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 将基于模板的安全证书嵌入强化学习，可有效降低类人机器人步态的安全违规，但安全约束与运动跟踪能力之间存在需进一步平衡的折中关系。

title: InterTab: Interleaved Visual-Structure Alignment for Multi-Modal Table Reasoning
summary: Table images preserve structural information that are often lost in text serialization, and reasoning over them requires locating relevant rows, columns, and cells step by step. Current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode the whole image once before reasoning, so they cannot pick up row-, column-, and cell-level evidence as the question unfolds. Encoder-side table structure and generic interleaved visual chain-of-thought still do not bind each reasoning step to that structure. We propose \textbf{InterTab}, an \textbf{Inter}leaved structure-aware framework for CoT reasoning over \textbf{Tab}le images, interleaves chain-of-thought with tool calls that crop structure-aligned table regions. First, we build InterTab-22K, includes reasoning trajectories in which each step is tied to both a structural location and a bounding box. InterTab is trained in two stages: supervised structure-aware alignment (SSA) on InterTab-22K teaches the model to interleave reasoning with structure-aligned crops, and active localization optimization (ALO) further optimizes answer correctness, localization IoU, and output format, while penalizing missing or excessive tool calls. Experiments on nine table benchmarks show that InterTab improves the average accuracy of its backbone from 68.28% to 73.17% and achieves the best average performance among all compared methods. Code and data will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InterTab，一个面向表格图像的交错式结构感知思维链推理框架，通过将推理步骤与结构对齐的表格区域裁剪工具调用交错进行，提升多模态大模型的表格推理能力。
AI.motivation: 表格图像保留了在文本序列化中常被丢失的结构信息，对其推理需逐步定位相关行、列和单元格。而当前多模态大模型（MLLMs）在推理前仅一次性编码整张图像，无法在问题展开过程中获取行、列、单元格级别的证据。编码器侧表格结构与通用交错视觉思维链均无法将每个推理步骤与结构绑定。
AI.method: 1）构建InterTab-22K数据集，包含每个步骤均绑定结构位置与边界框的推理轨迹；2）两阶段训练：监督式结构感知对齐（SSA）在InterTab-22K上教会模型将推理与结构对齐的裁剪交错进行；3）主动定位优化（ALO）进一步优化答案正确性、定位IoU和输出格式，同时惩罚缺失或过多的工具调用。
AI.result: 在九个表格基准上，InterTab将其骨干模型的平均准确率从68.28%提升至73.17%，并在所有对比方法中取得最佳平均性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过与结构对齐的裁剪工具调用交错思维链，可有效解决MLLMs在表格图像推理中难以动态定位行列单元格证据的问题，显著提升表格推理表现。代码与数据将开源。

title: Robot-Assisted Deployment and Maintenance of Inflatable Modules for Lunar Habitation: A Field Demonstration
comment: Author's version of a manuscript accepted at the International Conference on Space Robotics 2026 (iSpaRo 2026). (c) IEEE
summary: Long-term human habitation and in-situ development on the Moon open a new era of space utilization. In this context, robots are a key technology for facilitating the construction of future human outposts. Toward the deployment and establishment of human habitation modules on the lunar surface, we propose a combined system consisting of inflatable modules and a modular, reconfigurable robotic system. This paper presents a report demonstrating various robot-assisted task executions using real hardware, namely the modular and reconfigurable robot MoonBot and the inflatable module HIDAS, to enhance the reliability of their deployment and maintenance. The demonstrated tasks include robotic inspection during inflation, module position alignment, final safety locking, and three-dimensional mapping for post-deployment maintenance. All demonstrations were conducted either in a laboratory environment or at a lunar analogue test site. Finally, lessons learned are discussed to provide essential insights for this robotic application to future lunar habitation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种由充气式舱段与模块化可重构机器人组成的月球栖息地部署系统，并用真实硬件演示了多项机器人辅助任务，最后总结经验教训。
AI.motivation: 月球长期居住与原位开发需要建设未来人类前哨站，机器人是支撑其建设的关键技术，因此需提升充气模块部署与维护的可靠性。
AI.method: 构建充气模块（HIDAS）与模块化可重构机器人（MoonBot）相结合的系统，并在实验室或月球模拟试验场用真实硬件执行任务演示。
AI.result: 成功演示了充气过程中的机器人巡检、模块位置对准、最终安全锁定以及用于部署后维护的三维建图等任务。
AI.conclusion: 总结所获经验教训，为该机器人在未来月球居住中的应用提供关键见解。

title: RCVLA: 4D Radar-Grounded Semantic Reasoning and Trajectory Arbitration for Autonomous Driving
summary: 4D radar provides geometric and motion cues that complement visual semantics, but integrating it into vision-language-action (VLA) models requires both radar--language alignment for semantic reasoning and explicit use of radar measurements for trajectory refinement and selection. To support these capabilities, we construct Cap4DR with 86,016 radar-image-text samples for alignment pretraining and OmniHD-QA with 520,161 question-answer pairs for instruction tuning across scene description, key-object reasoning, occupancy understanding, and trajectory planning. Building on these datasets, we propose RCVLA, a radar-camera VLA framework consisting of a radar-grounded semantic reasoning stage (RCVLA-Sem) and a trajectory arbitration stage (RCVLA-Phys). RCVLA-Sem performs gated bidirectional interaction between camera and radar tokens for driving question answering and reference trajectory generation, while auxiliary heads provide object and occupancy queries. RCVLA-Phys refines reference-guided trajectory candidates through truncated diffusion conditioned on these queries and cluster-level radar measurements, then calibrates candidate scores using radar-derived time-to-collision risk. On OmniHD-QA, RCVLA-Sem improves CIDEr by 9.92 points and reduces key-object velocity error by $21.9\%$ relative to OmniDrive. RCVLA-Phys further reduces average L2 error from $0.348$ to $0.259\,\mathrm{m}$ and average open-loop collision rate from $0.576\%$ to $0.175\%$ relative to RCVLA-Sem. Ablation studies further show that language-aligned radar tokens improve semantic reasoning, while cluster-level radar measurements and risk calibration improve trajectory arbitration. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RCVLA，一个融合4D雷达与视觉的VLA框架，并构建Cap4DR对齐数据集与OmniHD-QA指令数据集，在语义推理与轨迹规划任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 4D雷达提供的几何与运动线索可补充视觉语义，但将其融入视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型需要同时实现雷达-语言对齐以支持语义推理，以及显式利用雷达测量进行轨迹细化与选择。现有方法难以兼顾这两方面能力。
AI.method: 构建两个数据集：Cap4DR（86,016个雷达-图像-文本样本，用于对齐预训练）和OmniHD-QA（520,161个问答对，覆盖场景描述、关键物体推理、占据理解、轨迹规划，用于指令微调）。提出RCVLA框架，包含两阶段：RCVLA-Sem进行雷达基础的语义推理，通过门控双向交互融合相机与雷达token，用于驾驶问答与参考轨迹生成，并附设物体与占据查询辅助头；RCVLA-Phys进行轨迹仲裁，以这些查询和聚类级雷达测量为条件，通过截断扩散细化参考引导的轨迹候选，并基于雷达推导的碰撞时间风险校准候选分数。
AI.result: 在OmniHD-QA上，RCVLA-Sem相比OmniDrive将CIDEr提升9.92分，关键物体速度误差降低21.9%。RCVLA-Phys进一步将平均L2误差从0.348 m降至0.259 m，平均开环碰撞率从0.576%降至0.175%。消融实验表明，语言对齐的雷达token改善语义推理，聚类级雷达测量与风险校准改善轨迹仲裁。
AI.conclusion: RCVLA通过雷达-语言对齐与显式雷达测量的结合，在两阶段框架中分别服务于语义推理与轨迹仲裁，验证了4D雷达融入VLA模型的有效性，代码将开源。

title: MonoEgo: Monocular Metric Egocentric Demonstration Capture with Passive Wrist Constellations and Sparse Workstation Anchors
summary: Image-aligned metric demonstrations often require dedicated tracking hardware and synchronization across devices. We present MonoEgo, a capture system that replaces active wrist instrumentation with offline monocular reconstruction. One 90-FPS global-shutter camera observes calibrated passive wrist constellations, sparse workstation anchors, and the scene on a shared image clock. MonoTag SLAM combines marker corners with ORB geometry and uses visual evidence to reject ambiguous planar-marker poses. Its metric Atlas supports interval scale re-anchoring, verified map merging, and retrospective localization of earlier frames supported by the final map. Camera and wrist-constellation outputs retain validity and map provenance, and unsupported motion is left missing. Experiments show metric tracking beyond continuous anchor visibility, reconnection of supported map components, and recovery of some missing camera poses. Comparisons against a multisensor camera reference and separate stationary-constellation tests characterize trajectory agreement and precision while revealing incomplete coverage and residual geometric uncertainty. The results indicate that passive fixtures and offline reconstruction can reduce capture-side requirements. Dynamic accuracy, deployment, and downstream policy benefits require further study.

AI.tldr: MonoEgo 提出一种离线单目重建的采集系统，用一台 90-FPS 全局快门相机替代主动腕部追踪硬件，通过 MonoTag SLAM 与度量 Atlas 实现度量追踪与地图合并。
AI.motivation: 图像对齐的度量演示通常依赖专用追踪硬件和跨设备同步，采集侧要求高、部署复杂，因此作者希望减少对主动腕部仪器的依赖。
AI.method: 单台 90-FPS 全局快门相机在统一图像时钟下观测标定的被动腕部星阵、稀疏工作站锚点和场景；MonoTag SLAM 结合标记角点与 ORB 几何，并用视觉证据剔除歧义的平面标记位姿；度量 Atlas 支持区间尺度重锚定、经验证的地图合并以及早期帧的回顾性定位。
AI.result: 实验显示可实现超出连续锚点可见性的度量追踪、重连受支持的地图组件，并恢复部分缺失的相机位姿；与多传感器相机参考及独立静止星阵测试比较，刻画了轨迹一致性与精度，同时暴露覆盖不完整和残余几何不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 被动固定装置与离线重建可降低采集侧需求，但动态精度、部署效果及下游策略收益仍需进一步研究。

title: MM-OPD: Towards One More Bottleneck Between Perception and Reasoning
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance visual reasoning by strengthening both perception and reasoning, implicitly assuming a process that transitions seamlessly from perception to reasoning. However, we observe a counterintuitive phenomenon that challenges this assumption: holding the model, question, and decoding fixed, we replace images with their caption or code representations (symbolic views), which seems to be redundant given the clear image structures, but the performance surprisingly improves by 10.2% to 23.6% across model scales and datasets. We term this performance gap as the Symbolic Visual Gap and then take a closer look at it. Through experiments, we find that although the visual evidence can already appear in the reasoning trace for the image-input model, the symbolic-view-input model shows much higher attention to the correct evidence than the image-input model. This suggests that despite good capabilities from current works in perception and reasoning themselves, another bottleneck exists between perception and reasoning in selecting perceived visual information as appropriate evidence for subsequent reasoning. To handle this bottleneck, since the symbolic view steers attention toward correct evidence and is readily obtained at scale, it provides supervision for evidence selection without manually labeled evidence. Building on this, we introduce MM-OPD, a multimodal on-policy self-distillation framework for symbolic-to-visual correction that transfers guidance from symbolic-conditioned behavior to the image-conditioned policy through residual token-level targets, steering the model toward correct visual evidence. Experiments across benchmarks and model scales show that MM-OPD improves a broad range of multimodal abilities, with gains in visual perception, chart and document understanding, mathematical reasoning, and general VQA.

AI.tldr: 论文发现多模态大模型存在"符号视觉鸿沟"：用图像的文本字幕或代码等符号视图替代原图，性能反而提升10.2%~23.6%，揭示了感知与推理之间存在证据选择瓶颈，并提出MM-OPD框架进行符号到视觉的自蒸馏纠正。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大模型通过强化感知与推理能力来提升视觉推理，隐含假设感知到推理的过渡是顺畅无缝的。但作者观察到一个反直觉现象：在模型、问题和解码固定的情况下，用字幕或代码等符号视图替代图像，虽然看似冗余（因图像结构已清晰），性能却显著提升。这说明感知与推理之间存在一个被忽视的瓶颈——即如何从感知到的视觉信息中选择适当的证据供后续推理使用。
AI.method: 作者首先通过实验定位瓶颈：分析推理轨迹发现，图像输入模型的推理痕迹中虽已出现视觉证据，但符号视图输入模型对正确证据的注意力明显更高，表明瓶颈在于证据选择。基于此，提出MM-OPD（多模态在策略自蒸馏框架），用于符号到视觉的纠正。该方法利用符号视图（易大规模获取且能将注意力导向正确证据）提供监督信号，无需人工标注证据，通过残差式的token级目标，将符号条件下的行为指导迁移到图像条件下的策略，引导模型关注正确的视觉证据。
AI.result: 在多种基准和模型规模上的实验表明，MM-OPD提升了广泛的多模态能力，在视觉感知、图表与文档理解、数学推理以及通用VQA等任务上均取得增益。
AI.conclusion: 感知与推理之间的证据选择是多模态大模型的一个关键瓶颈，而非单纯的感知或推理能力不足。利用符号视图作为无需人工标注的监督信号，通过符号到视觉的在策略自蒸馏（MM-OPD），可有效引导模型关注正确视觉证据，从而全面提升多模态能力。

title: Gaze Prompts: Temporally Dense Human Attention for Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) fine-tuning pairs images with actions at every step, yet typically provides only a task-level language instruction, leaving moment-to-moment visual relevance implicit. We introduce \emph{eye-tracker-supervised gaze prompting}, which uses gaze recorded during VR teleoperation to provide frame-level visual guidance for VLA fine-tuning. During training, recorded gaze locations are rendered as crosshairs on the robot's head-camera images. At deployment, a lightweight predictor estimates gaze locations from recent images and the instruction, supplying the same type of visual prompt without an eye tracker or changes to the policy architecture. Instantiated with $π_0$, gaze prompting increases mean success from $26.3\%$ to $56.0\%$ across six real-world bimanual manipulation tasks, with gains also observed when a single policy is trained on all six tasks. We release \textsc{GazeMani}, a dataset of $1{,}200$ teleoperated trajectories with synchronized gaze.

AI.tldr: 提出"眼动监督注视提示"方法，用VR遥操作中记录的眼动为VLA微调提供帧级视觉引导，部署时用轻量预测器替代眼动仪，在π₀上使六个双臂真实任务平均成功率从26.3%提升到56.0%，并发布GazeMani数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA微调在每一步将图像与动作配对，但通常只提供任务级语言指令，逐步的视觉相关性是隐含的、未被显式监督，导致策略难以聚焦当前关键时刻的关键视觉区域。
AI.method: 利用VR遥操作期间记录的眼动作为帧级视觉引导：训练时将注视位置以十字准星渲染到机器人头部相机图像上；部署时用一个轻量预测器根据近期图像与指令估计注视位置，提供同类型视觉提示，无需眼动仪，也不改变策略架构；以π₀为实例进行验证。
AI.result: 在六个真实世界双臂操作任务上，平均成功率由26.3%提升至56.0%；当用单一策略在全部六个任务上训练时同样获得增益；并发布包含1,200条带同步眼动的遥操作轨迹数据集GazeMani。
AI.conclusion: 帧级眼动引导可作为低成本、架构无关的视觉提示，有效提升VLA策略的精细操作成功率，且部署时无需真实眼动硬件。

title: DPAMixerSR: An Efficient Degradation-Pattern-Aware Model for Image Super-Resolution
summary: While content-adaptive schemes have delivered notable advances in image super-resolution (SR), existing approaches typically focus on texture complexity and ignore intrinsic degradation factors (e.g., blur kernels or noise patterns), leading to suboptimal computation allocation and reconstruction performance. To remedy this, we propose DPAMixerSR, a degradation-pattern-aware framework that enables efficient SR through adaptive sparse computation. We design a lightweight Perceptual Degradation Ranking (PDR) module partitions the image into severely and mildly degraded patches, which are routed to the Adaptive Sparse Processing (ASP) and a lightweight convolutional branch, respectively. ASP performs structure-aligned, multi-scale sparse propagation and bidirectional refinement, while the convolutional branch enhances efficiency in mildly degraded regions. By coupling degradation-driven routing with structure-aligned sparse processing, DPAMixerSR establishes a self-regulating framework that dynamically balances computational efficiency and reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments on various SR tasks demonstrate that our DPAMixerSR achieves superior structural restoration and perceptual fidelity with markedly reduced computational overhead, providing a novel and scalable framework for degradation-aware, resource-efficient SR.

AI.tldr: 提出DPAMixerSR，一种退化模式感知的稀疏计算框架，通过退化驱动路由实现高效图像超分辨率。
AI.motivation: 现有内容自适应超分方案主要关注纹理复杂度，忽略了退化因素（如模糊核、噪声模式），导致计算分配不优和重建性能欠佳。
AI.method: 设计轻量级感知退化排序（PDR）模块，将图像划分为严重退化和轻度退化区域，分别路由至自适应稀疏处理（ASP）分支和轻量卷积分支。ASP执行结构对齐的多尺度稀疏传播与双向细化，卷积分支负责轻度退化区域以保证效率。
AI.result: 在多种超分任务上的大量实验表明，DPAMixerSR在显著降低计算开销的同时，实现了更优的结构恢复和感知保真度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过退化驱动路由与结构对齐稀疏处理的耦合，构建了自调节框架，为退化感知、资源高效的超分提供了新颖且可扩展的范式。

title: Where Memory Belongs: Ledger, an Object Ledger for Memory-Augmented VLAs
summary: Memory is essential for long-horizon, partially observed robotic manipulation: a robot must remember which object was placed in a drawer, whose cup it moved, or how many action cycles have elapsed. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models embed memory directly inside the policy, but benchmarks show no single in-policy mechanism covers all spatio-temporal dimensions, trailing oracle methods by a wide margin. We argue that memory type dictates where memory should reside: short-term perceptual memory (repetition, timing, retracing) belongs inside the policy, while long-term object memory (persistent spatial state, containment, event history) belongs outside as an explicit, readable record. We present Ledger, a harness that realizes this split over a single fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ policy by pairing an in-policy frame-sampling memory with an external spatio-temporal object memory, the ledger, built from a SAM3 tracker and a VLM captioner of the demonstration and read by an LLM planner that decides at step boundaries. On RoboMME, Ledger reaches the highest four-suite average among the evaluated methods, 64.3% (vs. 45.9% for the strongest prior method under identical evaluation), leading object reference (60.7% vs. 40.3%) and object permanence (86.7% vs. 56.2%) using a single set of weights. Choosing the memory source at runtime, from the instruction and the record, removes the need for a task-level router.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ledger 框架，将机器人操作记忆分为策略内的短期感知记忆与策略外的长期物体记忆，在 RoboMME 上取得 64.3% 四套件平均成绩，显著超越此前最强方法。
AI.motivation: 长时程、部分可观测的机器人操作需要记忆能力，但现有 VLA 模型将记忆直接嵌入策略内部，基准测试显示没有单一策略内机制能覆盖所有时空维度，且远落后于 oracle 方法。作者主张记忆类型决定记忆存放位置。
AI.method: Ledger 在单个微调的 π_{0.5} 策略上实现记忆拆分：策略内使用帧采样记忆处理短期感知记忆（重复、计时、回溯）；策略外构建显式可读的时空物体记忆"ledger"，由 SAM3 跟踪器和 VLM 描述器从演示中构建，并由在步边界决策的 LLM 规划器读取。运行时根据指令和记录选择记忆来源，无需任务级路由器。
AI.result: 在 RoboMME 上，Ledger 以单套权重达到最高的四套件平均 64.3%（此前最强方法为 45.9%），物体引用 60.7%（对比 40.3%），物体恒存性 86.7%（对比 56.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆按类型拆分——短期感知记忆置于策略内、长期物体记忆置于策略外——是一种有效方案，能够在单一权重下大幅超越现有方法，且运行时记忆源选择可替代任务级路由器。

title: ProDyGS: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from a Single Static Monocular Camera
summary: We present ProDyGS, a novel dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for high-quality novel view synthesis from videos captured by a single static camera. While existing methods rely on multi-view setups or significant camera motion for geometric constraints, our approach addresses the challenging scenario where multi-view supervision is completely absent. We overcome this limitation by generating synthetic multi-view supervision through depth-guided proxy image synthesis. Specifically, we estimate temporally consistent depth maps using foundational monocular depth networks, then construct 3D Gaussian representations that generate proxy images from arbitrary viewpoints. A deformation network learns temporal dynamics by warping canonical Gaussians using this augmented supervision. Experiments on the DyNeRF dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance while requiring only monocular depth estimation as external supervision, outperforming approaches that rely on stronger priors such as scene flow.

AI.tldr: 提出ProDyGS，一种面向单目视频的动态3D高斯泼溅框架，通过深度引导的代理图像合成生成伪多视角监督，实现高质量新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 现有动态场景重建方法依赖多视角采集或显著的相机运动来获取几何约束，而单台静态相机拍摄的视频中完全缺少多视角监督，这是一个具有挑战性但尚未被很好解决的场景。
AI.method: 利用基础单目深度网络估计时间一致的深度图，据此构造3D高斯表示并从任意视角生成代理图像，以合成多视角监督；再通过形变网络对该增强监督下的规范高斯进行扭曲，学习时序动态。
AI.result: 在DyNeRF数据集上取得最先进性能，且仅需单目深度估计作为外部监督，优于依赖场景流等更强先验的方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，借助深度引导的代理监督合成，可在无多视角监督的单目静态相机场景下实现高质量动态新视角合成，且对外部监督的依赖更弱。

title: Aerial GRIPPER: A Gradient-based Real-time Inverse-game Predictor and Planner
summary: Accurate capture of non-cooperative targets is critical. In an attempt to tackle this intractable challenge, an aerial gripper system integrated with a Gradient-based Real-time Inverse-game Predictor and PlannER (GRIPPER) framework is proposed. The interaction is formulated as a general-sum pursuit-evasion game under incomplete information. Specifically, underlying cost parameters of the target are inferred online, and the open-loop Nash equilibrium (OLNE) strategy is iteratively refined within a receding-horizon loop. To ensure high-frequency execution, a computationally friendly gradient-based inverse-game solver is developed. Without explicit computation of the Hessian inverse, the optimized solution is updated (> 50 Hz) based on implicit differentiation and fast Hessian-vector products. Meanwhile, an anti-disturbance controller is developed to overcome disturbances of uncertain payload and gripper actuation, enabling precise tracking of the planned trajectory and accurate grasping of the target. Simulations and real-world experiments illustrate the superior computational efficiency and task performance of GRIPPER. The task of capturing and delivering a non-cooperative target is accomplished, highlighting the robustness, adaptability, and real-time performance of the framework in highly adversarial scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出GRIPPER框架，将空中抓取非合作目标建模为不完全信息下的一般和追逃博弈，在线推断目标代价参数并迭代求解开环纳什均衡，实现>50Hz实时规划与精准抓取。
AI.motivation: 准确捕获非合作目标是一项极具挑战性的任务，目标行为不确定且具有对抗性，传统方法难以在实时条件下应对不完全信息下的动态交互。
AI.method: 将交互建模为不完全信息下的一般和追逃博弈；在线推断目标的底层代价参数，并在滚动时域循环中迭代优化开环纳什均衡策略；提出计算友好的基于梯度的逆博弈求解器，借助隐式微分与快速Hessian-向量乘积避免显式计算Hessian逆，使解以>50Hz更新；同时设计抗扰控制器以应对不确定负载与夹爪执行扰动。
AI.result: 仿真与真实实验表明GRIPPER在计算效率和任务性能上均具优势，成功完成非合作目标的捕获与投送任务。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在高度对抗场景下展现出鲁棒性、适应性与实时性，验证了博弈论建模结合高效梯度求解在空中抓取任务中的有效性。

title: Region-Local Copula Evidence Fusion for Heterogeneous Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Superpixel copula models provide stable regional evidence for heterogeneous remote sensing change detection, but a single label per region limits localization within mixed superpixels. This letter develops a region-local copula evidence fusion method that retains the regional decision structure while introducing spatially varying local dependence anomalies. Independently fitted local models characterize departures from unchanged cross-image relationships. Reference ranking and an upper-tail gate transform these anomalies for fusion with continuous regional confidence. We derive the resulting regiondependent local decision threshold and identify a condition under which gating is equivalent to reparameterizing ungated fusion. On Lake and UK, whole-image optimized configurations achieve kappa coefficients of 0.78136 and 0.90817 and improve mixedregion and boundary decisions. Four-fold retrospective spatial validation over ten training subsets confirms complementary local information, with ungated reference fusion increasing mean kappa by 0.00693 and 0.01793. Fixed gating yields a larger UK gain of 0.03353 but only 0.00041 on Lake. These results support regional-local dependence interaction, while showing that calibration and gating have scene-dependent benefits.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种区域-局部copula证据融合方法，在保留超像素区域决策结构的同时引入空间变化的局部依赖异常，以改善混合超像素内的变化定位，并在Lake与UK数据集上取得较高kappa并验证局部信息的互补性。
AI.motivation: 超像素copula模型为异构遥感变化检测提供稳定的区域级证据，但每个区域单一标签限制了混合超像素内部的变化定位能力。
AI.method: 独立拟合局部模型刻画相对未变化跨图像关系的偏离；通过参考排序与上尾门控将局部异常变换后，与连续区域置信度融合；推导区域相关的局部决策阈值，并给出门控等价于无门控融合重参数化的条件。
AI.result: 在Lake与UK上，全图优化配置的kappa分别为0.78136与0.90817，改善了混合区域与边界决策；十折训练子集的四折回顾性空间验证确认局部信息互补，无门控参考融合的平均kappa分别提升0.00693与0.01793；固定门控在UK提升较大（0.03353），在Lake仅为0.00041。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持区域与局部依赖之间的相互作用，同时表明校准与门控的收益具有场景依赖性。

title: Efficient World Action Model Inference with Adaptive Intermediate States
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) enable future-aware control by jointly modeling actions and environment dynamics. However, iterative diffusion or flow inference incurs substantial denoising latency. Prior inference state offers a natural opportunity for acceleration, yet changing planning contexts, observations, and intermediate representations can quickly render retained state stale. Preserving useful computation therefore requires adapting inference state rather than reusing it as-is. To this end, we present $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$, a training-free framework that accelerates WAM inference by preserving and adapting inference state for efficient and accurate continuation as the control loop evolves. Across closed-loop replans, Trajectory Remapping remaps replan state from the preceding replan to initialize the next replan, reducing redundant trajectory generation. Across denoising steps, Observation Rebinding performs anticipatory inference during action execution and rebinds retained denoising state to the real observation for continuation when consistency checks pass, reducing latency exposed to the control loop. Across Transformer layers, Residual Rescaling selectively rescales retained layer state and refreshes it through full computation of the middle layers when probe checks fail, reducing repeated Transformer computation. Evaluations of three representative WAM architectures on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 show that $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$ achieves 1.47-3.05$\times$ speedups in observation-to-action latency and 2.23-3.27$\times$ speedups in GPU inference time per replan, while preserving 96.69-99.54% of native WAM task success.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架WAMACHINE，通过保留并自适应推理状态来加速World Action Models的推理。
AI.motivation: World Action Models依赖迭代扩散或流式推理实现未来感知控制，但去噪延迟高；虽然可利用前序推理状态加速，然而变化的规划上下文、观测和中间表征会迅速使保留状态过期，因此需要自适应状态而非直接复用。
AI.method: 包含三个机制：跨闭环重规划的Trajectory Remapping，用前次重规划状态初始化下一次以减少冗余轨迹生成；跨去噪步骤的Observation Rebinding，在执行期间进行预判推理并在一致性检查通过时将保留去噪状态重绑到真实观测；跨Transformer层的Residual Rescaling，在探针检查失败时选择性重缩放保留层状态并通过中间层完整计算刷新。
AI.result: 在LIBERO和RoboTwin 2.0上评估三种代表性WAM架构，观测到动作延迟加速1.47-3.05倍，每次重规划GPU推理时间加速2.23-3.27倍，同时保持96.69-99.54%的原生任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: WAMACHINE作为免训练框架，通过自适应当前推理状态，可有效加速World Action Models并保持较高任务成功率。

title: REALIS: A Curated Dataset for Studying the Challenges of AI Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors are often evaluated on benchmarks where real and synthetic images differ in content, quality, or generation artifacts, allowing models to rely on dataset-specific cues and fail on unfamiliar generators or processed images. Existing datasets provide limited support for evaluating these challenges jointly across diverse visual content. We introduce REALIS, a dataset of 1.43 million real and synthetic images generated by 42 modern text-to-image models, including the latest proprietary systems such as Nano Banana 2. REALIS combines prompts derived from real images, quality filtering, and stratified sampling to reduce class-specific shortcuts while preserving content diversity. We further introduce REALIS-Expert, a stress-test subset for high-quality synthetic images, where real and generated samples are selected with closely matched semantic and visual characteristics. We also propose a robustness protocol covering 35 transformations at five severity levels to analyze detector behavior under image processing. Based on REALIS, our benchmark evaluates pretrained detectors, fine-tuned models, and zero-shot vision-language models under generator and post-processing shifts. On the hardest processed split, the best pretrained conventional detector achieves 0.550 ROC-AUC, compared with 0.752 for the best REALIS-trained detector. REALIS provides a unified framework for measuring and improving the reliability of AI-image detectors under conditions that better reflect real-world use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出REALIS数据集（143万张真实与合成图像，42个现代文生图模型），并设计压力测试子集REALIS-Expert与35种变换的鲁棒性协议，用于统一评估AI图像检测器在生成器与后处理偏移下的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测基准中，真实图像与合成图像在内容、质量或生成痕迹上存在差异，导致模型依赖数据集特有线索，在面对陌生生成器或经过处理的图像时失效；现有数据集难以联合评估这些挑战并覆盖多样视觉内容。
AI.method: 构建REALIS数据集，包含143万张真实与合成图像，由42个现代文生图模型生成（含最新专有系统）；采用源自真实图像的提示词、质量过滤与分层采样，减少类别特异性捷径并保留内容多样性。另设REALIS-Expert压力测试子集，使真实与生成样本在语义和视觉特征上高度匹配。提出覆盖35种变换、5个严重等级的鲁棒性评估协议。
AI.result: 基于REALIS对预训练检测器、微调模型和零样本视觉语言模型在生成器与后处理偏移下进行评测。在最难的经过处理的数据划分上，最佳预训练传统检测器仅达0.550 ROC-AUC，而最佳REALIS训练检测器达到0.752 ROC-AUC。
AI.conclusion: REALIS为衡量和改进AI图像检测器在更贴近真实使用条件下的可靠性提供了统一框架。

title: On the Numerical Reliability of Differentiable Physics-Based Optimization for Robotic Material Manipulation
comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at the IROS 2026 workshop: Deformable Objects Manipulation: Research Foundations, Reproducibility and Real-World Challenges
summary: Differentiable physics is increasingly used in robotic material manipulation for system identification, trajectory or skill optimization, demonstration generation, and robot or end-effector design. These applications depend on gradients propagated through long, contact-rich simulation rollouts. We study the numerical reliability of those gradients using two Material Point Method (MPM) system-identification benchmarks derived from elastoplastic and granular manipulation. The benchmarks provide controlled cases for three effects that also arise in broader differentiable physics-based optimization. GPU many-to-one sums whose order depends on thread scheduling changed long-horizon gradients and reversed the sign of one parameter gradient relative to a deterministic reference. Finite-difference checks became less reliable for longer rollouts because repeated-run loss variation grew much faster than the loss change produced by the tested parameter perturbations. Observation and loss definitions changed optimization behaviour and the solution preferred by an independent metric. These results motivate reproducible accumulation, finite-difference validation that compares perturbation-induced loss changes with repeated-run variation, and explicit reporting of objective construction when differentiable simulation is used for robotic optimization.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究可微物理在机器人材料操作中长时程接触密集仿真梯度的数值可靠性，通过两个MPM系统辨识基准揭示GPU非确定性求和、有限差分校验失效及损失定义敏感性三类问题，并给出可复现累加、校验方法与目标函数报告建议。
AI.motivation: 可微物理被广泛用于机器人材料操作中的系统辨识、轨迹或技能优化、示范生成以及机器人/末端执行器设计，这些应用依赖通过长时程、接触密集仿真展开传播的梯度。然而这些梯度的数值可靠性尚不明确，可能影响优化结果的正确性，因此需要系统研究。
AI.method: 构建了两个基于MPM（物质点法）的系统辨识基准，分别来自弹塑性与颗粒材料操作场景，提供受控实验条件，用于考察三类效应：GPU多对一求和的线程调度顺序依赖、有限差分校验在长时程下的可靠性、以及观测与损失定义对优化行为的影响。
AI.result: GPU多对一求和因线程调度顺序不同而改变长时程梯度，并使某一参数梯度相对于确定性参考发生符号反转；随着展开变长，重复运行损失波动增长远快于参数扰动引起的损失变化，导致有限差分校验可靠性下降；观测与损失定义的改变会改变优化行为及独立指标所偏好的解。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果提示在使用可微仿真进行机器人优化时，应采用可复现的累加方式、将扰动引起的损失变化与重复运行波动进行对比的有限差分验证方法，并显式报告目标函数的构造方式。

title: Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation for Geospatial Vision-Language Models
summary: Existing geospatial vision-language models (Geo-VLMs) typically optimize diverse geospatial tasks through a unified multi-task adaptation paradigm without explicitly accounting for the heterogeneous optimization characteristics. Our empirical observations reveal heterogeneous gradient characteristics across tasks, including vision-language differences, intra-branch gradient relationships, and task interference, which hinder effective multi-task optimization. Motivated by these observations, we propose Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation (G2DA), a gradient-aware optimization framework for multi-task Geo-VLM learning. G2DA first partitions tasks into vision- and language-centric groups through gradient-guided cross-modal decoupling. It then constructs modality-specific curricula based on task gradient similarity and employs bidirectional rehearsal to mitigate the recency effects introduced by sequential optimization. We evaluate G2DA on three Geo-VLM benchmarks using six InternVL3 and Qwen3.5-VL variants, along with GeoChat and GeoLLaVA. Across all 24 benchmark-model combinations, G2DA consistently outperforms representative baselines, improving over the strongest competitor by 3.08, 4.30, and 2.81 percentage points on UrBench-MCQ, XLRS-Bench-Lite, and VRS-Bench-VQA, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of gradient-guided task organization for Geo-VLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation (G2DA)，一个面向多任务地理空间视觉语言模型（Geo-VLM）的梯度感知优化框架，通过跨模态解耦、模态特定课程学习和双向复演，缓解多任务优化中的梯度异质性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有Geo-VLM采用统一的多任务适应范式，未显式考虑不同任务的异质优化特性。作者通过实证观察发现任务间存在视觉-语言差异、分支内梯度关系及任务干扰等异质梯度特征，阻碍了有效的多任务优化。
AI.method: G2DA首先通过梯度引导的跨模态解耦将任务划分为视觉中心组和语言中心组；然后基于任务梯度相似性构建模态特定的课程学习；最后采用双向复演（bidirectional rehearsal）缓解顺序优化带来的近因效应。
AI.result: 在三个Geo-VLM基准上，使用六种InternVL3与Qwen3.5-VL变体以及GeoChat、GeoLLaVA进行评测。在全部24个基准-模型组合中，G2DA一致优于代表性基线，分别在UrBench-MCQ、XLRS-Bench-Lite和VRS-Bench-VQA上比最强竞争者提升3.08、4.30和2.81个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了梯度引导的任务组织对Geo-VLM适应具有有效性，为多任务Geo-VLM学习提供了更优的优化框架。

title: HOI-Retarget: Contact-Centric Retargeting for Human-Object Interaction
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to ICRA. Website: http://shinben0327.github.io/hoi-retarget
summary: Learning from demonstration (LfD) has enabled humanoid robots to acquire diverse whole-body skills, but extending this paradigm to human-object interaction (HOI) is limited by the availability of robot-compatible interaction references. We present HOI-Retarget, a contact-centric retargeting method that transfers HOI onto a humanoid robot for large-scale motion-data generation. Its windowed trajectory optimization uses every labeled contact as a target in the object frame, balancing body tracking, foot support and smoothness under the robot's kinematic limits. The method can augment a single demonstration across object sizes, absorb contacts reconstructed from monocular video, and extend to several robots manipulating one object. We publicly release the code and the retargeted motion dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出 HOI-Retarget，一种以接触为中心的重定向方法，将人-物交互（HOI）迁移到人形机器人，用于大规模运动数据生成。
AI.motivation: 从示范学习（LfD）已让人形机器人掌握多样全身技能，但扩展到人-物交互受限于缺少机器人可用的交互参考数据。
AI.method: 采用基于滑窗的轨迹优化，将每个标注接触作为物体坐标系下的目标，在机器人运动学约束下平衡身体跟踪、足部支撑与平滑性。
AI.result: 可将单次示范泛化到不同物体尺寸，吸收单目视频重建的接触信息，并扩展到多机器人协同操作同一物体；同时公开代码与重定向运动数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为 HOI 数据的大规模生成提供了可行路径，并推动了人形机器人交互技能的学习与应用。

title: AnesTRACE: Benchmarking Intraoperative Anesthesia from Multimodal Perception to Multi-step Decision-Making
summary: Intraoperative anesthesia requires systems to interpret evolving multimodal evidence, recommend timely management, and revise decisions as patient states change, yet existing benchmarks usually isolate perception or single-point reasoning. We introduce AnesTRACE, an evaluation suite comprising AnesTRACE-Bench and AnesTRACE-Eval. Built from public perioperative datasets with anesthesiologist annotation, AnesTRACE-Bench evaluates Intraoperative Perception, Single-point Anesthesia Decision-Making, and Multi-step Anesthesia Decision-Making. AnesTRACE-Eval assesses open-ended responses through anesthesiologist-defined criteria for Clinical Correctness, Evidence Grounding, Task Completeness, and Safety, with Temporal Consistency for multi-step decisions; its domain-specific evaluator is trained by supervised fine-tuning and preference alignment on expert-reviewed judgments. Across more than 30 models, fine-grained visual grounding and intervention selection remain difficult: the leading model reaches only 32.2 mIoU for TEE visual grounding and retains a 17.5\% Major/Critical Safety Error Rate in multi-step management. Evaluator alignment with anesthesiologists improves across both training stages, while the best decision quality is accompanied by a 74.3-second P95 Latency. These results show that aggregate performance alone does not establish safe, timely longitudinal decision-making. We release our code at https://github.com/zjuDBxAI/AnesTRACE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AnesTRACE 评测套件，用于系统评估术中麻醉的感知与多步决策能力。
AI.motivation: 术中麻醉需要系统解读多模态证据、及时推荐管理方案并随患者状态变化修正决策，但现有基准通常只孤立评估感知或单点推理，缺乏对纵向决策的完整评测。
AI.method: 构建 AnesTRACE，包含 AnesTRACE-Bench 和 AnesTRACE-Eval。前者基于公开围术期数据与麻醉医生标注，评估术中感知、单点麻醉决策和多步麻醉决策；后者按麻醉医生定义的临床正确性、证据支撑、任务完整性和安全性标准评估开放式回答，并对多步决策加入时间一致性；其领域评估器通过监督微调和偏好对齐在专家审核判断上训练。
AI.result: 在 30 多个模型上评测发现，细粒度视觉定位和干预选择仍很困难：最佳模型 TEE 视觉定位仅 32.2 mIoU，多步管理中仍有 17.5% 重大/危重安全错误率；评估器与麻醉医生的对齐在两阶段训练中均有提升，而最佳决策质量伴随 74.3 秒的 P95 延迟。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭总体性能无法证明系统具备安全、及时的纵向决策能力。代码已开源。

title: Natural State-Prediction Accuracy can Hide Weak Controlled Responsiveness in VLA Readouts
summary: Accurately decoding object states from the internal representations of vision-language-action (VLA) models does not establish that the predictions respond faithfully to changes in the target physical state. In natural observations, object state, robot configuration, occlusion, and task progress vary together, allowing contextual cues to contribute to prediction. In this paper, we introduce an evaluation framework that separates prediction accuracy, target-state responsiveness, and context stability using physically validated observations that cross target coordinates with robot contexts. We demonstrate that high natural-trajectory accuracy can coexist with weak controlled target-state responsiveness in fixed representation-readout pairs. Comparisons and interventions involving representations, readouts, and training data show that the three properties provide distinct diagnostic information. Furthermore, adding responsiveness and context sensitivity to a failure predictor based on initial state error and physical variables reduces policy-failure prediction error on new initializations relative to the specified baseline while same-observation controlled MAE is also informative. These findings motivate evaluating target-state responsiveness and context stability alongside natural prediction accuracy, and examining their relationship to actual policy behavior and task outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个评估框架，将VLA模型内部表征的预测准确性、目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性三者分离，发现高自然轨迹准确率可能伴随较弱的受控目标状态响应性。
AI.motivation: 仅凭从VLA模型内部表征中准确解码物体状态，并不能证明预测对目标物理状态的变化具有真实响应性，因为自然观测中物体状态、机器人构型、遮挡与任务进度会共同变化，使上下文线索参与预测。
AI.method: 提出评估框架，使用经物理验证的观测数据，将目标坐标与机器人上下文进行交叉组合，从而分离预测准确性、目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性三个属性；并进行涉及表征、读出器与训练数据的对比与干预实验。
AI.result: 在固定的表征-读出器配对下，高自然轨迹准确率可与较弱的受控目标状态响应性共存；三个属性提供了不同的诊断信息；在基于初始状态误差与物理变量的失败预测器中加入响应性与上下文敏感性，可在新初始化上降低策略失败预测误差，同时同观测受控MAE也具有信息量。
AI.conclusion: 应 alongside 自然预测准确率一同评估目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性，并考察它们与实际策略行为和任务结果之间的关系。

title: LoCoVSR: Local Context Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Video Super-Resolution
summary: Video super-resolution (VSR) is an ill-posed inverse problem that aims to reconstruct a high-resolution (HR) video from a noisy, low-resolution (LR) version of it. We present LoCoVSR, a diffusion-based VSR framework that leverages pixel-space denoising diffusion probabilistic models. LoCoVSR integrates the Diffusion Posterior Sampling technique with spatio-temporal context learning, operating in a moving-average form. A localized window of adjacent LR frames is used for recovering each center frame, while applying a shared noise trajectory across all frames. The localized windowing enables processing of long videos without length limitations, supports parallel inference, and prevents error accumulation that may occur in recursive processing. Unlike prior methods, LoCoVSR offers a simple yet very effective VSR solution, avoiding explicit optical flow estimation, or information loss caused by latent space processing. Trained on the VFHQ face dataset, LoCoVSR achieves accurate, temporally consistent and high-quality upscaling with competitive results against recent diffusion-based VSR approaches.

AI.tldr: LoCoVSR是一个基于像素空间扩散模型的视频超分辨率框架，结合扩散后验采样与时空上下文学习，采用局部窗口和移动平均策略，无需光流估计或潜空间处理即可实现高质量长视频超分。
AI.motivation: 视频超分是病态逆问题。现有扩散类方法存在缺陷：递归处理易导致误差累积，显式光流估计增加复杂度，潜空间处理会带来信息损失，且长视频受长度限制。因此需要一个简单有效、避免上述问题的VSR方案。
AI.method: 提出LoCoVSR，采用像素空间去噪扩散概率模型，融合扩散后验采样与时空上下文学习，以移动平均形式运行。对每个中心帧使用相邻LR帧的局部窗口进行恢复，并在所有帧间共享噪声轨迹。局部窗口设计支持长视频处理、并行推理，避免递归误差累积。无需显式光流估计，也避免潜空间信息损失。
AI.result: 在VFHQ人脸数据集上训练，LoCoVSR实现了准确、时间一致且高质量的超分效果，与近期基于扩散的VSR方法相比具有竞争力的表现。
AI.conclusion: LoCoVSR提供了一种简单而高效的扩散式视频超分方案，通过局部窗口与共享噪声轨迹规避了光流估计、潜空间信息损失和误差累积等问题，兼顾长视频处理与并行推理能力。

title: Sufficiency of Zeroth-Order Reward Shaping for Policy Gradient in Stabilization Control
summary: Reward shaping is fundamental to modern robotic control with deep reinforcement learning (RL), yet practitioners still rely heavily on heuristic principles borrowed from classical optimal control and trajectory optimization. Existing methods rarely distinguish reward terms that are intrinsic to the control objective from numerical regularizers, leading to brittle hyperparameter tuning. To determine which quantities a reward must contain, we study the stabilization control problem with a focus on zeroth-order (configuration) and first-order (velocity) information. We theoretically and empirically demonstrate that policy gradient methods can successfully solve stabilization tasks without first-order reward terms, adding such terms can instead introduce severe sensitivity as their scale grows. Conversely, our findings confirm that reward functions must be zeroth-order complete over goal-relevant coordinates, while the first-order state remains necessary in the policy observation under our low-dissipation assumptions. Overall, these results provide actionable and principled guidance for reward design in robotic RL.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器人强化学习中的奖励塑形问题，区分了控制目标内在的奖励项与数值正则项。理论与实验表明：稳定性控制任务无需一阶（速度）奖励项，加入反而会带来敏感性；但奖励函数必须在零阶（构型）目标坐标上完备，一阶状态仍需保留在策略观测中，为奖励设计提供了原则性指导。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人深度强化学习的奖励塑形多依赖从经典最优控制与轨迹优化借来的启发式原则，且往往不区分控制目标内在的奖励项与数值正则项，导致超参数调优脆弱、缺乏原则性依据。作者希望明确奖励函数究竟必须包含哪些量。
AI.method: 以稳定性控制问题为研究对象，聚焦零阶（构型）与一阶（速度）信息。通过理论分析与实证实验，检验策略梯度方法在缺少一阶奖励项时能否求解稳定性任务，并考察一阶奖励项尺度变化带来的敏感性，同时验证零阶坐标完备性与一阶状态在策略观测中的必要性（基于低耗散假设）。
AI.result: 理论证明与实验结果显示：策略梯度方法在没有一阶奖励项时也能成功求解稳定性任务；随着一阶奖励项尺度增大，会引入严重的敏感性。同时发现奖励函数必须在目标相关坐标上满足零阶完备性，而一阶状态在低耗散假设下仍需保留在策略观测中。
AI.conclusion: 研究为机器人强化学习中的奖励设计提供了可操作且具原则性的指导：奖励应关注零阶（构型）目标坐标的完备性，避免不必要的一阶奖励项，同时将一阶状态保留于策略观测，从而减少脆弱的超参数调优。

title: From Feed-Forward to Flow: Unifying Reconstruction and Generation Is Easier Than You Think
comment: 34 pages, including supplementary material. Haoru Wang and Qianfan Shen contributed equally
summary: Reconstruct where the images provide evidence, and generate where they do not: recent success of spatial world models such as Atlas (World Labs Team, 2026) highlights the value of unifying reconstruction and generation in one model. Yet the two have long lived in separate paradigms with distinctive failure modes: feed-forward reconstruction averages ambiguity into blur, while conditional generation invents plausible but scene-inconsistent detail. In this work, we present a unified flow-based formulation for reconstruction and generation, where a shared clean-target predictor performs direct reconstruction at its single-step endpoint and unfolds conditional generation through multi-step flow. A controlled toy study reveals the mechanism: with a single step, the predictor collapses to the conditional mean just like feed-forward methods, favoring consistency over diversity. With multi-step inference, the fidelity of generated details grows with context richness: closer observations reduce ambiguity and yield better-matched details. We further instantiate the formulation in appearance and geometry 3D tasks. JiT-LVSM improves perceptual and distributional quality in novel view synthesis, while JUSt3R retains competitive single-step geometry prediction with additional multi-step inference capabilities that reduces veil and flying-pixel artifacts, producing cleaner surface structure with greater test-time compute. Together, they show that reconstruction and generation can share both a formulation and a backbone, with their behavior governed by denoising configuration---making unification surprisingly simple.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统一的基于流的重建与生成框架，共享一个"干净目标预测器"，单步推理即直接重建，多步推理即条件生成，并在外观与几何3D任务中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 重建与生成长期分属两个范式，各有失败模式：前馈重建把歧义平均成模糊，条件生成则会产生看似合理但与场景不一致的细节。受Atlas等空间世界模型启发，作者希望在一个模型中统一二者。
AI.method: 提出统一的流（flow）式建模：共享的干净目标预测器在单步端点处做直接重建，通过多步流过程实现条件生成。并通过受控的toy实验揭示机制。将该框架实例化到外观和几何两类3D任务中，分别得到JiT-LVSM和JUSt3R。
AI.result: 受控toy实验表明：单步时预测器退化为条件均值，偏向一致性而非多样性；多步推理时，生成细节的保真度随上下文丰富度提升，观测越接近则歧义越少、细节匹配越好。JiT-LVSM提升了新视角合成的感知和分布质量；JUSt3R保持有竞争力的单步几何预测，并具备多步推理能力，可减少面纱（veil）和飞像素伪影，在更多测试时计算下产生更干净的表层结构。
AI.conclusion: 重建与生成可以共享同一套公式和骨干网络，其行为由去噪配置决定，使二者统一出奇地简单。

title: MarsLab: A Martian Rover Simulator for Planetary Rover Autonomous Navigation
comment: 8 pages, 11 figures. Accepted for publication at the 2026 International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo)
summary: Future Mars missions will require rover autonomy that can operate across unstructured terrain, changing illumination, atmospheric dust, and limited communication. Simulation is a practical way to study these conditions before deployment, but existing Mars-relevant resources differ in scope, including mission-oriented simulators, fixed analog datasets, task-specific environments, and open robotics interfaces. In this context, we present MarsLab, an open-source, ROS2-native Mars rover simulator for autonomy and navigation algorithm development. MarsLab combines HiRISE-derived and procedural terrain with customizable rock, crater, solar-illumination, and atmospheric-dust settings, and runs a Perseverance-class rover model in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. The runtime publishes RGB, depth, RGB-D point clouds, LiDAR, IMU, wheel odometry, and Ground Truth (GT) pose data through standard ROS2 topics. We demonstrate MarsLab with Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) benchmarks across sensing modalities, dust levels, scene geometry, and route length, and with Visual Place Recognition (VPR) benchmarks over repeated Mars Base traversals under illumination and dust changes. The results illustrate how controlled scene variation and shared GT trajectories can be used to compare trajectory-level estimation and image-level place recognition within the same simulator. Our Project Page: https://kimhoyun-robotair.github.io/MarsLab/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开源、ROS2原生的火星车仿真器MarsLab，结合HiRISE衍生与程序化地形，在Isaac Sim中运行Perseverance级火星车，并通过ROS2发布多种传感器与真值数据，用于SLAM与VPR基准测试。
AI.motivation: 未来火星任务需要能在非结构化地形、变化光照、大气尘埃和有限通信条件下运行的巡视器自主能力；仿真是在部署前研究这些条件的实用手段，但现有火星相关资源在覆盖范围上各不相同，包括任务导向仿真器、固定类比数据集、任务特定环境和开放机器人接口，缺乏统一平台。
AI.method: MarsLab将HiRISE衍生地形与程序化地形相结合，提供可定制的岩石、陨石坑、太阳光照和大气尘埃设置，并在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中运行Perseverance级火星车模型；运行时通过标准ROS2话题发布RGB、深度、RGB-D点云、LiDAR、IMU、轮式里程计和真值位姿数据。
AI.result: 作者用MarsLab进行了SLAM基准测试，覆盖多种传感模态、尘埃水平、场景几何和路径长度；并在火星基地重复遍历中，针对光照和尘埃变化进行了VPR基准测试。结果展示了受控场景变化与共享真值轨迹如何用于在同一仿真器中比较轨迹级估计与图像级位置识别。
AI.conclusion: MarsLab作为一个开源、ROS2原生的火星车仿真平台，能够为自主与导航算法开发提供统一、可控的测试环境，支持SLAM与VPR等任务的基准评估。项目页面：https://kimhoyun-robotair.github.io/MarsLab/。

title: OmniMoE-VL: A Sparse Vision-Language Model with Coupled Visual-Depth Routing
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly use sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) to scale language-side computation, yet visual information is typically routed only after passing through a fixed cross-modal interface. This leaves an important decision unresolved: which intermediate visual representations should be exposed to language computation for a given question? We introduce OmniMoE-VL, a sparse VLM with a coupled visual-depth routed projector. For each image-prompt pair, the projector selects a sparse set of intermediate visual depths and reuses the resulting global preference to guide both local patch fusion and dynamic visual injection into the language model. This design enables question-dependent visual access while preserving the native visual-token sequence, and complements token-level expert routing in the vision and language stacks. Across eight image-based benchmarks, OmniMoE-VL achieves an average score of 85.9 with 28B total and 9B activated parameters. Controlled comparisons show that the routed visual interface provides the dominant architectural gain, while matched route and component controls, same-image route analysis, and route interventions further support the value of coupling and question-conditioned visual access.

AI.tldr: OmniMoE-VL 是一个稀疏视觉语言模型，通过耦合的视觉深度路由投影器，让视觉接口的选择依赖于具体问题，从而在八个图像基准上取得 85.9 的平均分。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 在使用稀疏 MoE 扩展语言侧计算时，视觉信息通常在经过固定的跨模态接口后才被路由，导致一个关键问题未解决：针对特定问题，哪些中间视觉表示应当暴露给语言计算。
AI.method: 提出 OmniMoE-VL，采用耦合的视觉深度路由投影器。对每个图像-提示对，投影器稀疏地选择一组中间视觉深度，并复用由此得到的全局偏好来同时指导局部 patch 融合与向语言模型的动态视觉注入，从而在保留原生视觉 token 序列的同时实现问题相关的视觉访问，并与视觉、语言栈中的 token 级专家路由互补。
AI.result: 在八个图像基准上，OmniMoE-VL 以 28B 总参数、9B 激活参数取得 85.9 的平均分。受控对比显示路由式视觉接口是主要的架构增益来源，匹配的路由与组件控制实验、同图像路由分析以及路由干预进一步支持耦合与问题条件化视觉访问的价值。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视觉深度的选择与问题条件耦合，并复用全局偏好指导局部融合与动态注入，可在稀疏 MoE 框架下有效提升 VLM 性能，且所提出的路由式视觉接口是关键的架构贡献。

title: SOR-Nav: Search or Relocate? Context-Gated Exploration and Cross-Region Relocation for Object Navigation
summary: Object navigation requires an embodied agent to find an object in an unseen environment under partial observability and a limited motion budget. Existing methods primarily optimize where the robot should go next by ranking candidate destinations. In contrast to these methods, we present SOR-Nav, a hierarchical navigation system that explicitly arbitrates between continuing to explore the current context and abandoning it for a more promising reachable region. First, an autonomous semantic exploration system is built that accumulates persistent 3D object clusters and organizes reachable frontiers into a cluster decision graph to provide an efficient search abstraction. Then, SOR-Nav uses a context-gated LLM-driven object-search supervisor to evaluate the suitability of the current search context and decide whether to continue exploration or perform cross-region relocation to another reachable frontier cluster. Across the complete, unfiltered validation sets of HM3D-v1, HM3D-v2, and MP3D, SOR-Nav achieves the strongest reported Success Rate (SR) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) on all three benchmarks. On MP3D in particular, it more than doubles the previous best SPL from 18.1\% to 38.5\% while increasing SR from 50.7\% to 61.8\%. Nested HM3D-v2 ablations validate the proposed decision structure, while a continuous three-target physical deployment demonstrates persistent ObjectNav operation in real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出分层导航系统SOR-Nav，通过显式仲裁"继续探索当前上下文"还是"迁移到更优可达区域"来提升物体导航性能。
AI.motivation: 现有物体导航方法主要通过对候选目的地排序来决定下一步去哪，缺少对"当前搜索上下文是否值得继续"的显式判断，容易在低潜力区域浪费有限运动预算。
AI.method: 构建自主语义探索系统，累积持久3D物体簇并将可达前沿组织为簇决策图以提供高效搜索抽象；再用上下文门控的LLM驱动物体搜索监督器评估当前搜索上下文适宜性，决定继续探索或跨区域迁移到其他可达前沿簇。
AI.result: 在HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2、MP3D完整未过滤验证集上均取得最强SR和SPL。MP3D上SPL从18.1%提升至38.5%（翻倍以上），SR从50.7%提升至61.8%；嵌套HM3D-v2消融验证了决策结构有效性，三目标连续物理部署验证了真实场景中的持续运行。
AI.conclusion: 显式仲裁"继续探索vs跨区域迁移"的分层决策结构有效，SOR-Nav在多个基准上达到最优性能并具备真实部署能力。

title: CT-OPD: Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Vision-Language Models
summary: Diffusion vision-language models generate answers by gradually resolving masked tokens, making accurate conditional prediction in partially resolved states central to post-training. Masking completed answers yields coherent contexts and targets, but prescribed masks do not reflect the model's reveal decisions. Its trajectories capture these decisions, yet their provisional visible tokens can conflict with the target response. Outcome-based reinforcement learning follows these trajectories but provides only response-level feedback, which loses contrast when sampled rewards tie. To align coherent token-level supervision with the model's reveal decisions, we introduce Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation (CT-OPD), which combines completed teacher responses with trajectory masks from the current student. CT-OPD retokenizes each teacher response in the student's vocabulary and extracts unresolved-position masks at successive stages of the student's reverse process. For each mask, it discards provisional rollout values and reconstructs the partial state from the teacher endpoint, so the supervised positions follow the current trajectory while the visible context and targets remain consistent with the same response. The student is trained on these reconstructed states with its native categorical loss, and trajectories are refreshed as the model evolves. Across dense and sparse diffusion architectures, CT-OPD consistently enhances multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities, with gains of up to 9.80 points on the nine-benchmark average. On the unified understanding-and-generation architecture, it also improves both visual understanding and image generation, showing that the same principle transfers across architectures and modalities. Ablations further attribute these gains to coherent reconstruction and current-model trajectory masks.

AI.tldr: 提出 CT-OPD 方法，用完整教师回答配合学生当前轨迹掩码，在扩散视觉语言模型的部分解掩状态上做 token 级对齐，显著提升多模态理解与推理，并改善图像生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散视觉语言模型通过逐步解掩 token 生成答案，因此"部分解掩状态下的条件预测"是后训练的关键。现有做法存在问题：固定掩码（直接掩掉完整答案）虽上下文与目标一致，却不符合模型自身的揭示决策；而基于结果的强化学习虽遵循轨迹，却只给回答级反馈，采样奖励相同（tie）时缺乏对比信号。因此需要一种既能对齐一致 token 级监督、又能贴合模型揭示决策的方法。
AI.method: 提出 Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation (CT-OPD)：将完整教师回答与当前学生轨迹掩码结合。对每条教师回答按学生词表重新分词，并在学生反向过程的各阶段提取未解掩位置掩码；对每个掩码，丢弃临时 rollout 值，改由教师终点重建部分状态，使监督位置跟随当前轨迹，同时可见上下文与目标保持与同一回答一致。学生用原生类别损失在这些重建状态上训练，并随模型演化刷新轨迹。
AI.result: 在密集与稀疏扩散架构上，CT-OPD 一致提升多模态理解与推理能力，在九项基准平均上最高提升 9.80 分；在统一理解-生成架构上，同时改善视觉理解与图像生成，说明该原理可跨架构、跨模态迁移。消融实验进一步将收益归因于一致性重建与当前模型轨迹掩码。
AI.conclusion: CT-OPD 通过"教师回答 + 学生当前轨迹掩码 + 教师终点重建"的方式，实现了与模型揭示决策对齐的 token 级监督，在多种扩散架构与模态上均带来稳定收益，为扩散视觉语言模型的后训练提供了通用且有效的范式。

title: ExcavaTwin: Training-Free Geometry-Guided Semantic Elevation Mapping for Autonomous Excavation
summary: Autonomous excavation requires a spatial representation that jointly captures terrain geometry and task-relevant semantics. Existing excavation mapping is largely elevation-centric, while generic semantic models remain unstable in unstructured outdoor scenes. We present ExcavaTwin, a pure-vision geometry-guided semantic elevation mapping framework without excavation-specific training. Given multi-view RGB images, the framework: 1) reconstructs scene geometry and semantic observations using frozen vision models; 2) derives terrain and non-terrain geometric support; 3) performs geometry-constrained multi-view semantic fusion to suppress implausible predictions and recover incomplete observations; and 4) projects the fused state into a task-oriented semantic elevation map. Experiments on public datasets and real excavation scenes demonstrate reliable geometric and semantic perception. In real excavation, the system achieved an average update interval of approximately 1.4 s and a mean elevation error of 12.74cm in dynamically modified regions. Larger errors mainly occur during rapid terrain changes and transient visual disturbances caused by machine motion.

AI.tldr: ExcavaTwin是一个纯视觉、几何引导的语义高程建图框架，无需挖掘专用训练，即可联合建模地形几何与任务相关语义。
AI.motivation: 自主挖掘需要同时捕捉地形几何与任务相关语义的空间表示。现有挖掘建图多以高程为中心，而通用语义模型在非结构化室外场景中不稳定，因此需要一种不依赖挖掘专用训练、又能保持稳定语义的建图方法。
AI.method: 给定多视角RGB图像，框架分四步：1）用冻结的视觉模型重建场景几何与语义观测；2）推导地形与非地形的几何支撑；3）进行几何约束的多视角语义融合，抑制不合理预测并恢复缺失观测；4）将融合状态投影为面向任务的语义高程图。
AI.result: 在公开数据集与真实挖掘场景中验证了可靠的几何与语义感知。真实挖掘中平均更新间隔约1.4秒，在动态变化区域的平均高程误差为12.74厘米。较大误差主要出现在地形快速变化及机器运动引起的瞬态视觉扰动时。
AI.conclusion: ExcavaTwin证明了无需挖掘专用训练的纯视觉几何引导语义高程建图在真实挖掘场景中可行，能提供可靠的几何与语义感知，但快速地形变化与视觉扰动仍是主要误差来源。

title: Hierarchical Frequency-Domain Compression of Implicit Geometric Representations for Large-Scale Point Clouds
summary: Large-scale point cloud representations of complex geome tries incur prohibitive computational and memory costs, necessitating compressed implicit representations. To ad dress this, we propose a unified framework comprising im plicit geometric field representation, hierarchical frequency domain compression, and conditional high-frequency predic tion. Specifically, an unordered point cloud is mapped to an implicit field defined within its physical bounding box. A smooth Fourier pyramid is then constructed, where com pact low-frequency components capture the global geometry. Inter-scale high-frequency residuals are encoded to preserve the spatial information required for reconstructing fine geo metric details. To restore the high-frequency information lost during compression, we develop a hierarchical 3D neural net work. The reconstructed implicit field is converted back into a point cloud through isosurface extraction. Experiments on a complex-boundary point cloud with more than eight mil lion points demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a higher compression ratio than existing point cloud compres sion methods while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 提出一个统一框架，通过隐式几何场表示、层级频域压缩与条件高频预测，实现大规模复杂几何点云的高压缩比表示与重建。
AI.motivation: 大规模点云表示复杂几何时计算与内存开销过大，因此需要压缩的隐式表示方法来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 将无序点云映射到其物理包围盒内定义的隐式场；构建平滑傅里叶金字塔，用紧凑低频分量捕捉全局几何；编码跨尺度高频残差以保留重建细节所需空间信息；采用层级三维神经网络恢复压缩中丢失的高频信息；最后通过等值面提取将重建隐式场转回点云。
AI.result: 在超过八百万点的复杂边界点云上实验表明，该方法在保持可比重建质量的同时，取得了高于现有方法的压缩比。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效压缩大规模复杂几何点云，在压缩比与重建质量之间取得良好平衡。

title: DexWeave: Learning Dexterous Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Demonstrations
summary: Learning dexterous humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations requires transferring not only human motion, but also the coordinated interaction structure underlying the demonstrated behavior. This is challenging because embodiment differences distort the coupling among body motion, wrist placement, finger articulation, and object interaction, while kinematically accurate references may still be difficult to realize under robot dynamics. We present DexWeave, a unified framework that connects interaction-consistent motion retargeting with anatomy-aware whole-body policy learning. DexWeave first employs a two-stage retargeting procedure that initializes body and hand motions with specialized solvers and subsequently performs coupled refinement over the upper-body interaction chain while preserving lower-body support. The resulting references are tracked by an anatomy-aware Transformer policy that represents anatomical regions as structured tokens and uses directed masked attention to model their dependencies, with object information selectively conditioning the upper-body pathway for dexterous interaction. The policy jointly outputs body and dexterous-hand actions and is trained directly with reinforcement learning, without pretrained tracking policies, teacher-student distillation, or subsequent residual refinement. DexWeave improves retargeting fidelity and interaction consistency while achieving higher manipulation performance and faster policy convergence than MLP baselines. We further deploy the learned policies on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid equipped with Inspire dexterous hands, demonstrating dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation in the real world. See our project page (https://dexweave.github.io) for videos.

AI.tldr: 提出 DexWeave 统一框架，将交互一致的运动重定向与解剖感知的全身策略学习结合，实现人形机器人的灵巧全身移动操作。
AI.motivation: 从人类演示学习灵巧人形移动操作，不仅要迁移动作，还要迁移协调的交互结构。具身差异会破坏身体运动、手腕位置、手指关节与物体交互之间的耦合，而运动学上准确的参考在机器人动力学下也难以实现。
AI.method: 1) 两阶段重定向：先用专用求解器初始化身体与手部运动，再在上肢交互链上做耦合细化并保留下肢支撑；2) 解剖感知 Transformer 策略：将解剖区域表示为结构化 token，使用有向掩码注意力建模依赖，物体信息选择性地调节上肢通路，策略联合输出身体与灵巧手动作，直接用强化学习训练。
AI.result: 提升了重定向保真度与交互一致性，相比 MLP 基线取得更高操作性能和更快策略收敛；在配备 Inspire 灵巧手的 Unitree G1 实体人形上部署，实现真实世界灵巧全身移动操作。
AI.conclusion: DexWeave 将交互一致重定向与解剖感知策略学习统一起来，无需预训练跟踪策略、师生蒸馏或残差微调，即可在真实人形上实现灵巧全身移动操作。

title: Latent Space Is Not Flat: Rethinking Latent Structure for 3D Medical Image Synthesis
summary: Latent generative models make 3D medical image synthesis computationally practical by generating in a compressed space. However, we show that the common flat Euclidean assumption induced by $\ell_2$ objectives is imprecise: latent-space geometry is so strongly anisotropic that equal-magnitude errors can produce drastically different decoded distortions. We further find that this anisotropy has a clear feature: sensitive variation concentrates in a low-rank subspace. The dominant low-rank components capture the overall structure, encoding long-range, spatially coordinated variation while remaining resistant to local noise. Its orthogonal residual, in contrast, mainly captures local and image-specific variation. Motivated by this asymmetry, we introduce Latent Structure Flow (LSF). At each block, LSF decomposes the latent state into structure and residual, models structural changes with global context, and predicts residual variation locally while preserving a direct path for the input structure. LSF changes only the generator, leaving the frozen codec and pointwise training objective unchanged. Across cross-modality synthesis and tumor inpainting tasks, LSF outperforms all compared baselines on both global and tumor-specific metrics, demonstrating the benefit of explicitly modeling latent-space structure for 3D medical image synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示潜空间几何的强各向异性且敏感变化集中于低秩子空间，提出Latent Structure Flow (LSF)，在保持冻结编解码器和逐点目标不变的前提下显式建模潜空间结构，在跨模态合成与肿瘤修补任务上全面超越基线。
AI.motivation: 潜生成模型通过在压缩空间生成使3D医学图像合成可行，但常用ℓ2目标隐含的平坦欧氏假设不准确：潜空间几何高度各向异性，等幅误差会产生差异巨大的解码失真。作者进一步发现这种各向异性有明确特征——敏感变化集中于低秩子空间，需要被显式建模。
AI.method: 提出Latent Structure Flow (LSF)。在每个block将潜状态分解为结构与残差：用全局上下文建模结构变化，局部预测残差变化，同时为输入结构保留直接通路。LSF只改变生成器，冻结的编解码器和逐点训练目标保持不变。
AI.result: 在跨模态合成和肿瘤修补任务中，LSF在全局指标和肿瘤特定指标上均优于所有对比基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模潜空间结构对3D医学图像合成有明确收益，验证了结构-残差分解的有效性。

title: Action Sequence Transfer via LLMs for Heterogeneous Environments
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, Accepted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026)
summary: We present an action sequence transfer system that adaptively transfers user action sequences across different target spaces.
