Given an input action sequence from a source space and scene graph representations of both the source and target environments, our system predicts a corresponding action sequence in the target space by adapting to the spatial and object constraints of the new environment. To achieve this, we leverage multi-level representations of user activity to generalize actions at varying levels of abstraction. To demonstrate our system, we collect a new scene graph-based dataset derived from the Ego4D GoalStep dataset for evaluation. Results indicate that our system can generate valid action sequences even between spaces with drastically different object configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种动作序列迁移系统，利用多层级用户活动表征，将源空间的动作序列自适应迁移到目标空间，并在基于Ego4D GoalStep构建的场景图数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 用户动作序列通常与特定空间和物体配置绑定，难以直接应用于新环境。作者希望实现跨不同目标空间的动作序列自动迁移，使动作能够适应新环境的空间与物体约束。
AI.method: 输入源空间的动作序列以及源、目标环境的场景图表示，通过对用户活动进行多层级建模，将动作在不同抽象层级上泛化，从而预测目标空间中对应的动作序列以适配新的空间和物体约束。
AI.result: 作者基于Ego4D GoalStep数据集构建了新的场景图数据集用于评测，实验表明系统即使在物体配置差异极大的空间之间也能生成有效的动作序列。
AI.conclusion: 多层级动作表征有助于实现跨空间的动作序列迁移，系统具备在物体配置差异显著的场景间生成有效动作序列的能力。

title: Progressive Risk Estimation for Accident Anticipation
summary: Accident anticipation aims to recognize anomalous driving cues before a crash while avoiding false alarms during normal driving. Existing approaches typically formulate this task as binary classification, focusing on whether an accident will occur rather than when it will occur. We propose PRE-ACT, a framework that models accident risk as a continuously evolving signal that increases as the crash approaches. By explicitly enforcing temporal ordering and distance-to-accident awareness, our method progressively raises risk while suppressing premature alarms, leading to significant improvements on MM-AU subsets and Nexar. We further introduce a Separation Score to evaluate the global behavior of predicted risk curves beyond local temporal windows. Code and visualizations are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/PRE-ACT.

AI.tldr: PRE-ACT将事故预判建模为随时间演化的连续风险信号，通过强制时序排序和距事故远近感知来提前预警并抑制误报，在MM-AU和Nexar上取得显著提升，并提出分离度指标评估风险曲线的全局行为。
AI.motivation: 现有事故预判方法多将其视为二分类问题，只关注"是否会发生事故"，而忽略了"何时会发生"，导致预警时机不准且易产生误报。
AI.method: 提出PRE-ACT框架，将事故风险建模为随事故发生临近而逐渐升高的连续信号；显式引入时序排序约束与距事故发生距离感知，使风险随接近事故而渐进上升，同时抑制过早警报；并设计分离度评分（Separation Score）来评估风险曲线在局部时间窗之外的全局行为。
AI.result: 在MM-AU子集和Nexar数据集上均取得显著性能提升，并验证了分离度评分对风险曲线全局行为的评估有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将事故预判从二分类重新定义为连续风险信号建模，能更准确地在事故发生前发出预警并减少误报，代码与可视化结果已公开。

title: Simulation for Planetary Robotic Perception and Autonomy: A Concise Survey of Recent Capabilities and Gaps
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for publication at the 2026 International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo)
summary: Planetary robotics is an important enabler of scientific exploration in environments where direct human-in-the-loop operation is costly, hazardous, or infeasible. However, developing and validating planetary robotic systems remains difficult because representative field testing is expensive, limited, and often unrepeatable under mission-relevant conditions. In this setting, simulation serves as a central tool for perception and autonomy research, synthetic data generation, system integration, and pre-deployment evaluation. Despite its importance, the literature on planetary robotics simulation remains dispersed across different simulation engines, implementations, and application settings. This paper surveys simulation works for planetary robotic perception and autonomy across four practical axes: Openness and Availability, Scenario and Platform Coverage, Sensor and Perception Support, and Environmental and Operational Realism. The surveyed simulation works report visual or physical fidelity and support perception-oriented workflows. They also indicate uneven public availability, rover-centered coverage, partial support for specialized sensing modalities, and uneven reporting of operational constraints such as onboard computation, energy, and communication restrictions.

AI.tldr: 本文综述行星机器人感知与自主性的仿真工作，从开放性、场景平台覆盖、传感器支持、环境真实感四个维度进行梳理。
AI.motivation: 行星机器人科学探索中实地测试昂贵、受限且难以重复，仿真成为感知与自主性研究、合成数据生成、系统集成及部署前评估的核心工具。然而相关文献分散于不同仿真引擎、实现与应用场景，缺乏系统梳理。
AI.method: 对行星机器人感知与自主性的仿真工作进行综述，沿四个实用轴线组织：开放性与可获得性、场景与平台覆盖、传感器与感知支持、环境与任务运行真实感。
AI.result: 所综述的仿真工作普遍报告了视觉或物理保真度，并支持面向感知的工作流；但也显示公共可获得性不均、以巡视器为中心的覆盖、对特殊传感模态支持不完整，以及对星载计算、能量、通信等运行约束的报告不均衡。
AI.conclusion: 行星机器人仿真研究虽已支持感知与自主性工作流，但在开放性、平台多样性与运行约束建模方面仍存在明显不足，为未来仿真平台发展指明方向。

title: USAI-Quant: A Quantitative Reasoning Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Built Environments
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for urban and spatial AI. However, current state-of-the-art large VLMs still struggle with quantitative reasoning on remote sensing imagery. Existing benchmarks and algorithms are predominantly based on qualitative Visual Question Answering (VQA), providing limited insights into the quantitative reasoning capabilities of VLMs for built environment metrics. To address this gap, we develop Quantitative Urban and Spatial AI benchmark (USAI-Quant), the first benchmark designed to quantitatively evaluate VLM's reasoning capabilities on built environment metrics via remote sensing imagery. USAI-Quant is curated from the 335 largest U.S. cities, aligning high-resolution remote sensing images with quantitative built environment metrics. We then evaluate both general-purpose and remote sensing VLMs (RS-VLMs) by applying VQAs to tens of built environment metrics across three complexity levels. Our results reveal that current state-of-the-art models consistently fall short on numeric reasoning tasks. We further conduct in-depth analyses across models, question types, and geographic locations, uncovering insights into performance variability and task-specific challenges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 USAI-Quant，首个针对遥感影像中建成环境指标的定量推理基准，覆盖美国335个最大城市，评估通用与遥感VLM在三个复杂度层级的定量VQA表现，发现现有SOTA模型在数值推理任务上普遍不足。
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模视觉语言模型在遥感影像的定量推理上仍存在困难。已有基准与算法主要基于定性的视觉问答（VQA），无法充分揭示VLM在建成环境指标方面的定量推理能力，因此需要专门的定量评估基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建 USAI-Quant 基准：从美国335个最大城市中采集数据，将高分辨率遥感影像与定量建成环境指标对齐；随后对通用VLM与遥感VLM（RS-VLM）进行评测，围绕数十个建成环境指标设计三个复杂度层级的VQA任务；并进一步跨模型、问题类型和地理位置开展深入分析。
AI.result: 当前最先进的模型在数值推理任务上持续表现不佳；跨模型、问题类型与地理位置的深入分析揭示了性能差异及任务特定的挑战。
AI.conclusion: USAI-Quant 首次实现了基于遥感影像对建成环境指标的定量VLM推理评估，表明现有模型在定量推理方面仍有明显短板，为未来城市与空间AI的定量能力提升提供了评测基础与改进方向。

title: CoHuB: A Simulation Benchmark for Multi-Humanoid Collaboration
summary: Many physical tasks in human environments require collaboration, from assisting a partner to jointly manipulating an object. Yet, existing humanoid benchmarks largely focus on single-humanoid skills and lack evaluation of multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. We introduce CoHuB (Collaborative Multi-Humanoid Benchmark), a simulation benchmark for multi-humanoid collaboration under egocentric visual observations. CoHuB provides 10 tasks, eight with two humanoids and two with three humanoids, spanning diverse collaboration patterns. We also provide synchronized demonstrations collected through a multi-operator VR teleoperation pipeline, in which each operator controls one humanoid from its egocentric view. Experiments with representative visuomotor policies reveal substantial challenges across different forms of coordinated perception and control. CoHuB provides a foundation for developing and evaluating multi-humanoid collaboration policies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoHuB，一个面向多仿人机器人协作的仿真基准，支持以第一人称视角观测下的协同任务评估。
AI.motivation: 人类环境中的许多物理任务需要协作完成，但现有仿人机器人基准多聚焦单机器人技能，缺乏对多仿人机器人协作（尤其是在自我中心视觉观测下）的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建CoHuB仿真基准，包含10个任务（其中8个为双仿人、2个为三仿人），覆盖多种协作模式；并通过多操作员VR遥操作流水线采集同步示范数据，每位操作员从其对应的仿人机器人第一人称视角进行控制。
AI.result: 使用代表性视觉运动策略进行实验，结果显示在多种协调感知与控制形式上均存在显著挑战。
AI.conclusion: CoHuB为多仿人机器人协作策略的开发与评估提供了基础平台。

title: Unlocking Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein Distances for 3D Modeling
summary: \textit{Gromov-Wasserstein Distances} (GWDs) provide quantitative ways of comparing probabilistic distributions defined on different metric spaces by applying techniques from the optimal transport theory. As such, GWD can be potentially useful in a large variety of applications ranging from graph matching problems to 3D object detection. However its practical use at scale is significantly limited by cubic time complexity computations involving dense intra-space distance matrices. Even though in the Euclidean metric spaces several techniques (e.g. involving scalable kernel methods) were proposed to address it, to the best of our knowledge, analogous techniques for general geodesic distances on manifolds, or shortest-path distance on graphs in their discretized variants, were not developed. In this paper, we present \textbf{E}fficient \textbf{G}eodesic \textbf{Gro}mov-\textbf{W}asserstein methods (EGGroW), a new class of efficient algorithms designed to calculate geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein distances with entropic Sinkhorn-like approaches, leveraging recently introduced \textit{GenusSink} methods \citep{genussink} and the theory of random features. We provide important downstream applications, namely: 3D pose estimation and 3D template detection. In the latter setting, we formulate a partial 3D template recovery as a staged problem: capacity-constrained scene selection is followed by semi-relaxed recovery of template visibility and correspondence. Our empirical findings show that EGGroW provides accurate solutions when standard Euclidean-based techniques fail and is characterized by light computational footprint, as our theoretical analysis predicts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EGGroW，一类高效计算测地Gromov-Wasserstein距离的算法，结合GenusSink与随机特征，应用于3D姿态估计与模板检测。
AI.motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein距离可用于比较不同度量空间上的分布，在图匹配、3D目标检测等中潜力巨大，但其实际应用受限于涉及稠密空间内距离矩阵的立方时间复杂度。现有针对欧氏空间的加速方法（如可扩展核方法）不适用于流形上的测地距离或图的离散化最短路距离，此类技术尚未被开发。
AI.method: 提出EGGroW（Efficient Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein）方法，一类高效算法，利用熵正则化的Sinkhorn式方法计算测地Gromov-Wasserstein距离，借鉴新近提出的GenusSink方法与随机特征理论。在部分3D模板恢复场景中，将问题建模为分阶段流程：先进行容量约束的场景选择，再进行模板可见性与对应关系的半松弛恢复。
AI.result: 在3D姿态估计与3D模板检测应用中，EGGroW在标准欧氏方法失效时仍能提供准确解，且计算开销小，与理论分析预测一致。
AI.conclusion: EGGroW为一般测地距离下的Gromov-Wasserstein距离提供了高效算法，验证了其在3D相关任务中的有效性，弥补了现有技术在非欧氏度量空间加速方法上的空白。

title: AGRO-SUVIDE: Agentic Robotics for Surgical Viscoelastic Debridement
summary: Augmented dexterity has the potential to reduce the fatigue experienced by surgeons during repetitive surgical tasks. In this paper, we propose the first AGentic RObotics framework for SUrgical VIscoelastic DEbridement (AGRO-SUVIDE), the repeated removal of small fragments attached to a viscoelastic substrate. Leveraging the self-improving and coding capability of agents, AGRO-SUVIDE adopts a modular framework. Specifically, the demonstration analysis module automatically identifies recurring skills from a single expert demonstration, using both visual and kinematic information. The construction module then builds each skill, either as a procedural model-based skill the agent codes against a scaffolded library or as a model-free policy-based skill. At runtime, the monitoring module composes the skills into a loop-style graph sized to the number of fragments it observes, then verifies pre- and post-conditions of each skill to decide whether to advance or retry. We evaluate AGRO-SUVIDE through 340 physical trials on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK). AGRO-SUVIDE achieves an average single-fragment removal success rate of 85%, completing consecutive three-fragment removal at 60% and at 95% with one human intervention. It further generalizes to unseen five-fragment scenarios with an average success rate of 80% for single-fragment removal. Project page: https://surgical-robotics.github.io/AGRO-SUVIDE/

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向手术黏弹性清创（反复移除黏附于黏弹性基底的小碎块）的智能体机器人框架 AGRO-SUVIDE，在 dVRK 上经 340 次实体试验验证，单碎块移除平均成功率 85%，连续三碎块移除 60%（人工介入一次后达 95%），并可泛化到未见过的五碎块场景（单块移除平均成功率 80%）。
AI.motivation: 手术中反复的重复性操作易使外科医生疲劳，增强灵巧性有望减轻这种疲劳。黏弹性清创需要反复移除黏附在黏弹性基底上的细小碎块，任务重复且精细，亟需自主化方案。
AI.method: AGRO-SUVIDE 采用模块化智能体框架，利用智能体的自我改进与代码生成能力：演示分析模块从单次专家演示中，结合视觉与运动学信息自动识别可复用技能；构建模块将每项技能构建为基于过程模型的技能（智能体针对脚手架库编写代码）或无模型的策略式技能；运行时监测模块按观测到的碎块数量将技能组合成循环式图，并校验每个技能的前置与后置条件以决定推进或重试。
AI.result: 在 da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK) 上进行 340 次实体试验：单碎块移除平均成功率 85%；连续三碎块移除成功率 60%，在人工介入一次的情况下达到 95%；在未见过的五碎块场景中，单碎块移除平均成功率为 80%。
AI.conclusion: AGRO-SUVIDE 将智能体式机器人框架引入手术黏弹性清创任务，验证了其在重复性精细手术操作中的可行性与一定的泛化能力，为减轻外科医生疲劳提供了新思路。

title: VCRE-Fib: View-Conditioned Regional Evidence for Fine-Grained Ultrasound Grading of Schistosoma japonicum-Associated Liver Fibrosis
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, including appendices. Submitted to ICLR 2027. Code: https://github.com/StatXzy7/vcre-fib
summary: Accurate assessment of Schistosoma japonicum-associated liver fibrosis is essential for disease management and long-term follow-up in endemic regions. Ultrasound provides non-invasive imaging, but complex local echogenic patterns and anatomical structures make fine-grained grading challenging. Existing deep learning methods can predict fibrosis scores, yet directly incorporating acquisition views and regional cues into grading while retaining spatial information for inspection remains an open problem. Here we present VCRE-Fib, a view-conditioned regional evidence framework that integrates anatomical context, local information, and global image assessment for fine-grained ultrasound grading. The framework forms view-conditioned local grading evidence before spatial pooling, uses weak localization to guide its aggregation, and combines it with global predictions. Image-only inference jointly returns a fibrosis score, acquisition view, and candidate abnormal-region map. We developed and evaluated the method on a re-curated cohort of 108,709 ultrasound images from 6,373 patients across 35 centers. On a patient-disjoint test set of 4,107 images from 240 patients across four centers, VCRE-Fib reduced the prespecified composite grading risk by 7.115% relative to SFibAI trained and evaluated on the same data split. Image-level mean absolute error decreased from 0.391 to 0.378, alongside lower patient-max, patient-median, and center-balanced risks. The full model also achieved lower composite grading risk than variants that separately removed view conditioning or weak localization. These results support incorporating anatomical context and regional evidence into ultrasound grading while exposing spatial predictions for inspection alongside severity estimates.

AI.tldr: 提出VCRE-Fib，融合视角条件、局部区域证据与全局评估进行肝纤维化超声细粒度分级，在大规模多中心数据上降低分级风险。
AI.motivation: 日本血吸虫相关肝纤维化的准确评估对疾病管理与长期随访至关重要。超声虽无创，但局部回声模式与解剖结构复杂，细粒度分级困难；现有深度学习方法难以在保留空间信息以便复核的同时，融合采集视角与区域线索。
AI.method: VCRE-Fib框架在空间池化前形成视角条件的局部分级证据，利用弱定位引导其聚合，并与全局预测结合；仅图像推理即可同时输出纤维化评分、采集视角和候选异常区域图。
AI.result: 在来自35个中心、6,373名患者的108,709张超声图像上开发与评估。在4个中心240名患者4,107张图像的患者不重叠测试集上，相较同数据划分训练的SFibAI，预设复合分级风险降低7.115%；图像级MAE从0.391降至0.378，患者最大、患者中位与中心均衡风险均更低。完整模型风险低于分别移除视角条件或弱定位的变体。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将解剖上下文与区域证据纳入超声分级，并同时输出可供检查的空间预测与严重程度估计，具有可行性与优势。

title: Don't Throw Away the Tail: Action Upcycling for Policy Acceleration
summary: Modern robot policies predict a chunk of future actions from a single observation, execute only a prefix, and discard the rest before replanning. Choosing the length of this prefix, the execution horizon, poses a trade-off between reactivity and efficiency. A short horizon keeps the policy reactive to the environment, but requires frequent policy calls. Recent test-time methods adaptively select the horizon for each chunk, but they either read model internals, where the signal must be chosen for each architecture, or draw extra samples, which adds cost. We propose *Action Upcycling*, a training-free algorithm that reuses actions the policy would otherwise discard, without accessing model internals or drawing extra samples. We find that discarded actions stay close to their replanned versions as long as the action velocity remains smooth. Action Upcycling therefore extends the execution horizon up to the point where the velocity begins to fluctuate. Extensive experiments on simulated and real-world manipulation tasks show that Action Upcycling reduces policy calls by 1.2--1.7$\times$ with no loss in success rate, across multiple Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) and even a World Action Model (WAM). It applies to any chunked policy at negligible cost and is orthogonal to other policy acceleration methods such as few-step sampling and streaming action decoding, opening a new axis for policy acceleration.

AI.tldr: 提出Action Upcycling，一种免训练方法，通过复用被丢弃的动作来自适应延长执行视野，在保持成功率的同时减少策略调用次数。
AI.motivation: 现代机器人策略预测未来动作块但只执行前部，执行视野长度存在反应性与效率的权衡：短视野反应性好但需频繁调用策略。现有测试时自适应方法或需读取模型内部信号，或需额外采样，成本高且不通用。
AI.method: Action Upcycling是免训练算法，复用策略本会丢弃的动作，不访问模型内部也不额外采样。核心发现是只要动作速度保持平滑，被丢弃的动作与重新规划版本接近，因此将执行视野延长到速度开始波动为止。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实世界操作任务上，跨多种VLA模型甚至WAM，减少策略调用1.2–1.7倍且成功率无损失；成本可忽略，适用于任意分块策略。
AI.conclusion: Action Upcycling为策略加速开辟新维度，与少步采样、流式动作解码等方法正交，可组合使用。

title: Beyond Temporal Smoothing: Spatial Energy Budgets Stabilize One-Step Diffusion Editing
summary: One-step text-guided diffusion editing is efficient but prone to spatially misallocated updates that distort the edited object and alter the background. Existing methods often improve stability by averaging the editing field across timesteps. We instead identify spatial energy misallocation as a distinct and measurable failure mode: across two independent noise draws, the residual field is essentially unrepeatable, making the background field unreliable for direct transport, while its total energy still sets a usable magnitude for the draw at hand. BudEdit turns that magnitude into an explicit budget and reallocates it to edit-relevant regions selected jointly by residual energy and cross-attention, controlling where editing energy is spent rather than averaging over timesteps. The resulting training-free, inversion-free editor spends the budget on transport and reuses it to scale a correction in a lower-noise gated refinement. The budgeted injection field matches its prescribed budget exactly and vanishes on the identified background support, by construction. On PIE-Bench with SD-Turbo, BudEdit outperforms ChordEdit under each method's reported default settings on all 11 evaluated metrics, including a $2.1$\,dB gain in background PSNR, $31$\% lower DINO, and $36$\% lower LPIPS, while improving all five editing-quality metrics and reporting the lowest runtime in the comparison.

AI.tldr: 提出BudEdit，将单步文本引导扩散编辑的空间能量错配视为可测失败模式，通过预算化再分配编辑能量，实现无需训练与反演的图像编辑。
AI.motivation: 单步扩散编辑高效但易发生空间错配的更新，导致物体扭曲与背景改变。已有方法多通过跨时间步平均编辑场提升稳定性，却未针对空间能量错配这一独立失败模式。
AI.method: 识别空间能量错配：两次独立噪声采样下残差场几乎不可重复，背景场不可靠，但其总能量仍可提供当前采样的可用幅度。BudEdit将该幅度设为显式预算，依据残差能量与交叉注意力联合选择编辑相关区域进行再分配，控制编辑能量投向；无需训练与反演，预算用于传输并复用于低噪声门控精修的校正缩放。
AI.result: 在PIE-Bench与SD-Turbo上，按各方法默认设置，BudEdit在全部11项指标上优于ChordEdit，包括背景PSNR提升2.1 dB、DINO降低31%、LPIPS降低36%，同时改善全部五项编辑质量指标，并取得对比中最低运行时间。
AI.conclusion: BudEdit通过预算化的能量再分配解决单步编辑的空间错配，构造上使注入场精确匹配预算并在背景支撑上消失，兼顾编辑质量、背景保持与效率。

title: RoboFL: Federated Expert Assembly for World Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action and world-action models are increasingly popular, yet remain bottlenecked by physical interaction data that is scarce, institutionally siloed, and task-heterogeneous. A natural federated solution is to let each client adapt a shared foundation model through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, avoiding the exchange of full-model updates. However, federating these adapters is nontrivial, as naive aggregation can entangle incompatible updates, while incorporating MoE-style routing into federated aggregation may dilute specialization and destabilize expert selection. We present RoboFL, which instantiates MoSAIC (Mixture of Slotted Adapters) for federated world-action learning. MoSAIC directly installs locally trained LoRA adapters as the expert branches of a server MoE. Server-side routers learn token assignments over these prior-informed branches while jointly refining routing and expert parameters. Foresight-to-Action Routing Distillation (FARD) aligns routing across the model's three paths, while Path-Consensus Expert Aggregation (PCEA) converts complete expert updates into a compact global adapter for personalized redistribution. Experiments on RoboTwin 2.0, RLBench, and a real-world Franka robot arm show the superiority of RoboFL with structured expert assembly, as it outperforms centralized PEFT InternVLA-A1 by 12.23% on the Franka arm, while reducing per-round client communication by up to 86.81% relative to MoE-based federated VLA baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RoboFL 框架，通过 MoSAIC（槽式适配器混合）实现联邦世界-动作学习，在保护隐私、降低通信的同时有效整合异构客户端适配器。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作与世界-动作模型受限于稀缺、机构孤岛化且任务异构的物理交互数据。自然的联邦方案是客户端通过参数高效微调适配共享基础模型以避免交换全模型更新，但直接联邦化适配器存在困难：朴素聚合会纠缠不兼容的更新，而引入 MoE 式路由又可能稀释专精性并导致专家选择不稳定。
AI.method: 提出 RoboFL，实例化 MoSAIC（Mixture of Slotted Adapters）：将本地训练的 LoRA 适配器直接作为服务器 MoE 的专家分支，服务器端路由器在这些先验分支上学习 token 分配，并联合优化路由与专家参数。设计 Foresight-to-Action Routing Distillation（FARD）对齐模型三条路径的路由，以及 Path-Consensus Expert Aggregation（PCEA）将完整专家更新压缩为紧凑全局适配器以供个性化再分发。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0、RLBench 及真实 Franka 机械臂上的实验表明，RoboFL 的结构化专家组装具有优越性：在 Franka 机械臂上超越集中式 PEFT InternVLA-A1 达 12.23%，同时相对基于 MoE 的联邦 VLA 基线将每轮客户端通信降低最多 86.81%。
AI.conclusion: RoboFL 通过结构化专家组装有效解决了联邦世界-动作学习中适配器异构聚合与通信开销的难题，在多个基准和真实机器人上验证了其性能与通信效率优势。

title: SynCo: Learning Cross-Modal Synergy by Contrasting Interaction Residuals
summary: Multimodal contrastive learning is a dominant paradigm for learning transferable representations from unlabeled data, but standard objectives primarily capture information that is redundant between modalities. Partial Information Decomposition (PID) shows that task-relevant information in multimodal data decomposes into three components: redundancy shared between modalities, uniqueness specific to each modality, and synergy available only from their joint observation. Recent frameworks extend contrastive learning to capture all three components, yet synergy remains undertrained in practice. We propose SynCo (Synergy Contrastive Learning), a method that directly addresses synergy undertraining through dedicated supervision on an interaction residual. SynCo fits a linear projector to predict the fused representation from independently computed unimodal features, and the resulting interaction residual, which removes the linearly unimodal-predictable component, receives dedicated contrastive supervision at negligible computational cost. On the controlled Trifeature benchmark, SynCo achieves state-of-the-art synergy capture with a $+5.98\%$ gain over the baseline, and on real-world benchmarks from MultiBench, DARai, and MM-IMDb, SynCo consistently outperforms or matches prior methods across diverse modality combinations and task types. The method operates as a plug-in to existing contrastive multimodal frameworks without modifying the underlying fusion architecture and can further improve synergy capture when combined with other methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 SynCo 方法，通过对交互残差施加专门的对比监督，缓解多模态对比学习中协同信息训练不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 标准多模态对比学习主要捕获模态间的冗余信息。基于部分信息分解（PID），多模态任务相关信息可分为冗余、各自独有和协同三部分，现有框架虽尝试捕捉全部三类信息，但协同信息在实践中仍训练不足。
AI.method: SynCo 拟合一个线性投影器，从独立计算的单模态特征预测融合表示，得到交互残差，其去除了线性可预测的单模态成分；再对该残差施加专门的对比监督，计算开销极小，并可作为插件接入现有对比多模态框架，无需修改融合架构。
AI.result: 在受控的 Trifeature 基准上取得最优协同捕获效果，较基线提升 5.98%；在 MultiBench、DARai 和 MM-IMDb 等真实基准上，跨多种模态组合与任务类型持续优于或匹配已有方法；与其他方法结合可进一步提升协同捕获。
AI.conclusion: SynCo 通过针对交互残差的专门监督有效解决协同信息训练不足，具备即插即用、低成本的优势，并在合成与真实基准上验证了有效性。

title: NavJev: Efficient Vision-Language Navigation via Action-Centric Visual Compression and Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory
summary: Recent zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) methods increasingly rely on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to reason over visual observations, navigation instructions, and candidate actions. Although effective, repeatedly invoking autoregressive multimodal reasoning at every navigation step introduces substantial inference latency, limiting the responsiveness of embodied agents. We propose NavJev, an efficient VLN framework that reformulates online navigation from repeated multimodal generation into compact visual compression followed by lightweight typed action selection. Specifically, Action-Centric Visual Compression (ACVC) integrates waypoint geometry, BLIP captions, and RAM semantic tags into compact representations of candidate actions, while Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory (DASM) filters shared semantics and maintains discriminative action-specific evidence across navigation steps. Based on these representations, Jev directly performs structured probabilistic decisions over the available action set. Experiments on R2R-CE show that NavJev achieves 27.0% SR and 22.4% SPL with only 0.65 s per navigation step, while substantially reducing inference latency and cost compared with MLLM-based VLN methods. The project page is available at https://kai-sheng-caesar.github.io/NavJev/.

AI.tldr: NavJev 将零样本 VLN 从"每步自回归多模态生成"改为"视觉压缩 + 轻量类型化动作选择"，在 R2R-CE 上以 0.65 秒/步实现 27.0% SR 和 22.4% SPL，显著降低推理延迟与成本。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本 VLN 方法依赖 MLLM 在每一步对视觉观测、导航指令和候选动作进行自回归多模态推理，虽然有效，但反复调用带来巨大的推理延迟，限制了具身智能体的实时响应能力。
AI.method: 提出 NavJev 框架：Action-Centric Visual Compression (ACVC) 将航点几何、BLIP 描述和 RAM 语义标签整合为候选动作的紧凑表示；Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory (DASM) 过滤共享语义并跨导航步维护具有判别性的动作专属证据；基于这些表示，Jev 直接在可用动作集合上进行结构化概率决策。
AI.result: 在 R2R-CE 上达到 27.0% SR 和 22.4% SPL，每步仅需 0.65 秒，相较基于 MLLM 的 VLN 方法大幅降低推理延迟与成本。
AI.conclusion: 将在线导航从重复的多模态生成重构为紧凑视觉压缩加轻量类型化动作选择，可在保持竞争力的零样本导航性能的同时显著提升效率，为具身智能体的实时响应提供可行方案。项目页面：https://kai-sheng-caesar.github.io/NavJev/。

title: PolyTopoBench: A Benchmark for Complex Vector Polygon Generation from Remote Sensing Imagery
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track)
summary: Vector polygon generation converts visual inputs, e.g., remote sensing (RS) images, into vectorized polygonal geometries, supporting applications such as autonomous driving, vector map construction, and remote sensing. Early pipelines predict raster masks and post-process them into polygons, which prevents end-to-end optimization and may miss small objects or introduce inaccurate vertices. Recent methods directly generate vector polygons, but most focus on simple exterior contours, while they either cannot represent complex polygons with holes or fail to preserve their topology. In this paper, we propose PolyTopoBench, a unified evaluation framework for vector polygon generation from RS images with explicit emphasis on complex polygons. PolyTopoBench evaluates both exterior and interior rings, and benchmarks 11 representative methods, including segmentation-based polygonization pipelines, vision foundation model baselines, and specialized vector polygon generators, on two RS-image datasets covering buildings, roads, vegetation, and unvegetated regions. Experiments show that existing methods often recover simple exterior boundaries but degrade substantially on polygons with holes or multiple rings. These results reveal complex polygon generation as an unresolved challenge and motivate topology-aware benchmarks and model designs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/seai-lab/PolyTopoBench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PolyTopoBench，一个面向遥感图像矢量多边形生成的统一评测框架，重点关注复杂多边形（含孔洞与多环）。它同时评测外环与内环，并在两个遥感数据集上对比11种代表性方法，发现现有方法在复杂多边形上性能显著退化。
AI.motivation: 矢量多边形生成在自动驾驶、矢量地图构建与遥感等任务中具有重要价值。早期方法通过预测栅格掩膜再后处理成多边形，无法端到端优化，且易漏检小目标或产生不准确顶点；近期直接生成矢量多边形的方法多局限于简单外轮廓，难以表示含孔洞的复杂多边形或保持其拓扑结构。因此需要一个统一且强调拓扑与复杂性的评测框架来揭示现有方法的不足。
AI.method: 提出PolyTopoBench统一评测框架，用于从遥感图像生成矢量多边形，并明确强调复杂多边形。该框架同时评估外环与内环，对11种代表性方法进行基准测试，涵盖基于分割的多边形化流程、视觉基础模型基线以及专用矢量多边形生成器，涉及两个遥感图像数据集，覆盖建筑、道路、植被与无植被区域等地物。
AI.result: 实验表明，现有方法通常能够较好地恢复简单的外边界，但在处理含孔洞或多环的多边形时性能大幅下降。这揭示复杂多边形生成仍是一个未解决的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 复杂多边形生成仍是开放难题，亟需面向拓扑感知的评测基准与模型设计。PolyTopoBench提供了统一的评测平台，代码与数据已开源。

title: Graph-Based Simultaneous Path and Foothold Planning for Multi-Limbed Intra-Vehicular Robots in Space Stations
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Space Robotics 2026 (iSpaRo 2026)
summary: Robot-aided operations in space stations are essential for reducing the workload of astronauts and improving the efficiency of on-orbit activities. Multi-limbed intra-vehicular robots (MLIVRs) equipped with grappling end-effectors have emerged as a promising solution, as they can securely grasp pre-existing interfaces, such as handrails and seat tracks, thereby enabling stable locomotion and forceful manipulation in microgravity environments. Since graspable locations on these interfaces are spatially limited and discretely distributed, motion planning for MLIVRs must be addressed jointly with foothold planning. This paper presents a simultaneous path and foothold planning framework based on graph theory for MLIVRs. The proposed method efficiently searches for feasible stance sequences for a multi-limbed robot while satisfying manipulability constraints. The effectiveness of the proposed framework is validated through simulations in a 3D model of the International Space Station (ISS) cabin, demonstrating its capability to generate feasible and efficient locomotion plans in realistic intra-vehicular environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于图论的多肢站内机器人路径与足点同步规划框架，在满足可操作度约束下高效搜索可行站姿序列，并在国际空间站舱室3D模型中仿真验证。
AI.motivation: 空间站内机器人作业可减轻宇航员负担、提升在轨活动效率。多肢站内机器人（MLIVR）配抓取末端，可抓握扶手、座椅导轨等既有接口以在微重力下稳定移动与作业。但这些接口上可抓握位置空间受限且离散分布，因此运动规划必须与足点规划联合进行。
AI.method: 提出基于图论的路径与足点同步规划框架，将可行站姿序列的搜索形式化，并在搜索中满足可操作度约束。
AI.result: 在国际空间站（ISS）舱室3D模型中进行仿真，验证了框架能在真实站内环境中生成可行且高效的移动规划。
AI.conclusion: 所提同步路径与足点规划框架有效解决了MLIVR在离散抓握接口下的移动规划问题，具备在真实站内环境中的应用潜力。

title: Is H&E Image-to-Spatial Transcriptomics Simpler Than It Looks?
summary: Predicting spatial gene expression from routine H&E histology offers a scalable route toward spatial molecular profiling. Recent work has pursued increasingly sophisticated architectures to capture spatial context and richer expression structure. At the same time, simple estimators have shown strong performance in several studies, but what they already solve and where additional complexity is needed remain unclear. We study this behavior through the structure of prediction error under the mean-squared error (MSE) objective. Differences in average expression across genes can account for a substantial part of aggregate prediction performance, while a key unresolved error lies in recovering variation within each slide. Decomposing MSE into slide-level and within-slide components, we find that the within-slide component has lower residual-normalized parameter sensitivity in controlled neural experiments. This motivates Component-Guided Loss (CGL), which increases supervision of the within-slide component. CGL-Linear is a closed-form affine instantiation that achieves overall state-of-the-art performance across HEST-1k cohorts and gene-panel sizes. The same within-slide supervision improves existing neural models. These results suggest that substantial gains can come from aligning the training objective with prediction-error structure rather than increasing model complexity.

AI.tldr: 该论文从MSE误差结构出发，发现空间基因表达预测的难点在于slice内部变异，提出Component-Guided Loss（CGL）加强该分量监督，CGL-Linear在HEST-1k上达到SOTA，并提升现有神经模型。
AI.motivation: 从常规H&E组织学图像预测空间基因表达，是实现可扩展空间分子分型的途径。近期研究倾向使用日益复杂的架构来捕捉空间上下文和更丰富的表达结构，但简单估计器在多项研究中表现强劲，说明其已解决的部分与仍需额外复杂度的地方尚不明确。论文希望厘清：简单方法解决了什么，何处才真正需要更复杂的建模。
AI.method: 论文从MSE目标下的预测误差结构入手分析：基因间平均表达的差异可解释聚合预测性能的很大一部分，而关键未解决的误差在于恢复每个slide内部的变异。作者将MSE分解为slide级分量与within-slide分量，并在受控神经实验中观察到within-slide分量具有更低的残差归一化参数敏感度。基于此提出Component-Guided Loss（CGL），加大对within-slide分量的监督；其中CGL-Linear为该思路的闭式仿射实现。
AI.result: CGL-Linear在HEST-1k多个队列和多种基因面板规模上取得整体最优性能。此外，相同的within-slide监督方式也能改进现有神经模型的表现。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，相较于不断增大模型复杂度，将训练目标与预测误差结构对齐可以带来显著收益，为空间基因表达预测提供了更有效的优化方向。

title: Learning to Act under Visual Interruptions with Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, but they are typically developed and evaluated with all camera streams available throughout task execution. When a camera stops delivering frames during task execution, the policy must continue acting without access to subsequent observations from the missing view. Despite its practical importance, how such interruptions affect closed-loop manipulation remains insufficiently understood. To investigate this problem, we introduce MAIL-Bench, a benchmark that evaluates visual interruptions with VLA models. By interrupting different cameras at multiple stages of each policy's successful reference trajectory, MAIL-Bench measures how well policies retain their capabilities when visual inputs become unavailable. Building on this benchmark, we propose MINT, which first trains VLA policies to remain functional under missing visual inputs. At inference time, MINT selectively supplements missing observations using optical-flow extrapolation or an action-conditioned world model, and withdraws predicted views when they become unreliable. Experiments on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 show that MINT significantly improves task success under camera loss over the original models. Experiments on AgiBot G2 further demonstrate the real-robot deployment under camera loss. The benchmark is available at https://minglejiang.github.io/Mail-Bench/

AI.tldr: 论文提出MAIL-Bench基准，评估视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在任务执行中相机中断情况下的表现，并提出MINT方法提升相机丢失时的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型通常假设任务执行全程所有相机流可用，但实际中相机可能中断，此时策略需在缺少后续观测的情况下继续动作。这种视觉中断对闭环操作的影响尚不明确，亟需系统性研究。
AI.method: 构建MAIL-Bench基准：在策略成功参考轨迹的多个阶段中断不同相机，衡量策略在视觉输入不可用时的能力保持。基于该基准提出MINT：先训练VLA策略在缺失视觉输入下仍可运行；推理时用光流外推或动作条件世界模型选择性地补充缺失观测，并在预测视图不可靠时撤回。
AI.result: 在π0.5和GR00T N1.5上，MINT相比原模型显著提升相机丢失下的任务成功率；在AgiBot G2上的实验进一步验证了真实机器人相机丢失场景的部署效果。
AI.conclusion: 视觉中断是VLA操作中不可忽视的实际问题；MAIL-Bench提供了评估手段，MINT通过训练鲁棒策略与推理期选择性视图补全有效缓解相机丢失带来的性能下降，并具备真机可用性。

title: SV2V-RSim: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Self-Selective V2V Cooperative Perception with Near-Realistic Data
summary: Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) cooperative perception enhances autonomous driving by enabling vehicles to share information beyond their direct line of sight. However, existing V2V datasets are limited by a small number of participating agents, static collaborator selection strategies, and a significant domain gap between simulated and real-world environments. To overcome these challenges, we introduce SV2V-RSim, a large-scale, multi-modal, near-realistic simulation dataset engineered to elevate agent diversity and realism. Additionally, we present the Select Vehicles Adaptively (SVA) module, which optimizes collaborator selection to balance perception performance against communication bandwidth constraints. Our dataset is generated using the Unreal Engine 5-based simulator that integrates high-fidelity 3D assets, diverse environments, and intricate traffic scenarios. All vehicles within a specified range of the ego vehicle are equipped with sensor suites, enabling dynamic and adaptive collaborator selection. SV2V-RSim encompasses four maps, four weather conditions, six time periods from sunrise to night, 203K LiDAR frames, 402K RGB frames, and 788K annotated 3D bounding boxes across 17 object classes, supporting a range of cooperative perception tasks such as 3D object detection, segmentation, and depth estimation. Benchmarking on recent cooperative perception algorithms demonstrates that SVA achieves a superior performance-bandwidth trade-off, while sim-to-real experiments and No-Reference Image Quality Assessment validate the dataset's high realism and practical effectiveness. Our dataset and code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出大规模多模态近真实V2V协同感知仿真数据集SV2V-RSim及自适应协作者选择模块SVA，在性能与带宽权衡、仿真真实性方面均取得优越表现。
AI.motivation: 现有V2V数据集存在参与车辆数量少、协作者选择策略固定、仿真与真实环境域差距大等问题，限制了协同感知研究与实际落地。为提升智能体多样性与真实性，需要构建更大规模、更逼真的仿真数据集与自适应协作者选择方案。
AI.method: 基于Unreal Engine 5构建仿真器，集成高保真3D资产、多样环境与复杂交通场景；自车范围内的所有车辆均配备传感器套件，支持动态自适应协作者选择；提出Select Vehicles Adaptively（SVA）模块，在感知性能与通信带宽约束间取得平衡。数据集包含4个地图、4种天气、6个时段，203K LiDAR帧、402K RGB帧、788K标注3D框、17类目标。
AI.result: 在近期协同感知算法上的基准测试表明，SVA实现了更优的性能-带宽权衡；sim-to-real实验与无参考图像质量评估（NR-IQA）验证了数据集的高真实性与实际有效性。
AI.conclusion: SV2V-RSim与SVA共同提升了V2V协同感知的数据规模、真实性与通信效率，可支持3D检测、分割、深度估计等多种协同感知任务，数据集与代码将公开。

title: Do Not Cut When Uncertain: Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads for VLA Policies in Robotic Harvesting
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies trained with behavior cloning or flow matching are optimized to output an action trajectory, but they cannot express "I don't know" or "I should not act." In robotic harvesting, occlusion makes single-frame decisions fundamentally ambiguous: identical pixels can correspond either to a cuttable stem or to no stem at all. Existing VLAs are forced to commit, leading to high-confidence errors with irreversible consequences. We argue that the failure mode of a VLA is determined not by backbone scale but by its output interface. We propose Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads (RCDH), a typed, rejectable, and calibrated output interface that can be attached to a frozen VLA backbone without retraining or new features. RCDH introduces (i) a decision schema with explicit rejection and ordered, conditional decomposition, and (ii) a calibration procedure for risk-aware abstention. We evaluate RCDH on a robotic harvesting platform with controllable leaf occlusion, comparing generative, enumerated, calibrated, and rejectable interfaces. We show that replacing only the output head restores out-of-distribution usability under occlusion while preserving in-distribution performance. We further test whether the ordering of the rejection space is critical. Our results suggest that the right to refuse, rather than a larger model, is the missing interface for reliable manipulation under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 现有VLA策略被强制输出动作轨迹而无法表达"不知道"，本文提出可拒识、可校准的决策输出接口RCDH，仅替换输出头即可在遮挡下恢复可用性。
AI.motivation: 基于行为克隆或流匹配训练的VLA策略只输出动作轨迹，无法表达"我不知道"或"不应行动"。在机器人采摘中遮挡使单帧决策本质歧义：相同像素可能对应可切茎秆，也可能根本没有茎秆。现有VLA被迫做出承诺，导致高置信度且后果不可逆的错误。作者认为VLA的失效模式取决于输出接口而非骨干规模。
AI.method: 提出RCDH（Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads），一种带类型、可拒识、可校准的输出接口，可直接挂接在冻结的VLA骨干上，无需重训或新特征。包含：(i) 具有显式拒识和有序条件分解的决策模式；(ii) 面向风险感知弃权的校准流程。在具有可控叶片遮挡的采摘平台上，对比生成式、枚举式、校准式和可拒识式接口，并检验拒识空间排序是否关键。
AI.result: 仅替换输出头即可在遮挡下恢复分布外可用性，同时保持分布内性能；并进一步验证了拒识空间排序的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 在不确定性下实现可靠操作，缺失的接口是"拒绝的权利"而非更大的模型。

title: Multimodal LLMs Outperform Pathology Foundation Models in Cross-Domain Histological Similarity
summary: State-of-the-art pathology foundation models, trained on millions of histology tiles, can fail to preserve tissue similarity when comparisons cross slide or institution boundaries. We show that general-purpose multimodal LLMs, without being trained as pathology foundation models, consistently outperform these specialized models in cross-domain histological similarity judgments. Using a relative similarity framework that we release as the MOSAIC (Model Similarity Assessment across Institutions and Cohorts) benchmark, we evaluate 17 models across 6 datasets and find that pathology encoders often rank same-institution, different-disease tiles as more similar than same-disease, different-institution tiles, a clinically dangerous failure mode invisible to standard within-domain evaluations. LLMs appear less susceptible to this failure, likely because they perform semantic visual comparison of morphology and tissue architecture rather than relying on shortcut features tied to acquisition context. Scaling training data does not resolve the problem for pathology encoders, implicating the learning objective rather than data coverage. Our results expose a fundamental robustness gap in current pathology foundation models and establish multimodal LLMs as a viable alternative for cross-institutional retrieval, dataset harmonization, and multi-site quality control. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 当前病理基础模型在跨切片、跨机构比较时难以保持组织相似性，而通用多模态大模型（LLM）在这方面反而持续优于专用病理模型。作者提出MOSAIC基准，用相对相似性框架评测17个模型、6个数据集，发现病理编码器常把"同机构不同疾病"的切片排得比"同疾病不同机构"更相似，这是标准同域评测无法发现的危险失效模式。问题根源在于学习目标而非数据规模，通用LLM因进行语义层面的视觉比较而更鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型虽在数百万组织切片上训练，但在跨切片或跨机构比较时无法保持组织相似性。这类跨域失效在标准同域评测中不可见，却可能带来临床风险，因此需要专门评测跨机构相似性判断的基准与方法。
AI.method: 作者提出相对相似性框架，并发布MOSAIC（跨机构与队列的模型相似性评估）基准，在6个数据集上评测17个模型（含专用病理编码器与通用多模态LLM）。
AI.result: 病理编码器常把"同机构不同疾病"的切片判为比"同疾病不同机构"更相似，形成临床危险的失效模式；通用多模态LLM对此更不敏感，且持续优于专用病理模型。扩大训练数据无法解决病理编码器的问题，说明瓶颈在学习目标而非数据覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前病理基础模型的根本性鲁棒性缺口，并确立多模态LLM作为跨机构检索、数据集协调和多站点质量控制的可行替代方案。代码与数据将在接收后发布。

title: EMPIRIC: Experiment-Driven Learning of Residual World Models for Robot Planning
comment: The last two authors contributed equally as co-advisors. Website and code: https://yichao-liang.github.io/empiric
summary: A robot should be able to learn through experiments how unfamiliar objects behave and interact, then plan with that knowledge. It need not start from scratch: physics engines supply knowledge of motion and contact, but can omit entire mechanisms, such as glue curing, water heating, or wind. We present EMPIRIC, an agent that learns a residual world model: a physics engine extended with code for the missing mechanisms. The learned programs can introduce new forces, constraints, and hidden state, and Bayesian inference estimates their parameters and states from noisy observations. The resulting model lets the agent predict the outcomes of actions, choose informative experiments, and revise its hypotheses when predictions fail. Across five simulated domains, EMPIRIC learns interpretable, reusable models, and solves more tasks with fewer environment interactions than all three baselines. On a physical robot, it learns wind forces and domino masses to solve a manipulation task. Website and code: https://yichao-liang.github.io/empiric

AI.tldr: EMPIRIC 是一个学习"残差世界模型"的智能体，它在物理引擎基础上用程序代码补充缺失机制（如胶水固化、水加热、风），并通过贝叶斯推断从噪声观测中估计参数与隐状态，从而预测动作结果、选择实验并修正假设。
AI.motivation: 机器人需要通过与陌生物体交互来学习其行为并据此规划。物理引擎虽提供运动与接触知识，可免于从零学起，但常遗漏整类机制（如胶水固化、水加热或风），因此需要一种方法补全这些缺失机制。
AI.method: 提出 EMPIRIC 智能体，学习一个残差世界模型：在物理引擎之上扩展代码来刻画缺失机制。学到的程序可引入新的力、约束和隐状态，并用贝叶斯推断从带噪观测中估计其参数与状态。所得模型支持预测动作结果、选择信息量大的实验，并在预测失败时修正假设。
AI.result: 在五个模拟域中，EMPIRIC 学到可解释、可复用的模型，并相比三个基线以更少的环境交互解决更多任务。在真实机器人上，它学到风力与多米诺骨牌质量，以完成一项操作任务。
AI.conclusion: 将物理引擎与可学习的程序化机制相结合的残差建模方式，能够有效补齐物理引擎的缺失机制，提升样本效率与任务成功率，并具备可解释性与可复用性，且在真实机器人上得到验证。

title: Improving Video Sparse Attention with Fine-grained Router and Sparse Rebasing
summary: We present VSA2, a frontier trainable sparse attention for video DiTs. VSA2 includes a variety of new architectural features and training procedures that we apply across all stages of the DiT development cycle, including pretraining, RL, and inference, to produce a DiT with comparable or better quality than a full attention counterpart. Architecturally, VSA2 introduces a fine-grained router that improves the precision of identifying critical tokens and supports dynamic computation by allowing each query to attend to a variable number of key-value pairs. In training, we identify a Hard-to-Easy Curriculum, where models trained under high sparsity and later evaluated with lower sparsity during inference not only generalize effectively, but also outperform models trained with full attention in motion quality. VSA2 is also flexible: it can replace full attention during the middle of progressive low-to-high resolution pretraining, rebasing early-stage full-attention checkpoints. Experiments show that VSA2 reduces attention computation by half over VSA with lower loss. On 720p videos, it accelerates attention by 8.9x and end-to-end generation by 4.62x compared to the FlashAttention-3 baseline, while achieving comparable or better video quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VSA2，一种面向视频DiT的可训练稀疏注意力机制，在架构、训练和推理各阶段进行改进，在保持或提升视频质量的同时大幅降低注意力计算并加速生成。
AI.motivation: 视频DiT使用全注意力计算成本高；需要一种既能稀疏化又能保持甚至提升生成质量的可训练稀疏注意力方案。
AI.method: VSA2引入细粒度路由器，提升关键token识别精度，并支持动态计算，使每个query可关注可变数量的key-value对；训练中采用Hard-to-Easy课程（高稀疏训练、低稀疏推理评估）；同时可灵活替换渐进式低到高分辨率预训练中期的全注意力，并复用早期全注意力检查点。
AI.result: 相比VSA，注意力计算减半且损失更低；在720p视频上，相比FlashAttention-3基线，注意力加速8.9倍，端到端生成加速4.62倍，同时达到相当或更好的视频质量；运动质量优于全注意力训练模型。
AI.conclusion: VSA2是一种可训练、灵活且高效的稀疏注意力方案，适用于视频DiT全开发周期，可在显著加速的同时保持或提升生成质量。

title: QuadHand: A Compact Quadrotor Aerial Manipulator with MRC-SDF-Based Whole-Body Motion Planning
summary: Uncrewed aerial manipulators (UAMs) integrate robotic arms with aerial platforms for three-dimensional physical interaction. However, enlarging the workspace increases arm-induced disturbances, while existing geometric representations face a trade-off between geometric fidelity and computational efficiency in close-proximity interaction. This paper presents QuadHand, a compact quadrotor aerial manipulator with a 3-DoF arm, gripper, and battery-assisted passive CoG compensation module to reduce dominant arm-induced disturbances. We further propose MRC-SDF, a Multi-articulated Robot-Centric Signed Distance Field that preserves fine geometric detail with tractable computation, and a spatiotemporal whole-body trajectory optimization framework that jointly optimizes the quadrotor and manipulator for safe and executable trajectory generation. Simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate safe and executable aerial manipulation in complex environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 QuadHand——一款紧凑型四旋翼空中机械臂系统（含 3-DoF 机械臂、夹爪及电池辅助被动重心补偿模块），并提出了机器人中心多关节符号距离场 MRC-SDF 与时空全身轨迹优化框架，实现复杂环境下的安全、可执行空中操作。
AI.motivation: 无人空中机械臂（UAM）可实现三维物理交互，但扩大工作空间会加剧机械臂引起的扰动；同时现有几何表示在近距交互中难以兼顾几何保真度与计算效率。
AI.method: 1) 设计紧凑型四旋翼空中机械臂 QuadHand，配备 3-DoF 机械臂、夹爪以及电池辅助的被动重心补偿模块，以抑制主要的机械臂扰动；2) 提出 MRC-SDF（多关节机器人中心符号距离场），在可承受的计算开销下保留精细几何细节；3) 构建时空全身轨迹优化框架，联合优化四旋翼与机械臂，生成安全且可执行的轨迹。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验表明，该方法能够在复杂环境中实现安全且可执行的空中操作。
AI.conclusion: 通过硬件层面的重心补偿设计与算法层面的高效几何表征及全身轨迹优化，QuadHand 有效缓解了工作空间与扰动之间的矛盾，验证了复杂环境下空中操作的安全性与可执行性。

title: Rethinking the Fully Hyperbolic Vision Transformer in Polar Coordinates
summary: Hyperbolic space can embed intrinsic hierarchies in data with low distortion due to the exponential growth of volume with distance from the origin. However, current Lorentz transformer blocks are formulated in ambient coordinates, where numerical errors increase at large radii due to instability in the Lorentzian inner product, leading many models to limit the radius to avoid this issue. This prevents us from utilizing the regions of hyperbolic space that motivate the geometry. To address this, we revisit the components of the transformer block in polar coordinates, where hyperbolic operations such as distance calculation and attention centroids can be computed without the numerical cancellation in their ambient-coordinate formulations. Specifically, we propose a polar fully connected layer that separately maps an embedding's direction and radius, allowing the radius of a feature to be learned rather than determined by the norm of a linear map. We additionally introduce horospherical shifts as relative positional encodings whose query-key distances grow logarithmically with the token gap. Finally, we reformulate the residual connection as average radius Lorentz boosts. Combining these components, we develop a fully hyperbolic transformer that substantially improves performance over Euclidean and hyperbolic baselines on standard vision tasks. We further evaluate our model on ImageNet and demonstrate its ability to generalize to other datasets using pre-trained weights, similar to Euclidean counterparts.

AI.tldr: 提出极坐标下的全双曲Transformer，避免环境坐标的数值不稳定，提升视觉任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Lorentz Transformer在环境坐标中构建，大半径处内积计算数值不稳定，导致模型限制半径范围，无法利用真正激励双曲几何的大半径区域。
AI.method: 在极坐标下重访Transformer组件：(1)极坐标全连接层，分别映射嵌入的方向和半径，使半径可学习；(2)引入horospherical shifts作为相对位置编码，其query-key距离随token间隔对数增长；(3)将残差连接重构为平均半径Lorentz boosts。
AI.result: 在标准视觉任务上显著优于欧氏和双曲基线，并在ImageNet上验证，且能像欧氏模型一样用预训练权重泛化到其他数据集。
AI.conclusion: 通过极坐标重构可规避数值问题，构建充分利用双曲空间优势的全双曲Transformer。

title: ReCAT: Remember, Count, and Time: Structured Recurrent Memory for Robot Manipulation
summary: Memory-dependent manipulation requires robots to make decisions using information that is no longer available to their current sensors, such as recalling an earlier visual cue, tracking task progress, counting repeated events, or estimating elapsed time. We present ReCAT, a language-conditioned policy with structured recurrent memory. An instruction-conditioned encoder forms features from the current observation. A recurrent memory integrates the observation stream through Mamba-2 layers and one causal attention layer. A flow-matching Transformer decoder reads the current and the historical representation through separate cross-attention in every block. ReCAT reaches 95.3\% average success on LIBERO and 62.4\% on RMBench, with the best or tied-best result on six of nine tasks. On three real-robot tasks probing spatial recall, event counting, and interval timing, the best ReCAT variant reaches 66.7\% average success, against 8.3\% for the strongest short-history baseline. Controlled comparisons within ReCAT show that the observation encoder and every-block memory conditioning are needed for this performance. They also show that update rules developed for efficient sequence modeling behave differently as robot memory: additive updates have the highest observed success on counting and timing, and delta-rule updates on spatial recall. Project website is at https://intuitive-robots.github.io/ReCAT

AI.tldr: ReCAT 是一种带结构化循环记忆的语言条件机器人策略，通过 Mamba-2 循环层与因果注意力层整合观测流，并用流匹配 Transformer 解码器分别读取当前与历史表征，在记忆依赖的操控任务上显著优于短历史基线。
AI.motivation: 记忆依赖的操控任务要求机器人利用当前传感器已无法获取的信息做决策，例如回忆早前的视觉线索、追踪任务进度、计数重复事件或估计已过时间。现有策略难以有效保留和利用这类历史信息，因此需要专门的结构化记忆机制。
AI.method: ReCAT 由三部分组成：(1) 指令条件编码器从当前观测中提取特征；(2) 循环记忆模块通过 Mamba-2 层和一层因果注意力整合观测流；(3) 流匹配 Transformer 解码器在每个模块中通过独立的交叉注意力分别读取当前表征和历史表征。此外进行了受控对比，考察观测编码器、逐块记忆条件以及不同更新规则（加性更新、delta 规则更新）的作用。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 上达到 95.3% 平均成功率，在 RMBench 上达到 62.4%，在九个任务中有六个取得最佳或并列最佳结果。在三个真实机器人任务（空间回忆、事件计数、时间间隔估计）上，最佳 ReCAT 变体达到 66.7% 平均成功率，而最强短历史基线仅 8.3%。受控实验表明，加性更新在计数和计时任务上成功率最高，delta 规则更新在空间回忆任务上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 观测编码器与逐块记忆条件对性能至关重要；针对高效序列建模设计的更新规则在作为机器人记忆时表现不同，需根据任务类型（计数/计时 vs. 空间回忆）选择合适的记忆更新方式。ReCAT 验证了结构化循环记忆在记忆依赖操控任务中的有效性。

title: Synthetic Thermal Image Generation for Real-Time Animal Detection Under Low-Visibility Conditions
comment: Accepted at The IEEE Cyber Awareness Research Symposium (CARS), 2026
summary: Wildlife-vehicle collisions remain a significant road safety concern, particularly during nighttime and low-visibility conditions when RGB-based perception systems are often unreliable. Thermal imaging offers a promising alternative for detecting animals under poor illumination. However, the limited availability of annotated infrared animal datasets restricts the development of robust deep learning-based detection models. This paper investigates synthetic thermal image generation as a scalable approach for real-time animal detection under low-visibility conditions. A subset of 514 annotated visible-spectrum animal images from the NTLNP dataset is translated into synthetic thermal representations using CycleGAN-Turbo, while a limited real thermal dataset of 60 images is expanded through thermal-focused augmentation. Multiple object detection architectures, including YOLOv8, YOLOv9, YOLOv10, and RT-DETR, are trained independently on synthetic and real thermal datasets and evaluated using precision, recall, mAP@0.5, mAP@0.5:0.95, model size, and inference latency. Experimental results show that synthetic thermal images provide competitive detection performance, with RT-DETR achieving the highest synthetic-data mAP@0.5 of 0.9613. Models trained on augmented real thermal data achieve the strongest overall performance, with YOLOv10s obtaining 0.9879 mAP@0.5 and 0.9571 mAP@0.5:0.95. Computational analysis further indicates that lightweight YOLO variants provide favorable inference latency, supporting their potential for real-time deployment. These findings demonstrate that synthetic thermal imagery can reduce dependence on scarce infrared datasets and support the development of efficient animal detection systems for future vehicle-mounted wildlife collision mitigation applications.

AI.tldr: 本文探索利用合成热红外图像缓解红外动物数据集稀缺问题，以支持低能见度下的实时动物检测。用CycleGAN-Turbo将514张可见光动物图像转为合成热图，并对60张真实热图进行增强，训练YOLOv8/v9/v10和RT-DETR。合成数据mAP@0.5达0.9613，增强真实数据上YOLOv10s达0.9879，轻量YOLO具备实时部署潜力。
AI.motivation: 夜间及低能见度条件下野生动物与车辆碰撞是重要道路安全问题，基于RGB的感知系统此时往往不可靠。热成像是有前景的替代方案，但标注红外动物数据集稀缺，限制了鲁棒深度学习检测模型的发展。因此本文研究合成热图像生成作为一种可扩展方案。
AI.method: 从NTLNP数据集中选取514张有标注的可见光动物图像，用CycleGAN-Turbo转换为合成热红外表示；同时对60张真实热红外图像进行热聚焦增强以扩充数据。分别基于合成与真实热数据集独立训练YOLOv8、YOLOv9、YOLOv10、RT-DETR多种检测架构。
AI.result: 合成热图像提供有竞争力的检测性能，RT-DETR在合成数据上取得最高mAP@0.5为0.9613。基于增强真实热数据的模型整体表现最佳，YOLOv10s取得0.9879的mAP@0.5和0.9571的mAP@0.5:0.95。计算分析表明轻量YOLO变体推理延迟较低，有利于实时部署。
AI.conclusion: 合成热成像可减少对稀缺红外数据集的依赖，并支持高效动物检测系统的开发，为未来车载野生动物碰撞缓解应用提供支撑。

title: Zero-Shot Reactive Obstacle Avoidance for Generative Robot Policies
summary: We propose NUDGE (Nudge Update via Differentiable GEometry), a training-free obstacle-avoidance procedure that can be incorporated in any robot policy based on diffusion or flow matching, including diffusion policies and vision-language-action models. Our work injects gradients from a signed distance field, a function returning each point's distance to the nearest obstacle, into the policy at inference time to steer it away from obstacles. It supports any common action parameterization, from absolute or relative joint poses to end-effector poses, through a differentiable joint-trajectory decoder. Experiments show that NUDGE preserves the policy's task distribution and runs reactively in real time.

AI.tldr: NUDGE是一种免训练的实时避障方法，通过将符号距离场梯度注入扩散或流匹配机器人策略的推理过程，引导策略远离障碍物，同时保持任务分布。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散或流匹配的机器人策略（含扩散策略与视觉-语言-动作模型）缺乏通用的、无需重新训练的避障能力。作者希望提出一种可插入任意此类策略、且能实时反应式避障的方法。
AI.method: 提出NUDGE（Nudge Update via Differentiable GEometry）：在推理时将由符号距离场（返回每点到最近障碍物距离的函数）计算出的梯度注入策略，用于将动作引导远离障碍物。通过可微关节轨迹解码器，支持从绝对或相对关节位姿到末端执行器位姿等任意常见动作参数化。
AI.result: 实验表明，NUDGE能够保持原策略的任务分布，并能够以反应式方式实时运行。
AI.conclusion: NUDGE是一种免训练、通用、实时的避障程序，可无缝集成到任意基于扩散或流匹配的机器人策略中，在避障的同时保持任务分布与实时性。

title: DynamicDx: Evaluating Evidence Acquisition in Video-Based Diagnosis
summary: Diagnosing a patient from video requires more than recognizing the sign: a vision-language model must turn what it sees into hypotheses, questions and tests. DynamicDx evaluates each step in 71 neurological consultations across 11 sign categories, linking authentic patient videos to confirmed diagnoses and fixed charts built from the same case reports, so that every model queries the same evidence. Across five such models, video improves accuracy by 9.9-22.5 percentage points over blind input, but neither recognition alone nor temporal order explains the gain: the cause is usually missing from the model's video-only differential diagnosis even when the sign is recognized, and shuffling the frames produces no reliable accuracy loss. Instead, a trajectory replay traces most of the gain to the investigation results the video prompts. Evidence acquisition is the bottleneck: supplying the decisive investigations raises accuracy to 73.2-93.0%. Two interventions act on it. A post-trained 4B video describer improves sign descriptions, especially from a short, densely sampled segment, and source-clean literature retrieval expands initial hypotheses; both bring the tests a model orders closer to those the treating clinicians documented and, through them, raise accuracy. For video-based diagnosis, seeing better helps when it leads to asking better.

AI.tldr: DynamicDx 提出一个分步评估视频诊断的框架，覆盖71例神经科会诊、11类体征，发现视频带来的诊断增益主要来自"促使模型获取关键检查证据"而非单纯识别体征；改善视频描述与文献检索可提升检查选择的合理性，从而显著提高准确率。
AI.motivation: 视频诊断不仅是"识别体征"，还需将所见转化为假设、提问与检查。现有评估往往只关注体征识别或时序信息，未阐明视频为何能提升诊断准确率，也缺乏对诊断全流程各步骤的分步评测。
AI.method: 构建 DynamicDx 基准：71例神经科会诊、11类体征，将真实患者视频与确诊结果、由同一病例报告构建的固定病历相连，使各模型查询相同证据。在5个视觉-语言模型上评估，并进行轨迹回放、帧打乱实验；设置两项干预——经后训练的4B视频描述器（尤其针对短时密集采样片段）与来源干净的文献检索。
AI.result: 视频相较盲输入使准确率提升9.9–22.5个百分点；但单纯识别或时序顺序无法解释增益，帧打乱无明显损失。增益主要来自视频促使模型获取的检查结果。检查证据获取是瓶颈：直接提供决定性检查可将准确率提升至73.2–93.0%。两项干预使模型所开具的检查更接近临床医生实际记录的检查，并借此提高准确率。
AI.conclusion: 面向视频诊断，"看得更好"只有转化为"问得更好"（即更合理地获取检查证据）才能提升诊断。未来系统应优化证据获取环节，而非仅提升体征识别。

title: Spatial Grafting: Grounding 3D Features for Flow-Matching Robot Policies
summary: Pretrained robot manipulation policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) or world-action models (WAMs) leave interaction-relevant metric geometry implicit. Recent breakthroughs in spatial reconstruction can supply the necessary geometry reliably, but their features describe local shape without stating where it lies with respect to the robot. How best to deliver these features to a pretrained policy remains unresolved. We propose Spatial Grafting, a versatile, lightweight spatial module that binds frozen reconstruction features to metric, robot-relative geometry. Spatial Grafting constructs metric-grounded spatial tokens and injects them into the flow-matching action expert through cross-attention, without modifying the host's perceptual pathway, so the host retains the full benefit of its pretraining. We evaluate it more broadly than any geometry-aware policy we compare against: one graft architecture, with no per-host redesign, on two VLAs and two WAMs, across four simulation benchmarks that span short-horizon manipulation, visual robustness, clutter and long-horizon mobile manipulation, and on three real-robot platforms with single- and dual-arm configurations. On RoboTwin 2.0, a dual-arm manipulation benchmark, the graft improves every host across VLAs and WAMs. Grafted $π_{0.5}$ gains 11.3% and 15.6% on clean and randomized scenes, reaching 94.0% and 92.4%, above the strongest published 3D-conditioned policy, WAM4D (93.8% and 89.9%). The margin widens as the horizon lengthens: on tasks from BEHAVIOR-1K, a dual-arm mobile manipulation challenge scored by average task progress, it surpasses the 2025 challenge winner on five of six tasks,by up to 0.47 Q-score, and exceeds a map-conditioned spatial policy on average across the three tasks both report.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Spatial Grafting，一种轻量级空间模块，将冻结的稀疏重建特征绑定到机器人相对的公制几何，并通过交叉注意力注入预训练机器人操作策略（VLA/WAM）的动作专家，无需重新设计宿主感知通路。在多个仿真基准与真实机器人平台上验证其通用性与有效性。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人操作策略（如VLA和WAM）将交互相关的公制几何信息隐式化；现有空间重建特征虽能提供几何信息但仅描述局部形状，未表明其相对机器人的位置关系。如何将这类特征有效传递给预训练策略尚无定论。
AI.method: Spatial Grafting 构建具有公制基础的空间 token，通过交叉注意力注入流匹配动作专家，且不修改宿主的感知通路，使宿主保留预训练的全部收益。该架构通用，无需针对每个宿主重新设计。
AI.result: 在两种VLA与两种WAM、四个仿真基准及三个真实机器人平台（单臂与双臂）上评估。在RoboTwin 2.0上，graft提升所有宿主；grafted π0.5在干净与随机场景分别提升11.3%与15.6%，达94.0%与92.4%，超越最强已发布3D条件策略WAM4D（93.8%与89.9%）。在BEHAVIOR-1K上，六项任务中五项超过2025挑战赛冠军，最高提升0.47 Q-score，并在三任务平均上超过地图条件空间策略。
AI.conclusion: Spatial Grafting 提供了一种通用、轻量的方案，将公制机器人相对几何有效传递给预训练操作策略，在多平台多任务上显著提升性能，且随任务时长增加优势扩大。

title: Distributed Hydrological Modeling in the Feature Space
summary: Accurate forecasting of river discharge and floods is very challenging. River dynamics are affected by storage, meteorological forcing, and flow propagation at different spatial and temporal scales. Forecasting thus requires a framework that considers the upstream-to-downstream flow through river networks across grid cells and catchments. This modeling is known in hydrology as distributed modeling and routing. Existing deep learning approaches either ignore this topology, operate on lumped catchments, or route predicted physical quantities through a separate graph or physical routing model. We instead introduce feature-space routing: a topology-aware state-space operator embedded directly in the forecasting dynamics. At every forecast step, the operator gathers latent states from upstream grid cells and causally updates the downstream state according to the known river network. This preserves the physical connectivity of the river system while allowing the propagated state itself to be learned end-to-end and allows the model to predict river discharge considering both local dynamics and neighboring upstream contributions. To address uncertainty and provide probabilistic forecasts, we minimize the fair continuous ranked probability score (fCRPS) as a training objective. Our experiments on the European Flood Awareness System (EFAS) and observational data for river discharge forecasting demonstrate that encoding the physical structure of river networks explicitly in the feature space substantially improves the forecasting skill, particularly in an ungauged setting. Our approach achieves state-of-the-art results on both reanalysis and observational data and is able to forecast maps of river discharge at 1 arcminute and 6-hourly resolution up to 10 days lead time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"特征空间路由"（feature-space routing），将拓扑感知的状态空间算子直接嵌入预测动力学，实现端到端的河流流量概率预测，在EFAS与观测数据上取得最优结果，并支持1弧分、6小时、10天预见期的流量制图。
AI.motivation: 河流流量与洪水预测极具挑战，因为河流动力学受蓄水、气象强迫与不同时空尺度的水流传播共同影响，需要自上而下穿越河网、跨越网格与流域的分布式建模与汇流框架。现有深度学习要么忽略拓扑结构，要么在集总流域上运算，要么把预测的物理量再通过单独的图模型或物理汇流模型进行路由，未能将河网拓扑与预测过程统一。
AI.method: 提出特征空间路由：一种拓扑感知的状态空间算子，直接嵌入预测动力学中。每个预测步，算子从上游网格单元收集隐状态，并依据已知河网对下游状态进行因果更新，从而在端到端学习传播状态的同时保持河流系统的物理连通性。为处理不确定性并提供概率预测，采用公平连续排序概率评分（fCRPS）作为训练目标。
AI.result: 在EFAS与观测数据的河流流量预测实验中，将河网物理结构显式编码进特征空间显著提升了预测技巧，尤其在无测站（ungauged）设定下效果明显。方法在再分析数据与观测数据上均达到当前最优水平，能够以1弧分、6小时分辨率预测最长10天预见期的河流流量图。
AI.conclusion: 将河网拓扑以特征空间路由方式显式嵌入深度学习预测动力学，是一种有效且通用的分布式汇流建模范式，兼顾局部动态与上游邻域贡献，并在概率预测框架下显著提升流量与洪水预测能力。

title: Repair Before You Fuse: Frozen-Host Adaptation for Corrupted-but-Present Sensors
summary: Camera-LiDAR detectors can continue to consume unreliable features even when both sensors remain present, synchronized, and calibrated. We introduce \emph{Boundary Feature Repair} (BFR), a frozen-host adaptation framework that learns task-supervised residual corrections at modality interfaces the detector already consumes. BFR-C repairs each camera feature level read by fusion, whereas BFR-L aligns host-conditioned LiDAR candidates to a selected boundary and routes site-wise innovations relative to the frozen anchor. Their jointly trained composition is BFR-CL. Zero-initialized per-channel scales make every variant an exact detector-level identity before optimization; only the repair modules train, while the encoders, fusion consumer, router, detection head, and host normalization statistics remain fixed. At inference, BFR requires neither clean references, corruption metadata, temporal history, nor online updates. Across the complete 20-corruption, five-severity KITTI-C grid, BFR-C reduces RCE from $14.07$ to $11.92$ on MVX-Net and from $14.29$ to $11.00$ on Focals Conv-F relative to their reproduced frozen baselines. On the latter host, BFR-L raises AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ from $73.65$ to $74.48$, while BFR-CL reaches $77.01$ AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ and $10.46$ RCE with $86.02$ clean AP. On nuScenes-R, BFR-CL raises the reproduced MoME baseline's mAP robustness ratio from $80.1$ to $81.4$. These results establish boundary repair as a targeted retrofit for corrupted-but-present sensing without retraining the deployed detector.

AI.tldr: 提出边界特征修复(BFR)框架,在冻结的相机-LiDAR检测器上学习模态接口处的残差修正,无需重训检测器即可提升损坏数据下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 相机-LiDAR检测器在两个传感器均存在、同步且标定的情况下,仍会持续消费不可靠特征。作者希望不重新训练已部署检测器,针对"损坏但仍存在"的感知场景做定向改造。
AI.method: BFR是一种冻结宿主适配框架,在检测器已消费的模态接口上学习任务监督的残差修正。BFR-C修复融合所读取的每个相机特征层级;BFR-L将宿主条件化的LiDAR候选对齐到选定边界并相对冻结锚点路由逐站点新息;两者联合训练构成BFR-CL。零初始化的逐通道缩放使各变体在优化前为检测器级恒等映射,仅修复模块参与训练,编码器、融合消费者、路由器、检测头与宿主归一化统计保持固定。推理时无需干净参考、损坏元数据、时序历史或在线更新。
AI.result: 在完整的20种损坏、5种严重程度的KITTI-C网格上,BFR-C将MVX-Net的RCE从14.07降至11.92,将Focals Conv-F从14.29降至11.00(相对复现的冻结基线)。在后一宿主上,BFR-L将AP_cor从73.65提升至74.48;BFR-CL达到77.01 AP_cor与10.46 RCE,干净AP为86.02。在nuScenes-R上,BFR-CL将复现的MoME基线mAP鲁棒性比率从80.1提升至81.4。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明边界修复是针对"损坏但仍存在"感知的有效定向改造方案,无需重新训练已部署的检测器。

title: ReVision3D: Attribution-Guided Recursive Self-Improvement for 3D Medical Perception
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a promising path for overcoming the limited visual capability of current medical imaging agents. Yet applying RSI to volumetric imaging remains difficult: failures can arise from acquisition, perception, training recipe, or downstream inference, while self-generated feedback and logged trajectories provide little guidance on which component should change. We introduce ReVision3D, an RSI system that leverages 3D volumes with spatially grounded annotations to determine where visual evidence is lost and recursively improve the corresponding visual capability. A frozen language-model designer proposes revisions to acquisition, perception, training, or inference, while the verifier and system-level objective remain fixed. Our key insight is that an annotated volume forms an exact replay world for view rendering and spatial verification: unvisited views can be rendered on demand, and localized predictions can be checked directly against reference masks. This grounded feedback directs targeted revision, while only changes that improve beyond measured seed noise are retained. Each accepted change triggers renewed attribution, allowing the dominant bottleneck to shift across rounds. On abdominal CT, attribution identifies perception as the dominant remaining limitation. Revising that level enables ReVision3D to achieve 79% liver recall and 83% kidney recall at under 0.4 false positives per patient, outperforming the evaluated frozen multimodal foundation models, with the largest gains on small lesions.

AI.tldr: ReVision3D 是一个递归自我改进（RSI）系统，利用带空间标注的 3D 体数据构建可精确重放的验证环境，定位视觉证据丢失的关键环节，并递归改进对应的视觉能力。
AI.motivation: 现有医学影像智能体视觉能力有限，递归自我改进（RSI）虽有潜力但难以应用于体数据成像：失败可能来自采集、感知、训练配方或下游推理等多个环节，而自生成反馈与日志轨迹无法指明应修改哪个组件。
AI.method: 系统采用冻结的语言模型设计器提出对采集、感知、训练或推理的修订，验证器与系统级目标保持固定。核心思路是利用带标注体数据构成"精确重放世界"：可按需渲染未访问视图，并将局部预测直接与参考掩膜核对，从而提供有依据的反馈以进行定向修订；仅保留改善超过实测种子噪声的改动。每次被接受的改动触发重新归因，使主导瓶颈可跨轮次转移。
AI.result: 在腹部 CT 上，归因识别出感知是剩余的主要限制。修订该层面后，ReVision3D 在每患者低于 0.4 次假阳性的条件下达到 79% 肝脏召回率和 83% 肾脏召回率，优于所评估的冻结多模态基础模型，且在小病灶上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 带空间标注的 3D 体数据可作为可重放的验证环境，为递归自我改进提供有依据的定向反馈，从而有效定位并改进主导性的视觉瓶颈，在医学体数据检测任务上取得优于现有基础模型的表现。

title: GuardPIBT: Counterfactually Gated Neural Guidance for Ultra-Large-Scale 3D Multi-Agent Path Finding
summary: Large-scale 3D multi-agent path finding becomes increasingly difficult under dense traffic. Priority Inheritance with Backtracking (PIBT) scales well, but its one-step goal-directed ordering may become insufficient under dense interactions and large-scale congestion. We present GuardPIBT, which augments rather than replaces the PIBT executor: neural predictions only propose residual reorderings of PIBT's native candidates, while final actions remain determined by PIBT. First, local graph attention models nearby interactions, while global source--goal transport features provide population-level coordination context for candidate reordering. Second, a counterfactual group gate filters reorderings whose closed-loop effects may degrade coordination. Third, for ultra-large populations, population-adaptive grouping preserves decision granularity, asynchronous cached inference amortizes neural computation, and selective repair resolves long-tail agents. PIBT retains validity checking, priority inheritance, and backtracking throughout. Experiments with up to 100,000 agents demonstrate reliable completion across 2D and 3D environments, including all three 100,000-agent warehouse runs with zero audited graph violations. The project website is available at {\color{magenta}\texttt{https://guardpibt.github.io/GuardPIBT/}}.

AI.tldr: GuardPIBT在PIBT执行器上叠加神经残差重排序，在十万智能体规模下实现可靠三维多智能体路径规划。
AI.motivation: 大规模三维多智能体路径规划在密集交通下难度剧增，PIBT虽扩展性好，但其单步目标导向排序在密集交互和大规模拥堵时不足。
AI.method: 采用增强而非替换PIBT的思路：神经预测仅对PIBT原生候选提出残差重排序，最终动作仍由PIBT决定。包括局部图注意力建模邻近交互、全局起点-终点运输特征提供群体级协调上下文；反事实组门过滤可能降低协调性的重排序；面向超大群体的自适应分组、异步缓存推理与选择性修复。PIBT全程保留有效性检查、优先级继承与回溯。
AI.result: 在多达10万智能体的实验中，2D与3D环境均可靠完成任务，包括全部三次10万智能体仓库运行且零审计图违规。
AI.conclusion: 通过在PIBT上加入神经残差重排序并保持其安全机制，GuardPIBT在超大规模密集场景下兼顾可扩展性与可靠性。

title: Oracle Gaps in Reliability Coverage: Sampling Noise or Policy Specialization?
summary: Policies trained from the same base model can appear to solve different problems. An oracle that chooses the best policy for each problem may therefore appear much stronger than any single policy. Selecting the largest estimated success rate also selects favorable sampling errors. We study this effect through reliability coverage, the fraction of problems whose success probability reaches a chosen threshold. Our first test redistributes stored correctness outcomes across policies within each problem. A second also preserves each policy's total successes, accounting for overall quality differences under a specified statistical model. For five training seeds of a seven-billion-parameter vision-language model, redistribution reproduces 0.096 of an estimated 0.113 oracle gap at threshold 0.10. Neither test finds significant evidence at this threshold. Small advantages remain unresolved. Mixtures, routers, voting, and weight averaging show no detectable improvement over their corresponding single-policy baselines. Training policies on different datasets shows little detectable specialization under light post-training, and no router gain. A stronger recipe does create it, both tests detect it, and a router gain appears only at the high thresholds where the specialists separate. In a control with predictable specialization, a router recovers about half the oracle gap. Coverage bounds explain why even a genuine oracle advantage need not yield a deployment gain. The tests assess apparent specialization from stored responses before investment in routing. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/oracle-gaps

AI.tldr: 本文研究"策略集合的oracle增益"是否真实源于策略特化，提出基于可靠性覆盖率（reliability coverage）的两种检验方法，用同一基座模型的不同训练种子验证：表面上的oracle优势大多由采样误差造成，而非策略间真实特化。
AI.motivation: 同一基座模型训练出的多个策略看似能解决不同问题，若按每个问题挑选最佳策略（oracle），其表现会远强于任何单一策略。但"挑选最大估计成功率"同时也在挑选有利的采样误差，因此需要区分：oracle增益究竟来自真实的策略特化，还是统计噪声。
AI.method: 提出以"可靠性覆盖率"（成功概率达到给定阈值的问题比例）为核心度量。设计两种检验：(1) 在每个问题内部，将存储的正确性结果在各策略间重新分配；(2) 在保持每个策略总成功数的前提下重分配，以指定统计模型控制整体质量差异。在700亿参数视觉语言模型的5个训练种子上，对比混合、路由、投票、权重平均等方法，并设置可预测特化的对照实验。
AI.result: 阈值0.10下，重分配可复现估计oracle增益0.113中的0.096，两种检验在该阈值均未发现显著证据，仅存无法解释的小优势。混合、路由、投票、权重平均相对各自单策略基线无可检测改进。在轻量后训练下，不同数据集的策略几乎无特化，也无路由增益；仅在更强训练配方下才出现可检测特化，且路由增益只在高阈值处出现。对照实验中路由器可恢复约一半oracle增益。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖率上界说明即便存在真实的oracle优势，也未必转化为部署收益。所提检验可在投入路由开发前，利用已存储的响应评估表观特化是否真实。代码已开源。

title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Project website: https://dexagent123.github.io/
summary: Human videos offer a scalable source of demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation. However, existing human-to-simulation-to-robot (Human2Sim2Robot) pipelines rely on predefined procedures that struggle to accommodate diverse object properties and interactions, particularly those involving articulated and deformable objects. We introduce DexAgent, an agentic Human2Sim2Robot framework that converts a single egocentric human video and a task prompt into physically grounded robot trajectories for policy training. It operates through four stages: semantic understanding of human videos, property-based simulation reconstruction, robot trajectory optimization, and robot data generation. At each stage, DexAgent adapts its approach to the task and object properties by selecting suitable skills from its tool library or developing new ones when needed. Property-specific verifiers assess stage outcomes for physical validity and task-specific requirements and provide feedback for refinement, preventing error propagation through the workflow. This adaptive, verification-guided process allows DexAgent to process diverse objects and long-horizon tasks. In the final stage, DexAgent varies object and robot states in simulation to generate diverse robot trajectories from a single human video, then retextures the rendered observations to facilitate sim-to-real transfer. Newly developed skills and verifiers are retained in its tool library, making it self-evolving to accumulate reusable capabilities. This reduces processing time as DexAgent encounters more human videos. Across eleven real-world tasks, policies trained with DexAgent-generated data achieve a 3.5x higher success rate than competing baselines. Project website: https://dexagent123.github.io/.

AI.tldr: DexAgent 是一个智能体式 Human2Sim2Robot 框架，可将单段第一视角人类视频和任务提示转化为物理合理的机器人轨迹用于策略训练，通过四阶段流程与验证器反馈实现自适应、自进化，在11个真实任务上成功率比基线高3.5倍。
AI.motivation: 现有 Human2Sim2Robot 流水线依赖预定义流程，难以适应多样化的物体属性和交互，尤其是涉及铰接和可变形物体的情况。人类视频是灵巧机器人操作示范的可扩展来源，但如何有效利用其处理多样物体和长时程任务仍是挑战。
AI.method: DexAgent 包含四个阶段：人类视频语义理解、基于属性的仿真重建、机器人轨迹优化、机器人数据生成。每个阶段 DexAgent 通过从工具库中选择合适技能或在需要时开发新技能来适应任务和物体属性。属性特定的验证器评估各阶段结果的物理有效性和任务需求，并提供反馈进行改进，防止错误在工作流中传播。最终阶段通过变化仿真中的物体和机器人状态，从单段人类视频生成多样化机器人轨迹，并对渲染观测进行重新贴图以促进仿真到现实的迁移。新开发的技能和验证器保留在工具库中，使其能够自我进化并积累可复用能力。
AI.result: 在11个真实世界任务中，使用 DexAgent 生成数据训练的策略成功率比竞争基线高3.5倍。随着处理更多人类视频，DexAgent 的处理时间减少。
AI.conclusion: DexAgent 通过自适应、验证引导的智能体式框架，能够处理多样化物体和长时程任务，并从单段人类视频生成多样化机器人轨迹，实现自我进化和仿真到现实的迁移，显著优于现有基线方法。

title: Certified Interface Aliases: Exact Collisions in Vision-Language Preprocessing, and When They Exist
summary: Vision-language verifiers and routers must distinguish errors repairable by more reasoning from those caused by visual evidence never reaching the language model. This distinction lacks ground truth because annotators see full-resolution images while models receive preprocessed tensors. We introduce AliasForge to create cases where the relevant fact is provably absent from the interface. Fixed-point resampling makes the pre-rounding resize an exact integer linear map that can send nonzero integer perturbations to zero. Hiding a label-flipping perturbation there produces images with opposite step-correctness labels but bit-identical interface states. Every verifier therefore has the same output law on both members, giving pair-balanced accuracy exactly one half and zero gain from language-side repair. We prove that every fixed-point downscaler has such null vectors and bound their smallest size at the most common ratios, which rules out an 8-bit fit whenever the bound exceeds 255. From the resize configuration alone, a lattice criterion supplies realizable collisions and certifies their absence within the specified construction family. It resolves all 20 screened configurations, 17 as constructible and 3 as non-constructible. We construct certified pairs across three architectures and certify four additional processors, with zero decision-logit gap on all 18 scored pairs and none of the 18 controls. The pairs also screen routers that waste computation on re-attention or further reasoning. On natural items, per-item routing headroom exists, but no tested interface-only router improves over stopping. Our fiber ceiling bounds the headroom recoverable from the interface. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/aliasforge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AliasForge，构造一种"接口别名"案例：在图像缩放（pre-rounding resize）阶段构造定点重采样，使标签翻转扰动被映射为零，从而生成接口状态逐比特相同但正确性标签相反的图像对。由此证明任何验证器在这对样本上输出分布相同，成对平衡准确率恰为 1/2，语言侧修复收益为零，并给出可构造性判据与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言验证器与路由器需要区分两类错误：可通过更多推理修复的错误，与因视觉证据从未到达语言模型而导致的错误。但这一区分缺乏真实标签（ground truth）：标注者看到的是全分辨率图像，而模型接收的是预处理后的张量，二者信息不一致，因此无法客观界定"证据是否到达"。
AI.method: 提出 AliasForge：利用定点重采样（fixed-point resampling）使取整前的缩放成为一个精确的整数线性映射，该映射可将非零整数扰动送到零。在缩放环节隐藏一个"标签翻转"扰动，即可生成图像对——其接口状态（模型实际接收的张量）逐比特完全相同，但步骤正确性标签相反。论文进一步证明：每个定点降采样器都存在这样的零空间向量（null vectors），并在常见缩放比下给出其最小尺寸的界；当界超过 255 时即排除 8-bit 表示的可能性（8-bit fit）。此外，仅依据缩放配置，用格（lattice）判据给出可实现碰撞并认证其在指定构造族内不存在，从而判定配置是否可构造。
AI.result: 格判据解决了全部 20 个筛选配置，其中 17 个判定为可构造、3 个为不可构造。在三种架构上成功构造出认证样本对，并额外认证了四个处理器；全部 18 对计分样本对的决策 logit 差为零，而 18 个对照样本均无此性质。这些样本对还可用于筛选那些在重注意力或进一步推理上浪费计算的路由器。在自然样本上，逐项路由存在提升空间（headroom），但所有仅依赖接口的路由器都不优于"停止"策略；论文用 fiber ceiling 给出了接口可恢复提升空间的上界。
AI.conclusion: AliasForge 从缩放配置层面揭示了视觉-语言系统中一类根本性的接口信息损失：当相关事实在接口中可证明缺失时，任何验证器都无法区分，语言侧推理无法弥补，逐项路由也无法获得增益。研究给出了零向量存在性的理论证明、8-bit 可行性排除条件、基于格的配置可构造性判据，并通过跨架构实验验证了零决策 logit 差的认证样本对，同时界定了仅凭接口可恢复的性能上限。

title: From Pixel to Poses: Object-centric Tool Manipulation Learning from Human Demonstrations
summary: Scaling up robotic manipulation is primarily bottlenecked by the scarcity of real-world robot data. While recent approaches leverage human video demonstrations to mitigate this shortage, they remain computationally expensive and still rely on paired human-robot data for domain alignment. Although current state-of-the-arts excel at long-horizon tasks, they struggle with the delicate and precise control required for complex tool manipulation. To overcome these limitations, we introduce P2P-T, from Pixel to Poses for Tool Manipulation, a data-efficient, object-centric framework that learns tool use directly from human demonstrations. P2P-T bridges the cognitive and physical execution gap through a two-stage approach. First, pretraining an object-centric world model to extract stable pose priors; second, integrating these priors into an efficient, pose-aware low-level policy. By utilizing a robust automated data processing pipeline powered by modern foundation models, P2P-T completely bypasses the need for human-robot aligned data. This reduces overall training overhead drastically. With minimal per-task fine-tuning, our framework achieves a 73% improvement over the previous state of the art in execution performance on complex, real-world tool manipulation tasks that currently remain out of reach for standard large-scale pretrained models.

AI.tldr: P2P-T是一个数据高效、以物体为中心的工具操作框架，仅从人类演示中学习工具使用，无需人-机器人对齐数据，在真实复杂工具操作任务上比先前SOTA提升73%。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作规模化主要受限于真实机器人数据稀缺。利用人类视频演示虽可缓解，但计算开销大且仍需配对的人-机器人数据做域对齐。现有SOTA擅长长时程任务，却在复杂工具操作所需的精细精确控制上表现不佳。
AI.method: P2P-T采用两阶段方法：先预训练以物体为中心的世界模型以提取稳定的姿态先验，再将这些先验整合进高效的、姿态感知的底层策略，从而连接认知与物理执行之间的差距。同时借助由现代基础模型驱动的自动化数据处理流水线，完全绕过对人-机器人对齐数据的需求。
AI.result: 大幅降低整体训练开销；仅需极少的单任务微调即可在复杂真实工具操作任务上取得执行性能73%的提升，超越此前SOTA，而这些任务对标准大规模预训练模型而言仍难以企及。
AI.conclusion: P2P-T通过以物体为中心的世界模型与姿态感知策略，实现了无需人-机器人对齐数据的高效工具操作学习，为数据稀缺下的机器人操作提供了可行路径。

title: Safety-Constrained Cascade Inference for Robust Malaria Cell Classification Under Field Corruptions
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Code available at https://github.com/josehagbe3/MalariaVision
summary: Automated malaria diagnosis from thin blood-smear microscopy could meaningfully reduce the burden on under-resourced laboratories, but a model that maximises accuracy on clean laboratory images fails badly the moment an inexpensive smartphone camera introduces sensor noise. This paper introduces MalariaCascade, a two-stage inference system in which a lightweight MobileNetV2 sentinel (2,225,153 parameters) makes confident classifications at low compute cost and escalates uncertain cases to an EfficientNet-B3 expert (10,697,769 parameters) that sees only clean, standardised images regardless of how corrupted the incoming frame is. Structural isolation of the expert stage, not learned robustness, is the mechanism. The sentinel is trained under a safety-score objective that places an explicit floor on Recall(Parasitised) (>=0.95) and Recall(Uninfected) (>=0.40) before precision is optimised, ensuring the checkpoint satisfies clinical safety constraints by construction. On the NIH Malaria Cell Images Dataset (27,558 cells), the cascade reaches Accuracy=0.9736, Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570, Precision(Parasitised)=0.9912, F1=0.9738, and AUROC=0.9955 on the clean test set. Under Gaussian sensor noise at full severity, cascade Recall(Parasitised) degrades by only 2.4 pp (0.9570 to 0.9329), while the flat single-model baseline collapses by 63.0 pp (0.9584 to 0.3281). McNemar's test confirms the cascade improvement is statistically significant (chi^2=11.14, p=0.00085). An ablation isolating the structural property shows that routing clean images to the expert is responsible for a 16.8 pp Recall(Parasitised) advantage under sensor noise relative to a cascade where the expert also sees corrupted inputs.

AI.tldr: 提出双阶段级联推理系统 MalariaCascade，用轻量哨兵模型做初筛、将不确定样本升级给只看干净图像的专家模型，以结构隔离而非鲁棒训练实现抗传感器噪声的疟疾诊断。
AI.motivation: 自动化疟疾薄血涂片诊断可减轻资源匮乏实验室负担，但在干净实验室图像上高精度的模型，一旦遇到廉价智能手机摄像头引入的传感器噪声便严重失效。
AI.method: 两阶段推理：MobileNetV2 哨兵（2,225,153 参数）低成本给出置信分类，不确定样本升级至 EfficientNet-B3 专家（10,697,769 参数），专家始终只处理干净、标准化图像，与输入帧损坏程度无关；哨兵采用安全分数目标训练，先对 Recall(Parasitised)>=0.95 与 Recall(Uninfected)>=0.40 设下限，再优化精确率。
