AI.result: 在 NIH Malaria Cell Images Dataset（27,558 细胞）上，干净测试集 Accuracy=0.9736、Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570、Precision(Parasitised)=0.9912、F1=0.9738、AUROC=0.9955；满强度高斯噪声下级联 Recall(Parasitised) 仅降 2.4 pp（0.9570→0.9329），而单模型基线崩溃 63.0 pp（0.9584→0.3281）；McNemar 检验显著（chi^2=11.14, p=0.00085）；消融显示结构化路由带来 16.8 pp 的 Recall 优势。
AI.conclusion: 结构隔离（将干净图像路由至专家阶段）而非学习鲁棒性，是级联系统在传感器噪声下保持诊断性能的核心机制。

title: Adaptive Safety Filtering for Frozen ACC Policies via Conformal Residual Calibration
summary: Frozen adaptive cruise control (ACC) policies can violate constraints when deployment dynamics differ from their training conditions. We propose residual-aware conformal action filtering (RACF), which calibrates residuals of a fixed nominal predictor and converts their quantile into an operating margin for finite-model action projection. Completed transitions update margins and candidate selection without retraining the policy. In a registered comparison over 2,400 controller-trial units, Adaptive RACF achieves 94.3% episode safety, improving by 19.9 percentage points over the evaluated nominal CBF-QP baseline while reducing projection frequency from 8.11% to 6.63%. A controlled study isolates a 4.54-point improvement from residual-margin injection. In a separate matched-hardware evaluation, Adaptive reduces mean amortized rollout time by 21.2% relative to Robust CBF-QP, with 161/180 versus 170/180 safe episodes. We characterize conditions linking one-step residual coverage to constraint satisfaction and quantify the observed safety-computation trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 提出残差感知保形动作过滤（RACF），通过校准固定标称预测器的残差并转为运行裕度，实现无需重训练的策略动作投影，在安全性上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 冻结的ACC策略在部署动态与训练条件不一致时会违反约束，需要在无需重新训练策略的前提下保证安全性并兼顾计算效率。
AI.method: RACF校准固定标称预测器的残差，将其分位数转换为有限模型动作投影的运行裕度；已完成的转移用于更新裕度和候选选择，无需重训练策略。研究还刻画了一步残差覆盖与约束满足的关系。
AI.result: 在2,400个控制器-试验单元的注册对比中，Adaptive RACF达到94.3%的回合安全率，比标称CBF-QP基线提升19.9个百分点，投影频率从8.11%降至6.63%；对照实验显示残差裕度注入贡献4.54个百分点提升。匹配硬件评测中，相对Robust CBF-QP平均摊销展开时间减少21.2%，安全回合为161/180对170/180。
AI.conclusion: RACF可在不重训练策略的情况下提升部署安全性并降低投影/计算开销，同时量化了安全性与计算之间的权衡。

title: Residual Diffusion Implicit Models
comment: 38 pages, 17 figures. Implementation available at https://github.com/joaolcguerreiro/RDIM
summary: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art results across multiple tasks. However, in inverse problems, standard initialization from pure Gaussian noise misaligns the generative process with real-world degradations. More recent methods such as diffusion bridges impose strict endpoint constraints and often require long reverse processes that are prone to hallucinations. Alternative consistency models provide noise-invariant, one-step mappings but lack inherent variance modeling and can degrade under severe corruption. Hence, residual diffusion implicit models (RDIMs) are proposed, constituting a generalized framework that explicitly models the residuals between high-quality (HQ) and low-quality (LQ) images, aligning the forward process with the actual degradation. A non-Markovian implicit reverse sampler is derived, which can skip intermediate timesteps, enabling accurate few-step or even single-step reconstruction, while mitigating the hallucinations inherent to long diffusion chains. RDIM also introduces a controllable variance mechanism that interpolates between deterministic and stochastic sampling, balancing fidelity and diversity. Furthermore, it enables the straightforward use of perceptual losses, when needed. Experiments on denoising and super-resolution benchmarks demonstrate that RDIMs consistently outperforms the state of the art, including bridge and consistency models, in terms of PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, reducing hallucinations while requiring only a few sampling steps (often just one). The results position RDIMs as an efficient solution for a broad range of image restoration tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出残差扩散隐式模型（RDIM），通过显式建模高质量与低质量图像间的残差并对齐前向过程与实际退化，结合非马尔可夫隐式反向采样器，实现少步甚至单步的高质量图像复原，在去噪与超分任务上超越桥模型和一致性模型。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在逆问题中从纯高斯噪声初始化，导致生成过程与真实退化不匹配；扩散桥模型端点约束严格、反向过程长且易产生幻觉；一致性模型虽能一步映射但缺乏方差建模，在严重退化下性能下降。因此需要一种能对齐真实退化、支持少步采样且可控方差的新框架。
AI.method: 提出残差扩散隐式模型（RDIM）：1）显式建模HQ与LQ图像间的残差，使前向过程与真实退化对齐；2）推导非马尔可夫隐式反向采样器，可跳过中间时间步，实现少步甚至单步重建并缓解长链幻觉；3）引入可控方差机制，在确定性与随机采样间插值，平衡保真度与多样性；4）支持按需使用感知损失。
AI.result: 在去噪与超分辨率基准上，RDIM在PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS指标上一致超越当前最优方法（包括桥模型和一致性模型），同时减少幻觉，且仅需少量采样步数（往往仅一步）。
AI.conclusion: RDIM为广泛的图像复原任务提供了一种高效且性能优越的解决方案。

title: Memory in the Sky: Low-Altitude Question Answering with Multi-Agent Memory Aggregation
summary: This paper studies low-altitude question answering (LAQA), in which distributed unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) memories are aggregated at a ground server to answer questions about observations over a long horizon. Unlike conventional resource allocation based on sensing, communication, control, or computation metrics, LAQA requires an explicit measure of memory value. We propose a generative adversarial exam (GAE) that uses forward simulation to evaluate memory retrieval and exam scores to quantify memory quality. This enables the downstream QA value of candidate memories to be measured and optimized without accessing the internal mechanisms of the black-box captioning, retrieval, and reasoning pipeline. Building on this metric, we develop a memory-centric (MemCen) framework that jointly selects UAVs and allocates transmit power to maximize memory quality under communication constraints. In the noise-limited regime, we derive a QoM-aware capped water-filling law that explicitly connects task utility with physical-layer power allocation. We further develop penalty successive optimization (PSO) and learning to memorize (L2M) solvers. MemCen achieves QA accuracies of 92.4% and 84.0% in CARLA Town04 and Town05 under static and dynamic communication conditions, respectively. In real-world experiments, MemCen achieves 88.5% QA accuracy on the panoramic multi-agent system (PMAS) benchmark. Finally, UAV-to-robot-dog demonstrations further validate the practical utility of the acquired memories for environmental understanding and navigation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出低空问答(LAQA)任务，用生成对抗考试(GAE)量化记忆价值，并构建以记忆为中心(MemCen)的框架联合优化无人机选择与功率分配，实现高精度问答。
AI.motivation: 传统资源分配基于感知、通信、控制或计算指标，而LAQA需要显式的记忆价值度量，且黑盒流水线内部机制不可访问。
AI.method: 提出生成对抗考试(GAE)，用前向仿真评估记忆检索并用考试分数量化记忆质量；在此基础上构建MemCen框架，联合选择无人机并分配发射功率以在通信约束下最大化记忆质量；在噪声受限区推导QoM感知的封顶注水定律，并开发罚函数逐次优化(PSO)与学习记忆(L2M)求解器。
AI.result: MemCen在CARLA Town04和Town05中分别达到92.4%和84.0%的问答准确率（静态与动态通信条件）；在PMAS基准上达到88.5%问答准确率；无人机到机器狗演示验证了所获记忆在环境理解与导航中的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为低空问答提供了可优化的记忆价值度量与资源分配方案，并在仿真与实际系统上验证了有效性。

title: NutriVision: Ingredient-Conditioned Fusion and Prediction for Single-Image Food Nutrition Estimation
summary: Nutrition estimation is a fundamental task in consumer diet tracking, clinical dietetics, chronic disease management, sports and hospital nutrition, and broader food computing systems. The existing approaches have progressed along two largely separate axes, vision models that rely on calibrated RGB-depth captures and ingredient-aware methods that use textual cues but use limited multimodal fusion. We introduce NutriVision, an end-to-end framework that leverages visual geometry and ingredient semantics to estimate calories, mass, fat content, carbohydrates, and protein from a single RGB image and an optional ingredient list. It obtains the unavailable depth modality using DepthAnything-V3 and encodes ingredient descriptions using CLIP. It integrates three complementary mechanisms: (1) an \emph{Ingredient-Conditioned Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module (IC-FAFM)}, which uses textual guidance to reweight and align RGB-depth frequency components; (2) an \emph{Ingredient-Aware Mask-based Prediction Head (IA-MPH)}, whose gating and channel masks are conditioned on food identity; and (3) modality-specific \emph{Internal Semantic Modeling (ISM)} blocks. On the Nutrition5k dataset, NutriVision achieves a mean PMAE of $\mathbf{13.60\pm0.10\%}$, outperforming our IGSMNet implementation by $0.89$ percentage points and OmniFood8k by $2.90$ percentage points (both $p<0.001$). The module-level ablations identify the ingredient-aware prediction head as the primary architectural contributor, improving mean PMAE by $1.50\pm0.17$ percentage points ($p<0.001$). These results demonstrate that ingredient-conditioned prediction and frequency-aware RGB-depth fusion provide measurable gains for single-image nutrient estimation. More broadly, NutriVision offers a practical route toward nutrition-assessment systems that exploit geometric and semantic cues without requiring specialized depth-sensing hardware

AI.tldr: NutriVision 是一个端到端营养估计框架，仅用单张 RGB 图像和可选配料表即可估计热量、质量、脂肪、碳水化合物和蛋白质，在 Nutrition5k 上达到 13.60% 的平均 PMAE。
AI.motivation: 现有营养估计方法分两条独立路线：依赖标定 RGB-D 采集的视觉模型，以及使用文本线索但多模态融合有限的配料感知方法。本文希望在不依赖专用深度传感硬件的前提下，同时利用视觉几何与配料语义信息提升估计精度。
AI.method: 用 DepthAnything-V3 从单张 RGB 图像生成深度模态，用 CLIP 编码配料描述；集成三种机制：配料条件频率对齐融合模块（IC-FAFM）用文本引导重加权并对齐 RGB-深度频率分量；配料感知掩码预测头（IA-MPH）以食物身份为条件生成门控和通道掩码；以及模态特定的内部语义建模（ISM）模块。
AI.result: 在 Nutrition5k 数据集上，NutriVision 的平均 PMAE 为 13.60±0.10%，比 IGSMNet 实现高 0.89 个百分点，比 OmniFood8k 高 2.90 个百分点（均 p<0.001）。模块级消融显示，配料感知预测头是主要架构贡献者，使平均 PMAE 提升 1.50±0.17 个百分点（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 配料条件预测与频率感知的 RGB-深度融合为单图营养估计带来可量化增益；NutriVision 为无需专用深度传感硬件的营养评估系统提供了一条实用路径。

title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents: From Digital Programs to Physical-World Intelligence
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action (WAM) models map observations and instructions directly to robot actions. This directness ties a policy to training: minor layout or viewpoint changes cause failure, and instructions generalize poorly. The root cause lies in representation: task requirements, conditions, progress, and failure recovery are implicitly encoded in action sequences, making them difficult to inspect or revise. Digital coding agents offer a precedent: LLMs call tools, verify results, and revise from feedback as executable code. The same working pattern of explicit state, manageable execution, and revisable procedures underlies generalization and long-horizon execution in the physical world, letting physical experience return as reusable programs, memory, or evidence. We propose Physical Coding, representing task state and execution as code. Code as World records objects, relations, constraints, and progress; Code as Policy organizes planning, verification, recovery, and execution. We build HexaAnything, which calls perception, planning, and control tools, including VLA/WAM policies, and makes in-the-loop decisions from external feedback. Verified traces become data and memory, enabling evolution from tools and Harness to model weights, architectures, and ultimately hardware and task design. On RoboCasa365, HexaAnything improves Composite-Unseen and overall success over XR-1 VLA, and its Harness-trained HexaModel beats the base on every split, indicating code traces internalize physical execution. On PhyBench and a dual-arm AgileX robot, the agent autonomously completes physics experiments and most tabletop tasks, often faster than published results. We observe data, model, and tool self-evolution; future work targets weight internalization, autonomous redesign of architectures, languages, representations, and tasks, and deployment in manufacturing and science.

AI.tldr: 提出"Physical Coding"范式，将任务状态与执行表示为代码，构建HexaAnything智能体，通过调用感知/规划/控制工具（含VLA/WAM策略）实现可检查、可修正的物理任务执行，并在多项基准与真实机器人上取得更优表现。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA与WAM模型将观测和指令直接映射为机器人动作，导致策略与训练强绑定：布局或视角微小变化即失败，指令泛化差。根本原因在于任务需求、条件、进度与失败恢复被隐式编码在动作序列中，难以检查或修改。作者借鉴数字编码智能体的先例——LLM以可执行代码调用工具、验证结果并基于反馈修正——认为物理世界同样需要显式状态、可管理执行和可修正流程。
AI.method: 提出Physical Coding，将任务状态与执行表示为代码：Code as World记录对象、关系、约束与进度；Code as Policy组织规划、验证、恢复与执行。据此构建HexaAnything智能体，调用感知、规划、控制工具（包括VLA/WAM策略），并基于外部反馈进行在环决策；经验证的执行轨迹转化为数据与记忆，实现从工具与Harness到模型权重、架构乃至硬件与任务设计的演化。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa365上，HexaAnything在Composite-Unseen和整体成功率上均优于XR-1 VLA；其经Harness训练的HexaModel在所有划分上均超过基座模型，表明代码轨迹能内化物理执行能力。在PhyBench及双臂AgileX机器人上，智能体可自主完成物理实验和多数桌面任务，且常快于已发表结果。此外观察到数据、模型与工具的自演化现象。
AI.conclusion: 代码作为物理任务的表示形式，能提升泛化性与长程执行能力，并使物理经验以可复用程序、记忆或证据的形式回流。未来工作聚焦于权重内化、自主重新设计架构/语言/表示/任务，以及在制造与科学场景中的部署。

title: Parameter-Efficient 3D Segmentation of Liver and Liver tumors: Depthwise factorization Scales Better Than Dense Convolution with Spatial Dimensionality
summary: Three-dimensional dense convolutional networks are the strongest performers on volumetric medical image segmentation, but their parameter counts scale poorly: moving a dense k x k convolution to k x k x k multiplies its weights by k. We observe that depthwise separable factorization does not share this penalty. Because the cubic kernel term applies only to the depthwise stage while the pointwise projection, which dominates the parameter count, is unchanged, the same architecture grows by 5 % from 2D to 3D where a dense convolutional U-Net grows by 200 %. We exploit this asymmetry to build a 3D U-Net with 536,990 parameters, 24x fewer than an identical dense 3D U-Net. On MSD Task03 Liver (the Medical Segmentation Decathlon liver task, derived from LiTS), evaluated per case under five-fold cross-validation over all 131 public volumes, the model reaches a tumor Dice of 0.577 (95% CI [0.518, 0.633]) and a liver Dice of 0.947 (95% CI [0.941, 0.952]). Its liver Dice exceeds previously reported performance. Its tumor Dice exceeds their low-resolution configuration (0.4701) by 0.107 and their 2D configuration (0.5394), at approximately one twenty-fourth of the parameters and roughly half the in-plane resolution. Trained under identical conditions on a common held-out split, it exceeds a dense 3D U-Net on liver by +0.031 Dice (paired p = 0.006) and on tumor by +0.041 (95 % CI [+0.005, +0.081], paired p = 0.056), suggesting the factorization also acts as a regularizer in the small-data regime characteristic of medical imaging. We further show, on both LiTS and a 2D endoscopy benchmark, that a large fraction of the network's learnable spatial filters can be replaced by fixed shifts at no cost in accuracy, but that replacing all of them is measurably worse, the placement of spatial capacity matters more than its total amount.

AI.tldr: 将深度可分离卷积用于3D医学图像分割，参数增长远小于密集卷积，构建仅53.7万参数的3D U-Net，在MSD Task03肝脏任务上肝脏Dice达0.947、肿瘤Dice达0.577，超过对比方法且具正则化效果。
AI.motivation: 三维密集卷积网络在体素医学图像分割中性能最强，但参数随卷积核维度增长膨胀严重（k×k×k会令权重大增至k倍）。作者观察到深度可分离因子化不具备这一惩罚，希望借此在保持精度的同时大幅降低3D网络参数量。
AI.method: 利用深度可分离因子化的不对称性：立方核项仅作用于depthwise阶段，而占参数主导的pointwise投影保持不变，因此从2D到3D仅增长约5%。据此构建3D U-Net（536,990参数，比同构密集3D U-Net少24倍）。在MSD Task03 Liver（源自LiTS）全部131例公开体数据上做五折交叉验证、逐病例评估；并在LiTS与一个2D内窥镜基准上测试以固定位移替换可学习空间滤波器的效果。
AI.result: MSD Task03肿瘤Dice 0.577（95% CI [0.518, 0.633]），肝脏Dice 0.947（95% CI [0.941, 0.952]），肝脏Dice超过此前报告性能；肿瘤Dice较其低分辨率配置（0.4701）高0.107，超其2D配置（0.5394），而参数量约为其1/24、面内分辨率约为一半。相同条件同等留出划分下，相比密集3D U-Net肝脏+0.031 Dice（配对p=0.006）、肿瘤+0.041（95% CI [+0.005, +0.081]，配对p=0.056）。在LiTS与2D内窥镜基准上，大部分可学习空间滤波器可用固定位移替换而无精度损失，但全部替换则明显变差。
AI.conclusion: 深度可分离因子化能在3D医学分割中实现极高参数效率，并在小数据场景下起到正则化作用，性能超过密集3D U-Net及既有方法。此外，空间容量的"放置位置"比其"总量"更重要——可部分替换为固定位移但不宜全部替换。

title: Revision, Not Restart: Revisable Visual Plans for Closed-Loop World-Action Models
summary: World-action models use predicted visual futures to condition robot actions, yet execution feedback can invalidate parts of a prediction while leaving its task structure useful. We propose Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP), which maintains the visual future as a persistent action condition and revises it after feedback. Its central mechanism is a learned revision bridge: it resumes an intermediate state saved during visual generation and adapts its continuation to current observations. Visual and action supervision connect this revision to subsequent control. Time-aware history supplies observed evidence, and an adaptive policy selects retention, bridge revision, or fresh replanning from new noise before decoding the next action. On RoboMME and RMBench, RTP achieves task-averaged success rates of 48.6% and 84.8%, respectively. Matched comparisons support learned continuation; estimated checkpoint-source and action-prefix effects are positive but less precisely resolved. These results connect feedback-driven visual-plan revision to closed-loop task performance. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/RTP/

AI.tldr: 该论文提出可修订时序规划（Revisable Temporal Planning, RTP），将预测的视觉未来作为持续的动作条件，并在执行反馈后对其加以修订，从而改善机器人闭环任务表现。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型利用预测的视觉未来来条件化机器人动作，但执行反馈可能使预测的部分内容失效，而其中的任务结构仍然有用。因此需要一种机制，在保留有用任务结构的同时根据反馈修订视觉预测。
AI.method: RTP 将视觉未来作为持久动作条件，并在反馈后修订。其核心是一个学习到的修订桥（revision bridge）：恢复视觉生成过程中保存的中间状态，并使其延续适配当前观测。视觉与动作监督将修订过程与后续控制相衔接。时间感知历史提供观测证据，自适应策略在新噪声基础上选择保留、桥接修订或全新重规划，再解码下一步动作。
AI.result: 在 RoboMME 和 RMBench 上，RTP 分别取得 48.6% 和 84.8% 的任务平均成功率。匹配对比支持学习式延续的有效性；估计的检查点来源效应与动作前缀效应为正，但精度较低。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果将反馈驱动的视觉计划修订与闭环任务性能联系起来，表明在执行反馈下持续修订视觉未来有助于提升机器人控制表现。

title: SemReward-VL: Semantic Reward-Guided Video-Language Adaptation for Developmental Behavior Assessment
summary: Developmental screening videos show how children perform specific behaviors, but clinical records usually contain outcomes rather than descriptions of what happened. We present SemReward-VL, which learns to describe item-specific behavior from these outcomes. A vision-language model generates a description, and a frozen language model scores its agreement with the clinical outcome, relevance to the item, abstention on unrelated video-item pairs, and clarity. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) updates LoRA adapters using this semantic reward. On 13,379 videos covering 41 items, the method improves aggregate accuracy and the number of items with recall above 0.5. Errors remain in temporal direction, duration, and age-specific interpretations of behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出SemReward-VL，利用语义奖励与GRPO训练LoRA适配器，使视觉语言模型能从临床结果学习描述发育筛查视频中特定行为项的行为。
AI.motivation: 发育筛查视频记录了儿童具体行为，但临床记录通常只包含结果，而缺少对实际发生行为的描述，导致难以直接从结果中学到行为级别的信息。
AI.method: 视觉语言模型生成行为描述，冻结的语言模型从与临床结果的一致性、与行为项的相关性、对无关视频-行为项对的弃权、以及清晰度四方面进行评分；再用组相对策略优化（GRPO）基于该语义奖励更新LoRA适配器。
AI.result: 在覆盖41个行为项的13,379段视频上，该方法提升了总体准确率以及召回率高于0.5的行为项数量；但仍在时间方向、持续时长和年龄特异性行为解释方面存在错误。
AI.conclusion: 语义奖励结合GRPO可有效利用临床结果提升行为描述与筛查表现，但时序与年龄相关理解仍是待解决的问题。

title: Uni-VLaT: Whole-Body Tactile Adaptation of VLA Policies for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Physical contact often determines how a humanoid should respond during loco-manipulation, yet vision and proprioception alone are often insufficient to characterize physical interaction, especially when the contact region is occluded. Unlike sparse force or torque measurements at predefined regions, distributed tactile sensing preserves spatially resolved contact patterns across the robot body. We therefore study how to integrate such whole-body tactile information into vision-language-action (VLA) policies for contact-rich control. Our approach, Uni-VLaT, introduces a tactile pathway whose latent state is trained not only for action generation, but also to predict future tactile, proprioceptive, and visual representations. This predictive objective builds a tactile-anchored multimodal context, encouraging a more structured understanding of the physical world. We evaluate Uni-VLaT on five real-robot tasks covering tactile-triggered locomotion, sustained physical interaction, human-robot contact, and loco-manipulation. Uni-VLaT achieves a 75% average success rate, outperforming a baseline without tactile input by 43 points and a tactile-input baseline without predictive supervision by 7 points. Across two pretrained VLA backbones, our method improves Table Sweeping by 30 points on both backbones and Back-Tap Walking by 85-90 points. Ablations further show that contextualized tactile prediction and absolute future targets are critical to performance. These results indicate that predictive tactile learning provides an effective route for extending pretrained VLA policies to whole-body physical interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出 Uni-VLaT，将全身分布式触觉感知引入 VLA 策略，并通过预测未来触觉/本体/视觉表征来构建触觉锚定的多模态上下文，在五类真实机器人任务上平均成功率达 75%。
AI.motivation: 在移动操作（loco-manipulation）中，物理接触往往决定人形机器人的响应方式，但仅靠视觉和本体感知难以刻画物理交互，尤其在接触区域被遮挡时。与预设区域的稀疏力/力矩测量不同，分布式触觉感知能保留全身空间分辨的接触模式，因此需要研究如何将全身触觉信息整合进 VLA 策略以支持富接触控制。
AI.method: Uni-VLaT 在 VLA 中引入一条触觉通路，其隐状态不仅用于动作生成，还被训练去预测未来的触觉、本体感知和视觉表征。该预测目标构建了触觉锚定的多模态上下文，促使模型形成更结构化的物理世界理解。
AI.result: 在五类真实机器人任务（触觉触发移动、持续物理交互、人机接触、移动操作）上评估：平均成功率 75%，比无触觉基线高 43 个百分点，比有触觉输入但无预测监督的基线高 7 个百分点。在两个预训练 VLA 骨干上，Table Sweeping 均提升 30 个百分点，Back-Tap Walking 提升 85–90 个百分点。消融实验表明，上下文化的触觉预测与绝对未来目标对性能至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 预测式触觉学习是将预训练 VLA 策略扩展到全身物理交互的有效途径。

title: dKFD: Phase-Structured Evidence Allocation for Fixed-Budget Localized Event Understanding
summary: Sparse video understanding often requires selecting a small set of visual evidence under a fixed frame budget. Most sparse selectors allocate this budget globally, allowing all frames to compete with one another. For temporally localized events, this can be a poor inductive bias: useful evidence is often distributed across pre-event context, the event itself, and post-event consequences. We study fixed-budget evidence allocation for localized event videos and show that globally competitive Top-$K$ selectors can preserve recognition and grounding while producing unstable event evidence. On DoTA Video Anomaly Recognition, Global Top-$K$ obtains competitive recognition and temporal grounding, but low selector-event alignment at $K=12$ (Frame AUC $51.5 \pm 10.8$). We propose dKFD, a phase-structured differentiable selector that reserves evidence capacity across pre-event, event, and post-event phases after full-sequence temporal encoding. Under matched-budget multi-seed evaluation, dKFD improves Frame AUC by $+30.97$ over a matched Global Top-$K$ selector at $K=12$ ($p<0.01$), while yielding modest but statistically significant recognition gains and comparable temporal grounding. Mechanism ablations show that phase supervision is load-bearing: removing it reduces Frame AUC to $41.1 \pm 12.0$ even when phase-partitioned budgets are retained. Downstream diagnostics on VRU-Accident show consistent gains over learned Global Top-$K$ across VLM families, while dense captioning reveals a boundary condition where uniform sampling remains competitive. These results support phase-structured allocation as a controlled fixed-budget approach for event-centric sparse evidence selection, not as a universal video summarization strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文研究固定预算下的事件视频稀疏证据选择，指出全局竞争的Top-K选择器证据不稳定，提出相结构可微选择器dKFD，在DoTA上大幅提升事件对齐并保持识别与定位性能。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视频理解需在固定帧预算下选取少量视觉证据。多数选择器全局分配预算，让所有帧相互竞争，这对时间局部化事件是不良归纳偏置，因为有用证据常分布在事件前、事件本身和事件后三个阶段。作者希望改进这种固定预算证据分配方式。
AI.method: 提出dKFD，一种相结构可微选择器。在完整序列时间编码后，将证据容量分别预留在事件前、事件、事件后三个阶段，并进行阶段监督。采用匹配预算的多随机种子评估和机制消融。
AI.result: 在DoTA视频异常识别上，Global Top-K识别与定位有竞争力，但K=12时选择器-事件对齐低（Frame AUC 51.5±10.8）。dKFD在K=12时Frame AUC提升+30.97（p<0.01），识别有适度但显著提升，定位相当。去掉阶段监督后Frame AUC降至41.1±12.0。VRU-Accident上跨VLM家族有一致增益；密集描述任务中均匀采样仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 相结构分配是一种可控的固定预算事件中心稀疏证据选择方法，而非通用视频摘要策略，存在边界条件。

title: Rethinking Causal Action Tokenization with Conditional Annealing in Flow Matching
summary: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a scalable path to robot learning, yet existing action tokenizers treat tokenization as a compression problem, producing representations that are semantically misaligned with the autoregressive backbone. We propose CATok, a causal action tokenizer that reframes tokenization as a causally structured generative process. CATok introduces a conditional annealing mechanism that extracts action tokens by progressively annealing a flow-matching process: each token is conditioned on all preceding tokens and encodes the residual reconstruction signal at a specific noise level, establishing a coarse-to-fine causal token space whose generative semantics are structurally aligned with autoregressive modeling. A token-conditioned flow-matching decoder built on Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT) reconstructs continuous action chunks from these discrete tokens with the precision of hybrid diffusion-head architectures. This discrete bottleneck enforces knowledge insulation by design, cleanly separating high-level semantic reasoning from low-level motor execution without requiring explicit attention masking. Extensive evaluations across three simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that CATok consistently surpasses existing tokenization methods in both reconstruction fidelity-compression tradeoff and inference efficiency, while improving VLA task success rate and training efficiency, establishing a high-performance, scalable foundation for purely autoregressive VLA systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CATok——一种因果动作分词器，将动作分词重新定义为因果结构化的生成过程，通过条件退火机制提取动作token，并配合MMDiT解码器重建连续动作，在仿真与真实机器人任务中超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归VLA模型的动作分词器将分词视为压缩问题，产生的表示与自回归主干在语义上不对齐。此外，需要在不依赖显式注意力掩码的情况下分离高层语义推理与低层运动执行。
AI.method: CATok引入条件退火机制，通过逐步退火流匹配过程提取动作token：每个token以所有前序token为条件，并编码特定噪声水平下的残差重建信号，建立由粗到细的因果token空间。采用基于MMDiT的token条件流匹配解码器从离散token重建连续动作块。
AI.result: 在三个仿真基准和真实机器人操作任务上，CATok在重建保真度-压缩权衡和推理效率上持续超越现有分词方法，同时提升VLA任务成功率和训练效率。
AI.conclusion: CATok通过离散瓶颈实现知识隔离，为纯自回归VLA系统建立了高性能、可扩展的基础。

title: QSCP: Beyond Class-Name Prompts for Query-Guided Semantic Change Parsing
summary: Traditional change detection (CD) identifies changes between bi-temporal remote sensing images, while semantic change detection (SCD) assigns predefined land-cover classes. However, mapping all changes may not meet a user's specific needs. Referring change detection (RCD) enables selective retrieval through category prompts. However, existing category-prompted RCD uses the queried category to specify the destination of a change and returns only a binary mask of the corresponding regions. Users may instead request a particular transition and paired semantic maps to understand what changed into what. Such requests require explicit source and target reasoning beyond target-class localization. To address these needs, we propose query-guided semantic change parsing (QSCP), which supports category names, synonyms, and intent-bearing sentences and returns a query-specific mask with paired temporal semantic maps. QSCP parses requests into intents and semantic slots, composes bidirectional visual evidence, and predicts both temporal states with a query-conditioned decoder. On SECOND, QSCP outperforms RCDNet on synonym, sentence, and transition queries and improves end-to-end semantic prediction over evaluated semantic baselines. WHU-CDC experiments further assess cross-dataset transfer and consistency across equivalent expressions without target-domain training. Code is available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/QSCP

AI.tldr: 本文提出查询引导的语义变化解析（QSCP），支持类别名、同义词和意图句查询，返回查询特定掩膜与配对时序语义图。
AI.motivation: 传统变化检测（CD）只识别双时相影像间变化，语义变化检测（SCD）赋予预定义地物类别，但映射所有变化未必满足用户特定需求。现有类别提示RCD仅用查询类别指定变化目的地并仅返回二值掩膜，无法回答"从什么变成什么"，需要显式的源—目标推理。
AI.method: QSCP将请求解析为意图与语义槽，组合双向视觉证据，并使用查询条件化解码器预测两个时相的状态，支持类别名、同义词及意图句输入。
AI.result: 在SECOND数据集上，QSCP在同义词、句子和转换查询上均优于RCDNet，并较所评估的语义基线提升端到端语义预测。WHU-CDC实验进一步评估了跨数据集迁移及在无目标域训练下等价表达的语义一致性。
AI.conclusion: QSCP实现了更灵活、语义更丰富的查询引导变化解析，可返回配对时序语义图，代码已开源。

title: CoBrush: A Hierarchical Planning Framework for Human-Robot Co-Painting
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Embodied co-painting requires a robot to repeatedly update a shared physical canvas while human intent evolves over interaction. Existing reference-driven painters or reactive assistants are typically optimized for single-shot rendering or sketch completion, limiting their ability to sustain coherent multi-round collaboration or to construct complex, content-rich scenes over time. We present CoBrush, a hierarchical framework that formulates multi-round co-painting as a coordinated semantic, spatial, and execution process. By separating high-level intent inference from spatial grounding and stroke-level control, the system supports progressive scene development on real acrylic canvases. We evaluate the framework through real human-robot painting sessions, stress tests, and user studies. Compared to single-turn baselines, our approach achieves stronger semantic alignment, more stable spatial progression, and higher perceived plausibility of robot actions. These results demonstrate that structured multi-stage reasoning improves the coherence and robustness of interactive painting and supports the progressive development of content-rich physical artworks.

AI.tldr: 提出 CoBrush——一个分层机器人协同绘画框架，将多轮协同绘画拆解为语义、空间与执行三阶段协同过程，在真实丙烯画布上实现渐进式场景创作。
AI.motivation: 现有参考驱动的绘画机器人或被动式助手多针对单次渲染或草图补全优化，难以在人意图随交互演变时维持连贯的多轮协作，也无法随时间构建内容丰富的复杂场景。
AI.method: 将多轮协同绘画建模为语义、空间与执行相协调的过程：分离高层意图推断、空间落地与笔画级控制，使系统能在真实丙烯画布上支持场景的渐进式发展。评估方式包括真实人-机器人绘画实验、压力测试与用户研究。
AI.result: 相比单轮基线方法，该框架取得更强的语义对齐、更稳定的空间推进，以及更高的机器人动作感知合理性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的多阶段推理可提升交互式绘画的连贯性与鲁棒性，并支持内容丰富的实体艺术作品的渐进式创作。

title: Query, Align, and Distill: Navigation-Aware Cross-Modal Interaction for Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Recent large-scale Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) models deliver strong accuracy but remain costly to deploy due to their large parameter counts and computational requirements. We tackle efficient VLN in two steps. First, we build a high-performing teacher that makes navigation evidence selection explicit and compressible. The teacher introduces a small set of learnable query slots to extract global and local action-sufficient navigable evidence from panoramic observations via a Navigable Query Generator, then progressively grounds these evidence tokens to the instruction with an Instruction-Query Aligner for policy prediction. Second, using this explicit query bottleneck as a distillation interface, we train a compact student by transferring both where to attend and what to do. We distill the teacher's global and local navigable queries with a navigation-aware token-adaptive objective, then further match action distributions during fine-tuning. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that our student nearly matches the teacher's navigation performance while reducing the number of parameters by 93.65% compared to the teacher.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种高效视觉语言导航(VLN)方法:先构建带显式查询瓶颈的高性能教师模型,再通过蒸馏训练紧凑学生模型,学生性能接近教师,参数量减少93.65%。
AI.motivation: 大规模VLN模型精度高但参数量大、计算需求高,部署成本昂贵,亟需在保持性能的同时实现高效导航。
AI.method: 两步法:1) 教师模型引入少量可学习查询槽,通过Navigable Query Generator从全景观测提取全局与局部"动作充分"的可导航证据,并用Instruction-Query Aligner逐步将证据token与指令对齐以预测策略;2) 以该显式查询瓶颈为蒸馏接口,用导航感知的token自适应目标蒸馏教师的全局/局部可导航查询,并在微调阶段匹配动作分布,训练紧凑学生模型。
AI.result: 在标准VLN基准上,学生模型导航性能几乎与教师持平,同时参数量相比教师减少93.65%。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式可压缩的查询瓶颈作为蒸馏接口,可有效实现高效VLN,在显著压缩参数的同时保持导航精度。

title: Robot Tool Design from Scratch via Behavior-Aware Hierarchical Optimization
summary: The ability to design a tool for a task marks a level of intelligence beyond merely understanding, selecting, or using one. Existing methods for robotic tool design typically optimize a tool's continuous shape and action within a structure that is prescribed or generated beforehand, so the structure itself stays outside the physical optimization loop. We study task-driven tool design from scratch, where tool structure, shape, and action are all derived from the desired physical outcome. Here we show that the three elements can be designed jointly by HOT, a hierarchical optimization whose upper level searches over discrete tool structures with BASS, while lower-level physical optimization evaluates their task behavior and returns milestone progress as behavioral evidence for the search, ultimately providing jointly optimized shape and action. On four tool-use tasks with distinct physical functions, HOT discovers functional structures after evaluating only a small fraction of search spaces containing up to 56 million structures, and the subsequent refinement of their geometry lowers the task loss on all tasks while preserving success, through deformations that are functionally interpretable. Once 3D printed, the tools accomplish all tasks on a real robot with the actions found in simulation. Designing tools from required physical effects, rather than a catalog of known tools, is a step toward the open-ended tool making seen in humans and animals.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出HOT框架，从零开始联合设计工具的结构、形状与动作，通过层级优化在巨大离散结构空间中搜索并精化，实现任务驱动的工具设计。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人工具设计方法通常在预设或预先生成的结构上优化工具的连续形状和动作，结构本身未纳入物理优化循环，因此无法从任务物理需求出发自动生成工具结构。
AI.method: 提出HOT层级优化方法：上层使用BASS在离散工具结构空间中进行搜索，下层进行物理优化以评估任务行为，并将里程碑进展作为行为证据反馈给上层搜索，最终联合输出优化后的形状与动作。
AI.result: 在四项具有不同物理功能的工具使用任务中，HOT仅评估搜索空间的一小部分（搜索空间最多含5600万个结构）即发现功能性结构；几何精化在所有任务上降低了任务损失并保持成功率，且变形具有功能可解释性；3D打印后，工具在真实机器人上以仿真中找到的动作完成所有任务。
AI.conclusion: 从所需物理效果而非已知工具目录出发设计工具，是迈向人类和动物开放式工具制造能力的一步。

title: Octree-based Video Representation
summary: Video models commonly use uniform grids even though visual complexity varies substantially across space and time. We introduce OctVideo, which approximates a video clip with an octree. This hierarchy recursively partitions a spatio-temporal volume into eight subvolumes, so that smooth regions remain coarse while detailed regions receive finer cells. Each leaf stores local RGB values and spatio-temporal gradients, supplemented by a lightweight learned residual. For reconstruction, a Conv1D VAE maps the serialized cells to a regular latent grid and selectively refines details during decoding. Our VAE achieves 36.12 dB PSNR with 38.2M parameters and 189.4 GFLOPs per clip on Kinetics-400 (K400). It also generalizes zero-shot to the high-resolution Densely Annotated VIdeo Segmentation (DAVIS) 2016 dataset with reconstruction quality comparable to the best evaluated models. On both datasets, it requires the fewest model FLOPs and achieves the fastest encoding and decoding among the evaluated models. OctVideo also supports video understanding, achieving competitive recognition performance with few input tokens when trained from scratch. By exploiting the redundancy already present in video signals and efficiently processing sparse structures, OctVideo provides an efficient representation for video.

AI.tldr: OctVideo用八叉树对视频时空体进行递归划分，平滑区域粗划分、细节区域细划分，配合Conv1D VAE完成高效视频重建与理解。
AI.motivation: 现有视频模型普遍采用均匀网格，但视觉复杂度在空间和时间上差异显著，均匀网格造成冗余计算与资源浪费。
AI.method: 用八叉树将视频片段表示为时空体，递归分为八个子体，平滑区域保持粗糙、细节区域获得更细单元；每个叶节点存储局部RGB值与时空梯度，并辅以轻量学习残差；重建时用Conv1D VAE将序列化单元映射到规则潜网格，并在解码中选择性细化细节。
AI.result: 在Kinetics-400上达到36.12 dB PSNR，仅38.2M参数、每片段189.4 GFLOPs；零样本泛化到DAVIS 2016高分辨率数据集，重建质量与最佳模型相当，且在两个数据集上FLOPs最少、编解码最快；支持视频理解，从零训练时用少量输入token即可获得有竞争力的识别性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用视频信号中已有的冗余并高效处理稀疏结构，OctVideo为视频提供了一种高效表示。

title: ForVis: An In-Field Dataset and Benchmark for VIO Using Under-Canopy UAV Flights in Forests
summary: Visual-inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VI-SLAM) for UAVs remains difficult to evaluate in real forest environments, where motion, illumination changes, repetitive vegetation, and vibration can all affect estimation. We present ForVis, an in-field dataset and benchmark for evaluating VI-SLAM during UAV flight in forest environments. The dataset contains twelve flights across open meadow, above-canopy, and under-canopy conditions in each environment. In total, it provides 563.8s of flight over 1096.8m of trajectory, recorded simultaneously with an Intel RealSense D435i and an OAK-D Pro Wide together with inertial and flight-controller data. We benchmark seven open-source VI-SLAM systems over 504 runs. The results show that sensor choice has a larger effect on trajectory error than the spread between algorithms: all seven methods achieve lower median error on the OAK-D Pro than on the D435i. ForVis is intended to support evaluation of speed, accuracy and robustness for VI-SLAM in challenging forest flight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ForVis，一个面向森林环境下无人机VI-SLAM评估的实地数据集与基准，并基于双传感器与多次飞行对七种开源VI-SLAM系统进行评测。
AI.motivation: 森林环境中运动、光照变化、重复植被纹理和振动会影响VI-SLAM估计，而该类真实场景下的无人机VI-SLAM评估仍然困难，缺少专门的实地数据集和基准。
AI.method: 采集十二次飞行数据，覆盖开阔草甸、冠层上方和冠层下方三种条件；总计563.8秒飞行、1096.8米轨迹，使用Intel RealSense D435i与OAK-D Pro Wide同步记录，并采集惯性与飞控数据；对七种开源VI-SLAM系统进行504次运行的基准测试。
AI.result: 传感器选择对轨迹误差的影响大于算法之间的差异：七种方法在OAK-D Pro上的中位误差均低于D435i。
AI.conclusion: ForVis可用于支持森林飞行场景下VI-SLAM在速度、精度和鲁棒性方面的评估。

title: Toward Comprehensive 3D Grounding: Orientation Grounding through Vision-Language Models
summary: Grounding is a core capability of spatial vision-language models, yet most existing work focuses only on where a referred object is. Many 3D tasks also require knowing how it is oriented. Although existing 3D VLMs may predict oriented boxes, box pose does not explicitly capture object-centric orientation or symmetry-induced ambiguities. We introduce orientation grounding, a referring grounding task that predicts an object's 6D orientation and axial symmetry from a language or box query in single-view or multi-view scenes. To support this task, we construct ReferOri, with 331K multi-view and 387K single-view orientation-grounding queries obtained through scalable reconstruction, consistency checking, and human verification. We further present OG-VLM, which adapts a 3D VLM with structured box/orientation outputs, sign and symmetry tokens, and geometry-aware auxiliary losses. Across single-view and multi-view benchmarks, OG-VLM substantially outperforms orientation-aware VLM baselines and surpasses object-level orientation foundation models on scene-level referring benchmarks, showing that explicit orientation grounding is a distinct and learnable capability beyond localization. Downstream results validate its benefit for orientation-related spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"朝向基础（orientation grounding）"任务，要求模型根据语言或框查询预测物体的6D朝向和轴对称性，并构建了ReferOri数据集（331K多视角+387K单视角查询），提出OG-VLM模型在多个基准上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有空间视觉语言模型（VLM）工作大多只关注"物体在哪里"（定位），而许多3D任务还需要知道物体"如何朝向"。尽管现有3D VLM可以预测有向框，但框的姿态无法显式捕捉以物体为中心的朝向信息以及对称性带来的歧义。
AI.method: 1）定义"朝向基础"任务，从语言或框查询预测物体的6D朝向与轴对称性，支持单视角和多视角场景；2）构建ReferOri数据集，通过可扩展重建、一致性检查与人工验证获得331K多视角和387K单视角查询；3）提出OG-VLM，在3D VLM基础上加入结构化框/朝向输出、符号与对称性token，以及几何感知辅助损失。
AI.result: 在单视角和多视角基准上，OG-VLM大幅超越具备朝向感知能力的VLM基线，并在场景级指代基准上超过物体级朝向基础模型，表明显式的朝向基础是一种独立且可学习的能力，超越了单纯的定位。下游结果验证了其对于朝向相关空间推理的益处。
AI.conclusion: 显式朝向基础是一种区别于定位的独立且可学习的能力；通过专门数据集与引入结构化输出、对称性token和几何损失，模型能够有效完成朝向基础任务并提升朝向相关空间推理性能。

title: Terrain-Aware Autonomous Planetary Exploration for Exteroceptive-Proprioceptive Mapping with Quadruped Scouts
comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo 2026)
summary: Autonomous planetary exploration requires robots to navigate unknown, uneven terrain while assessing risk, traversability, and energetic cost. Quadruped scouts are well suited for this task because they can traverse irregular surfaces and gather mobility-relevant information during locomotion. This paper presents a terrain-aware exploration framework that combines exteroceptive and proprioceptive mapping for a quadruped robot in lunar-like environments. An onboard RGB-D camera builds robot-centered elevation maps, estimates geometric traversability, and derives navigation costs for autonomous planning. In parallel, proprioceptive measurements provide interaction-aware terrain cues that complement geometry-based assessment. Local maps are incrementally registered into a global multi-layer representation, which is used by an exploration module to select targets in unexplored regions of interest. The targets are reached by an autonomous navigation system that guides collision-aware motion using the available map and cost layers. Simulation results on NVIDIA Isaac Sim show autonomous exploration, map expansion, and spatial association between terrain geometry and robot-terrain interaction. Subsequent navigation using this information exhibits lower average Cost of Transport (CoT) than initial exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向四足机器人的地形感知探索框架，融合外部感知与本体感知建图，在类月球环境中实现自主探索与低能耗导航。
AI.motivation: 自主行星探索要求机器人能在未知、崎岖地形中导航，同时评估风险、可通行性与能量消耗。四足机器人适合此类任务，但需要同时利用几何信息与机器人-地形交互信息来提升评估与规划能力。
AI.method: 采用机载RGB-D相机构建以机器人为中心的高程地图，估计几何可通行性并推导导航代价；同时利用本体感知测量获得交互感知的地形线索以补充几何评估。局部地图被增量式配准到全局多层表示中，探索模块据此在未探索兴趣区域选择目标，自主导航系统利用地图与代价层引导避障运动。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA Isaac Sim上的仿真结果展示了自主探索、地图扩展，以及地形几何与机器人-地形交互之间的空间关联；基于该信息进行的后续导航，其平均运输代价（CoT）低于初始探索阶段。
AI.conclusion: 融合外部感知与本体感知的多层地形建模有助于四足机器人在类月球环境中自主探索，并能利用交互信息降低后续导航的能量代价。

title: Train Together or Merge Later? Unifying VLA Experts via a Shared Action Interface
summary: Co-training offers a straightforward way to build a multi-task vision-language-action (VLA) policy, but can fall short of the performance achieved by training each task independently. The challenge is to retain these task-specific gains in a multi-task policy without joint post-training. Combining independently trained experts through model merging is a natural approach, yet strong individual experts do not necessarily yield a strong merged policy. We identify one source of this incompatibility: task-specific changes to the action interface, comprising action normalization and the action encoder and decoder. We propose PolicyWeave, combining merge-compatible post-training with context-guided sparse merging. During post-training, all experts retain the common base policy's action interface, while task adaptation is restricted to LoRA updates in the hidden layers of the action model. This makes the experts more compatible with existing model merging methods. However, merging all experts can still introduce interference from unrelated tasks at deployment. PolicyWeave scores each expert's LoRA updates using the initial visual-language context, determines the expert set through leave-one-layer-out ranking stability, and forms a sparse weighted merge of the selected updates that remains fixed for current task. We evaluate PolicyWeave with GR00T N1.5 on 18 RoboCasa365 tasks, using only 10% of the target-task demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Preserving the shared action interface raises the average success rate across four static merging methods from 17.0% to 52.8%. PolicyWeave achieves 64.7% success with these SFT experts and 74.1% after task-specific reinforcement learning (RL), compared with 60.7% for joint RL. Further evaluations on LIBERO-10 and an AgileX Piper arm support the deployment of independently learned skills in long-horizon and real-world manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PolicyWeave，通过让专家保持共享动作接口、只在隐藏层做 LoRA 更新，并结合基于上下文评分的稀疏合并，使独立训练的 VLA 专家能高效合并成多任务策略，成功率显著提升。
AI.motivation: 多任务 VLA 策略常通过 co-training 获得，但其性能往往不如各任务单独训练。如何在无需联合后训练的情况下，保留各任务专属收益，是核心挑战。直接合并独立专家效果不理想，作者发现任务特定的动作接口改动（动作归一化、动作编解码器）是导致专家不兼容的重要来源。
AI.method: 提出 PolicyWeave，包含两部分：(1) 合并兼容的后训练——所有专家保留公共基础策略的动作接口，仅对动作模型隐藏层做 LoRA 更新；(2) 上下文引导的稀疏合并——用初始视觉-语言上下文对每个专家的 LoRA 更新评分，通过 leave-one-layer-out 排序稳定性确定专家集合，形成对所选更新的稀疏加权合并，并在当前任务中保持固定。
AI.result: 在 GR00T N1.5 与 18 个 RoboCasa365 任务上，仅用 10% 目标任务示范做 SFT：保留共享动作接口使四种静态合并方法的平均成功率从 17.0% 提升到 52.8%；PolicyWeave 达 64.7%，经任务特定 RL 后达 74.1%，高于联合 RL 的 60.7%。LIBERO-10 与 AgileX Piper 机械臂上的评估进一步支持独立学习技能在长时程与真实世界操作中的部署。
AI.conclusion: 保留共享动作接口是提升专家合并兼容性的关键，结合上下文引导的稀疏合并可有效减少无关任务干扰，PolicyWeave 在仿真与真实机器人任务上均优于基于 SFT 与联合 RL 的基线，验证了独立学习技能可部署到多任务策略中。

title: Inspection-SPARS: Task-Oriented Sparse Roadmaps for Inspection Planning
summary: Inspection planning seeks a minimum-length collision-free robot tour that observes a given set of points of interest (POIs). Sampling-based methods reduce this continuous problem to a graph inspection planning (GIP) problem over a discrete roadmap, which is then solved using combinatorial solvers. Dense roadmaps capture diverse inspection viewpoints and motion shortcuts, and thus admit higher-quality solutions, but they induce large combinatorial search spaces on which state-of-the-art GIP solvers struggle to find good solutions within practical time budgets. Roadmap sparsification---restructuring a dense roadmap into a compact representation that preserves connectivity and path lengths---can alleviate this burden. However, existing sparsification approaches are either agnostic to the underlying inspection task, or strive to ensure coverage of the POIs without accounting for the quality of the resulting inspection plan. We present Inspection-SPARS, which is, to our knowledge, the first inspection-roadmap sparsifier with POI coverage and path-quality guarantees relative to the dense roadmap. To this end, we generalize the SPARS framework, a popular task-agnostic sparsifier, from purely geometric criteria to task-oriented ones, introducing an inspection-aware vertex admission mechanism that treats POI coverage as a first-class sparsification criterion alongside connectivity and path quality. Experiments in realistic 3D environments show that Inspection-SPARS reduces vertex and edge counts by 4-8x while preserving coverage, allowing the GIP solver to compute tours up to 25% shorter than with the dense roadmap or state-of-the-art inspection roadmap. More broadly, Inspection-SPARS shows that sparsification can be made task-aware without sacrificing guarantees on solution quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Inspection-SPARS，首个兼顾 POI 覆盖与路径质量保证的巡检路网稀疏化方法，将 SPARS 框架从几何标准推广到任务导向标准。实验显示在 3D 环境中顶点和边减少 4-8 倍，同时生成的最短巡检路径比稠密路网或现有方法短达 25%。
AI.motivation: 采样式巡检规划需将连续问题离散为图巡检规划（GIP）问题求解。稠密路网能提供更多巡检视角与运动捷径、解质量更高，但会带来巨大的组合搜索空间，使现有 GIP 求解器难以在实用时间内找到好解。路网稀疏化可缓解该负担，但现有方法要么与巡检任务无关，要么仅保证 POI 覆盖而不考虑最终巡检方案质量。
AI.method: 提出 Inspection-SPARS：将流行的任务无关稀疏化框架 SPARS 从纯几何准则推广为任务导向准则，引入"巡检感知"的顶点准入机制，把 POI 覆盖作为与连通性、路径质量并列的一等稀疏化标准，从而在稀疏化后仍相对稠密路网保持 POI 覆盖与路径质量保证。
AI.result: 在真实感 3D 环境中，Inspection-SPARS 将顶点数和边数减少 4-8 倍，同时保持覆盖；使 GIP 求解器计算出的巡检路径比使用稠密路网或当前最优巡检路网时缩短最多 25%。
AI.conclusion: Inspection-SPARS 表明稀疏化可以在不牺牲解质量保证的前提下实现任务感知，为巡检规划在稠密路网下的可扩展性提供了有效途径。

title: DroneWAM: Efficient World Action Model for Drone Visual Navigation
summary: World-action models give visual navigation agents a way to anticipate how candidate actions will change future observations and to act from the predicted consequences. For drones, this capability must operate under tight accuracy and efficiency constraints. We present DroneWAM, an efficient world-action model for drone visual navigation. DroneWAM adopts a JEPA-based architecture to model future states directly in representation space, avoiding the cost of explicit future image generation. A pretrained Resampler further compresses dense encoder features into fewer latent tokens, reducing the computation repeated at each imagined step. We also introduce adaptive rollout, where a preference-trained Gate adaptively allocates prediction depth according to the current scene. To support learning under richer aerial motion, we construct DroneNav-6D, a simulated visual navigation dataset with synchronized RGB observations, 6-DoF flight trajectories, control commands, and randomized wind disturbances. On DroneNav-6D, DroneWAM achieves the best trajectory accuracy among the compared methods. Adaptive rollout further reduces the average prediction depth from 8 to 4.58 while improving trajectory accuracy, demonstrating that predictive computation can be allocated more effectively across scenes. \href{https://github.com/1e12Leon/DroneWAM}{Codes and data} will be released.

AI.tldr: DroneWAM 是一种面向无人机视觉导航的高效 world-action model，基于 JEPA 架构在表征空间建模未来状态，结合 Resampler 压缩特征与自适应 rollout 机制，在 DroneNav-6D 数据集上取得最优轨迹精度并显著降低预测深度。
AI.motivation: 无人机视觉导航对精度和效率要求严苛，而 world-action model 能让智能体预判动作对观测的影响并据此行动；但现有方法需显式生成未来图像，计算开销大，难以满足无人机的实时约束，因此需要一种高效的世界-动作建模方案。
AI.method: 提出 DroneWAM：1) 采用 JEPA 架构直接在表征空间建模未来状态，避免显式生成未来图像；2) 使用预训练 Resampler 将稠密编码器特征压缩为少量 latent token，降低每步想象重复计算；3) 引入自适应 rollout，通过偏好训练的 Gate 根据当前场景自适应分配预测深度；4) 构建 DroneNav-6D 仿真数据集，包含同步 RGB 观测、6-DoF 飞行轨迹、控制指令和随机风扰。
AI.result: 在 DroneNav-6D 上，DroneWAM 在所比较方法中取得最优轨迹精度；自适应 rollout 将平均预测深度从 8 降至 4.58，同时进一步提升轨迹精度，表明预测计算可按场景更有效分配。
AI.conclusion: DroneWAM 通过表征空间建模、特征压缩与自适应计算分配，在无人机视觉导航中兼顾了精度与效率；代码与数据将开源。

title: EdgeVLN: Runtime-Aware Deployment Ready Quantized Vision Language Navigation Model
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) models perform well but target compute-rich platforms, limiting deployment on memory- and power-constrained robotic edge devices. Compression alone does not establish whether a VLN model fits the memory, latency, and energy budgets of an edge platform while preserving navigation behavior. We introduce EdgeVLN, a runtime-aware, deployment-ready quantized VLN model that closes this gap. EdgeVLN combines a quantized StreamVLN model with Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor (LATTE), a lightweight causal transformer that improves real-time stopping by predicting a Stop Action verifier rank. Both execute through our llama.cpp VLN driver, which reconstructs streaming context and prunes memory tokens on-board. We characterize a pretrained StreamVLN backbone across weight quantization from 8 to 2 bits and multiple inference runtimes to identify a feasible operating point. LATTE reuses backbone hidden states within the budget freed by quantization, requiring neither a second vision encoder nor an additional backbone forward pass. We evaluate six backbone precisions and seven candidate stop heads on BF16 and IQ4 NL across all 1,839 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen episodes. We measure success rate (SR) in simulation and latency, energy, and resident memory on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB. LATTE achieves our highest SR, 58.02 percent on the deployed 4-bit model, exceeding the BF16 baseline with only 0.013 s additional latency per navigation step. Four-bit formats achieve nearly identical SR, but step energy varies 36.8 times by execution path. Only IQ4 NL under our VLN driver fits the board, using 11.35 GB resident memory while running 20.8 times faster and using 13.3 times less energy than storage-streamed BF16. INT2 collapses. Runtime selection, memory-token pruning, and quantization are essential for efficient edge deployment.

AI.tldr: EdgeVLN 是一个面向边缘设备的运行时感知量化视觉语言导航（VLN）模型，结合量化 StreamVLN 与轻量因果变换器 LATTE，实现在 Jetson Orin NX 上的高效部署。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLN 模型性能虽好但依赖高算力平台，难以部署于内存和功耗受限的机器人边缘设备；仅靠压缩无法判断模型是否满足边缘平台的内存、延迟与能耗预算，同时保持导航行为。
AI.method: EdgeVLN 将量化 StreamVLN 与 Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor（LATTE）结合，后者是预测 Stop Action verifier rank 的轻量因果变换器，可改善实时停止。二者通过 llama.cpp VLN 驱动执行，在板载重建流式上下文并裁剪记忆 token。对预训练 StreamVLN 主干在 8 至 2 位权重量化及多种推理运行时下进行表征。LATTE 复用主干隐藏状态，无需第二视觉编码器或额外前向传播。在全部 1,839 个 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen 回合上评估六种主干精度和七种候选停止头。
AI.result: LATTE 在部署的 4 位模型上取得最高成功率 58.02%，超过 BF16 基线，每步仅增 0.013 秒延迟。四种 4 位格式成功率几乎相同，但每步能耗因执行路径相差 36.8 倍。仅 IQ4 NL 在 VLN 驱动下适配该板，占用 11.35 GB 常驻内存，比存储流式 BF16 快 20.8 倍、能耗低 13.3 倍。INT2 崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 运行时选择、记忆 token 裁剪与量化是实现高效边缘部署的关键要素。

title: FOCUS: Benchmarking Retinal Model Generalization from Foundation Vision Encoders to Multimodal LLMs
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. Interactive benchmark dashboard: https://huggingface.co/spaces/focus-retina-benchmark/focus-retinal-benchmark-arena
summary: Progress in AI-based retinal image analysis has advanced with foundation models, yet evaluating their reliability remains challenging. Performance reported on a single dataset does not capture how models behave under dataset shift, across clinical definitions, or for different patient subgroups. This limitation is particularly critical in medical imaging analysis, where robustness, calibration, and fairness are essential for safe deployment. We introduce FOCUS (Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift), a cross-dataset benchmark for evaluating retinal fundus models that considers vision-only encoder models (VM), vision-language dual-encoder models (VLM), and multimodal large language models (MLLM). FOCUS harmonizes binary diabetic retinopathy, referable diabetic retinopathy, and glaucomatous optic neuropathy tasks across ten public datasets spanning diverse geographies, acquisition conditions, and label protocols. The benchmark evaluates models through a unified analysis layer that measures ranking performance, calibration, subgroup disparities, and image-quality robustness. We present a large-scale evaluation covering 532 base configurations and 228 MLLM configurations adapted through supervised fine-tuning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). Results show that no model family consistently dominates across tasks and datasets: general VM encoders achieve the strongest average ranking performance, medical MLLMs are competitive but variable, and dual encoder VLMs benefit substantially from lightweight adaptation. Fine-tuning improves in-domain performance but exhibits heterogeneous transfer to external datasets, particularly in calibration. These findings demonstrate that retinal model evaluation is inherently multidimensional. FOCUS provides a practical framework and public benchmark to assess generalization, reliability, and robustness beyond single-dataset leaderboards

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 FOCUS——一个跨数据集视网膜眼底模型基准，涵盖 VM、VLM、MLLM 三类模型，在十套公开数据集上统一评测排序性能、校准度、亚组差异与图像质量鲁棒性，结果表明没有单一模型族能全面占优。
AI.motivation: 现有基于基础模型的视网膜图像分析评测多依赖单一数据集性能，无法反映模型在数据集偏移、临床定义差异和不同患者亚组下的行为。而医学影像对鲁棒性、校准度和公平性要求极高，单一榜单式评测不足以支撑安全部署，因此需要跨数据集的多维评测框架。
AI.method: 提出 FOCUS（Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift）基准，覆盖视觉编码器模型（VM）、视觉-语言双编码器模型（VLM）和多模态大语言模型（MLLM）。统一协调十套公开数据集上的三类任务：二分类糖尿病视网膜病变、需转诊糖尿病视网膜病变和青光眼性视神经病变，数据跨越不同地域、采集条件与标注协议。通过统一分析层评测排序性能、校准度、亚组差异和图像质量鲁棒性，共评估 532 个基础配置与 228 个经 LoRA 监督微调的 MLLM 配置。
AI.result: 没有任何模型族在各任务和数据集上持续占优。通用 VM 编码器平均排序性能最强；医学 MLLM 具有竞争力但表现波动较大；双编码器 VLM 经轻量适配后提升显著。微调能改善域内性能，但向外部数据集迁移表现异质，尤其在校准度方面。
AI.conclusion: 视网膜模型评测本质上是多维度的，FOCUS 提供了实用框架与公开基准，可在单数据集榜单之外评估模型的泛化性、可靠性与鲁棒性。

title: F4R: Failure-Driven Recognition, Reconstruction, Refinement, and Redeployment for Continual Robot Self-Improvement
summary: The real-world performance of current vision-language-action models is fundamentally constrained by the limited coverage of expert demonstrations and their insufficient understanding of physical interactions. A common remedy is to collect additional real-world demonstrations of newly encountered failures. However, this process is costly, inefficient, potentially unsafe, and difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose Failure for Rising (F4R), a failure-driven real-to-sim-to-real closed-loop learning framework that converts real-world failures into targeted policy improvement. F4R first uses an agent to automatically identify and diagnose failures from rollouts. It reconstructs each failure as an interactive, object-centric table-top environment that preserves the task-relevant spatial and physical conditions. The policy is then refined through failure-conditioned sim-real co-training followed by targeted reinforcement learning in the reconstructed environments. The improved policy is subsequently redeployed, while newly observed failures are continuously fed back into the next reconstruction and learning cycle. Real-world evaluations on four manipulation tasks show that F4R achieves 93.75% In-Distribution and 90.0% Out-of-Distribution (OOD) success, outperforming the budget-matched Targeted BC baseline by 18.75 percentage points under OOD conditions without collecting additional real-world corrective demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 提出失败驱动的real-to-sim-to-real闭环学习框架F4R，将真实世界失败转化为针对性策略改进，无需额外收集真实纠正示范。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉-语言-动作模型受限于专家示范覆盖不足及对物理交互理解不充分；常见做法是补充收集新失败的真实示范，但该过程成本高、低效、可能不安全且难以扩展。
AI.method: F4R首先用智能体从rollout中自动识别并诊断失败；将每个失败重建为交互式、以物体为中心的桌面环境，保留任务相关的空间与物理条件；随后通过失败条件化的sim-real协同训练及在重建环境中的针对性强化学习来精炼策略；改进后的策略重新部署，新观察到的失败持续反馈至下一轮重建与学习循环。
AI.result: 在四个操作任务的真实世界评估中，F4R取得93.75%的分布内成功率和90.0%的分布外（OOD）成功率，在OOD条件下较预算匹配的Targeted BC基线高出18.75个百分点，且未收集额外真实纠正示范。
AI.conclusion: 失败驱动的real-to-sim-to-real闭环框架能够有效利用真实失败实现策略持续改进，避免昂贵且难以扩展的真实示范收集，在操作任务中显著提升性能与泛化能力。

title: FloodDiffusion 2: Efficient and Path Controllable Streaming Motion Generation
summary: We present FloodDiffusion 2 (FD2), an efficient and controllable framework that builds upon FloodDiffusion (FD1), a state-of-the-art streaming motion generation model. While FD1 produces plausible motion, it suffers from low efficiency and limited controllability, as its attention design requires repeated computation over the entire history, and it lacks precise trajectory control for real-world applications. To address these limitations and improve generation quality, FD2 introduces three advances. First, Partial Attention makes finalized history representations independent of the active window, enabling KV-cached inference and shared-history packing for efficient training. Second, we establish a necessary-and-sufficient Bregman criterion for regression losses to preserve diffusion's conditional-mean velocity field. This criterion guides an FK-induced quadratic loss that incorporates motion geometry without online FK evaluation. Third, FD2 introduces precise path conditioning to control the character's root trajectory while preserving natural body motion. Experiments show that FD2 reduces training computation by 4.6$\times$ and accelerates denoising by 11.29$\times$, reaching 2.303 ms per update on long sequences. Alongside these efficiency gains, FD2 improves motion quality over FD1 and achieves state-of-the-art FID scores among streaming methods, with 0.048 on SEED and 0.053 on HumanML3D.

AI.tldr: FD2是一个高效可控的流式运动生成框架，通过Partial Attention、Bregman回归准则和路径条件控制，实现4.6倍训练加速、11.29倍去噪加速，并达到流式方法最优FID。
AI.motivation: 现有最优流式运动生成模型FD1虽能生成合理运动，但存在效率低（注意力设计需反复计算整个历史）和可控性差（缺乏精确轨迹控制）的问题，限制了其实际应用。
AI.method: FD2提出三项改进：(1) Partial Attention使已确定的历史表示独立于活动窗口，支持KV缓存推理和共享历史打包训练；(2) 建立回归损失的Bregman必要充分准则以保持扩散的条件均值速度场，并据此设计无需在线FK评估的FK诱导二次损失，以融入运动几何；(3) 引入精确路径条件，在保持自然身体运动的同时控制角色根轨迹。
AI.result: 实验显示FD2将训练计算减少4.6倍，去噪加速11.29倍，长序列每次更新仅需2.303 ms；同时运动质量优于FD1，在流式方法中取得最优FID：SEED上0.048，HumanML3D上0.053。
AI.conclusion: FD2在效率、可控性与生成质量上全面超越FD1，成为流式运动生成领域的新标杆。

title: CollisionSplatting: Collision-Aware Motion Planning in 3DGS Scenes with Image-Conditioned Objectives and Adjustable Conservatism
summary: Incorporating dense visual information into motion planning remains challenging, as geometric planners rely on abstracted scene representations that discard visual richness, while learned visual models often lack geometric interpretability and computational efficiency. This paper introduces CollisionSplatting, a simple, modular, GPU-accelerated, probability-inspired distance metric with tunable conservatism that operates directly on standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes. When combined with learned image-conditioned reward functions, this metric enables joint geometric and visual planning by unifying collision-aware costs with image-space objectives. We integrate the metric into GPU-accelerated Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) and Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree (RRT) planners, and show on-par or better collision-classification performance compared to representative baselines while achieving substantially higher collision-checking throughput and significantly lower VRAM usage. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our metric in real-world vision-guided navigation and manipulation tasks, highlighting 3DGS as a practical bridge between rich perception and real-time motion planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CollisionSplatting，一种直接在 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 场景上运行的 GPU 加速、受概率启发、保守性可调的简单模块化距离度量。将其与学习到的图像条件奖励函数结合，可在统一的框架中实现几何与视觉联合规划。集成到 GPU 加速的 MPPI 与 RRT 规划器后，在碰撞分类性能上与代表性基线相当或更优，同时显著提升碰撞检测吞吐量并降低显存占用。真实世界的视觉引导导航与操作任务验证了其有效性，表明 3DGS 是连接丰富感知与实时运动规划的实用桥梁。
AI.motivation: 将密集视觉信息融入运动规划仍具挑战：几何规划器依赖抽象的场景表示而丢弃了视觉丰富性，而学习到的视觉模型往往缺乏几何可解释性与计算效率。本文旨在弥合这一鸿沟，利用 3DGS 同时提供丰富视觉与几何可解释性，实现实时、碰撞感知的几何-视觉联合规划。
AI.method: 提出 CollisionSplatting：一种直接在标准 3DGS 场景上运行的、简单模块化的 GPU 加速距离度量，受概率启发且保守性可调。该度量与学习到的图像条件奖励函数结合，统一碰撞感知代价与图像空间目标，实现几何与视觉联合规划。度量被集成进 GPU 加速的 MPPI 与 RRT 规划器中。
AI.result: 与代表性基线相比，碰撞分类性能相当或更优；碰撞检测吞吐量大幅提升，显存（VRAM）使用显著降低。在真实世界的视觉引导导航与操作任务中验证了该度量的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CollisionSplatting 表明 3DGS 可作为连接丰富感知与实时运动规划的实用桥梁，兼顾几何可解释性与视觉丰富性，适用于真实机器人导航与操作场景。

title: ABO-Med: Accelerated Bilevel Optimization for Few-Shot Medical Image Classification
summary: In recent years, bilevel optimization has been widely used in a variety of machine learning tasks. However, prior bilevel optimization algorithms generally require the computation of second-order information, which limits their practical scalability. Only recently has a first-order paradigm for bilevel optimization been established, attaining near-optimal theoretical guarantees for solving bilevel optimization problems. In this paper, we propose ABO-Med, a scalable instantiation of this paradigm for few-shot learning, by incorporating it into the model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) framework and tailoring it to medical image classification. We also introduce Medical Adaptive RandomAugment (MedRAug), a modality-aware augmentation strategy designed for medical images. Theoretically, ABO-Med establishes the optimality of MAML-type meta-learning approaches. Empirically, ABO-Med outperforms prior baselines on several public medical datasets, with gains of 1.99% to 18.76%, while MedRAug further improves the average accuracy by 2.20% to 6.34%. Additional cross-domain experiments, augmentation ablation studies, backbone ablation studies, and training efficiency analysis further validate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ABO-Med，将一阶双层优化范式融入MAML框架，用于医学图像小样本分类，并提出模态感知的MedRAug增强策略，理论与实验均验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有双层优化算法多依赖二阶信息，可扩展性差；虽已有取得近优理论保证的一阶范式，但尚缺乏面向医学图像小样本学习的可扩展实例化方案，且医学图像缺乏适配的增强策略。
AI.method: 提出ABO-Med：将该一阶双层优化范式实例化并嵌入MAML元学习框架，针对医学图像分类进行定制；同时提出Medical Adaptive RandomAugment（MedRAug），一种模态感知的医学图像增强策略。
AI.result: 在多个公开医学数据集上，ABO-Med相比基线提升1.99%至18.76%，MedRAug进一步提升平均准确率2.20%至6.34%；跨域实验、增强消融、骨干网络消融及训练效率分析均验证了方法的有效性与高效性。
AI.conclusion: ABO-Med在理论上确立了MAML类元学习方法的（近）最优性，在实践上以可扩展的一阶方式显著提升医学图像小样本分类性能，并配合MedRAug进一步增强效果。

title: Denoising Multi-Robot Trajectories
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO)
summary: Multi-robot trajectory planning is a fundamental problem in multi-robot coordination but remains computationally challenging due to its nonconvex, multimodal, and high-dimensional nature. This work builds upon D4orm, a dynamics-aware diffusion-denoising framework, and develops a family of planning architectures for diverse operational requirements. Unlike conventional numerical optimization methods, D4orm employs sampling-based optimization to generate solution trajectories through massively parallel sampling, leveraging modern computing architectures such as GPUs. Its diffusion-denoising structure iteratively optimizes \textit{deformations} to candidate control trajectories, providing an efficient and versatile paradigm for generating kinodynamically feasible and conflict-free trajectories. Using D4orm as the building block for advanced planners, we present a decoupled planner for improved scalability, an online receding-horizon planner with feedback control, and a distributed planner for resource-constrained settings. Evaluations with differential-drive and holonomic robots in 2D and 3D environments demonstrate that D4orm-based approaches find high-quality solutions faster and more reliably than other sampling-based optimization methods, such as MPPI, as well as a learned diffusion-model-based method. We further demonstrate zero-shot deployment on ten real quadrotors with obstacles, large-scale deconfliction with 100 simulated robots, and fully onboard distributed `lifelong' operation with six ground robots. Overall, these results establish diffusion denoising as a scalable and reliable framework for multi-robot coordination. Code and video: https://github.com/proroklab/d4orm

AI.tldr: 本文在D4orm（动力学感知扩散去噪框架）基础上，提出一系列面向不同需求的多机器人轨迹规划架构，并在仿真与真实机器人上验证其高效性与可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 多机器人轨迹规划本质上是非凸、多模态、高维问题，计算难度大。传统数值优化方法在求解质量与效率上存在局限，而基于采样的优化可借助GPU等并行计算架构提升性能，因此需要一个高效、通用且可扩展的规划范式。
AI.method: 以D4orm为基本构建模块，采用基于采样的优化，通过大规模并行采样生成解轨迹，其扩散-去噪结构迭代优化候选控制轨迹的“形变”，从而生成满足运动动力学约束且无冲突的轨迹。基于此提出三种规划器：解耦式规划器（提升可扩展性）、带反馈控制的在线滚动时域规划器、面向资源受限场景的分布式规划器。
AI.result: 在2D和3D环境下对差速驱动与全向机器人进行评测，D4orm类方法比MPPI等采样优化方法及基于学习扩散模型的方法更快、更可靠地找到高质量解。进一步展示：十个真实四旋翼在障碍环境中的零样本部署、100个仿真机器人的大规模去冲突、六个地面机器人的完全机载分布式“终身”运行。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明扩散去噪是一种可扩展且可靠的多机器人协同框架。代码与视频见 https://github.com/proroklab/d4orm。

title: Can Protein-Derived Knowledge Improve Pathology Foundation Models?
summary: Molecularly guided pathology foundation models (PFMs) exploit transcriptomic or proteomic information to enrich whole-slide image (WSI) representations, yet effectively leveraging large standalone molecular corpora remains challenging. First, existing molecular foundation models encode protein sequences or single-cell states, not the patient-level bulk expression profiles paired with WSIs. Second, because cross-modal supervision is restricted to paired WSI-omics samples, knowledge from standalone molecular corpora reaches the pathology encoder only indirectly, creating a paired-support bottleneck. To address these challenges, we propose a three-stage framework that decouples proteomic knowledge acquisition from cross-modal transfer, yielding ProSlide, a slide-level hierarchical pathology foundation model. First, to close the modality gap, we pretrain a Proteomic Foundation Encoder (PFE) on 12,695 sample-level bulk protein profiles using virtual profile generation and expression-space multi-view pretraining. Second, we pretrain ProSlide, a patch-region-slide encoder, to predict protein expression from paired WSI-protein samples. Third, to relax the paired-support bottleneck, we introduce Prot2Path, a cross-modal relational distillation objective. For each paired sample, it aligns the similarity distributions of the WSI and its protein profile over a shared, frozen bank of PFE-encoded paired and standalone profiles. We evaluate ProSlide on 12 downstream tasks across breast, lung, and renal cancers. Despite being pretrained with only 2,229 WSIs and 12,695 sample-level protein profiles, ProSlide achieves the highest mean accuracy and AUC within each cancer group.

AI.tldr: 提出三阶段框架ProSlide，解耦蛋白质组知识获取与跨模态迁移，在仅用2,229张WSI和12,695份蛋白谱的预训练下，于乳腺、肺、肾癌的12项下游任务中取得最优平均准确率与AUC。
AI.motivation: 分子引导的病理基础模型（PFM）利用转录组或蛋白质组信息丰富全切片图像（WSI）表示，但有效利用大规模独立分子语料仍面临两个挑战：一是现有分子基础模型编码的是蛋白序列或单细胞状态，而非与WSI配对的患者级bulk表达谱；二是跨模态监督仅限配对的WSI-组学样本，使独立分子语料的知识只能间接进入病理编码器，形成"配对支持瓶颈"。
AI.method: 提出三阶段框架，将蛋白质组知识获取与跨模态迁移解耦：1）预训练蛋白质组基础编码器（PFE），在12,695份样本级bulk蛋白谱上使用虚拟谱生成与表达空间多视图预训练，以弥合模态鸿沟；2）预训练ProSlide（patch-region-slide分层编码器），从配对WSI-蛋白样本预测蛋白表达；3）引入Prot2Path跨模态关系蒸馏目标，对每个配对样本，将其WSI及其蛋白谱在一个共享冻结的PFE编码配对的与独立样本库上的相似度分布进行对齐，以缓解配对支持瓶颈。
AI.result: 在乳腺、肺、肾癌的12项下游任务上评估ProSlide。尽管仅用2,229张WSI和12,695份样本级蛋白谱预训练，ProSlide在每个癌种组内均取得最高的平均准确率与AUC。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦蛋白质组知识获取与跨模态迁移，并借助Prot2Path关系蒸馏利用独立分子语料，ProSlide在数据规模有限的条件下仍实现了优越的切片级病理表示性能。

title: MM-ABC: Towards Generalist Mobile Manipulation via Seeing, Coordinating and Imagining
summary: Mobile manipulation extends robot interaction beyond a fixed kinematic workspace by making the reachable region itself controllable. This flexibility introduces two central challenges: spatially grounded perception under continuous ego-motion and coordinated control of heterogeneous arm and base actions. Existing approaches strengthen geometry through explicit 3D representations or predictive world models, and often decouple mobility and manipulation into separate action streams. We argue that effective mobile manipulation requires not only decoupling, but also representations that support efficient cross-stream collaboration. We present MM-ABC, a foundation model built around Seeing, Coordinating, and Imagining Arm-Base Collaboration. MM-ABC combines sparse multi-level VLM features for spatial perception; a training-only future branch that uses world imagination and geometric intent as extra supervision, strengthening perception and manipulation-intent prediction and improving the overall learning signal; and MM-APT, which coordinates separate manipulation and mobility streams through masked joint attention and clean-action x-prediction. In controlled ablations, replacing clean-action prediction with velocity prediction lowers success on RoboCasa365 composite-seen tasks from 32.8% to 29.2%, and removing future supervision or multilevel conditioning causes larger drops. We pretrain MM-ABC on 5,000+ hours of heterogeneous robot data spanning 400K+ episodes, 12 datasets, and 17 embodiments. Experiments cover EBench, RoboCasa365, ManiSkill-HAB, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world mobile manipulation. MM-ABC achieves 44.71% success on EBench, 61.2% on RoboCasa365, 99.1% on LIBERO, 82.8% on LIBERO-Plus without perturbation training, and 83% mean success on five real-world tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MM-ABC，一个面向移动操作的基础模型，围绕"看、协调、想象"三方面实现臂-基座协作，在多个仿真基准和真实任务上取得领先成功率。
AI.motivation: 移动操作将可及工作空间本身变为可控，带来两大挑战：连续自运动下的空间感知，以及异构机械臂与基座动作的协调控制。现有方法多依赖显式3D表示或预测式世界模型增强几何，并把移动与操作解耦为独立动作流；作者认为仅解耦不够，还需支持高效跨流协作的表示。
AI.method: MM-ABC 由三部分组成：1) 融合稀疏多层级 VLM 特征进行空间感知；2) 仅训练期使用的未来分支，以世界想象和几何意图作为额外监督，强化感知与操作意图预测；3) MM-APT，通过掩码联合注意力与干净动作 x-prediction 协调分离的操作流与移动流。
AI.result: 控制变量消融显示：将干净动作预测替换为速度预测会使 RoboCasa365 复合已见任务成功率从 32.8% 降至 29.2%；移除未来监督或多层级条件则下降更大。模型在 5000+ 小时、40 万+ 回合、12 个数据集、17 种本体上预训练。评测结果为：EBench 44.71%、RoboCasa365 61.2%、LIBERO 99.1%、LIBERO-Plus 82.8%（无扰动训练），五个真实任务平均成功率 83%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，跨流协作表示与训练期未来监督对移动操作至关重要，MM-ABC 在仿真与真实场景中均达到领先水平，验证了"看、协调、想象"框架的有效性。

title: FocusDrive: Reasoning with Visual Focus for Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving decisions depend on both where to focus and how to act on what is seen. Effective driving reasoning must establish which objects matter, where they are, and how they inform the intended action. Text-based rationales can describe a driving response while leaving its correspondence to specific visual evidence implicit. Visual focus provides a concrete starting point for this connection by identifying what matters in the scene and where it is. We propose FocusDrive, a structured multimodal reasoning framework that organizes end-to-end planning around explicit visual focus. It pairs descriptions of decision-relevant objects with image-patch references, bringing explicit visual focus into the reasoning that generates driving plans and trajectories. We first assess this focus representation through driver gaze prediction, then investigate its role in planning reasoning using driving-focus annotations within existing NAVSIM training scenes. Experiments on W3DA and NAVSIM demonstrate competitive gaze prediction and end-to-end planning performance, with FocusDrive improving over text-based chain-of-thought. These results support visual focus as an effective link between scene understanding and driving action.

AI.tldr: 提出 FocusDrive 结构化多模态推理框架，围绕显式视觉焦点组织端到端驾驶规划，在 W3DA 与 NAVSIM 上取得有竞争力的凝视预测与规划表现。
AI.motivation: 驾驶决策同时依赖"关注哪里"和"如何依据所见行动"。基于文本的推理链条虽能描述驾驶响应，却无法显式建立与具体视觉证据的对应关系；视觉焦点则能通过指出场景中重要目标及其位置，提供这一连接的起点。
AI.method: FocusDrive 将决策相关物体的描述与图像块（image-patch）引用配对，把显式视觉焦点引入生成驾驶规划与轨迹的推理过程。先用驾驶员凝视预测评估该焦点表示，再利用 NAVSIM 训练场景中的驾驶焦点标注，考察其在规划推理中的作用。
AI.result: 在 W3DA 和 NAVSIM 上的实验显示，凝视预测与端到端规划均具竞争力，FocusDrive 优于基于文本的思维链方法。
AI.conclusion: 视觉焦点可作为连接场景理解与驾驶动作的有效桥梁。

title: Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning
summary: Robots that learn from a few demonstrations often require two forms of generalization. Compositional generalization recombines skills to solve new tasks, and skill generalization lets the learned policy behind each skill work in new situations. The two depend on each other, yet information is lost between composition and the skills it calls. Where a skill works is determined by the structure its policy is trained with, while composition sees the skill only through a separate description, such as a name, an instruction, or a symbolic operator, that omits this structure. Our key idea is to use each policy's structural prior as part of the interface between composition and the skill. A structural prior states what a behavior depends on, for example that a grasp depends only on the gripper's pose relative to the object. Built into training, it shapes where the policy generalizes; stated in language, it tells composition where the policy applies. We instantiate this idea in Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning (APPL). A construction agent segments complete demonstrations into reusable skills, proposes several structural priors for each skill, and trains and verifies one policy per prior. A runtime agent then selects among these prior-specific policies and composes them toward new task goals using their interfaces. Across MetaWorld and long-horizon ManiSkill tasks, APPL improves out-of-distribution skill generalization and enables previously unseen skill compositions; ablating the interface information substantially reduces performance. These results support the use of training-time structural assumptions as a bridge between skill learning and skill composition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将策略的结构先验作为技能组合与技能学习之间的接口，并在 APPL 框架中实现，提升了分布外技能泛化与新颖技能组合能力。
AI.motivation: 少样本演示学习需要组合泛化（重组技能解决新任务）与技能泛化（学到的策略适应新情境），二者相互依赖。但组合层只看技能的描述（名称、指令、符号算子），丢失了决定技能适用范围的策略结构信息。作者希望用结构先验弥合这一信息鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出 Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning (APPL)。构建智能体将完整演示切分为可复用技能，为每个技能提出多个结构先验，并针对每个先验训练与验证一个策略；运行时智能体依据先验接口选择相应策略，并组合它们完成新任务。
AI.result: 在 MetaWorld 与长时程 ManiSkill 任务上，APPL 提升了分布外技能泛化，并实现了此前未见的技能组合；消融接口信息会显著降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 训练时的结构假设可作为连接技能学习与技能组合的桥梁，验证了结构先验作为组合接口的有效性。

title: ReAL: Accelerating Flow Matching through Segment Advancement with Shared Lookahead
summary: Flow-matching models generate high-quality images and videos, but repeated neural network evaluations make sampling expensive. Skipping evaluations reduces this cost by extending an available velocity estimate over a longer span. However, local velocity agreement alone does not determine a suitable span, and checking each candidate endpoint adds costly model calls. We introduce ReAL, a training-free sampler that selects how far to advance using one shared lookahead. Our key insight is that the discrepancy between uncorrected and lookahead-corrected endpoint proposals can be computed directly from the observed velocity mismatch and the candidate span beyond the lookahead. This relation provides a span-dependent selection criterion without additional endpoint evaluations. The same lookahead selects the longest passing candidate span, corrects the accepted update, and supplies its velocity as the next starting estimate. After initialization, each regular iteration requires only one fresh evaluation. ReAL uses the pretrained velocity output and original noise schedule, with no additional training or access to internal features. Experiments cover four image-generation backbones, video generation, and image editing. ReAL achieves 4.91x measured speedup on FLUX.1-dev while retaining 97.0% of dense mean ImageReward. On HunyuanVideo, it achieves a 5.49x speedup while maintaining a VBench score close to that of dense sampling.

AI.tldr: ReAL 是一种免训练采样器，通过共享单次前瞻（lookahead）估计可跨越的最大速度区间，在不增加端点评估的情况下加速流匹配生成。
AI.motivation: 流匹配模型生成质量高但采样需反复调用神经网络、开销昂贵。跳过部分评估可降本，但仅凭局部速度一致性难以确定合适的跨越跨度，而逐一校验候选端点又会引入额外模型调用。
AI.method: 提出免训练采样器 ReAL，核心是只用一次共享前瞻：利用观测到的速度失配与候选跨度直接计算“未校正端点提议”与“前瞻校正端点提议”之间的差异，从而得到与跨度相关的选择准则，无需额外端点评估。同一前瞻用于选择最长可通过的候选跨度、校正被接受的更新，并将其速度作为下一步起始估计；初始化后每次常规迭代仅需一次新评估。仅使用预训练速度输出与原始噪声调度，无需额外训练或访问内部特征。
AI.result: 在四个图像生成骨干、视频生成与图像编辑上验证。FLUX.1-dev 实测加速 4.91x，保留 97.0% 稠密采样的平均 ImageReward；HunyuanVideo 加速 5.49x，VBench 分数接近稠密采样。
AI.conclusion: ReAL 通过单次前瞻驱动的跨度选择准则，在免训练、免内部特征的前提下显著加速流匹配采样，并在图像、视频与编辑任务中保持接近稠密采样的生成质量。

title: LQR-ArUco Fusion: Robust Hierarchical Control for Navigation and Asymmetric Manipulation in Two-Wheeled Robots
comment: 6 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Navigation and Systems (CINS), Dubai, UAE
summary: We propose a hierarchical control framework to address severe dynamic instabilities and navigational drift that arise when a two-wheeled inverted pendulum (TWIP) robot attempts asymmetric object manipulation. While two-wheeled platforms are highly manoeuvrable, their constant balancing adjustments make onboard odometry highly unreliable for precise navigation. Furthermore, the addition of a side-mounted robotic arm introduces unactuated lateral roll moments when a payload is lifted, a challenge heavily compounded on uneven terrain. To solve these coupled problems, our architecture divides the workload. An offboard vision system tracks overhead ArUco markers to provide high-latency global waypoint navigation, bypassing odometry drift. Simultaneously, a low-latency onboard control loop rejects active physical disturbances using inertial and encoder data. In our physical experiments, this dual-loop approach enabled the custom-built robot to navigate accurately, reject transient impacts from speed bumps, adapt to a dynamic seesaw ramp, and carry a payload securely without falling over its narrow wheelbase.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层控制框架，解决两轮倒立摆（TWIP）机器人在非对称物体操作时的严重动态失稳与导航漂移问题：离板视觉用ArUco标记提供低频全局航点导航，板载低延迟控制回路用惯性/编码器数据抑制扰动，实验验证了机器人可精准导航、抗冲击、适应动态跷跷板斜坡并稳定搬运负载。
AI.motivation: 两轮倒立摆机器人机动性高，但持续平衡调整导致板载里程计不可靠，难以精准导航；侧挂机械臂抬升负载时会产生未驱动的横向滚转力矩，在崎岖地形上问题被进一步放大。因此需要同时解决导航漂移与动态失稳这两个耦合难题。
AI.method: 提出分层（双回路）控制架构，将任务分工：离板视觉系统追踪顶部ArUco标记，提供高延迟的全局航点导航以绕开里程计漂移；同时板载低延迟控制回路利用惯性测量与编码器数据，主动抑制物理扰动。
AI.result: 在实物实验中，该双回路方法使自研机器人实现了精准导航，能够抵御减速带带来的瞬态冲击、适应动态跷跷板斜坡，并在狭窄轮距下安全搬运负载而不倾倒。
AI.conclusion: 分层控制架构有效解耦导航与动态稳定问题，验证了TWIP机器人在非对称负载操作与复杂地形下的可行性。

title: Structured Residual Connectivity Matters for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have established themselves as a scalable backbone for high-fidelity image synthesis. However, unlike U-Net based diffusion models that rely on rigid, hand-crafted skip connections, DiTs predominantly use a uniform residual stream that integrates all preceding layers as a monolithic state. In this work, we rethink residual connections in diffusion transformers and propose to transform them from passive summation into an active retrieval mechanism optimized for image denoising. First, we conduct a systematic analysis of DiT's internal representation, revealing a latent preference for early-layer feature reuse and symmetric layer guidance. Motivated by this, we introduce a structured connectivity design that explicitly integrates local residual connections with long-range pathways. Instead of static skip connections or dense all-layer routing, our method enables each transformer block to selectively ``attend'' to critical earlier representations, dynamically retrieving spatial and semantic cues through direct, differentiable cross-depth paths. Experiments show that our adaptive connectivity leads to faster convergence, with up to $1.73\times$ fewer training iterations, and significant gains in FID and visual quality with less than $0.1\%$ additional parameters, further improving a strong REPA-XL/2 model from $5.9$ to $4.34$ FID without guidance and reaching $1.39$ FID with classifier-free guidance. Our findings suggest that adaptive cross-layer connectivity is a critical yet underexplored factor in diffusion transformers, and that incorporating structured information pathways provides a simple and effective direction for improving scalable generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视扩散Transformer（DiT）中的残差连接，将其从被动求和改造为面向图像去噪的主动检索机制，提出结构化跨层连接设计，在几乎不增加参数的情况下实现更快收敛与显著FID提升。
AI.motivation: DiT已成为高保真图像生成的可扩展骨干，但与依赖手工跳跃连接的U-Net扩散模型不同，DiT主要使用统一的残差流，将前面所有层整合为单一状态，缺乏结构化的信息通路。作者认为跨层连接这一因素被严重忽视，希望通过分析DiT内部表示并重新设计残差连接来提升生成质量与训练效率。
AI.method: 首先系统分析DiT内部表示，发现其对早期层特征复用和对称层引导存在潜在偏好。基于此提出结构化连接设计，将局部残差连接与长程通路相结合，使每个transformer块能够选择性地"关注"关键的早期表示，通过直接、可微的跨深度路径动态检索空间与语义线索，而非静态跳跃连接或稠密全层路由。
AI.result: 自适应连接带来更快收敛，训练迭代最多减少1.73倍；在额外参数不足0.1%的情况下，FID和视觉质量显著提升；将强基线REPA-XL/2在无引导下从5.9 FID提升至4.34，在有分类器自由引导下达到1.39 FID。
AI.conclusion: 自适应跨层连接是扩散Transformer中关键但尚未充分探索的因素，引入结构化信息通路为改进可扩展生成模型提供了简单而有效的方向。

title: Humanoid Loco-Manipulation With Discrete VLA Model
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models using discrete action tokens have proven effective for controling robotic arms on manipulation tasks. For a humanoid, however, the whole-body action space -- legs, torso, arms, and hands -- is far higher-dimensional and heterogeneous, raising tokenization, training, and real-time inference challenges that the previous VLA models do not address. We present Holo-M, to our knowledge the first discrete VLA model for humanoid loco-manipulation that intrinsically exploits the language model by extending its vocabulary with action tokens.
